teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who is adult has reached adulthood and is no longer a child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人已经成年，不再是儿童。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li laħqet l-età adulta u m'għadhiex tifel jew tifla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已成年的；用于描述已经进入成年阶段的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jintuża biex jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li laħaq l-età adulta u m'għadux tifel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person described as adult has reached adulthood and is no longer a child.

formal.mt: Kull tifel għandu jkun akkumpanjat minn persuna adulta waqt iż-żjara.
formal.en: Every child must be accompanied by an adult person during the visit.
formal.zh: 参观期间，每个孩子都必须有一名成年人陪同。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Jista' ħija ż-żgħir jiġi magħna? Mark: Iva, imma jrid jiġi ma' xi ħadd adult.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can my little brother come with us? Mark: Yes, but he needs to come with someone who is an adult.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我弟弟可以跟我们一起去吗？马克：可以，但他得有个成年人陪着来。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我弟弟可以跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Can my little brother come with us?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma jrid jiġi ma' xi ħadd adult.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma jrid jiġi ma' xi ħadd adult.
messages.zh: 可以，但他得有个成年人陪着来。
messages.en: Yes, but he needs to come with someone who is an adult.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 adult 放进 raġel adult“成年男子”一起记，再用 persuna adulta“成年人”提醒自己留意形容词形式的变化。

gloss_zh: 通奸；婚内与配偶以外的人发生性关系

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sexual relations between a married person and someone other than their spouse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已婚者与其配偶以外的人发生性关系的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Relazzjoni sesswali bejn persuna miżżewġa u xi ħadd li mhuwiex il-konjuġi tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通奸，即已婚者与配偶以外的人发生性关系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att ta' persuna miżżewġa li jkollha relazzjoni sesswali ma' xi ħadd li mhuwiex il-konjuġi tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Adultery occurs when a married person has sexual relations with someone other than their spouse.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-adulterju tal-protagonist iwassal għal kriżi fiż-żwieġ tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist's adultery leads to a crisis in his marriage.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，主人公的通奸行为导致了他的婚姻危机。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser 'adulterju' f'dan ir-rumanz? Lara: Ifisser li persuna miżżewġa jkollha relazzjoni sesswali ma' xi ħadd li mhuwiex il-konjuġi tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'adulterju' mean in this novel? Lara: It means that a married person has sexual relations with someone other than their spouse.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这部小说里的 adulterju 是什么意思？拉拉：指已婚者与配偶以外的人发生性关系。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 这部小说里的 adulterju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'adulterju' mean in this novel?

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li persuna miżżewġa jkollha relazzjoni sesswali ma' xi ħadd li mhuwiex il-konjuġi tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li persuna miżżewġa jkollha relazzjoni sesswali ma' xi ħadd li mhuwiex il-konjuġi tagħha.
messages.zh: 指已婚者与配偶以外的人发生性关系。
messages.en: It means that a married person has sexual relations with someone other than their spouse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“已婚者—配偶以外的人—性关系”三个要点记住 adulterju；它指具体的通奸行为，不能泛指所有感情矛盾。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To know a fact, be aware of something, or have a thorough knowledge of a subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 知道某个事实，意识到某种情况，或对某个领域有深入了解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollok tagħrif dwar fatt, tkun konxju ta' xi ħaġa, jew ikollok għarfien tajjeb ta' suġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 知道；掌握某个事实或某项信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikollok tagħrif dwar xi ħaġa u tkun taf x'inhi jew kif inhi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you know something, you have information about it and understand it as a fact.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 意识到某事；知悉某种情况的存在。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tkun konxju li xi ħaġa teżisti jew li hemm ċerta sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are aware of something, you know that it exists or is happening.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通晓某事；熟悉某个领域并具备相应知识。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikollok għarfien wiesa' u tajjeb ta' suġġett jew ta' qasam partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are versed in a subject, you have a thorough knowledge of that subject.

formal.mt: Qabel tibda l-esperiment, kun af sewwa l-proċedura u r-regoli tas-sigurtà.
formal.en: Before starting the experiment, make sure you know the procedure and the safety rules thoroughly.
formal.zh: 开始实验之前，务必充分了解操作程序和安全规则。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se niltaqgħu fil-ħamsa? Pawlu: Iva, imma kun af li nista' nasal ftit tard. Maja: Tajjeb, nistenniek ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are we meeting at five? Pawlu: Yes, but be aware that I might arrive a little late. Maja: All right, I'll wait for you by the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们五点见吗？保罗：对，不过要先告诉你，我可能会晚到一会儿。玛雅：好，我在门口等你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们五点见吗？
messages.en: Are we meeting at five?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma kun af li nista' nasal ftit tard.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma kun af li nista' nasal ftit tard.
messages.zh: 对，不过要先告诉你，我可能会晚到一会儿。
messages.en: Yes, but be aware that I might arrive a little late.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我在门口等你。
messages.en: All right, I'll wait for you by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项串成“知道一个事实—意识到一种情况—通晓一个领域”；再用 kun af li（要知道……）整块记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have applied pressure to something, for example by pushing a button or a pedal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示对某物施加了压力，例如按下按钮或踩下踏板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika azzjoni li fiha saret pressjoni fuq xi ħaġa, bħal buttuna jew pedala.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按了；压了，表示对某物施加了压力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li saret pressjoni fuq oġġett biex jiċċaqlaq, jinżamm f'postu, jew jitħaddem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone pressed something, they applied pressure to it with a hand, foot, or another object.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-vokabularju, 'afast' jindika li saret pressjoni fuq xi ħaġa, bħal meta tingħafas buttuna.
formal.en: In the vocabulary exercise, 'afast' indicates that pressure was applied to something, as when a button is pressed.
formal.zh: 在这道词汇练习中，afast 表示对某物施加了压力，例如按下按钮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser 'afast' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Lara: Ifisser li saret pressjoni fuq xi ħaġa. Aħseb f'buttuna li tagħfas b'subgħajk. Maja: Issa fhimt: bħal meta nagħfas il-buttuna tal-lift.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'afast' mean in this exercise? Lara: It means that pressure was applied to something. Think of a button you press with your finger. Maja: Now I understand: like when I press the lift button.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这道练习里的 afast 是什么意思？拉拉：表示对某物施加了压力。想想用手指按按钮的动作。玛雅：现在懂了，就像我按电梯按钮的时候。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这道练习里的 afast 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'afast' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li saret pressjoni fuq xi ħaġa. Aħseb f'buttuna li tagħfas b'subgħajk.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li saret pressjoni fuq xi ħaġa. Aħseb f'buttuna li tagħfas b'subgħajk.
messages.zh: 表示对某物施加了压力。想想用手指按按钮的动作。
messages.en: It means that pressure was applied to something. Think of a button you press with your finger.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa fhimt: bħal meta nagħfas il-buttuna tal-lift.
messages.mt_standard: Issa fhimt: bħal meta nagħfas il-buttuna tal-lift.
messages.zh: 现在懂了，就像我按电梯按钮的时候。
messages.en: Now I understand: like when I press the lift button.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 afast 与“手指已经按下按钮”的画面相连，记住“按了、压了”的动作义；这个画面只帮助记义，不用于推断词根或其他变位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The final breath a person takes immediately before dying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人在死亡前呼出的或吸入的最后一口气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-aħħar nifs li persuna tieħu qabel ma tmut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 临终前的最后一口气；死亡之前的最后一次呼吸。
sense_translations.mt_definition: In-nifs finali ta' persuna fil-waqt ta' qabel il-mewt tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person's affan is the final breath they take immediately before they die.

collocations.zh: 在咽下最后一口气之前

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-familja tinġabar madwar is-sodda tar-raġel qabel l-affan tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the family gathers around the man's bed before his final breath.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，家人在那名男子咽下最后一口气之前围聚在他的床边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'affan' f'din l-istorja? Lara: Tfisser l-aħħar nifs qabel il-mewt. Maja: Allura mhijiex sempliċement nifs wara ġirja. Lara: Eżatt, hawn qed nitkellmu dwar l-aħħar nifs ta' persuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'affan' mean in this story? Lara: It means the last breath before death. Maja: So it isn't simply a breath after a run. Lara: Exactly, here we are talking about a person's final breath.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个故事里的 affan 是什么意思？拉拉：指临终前的最后一口气。玛雅：所以不是跑完步后普通的一次呼吸。拉拉：对，这里说的是一个人生命中的最后一次呼吸。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 affan 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'affan' mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.zh: 指临终前的最后一口气。
messages.en: It means the last breath before death.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura mhijiex sempliċement nifs wara ġirja.
messages.mt_standard: Allura mhijiex sempliċement nifs wara ġirja.
messages.zh: 所以不是跑完步后普通的一次呼吸。
messages.en: So it isn't simply a breath after a run.

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Eżatt, hawn qed nitkellmu dwar l-aħħar nifs ta' persuna.
messages.mt_standard: Eżatt, hawn qed nitkellmu dwar l-aħħar nifs ta' persuna.
messages.zh: 对，这里说的是一个人生命中的最后一次呼吸。
messages.en: Exactly, here we are talking about a person's final breath.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“生命终点前，最后一口气”的画面记住 affan，牢牢记住“临终”和“最后”两个限定，不把它泛记成普通呼吸。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A situation, event, or matter that someone is discussing or dealing with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们谈论、处理或经历的某种情况、事件或事务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni, ġrajja jew kwistjoni li xi ħadd ikun qiegħed jitkellem dwarha jew jieħu ħsiebha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某一时刻存在的情况或局面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qagħda jew sett ta' ċirkustanzi li fihom jinsabu persuna jew grupp f'ħin partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An affari is a situation involving circumstances that people must understand or deal with.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生的一件事或一次事件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tiġri f'ħin jew f'post partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An affari is something that happens on a particular occasion.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 需要关注、讨论或处理的一件事务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwistjoni jew biċċa xogħol li tkun teħtieġ attenzjoni, diskussjoni jew azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An affari is a matter or business that concerns someone and may require attention.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-affari bħala kwistjoni serja li teħtieġ investigazzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes the affair as a serious matter requiring investigation.
formal.zh: 报告将此事描述为一件需要调查的严重事务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara bil-bieb? Mark: Infetaħ waħdu darbtejn. Maja: Din affari stramba!
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened with the door? Mark: It opened by itself twice. Maja: That's a strange thing!
colloquial.zh: Maja：门怎么了？Mark：它自己开了两次。Maja：这可真是件怪事！

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 门怎么了？
messages.en: What happened with the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 它自己开了两次。
messages.en: It opened by itself twice.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这可真是件怪事！
messages.en: That's a strange thing!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 affari 放进三个中文提问里记：什么情况、发生什么事、什么事务；共同核心都是正在谈论的那件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be deeply interested in and strongly attracted by someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被某人或某物深深吸引，产生强烈兴趣而着迷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun miġbud ħafna lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa u jħoss interess qawwi fihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被某人或某物深深吸引，感到十分着迷。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikun tant interessat f'xi ħadd jew f'xi ħaġa li jagħtihom ħafna attenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is affaxxonat, something interests or attracts them so strongly that it holds their attention.

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara fil-mużew, l-istudent kien affaxxonat bl-istorja tal-gżejjer Maltin.
formal.en: During the museum visit, the student was fascinated by the history of the Maltese islands.
formal.zh: 参观博物馆时，这名学生被马耳他群岛的历史深深吸引。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għoġbok il-mużew? Pawlu: Iva, kont affaxxonat bil-vapuri l-qodma. Lara: Mela nerġgħu mmorru!
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you like the museum? Pawlu: Yes, I was fascinated by the old ships. Lara: Then let's go again!
colloquial.zh: Lara：你喜欢那个博物馆吗？Pawlu：喜欢，我被那些古老的船深深吸引了。Lara：那我们再去一次吧！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢那个博物馆吗？
messages.en: Did you like the museum?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 喜欢，我被那些古老的船深深吸引了。
messages.en: Yes, I was fascinated by the old ships.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们再去一次吧！
messages.en: Then let's go again!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 affaxxonat 时想象参观博物馆看得入迷、久久不愿离开的画面，把词义连到强烈吸引注意力的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Behaving or sounding deliberately unnatural in order to create an impression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为给人某种印象而刻意表现得不自然、显得做作的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu jew jinstema' b'mod mhux naturali biex jagħti impressjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指言语、举止或表达刻意装出来，显得做作而不自然的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri nuqqas ta' naturalezza fil-kliem, fl-imġiba jew fl-espressjoni minħabba sforz biex jagħti impressjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone's manner or speech is affettat, it seems deliberately unnatural and intended to impress other people.

formal.mt: Il-kritiku nnota li t-ton affettat tad-diskors naqqas il-kredibbiltà tal-kelliem.
formal.en: The critic noted that the affected tone of the speech reduced the speaker's credibility.
formal.zh: 评论者指出，演讲中做作的语气削弱了演讲者的可信度。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif deherlek it-ton tiegħi fil-vidjo? Samwel: Ftit affettat. Tkellem bħas-soltu. Nina: Sewwa, nerġa' nipprova.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did you think of my tone in the video? Samwel: A little affected. Speak the way you usually do. Nina: Okay, I'll try again.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你觉得我在视频里的语气怎么样？Samwel：有点做作。像平时那样说话就好。Nina：好，我再试一次。

messages.speaker: Nina (视频创作者)
messages.zh: 你觉得我在视频里的语气怎么样？
messages.en: What did you think of my tone in the video?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.zh: 有点做作。像平时那样说话就好。
messages.en: A little affected. Speak the way you usually do.

messages.speaker: Nina (视频创作者)
messages.zh: 好，我再试一次。
messages.en: Okay, I'll try again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 affettat 和刻意拿腔拿调的声音配对记忆：本条强调表现做作；可用 ton affettat 反复联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Changed, influenced, or harmed by an event, condition, or action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某个事件、状况或行为而受到影响、发生变化或遭受损害的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ġarrab bidla, influwenza jew ħsara minħabba ġrajja, kundizzjoni jew azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到外部事件、状况或行为影响的；也可指受到不利波及或损害的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun intlaqat minn xi ġrajja, kundizzjoni jew azzjoni u jkun ġarrab xi effett minħabba fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is affettwat, an event or condition has produced a change or effect on them.

formal.mt: Is-servizz tal-laneċ kien affettwat mill-maltemp, u diversi vjaġġi ġew ikkanċellati.
formal.en: The ferry service was affected by the bad weather, and several crossings were cancelled.
formal.zh: 渡轮服务受到恶劣天气影响，多个航次被取消。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex wasalt tard? David: It-traffiku kien affettwat minn inċident. Sara: Issa nifhem. Ejja, għadna fil-ħin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you arrive late? David: Traffic was affected by an accident. Sara: Now I understand. Come on, we still have time.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么迟到了？David：交通受到了一起事故的影响。Sara：现在我明白了。走吧，我们还来得及。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive late?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.zh: 交通受到了一起事故的影响。
messages.en: Traffic was affected by an accident.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 现在我明白了。走吧，我们还来得及。
messages.en: Now I understand. Come on, we still have time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 affettwat 时画一条因果箭头：恶劣天气指向渡轮停航；箭头终点就是受到影响的人或事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: They influenced someone or something, or caused a change in them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示他们或它们在过去对某人或某事产生了影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma verbali li tindika li huma kellhom effett fuq xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa fil-passat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 影响了；表示复数主语在过去对某人或某事产生了作用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li persuni, affarijiet jew ġrajjiet kellhom effett fuq xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa fil-passat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If events or actions affected someone or something, they influenced them or changed their situation.

formal.mt: Il-bidliet fl-iskeda affettwaw il-ħinijiet tal-wasla tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The changes to the timetable affected the students' arrival times.
formal.zh: 时间表的变动影响了学生们的到达时间。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-bidliet fil-ħinijiet tal-karozzi tal-linja affettwaw il-vjaġġ tiegħek? Pawlu: Iva, issa nasal id-dar nofs siegħa wara.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did the changes to the bus times affect your journey? Pawlu: Yes, now I get home half an hour later.
colloquial.zh: Marija：公交车时刻的变动影响了你的行程吗？Pawlu：是啊，我现在晚半小时才到家。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bidliet fil-ħinijiet tal-karozzi tal-linja affettwaw il-vjaġġ tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Il-bidliet fil-ħinijiet tal-karozzi tal-linja affettwaw il-vjaġġ tiegħek?
messages.zh: 公交车时刻的变动影响了你的行程吗？
messages.en: Did the changes to the bus times affect your journey?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa nasal id-dar nofs siegħa wara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa nasal id-dar nofs siegħa wara.
messages.zh: 是啊，我现在晚半小时才到家。
messages.en: Yes, now I get home half an hour later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 affettwaw 配上“几项变动已经影响了生活”的画面，连同复数主语和过去发生的影响一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be trusted to work properly, provide accurate information, or do what is expected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 值得信赖的；能够正常运作、提供准确信息或按预期完成事情的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tista' tafda fih għax jagħmel dak li hu mistenni minnu, jaħdem sew jew jagħti informazzjoni korretta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可靠的；指人、事物或信息值得信任，可以放心依赖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna, ħaġa jew informazzjoni li tista' tafda fiha u toqgħod fuqha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is reliable can be trusted to do what is expected or to provide correct information.

formal.mt: Għal dan ir-rapport, għandna bżonn sors affidabbli li jipprovdi informazzjoni preċiża.
formal.en: For this report, we need a reliable source that provides accurate information.
formal.zh: 撰写这份报告时，我们需要一个能够提供准确信息的可靠来源。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taf lil xi ħadd affidabbli li jista' jsewwili l-karozza? Mark: Iva, il-mekkanik tiegħi dejjem jagħmel xogħol tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you know someone reliable who can fix my car? Mark: Yes, my mechanic always does a good job.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你认识能帮我修车的可靠师傅吗？Mark：认识，我的修车师傅每次都修得很好。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf lil xi ħadd affidabbli li jista' jsewwili l-karozza?
messages.mt_standard: Taf lil xi ħadd affidabbli li jista' jsewwili l-karozza?
messages.zh: 你认识能帮我修车的可靠师傅吗？
messages.en: Do you know someone reliable who can fix my car?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-mekkanik tiegħi dejjem jagħmel xogħol tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-mekkanik tiegħi dejjem jagħmel xogħol tajjeb.
messages.zh: 认识，我的修车师傅每次都修得很好。
messages.en: Yes, my mechanic always does a good job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想到每次都准时完成工作的师傅，就用 affidabbli 评价他；把这个词和“可以放心依靠”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small insects that suck sap from plants and can damage them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蚜虫；吸食植物汁液、可能损害植物的小型昆虫，此处为复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insetti żgħar li jerdgħu l-meraq tal-pjanti u jistgħu jagħmlulhom il-ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蚜虫；一类以植物汁液为食的小型昆虫，常聚集在嫩梢或叶片上，此词表示复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Insetti żgħar li jgħixu fuq il-pjanti, spiss fuq il-weraq jew ir-rimjiet ġodda, u jerdgħu l-meraq tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Aphids are small insects that feed by sucking sap from plants, often gathering on leaves or young shoots.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni tal-ġnien, instabu afidi fuq il-weraq u r-rimjiet ġodda tal-pjanti.
formal.en: During the garden inspection, aphids were found on the plants' leaves and young shoots.
formal.zh: 检查花园时，人们在植物的叶片和嫩梢上发现了蚜虫。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhuma dawn l-insetti żgħar fuq il-ward? Toni: Dawk huma afidi. Ara kemm hemm taħt din il-werqa!
colloquial.en: Nina: What are these little insects on the roses? Toni: Those are aphids. Look how many there are under this leaf!
colloquial.zh: Nina：玫瑰上的这些小虫是什么？Toni：那些是蚜虫。看，这片叶子下面有这么多！

messages.speaker: Nina (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhuma dawn l-insetti żgħar fuq il-ward?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhuma dawn l-insetti żgħar fuq il-ward?
messages.zh: 玫瑰上的这些小虫是什么？
messages.en: What are these little insects on the roses?

messages.speaker: Toni (园艺朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawk huma afidi. Ara kemm hemm taħt din il-werqa!
messages.mt_standard: Dawk huma afidi. Ara kemm hemm taħt din il-werqa!
messages.zh: 那些是蚜虫。看，这片叶子下面有这么多！
messages.en: Those are aphids. Look how many there are under this leaf!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 afidi 时想象翻开一片叶子，下面挤着一群吸食汁液的蚜虫；用“一群”的画面记住复数意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming from Africa or relating to its people, places, or cultures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自非洲的，或与非洲的人民、地域及文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Afrika jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Afrika, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kulturi tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非洲的；用来描述源自非洲或与非洲有关的人或事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna jew ħaġa li ġejja mill-Afrika jew li għandha rabta ma' dan il-kontinent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as African comes from Africa or has a connection with the continent and its people.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Africa
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自非洲的，或属于、涉及非洲的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu l-oriġini tiegħu fl-Afrika jew li jirrigwarda lil dan il-kontinent u lin-nies tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or thing that is African originates in Africa or is associated with the continent.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina t-tkabbir tal-popolazzjoni f'pajjiż Afrikan matul l-aħħar għaxar snin.
formal.en: The study examines population growth in an African country over the last ten years.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察了一个非洲国家在过去十年间的人口增长情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema pajjiż Afrikan tixtieq iżżur? David: Nixtieq inżur il-Kenja u nara l-annimali hemmhekk.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which African country would you like to visit? David: I'd like to visit Kenya and see the animals there.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你想去哪个非洲国家旅行？David：我想去肯尼亚，看看那里的动物。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想去哪个非洲国家旅行？
messages.en: Which African country would you like to visit?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq inżur il-Kenja u nara l-annimali hemmhekk.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq inżur il-Kenja u nara l-annimali hemmhekk.
messages.zh: 我想去肯尼亚，看看那里的动物。
messages.en: I'd like to visit Kenya and see the animals there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 afrikan 和英语 African 并排做词卡，再配上非洲地图；用“一个非洲国家”练习它修饰名词的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entity that brings together electricity resources so that their output or consumption can be adjusted for redispatching.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 汇集多个电力资源，使其发电量或用电量能够协调调整以参与再调度的主体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entità li tiġbor flimkien diversi riżorsi tal-elettriku sabiex il-produzzjoni jew il-konsum tagħhom ikunu jistgħu jiġu aġġustati b'mod koordinat għar-ridispaċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将多个电力资源汇集起来，通过协调调整发电或用电参与再调度的聚合主体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Aggregatur għar-ridispaċċ huwa entità li tiġbor flimkien riżorsi tal-elettriku u tikkoordina bidliet fil-produzzjoni jew fil-konsum tagħhom għall-finijiet tar-ridispaċċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A redispatching aggregator combines electricity resources and coordinates changes in their generation or consumption for redispatching.

collocations.en: an agreement with a redispatching aggregator
collocations.zh: 与再调度聚合商签订的协议

collocations.en: the services of a redispatching aggregator
collocations.zh: 再调度聚合商提供的服务

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jiddeskrivi kif l-aggregatur għar-ridispaċċ għandu jikkoordina l-aġġustamenti fil-konsum tar-riżorsi parteċipanti.
formal.en: The agreement describes how the redispatching aggregator is to coordinate adjustments in the consumption of participating resources.
formal.zh: 协议说明了再调度聚合商应如何协调参与资源的用电调整。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'jagħmel aggregatur għar-ridispaċċ? Lara: Jiġbor flimkien diversi riżorsi tal-elettriku u jikkoordina bidliet fil-produzzjoni jew fil-konsum tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does a redispatching aggregator do? Lara: It brings together several electricity resources and coordinates changes in their generation or consumption.
colloquial.zh: 马克：再调度聚合商是做什么的？拉拉：它把多个电力资源汇集起来，协调它们的发电或用电调整。

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.zh: 再调度聚合商是做什么的？
messages.en: What does a redispatching aggregator do?

messages.speaker: Lara (培训师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġbor flimkien diversi riżorsi tal-elettriku u jikkoordina bidliet fil-produzzjoni jew fil-konsum tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġbor flimkien diversi riżorsi tal-elettriku u jikkoordina bidliet fil-produzzjoni jew fil-konsum tagħhom.
messages.zh: 它把多个电力资源汇集起来，协调它们的发电或用电调整。
messages.en: It brings together several electricity resources and coordinates changes in their generation or consumption.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位协调员把多个电力资源集中起来统一调整，用“汇集资源、协调再调度”的画面记住整个词组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of combining demand from several users or customers so that it can be considered or managed together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把多个用户或客户的需求汇集起来，以便统一考虑或管理的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih id-domanda ta' diversi utenti jew klijenti tinġabar flimkien sabiex tkun tista' titqies jew titmexxa bħala ħaġa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将多个用户或客户各自的需求合并起来，作为整体加以考虑或管理的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-aggregazzjoni tad-domanda hija l-ġbir flimkien tad-domanda ta' diversi utenti jew klijenti biex din tiġi kkunsidrata jew ġestita b'mod konġunt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Demand aggregation is the process of bringing several users' or customers' requirements together so that they can be considered or managed collectively.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif l-aggregazzjoni tad-domanda tiġbor flimkien il-ħtiġijiet ta' diversi klijenti għall-finijiet tal-ippjanar.
formal.en: The report explains how demand aggregation brings together the requirements of several customers for planning purposes.
formal.zh: 报告说明了需求聚合如何汇集多个客户的需求，以供规划使用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed niġbru t-talbiet tal-klijenti kollha flimkien? David: Din hija aggregazzjoni tad-domanda. B'hekk inkunu nistgħu nippjanaw skont il-ħtiġijiet tagħhom kollha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are we collecting all the customers' requests together? David: This is demand aggregation. It lets us plan for their combined requirements.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么要把所有客户的需求收集到一起？戴维：这就是需求聚合。这样我们就能根据他们的整体需求来规划。

messages.speaker: Nina (新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed niġbru t-talbiet tal-klijenti kollha flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed niġbru t-talbiet tal-klijenti kollha flimkien?
messages.zh: 为什么要把所有客户的需求收集到一起？
messages.en: Why are we collecting all the customers' requests together?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din hija aggregazzjoni tad-domanda. B'hekk inkunu nistgħu nippjanaw skont il-ħtiġijiet tagħhom kollha flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Din hija aggregazzjoni tad-domanda. B'hekk inkunu nistgħu nippjanaw skont il-ħtiġijiet tagħhom kollha flimkien.
messages.zh: 这就是需求聚合。这样我们就能根据他们的整体需求来规划。
messages.en: This is demand aggregation. It lets us plan for their combined requirements.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把许多人的需求便签放到同一张总表上，用“分散需求、汇成整体”的画面记住这个词组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of growing crops and raising animals to produce food and other useful products.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过种植作物和饲养动物来生产食物及其他有用产品的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività tat-tkabbir tal-għelejjel u t-trobbija tal-annimali għall-produzzjoni tal-ikel u ta' prodotti utli oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 农业，即种植作物、饲养动物以生产食物及其他产品的生产活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-agrikultura hija l-ħidma li tinkludi t-tkabbir tal-għelejjel u t-trobbija tal-annimali biex jiġu prodotti l-ikel u prodotti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Agriculture is the activity of growing crops and raising animals to provide food and other products.

formal.mt: Il-programm edukattiv jintroduċi lill-istudenti għall-agrikultura permezz ta' attivitajiet dwar it-tkabbir tal-ħxejjex u t-trobbija tal-annimali.
formal.en: The educational programme introduces students to agriculture through activities about growing vegetables and raising animals.
formal.zh: 该教育项目通过有关蔬菜种植和动物饲养的活动，向学生介绍农业。

colloquial.mt: Sara: F'liema qasam taħdem? Ġużeppi: Naħdem fl-agrikultura. Inkabbar il-patata u t-tadam.
colloquial.en: Sara: What field do you work in? Ġużeppi: I work in agriculture. I grow potatoes and tomatoes.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你从事哪个行业？朱塞佩：我从事农业，种土豆和番茄。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你从事哪个行业？
messages.en: What field do you work in?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħdem fl-agrikultura. Inkabbar il-patata u t-tadam.
messages.mt_standard: Naħdem fl-agrikultura. Inkabbar il-patata u t-tadam.
messages.zh: 我从事农业，种土豆和番茄。
messages.en: I work in agriculture. I grow potatoes and tomatoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 agrikultura 和英语 agriculture 对照记忆，再联想田里种作物、农场养动物的画面，牢记它表示“农业”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extreme physical pain or severe mental suffering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体上极其强烈的疼痛，或精神上难以承受的痛苦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uġigħ fiżiku qawwi ħafna jew tbatija mentali kbira ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体或精神上的极度痛苦。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tbatija kbira ħafna li persuna tħoss fil-ġisem jew fil-moħħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Agony is extreme suffering that someone experiences physically or emotionally.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈到难以忍受的身体疼痛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uġigħ fil-ġisem li jkun qawwi ħafna u diffiċli biex wieħed jissaporti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Intense pain is a very strong physical sensation that is difficult to bear.

formal.mt: Il-pazjent iddeskriva l-agunija li ħass qabel ma rċieva t-trattament.
formal.en: The patient described the agony he experienced before receiving treatment.
formal.zh: 患者描述了接受治疗之前所承受的剧痛。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għadek bl-uġigħ? Pawlu: Iva, il-lejl li għadda kont f'agunija minħabba s-snien.
colloquial.en: Marta: Are you still in pain? Pawlu: Yes, last night I was in agony because of my teeth.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你还疼吗？保罗：是啊，昨晚我的牙疼得我痛苦不堪。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还疼吗？
messages.en: Are you still in pain?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-lejl li għadda kont f'agunija minħabba s-snien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-lejl li għadda kont f'agunija minħabba s-snien.
messages.zh: 是啊，昨晚我的牙疼得我痛苦不堪。
messages.en: Yes, last night I was in agony because of my teeth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 agunija 与英语 agony 配对记忆，联想牙疼得整夜难眠的情景；这个词强调极度痛苦，程度远超过一般不舒服。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sound, especially when it is loud, unwanted, or disturbing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声音，尤指响亮、令人厌烦或造成干扰的噪声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss, speċjalment meta jkun qawwi, mhux mixtieq jew idejjaq lin-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 噪声；尤指扰乱安静、使人分心的声音。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħoss jew taħlita ta' ħsejjes li jistgħu jtellfu l-kwiet jew il-konċentrazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Noise is sound, especially sound that is loud, unwanted, or distracting.

formal.mt: L-agħaa kontinwu mit-triq fixkel il-konċentrazzjoni tal-istudenti waqt l-eżami.
formal.en: The continuous noise from the street disrupted the students' concentration during the examination.
formal.zh: 街上传来的持续噪声干扰了学生考试时的注意力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak l-agħaa barra? Mark: Qed jaħdmu fit-triq; ejja nagħlqu t-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that noise outside? Mark: They're doing roadwork; let's close the window.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：外面那是什么噪声？马克：有人在修路，我们把窗户关上吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 外面那是什么噪声？
messages.en: What's that noise outside?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jaħdmu fit-triq; ejja nagħlqu t-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jaħdmu fit-triq; ejja nagħlqu t-tieqa.
messages.zh: 有人在修路，我们把窗户关上吧。
messages.en: They're doing roadwork; let's close the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 agħaa 放进窗外修路的画面里记忆：听到刺耳噪声，就想到关窗；同时用“持续噪声”和“很大噪声”两个搭配巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of lower quality, less satisfactory, or more serious than something else or than before.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一事物或先前状态相比，质量更低、情况更差或程度更严重。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ta' kwalità aktar baxxa, inqas tajjeb jew aktar serju minn xi ħaġa oħra jew minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 更差；更坏；表示比先前或比较对象更不理想，也可指情况更严重。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun inqas tajjeb jew aktar ħażin meta mqabbel ma' xi ħaġa oħra jew mal-istat ta' qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is worse, it is less good or more serious than before or than something else.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li l-kwalità tal-ilma hija agħar minn dik irreġistrata s-sena l-oħra.
formal.en: The report shows that the water quality is worse than that recorded last year.
formal.zh: 报告显示，水质比去年记录的水平更差。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-traffiku llum aħjar mill-bieraħ? David: Le, agħar minn qabel; ilna nofs siegħa hawn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the traffic better today than yesterday? David: No, worse than before; we've been here for half an hour.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：今天的交通比昨天好些吗？戴维：没有，比之前更糟；我们已经在这里堵了半小时。

messages.speaker: Nina (乘客)
messages.zh: 今天的交通比昨天好些吗？
messages.en: Is the traffic better today than yesterday?

messages.speaker: David (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, agħar minn qabel; ilna nofs siegħa hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, agħar minn qabel; ilna nofs siegħa hawn.
messages.zh: 没有，比之前更糟；我们已经在这里堵了半小时。
messages.en: No, worse than before; we've been here for half an hour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用前后对比记 agħar：昨天堵车十分钟，今天堵车半小时，就是“更糟”；整块记住 agħar minn qabel，表示“比以前更差”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Information about recent events or newly reported developments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 关于近期事件或最新进展的信息，可指新闻或新得到的消息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħrif dwar ġrajjiet reċenti jew żviluppi li jkunu għadhom kemm saru magħrufa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 新闻；消息，指近期发生的事情或刚获知的进展。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Informazzjoni dwar dak li ġara dan l-aħħar jew dwar żviluppi ġodda li jiġu rrappurtati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: News is information about recent events or developments that people have only just learned about.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ta' kull ġimgħa hemm Ahbar dwar il-progress tal-proġett.
formal.en: The weekly report contains news about the project's progress.
formal.zh: 每周报告中有关于项目进展的消息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek xi Ahbar dwar il-kors? Luqa: Iva, se jibda nhar it-Tnejn li ġej.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have any news about the course? Luqa: Yes, it starts next Monday.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你有关于课程的新消息吗？卢卡：有，下周一开课。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你有关于课程的新消息吗？
messages.en: Do you have any news about the course?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se jibda nhar it-Tnejn li ġej.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se jibda nhar it-Tnejn li ġej.
messages.zh: 有，下周一开课。
messages.en: Yes, it starts next Monday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ahbar 和“刚收到的新消息”连在一起：同学告诉你下周一开课，这就是关于课程的消息；再用“本地新闻”扩展到公共事件。

gloss_zh: 学术的；与高等教育或学术研究有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to scholarly study, research, or higher education.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与学术学习、研究或高等教育有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-istudju, mar-riċerka jew mat-tagħlim f'istituzzjonijiet ta' edukazzjoni għolja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学术的；与学术研究、学习或高等教育有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-istudju u r-riċerka, speċjalment f'università jew f'istituzzjoni oħra ta' edukazzjoni għolja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is academic is connected with scholarly study, research, or higher education.

formal.mt: Dan ix-xogħol akkademiku jippreżenta r-riżultati ta' studju dwar it-tagħlim tal-lingwi.
formal.en: This academic work presents the results of a study on language teaching.
formal.zh: 这项学术工作介绍了一项关于语言教学的研究结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex qed taħdem bħalissa? Daniel: Qed nikteb artiklu akkademiku dwar it-tagħlim tal-Malti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you working on at the moment? Daniel: I'm writing an academic article about teaching Maltese.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你最近在做什么？丹尼尔：我正在写一篇关于马耳他语教学的学术文章。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你最近在做什么？
messages.en: What are you working on at the moment?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nikteb artiklu akkademiku dwar it-tagħlim tal-Malti.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nikteb artiklu akkademiku dwar it-tagħlim tal-Malti.
messages.zh: 我正在写一篇关于马耳他语教学的学术文章。
messages.en: I'm writing an academic article about teaching Maltese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 akkademiku 写在论文和大学课堂的图片旁，用 xogħol akkademiku 整组记忆，建立“与学术研究有关”的场景联系。

gloss_zh: 一心要做的；热衷的；热情的；坚韧不拔的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strongly determined, deeply interested, enthusiastic, or persistent in pursuing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人一心追求某事、对某事十分热衷，或在追求目标时坚持不懈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun determinat ħafna li jagħmel xi ħaġa, juri interess jew ħeġġa kbira fiha, jew jibqa' jinsisti minkejja d-diffikultajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一心想做某事的；下定决心要实现某事的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun determinat ħafna li jagħmel xi ħaġa jew jilħaq għan partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is intent on something, they are firmly determined to do or achieve it.

sense_translations.en_definition: highly involved or interested in sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 深度参与某事的；对某事有浓厚兴趣的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun involut ħafna f'xi attività jew ikollu interess qawwi f'xi suġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is highly involved or interested in something gives it considerable attention or participation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热情的；对某事表现出强烈兴趣和积极态度的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri ħeġġa kbira u interess qawwi għal xi ħaġa jew biex jieħu sehem f'xi attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is enthusiastic shows strong interest and excitement about an activity or idea.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坚韧不拔的；遇到困难仍不轻易放弃的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jibqa' jaħdem għal għan jew jinsisti fuq xi ħaġa minkejja l-ostakli u ma jaqtax qalbu malajr.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is tenacious continues pursuing a goal despite difficulties and does not give up easily.

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur baqa' akkanit li jsib soluzzjoni, minkejja d-diffikultajiet li ltaqa' magħhom.
formal.en: The researcher remained determined to find a solution despite the difficulties he encountered.
formal.zh: 尽管遇到种种困难，这位研究人员仍一心要找到解决办法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se terġa' tipprova wara dawk it-tentattivi kollha? Daniel: Iva, għadni akkanit li nsib soluzzjoni. Ma rridx naqta' qalbi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to try again after all those attempts? Daniel: Yes, I'm still determined to find a solution. I don't want to give up.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：试了那么多次，你还要再试吗？丹尼尔：是的，我还是一心想找到解决办法。我不想放弃。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se terġa' tipprova wara dawk it-tentattivi kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Se terġa' tipprova wara dawk it-tentattivi kollha?
messages.zh: 试了那么多次，你还要再试吗？
messages.en: Are you going to try again after all those attempts?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni akkanit li nsib soluzzjoni. Ma rridx naqta' qalbi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni akkanit li nsib soluzzjoni. Ma rridx naqta' qalbi.
messages.zh: 是的，我还是一心想找到解决办法。我不想放弃。
messages.en: Yes, I'm still determined to find a solution. I don't want to give up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四幅连续画面记 akkanit：盯住目标、投入活动、热情参与、遇阻坚持。依上下文选择“一心想要、热衷、热情、坚韧”的意思。

gloss_zh: 日内耦合；在同一天内进行的配对或连接

teaching_sense.en_definition: The pairing or linking of elements within the same day.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在同一天内将相关对象配对或连接起来的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih elementi jiġu mqabbda jew konnessi ma' xulxin fi ħdan l-istess ġurnata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 日内耦合，即在同一天内进行的配对或连接过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Akkoppjament li jsir fi ħdan ġurnata waħda, meta elementi jitqabbdu jew jiġu konnessi ma' xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Intraday coupling is a process in which elements are paired or linked within the same day.

collocations.en: the time required for intraday coupling

formal.mt: Il-pjan tekniku jipprevedi akkoppjament fl-istess ġurnata, sabiex iż-żewġ sistemi jkunu konnessi qabel tmiem il-jum.
formal.en: The technical plan provides for intraday coupling so that the two systems are connected before the end of the day.
formal.zh: 技术方案安排了日内耦合，以便两个系统在当天结束前完成连接。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-konnessjoni taż-żewġ sistemi se tkun lesta llum? Daniel: Iva, il-pjan jipprevedi akkoppjament fl-istess ġurnata. Irridu nlestu qabel tmiem il-jum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Will the connection between the two systems be ready today? Daniel: Yes, the plan provides for intraday coupling. We need to finish before the end of the day.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：两个系统的连接今天能完成吗？丹尼尔：能，方案安排了日内耦合。我们需要在当天结束前完成。

messages.speaker: Maja (技术同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-konnessjoni taż-żewġ sistemi se tkun lesta llum?
messages.mt_standard: Il-konnessjoni taż-żewġ sistemi se tkun lesta llum?
messages.zh: 两个系统的连接今天能完成吗？
messages.en: Will the connection between the two systems be ready today?

messages.speaker: Daniel (技术同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-pjan jipprevedi akkoppjament fl-istess ġurnata. Irridu nlestu qabel tmiem il-jum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-pjan jipprevedi akkoppjament fl-istess ġurnata. Irridu nlestu qabel tmiem il-jum.
messages.zh: 能，方案安排了日内耦合。我们需要在当天结束前完成。
messages.en: Yes, the plan provides for intraday coupling. We need to finish before the end of the day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出一天的时间框，在框内把两个圆点连接起来，并标注整条短语；用“同一天内完成连接”的画面记住日内耦合。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unified mechanism that links markets for day-ahead trading.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在日前交易中将不同市场连接起来的统一耦合机制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mekkaniżmu wieħed li jgħaqqad swieq differenti għall-kummerċ ta' ġurnata bil-quddiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于日前交易、将不同市场连接起来的单一市场耦合机制。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mekkaniżmu uniku għall-akkoppjament ta' swieq differenti fil-kummerċ ta' ġurnata bil-quddiem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Single day-ahead coupling is a unified mechanism through which different markets are linked for day-ahead trading.

collocations.mt: il-proċess tal-akkoppjament singolu ta' ġurnata bil-quddiem
collocations.zh: 单一日前市场耦合流程

collocations.mt: il-parteċipazzjoni fl-akkoppjament singolu ta' ġurnata bil-quddiem
collocations.zh: 参与单一日前市场耦合

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif l-akkoppjament singolu ta' ġurnata bil-quddiem jgħaqqad swieq differenti fil-kummerċ ta' ġurnata bil-quddiem.
formal.en: The report explains how single day-ahead coupling links different markets in day-ahead trading.
formal.zh: 该报告解释了单一日前市场耦合如何在日前交易中连接不同市场。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser 'akkoppjament singolu ta' ġurnata bil-quddiem'? Pawlu: Huwa mekkaniżmu wieħed li jgħaqqad swieq differenti għall-kummerċ ta' ġurnata bil-quddiem.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'single day-ahead coupling' mean? Pawlu: It is one mechanism that links different markets for day-ahead trading.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：什么是“单一日前市场耦合”？保罗：就是在日前交易中连接不同市场的一套统一机制。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是“单一日前市场耦合”？
messages.en: What does 'single day-ahead coupling' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa mekkaniżmu wieħed li jgħaqqad swieq differenti għall-kummerċ ta' ġurnata bil-quddiem.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa mekkaniżmu wieħed li jgħaqqad swieq differenti għall-kummerċ ta' ġurnata bil-quddiem.
messages.zh: 就是在日前交易中连接不同市场的一套统一机制。
messages.en: It is one mechanism that links different markets for day-ahead trading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整条术语分成“耦合＋单一＋提前一天”来记；看到 bil-quddiem，就联想到日历上提前一天安排交易。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unified mechanism that links markets for trading within the same day.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在同一天内的交易中将不同市场连接起来的统一耦合机制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mekkaniżmu wieħed li jgħaqqad swieq differenti għall-kummerċ li jsir matul l-istess ġurnata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于日内交易、将不同市场连接起来的单一市场耦合机制。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mekkaniżmu uniku għall-akkoppjament ta' swieq differenti fil-kummerċ li jsir matul l-istess ġurnata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Single intra-day coupling is a unified mechanism through which different markets are linked for trading within the same day.

collocations.en: the operation of single intra-day coupling
collocations.zh: 单一日内市场耦合的运行
参与单一日内市场耦合

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi l-akkoppjament singolu tal-istess ġurnata bħala mekkaniżmu li jgħaqqad swieq differenti għall-kummerċ matul l-istess ġurnata.
formal.en: The document describes single intra-day coupling as a mechanism that links different markets for trading within the same day.
formal.zh: 该文件将单一日内市场耦合描述为一种连接不同市场、用于同一天内交易的机制。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-akkoppjament singolu tal-istess ġurnata huwa għall-kummerċ matul l-istess jum? Mark: Iva, jgħaqqad swieq differenti għal dak it-tip ta' kummerċ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is single intra-day coupling for trading within the same day? Mark: Yes, it links different markets for that type of trading.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：单一日内市场耦合是用于同一天内的交易吗？马克：是的，它为这类交易连接不同市场。

messages.zh: 单一日内市场耦合是用于同一天内的交易吗？
messages.en: Is single intra-day coupling for trading within the same day?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jgħaqqad swieq differenti għal dak it-tip ta' kummerċ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jgħaqqad swieq differenti għal dak it-tip ta' kummerċ.
messages.zh: 是的，它为这类交易连接不同市场。
messages.en: Yes, it links different markets for that type of trading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tal-istess ġurnata 对应到“同一天的”，在脑中画一个日历格，把市场之间的连线放进同一格，记住“日内耦合”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Official recognition that a person or organization meets specified standards or is qualified for a particular activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式确认个人或机构符合规定标准，或具备从事某项活动资格的认可。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rikonoxximent uffiċjali li persuna jew organizzazzjoni tissodisfa standards stabbiliti jew għandha l-kwalifiki meħtieġa għal attività partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由有关机构正式确认个人或组织符合特定标准、具备相应资格的认可或认证。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess jew għoti ta' rikonoxximent uffiċjali li jikkonferma li persuna jew organizzazzjoni tissodisfa standards jew rekwiżiti speċifiċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Accreditation is official recognition that a person or organization has met the standards required for a particular purpose.

formal.mt: Il-laboratorju kiseb akkreditament wara li wera li jissodisfa l-istandards meħtieġa.
formal.en: The laboratory obtained accreditation after demonstrating that it met the required standards.
formal.zh: 该实验室在证明其符合规定标准后获得了认可。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-laboratorju kiseb l-akkreditament? David: Iva, waslet il-konferma uffiċjali dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has the laboratory obtained accreditation? David: Yes, the official confirmation arrived this morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：实验室获得认可了吗？戴维：获得了，今天早上收到了正式确认。

messages.speaker: Sara (实验室职员)
messages.zh: 实验室获得认可了吗？
messages.en: Has the laboratory obtained accreditation?

messages.speaker: David (实验室主管)
messages.zh: 获得了，今天早上收到了正式确认。
messages.en: Yes, the official confirmation arrived this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想一张盖着正式印章的资格证：先达到标准，再得到官方认可；把 akkreditament 和“资质获认可”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having another person present as a companion, or having something else present alongside it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有他人陪同的，或伴随有其他事物的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu persuna oħra miegħu bħala sieħba, jew li għandu xi ħaġa oħra miegħu bħala akkumpanjament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有人陪伴或陪同的；与其他事物一同出现的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab ma' persuna oħra li qed takkumpanjah, jew li jiġi flimkien ma' xi ħaġa oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is accompanied, another person or thing is present or goes along with them.

formal.mt: Kull tifel li jżur il-wirja għandu jkun akkumpanjat minn adult.
formal.en: Every boy visiting the exhibition must be accompanied by an adult.
formal.zh: 每个参观展览的男孩都必须由一名成年人陪同。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ibnek se jkun akkumpanjat minn xi ħadd fil-ħarġa? Marija: Iva, se jkun akkumpanjat minn missieru.
colloquial.en: Anna: Will someone accompany your son on the outing? Marija: Yes, he will be accompanied by his father.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这次外出会有人陪你儿子吗？玛丽亚：会，他爸爸会陪他。

messages.speaker: Anna (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibnek se jkun akkumpanjat minn xi ħadd fil-ħarġa?
messages.mt_standard: Ibnek se jkun akkumpanjat minn xi ħadd fil-ħarġa?
messages.zh: 这次外出会有人陪你儿子吗？
messages.en: Will someone accompany your son on the outing?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se jkun akkumpanjat minn missieru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se jkun akkumpanjat minn missieru.
messages.zh: 会，他爸爸会陪他。
messages.en: Yes, he will be accompanied by his father.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A method of storing energy by pumping water to a higher reservoir and releasing it through turbines when electricity is needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把水抽至高处水库，并在需要用电时放水驱动涡轮机发电的储能方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Metodu ta' ħażna tal-enerġija li fih l-ilma jiġi ppompjat lejn ġibjun ogħla u mbagħad jitħalla jinżel minn turbini biex jiġi ġġenerat l-elettriku meta jkun meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抽水蓄能；通过把水抽到高处来储存能量的方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema għall-ħażna tal-enerġija li tuża pompi biex ittella' l-ilma lejn ġibjun ogħla, sabiex aktar tard jintuża għall-ġenerazzjoni tal-elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pump storage is a way of storing energy by pumping water uphill for later electricity generation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抽水蓄能；先抽水储能，再利用水流落差发电的方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Metodu li jaħżen l-enerġija billi jtella' l-ilma lejn ġibjun ogħla u juża l-fluss tiegħu lejn ġibjun aktar baxx biex iħaddem turbini.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pumped storage is an energy storage method in which water is pumped uphill and later released to generate electricity.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif sistema ta' akkumulu ppompjat tista' taħżen l-enerġija żejda biex tintuża meta tiżdied id-domanda għall-elettriku.
formal.en: The report explains how a pumped storage system can store surplus energy for use when electricity demand increases.
formal.zh: 报告解释了抽水蓄能系统如何储存多余能量，以便在用电需求增加时使用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jaħdem l-akkumulu ppompjat? Pawlu: Ippompjaw l-ilma 'l fuq, imbagħad iħalluh jinżel minn turbini meta jkollhom bżonn l-elettriku.
colloquial.en: Maja: How does pumped storage work? Pawlu: They pump water uphill, then let it flow down through turbines when they need electricity.
colloquial.zh: Maja：抽水蓄能是怎么运作的？Pawlu：先把水抽到高处，需要电时再让水流下来，经过涡轮机发电。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 抽水蓄能是怎么运作的？
messages.en: How does pumped storage work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ippompjaw l-ilma 'l fuq, imbagħad iħalluh jinżel minn turbini meta jkollhom bżonn l-elettriku.
messages.mt_standard: Ippompjaw l-ilma 'l fuq, imbagħad iħalluh jinżel minn turbini meta jkollhom bżonn l-elettriku.
messages.zh: 先把水抽到高处，需要电时再让水流下来，经过涡轮机发电。
messages.en: They pump water uphill, then let it flow down through turbines when they need electricity.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组配上“水先上山、再下山发电”的示意图，按“抽水—储能—发电”三个动作记住抽水蓄能。

gloss_zh: 被告；被指控的人；被指控的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who has been formally accused of an offence, especially in a court case.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被正式指控涉嫌某项违法行为的人，尤指刑事案件中的被告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun ġiet akkużata formalment b'reat, speċjalment f'kawża quddiem qorti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被指控的人；被正式指控涉嫌犯罪的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun mixlija formalment li wettqet reat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The accused is a person who has been formally charged with committing an offence.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被告；在法庭案件中受到起诉或指控的一方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li kontriha titressaq kawża jew akkuża quddiem qorti u li jkollha twieġeb għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A defendant is a person against whom a court case or criminal charge is brought.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被指控的；被指称做了违法或错误之事的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie mixli li wettaq reat jew għamel xi ħaġa ħażina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is accused of something, another person claims that they have done something wrong.

collocations.zh: 一名被指控盗窃的男子

formal.mt: L-akkużat wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet tal-qorti bl-għajnuna ta' interpretu.
formal.en: The defendant answered the court's questions with the help of an interpreter.
formal.zh: 被告在口译员的帮助下回答了法庭的提问。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-akkużat f'din l-istorja? Mark: Ir-raġel bil-ġakketta blu; l-avukat tiegħu qiegħed ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the defendant in this story? Mark: The man in the blue jacket; his lawyer is beside him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个故事里谁是被告？Mark：穿蓝色夹克的那个男人；他的律师就在他旁边。

messages.en: Who is the defendant in this story?

messages.mt_spoken: Ir-raġel bil-ġakketta blu; l-avukat tiegħu qiegħed ħdejh.

messages.zh: 穿蓝色夹克的那个男人；他的律师就在他旁边。
messages.en: The man in the blue jacket; his lawyer is beside him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个位置记词性：l-akkużat 单独指“被告这个人”，raġel akkużat 则用来说明“被指控的男子”；被指控不等于已被判有罪。

gloss_zh: 水生的；水中的；与水有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Living or growing in water, taking place in water, or otherwise connected with water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在水中生活或生长的、在水中进行的，或与水有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħix jew jikber fl-ilma, li jsir fl-ilma, jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水生的；在水中生活或生长的，也可指在水中进行的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jgħix jew jikber fl-ilma, jew li jsir fl-ilma, bħal ċertu sport.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Aquatic animals and plants live or grow in water, and aquatic activities take place in water.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与水有关的；用于描述涉及水的环境、活动或事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu rabta mal-ilma, pereżempju meta jiddeskrivi ambjent jew attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as related to water has a connection with water through its nature, setting, or use.

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi l-effetti tat-tniġġis fuq l-ambjent akkwatiku tal-lag.
formal.en: The study describes the effects of pollution on the lake's aquatic environment.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了污染对该湖水生环境的影响。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema sport akkwatiku tixtieq tipprova? Ben: Nixtieq nipprova l-waterpolo, għax inħobb ngħum u nilgħab f'tim.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which aquatic sport would you like to try? Ben: I'd like to try water polo because I enjoy swimming and playing on a team.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你想尝试哪种水上运动？Ben：我想试试水球，因为我喜欢游泳，也喜欢参加团队运动。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想尝试哪种水上运动？
messages.en: Which aquatic sport would you like to try?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq nipprova l-waterpolo, għax inħobb ngħum u nilgħab f'tim.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq nipprova l-waterpolo, għax inħobb ngħum u nilgħab f'tim.
messages.zh: 我想试试水球，因为我喜欢游泳，也喜欢参加团队运动。
messages.en: I'd like to try water polo because I enjoy swimming and playing on a team.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 akkwatiku 放进一幅有鱼、水草和游泳者的图：鱼和水草提示“水生的”，游泳者提示“与水有关的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The purchase of goods or services through electronic systems, including the online management of procurement procedures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电子系统采购货物或服务，并在线管理相关采购程序的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xiri ta' oġġetti jew servizzi permezz ta' sistemi elettroniċi, inkluża l-ġestjoni tal-proċeduri tal-akkwist fuq l-internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利用电子平台开展和管理货物或服务采购的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' xiri ta' oġġetti jew servizzi u l-ġestjoni tiegħu permezz ta' pjattaformi elettroniċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: E-procurement is the use of electronic platforms to purchase goods or services and manage the purchasing process.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过电子系统发布招标信息、提交投标文件及处理相关招投标程序的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tmexxija tal-proċess tas-sejħiet għall-offerti permezz ta' sistemi elettroniċi, inklużi l-pubblikazzjoni tas-sejħiet u s-sottomissjoni tal-offerti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: E-tendering is a process in which tender notices and bids are issued, submitted, or handled through electronic systems.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用电子系统进行的货物或服务采购。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-akkwist ta' oġġetti jew servizzi bl-użu ta' sistemi elettroniċi biex jitwettqu l-attivitajiet tax-xiri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Electronic procurement is purchasing that uses electronic systems to carry out activities involved in obtaining goods or services.

formal.mt: L-istituzzjoni tuża pjattaforma għall-akkwist elettroniku biex tippubblika sejħiet għall-offerti u tirċievi l-offerti mingħand il-fornituri.
formal.en: The institution uses an e-procurement platform to publish calls for tenders and receive bids from suppliers.
formal.zh: 该机构使用电子采购平台发布招标公告并接收供应商的投标文件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif nibgħat l-offerta għal din is-sejħa? Pawlu: Uża l-pjattaforma għall-akkwist elettroniku; idħol fil-kont tiegħek u tella' d-dokumenti hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do I submit a bid for this call? Pawlu: Use the e-procurement platform; log in to your account and upload the documents there.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这次招标的投标文件怎么提交？Pawlu：用电子采购平台，登录你的账户，把文件上传到那里。

messages.speaker: Lara (供应商)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nibgħat l-offerta għal din is-sejħa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nibgħat l-offerta għal din is-sejħa?
messages.zh: 这次招标的投标文件怎么提交？
messages.en: How do I submit a bid for this call?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (采购人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża l-pjattaforma għall-akkwist elettroniku; idħol fil-kont tiegħek u tella' d-dokumenti hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Uża l-pjattaforma għall-akkwist elettroniku; idħol fil-kont tiegħek u tella' d-dokumenti hemm.
messages.zh: 用电子采购平台，登录你的账户，把文件上传到那里。
messages.en: Use the e-procurement platform; log in to your account and upload the documents there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“登录平台、上传采购文件”的画面绑定：akkwist 表示采购，elettroniku 提示电子方式；遇到招标语境，再具体理解为电子招投标。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Procurement that combines different categories of purchases or different purchasing arrangements within one overall process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在同一整体采购活动中结合不同采购类别或不同采购安排的采购。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Akkwist li jgħaqqad kategoriji differenti ta' xiri jew arranġamenti differenti ta' xiri fi proċess wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结合不同采购类别或采购安排的混合采购；具体混合内容由语境确定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Akkwist li jiġbor flimkien tipi differenti ta' xiri jew arranġamenti differenti ta' xiri, skont il-kuntest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mixed procurement is purchasing that combines different categories or arrangements, with the particular combination depending on the context.

formal.mt: Il-pjan ta' akkwist imħallat jiġbor flimkien ix-xiri tat-tagħmir u s-servizzi ta' installazzjoni, u jiddeskrivi kull parti b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The mixed procurement plan brings together the purchase of equipment and installation services, and describes each part clearly.
formal.zh: 该混合采购计划将设备采购和安装服务纳入同一安排，并清楚说明各个部分。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan il-pjan hu biss għax-xiri tal-kompjuters? Ġorġ: Le, hu pjan ta' akkwist imħallat: jinkludi l-kompjuters u s-servizz ta' installazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is this plan just for buying computers? Ġorġ: No, it is a mixed procurement plan: it includes the computers and the installation service.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这个计划只采购电脑吗？Ġorġ：不是，这是混合采购计划，包括电脑和安装服务。

messages.speaker: Marija (行政同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-pjan hu biss għax-xiri tal-kompjuters?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-pjan hu biss għax-xiri tal-kompjuters?
messages.zh: 这个计划只采购电脑吗？
messages.en: Is this plan just for buying computers?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hu pjan ta' akkwist imħallat: jinkludi l-kompjuters u s-servizz ta' installazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hu pjan ta' akkwist imħallat: jinkludi l-kompjuters u s-servizz ta' installazzjoni.
messages.zh: 不是，这是混合采购计划，包括电脑和安装服务。
messages.en: No, it is a mixed procurement plan: it includes the computers and the installation service.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一个采购篮里放进不同类别”的画面记忆：akkwist imħallat 是混合采购。先记住“混合”这一特征，再从上下文判断究竟混合了哪些内容。

gloss_zh: 联合采购；集中成组采购

teaching_sense.en_definition: Procurement in which two or more buyers combine their purchasing needs and arrange purchases together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由两个或多个采购方汇集采购需求、共同安排购买的采购活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Akkwist li fih żewġ xerrejja jew aktar jgħaqqdu l-ħtiġijiet tax-xiri tagħhom u jorganizzaw ix-xiri flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将多个采购方的采购需求汇集起来、统一组织购买的成组采购。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Akkwist li fih il-ħtiġijiet ta' diversi xerrejja jinġabru flimkien biex ix-xiri jiġi organizzat bħala grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Grouped procurement is an arrangement in which several buyers pool their requirements so that purchasing can be organized collectively.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 两个或多个采购方共同组织或开展的联合采购。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Akkwist organizzat jew imwettaq flimkien minn żewġ xerrejja jew aktar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Joint procurement is purchasing that two or more buyers organize or carry out together.

formal.mt: Tliet skejjel qablu li jipparteċipaw f'akkwist konġunt ta' materjal edukattiv u ħejjew lista waħda tal-ħtiġijiet tagħhom.
formal.en: Three schools agreed to participate in joint procurement of educational materials and prepared a single list of their requirements.
formal.zh: 三所学校同意参与教学材料的联合采购，并共同编制了一份需求清单。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Se nixtru l-karti waħedna din id-darba? David: Le, se nagħmlu akkwist konġunt ma' żewġ uffiċċji oħra. Anna: Tajjeb, mela nibgħatlek il-kwantità li għandna bżonn.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are we buying the paper on our own this time? David: No, we are arranging joint procurement with two other offices. Anna: Good, then I will send you the quantity we need.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这次我们单独采购纸张吗？David：不是，我们要和另外两个办公室联合采购。Anna：好，那我把我们需要的数量发给你。

messages.speaker: Anna (办公室同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nixtru l-karti waħedna din id-darba?
messages.mt_standard: Se nixtru l-karti waħedna din id-darba?
messages.zh: 这次我们单独采购纸张吗？
messages.en: Are we buying the paper on our own this time?

messages.speaker: David (采购协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, se nagħmlu akkwist konġunt ma' żewġ uffiċċji oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, se nagħmlu akkwist konġunt ma' żewġ uffiċċji oħra.
messages.zh: 不是，我们要和另外两个办公室联合采购。
messages.en: No, we are arranging joint procurement with two other offices.

messages.speaker: Anna (办公室同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, mela nibgħatlek il-kwantità li għandna bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, mela nibgħatlek il-kwantità li għandna bżonn.
messages.zh: 好，那我把我们需要的数量发给你。
messages.en: Good, then I will send you the quantity we need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几个办公室把需求清单合成一张，再一起采购：akkwist konġunt 的重点是“多个采购方共同买”。用“共同清单、共同采购”帮助记住整个短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Procurement conducted without a competitive process between potential suppliers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不通过潜在供应商之间的竞争性程序开展的采购。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Akkwist li jsir mingħajr proċess ta' kompetizzjoni bejn fornituri potenzjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未通过供应商之间的竞争性选择程序进行的采购。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xiri ta' oġġetti jew servizzi li fih il-fornitur ma jintgħażilx permezz ta' proċess kompetittiv bejn fornituri potenzjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Non-competitive procurement is purchasing in which a supplier is selected without a competitive process involving potential suppliers.

collocations.zh: 采用非竞争性采购的理由说明

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċedura ta' akkwist mhux kompetittiv u jagħti r-raġunijiet għall-għażla tal-fornitur.
formal.en: The report describes the non-competitive procurement procedure and gives the reasons for selecting the supplier.
formal.zh: 该报告说明了非竞争性采购程序，并列出了选择该供应商的理由。

colloquial.mt: Rita: F'dan ix-xiri se nqabblu offerti minn diversi fornituri? Mark: Le, dan hu akkwist mhux kompetittiv; il-fornitur intgħażel mingħajr kompetizzjoni. Rita: Fejn nista' naqra r-raġuni għal din l-għażla? Mark: Ir-raġuni tinsab fir-rapport.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are we going to compare bids from several suppliers for this purchase? Mark: No, this is non-competitive procurement; the supplier was selected without competition. Rita: Where can I read the reason for this choice? Mark: The reason is in the report.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这次采购会比较几家供应商的报价吗？Mark：不会，这是非竞争性采购，供应商是未经竞争选定的。Rita：在哪里能看到这样选择的理由？Mark：理由写在报告里。

messages.speaker: Rita (行政同事)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan ix-xiri se nqabblu offerti minn diversi fornituri?
messages.mt_standard: F'dan ix-xiri se nqabblu offerti minn diversi fornituri?
messages.zh: 这次采购会比较几家供应商的报价吗？
messages.en: Are we going to compare bids from several suppliers for this purchase?

messages.speaker: Mark (采购人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan hu akkwist mhux kompetittiv; il-fornitur intgħażel mingħajr kompetizzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan hu akkwist mhux kompetittiv; il-fornitur intgħażel mingħajr kompetizzjoni.
messages.zh: 不会，这是非竞争性采购，供应商是未经竞争选定的。
messages.en: No, this is non-competitive procurement; the supplier was selected without competition.

messages.speaker: Rita (行政同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' naqra r-raġuni għal din l-għażla?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' naqra r-raġuni għal din l-għażla?
messages.zh: 在哪里能看到这样选择的理由？
messages.en: Where can I read the reason for this choice?

messages.speaker: Mark (采购人员)
messages.zh: 理由写在报告里。
messages.en: The reason is in the report.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分块记忆：akkwist 是采购，mhux 表示否定，kompetittiv 表示竞争性的。把整个短语记成“采购过程中没有竞争性选择”，避免把“非竞争”误读为“竞争力弱”。

gloss_zh: 公共采购；公共合同授予

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which public authorities obtain goods, services, or works through contracts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公共机构通过合同取得货物、服务或工程的采购过程，也可侧重其中的合同授予环节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih l-awtoritajiet pubbliċi jiksbu oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet permezz ta' kuntratti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合同授予，即选定承包方并将合同授予该方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' kuntratti lill-fornituri jew lill-kuntratturi magħżula wara proċess ta' għażla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The award of contracts is the act of selecting suppliers or contractors and granting them contracts.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共合同授予，即公共机构将采购合同授予选定的供应商或承包方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' kuntratti minn awtoritajiet pubbliċi lill-fornituri jew lill-kuntratturi magħżula.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The award of public contracts occurs when a public authority grants contracts to selected suppliers or contractors.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 采购，即为满足需要而取得货物、服务或工程的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess tal-kisba ta' oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet biex jiġu ssodisfati ħtiġijiet partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Procurement is the process of obtaining the goods, services, or works that an organization needs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共采购，即公共机构为履行职能而采购货物、服务或工程的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kisba ta' oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet minn awtoritajiet pubbliċi biex jaqdu l-funzjonijiet tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Public procurement is the process through which public authorities purchase goods, services, or works.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċeduri ta' akkwist pubbliku u jispjega kif jintgħażlu l-fornituri.
formal.en: The report describes public procurement procedures and explains how suppliers are selected.
formal.zh: 该报告介绍公共采购程序，并说明如何选择供应商。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser akkwist pubbliku? Mark: Pereżempju, meta kunsill lokali jixtri kompjuters għall-uffiċċju tiegħu permezz ta' kuntratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does public procurement mean? Mark: For example, when a local council buys computers for its office through a contract.
colloquial.zh: Maja：公共采购是什么意思？Mark：比如地方议会通过合同为办公室购买电脑。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 公共采购是什么意思？
messages.en: What does public procurement mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Pereżempju, meta kunsill lokali jixtri kompjuters għall-uffiċċju tiegħu permezz ta' kuntratt.
messages.mt_standard: Pereżempju, meta kunsill lokali jixtri kompjuters għall-uffiċċju tiegħu permezz ta' kuntratt.
messages.zh: 比如地方议会通过合同为办公室购买电脑。
messages.en: For example, when a local council buys computers for its office through a contract.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成“公共机构签合同买东西”；遇到合同授予语境，再把注意力放在选定供应商的环节。

gloss_zh: 竞争性公共采购；公开竞争招标

teaching_sense.en_definition: Public procurement that allows suppliers or contractors to compete for a contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让供应商或承包方通过竞争争取合同的公共采购，也可指将采购项目交付竞争或招标的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Akkwist minn awtorità pubblika li fih fornituri jew kuntratturi jingħataw l-opportunità li jikkompetu għal kuntratt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 竞争性采购，即让多个供应商或承包方竞争取得采购合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess ta' akkwist li fih diversi fornituri jew kuntratturi jikkompetu biex jingħataw kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Competitive procurement is a purchasing process in which suppliers or contractors compete to win a contract.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开放竞争，即使有关采购机会可由供应商或承包方参与竞争。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ftuħ ta' opportunità ta' akkwist biex fornituri jew kuntratturi jkunu jistgħu jikkompetu għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Opening for competition means making a procurement opportunity available for suppliers or contractors to compete for.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将采购项目交付竞争，即邀请供应商或承包方提交相互竞争的报价或方案。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tqegħid ta' akkwist għall-kompetizzjoni billi jiġu mistiedna fornituri jew kuntratturi jippreżentaw offerti li jikkompetu bejniethom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Putting out to competition involves inviting competing offers for a particular procurement requirement.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将项目交付招标，即邀请有意承接的供应商或承包方提交正式投标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ ta' sejħa għall-offerti li tistieden fornituri jew kuntratturi interessati jippreżentaw offerti formali għal kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Putting up for tender means inviting formal bids from suppliers or contractors for a contract.

formal.mt: L-awtorità se tuża proċedura ta' akkwist pubbliku kompetittiv biex tagħżel fornitur għas-servizz il-ġdid.
formal.en: The authority will use a competitive public procurement procedure to select a supplier for the new service.
formal.zh: 该机构将通过竞争性公共采购程序，为新服务选择供应商。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed jitolbu offerti mingħand diversi kumpaniji? Paul: Għax dan hu akkwist pubbliku kompetittiv; il-kumpaniji jikkompetu għall-kuntratt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are they asking several companies for bids? Paul: Because this is competitive public procurement; the companies compete for the contract.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么要向好几家公司征求投标？Paul：因为这是竞争性公共采购，各家公司要竞争取得合同。

messages.speaker: Lara (新同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jitolbu offerti mingħand diversi kumpaniji?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jitolbu offerti mingħand diversi kumpaniji?
messages.zh: 为什么要向好几家公司征求投标？
messages.en: Why are they asking several companies for bids?

messages.speaker: Paul (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dan hu akkwist pubbliku kompetittiv; il-kumpaniji jikkompetu għall-kuntratt.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dan hu akkwist pubbliku kompetittiv; il-kumpaniji jikkompetu għall-kuntratt.
messages.zh: 因为这是竞争性公共采购，各家公司要竞争取得合同。
messages.en: Because this is competitive public procurement; the companies compete for the contract.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象公共采购桌前摆着几家公司的投标书：整个短语强调“大家竞争争合同”，也可聚焦开放竞争或发起招标这一步。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The purchase of goods, services, or works by the government.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 政府为满足公共事务需要而采购货物、服务或工程的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xiri ta' oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet mill-gvern biex jiġu ssodisfati ħtiġijiet pubbliċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 政府采购，即政府取得所需货物、服务或工程的采购过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-gvern jixtri l-oġġetti, is-servizzi jew ix-xogħlijiet li jeħtieġ biex jaqdi l-funzjonijiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Government procurement is the process through which the government purchases goods, services, or works for its activities.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport dwar l-akkwist pubbliku mill-gvern jinkludi x-xiri ta' tagħmir u servizzi għad-dipartimenti.
formal.en: The report on government procurement includes purchases of equipment and services for government departments.
formal.zh: 这份政府采购报告涵盖为政府各部门采购设备和服务的情况。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min qed jixtri dan it-tagħmir? David: Il-gvern. Dan hu eżempju ta' akkwist pubbliku mill-gvern.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is buying this equipment? David: The government. This is an example of government procurement.
colloquial.zh: Nina：谁在采购这些设备？David：政府。这就是政府采购的一个例子。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 谁在采购这些设备？
messages.en: Who is buying this equipment?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-gvern. Dan hu eżempju ta' akkwist pubbliku mill-gvern.
messages.mt_standard: Il-gvern. Dan hu eżempju ta' akkwist pubbliku mill-gvern.
messages.zh: 政府。这就是政府采购的一个例子。
messages.en: The government. This is an example of government procurement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时先问“谁在买”：这里的采购方是政府。把整句与“政府为部门购买设备”的画面绑定，就能记住政府采购。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which goods acquire originating status under the applicable rules of origin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物依照适用的原产地规则取得原产资格的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih merkanzija tikseb l-istatus ta' oriġini skont ir-regoli tal-oriġini applikabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原产资格的取得，指货物满足适用的原产地规则，从而被认定具有相应原产资格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kisba tal-istatus ta' oriġini minn merkanzija meta din tissodisfa r-regoli tal-oriġini applikabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Acquisition of origin occurs when goods meet the applicable rules for obtaining originating status.

collocations.en: conditions for the acquisition of origin
rules on the acquisition of origin
collocations.zh: 关于原产资格取得的规则

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispjega l-kundizzjonijiet għall-akkwist tal-oriġini tal-prodott skont ir-regoli applikabbli.
formal.en: The document explains the conditions for the product's acquisition of origin under the applicable rules.
formal.zh: 该文件说明产品依照适用规则取得原产资格所需满足的条件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser akkwist tal-oriġini hawn? Luke: Ifisser li l-prodott jikseb l-istatus ta' oriġini għax jissodisfa r-regoli applikabbli.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does acquisition of origin mean here? Luke: It means that the product obtains originating status because it meets the applicable rules.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这里的“原产资格的取得”是什么意思？Luke：意思是产品满足了适用规则，因此取得原产资格。

messages.speaker: Sara (实习生)
messages.zh: 这里的“原产资格的取得”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does acquisition of origin mean here?

messages.speaker: Luke (贸易业务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-prodott jikseb l-istatus ta' oriġini għax jissodisfa r-regoli applikabbli.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-prodott jikseb l-istatus ta' oriġini għax jissodisfa r-regoli applikabbli.
messages.zh: 意思是产品满足了适用规则，因此取得原产资格。
messages.en: It means that the product obtains originating status because it meets the applicable rules.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象产品通过规则检查后获得一枚“原产资格”印章：这个短语记的是取得资格这一过程，而不只是看到一个产地名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Gained, obtained, or bought, rather than merely wanted or sought.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经通过学习、努力、购买或其他途径获得或取得的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun inkiseb permezz tat-tagħlim, tal-isforz, tax-xiri jew ta' xi mezz ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获得的；购得的；通过学习、经验、购买等途径得到的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun sar ta' xi ħadd jew inkiseb permezz tax-xiri, tat-tagħlim, tal-esperjenza jew ta' mezz ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something acquired has become someone's possession or has been gained through learning, experience, or another process.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 取得的；通过努力、申请或其他途径得到的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun inkiseb wara sforz, talba jew proċess ieħor li wassal biex xi ħadd ġabu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something obtained has been successfully received or gained, often after effort or a particular process.

formal.mt: L-għarfien akkwistat matul il-kors għen lill-parteċipanti japplikaw metodi ġodda fuq il-post tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The knowledge acquired during the course helped participants apply new methods in the workplace.
formal.zh: 课程期间获得的知识帮助参与者在工作中运用了新方法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan huwa t-tagħmir akkwistat reċentement mill-klabb? Pawlu: Iva, xtrajnieh il-ġimgħa li għaddiet u se nużawh fit-taħriġ illum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this the equipment recently acquired by the club? Pawlu: Yes, we bought it last week, and we're going to use it in training today.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这就是俱乐部最近购得的设备吗？Pawlu：对，我们上周买的，今天训练就会用。

messages.speaker: Maja (俱乐部成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan huwa t-tagħmir akkwistat reċentement mill-klabb?
messages.mt_standard: Dan huwa t-tagħmir akkwistat reċentement mill-klabb?
messages.zh: 这就是俱乐部最近购得的设备吗？
messages.en: Is this the equipment recently acquired by the club?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xtrajnieh il-ġimgħa li għaddiet u se nużawh fit-taħriġ illum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xtrajnieh il-ġimgħa li għaddiet u se nużawh fit-taħriġ illum.
messages.zh: 对，我们上周买的，今天训练就会用。
messages.en: Yes, we bought it last week, and we're going to use it in training today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“已经到手”记住 akkwistat：知识学到了、设备买到了，都能用它描述；搭配 għarfien 和 tagħmir 一起练习。

gloss_zh: 藏头诗；首字母组词诗文

teaching_sense.en_definition: A poem or text in which the first letters of successive lines spell a word or message.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种诗文形式，各行的第一个字母依次连起来可拼出词语或信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Poeżija jew test li fih l-ewwel ittri tal-linji, meta jinqraw wara xulxin, jiffurmaw kelma jew messaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 藏头诗或藏头文字，各行首字母依次组成词语或信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Poeżija jew kitba li l-ewwel ittra ta' kull linja tagħha tifforma parti minn kelma jew messaġġ li jinqara minn fuq għal isfel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An acrostic is a poem or piece of writing whose initial letters, read in order, form a word or message.

collocations.en: an acrostic spelling a person's name
collocations.zh: 首字母拼出人名的藏头诗

formal.mt: Għal dan l-eżerċizzju, ikteb akrustika li fiha l-ewwel ittri tal-linji jiffurmaw ismek.
formal.en: For this exercise, write an acrostic in which the first letters of the lines spell your name.
