formal.zh: 本练习要求写一首藏头诗，使各行首字母依次拼出你的名字。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se tikteb fuq il-kartolina? Lara: Se nikteb akrustika b'isem ommi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you going to write on the card? Lara: I'm going to write an acrostic spelling my mother's name.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你打算在卡片上写什么？拉拉：我要写一首首字母拼出我妈妈名字的藏头诗。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算在卡片上写什么？
messages.en: What are you going to write on the card?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要写一首首字母拼出我妈妈名字的藏头诗。
messages.en: I'm going to write an acrostic spelling my mother's name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 akrustika 想成一列诗行：从上往下圈出每行首字母，再把它们拼成名字，借这个画面记住“藏头诗”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Paint used with water, the technique of painting with it, or a picture made using it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用水调和的绘画颜料，也指使用这种颜料的画法或画成的作品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żebgħa li titħallat mal-ilma biex tintuża fil-pittura, it-teknika ta' pittura b'din iż-żebgħa, jew stampa magħmula biha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水彩颜料、水彩画法，或以水彩颜料绘制的画。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żebgħa għall-pittura li tintuża mal-ilma, il-mod ta' kif wieħed ipinġi biha, jew pittura magħmula b'din iż-żebgħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Watercolor is paint mixed with water, and the word also refers to the painting technique or a picture produced with it.

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, l-istudenti se jużaw l-akwarell biex ipinġu pajsaġġ fuq il-karta.
formal.en: In this lesson, the students will use watercolor to paint a landscape on paper.
formal.zh: 本课中，学生将用水彩在纸上绘制风景。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Biex pinġejt din il-fjura? Nina: Bl-akwarell. Ħallatt il-kulur ma' ftit ilma.
colloquial.en: Mark: What did you use to paint this flower? Nina: Watercolor. I mixed the paint with a little water.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你用什么画的这朵花？妮娜：水彩。我在颜料里加了一点水。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你用什么画的这朵花？
messages.en: What did you use to paint this flower?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bl-akwarell. Ħallatt il-kulur ma' ftit ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Bl-akwarell. Ħallatt il-kulur ma' ftit ilma.
messages.zh: 水彩。我在颜料里加了一点水。
messages.en: Watercolor. I mixed the paint with a little water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 akwarell 时，想象画笔蘸水后把颜色晕染在纸上；把“水、颜料、纸上的画”连成一个记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tank for keeping fish and other aquatic life, or a place where such animals are displayed in tanks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 饲养鱼类等水生生物的水箱，也指用水箱展示这些动物的水族馆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tank tal-ilma fejn jinżammu ħut u ħlejjaq oħra tal-ilma, jew post fejn dawn jintwerew lill-pubbliku f'tankijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供鱼类及其他水生生物生活的水族箱，或向公众展示水生动物的水族馆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tank fejn jgħixu ħut jew annimali oħra tal-ilma, jew bini li fih jinżammu u jintwerew dawn l-annimali f'tankijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An aquarium is a tank containing aquatic animals, or a public building where these animals are kept and displayed.

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fl-akwarju, l-istudenti osservaw diversi speċi ta' ħut fit-tankijiet.
formal.en: During their visit to the aquarium, the students observed several species of fish in the tanks.
formal.zh: 参观水族馆时，学生观察了水箱中的多种鱼类。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se npoġġu l-akwarju? Pawlu: Fuq din il-mejda, ħdejn il-kotba.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we put the aquarium? Pawlu: On this table, next to the books.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们把水族箱放在哪里？保罗：放在这张桌子上，书的旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 我们把水族箱放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put the aquarium?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 放在这张桌子上，书的旁边。
messages.en: On this table, next to the books.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 akwarju 配上一幅游鱼在玻璃水箱里活动的画面；家中小箱和供人参观的水族馆都可用这个词记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area or locality, especially the surroundings of a particular place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个地区或地段，尤其指某地点周围的一带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona jew medda ta' art, speċjalment il-postijiet li jinsabu madwar post partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地区、地段，或某个地点附近的一带。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post jew żona b'mod ġenerali, jew il-partijiet ta' madwar post li jkun qed jissemma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An area is a particular part of a place, including the locality or surroundings being referred to.

collocations.en: in the area around the school

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-traffiku fl-akwati tal-iskola matul il-ħinijiet tad-dħul u l-ħruġ tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The report describes traffic in the area around the school during student arrival and departure times.
formal.zh: 报告描述了学生上学和放学时段学校附近一带的交通情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf xi kafetterija fl-akwati? Mark: Iva, hemm waħda ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know a café around here? Mark: Yes, there's one next to the square.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你知道这附近有什么咖啡馆吗？马克：知道，广场旁边有一家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你知道这附近有什么咖啡馆吗？
messages.en: Do you know a café around here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 知道，广场旁边有一家。
messages.en: Yes, there's one next to the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 akwati 时，在地图上围着学校或广场画一个圈，把圈内理解为“周边这一带”；连着 fl-akwati 一起练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A structure or channel built to carry water from one place to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为把水从一处输送到另一处而建造的水渠或架空输水结构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura jew kanal mibni biex iwassal l-ilma minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 输水用的人工渠道或渡槽，尤其指架在高处、跨越低地的输水结构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Akwedott huwa kanal jew struttura mibnija biex twassal l-ilma minn post għal ieħor, xi drabi fuq arkati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An aqueduct is a channel or structure that carries water from one place to another.

formal.mt: Il-manutenzjoni regolari tal-akwedott tgħin biex l-ilma jibqa' jgħaddi mingħajr telf.
formal.en: Regular maintenance of the aqueduct helps water continue to flow without loss.
formal.zh: 定期维护输水渠有助于让水持续流通而不流失。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik l-istruttura fuq l-arkati hija pont? Mark: Le, hija akwedott. Kienet twassal l-ilma minn post għal ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that structure on the arches a bridge? Mark: No, it is an aqueduct. It used to carry water from one place to another.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那座架在拱上的建筑是桥吗？马克：不是，是渡槽。它以前把水从一处输送到另一处。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik l-istruttura fuq l-arkati hija pont?
messages.mt_standard: Dik l-istruttura fuq l-arkati hija pont?
messages.zh: 那座架在拱上的建筑是桥吗？
messages.en: Is that structure on the arches a bridge?

messages.speaker: Mark (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hija akwedott. Kienet twassal l-ilma minn post għal ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hija akwedott. Kienet twassal l-ilma minn post għal ieħor.
messages.zh: 不是，是渡槽。它以前把水从一处输送到另一处。
messages.en: No, it is an aqueduct. It used to carry water from one place to another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 akwedott 想成一座让水通过的高架桥：桥上流的是水，就能记住“渡槽”。

gloss_zh: 雪花石膏；雕刻用的浅色软石

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pale, relatively soft stone used to make sculptures and decorative objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种颜色浅、质地较软的石材，常用于制作雕像和装饰品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġebla ta' lewn ċar u relattivament ratba li tintuża biex isiru skulturi u oġġetti dekorattivi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雪花石膏，一种通常呈白色或浅色、适合雕刻和制作装饰品的细腻软石。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-alabastru huwa ġebla fina, ġeneralment bajda jew ta' lewn ċar, li tista' tinħadem biex isiru skulturi u oġġetti dekorattivi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Alabaster is a pale, soft stone that people carve into sculptures and decorative objects.

formal.mt: L-iskultur għażel l-alabastru biex jagħmel statwa żgħira b'dettalji fini.
formal.en: The sculptor chose alabaster to make a small statue with fine details.
formal.zh: 雕刻家选用雪花石膏制作一尊细节精致的小雕像。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-vażun tal-alabastru? Mark: Iva, tal-alabastru. Ara kemm hu lixx!
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this vase made of alabaster? Mark: Yes, it is alabaster. Look how smooth it is!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个花瓶是雪花石膏做的吗？马克：是的，是雪花石膏。你看它多光滑！

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个花瓶是雪花石膏做的吗？
messages.en: Is this vase made of alabaster?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tal-alabastru. Ara kemm hu lixx!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tal-alabastru. Ara kemm hu lixx!
messages.zh: 是的，是雪花石膏。你看它多光滑！
messages.en: Yes, it is alabaster. Look how smooth it is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 alabastru 和一尊浅白色的小雕像一起记：看到这种细腻石材，就联想到“雪花石膏”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The set of letters used to write a language, usually arranged in a fixed order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种语言书写时使用的整套字母，通常按照固定顺序排列。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sett ta' ittri li jintużaw biex tinkiteb lingwa, normalment irranġati f'ordni fissa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 字母表，指一种语言所使用的全部字母及其通常的排列顺序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-alfabet huwa s-sett sħiħ ta' ittri ta' lingwa, li normalment jitgħallmu u jinkitbu f'ordni stabbilita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An alphabet is the set of letters used in a language, usually presented in a fixed order.

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tal-kors, l-istudenti jitgħallmu jagħrfu u jiktbu l-ittri tal-alfabet Malti.
formal.en: At the beginning of the course, students learn to recognize and write the letters of the Maltese alphabet.
formal.zh: 课程开始时，学生学习辨认和书写马耳他语字母表中的字母。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tgħidli l-alfabet Malti? Mark: Iva, ejja ngħiduh flimkien bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you recite the Maltese alphabet for me? Mark: Yes, let's say it together slowly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能给我念一遍马耳他语字母表吗？马克：可以，我们一起慢慢念吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 你能给我念一遍马耳他语字母表吗？
messages.en: Can you recite the Maltese alphabet for me?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.zh: 可以，我们一起慢慢念吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's say it together slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 alfabet 记成课堂墙上按顺序排列的一整套字母；它指整张字母表，而不是其中一个字母。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In an order determined by the sequence of letters in the alphabet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照字母表中字母的先后次序排列或组织。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skont l-ordni tal-ittri fl-alfabet, bħalma jiġu rranġati l-kliem jew l-ismijiet f'lista.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按字母顺序，即依据字母表中字母的排列次序来安排词语、姓名等。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta kliem jew ismijiet jiġu rranġati alfabetikament, jitqiegħdu skont l-ordni tal-ittri tagħhom fl-alfabet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If words or names are arranged alphabetically, they follow the order of the letters in the alphabet.

formal.mt: L-ismijiet tal-parteċipanti huma elenkati alfabetikament skont il-kunjom.
formal.en: The participants' names are listed alphabetically by surname.
formal.zh: 参与者的姓名按姓氏的字母顺序列出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se nirranġaw dawn il-kotba? Mark: Ejja nqegħduhom alfabetikament skont it-titlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How shall we arrange these books? Mark: Let's put them in alphabetical order by title.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些书我们怎么排列？马克：我们按书名字母顺序摆放吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (图书馆助理)
messages.zh: 这些书我们怎么排列？
messages.en: How shall we arrange these books?

messages.speaker: Mark (图书管理员)
messages.zh: 我们按书名字母顺序摆放吧。
messages.en: Let's put them in alphabetical order by title.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 alfabetikament 放进“整理名单”的画面：照着字母表一个个排好，就记住了“按字母顺序”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to letters of an alphabet or arranged according to their order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与字母表中字母有关的，或按照字母表顺序排列的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ittri tal-alfabett jew li jsegwi l-ordni tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 字母的；与字母表有关的；按字母顺序排列的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-ittri tal-alfabett jew l-arranġament ta' kliem u ismijiet skont l-ordni ta' dawn l-ittri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something alphabetic relates to the letters of an alphabet or follows the order in which those letters occur.

collocations.zh: 按字母顺序编排的索引

formal.mt: L-ismijiet tal-parteċipanti għandhom jitniżżlu f'ordni alfabetiku sabiex ikun aktar faċli li jinstabu.
formal.en: The participants' names should be listed in alphabetical order so that they are easier to find.
formal.zh: 参与者的姓名应按字母顺序列出，以便查找。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif irranġajt il-kotba? Lara: Poġġejthom f'ordni alfabetiku skont il-kunjom tal-awtur.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you arrange the books? Lara: I put them in alphabetical order by the author's surname.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你是怎么整理这些书的？拉拉：我按作者姓氏的字母顺序排列了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是怎么整理这些书的？
messages.en: How did you arrange the books?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġejthom f'ordni alfabetiku skont il-kunjom tal-awtur.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġejthom f'ordni alfabetiku skont il-kunjom tal-awtur.
messages.zh: 我按作者姓氏的字母顺序排列了。
messages.en: I put them in alphabetical order by the author's surname.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 alfabetiku 和字母表的排列画面联系起来：姓名从 A 排到 Z，就想到 ordni alfabetiku。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chess piece that moves diagonally and remains on squares of the same colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 国际象棋中的象，沿斜线移动，始终停留在同一种颜色的格子上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa taċ-ċess li timxi djagonalment u tibqa' dejjem fuq kaxxi tal-istess kulur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 国际象棋中的象，一种沿斜线移动的棋子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa fil-logħba taċ-ċess li tista' timxi għadd ta' kaxxi djagonalment, sakemm ma jkunx hemm biċċa oħra fit-triq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In chess, a bishop is a piece that moves diagonally across any number of unobstructed squares.

formal.mt: F'din il-pożizzjoni, l-alfier jista' jaqbad il-pedina billi jimxi tliet kaxxi djagonalment.
formal.en: In this position, the bishop can capture the pawn by moving three squares diagonally.
formal.zh: 在这个局面中，象可以沿斜线移动三格，吃掉那枚兵。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nċaqlaq l-alfier dritt 'il quddiem? Nina: Le, l-alfier jimxi djagonalment.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I move the bishop straight forward? Nina: No, the bishop moves diagonally.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我能把象竖直向前移动吗？妮娜：不能，象沿斜线走。

messages.speaker: Mark (国际象棋初学者)
messages.zh: 我能把象竖直向前移动吗？
messages.en: Can I move the bishop straight forward?

messages.speaker: Nina (棋友)
messages.zh: 不能，象沿斜线走。
messages.en: No, the bishop moves diagonally.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 alfier 时，在棋盘上画一条斜线，再想象象沿线移动；把词形、棋子和走法一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sets of ordered instructions used to solve problems or carry out calculations; the plural of algoritmu.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为解决问题或完成计算而规定的有序步骤；algoritmi 是算法的复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Settijiet ta' istruzzjonijiet ordnati biex tissolva problema jew isir kalkolu; algoritmi hija l-forma plural ta' algoritmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 算法，即为解决某类问题或完成计算而设定的明确、有序的步骤；本词条形式为复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Algoritmu huwa sett ta' passi ċari u ordnati li jiġu segwiti biex tissolva problema jew isir kalkolu; algoritmi tirreferi għal aktar minn sett wieħed bħal dan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An algorithm is a set of clearly ordered instructions for solving a problem or performing a calculation, and algoritmi is the plural form.

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel żewġ algoritmi ta' tfittxija skont il-ħin meħtieġ biex isibu l-istess informazzjoni.
formal.en: The study compares two search algorithms according to the time they need to find the same information.
formal.zh: 该研究根据查找同一信息所需的时间，对两种搜索算法进行比较。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tipprova żewġ algoritmi? Pawlu: Biex nara liema wieħed isib ir-riżultat aktar malajr.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you trying two algorithms? Pawlu: To see which one finds the result faster.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么要试两种算法？保罗：看看哪一种能更快找到结果。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么要试两种算法？
messages.en: Why are you trying two algorithms?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nara liema wieħed isib ir-riżultat aktar malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nara liema wieħed isib ir-riżultat aktar malajr.
messages.zh: 看看哪一种能更快找到结果。
messages.en: To see which one finds the result faster.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上放着多张解题步骤卡：每张代表一种算法。用 żewġ algoritmi（两种算法）提醒自己这里是复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A set of rules that continuously matches compatible buy and sell orders as trading takes place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在连续交易过程中，按照既定规则持续匹配相容买单与卖单的算法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sett ta' regoli li jqabbel ordnijiet ta' xiri u bejgħ kompatibbli waqt li n-negozjar ikun għaddej kontinwament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 连续交易撮合算法，即在连续交易机制下，依照规定条件匹配买卖订单的算法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura b'passi definiti li, matul negozjar kontinwu, tqabbel ordnijiet ta' xiri ma' ordnijiet ta' bejgħ li jissodisfaw il-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa biex isir skambju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A continuous trading matching algorithm applies defined rules to match compatible buy and sell orders while trading is taking place.

collocations.mt: it-tħaddim ta' algoritmu rikonċiljanti għan-negozjar kontinwu
collocations.en: the operation of a continuous trading matching algorithm
collocations.zh: 连续交易撮合算法的运行

collocations.mt: l-evalwazzjoni ta' algoritmu rikonċiljanti għan-negozjar kontinwu
collocations.en: the evaluation of a continuous trading matching algorithm
collocations.zh: 连续交易撮合算法的评估

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi algoritmu rikonċiljanti għan-negozjar kontinwu li jqabbel ordnijiet ta' xiri u bejgħ skont regoli definiti.
formal.en: The report describes a continuous trading matching algorithm that matches buy and sell orders according to defined rules.
formal.zh: 该报告介绍了一种连续交易撮合算法，它按照既定规则匹配买卖订单。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jagħmel algoritmu rikonċiljanti għan-negozjar kontinwu? Mark: Iqabbel ordnijiet ta' xiri u bejgħ waqt li n-negozjar ikun għaddej.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does a continuous trading matching algorithm do? Mark: It matches buy and sell orders while trading is taking place.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：连续交易撮合算法是做什么的？马克：它在交易进行期间匹配买卖订单。

messages.speaker: Lara (学员)
messages.zh: 连续交易撮合算法是做什么的？
messages.en: What does a continuous trading matching algorithm do?

messages.speaker: Mark (讲师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iqabbel ordnijiet ta' xiri u bejgħ waqt li n-negozjar ikun għaddej.
messages.mt_standard: Iqabbel ordnijiet ta' xiri u bejgħ waqt li n-negozjar ikun għaddej.
messages.zh: 它在交易进行期间匹配买卖订单。
messages.en: It matches buy and sell orders while trading is taking place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整条术语配成一幅画：买单和卖单不断进入，算法按规则逐一配对。用“算法、撮合、连续交易”三个意义块分段记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An algorithm used to coordinate price determination across connected markets according to specified rules.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照规定的规则协调相互关联市场的价格确定过程的算法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Algoritmu li jintuża biex jikkoordina kif jiġu ddeterminati l-prezzijiet fi swieq konnessi skont regoli stabbiliti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于协调相互关联市场定价过程的价格耦合算法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Algoritmu li jintuża biex jikkoordina d-determinazzjoni tal-prezzijiet bejn swieq konnessi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A price coupling algorithm is a set of computational rules used to coordinate the determination of prices across connected markets.

collocations.en: the application of the price coupling algorithm
the results of the price coupling algorithm
collocations.zh: 价格耦合算法的计算结果

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif l-algoritmu tal-akkoppjament tal-prezz jintuża biex jikkoordina d-determinazzjoni tal-prezzijiet bejn is-swieq konnessi.
formal.en: The report explains how the price coupling algorithm is used to coordinate price determination across the connected markets.
formal.zh: 报告说明了如何利用价格耦合算法协调相互关联市场的价格确定过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jagħmel l-algoritmu tal-akkoppjament tal-prezz? Mark: Jgħin biex il-prezzijiet fi swieq konnessi jiġu ddeterminati b'mod koordinat.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the price coupling algorithm do? Mark: It helps prices in connected markets to be determined in a coordinated way.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：价格耦合算法是做什么的？马克：它帮助相互关联的市场协调确定价格。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 价格耦合算法是做什么的？
messages.en: What does the price coupling algorithm do?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jgħin biex il-prezzijiet fi swieq konnessi jiġu ddeterminati b'mod koordinat.
messages.mt_standard: Jgħin biex il-prezzijiet fi swieq konnessi jiġu ddeterminati b'mod koordinat.
messages.zh: 它帮助相互关联的市场协调确定价格。
messages.en: It helps prices in connected markets to be determined in a coordinated way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词想成一台协调多个市场价格的计算器：algoritmu记“算法”，prezz记“价格”，整组一起记作“价格耦合算法”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fish soup served as a dish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以鱼为主要食材煮成、作为一道菜食用的汤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Soppa magħmula bil-ħut li tittiekel bħala platt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用鱼煮成的汤；鱼汤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Soppa li ssir billi jissajjar il-ħut fil-likwidu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Aljotta is a soup made by cooking fish in liquid and serving it as a dish.

formal.mt: L-aljotta ġiet servuta bħala l-ewwel platt waqt l-ikla.
formal.en: The fish soup was served as the first course of the meal.
formal.zh: 这顿饭的第一道菜是鱼汤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi trid tiekol illum? Pawlu: Nixtieq platt aljotta sħuna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What would you like to eat today? Pawlu: I'd like a bowl of hot fish soup.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今天想吃什么？保罗：我想喝一碗热鱼汤。

messages.speaker: Lara (餐厅服务员)
messages.zh: 你今天想吃什么？
messages.en: What would you like to eat today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (顾客)
messages.zh: 我想喝一碗热鱼汤。
messages.en: I'd like a bowl of hot fish soup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把aljotta与一碗冒着热气的鱼汤绑定记忆，再连读platt aljotta“一碗鱼汤”，用点餐画面帮助回想词义。

gloss_zh: 饮用酒精；可供饮用的酒精

teaching_sense.en_definition: Alcohol suitable for human consumption in drinks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 适合用于人类饮用的酒精。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Alkoħol adattat għall-konsum mill-bniedem permezz tax-xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人经口饮用的酒精。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Alkoħol maħsub biex jiġi kkunsmat mill-bniedem permezz tax-xorb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Alcohol for oral consumption is alcohol intended to be consumed by people in drinks.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 适合供人饮用的酒精。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Alkoħol li huwa adattat għall-użu f'xorb għall-konsum mill-bniedem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Potable alcohol is alcohol that is suitable for use in drinks intended for human consumption.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju jiddeskrivi l-kontrolli tal-kwalità li saru fuq kampjun ta' alkoħol potabbli.
formal.en: The laboratory report describes the quality checks carried out on a sample of potable alcohol.
formal.zh: 实验室报告说明了对一份饮用酒精样品进行的质量检查。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ifisser alkoħol potabbli fuq din it-tikketta? David: Ifisser alkoħol adattat għall-użu fix-xorb.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does potable alcohol mean on this label? David: It means alcohol suitable for use in drinks.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个标签上的“饮用酒精”是什么意思？戴维：意思是适合用于饮品的酒精。

messages.speaker: Sara (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser alkoħol potabbli fuq din it-tikketta?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser alkoħol potabbli fuq din it-tikketta?
messages.zh: 这个标签上的“饮用酒精”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does potable alcohol mean on this label?

messages.speaker: David (实验室技术员)
messages.zh: 意思是适合用于饮品的酒精。
messages.en: It means alcohol suitable for use in drinks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把alkoħol记成“酒精”，把potabbli当作“可供饮用”的标签；脑中给酒精瓶贴上饮品用途标签，整组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to introduce a fact or situation that contrasts with what the main clause says.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引出一个与主句内容形成让步关系的事实或情况，表示“虽然”或“尽管”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex tintroduċi fatt jew sitwazzjoni li, minkejja dak li wieħed jistenna, ma jipprevjenux dak li jingħad fil-klawżola prinċipali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虽然；尽管。用于引出让步分句，说明某种情况并未阻止主句所述事情发生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li tintroduċi ċirkostanza li ma twaqqafx milli jseħħ dak li jingħad fil-bqija tas-sentenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use allavolja to introduce a fact that makes the statement in the main clause seem unexpected.

formal.mt: Allavolja l-ħin kien limitat, il-kumitat eżamina kull proposta bir-reqqa.
formal.en: Although time was limited, the committee examined every proposal carefully.
formal.zh: 虽然时间有限，委员会仍仔细审查了每一项提案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħriġt ilbieraħ, allavolja kienet ix-xita? Mark: Iva, mort nimxi ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you go out yesterday, although it was raining? Mark: Yes, I went for a short walk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：昨天虽然下雨，你还是出门了吗？马克：是的，我出去走了一小会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天虽然下雨，你还是出门了吗？
messages.en: Did you go out yesterday, although it was raining?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我出去走了一小会儿。
messages.en: Yes, I went for a short walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“虽然下雨，仍然出门”的画面记allavolja：它引出原本可能构成阻碍的情况，后面的事情却照样发生。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person, group, or country that supports another or works with them towards a shared goal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持另一方或与其合作实现共同目标的人、团体或国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna, grupp jew pajjiż li jagħti appoġġ lil ħaddieħor jew jaħdem miegħu biex jilħqu għan komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在共同目标、行动或利益上提供支持并与另一方合作的盟友或支持者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna, grupp jew pajjiż li jkun fuq l-istess naħa ta' ħaddieħor u jagħtih appoġġ għal għan komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ally is a person, group, or country that supports another and helps them achieve a shared aim.

formal.mt: Il-pajjiż qies lil dan l-istat bħala alleat importanti fil-ħarsien tal-paċi.
formal.en: The country regarded this state as an important ally in preserving peace.
formal.zh: 该国将这个国家视为维护和平的重要盟友。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Nista' noqgħod fuqek waqt il-laqgħa? Pawlu: Iva, għandek alleat fija; nappoġġja l-proposta tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can I count on you during the meeting? Pawlu: Yes, you have an ally in me; I support your proposal.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：开会时我能指望你支持我吗？保罗：可以，我是你的盟友；我支持你的提议。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 开会时我能指望你支持我吗？
messages.en: Can I count on you during the meeting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandek alleat fija; nappoġġja l-proposta tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandek alleat fija; nappoġġja l-proposta tiegħek.
messages.zh: 可以，我是你的盟友；我支持你的提议。
messages.en: Yes, you have an ally in me; I support your proposal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 alleat 和“站在同一边、朝共同目标出力”的画面联系起来；既可指国家盟友，也可指支持你的同事。

gloss_zh: 被指称的；据称的；尚未证实的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Claimed to have happened or to be true, but not yet proved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被声称已经发生或属实，但尚未得到证实的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jingħad li ġara jew li hu minnu, iżda li għadu ma ġiex ippruvat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 据他人声称或指控而存在、发生或属实，但尚未得到证实的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun issemma bħala fatt jew f'akkuża, iżda li l-verità tiegħu tkun għadha ma ġietx ippruvata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An alleged event or act is one that someone claims occurred, although it has not yet been proved.

collocations.en: an alleged breach of the law

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi allegat ksur tar-regoli, iżda l-fatti għadhom ma ġewx ivverifikati.
formal.en: The report describes an alleged breach of the rules, but the facts have not yet been verified.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起被指称的违规行为，但相关事实尚未核实。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Qrajt dwar l-allegat serq fil-maħżen? Pawlu: Iva, iżda għad ma nafux x'ġara eżatt.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you read about the alleged theft at the warehouse? Pawlu: Yes, but we still don't know exactly what happened.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你读到仓库据称发生盗窃的消息了吗？保罗：读到了，但我们还不知道究竟发生了什么。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你读到仓库据称发生盗窃的消息了吗？
messages.en: Did you read about the alleged theft at the warehouse?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda għad ma nafux x'ġara eżatt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda għad ma nafux x'ġara eżatt.
messages.zh: 读到了，但我们还不知道究竟发生了什么。
messages.en: Yes, but we still don't know exactly what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 allegat，就给后面的事件贴一张“有人这样说，尚待证实”的标签；它是形容词，不表示事情已经坐实。

gloss_zh: 据称；据指控；据说但尚未证实

teaching_sense.en_definition: According to what someone claims, without the claim having been proved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据他人的说法或指控而言，但有关说法尚未得到证实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skont dak li jingħad jew jiġi sostnut, mingħajr ma jkun għadu ġie ppruvat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 据他人声称或指控，用于表明所述情况尚未被证实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod li juri li l-informazzjoni hija bbażata fuq dak li qal jew sostna xi ħadd u għadha mhix ippruvata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use allegedly when reporting a claim that has not been proved to be true.

formal.mt: Id-dokument allegatament intbagħat nhar it-Tnejn, iżda d-data għadha ma ġietx ikkonfermata.
formal.en: The document was allegedly sent on Monday, but the date has not yet been confirmed.
formal.zh: 据称该文件于星期一发出，但日期尚未得到确认。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Allegatament, il-ħanut se jagħlaq ix-xahar id-dieħel. Pawlu: Min qallek? Is-sid għadu ma ħabbar xejn.
colloquial.en: Marija: Allegedly, the shop is closing next month. Pawlu: Who told you? The owner hasn't announced anything yet.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：据说这家店下个月要关门。保罗：谁告诉你的？店主还没有宣布任何消息。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Allegatament, il-ħanut se jagħlaq ix-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: Allegatament, il-ħanut se jagħlaq ix-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 据说这家店下个月要关门。
messages.en: Allegedly, the shop is closing next month.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Min qallek? Is-sid għadu ma ħabbar xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Min qallek? Is-sid għadu ma ħabbar xejn.
messages.zh: 谁告诉你的？店主还没有宣布任何消息。
messages.en: Who told you? The owner hasn't announced anything yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 allegatament 想成整句话前的“据称”提示牌：它是副词，提醒读者这项陈述来自尚未证实的说法。

gloss_zh: 指称；指控；尚未证实的说法

teaching_sense.en_definition: A claim that someone has done something wrong, which has not yet been proved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声称某人做了错事或有不当行为、但尚未得到证实的指控。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stqarrija li xi ħadd għamel xi ħaġa ħażina jew mhux xierqa, iżda li għadha ma ġietx ippruvata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尚未证实的指称或指控，通常声称某人有违法、不当或其他错误行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li ssostni li ġara xi ħaġa, normalment xi ħaġa ħażina jew illegali, mingħajr ma tkun għadha ġiet ippruvata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An allegation is a statement claiming that someone has done something wrong, although proof has not yet been established.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat se jeżamina l-allegazzjoni ta' trattament inġust qabel ma jasal għal konklużjoni.
formal.en: The committee will examine the allegation of unfair treatment before reaching a conclusion.
formal.zh: 委员会将在作出结论前审查有关不公平待遇的指控。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Smajt l-allegazzjoni li xi ħadd biddel ir-riżultati? Pawlu: Iva, imma rridu naraw l-evidenza qabel nemmnuha.
colloquial.en: Marija: Have you heard the allegation that someone changed the results? Pawlu: Yes, but we need to see the evidence before believing it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你听到有人篡改结果的指控了吗？保罗：听到了，但我们得先看证据才能相信。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt l-allegazzjoni li xi ħadd biddel ir-riżultati?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt l-allegazzjoni li xi ħadd biddel ir-riżultati?
messages.zh: 你听到有人篡改结果的指控了吗？
messages.en: Have you heard the allegation that someone changed the results?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma rridu naraw l-evidenza qabel nemmnuha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma rridu naraw l-evidenza qabel nemmnuha.
messages.zh: 听到了，但我们得先看证据才能相信。
messages.en: Yes, but we need to see the evidence before believing it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 allegazzjoni 想成一份写着“待查证”的指控书；它指那项说法本身，可以被提出、审查或否认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Using characters, events, or images to represent ideas and convey a meaning beyond the literal account.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过人物、事件或形象象征某些观念，表达字面叙述之外寓意的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol allegoriku juża karattri, ġrajjiet jew xbihat biex jirrappreżenta ideat u jwassal tifsira lil hinn minn dik litterali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寓言式的；借助人物、事件或形象来象征观念、传达深层寓意的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rakkont jew xogħol allegoriku jippreżenta karattri, ġrajjiet jew xbihat li jirrappreżentaw ideat u għandhom tifsira lil hinn minn dik litterali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An allegorical story or work uses its characters, events, or images to represent ideas beyond their literal meaning.

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rakkont allegoriku, il-vjaġġ tal-karattru prinċipali jirrappreżenta t-tfittxija għall-għarfien.
formal.en: In this allegorical story, the main character's journey represents the search for knowledge.
formal.zh: 在这个寓言式故事中，主人公的旅程象征着对知识的追寻。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex f'dan ir-rakkont l-annimali jitkellmu dwar il-poter? Mark: Għax huwa rakkont allegoriku; l-annimali jirrappreżentaw tipi differenti ta' mexxejja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do the animals in this story talk about power? Mark: Because it is an allegorical story; the animals represent different types of leaders.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么这个故事里的动物会谈论权力？马克：因为这是个寓言式故事，动物代表不同类型的领导者。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex f'dan ir-rakkont l-annimali jitkellmu dwar il-poter?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex f'dan ir-rakkont l-annimali jitkellmu dwar il-poter?
messages.zh: 为什么这个故事里的动物会谈论权力？
messages.en: Why do the animals in this story talk about power?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa rakkont allegoriku; l-annimali jirrappreżentaw tipi differenti ta' mexxejja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa rakkont allegoriku; l-annimali jirrappreżentaw tipi differenti ta' mexxejja.
messages.zh: 因为这是个寓言式故事，动物代表不同类型的领导者。
messages.en: Because it is an allegorical story; the animals represent different types of leaders.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“表面讲故事，背后讲观念”：看到 allegoriku，就想象故事中的人物和事件各自代表一种观念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Assigned or set aside for a particular person, purpose, or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经分配给某个人，或已经划定用于某个目的或活动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa allokata tkun ġiet assenjata jew imwarrba għal persuna, għan jew attività partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已分配的；已指定供某人使用或用于某一用途的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ammont jew riżors allokat ikun ġie assenjat jew imwarrab biex jintuża minn persuna jew għal skop speċifiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If money, time, or another resource is allocated, it has been assigned to a particular person or purpose.

formal.mt: L-ammont allokat għall-proġett għandu jintuża biss għax-xiri ta' tagħmir edukattiv.
formal.en: The amount allocated to the project must be used only to purchase educational equipment.
formal.zh: 拨给该项目的款项必须仅用于购买教学设备。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm għandna ħin għall-preżentazzjoni? David: Il-ħin allokat għalina huwa għaxar minuti, mela rridu nkunu konċiżi.
colloquial.en: Lara: How much time do we have for the presentation? David: The time allocated to us is ten minutes, so we need to be concise.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们的展示有多少时间？戴维：分配给我们的是十分钟，所以我们得讲得简洁。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 我们的展示有多少时间？
messages.en: How much time do we have for the presentation?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħin allokat għalina huwa għaxar minuti, mela rridu nkunu konċiżi.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħin allokat għalina huwa għaxar minuti, mela rridu nkunu konċiżi.
messages.zh: 分配给我们的是十分钟，所以我们得讲得简洁。
messages.en: The time allocated to us is ten minutes, so we need to be concise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象预算表或时间表上已经画好的一格：allokat 表示资源已经分给某人或某项用途，抓住“已分配”的状态。

gloss_zh: 语素变体；同一语素的不同形式之一

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the different forms of a single morpheme, with the same meaning or grammatical function.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 同一语素所具有的不同形式之一；这些形式承担相同的意义或语法功能。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Allomorf huwa forma partikolari ta' morfema li għandha l-istess tifsira jew funzjoni grammatikali bħal forom oħra tal-istess morfema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 语素变体：同一语素在不同环境中出现的不同形式之一，其意义或语法功能保持相同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Allomorf huwa waħda mill-forom differenti li morfema tista' tieħu f'kuntesti differenti, filwaqt li żżomm l-istess tifsira jew funzjoni grammatikali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An allomorph is one of the forms that a single morpheme takes in different linguistic environments while retaining its meaning or grammatical function.

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi morfoloġika, ir-riċerkatur identifika kull allomorf u ddeskriva l-kuntest li fih jidher.
formal.en: In the morphological analysis, the researcher identified each allomorph and described the context in which it occurs.
formal.zh: 在形态分析中，研究者识别了每个语素变体，并描述了它出现的环境。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu allomorf? Ġanni: Huwa forma ta' morfema; l-istess morfema jista' jkollha forom differenti bl-istess tifsira jew funzjoni grammatikali.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is an allomorph? Ġanni: It is a form of a morpheme; the same morpheme can have different forms with the same meaning or grammatical function.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：什么是语素变体？詹尼：它是语素的一种形式；同一语素可以有不同形式，而意义或语法功能相同。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是语素变体？
messages.en: What is an allomorph?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa forma ta' morfema; l-istess morfema jista' jkollha forom differenti bl-istess tifsira jew funzjoni grammatikali.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa forma ta' morfema; l-istess morfema jista' jkollha forom differenti bl-istess tifsira jew funzjoni grammatikali.
messages.zh: 它是语素的一种形式；同一语素可以有不同形式，而意义或语法功能相同。
messages.en: It is a form of a morpheme; the same morpheme can have different forms with the same meaning or grammatical function.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“同一语素换外衣”来记 allomorf：外在形式可以改变，所表达的意义或承担的语法功能保持相同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where someone stays or lives, especially temporarily, or the provision of such a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人居住、尤其是暂时停留的地方，也指提供这种住处的安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Alloġġ huwa post fejn persuna toqgħod jew tgħix, speċjalment għal żmien limitat, jew il-provvista ta' post bħal dan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人暂住或过夜的住处；寄宿处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Alloġġ huwa post fejn persuna tista' torqod u toqgħod għal żmien limitat, pereżempju waqt vjaġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Lodging is a place where someone can sleep and stay temporarily, especially while travelling.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人居住或停留的住宿设施，也指住宿的提供或安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Alloġġ huwa post disponibbli biex persuna tgħix jew toqgħod fih, jew l-arranġament biex jingħata tali post.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Accommodation is a place provided for someone to live or stay, or the arrangement of such a place.

formal.mt: L-università tipprovdi alloġġ temporanju lill-istudenti li jkunu għadhom qed ifittxu post fejn jgħixu.
formal.en: The university provides temporary accommodation for students who are still looking for somewhere to live.
formal.zh: 大学为仍在寻找住处的学生提供临时住宿。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Sibt alloġġ għal tmiem il-ġimgħa? Pawlu: Iva, sibt kamra f'dar tal-mistednin qrib il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you found somewhere to stay for the weekend? Pawlu: Yes, I found a room in a guesthouse near the sea.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你找到周末住的地方了吗？保罗：找到了，我在海边附近的一家旅馆订到了一间房。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你找到周末住的地方了吗？
messages.en: Have you found somewhere to stay for the weekend?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sibt kamra f'dar tal-mistednin qrib il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sibt kamra f'dar tal-mistednin qrib il-baħar.
messages.zh: 找到了，我在海边附近的一家旅馆订到了一间房。
messages.en: Yes, I found a room in a guesthouse near the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 alloġġ 和“旅途中放下行李、晚上睡觉的地方”绑定记忆；它可以指住处，也可以指住宿安排。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An indirect reference to a person, event, text, or idea that the audience is expected to recognize.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不直接点明某个人、事件、文本或观念，而让读者或听者自行领会的提及。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Referenza indiretta għal persuna, ġrajja, test jew idea li l-qarrej jew is-semmiegħ mistenni jagħraf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种间接的指涉，即不明说对象而通过提示使人联想到它。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' referenza li ssemmi jew tissuġġerixxi xi ħaġa b'mod indirett, mingħajr ma tidentifikaha b'mod ċar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An allusion is an indirect reference that invites readers or listeners to recognize something without having it explicitly named.

collocations.en: an allusion to a historical event
collocations.zh: 对某一历史事件的暗指

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar paragrafu, l-awtur jagħmel allużjoni għal ġrajja storika mingħajr ma jsemmiha direttament.
formal.en: In the final paragraph, the author makes an allusion to a historical event without naming it directly.
formal.zh: 在最后一段中，作者暗指某一历史事件，却没有直接点明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din hi allużjoni għal dik l-istorja li qrajna? Pawlu: Iva, isem il-karattru jfakkarna fiha, għalkemm it-titlu ma jissemmiex.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this an allusion to that story we read? Pawlu: Yes, the character's name reminds us of it, although the title is not mentioned.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是在暗指我们读过的那个故事吗？保罗：对，人物的名字让我们想起它，虽然没有提到书名。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Din hi allużjoni għal dik l-istorja li qrajna?
messages.mt_standard: Din hi allużjoni għal dik l-istorja li qrajna?
messages.zh: 这是在暗指我们读过的那个故事吗？
messages.en: Is this an allusion to that story we read?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, isem il-karattru jfakkarna fiha, għalkemm it-titlu ma jissemmiex.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, isem il-karattru jfakkarna fiha, għalkemm it-titlu ma jissemmiex.
messages.zh: 对，人物的名字让我们想起它，虽然没有提到书名。
messages.en: Yes, the character's name reminds us of it, although the title is not mentioned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把暗指想成作者留下的线索：只给提示，不报名字，让读者自己联想到对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mention of, or connection to, a person, thing, text, or source.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在说话或写作中提到某个人、事物、文本或来源，或建立与其相关的联系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tismija ta' persuna, ħaġa, test jew sors, jew rabta magħhom f'diskors jew f'kitba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某个人、事物或资料来源的提及、指涉或参照。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Referenza hija tismija ta' persuna, ħaġa jew sors, jew indikazzjoni li torbot id-diskors jew il-kitba magħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reference is a mention of someone or something, or an indication that directs attention to a related source.

collocations.en: a reference to the original source
collocations.zh: 对原始来源的引用或指引

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi referenza għas-sors oriġinali sabiex il-qarrej ikun jista' jivverifika l-informazzjoni.
formal.en: The report includes a reference to the original source so that the reader can verify the information.
formal.zh: 报告列出了原始来源，供读者核实信息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għamilt referenza għal dak il-ktieb? Mark: Għax fih eżempju li jgħinna nifhmu dan il-punt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you make a reference to that book? Mark: Because it contains an example that helps us understand this point.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你为什么提到那本书？马克：因为里面有个例子，能帮助我们理解这一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għamilt referenza għal dak il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għamilt referenza għal dak il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 你为什么提到那本书？
messages.en: Why did you make a reference to that book?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax fih eżempju li jgħinna nifhmu dan il-punt.
messages.mt_standard: Għax fih eżempju li jgħinna nifhmu dan il-punt.
messages.zh: 因为里面有个例子，能帮助我们理解这一点。
messages.en: Because it contains an example that helps us understand this point.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把指涉想成文字中的指路箭头：提到一本书或一个来源，就把读者的注意力引向那里。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At least; used to state a minimum amount, number, or requirement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示数量、程度或要求的最低界限，意思是至少达到所说的标准。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfisser mill-inqas u tintuża biex tindika l-iżgħar ammont, numru jew livell meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 至少；不少于所说的数量，或不低于所说的最低要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Almenu tfisser mill-inqas, jiġifieri mhux inqas mill-ammont, in-numru jew il-livell imsemmi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use almenu to indicate that a stated number, amount, or level is the minimum.

formal.mt: L-applikant għandu jippreżenta almenu żewġ dokumenti li jikkonfermaw l-indirizz tiegħu.
formal.en: The applicant must submit at least two documents confirming his address.
formal.zh: 申请人必须提交至少两份证明其地址的文件。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm irridu ħin biex naslu? David: Almenu siegħa, għax hemm ħafna traffiku.
colloquial.en: Nina: How much time do we need to get there? David: At least an hour, because there is a lot of traffic.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们到那里需要多长时间？戴维：至少一小时，因为路上很堵。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们到那里需要多长时间？
messages.en: How much time do we need to get there?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Almenu siegħa, għax hemm ħafna traffiku.
messages.mt_standard: Almenu siegħa, għax hemm ħafna traffiku.
messages.zh: 至少一小时，因为路上很堵。
messages.en: At least an hour, because there is a lot of traffic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把至少画成一条最低刻度线：almenu 后面的数量是下限，可以更多，不能更少。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A table or raised structure used for offerings or religious ceremonies in a place of worship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗教场所中用于举行仪式、献祭或放置供物的台桌或高台。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mejda jew struttura għolja f'post ta' qima li tintuża għal offerti jew ċerimonji reliġjużi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 祭坛；宗教仪式中用来献祭、放置供物或举行礼仪的台桌。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Struttura, spiss f'għamla ta' mejda, li fuqha jitqiegħdu offerti jew isiru riti reliġjużi f'post ta' qima.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An altar is a table or raised structure where offerings are placed or religious ceremonies are performed.

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, tqiegħdu fjuri u xemgħat fuq l-altar.
formal.en: During the ceremony, flowers and candles were placed on the altar.
formal.zh: 仪式期间，人们在祭坛上摆放了鲜花和蜡烛。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-fjuri? Pawlu: Fuq il-mejda ħdejn l-altar, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where should I put these flowers? Pawlu: On the table beside the altar, please.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这些花应该放在哪里？保罗：请放在祭坛旁边的桌子上。

messages.speaker: Anna (志愿者)
messages.zh: 这些花应该放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these flowers?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教堂工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-mejda ħdejn l-altar, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-mejda ħdejn l-altar, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请放在祭坛旁边的桌子上。
messages.en: On the table beside the altar, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住祭坛的仪式场景：鲜花与蜡烛摆在台上，再用前面、旁边、上面练习位置表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Available as another choice in place of the usual or originally planned one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可用来替代通常选择或原定选择的；提供另一种办法的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joffri għażla oħra minflok dik tas-soltu jew dik ippjanata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 替代的；可作为另一种选择的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jista' jintgħażel jew jintuża minflok xi ħaġa oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An alternative plan or method gives you another choice when the usual one is unsuitable or unavailable.

formal.mt: Jekk il-metodu ewlieni ma jagħtix ir-riżultat mixtieq, għandu jintuża metodu alternattiv.
formal.en: If the main method does not produce the desired result, an alternative method should be used.
formal.zh: 如果主要方法未能取得预期结果，应采用另一种方法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kafetterija magħluqa. Għandek pjan alternattiv? Mark: Iva, nistgħu nieħdu kafè fil-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: The café is closed. Do you have an alternative plan? Mark: Yes, we can have coffee in the square.
colloquial.zh: Maja：咖啡馆关门了。你有别的安排吗？Mark：有，我们可以去广场喝咖啡。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 咖啡馆关门了。你有别的安排吗？
messages.en: The café is closed. Do you have an alternative plan?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我们可以去广场喝咖啡。
messages.en: Yes, we can have coffee in the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 alternattiv 和“备用方案”一起记：原计划行不通，就拿出 pjan alternattiv，重点是还有另一种选择。

gloss_zh: 含糊的；有歧义的（阴性形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unclear because it can be understood in more than one way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因可以有不止一种理解而含糊不清或存在歧义的；此处为阴性形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tista' tinftiehem b'aktar minn mod wieħed u għalhekk mhix ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含糊的；可作多种理解而有歧义的，此处为阴性形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandha aktar minn tifsira possibbli, b'mod li ma jkunx ċar x'inhu maħsub.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a statement or answer is ambiguous, it can be understood in different ways and its intended meaning is unclear.

formal.mt: Il-frażi hija ambigwa u għandha tinkiteb mill-ġdid biex il-qarrej jifhem eżatt x'inhu maħsub.
formal.en: The phrase is ambiguous and should be rewritten so that the reader understands exactly what is intended.
formal.zh: 这个短语有歧义，应重新表述，使读者准确理解所要表达的意思。

colloquial.mt: Lea: It-tweġiba ta' Pawlu kienet ambigwa. Se jiġi jew le? Nina: Ma nafx. Se nistaqsih direttament.
colloquial.en: Lea: Pawlu's answer was ambiguous. Is he coming or not? Nina: I don't know. I'll ask him directly.
colloquial.zh: Lea：Pawlu 的回答含糊不清。他到底来不来？Nina：我不知道。我会直接问他。

messages.speaker: Lea (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tweġiba ta' Pawlu kienet ambigwa. Se jiġi jew le?
messages.mt_standard: It-tweġiba ta' Pawlu kienet ambigwa. Se jiġi jew le?
messages.zh: Pawlu 的回答含糊不清。他到底来不来？
messages.en: Pawlu's answer was ambiguous. Is he coming or not?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我不知道。我会直接问他。
messages.en: I don't know. I'll ask him directly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句回答分出两条理解路线：意思不明确就是 ambigwa；连着阴性名词 tweġiba（回答）一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The surroundings and conditions in which people, animals, or plants live or operate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人、动物或植物生活及活动的周围环境和条件，也可指自然环境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-post, l-affarijiet u l-kundizzjonijiet li jdawru lin-nies, lill-annimali jew lill-pjanti u jinfluwenzawhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 环境；人或其他生物所处的周围事物及条件，也指自然环境。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dak kollu li jdawwar persuna jew ħlejqa, inklużi l-kundizzjonijiet tal-post fejn tgħix jew taħdem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An environment consists of the surroundings and conditions that affect the people or other living things within it.

formal.mt: L-iskola għandha tipprovdi ambjent sigur u kwiet li jgħin lill-istudenti jitgħallmu.
formal.en: The school should provide a safe and quiet environment that helps students learn.
formal.zh: 学校应提供安全、安静且有助于学生学习的环境。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif inhu l-ambjent fl-uffiċċju l-ġdid? Toni: Kwiet ħafna, u l-kollegi jgħinu lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's the environment like in the new office? Toni: It's very quiet, and the colleagues help one another.
colloquial.zh: Sara：新办公室的环境怎么样？Toni：很安静，而且同事们互相帮助。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 新办公室的环境怎么样？
messages.en: What's the environment like in the new office?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kwiet ħafna, u l-kollegi jgħinu lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Kwiet ħafna, u l-kollegi jgħinu lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 很安静，而且同事们互相帮助。
messages.en: It's very quiet, and the colleagues help one another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ambjent 时，在脑中画一个包围人的圆圈：圈内的空气、场所和周围条件共同构成“环境”。

gloss_zh: 环境的；与环境问题有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the environment, including its conditions, protection, and problems affecting it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与环境及其条件有关的，也用于描述环境保护或影响环境的问题。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ambjent, mal-kundizzjonijiet tiegħu jew mal-problemi u l-ħarsien tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 环境的；与周围环境或自然环境有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ambjent jew mal-kundizzjonijiet li fihom jgħixu n-nies, l-annimali u l-pjanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Environmental conditions or factors are connected with the surroundings in which people and other living things exist.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与环境问题有关的，尤其涉及污染、生态影响或环境保护。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda kwistjonijiet bħat-tniġġis, il-ħarsien tan-natura u l-effetti tal-attivitajiet tal-bniedem fuq l-ambjent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Environmental concerns, policies, or discussions deal with problems affecting the environment and ways of protecting it.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza l-impatt ambjentali tal-proġett u jipproponi miżuri biex jitnaqqas it-tniġġis.
formal.en: The report analyses the project's environmental impact and proposes measures to reduce pollution.
formal.zh: 报告分析了该项目对环境的影响，并提出减少污染的措施。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'se tiddiskutu fil-laqgħa tal-lokal? David: Problemi ambjentali, speċjalment iż-żibel li qed jitħalla fit-toroq.
colloquial.en: Anna: What will you discuss at the neighbourhood meeting? David: Environmental problems, especially the rubbish being left in the streets.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你们在社区会议上会讨论什么？David：环境问题，尤其是街上被随意丢弃的垃圾。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 你们在社区会议上会讨论什么？
messages.en: What will you discuss at the neighbourhood meeting?

messages.speaker: David (居民代表)
messages.mt_spoken: Problemi ambjentali, speċjalment iż-żibel li qed jitħalla fit-toroq.
messages.mt_standard: Problemi ambjentali, speċjalment iż-żibel li qed jitħalla fit-toroq.
messages.zh: 环境问题，尤其是街上被随意丢弃的垃圾。
messages.en: Environmental problems, especially the rubbish being left in the streets.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ambjent（环境）与 ambjentali（环境的）配对记：前者命名环境，后者放进“环境条件、环境问题”等搭配中作描述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vehicle equipped to transport sick or injured people and provide urgent medical assistance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于运送病人或伤者，并配有急救设备的车辆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vettura mgħammra biex tittrasporta persuni morda jew midruba u tipprovdi għajnuna medika urġenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 救护车；配有医疗设备、用于运送病人或伤者的车辆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Vettura b'tagħmir mediku li tintuża biex twassal persuni morda jew midruba għall-kura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ambulance is a specially equipped vehicle that takes sick or injured people to receive medical care.

formal.mt: L-ambulanza waslet fuq il-post tal-inċident u ħadet lill-persuna midruba l-isptar.
formal.en: The ambulance arrived at the scene of the accident and took the injured person to hospital.
formal.zh: 救护车抵达事故现场，将伤者送往医院。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Diġà ċempilt għall-ambulanza? Pawlu: Iva, l-ambulanza qiegħda fi triqitha.
colloquial.en: Marta: Have you called for an ambulance yet? Pawlu: Yes, the ambulance is on its way.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你已经打电话叫救护车了吗？保罗：叫了，救护车正在赶来。

messages.speaker: Marta (路人)
messages.zh: 你已经打电话叫救护车了吗？
messages.en: Have you called for an ambulance yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (路人)
messages.zh: 叫了，救护车正在赶来。
messages.en: Yes, the ambulance is on its way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ambulanza 和英语 ambulance 并排记忆，再联想闪灯驶来的救护车；这是词形联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a condition, situation, or service better.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某种状况、处境或服务变得更好。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel kundizzjoni, sitwazzjoni jew servizz aħjar milli kien qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 改善；使原有的不良状况或困难处境有所好转。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel sitwazzjoni jew kundizzjoni diffiċli jew ħażina aħjar milli kienet qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something ameliorates a difficult situation, it makes that situation better or less severe.

formal.mt: Il-proġett ameljora l-kundizzjonijiet tax-xogħol billi pprovda tagħmir aktar sigur.
formal.en: The project improved working conditions by providing safer equipment.
formal.zh: 该项目通过提供更安全的设备，改善了工作条件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tibdil fl-iskeda ameljora s-servizz? Mark: Iva, issa n-nies jistennew inqas.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the timetable change improve the service? Mark: Yes, people wait less now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：调整时刻表后，服务改善了吗？马克：改善了，现在大家等的时间更短了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 调整时刻表后，服务改善了吗？
messages.en: Did the timetable change improve the service?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 改善了，现在大家等的时间更短了。
messages.en: Yes, people wait less now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“原来等很久，调整后等更少”的前后画面记住 ameljora：重点是让已有状况变得更好。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Learning words or information so that they can be recalled without looking at a text.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把文字或信息熟记在心，以便不看原文也能回忆或背诵出来；可通过 bl-amment 这一表达学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tagħlim ta' kliem jew informazzjoni sabiex wieħed ikun jista' jiftakarhom mingħajr ma jħares lejn it-test, kif fl-espressjoni bl-amment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 记诵；通过学习把内容记住，使自己能够脱离原文回忆或背出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih wieħed jitgħallem kliem jew informazzjoni u jżommhom fil-memorja biex ikun jista' jirriproduċihom mingħajr ma jaqra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Memorising involves learning words or information until you can recall them without consulting the original text.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jitgħallmu l-poeżija bl-amment u jirreċitawha mingħajr ma jħarsu lejn il-ktieb.
formal.en: The students should learn the poem by heart and recite it without looking at the book.
formal.zh: 学生应把这首诗背下来，并在不看书的情况下背诵。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Diġà taf il-poeżija bl-amment? Ben: Kważi kollha; għad irrid nitgħallem l-aħħar żewġ versi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you already know the poem by heart? Ben: Almost all of it; I still need to learn the last two lines.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你已经把这首诗背熟了吗？本：差不多全背熟了；我还得背最后两行。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你已经把这首诗背熟了吗？
messages.en: Do you already know the poem by heart?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi kollha; għad irrid nitgħallem l-aħħar żewġ versi.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi kollha; għad irrid nitgħallem l-aħħar żewġ versi.
messages.zh: 差不多全背熟了；我还得背最后两行。
messages.en: Almost all of it; I still need to learn the last two lines.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bl-amment 整体配上“合上书也能背”的画面记忆；先记熟完整搭配，再练习说自己背会了什么。

gloss_zh: 获准进入的；被承认成立的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Accepted or allowed to enter a place or programme; also accepted as valid when discussing a point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示获准进入某场所或参加某课程等；讨论观点时，也表示某一点被承认成立。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aċċettat jew mogħti permess jidħol f'post jew jipparteċipa f'kors; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi punt li jkun aċċettat bħala validu f'diskussjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获准进入的；被接收或录取的，例如获准入院或修读课程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie aċċettat jew ingħata permess jidħol f'post, jiddaħħal l-isptar jew jibda kors.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is admitted has been accepted or given permission to enter a place or join a programme.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被承认成立的；指在讨论或论证中被接受为有效或真实的观点、论点或事实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun aċċettat bħala veru jew validu waqt diskussjoni jew argument, anki jekk jibqa' nuqqas ta' qbil dwar punti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A point that is granted is accepted as true or valid, even when other parts of an argument remain disputed.

formal.mt: Huwa ammess li l-proposta għandha diversi vantaġġi, iżda l-ispiża tagħha għadha teħtieġ eżami bir-reqqa.
formal.en: It is conceded that the proposal has several advantages, but its cost still requires careful examination.
formal.zh: 人们承认这项提案有若干优点，但其成本仍需仔细审查。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħuk ġie ammess għall-kors? David: Iva, irċieva l-konferma dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was your brother admitted to the course? David: Yes, he received confirmation this morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你兄弟被那个课程录取了吗？戴维：是的，他今天早上收到确认通知了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟被那个课程录取了吗？
messages.en: Was your brother admitted to the course?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他今天早上收到确认通知了。
messages.en: Yes, he received confirmation this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面区分 ammess：收到录取通知对应“获准进入”，讨论时点头认可对应“承认这一点成立”。

gloss_zh: 受管理的；已施用的；已配发的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Managed by a responsible person or body, or given or distributed according to an established procedure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由负责人或机构管理的，或按规定程序给予、施用或配发的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Immexxi minn persuna jew entità responsabbli, jew mogħti jew imqassam skont proċedura stabbilita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由负责人或机构管理的；也指药物或治疗已给予或施用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Immexxi jew immaniġġjat minn persuna jew entità responsabbli; jista' jirreferi wkoll għal mediċina jew trattament mogħti lil pazjent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is administered is managed by a responsible person or organization, or given to someone as medicine or treatment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已按规定配发或分发的，尤指药品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mogħti jew imqassam lil min għandu jirċevih skont struzzjonijiet jew regoli, speċjalment meta jkun hemm mediċina involuta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is dispensed is prepared and supplied to the person who needs it, especially when it is medicine.

collocations.en: a fund administered by the council

collocations.zh: 在医疗监督下实施的治疗

formal.mt: Il-fond huwa amministrat minn kumitat li jippubblika rapport finanzjarju kull sena.
formal.en: The fund is administered by a committee that publishes a financial report every year.
formal.zh: 该基金由一个委员会管理，该委员会每年公布一份财务报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min jieħu ħsieb il-fond tal-klabb? Pawlu: Huwa amministrat mit-teżorier, u kull ħlas jitniżżel fir-reġistru.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who looks after the club's fund? Pawlu: It is administered by the treasurer, and every payment is entered in the register.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁负责管理俱乐部的基金？保罗：由财务主管管理，每笔付款都会登记在册。

messages.speaker: Lara (俱乐部成员)
messages.zh: 谁负责管理俱乐部的基金？
messages.en: Who looks after the club's fund?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (俱乐部秘书)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa amministrat mit-teżorier, u kull ħlas jitniżżel fir-reġistru.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa amministrat mit-teżorier, u kull ħlas jitniżżel fir-reġistru.
messages.zh: 由财务主管管理，每笔付款都会登记在册。
messages.en: It is administered by the treasurer, and every payment is entered in the register.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把基金管理表和药品发放表并排想象：amministrat 描述某物受到管理，或已经按程序给予、施用或配发的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A senior naval officer who may command a fleet or another large naval formation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海军中的高级军官，可指挥舰队或其他大型海军编队。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċjal ta' grad għoli fil-flotta militari li jista' jkollu taħt il-kmand tiegħu għadd ta' bastimenti jew formazzjoni navali kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海军中的高级将领，通常担任舰队等部队的高级指挥职务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċjal militari ta' grad għoli fil-flotta, li jista' jkun responsabbli mill-kmand ta' flotta jew ta' parti kbira minnha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An admiral is a senior officer in a navy who may be responsible for commanding a fleet.

formal.mt: L-ammirall ippreżenta pjan biex jikkoordina l-movimenti tal-bastimenti waqt l-eżerċizzju navali.
formal.en: The admiral presented a plan to coordinate the ships' movements during the naval exercise.
formal.zh: 这位海军将领提出了一项计划，用于协调海军演习期间各舰艇的行动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak l-uffiċjal ħdejn il-bastiment? Mark: Dak hu l-ammirall li għandu l-kmand tal-flotta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that officer next to the ship? Mark: That is the admiral who commands the fleet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：舰艇旁边的那位军官是谁？马克：那是指挥舰队的海军将领。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak l-uffiċjal ħdejn il-bastiment?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak l-uffiċjal ħdejn il-bastiment?
messages.zh: 舰艇旁边的那位军官是谁？
messages.en: Who is that officer next to the ship?

messages.speaker: Mark (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu l-ammirall li għandu l-kmand tal-flotta.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu l-ammirall li għandu l-kmand tal-flotta.
messages.zh: 那是指挥舰队的海军将领。
messages.en: That is the admiral who commands the fleet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ammirall 时想象一位站在旗舰上指挥整支舰队的高级军官，把词义牢牢连到海军将领这一画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Permission or acceptance to enter a place, join an institution, or begin a course.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 获准进入某个场所、加入某个机构或就读某项课程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Permess jew aċċettazzjoni biex wieħed jidħol f'post, jingħaqad ma' istituzzjoni jew jibda kors.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准许进入场所或接纳进入机构、课程等的行为或资格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' permess lil persuna biex tidħol f'post jew l-aċċettazzjoni tagħha fi skola, istituzzjoni jew kors.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Admission is the permission or acceptance that allows someone to enter a place or study at an institution.

formal.mt: L-ammissjoni għall-kors tiddependi fuq il-kwalifiki tal-applikant u n-numru ta' postijiet disponibbli.
formal.en: Admission to the course depends on the applicant's qualifications and the number of places available.
formal.zh: 该课程的录取取决于申请人的资历和可提供的名额。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Irridu nixtru biljett għall-mużew illum? Toni: Le, illum l-ammissjoni hija bla ħlas.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do we need to buy a ticket for the museum today? Toni: No, admission is free today.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天去博物馆需要买票吗？托尼：不用，今天免费入场。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.zh: 今天去博物馆需要买票吗？
messages.en: Do we need to buy a ticket for the museum today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, illum l-ammissjoni hija bla ħlas.
messages.mt_standard: Le, illum l-ammissjoni hija bla ħlas.
messages.zh: 不用，今天免费入场。
messages.en: No, admission is free today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ammissjoni 想成门口的一张准入凭证：博物馆允许你入场，学校允许你入学，核心都是获得进入的许可。

teaching_sense.en_definition: How much of something there is, especially a quantity of material or a sum of money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物有多少，尤指物质的量或一笔钱的数额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kemm hemm minn xi ħaġa, speċjalment kwantità ta' materjal jew somma ta' flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某物的量或数额，表示其有多少。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kejl ta' kemm hemm minn xi ħaġa, bħal ilma, xogħol jew flus.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The amount of something is how much of it there is or how much is needed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可通过计数或测量确定的数量或分量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwantità ta' oġġetti jew materjal li tista' tiġi stabbilita billi jingħaddu jew jitkejlu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A quantity is a particular measure or number of something that can be counted or measured.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一笔钱的金额，或若干款项相加所得的总额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus, jew it-total li jinkiseb meta jingħaddu flimkien diversi ħlasijiet jew somom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sum is an amount of money, including a total obtained by adding several payments together.

formal.mt: Il-fattura turi l-ammont totali dovut u d-data sa meta għandu jsir il-ħlas.
formal.en: The invoice shows the total amount due and the date by which payment must be made.
formal.zh: 发票列明了应付总额以及最迟付款日期。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Inżid aktar ilma mas-soppa? Omm: Iva, imma żid ammont żgħir u ħawwad sew.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall I add more water to the soup? Mum: Yes, but add a small amount and stir well.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我要再往汤里加点水吗？妈妈：可以，不过加少量就好，然后充分搅拌。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 我要再往汤里加点水吗？
messages.en: Shall I add more water to the soup?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma żid ammont żgħir u ħawwad sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma żid ammont żgħir u ħawwad sew.
messages.zh: 可以，不过加少量就好，然后充分搅拌。
messages.en: Yes, but add a small amount and stir well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ammont 就在脑中问有多少：水用量杯量，工作看多少，钱看金额；这些场景都围绕数量或数额。

gloss_zh: 释义不明（所给释义为 yhch）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning cannot be established from the supplied gloss 'yhch'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个名词；所给释义“yhch”无法提供可确定的词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu ma tistax tiġi stabbilita mill-glossa mogħtija 'yhch'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义为“yhch”，无法据此确定该名词的含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom mhix ċara, għax il-glossa mogħtija hija 'yhch'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss 'yhch' does not establish a clear meaning for this noun.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'ammunition' għandha l-glossa 'yhch', li ma tagħtix tifsira ċara.
formal.en: The entry 'ammunition' has the gloss 'yhch', which does not provide a clear meaning.
formal.zh: 词条“ammunition”所附的释义是“yhch”，但这并未提供清晰的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tfisser il-kelma 'ammunition' hawn? Mark: Il-glossa hi 'yhch'; minnha ma nistgħux nagħtu tifsira ċara.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'ammunition' mean here? Mark: The gloss is 'yhch'; we cannot establish a clear meaning from it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的“ammunition”是什么意思？Mark：释义是“yhch”；我们无法据此确定清晰的含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“ammunition”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'ammunition' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-glossa hi 'yhch'; minnha ma nistgħux nagħtu tifsira ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Il-glossa hi 'yhch'; minnha ma nistgħux nagħtu tifsira ċara.
messages.zh: 释义是“yhch”；我们无法据此确定清晰的含义。
messages.en: The gloss is 'yhch'; we cannot establish a clear meaning from it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把此词放进“待核实词义”卡片：先记名词身份，不把不明释义硬背成确定含义。

gloss_zh: 虎皮鹦鹉；牡丹鹦鹉（爱情鸟）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small parrot kept as a pet, referring to a budgerigar or a lovebird according to context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种可作宠物饲养的小型鹦鹉；依语境可指虎皮鹦鹉或牡丹鹦鹉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pappagall żgħir li jinżamm bħala annimal domestiku, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala budgerigar jew lovebird skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虎皮鹦鹉，一种常作宠物饲养的小型鹦鹉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pappagall żgħir li spiss jinżamm bħala annimal domestiku u li huwa magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala budgerigar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A budgerigar is a small parrot that people often keep as a pet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牡丹鹦鹉，也称爱情鸟，一种小型鹦鹉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pappagall żgħir magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala lovebird, distint mill-budgerigar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lovebird is a small parrot of a different kind from a budgerigar.

collocations.zh: 笼子里的一只虎皮鹦鹉

formal.mt: L-amorin għandu jkollu ilma nadif kuljum.
formal.en: The budgerigar should have clean water every day.
formal.zh: 应当每天为这只虎皮鹦鹉提供干净的饮水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-amorin? Mark: Fil-gaġġa, ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the budgerigar? Mark: In the cage, beside the window.
colloquial.zh: Maja：虎皮鹦鹉在哪里？Mark：在窗边的笼子里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 虎皮鹦鹉在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the budgerigar?

messages.speaker: Mark (养鸟的朋友)
messages.zh: 在窗边的笼子里。
messages.en: In the cage, beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两张鸟类识别卡，一张虎皮鹦鹉、一张牡丹鹦鹉，都标着 amorin；用上下文选择对应鸟种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that measures time by allowing sand to flow from an upper container into a lower one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用沙子从上部容器流入下部容器来计量时间的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument li jkejjel il-ħin billi jħalli r-ramel jgħaddi mill-parti ta' fuq għall-parti ta' isfel minn fetħa dejqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙漏，通过沙子经狭窄通道向下流动来计量一段时间的器具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arloġġ bir-ramel li jkejjel perjodu ta' ħin hekk kif ir-ramel jgħaddi minn fetħa dejqa minn parti għall-oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An hourglass measures a period of time as sand flows through a narrow opening between two containers.

formal.mt: L-attività tintemm meta r-ramel kollu fl-ampuletta jkun niżel fil-parti ta' isfel.
formal.en: The activity ends when all the sand in the hourglass has reached the lower container.
formal.zh: 当沙漏里的沙子全部流入下部容器时，活动结束。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawwar l-ampuletta biex nibdew il-logħba. Mark: Tajjeb, ir-ramel beda nieżel!
colloquial.en: Maja: Turn the hourglass over so we can start the game. Mark: All right, the sand has started falling!
colloquial.zh: Maja：把沙漏翻过来，我们开始游戏吧。Mark：好，沙子已经开始往下流了！

messages.speaker: Maja (一起玩游戏的朋友)
messages.zh: 把沙漏翻过来，我们开始游戏吧。
messages.en: Turn the hourglass over so we can start the game.

messages.speaker: Mark (一起玩游戏的朋友)
messages.zh: 好，沙子已经开始往下流了！
messages.en: All right, the sand has started falling!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ampuletta 和翻转沙漏的动作一起记：一翻转，沙子下落，一段计时就开始。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An edible curved nut that can be eaten as a snack or used in cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种形状弯曲的食用坚果，可作零食，也可用于烹饪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġewża li tittiekel u li għandha għamla mgħawġa, li tista' tittiekel waħedha jew tintuża fit-tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腰果，一种外形弯曲、可直接食用或用于烹饪的坚果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġewża b'għamla mgħawġa, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala cashew nut, li tittiekel waħedha jew bħala ingredjent fl-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cashew nut is a curved edible nut that people eat as a snack or add to dishes.

formal.mt: L-anakardju jista' jintuża fit-tħejjija ta' zalza biex jagħtiha togħma aktar rikka.
formal.en: Cashew nut can be used in preparing a sauce to give it a richer flavour.
formal.zh: 制作酱汁时可以加入腰果，使味道更加浓郁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid anakardju? Mark: Iva, wieħed bla melħ, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a cashew nut? Mark: Yes, an unsalted one, please.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你要一颗腰果吗？Mark：要，请给我一颗无盐的。

messages.speaker: Maja (分享零食的朋友)
messages.zh: 你要一颗腰果吗？
messages.en: Would you like a cashew nut?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wieħed bla melħ, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wieħed bla melħ, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 要，请给我一颗无盐的。
messages.en: Yes, an unsalted one, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看着一颗弯弯的腰果说 anakardju，再配着记 mixwi“烤的”和 bla melħ“无盐的”。

gloss_zh: 时代错置的；与所处时代不相符的；不合时宜的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Belonging to a different historical period from the one being represented, or unsuitable for the present time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容事物出现在不属于它的历史时期，或观念、做法与当前时代不相适应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidher f'perjodu storiku li ma jaqbilx miegħu, jew li ma għadux adattat għaż-żmien preżenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 时代错置的；出现在不属于其自身的历史时期的；与当今时代不相适应的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jaqbilx mal-perjodu storiku li fih jidher, jew li jidher qadim u mhux adattat għaż-żmien preżenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is anachronistic belongs to a different historical period or seems inappropriate for the time in which it appears.

collocations.zh: 一处与时代不符的细节

formal.mt: Fil-film ambjentat fis-seklu sittax, l-arloġġ diġitali huwa dettall anakronistiku.
formal.en: In the film set in the sixteenth century, the digital watch is an anachronistic detail.
formal.zh: 在这部以十六世纪为背景的电影中，数字手表是一处与时代不符的细节。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak arloġġ diġitali fuq id is-suldat? Mark: Iva, huwa anakronistiku f'film dwar is-seklu sittax.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is that a digital watch on the soldier's wrist? Mark: Yes, it is anachronistic in a film about the sixteenth century.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那个士兵手腕上戴的是数字手表吗？Mark：对，放在一部讲述十六世纪的电影里，它就与时代不符了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak arloġġ diġitali fuq id is-suldat?
messages.mt_standard: Dak arloġġ diġitali fuq id is-suldat?
messages.zh: 那个士兵手腕上戴的是数字手表吗？
messages.en: Is that a digital watch on the soldier's wrist?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa anakronistiku f'film dwar is-seklu sittax.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa anakronistiku f'film dwar is-seklu sittax.
messages.zh: 对，放在一部讲述十六世纪的电影里，它就与时代不符了。
messages.en: Yes, it is anachronistic in a film about the sixteenth century.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象古装电影里的士兵戴着数字手表，用这个画面记住“时代错置的”；这个词是形容词，用来描述那件不合时代的东西。

gloss_zh: 时代错置；与所处时代不相符的事物；不合时宜的观念或做法

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object, detail, idea, or practice that belongs to a different historical period from the one in which it appears.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出现在不属于它的历史时期的事物或细节，也可指与当下时代不相适应的观念或做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett, dettall, idea jew drawwa li ma jaqbilx mal-perjodu storiku li fih jidher, jew li ma għadux adattat għaż-żmien preżenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 时代错置，即某事物被放入不属于它的历史时期；也指与所处时代不相符的事物、观念或做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-preżenza ta' xi ħaġa f'perjodu storiku li ma taqbilx miegħu, jew ħaġa, idea jew drawwa li ma għadhiex adattata għaż-żmien preżenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An anachronism is something that appears in the wrong historical period or seems out of place in its own time.

collocations.en: an anachronism in a historical film
collocations.zh: 历史题材电影中的一处时代错置

formal.mt: Il-preżenza ta' mowbajl f'xena ambjentata fis-seklu tmintax hija anakroniżmu evidenti.
formal.en: The presence of a mobile phone in a scene set in the eighteenth century is an obvious anachronism.
formal.zh: 在以十八世纪为背景的场景中出现手机，是一处明显的时代错置。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex hemm mowbajl f'din ix-xena tas-seklu tmintax? Pawlu: Dak anakroniżmu; il-mowbajls ma kinux jeżistu dak iż-żmien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is there a mobile phone in this eighteenth-century scene? Pawlu: That is an anachronism; mobile phones did not exist at that time.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个十八世纪的场景里为什么会有手机？Pawlu：那是一处时代错置；那个时候还没有手机。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm mowbajl f'din ix-xena tas-seklu tmintax?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm mowbajl f'din ix-xena tas-seklu tmintax?
messages.zh: 这个十八世纪的场景里为什么会有手机？
messages.en: Why is there a mobile phone in this eighteenth-century scene?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak anakroniżmu; il-mowbajls ma kinux jeżistu dak iż-żmien.
messages.mt_standard: Dak anakroniżmu; il-mowbajls ma kinux jeżistu dak iż-żmien.
messages.zh: 那是一处时代错置；那个时候还没有手机。
messages.en: That is an anachronism; mobile phones did not exist at that time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“十八世纪场景里出现手机”当作一处可以指出的错误，记住这个名词表示“时代错置”或那件与时代不符的事物。

gloss_zh: 分析的；善于分析的；采用分析方法的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Using careful examination of separate parts to understand a subject, problem, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过仔细考察各个部分及其关系来理解整体的；采用分析方法的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jeżamina bir-reqqa l-partijiet ta' suġġett, problema jew sitwazzjoni u r-relazzjonijiet bejniethom biex jifhem il-ħaġa kollha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分析的；通过分别考察组成部分及其关系来研究或理解问题的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juża l-analiżi biex jifhem xi ħaġa billi jeżamina l-partijiet tagħha u kif dawn huma marbuta ma' xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An analytic approach examines the separate parts of something carefully in order to understand how the whole works.

formal.mt: L-istudju juża approċċ analitiku biex jeżamina kull parti tal-argument u r-relazzjonijiet bejn il-partijiet.
formal.en: The study uses an analytic approach to examine each part of the argument and the relationships between the parts.
formal.zh: 这项研究采用分析式方法，考察论证的各个部分以及它们之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif se nifhmu dan l-argument? Daniel: Ejja nużaw approċċ analitiku u neżaminawh parti parti.
colloquial.en: Sara: How are we going to understand this argument? Daniel: Let's use an analytic approach and examine it part by part.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们该怎么理解这个论证？Daniel：我们用分析式方法，把它逐部分研究一下吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 我们该怎么理解这个论证？
messages.en: How are we going to understand this argument?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nużaw approċċ analitiku u neżaminawh parti parti.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nużaw approċċ analitiku u neżaminawh parti parti.
messages.zh: 我们用分析式方法，把它逐部分研究一下吧。
messages.en: Let's use an analytic approach and examine it part by part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一个复杂问题拆成几块，逐块检查，再看各块怎样联系；用“拆开看清楚”的学习画面记住“分析的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Examined carefully to understand its composition, features, or meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经过细致检查或研究，以了解其组成、特征或意义的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġie eżaminat bir-reqqa biex jinftiehmu l-kompożizzjoni, il-karatteristiċi jew it-tifsira tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已分析的；已经过细致考察或研究的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li diġà ġie studjat jew eżaminat fid-dettall sabiex jinftiehem aħjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is analysed has been examined carefully so that more can be understood about it.

formal.mt: Il-kampjun analizzat ġie mqabbel ma' kampjun ieħor mill-istess post.
formal.en: The analysed sample was compared with another sample from the same location.
formal.zh: 这个已分析的样本与来自同一地点的另一个样本进行了比较。
