colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan huwa t-test analizzat fil-klassi? Mark: Iva, u n-noti tiegħi qegħdin ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this the text analysed in class? Mark: Yes, and my notes are beside it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这就是课堂上分析过的文本吗？Mark：是的，我的笔记就在旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这就是课堂上分析过的文本吗？
messages.en: Is this the text analysed in class?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u n-noti tiegħi qegħdin ħdejh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u n-noti tiegħi qegħdin ħdejh.
messages.zh: 是的，我的笔记就在旁边。
messages.en: Yes, and my notes are beside it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 analizzat 放在 test 后面记成“已分析的文本”：analiżi 是分析这件事，analizzat 描述东西已经分析过。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A detailed examination of something to understand its parts, features, or meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为理解某事物的组成、特征或意义而进行的细致研究。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżami dettaljat ta' xi ħaġa biex jinftiehmu l-partijiet, il-karatteristiċi jew it-tifsira tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分析；通过细致考察来理解事物的组成、特征或意义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Studju dettaljat ta' xi ħaġa li jgħin biex wieħed jifhem minn xiex tikkonsisti u xi tfisser.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An analysis is a detailed examination that helps you understand something and its different parts.

formal.mt: L-analiżi tad-dejta turi li aktar studenti qed jużaw il-librerija.
formal.en: The analysis of the data shows that more students are using the library.
formal.zh: 数据分析显示，使用图书馆的学生人数正在增加。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lestejt l-analiżi tat-test? Mark: Għadni le. Qed inħares lejn l-aħħar paragrafu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you finished the analysis of the text? Mark: Not yet. I'm looking at the last paragraph.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你完成文本分析了吗？Mark：还没有。我正在看最后一段。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你完成文本分析了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished the analysis of the text?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le. Qed inħares lejn l-aħħar paragrafu.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le. Qed inħares lejn l-aħħar paragrafu.
messages.zh: 还没有。我正在看最后一段。
messages.en: Not yet. I'm looking at the last paragraph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 analiżi 与英文 analysis 联想记忆：看到一篇文章，逐段研究就是做分析；搭配 analiżi dettaljata 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A medicine used to reduce or relieve pain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于减轻或缓解疼痛的药物，即止痛药或镇痛药。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mediċina li tintuża biex tnaqqas jew ittaffi l-uġigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 止痛药，即用于减轻或缓解疼痛的药物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mediċina li ttaffi l-uġigħ jew tnaqqas kemm persuna tħoss uġigħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A painkiller is a medicine that you take to reduce or relieve pain.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镇痛药，即具有缓解疼痛作用的药物，常用于医学表述。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mediċina li għandha l-effett li tnaqqas jew ittaffi l-uġigħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An analgesic is a medicine used to relieve pain, especially when described in medical language.

collocations.zh: 用于缓解疼痛的镇痛药

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-pazjent ingħata analġesiku biex jitnaqqas l-uġigħ.
formal.en: The report indicates that the patient was given an analgesic to reduce the pain.
formal.zh: 报告指出，患者接受了镇痛药治疗，以减轻疼痛。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għal xiex inhu dan l-analġesiku? It-tabib Borg: Huwa mediċina li tnaqqas l-uġigħ.
colloquial.en: Marta: What is this analgesic for? Dr Borg: It is a medicine that reduces pain.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这种镇痛药是做什么用的？Borg医生：它是一种减轻疼痛的药。

messages.speaker: Marta (患者)
messages.zh: 这种镇痛药是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this analgesic for?

messages.speaker: Borg (医生)
messages.zh: 它是一种减轻疼痛的药。
messages.en: It is a medicine that reduces pain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“药物让疼痛减轻”的画面里记忆；英语 painkiller 和 analgesic 在这里都对应同一类止痛药，后者更常见于医学表述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large tropical fruit with rough skin, a crown of stiff leaves, and sweet yellow flesh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种大型热带水果，外皮粗糙，顶部有硬叶，果肉呈黄色且味甜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta tropikali kbira b'qoxra ħarxa, weraq iebes fil-quċċata u polpa safra u ħelwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 菠萝；凤梨，一种外皮粗糙、顶部有硬叶、果肉黄色且味甜的热带水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Frotta tropikali li għandha qoxra ħarxa, kuruna ta' weraq iebes u polpa safra li tittiekel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pineapple is a tropical fruit with rough skin and sweet yellow flesh inside.

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, aqta' l-ananas f'biċċiet żgħar u żidu mal-frott l-ieħor.
formal.en: For this recipe, cut the pineapple into small pieces and add it to the other fruit.
formal.zh: 按照这份食谱，将菠萝切成小块，再加入其他水果中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit ananas mal-jogurt? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Aqtagħli żewġ biċċiet żgħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some pineapple with your yoghurt? Mark: Yes, please. Cut me two small pieces.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的酸奶里要加一点菠萝吗？Mark：好的，谢谢。给我切两小块。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的酸奶里要加一点菠萝吗？
messages.en: Would you like some pineapple with your yoghurt?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Aqtagħli żewġ biċċiet żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Aqtagħli żewġ biċċiet żgħar.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。给我切两小块。
messages.en: Yes, please. Cut me two small pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ananas 就想象一只顶着硬叶的黄色菠萝，再把 meraq tal-ananas“菠萝汁”和 biċċiet tal-ananas“菠萝块”一起记住。

gloss_zh: 无政府状态的；混乱无序的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lacking effective authority or control, often resulting in disorder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏有效权威或管控的，常表现为混乱无序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun mingħajr awtorità jew kontroll effettiv u spiss ikun ikkaratterizzat minn diżordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无政府状态的；缺乏有效权威、管控或秩序的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li fih ma jkunx hemm awtorità jew kontroll effettiv, u għalhekk jista' jkun hemm nuqqas ta' ordni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A situation that is anarchic has little effective authority or control and may be very disorderly.

collocations.zh: 处于无政府状态的国家

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ambjent anarkiku fejn ħadd ma jsegwi regoli komuni.
formal.en: The report describes an anarchic environment where no one follows shared rules.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一个混乱无序的环境，其中没有人遵守共同的规则。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif marret il-laqgħa? Mark: Kien hemm ambjent anarkiku; kulħadd beda jitkellem fl-istess ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the meeting go? Mark: The atmosphere was anarchic; everyone started talking at the same time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：会议开得怎么样？Mark：现场乱成一团，大家都同时开口说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 会议开得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the meeting go?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm ambjent anarkiku; kulħadd beda jitkellem fl-istess ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm ambjent anarkiku; kulħadd beda jitkellem fl-istess ħin.
messages.zh: 现场乱成一团，大家都同时开口说话。
messages.en: The atmosphere was anarchic; everyone started talking at the same time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 anarkiku 与英文 anarchic 联想记忆：想象会议无人主持、人人同时说话，用 ambjent anarkiku 记住“混乱无序的环境”。

gloss_zh: 解剖学的；与身体结构有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to anatomy or the structure of a living body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与解剖学或生物身体各部分的结构有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-anatomija jew mal-istruttura tal-ġisem ta' bniedem, annimal jew organiżmu ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解剖学的；涉及生物身体内部或各部分结构的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-anatomija, jiġifieri l-istudju tal-istruttura tal-ġisem u tal-partijiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something anatomical relates to the structure of a body or to the scientific study of its parts.

formal.mt: L-istudenti użaw mudell anatomiku biex jistudjaw il-pożizzjoni tal-organi fil-ġisem.
formal.en: The students used an anatomical model to study the positions of the organs in the body.
formal.zh: 学生们使用解剖模型来学习各器官在身体中的位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandek dan il-mudell anatomiku fuq il-mejda? Pawlu: Qed nużah biex nitgħallem fejn jinsabu l-organi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you have this anatomical model on the table? Pawlu: I'm using it to learn where the organs are.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么把这个解剖模型放在桌上？Pawlu：我在用它学习各器官的位置。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandek dan il-mudell anatomiku fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandek dan il-mudell anatomiku fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 你为什么把这个解剖模型放在桌上？
messages.en: Why do you have this anatomical model on the table?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nużah biex nitgħallem fejn jinsabu l-organi.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nużah biex nitgħallem fejn jinsabu l-organi.
messages.zh: 我在用它学习各器官的位置。
messages.en: I'm using it to learn where the organs are.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 anatomiku 和英语 anatomical 对照记忆，再想象课堂上的人体解剖模型；用 mudell anatomiku 整组记住“解剖学的”这一形容词义。

gloss_zh: 成人教育学；成人教学理论与方法

teaching_sense.en_definition: The theory and practice of helping adults learn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究并指导成年人学习的教育理论与教学实践。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-teorija u l-prattika tat-tagħlim għall-adulti, li jqisu l-esperjenzi, il-ħtiġijiet u l-għanijiet tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成人教育学，关注成年学习者的特点、需求及相应教学方法的理论与实践。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qasam edukattiv li jistudja kif jitgħallmu l-adulti u kif it-tagħlim jista' jitfassal skont il-ħtiġijiet u l-esperjenzi tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Andragogy is the theory and practice of teaching adults, with attention to their experience and learning needs.

formal.mt: Il-programm japplika l-prinċipji tal-andragogija billi jgħaqqad it-tagħlim mal-esperjenzi tax-xogħol tal-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The programme applies the principles of andragogy by connecting learning with the participants' work experience.
formal.zh: 该项目把学习内容与参与者的工作经验联系起来，以此运用成人教育学的原则。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed tistudja f'dan il-kors? Mark: L-andragogija, jiġifieri kif ngħinu lill-adulti jitgħallmu billi nqisu l-esperjenzi tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you studying in this course? Mark: Andragogy, which means how we help adults learn while taking their experience into account.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你在这门课里学什么？Mark：成人教育学，也就是怎样结合成年人的经验来帮助他们学习。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在这门课里学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying in this course?

messages.speaker: Mark (成人教育课程学员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-andragogija, jiġifieri kif ngħinu lill-adulti jitgħallmu billi nqisu l-esperjenzi tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: L-andragogija, jiġifieri kif ngħinu lill-adulti jitgħallmu billi nqisu l-esperjenzi tagħhom.
messages.zh: 成人教育学，也就是怎样结合成年人的经验来帮助他们学习。
messages.en: Andragogy, which means how we help adults learn while taking their experience into account.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一间成人夜校，老师先听学员分享工作经验，再安排学习任务；用这个课堂画面记住 andragogija 是“成人教育学”。

gloss_zh: 男性更年期；男性随年龄增长出现的渐进性激素变化

teaching_sense.en_definition: A term for gradual hormonal changes associated with ageing in some men.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于指部分男性随年龄增长而出现的渐进性激素变化，常称为男性更年期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Terminu użat għal bidliet ormonali gradwali li jistgħu jseħħu f'xi rġiel hekk kif jikbru fl-età.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 男性更年期，指部分男性随年龄增长出现的渐进性激素变化；并不表示与女性绝经相同的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tirreferi għal bidliet ormonali gradwali f'xi rġiel maż-żieda fl-età, mingħajr ma tfisser proċess identiku għall-menopawża fin-nisa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Male menopause is an expression for gradual hormonal changes in some ageing men, rather than a direct equivalent of female menopause.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 男性更年期；描述部分男性年龄增长过程中渐进性激素变化的术语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Terminu li jiddeskrivi bidliet gradwali fl-ormoni ta' xi rġiel hekk kif jikbru fl-età.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Andropause is a term used to describe gradual hormonal changes that may occur in some men as they age.

collocations.zh: 与男性更年期有关的变化
关于男性更年期的讨论

formal.mt: It-test jispjega li l-andropawża tirreferi għal bidliet ormonali gradwali f'xi rġiel hekk kif jikbru fl-età.
formal.en: The text explains that andropause refers to gradual hormonal changes in some men as they age.
formal.zh: 文章解释说，男性更年期指部分男性随年龄增长而出现的渐进性激素变化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser il-kelma andropawża? David: Tirreferi għal bidliet gradwali fl-ormoni ta' xi rġiel hekk kif jikbru fl-età.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the word andropause mean? David: It refers to gradual hormonal changes in some men as they age.
colloquial.zh: Lara：andropawża 这个词是什么意思？David：它指部分男性随年龄增长而出现的渐进性激素变化。

messages.speaker: Lara (语言学习者)
messages.zh: andropawża 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word andropause mean?

messages.speaker: David (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Tirreferi għal bidliet gradwali fl-ormoni ta' xi rġiel hekk kif jikbru fl-età.
messages.mt_standard: Tirreferi għal bidliet gradwali fl-ormoni ta' xi rġiel hekk kif jikbru fl-età.
messages.zh: 它指部分男性随年龄增长而出现的渐进性激素变化。
messages.en: It refers to gradual hormonal changes in some men as they age.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 andropawża 与英语 andropause 对照记忆，配上“男性、年龄增长、激素逐渐变化”三个提示；不要把“更年期”想成所有男性都会突然经历的固定阶段。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substance used to cause a temporary loss of sensation in part or all of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使身体局部或全身暂时失去感觉、用于麻醉的药物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tintuża biex tikkawża telf temporanju tas-sensazzjoni f'parti mill-ġisem jew fil-ġisem kollu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 麻醉剂，即用于使身体局部或全身暂时失去感觉的药物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mediċina li tintuża biex tneħħi temporanjament is-sensazzjoni, speċjalment dik tal-uġigħ, f'parti mill-ġisem jew fil-ġisem kollu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An anaesthetic is a substance used to produce a temporary loss of sensation during a medical or dental procedure.

formal.mt: Qabel l-intervent, it-tabib spjega li l-anestetiku lokali jneħħi temporanjament is-sensazzjoni fiż-żona ttrattata.
formal.en: Before the procedure, the doctor explained that the local anaesthetic temporarily removes sensation in the treated area.
formal.zh: 操作前，医生解释说，局部麻醉剂会使接受处理的部位暂时失去感觉。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Se tuża anestetiku lokali? Rita: Iva, biex din iż-żona titlef is-sensazzjoni temporanjament waqt it-trattament.
colloquial.en: Mark: Will you use a local anaesthetic? Rita: Yes, so this area temporarily loses sensation during the treatment.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你会使用局部麻醉剂吗？Rita：会，让这个部位在治疗期间暂时失去感觉。

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.zh: 你会使用局部麻醉剂吗？
messages.en: Will you use a local anaesthetic?

messages.speaker: Rita (牙医)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, biex din iż-żona titlef is-sensazzjoni temporanjament waqt it-trattament.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, biex din iż-żona titlef is-sensazzjoni temporanjament waqt it-trattament.
messages.zh: 会，让这个部位在治疗期间暂时失去感觉。
messages.en: Yes, so this area temporarily loses sensation during the treatment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 anestetiku 与英语 anaesthetic 对照，想象牙医使用的一支局部麻醉药；本条按名词记忆，指“麻醉剂”，搭配 lokali 就是“局部麻醉剂”。

gloss_zh: 圣公会的；与圣公会有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Anglican Church, its worship, or its traditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于圣公会的，或与圣公会的礼拜、信仰及传统有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Knisja Anglikana, mal-qima tagħha jew mat-tradizzjonijiet tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣公会的；属于圣公会传统的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni għall-Knisja Anglikana jew għat-tradizzjoni tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something Anglican belongs to or follows the traditions of the Anglican Church.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与圣公会及其活动、礼拜或组织有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa marbut mal-Knisja Anglikana, mal-attivitajiet tagħha, mal-qima tagħha jew mal-organizzazzjoni tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An Anglican activity or institution is connected with the Anglican Church.

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi taħdita dwar il-wirt anglikan u żjara fi knisja Anglikana.
formal.en: The programme includes a talk about Anglican heritage and a visit to an Anglican church.
formal.zh: 活动安排包括一场关于圣公会传统的讲座，以及一次圣公会教堂参观。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan hu servizz anglikan? Mark: Iva, qed isir fil-knisja Anglikana.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this an Anglican service? Mark: Yes, it is taking place in the Anglican church.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这是圣公会的礼拜吗？Mark：是的，正在圣公会教堂里举行。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 这是圣公会的礼拜吗？
messages.en: Is this an Anglican service?

messages.speaker: Mark (接待员)
messages.zh: 是的，正在圣公会教堂里举行。
messages.en: Yes, it is taking place in the Anglican church.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 anglikan 放在 servizz anglikan“圣公会礼拜”中整体记忆，看到它就联想教堂、礼拜和宗教传统。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who creates animated images or makes characters appear to move in films or other media.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作动画图像，或使电影等媒介中的角色呈现运动效果的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li toħloq immaġnijiet animati jew tagħmel karattri jidhru li qed jiċċaqalqu f'films jew f'mezzi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动画师；运用绘画、模型或数字技术制作动画的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tipproduċi animazzjoni permezz ta' tpinġijiet, mudelli jew teknoloġija diġitali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An animator creates images or models that appear to move in an animated production.

formal.mt: L-animatur ħoloq sensiela ta' movimenti għall-karattru prinċipali tal-film.
formal.en: The animator created a sequence of movements for the film's main character.
formal.zh: 动画师为电影的主角制作了一组连续动作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min għamel lil dan il-karattru jiċċaqlaq? Pawlu: L-animatur tagħna; ħadem fuq kull moviment.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who made this character move? Pawlu: Our animator; he worked on every movement.
colloquial.zh: Lara：是谁让这个角色动起来的？Pawlu：我们的动画师；每个动作都是他制作的。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għamel lil dan il-karattru jiċċaqlaq?
messages.mt_standard: Min għamel lil dan il-karattru jiċċaqlaq?
messages.zh: 是谁让这个角色动起来的？
messages.en: Who made this character move?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (动画教师)
messages.mt_spoken: L-animatur tagħna; ħadem fuq kull moviment.
messages.mt_standard: L-animatur tagħna; ħadem fuq kull moviment.
messages.zh: 我们的动画师；每个动作都是他制作的。
messages.en: Our animator; he worked on every movement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 animatur 与英语 animator 对照记忆，再想象一位逐个调整角色动作的动画师，牢牢记住它表示人。

gloss_zh: 敌意；仇视；不友好的对立情绪

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong feeling of dislike or hostility towards another person or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人或某个群体怀有的强烈厌恶、敌意或对立情绪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment qawwi ta' mibegħda jew ostilità lejn persuna oħra jew lejn grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈的不满或仇视，尤其指人与人或群体之间持续存在的敌意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sentiment qawwi ta' nuqqas ta' ħbiberija jew mibegħda, speċjalment meta jdum bejn persuni jew gruppi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Animosity is a strong feeling of dislike that someone has towards another person or group.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 敌意；对某人或某个群体表现出的不友好或对抗态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attitudni ta' nuqqas ta' ħbiberija jew ta' oppożizzjoni lejn persuna jew grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hostility is an unfriendly or antagonistic attitude towards someone or a group.

formal.mt: Il-medjazzjoni kellha l-għan li tnaqqas l-animosità bejn iż-żewġ gruppi u tiffaċilita d-djalogu.
formal.en: The mediation aimed to reduce animosity between the two groups and facilitate dialogue.
formal.zh: 这次调解旨在减少两个群体之间的敌意，并促进对话。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għad hemm animosità bejnek u bejn Mark? Nina: Le, tkellimna u ċċarajna kollox.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there still animosity between you and Mark? Nina: No, we talked and cleared everything up.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你和 Mark 之间还有敌意吗？Nina：没有了，我们谈过，把事情都说清楚了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad hemm animosità bejnek u bejn Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Għad hemm animosità bejnek u bejn Mark?
messages.zh: 你和 Mark 之间还有敌意吗？
messages.en: Is there still animosity between you and Mark?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有了，我们谈过，把事情都说清楚了。
messages.en: No, we talked and cleared everything up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 animosità 放进“两人见面仍互有敌意”的场景记忆；它指一种对立情绪，记拼写时留意末尾的 à。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sweet alcoholic liqueur flavoured with anise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种带有茴香风味的甜味利口酒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Likur alkoħoliku ħelu b'togħma taż-żerriegħa tal-ħlewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 茴香甜酒；以茴香风味为特点的一种甜味利口酒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xarba alkoħolika ħelwa tat-tip likur li għandha t-togħma taż-żerriegħa tal-ħlewwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Anisette is a sweet alcoholic liqueur that has the distinctive flavour of anise.

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob kuċċarina aniżett biex tagħti lill-għaġina togħma ta' ħlewwa.
formal.en: The recipe calls for a teaspoon of anisette to give the dough an anise flavour.
formal.zh: 这份食谱要求加入一茶匙茴香甜酒，使面团带有茴香风味。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhu l-aniżett? Rita: Hu likur ħelu b'togħma ta' ħlewwa; dan hu l-flixkun.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is anisette? Rita: It is a sweet liqueur with an anise flavour; this is the bottle.
colloquial.zh: Mark：茴香甜酒是什么？Rita：是一种带有茴香风味的甜味利口酒；就是这瓶。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 茴香甜酒是什么？
messages.en: What is anisette?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu likur ħelu b'togħma ta' ħlewwa; dan hu l-flixkun.
messages.mt_standard: Hu likur ħelu b'togħma ta' ħlewwa; dan hu l-flixkun.
messages.zh: 是一种带有茴香风味的甜味利口酒；就是这瓶。
messages.en: It is a sweet liqueur with an anise flavour; this is the bottle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一瓶带茴香味的甜酒”作画面记住 aniżett，并搭配 flixkun aniżett 朗读，把酒名与容器一起记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An aromatic plant whose seeds are used to flavour food and drinks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 茴芹，即洋茴香；其种子具有香气，可用来为食物和饮料调味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta aromatika li ż-żerriegħa tagħha tintuża biex tagħti togħma lill-ikel u lix-xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 茴芹（洋茴香），一种种子可作调味香料的芳香植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta bi żrieragħ aromatiċi li jintużaw bħala ħwawar fl-ikel u fix-xorb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Anise is a plant whose aromatic seeds are used to flavour food and drinks.

formal.mt: Din ir-riċetta tuża ż-żerriegħa tal-aniżi biex tagħti togħma lill-gallettini.
formal.en: This recipe uses anise seeds to flavour the biscuits.
formal.zh: 这份食谱使用茴芹籽为饼干增添风味。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'poġġejt f'dawn il-gallettini? Nina: Ftit aniżi. Togħġbok it-togħma?
colloquial.en: Lara: What did you put in these biscuits? Nina: A little anise. Do you like the flavour?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在这些饼干里放了什么？妮娜：一点茴芹。你喜欢这个味道吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在这些饼干里放了什么？
messages.en: What did you put in these biscuits?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 一点茴芹。你喜欢这个味道吗？
messages.en: A little anise. Do you like the flavour?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 aniżi 和英文 anise 放在同一张香料卡上，想象撒进饼干面团的茴芹籽，连着记住 żerriegħa tal-aniżi。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to emphasize that something surprising or unexpected is included.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来强调某个出乎意料的人、事物或情况也包括在内，相当于“甚至”或“连……也”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tenfasizza li persuna, ħaġa jew sitwazzjoni mhux mistennija tkun inkluża wkoll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甚至；连……也，强调所说的情况也适用于某个出乎意料的对象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex turi li dak li jingħad japplika wkoll għal xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li ma tkunx mistennija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use even to emphasize that a surprising or unexpected person, thing, or situation is included.

formal.mt: L-istruzzjonijiet huma tant ċari li anke persuna mingħajr esperjenza tista' ssegwihom.
formal.en: The instructions are so clear that even a person without experience can follow them.
formal.zh: 这些说明非常清楚，连没有经验的人也能照着操作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ġej għall-mixja? Mark: Anke n-nannu ġej! Maja: Tassew? Mela se nkunu ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is coming on the walk? Mark: Even Grandpa is coming! Maja: Really? Then there will be a lot of us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁要一起去散步？马克：连爷爷也要来！玛雅：真的？那我们人可不少。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁要一起去散步？
messages.en: Who is coming on the walk?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 连爷爷也要来！
messages.en: Even Grandpa is coming!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 真的？那我们人可不少。
messages.en: Really? Then there will be a lot of us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 anke 想成聚光灯：它照到谁，就强调“连谁也”。用 anke n-nannu 记住“连爷爷也”，突出意外包含。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join something to another thing or include a document with a message.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物连接或附加到另一物上，也可指随消息附上文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad xi ħaġa ma' oħra jew iżżid dokument ma' messaġġ bħala anness.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物连接或附加到另一物上；附上文件等材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Twaħħal jew tgħaqqad xi ħaġa ma' oħra, jew tinkludi dokument bħala anness ma' messaġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you attach something, you join it to something else or include it with a message.

collocations.en: attach a copy of the certificate

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, annetti kopja taċ-ċertifikat mal-applikazzjoni qabel tibgħatha.
formal.en: Please attach a copy of the certificate to the application before sending it.
formal.zh: 请在发送申请前，随申请附上证书副本。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se nibgħatlek l-email issa. Pawlu: Annetti r-ritratt ukoll, jekk jogħġbok. Sara: Tajjeb, nibgħat kollox flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: I'll send you the email now. Pawlu: Attach the photo too, please. Sara: All right, I'll send everything together.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我现在给你发邮件。保罗：请把照片也附上。萨拉：好的，我把所有东西一起发过去。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 我现在给你发邮件。
messages.en: I'll send you the email now.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 请把照片也附上。
messages.en: Attach the photo too, please.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 好的，我把所有东西一起发过去。
messages.en: All right, I'll send everything together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象点击邮件里的回形针按钮，同时说 annetti fajl，把“附上文件”的动作与这个短语一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of having a name or identity that is not known or disclosed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 姓名或身份不为人所知，或不被公开的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda li fiha l-isem jew l-identità ta' persuna ma jkunux magħrufa jew żvelati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 匿名状态，即个人姓名或身份不为人所知或不被披露。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat li fih persuna ma tkunx identifikata b'isimha jew bl-identità tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Anonymity is the state of having your name or identity kept unknown to other people.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ma jinkludix ismijiet sabiex jipproteġi l-anonimità tal-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The report does not include names in order to protect the participants' anonymity.
formal.zh: 报告不列出姓名，以保护参与者的匿名性。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Irrid nagħti l-opinjoni tiegħi, imma ma rridx li jidher ismi. Lara: Tista' titlob l-anonimità. Rita: Tajjeb, hekk inħossni aktar komda.
colloquial.en: Rita: I want to give my opinion, but I don't want my name to appear. Lara: You can request anonymity. Rita: Good, I feel more comfortable that way.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我想发表意见，但不想显示我的姓名。拉拉：你可以要求匿名。丽塔：好，这样我会更自在。

messages.speaker: Rita (活动参与者)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid nagħti l-opinjoni tiegħi, imma ma rridx li jidher ismi.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid nagħti l-opinjoni tiegħi, imma ma rridx li jidher ismi.
messages.zh: 我想发表意见，但不想显示我的姓名。
messages.en: I want to give my opinion, but I don't want my name to appear.

messages.speaker: Lara (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 你可以要求匿名。
messages.en: You can request anonymity.

messages.speaker: Rita (活动参与者)
messages.zh: 好，这样我会更自在。
messages.en: Good, I feel more comfortable that way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象意见表上的姓名栏被遮住：意见仍然可见，身份保持隐藏，这种状态就是 anonimità，可连着记 titlob l-anonimità。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone or something is anonymous when the person's name or identity is unknown or not made public.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某人的姓名或身份不为人知或未被公开，也可形容未署名的作品、信息等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna tkun anonima meta isimha jew l-identità tagħha ma jkunux magħrufa jew ma jiġux żvelati; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għal kitba jew messaġġ mingħajr isem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 匿名的；姓名、身份或作者未公开的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li isimha ma jkunx magħruf jew żvelat, jew kitba jew messaġġ li ma jurix min kitbu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is anonymous, their name or identity is unknown or has deliberately not been revealed.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi informazzjoni minn sors anonimu li talab li ismu ma jiġix ippubblikat.
formal.en: The report includes information from an anonymous source who requested that his name not be published.
formal.zh: 报告包含一位匿名消息人士提供的信息，他要求不要公布自己的姓名。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min bagħat dan il-messaġġ? Pawlu: Ma nafx. Min bagħtu baqa' anonimu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who sent this message? Pawlu: I don't know. Whoever sent it remained anonymous.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这条消息是谁发的？保罗：我不知道，发送者没有透露身份。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 这条消息是谁发的？
messages.en: Who sent this message?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx. Min bagħtu baqa' anonimu.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx. Min bagħtu baqa' anonimu.
messages.zh: 我不知道，发送者没有透露身份。
messages.en: I don't know. Whoever sent it remained anonymous.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一封没有署名的来信，把 anonimu 与“看得到内容，看不到姓名”的画面一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Anxiety is a feeling of worry or unease, especially about something uncertain that may happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对不确定的事情或可能发生的情况感到担忧、紧张和不安的情绪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ansjetà hija sensazzjoni ta' tħassib u nuqqas ta' serħan, speċjalment dwar xi ħaġa li tista' tiġri u li r-riżultat tagħha għadu mhux magħruf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 焦虑；因不确定的情况或对未来的担忧而产生的不安情绪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ansjetà hija stat ta' tħassib, tensjoni jew biża' dwar xi ħaġa li tista' tiġri jew li wieħed għadu ma jafx kif se tispiċċa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Anxiety is a feeling of worry or nervousness about something that might happen.

formal.mt: L-istħarriġ juri li ħafna studenti jħossu ansjetà qabel l-eżamijiet.
formal.en: The survey shows that many students feel anxiety before examinations.
formal.zh: 调查显示，许多学生在考试前会感到焦虑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed inħoss ħafna ansjetà dwar l-eżami ta' għada. Mark: Trid nirrevedu flimkien għal ftit?
colloquial.en: Sara: I'm feeling a lot of anxiety about tomorrow's exam. Mark: Would you like us to revise together for a while?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：想到明天的考试，我感到很焦虑。马克：要不要一起复习一会儿？

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħoss ħafna ansjetà dwar l-eżami ta' għada.
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħoss ħafna ansjetà dwar l-eżami ta' għada.
messages.zh: 想到明天的考试，我感到很焦虑。
messages.en: I'm feeling a lot of anxiety about tomorrow's exam.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 要不要一起复习一会儿？
messages.en: Would you like us to revise together for a while?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ansjetà 写在“明天考试，心里不安”的情绪卡上，记住它是表示焦虑这种感受的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who is anxious feels worried, uneasy, or nervous about something that may happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人因担心某件事或面对即将发生的事情而感到焦虑、紧张不安。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna tkun ansjuża meta tħoss tħassib, tensjoni jew nuqqas ta' serħan dwar xi ħaġa li tista' tiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 焦虑的；因担心某事的结果或可能发生的事情而不安的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li tħossha mħassba dwar xi ħaġa, speċjalment meta ma tkunx taf x'se jiġri jew kif se tispiċċa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are anxious about something, you feel worried because you are uncertain about what will happen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧张不安的；面对考试、面试等情境时难以放松的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li tħoss tensjoni u ma tkunx tista' tirrilassa faċilment, pereżempju qabel eżami, intervista jew diskors quddiem in-nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you feel nervous, you are tense or uneasy, especially before a difficult or important event.

formal.mt: Il-kandidat kien ansjuż qabel l-intervista, iżda wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet kollha b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The candidate was nervous before the interview, but he answered all the questions clearly.
formal.zh: 这位应聘者在面试前很紧张，但他清楚地回答了所有问题。

colloquial.mt: Luqa: Jien ansjuż dwar ir-riżultat tal-eżami. Nina: Nifhmek. Trid noħorġu nimxu ftit waqt li tistenna?
colloquial.en: Luqa: I'm anxious about the exam result. Nina: I understand. Shall we go for a short walk while you wait?
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：我很担心考试结果。妮娜：我理解。等结果的时候，我们出去走一会儿好吗？

messages.speaker: Luqa (学生)
messages.zh: 我很担心考试结果。
messages.en: I'm anxious about the exam result.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhmek. Trid noħorġu nimxu ftit waqt li tistenna?
messages.mt_standard: Nifhmek. Trid noħorġu nimxu ftit waqt li tistenna?
messages.zh: 我理解。等结果的时候，我们出去走一会儿好吗？
messages.en: I understand. Shall we go for a short walk while you wait?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“他很焦虑”记 ansjuż，用“他感到焦虑”记 ansjetà：前者形容人的状态，后者命名这种情绪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Pole is a person who comes from Poland or has Polish nationality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自波兰或具有波兰国籍的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Antarjoli huwa persuna li ġejja mill-Polonja jew li għandha n-nazzjonalità Pollakka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 波兰人；来自波兰或具有波兰国籍的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Antarjoli huwa bniedem li ġej mill-Polonja jew li għandu n-nazzjonalità Pollakka.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Pole is someone who comes from Poland or is a citizen of that country.

collocations.zh: 居住在马耳他的波兰人
会说马耳他语的波兰人

formal.mt: Għall-proġett kulturali, intervistajna Antarjoli li jgħix Malta u jitkellem bil-Malti.
formal.en: For the cultural project, we interviewed a Pole who lives in Malta and speaks Maltese.
formal.zh: 为了开展这项文化项目，我们采访了一位居住在马耳他、会说马耳他语的波兰人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ġar il-ġdid tiegħek huwa Antarjoli? David: Iva, ġej mill-Polonja u issa qed jitgħallem il-Malti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is your new neighbour a Pole? David: Yes, he comes from Poland and is now learning Maltese.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的新邻居是波兰人吗？戴维：是的，他来自波兰，现在正在学习马耳他语。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的新邻居是波兰人吗？
messages.en: Is your new neighbour a Pole?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mill-Polonja u issa qed jitgħallem il-Malti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mill-Polonja u issa qed jitgħallem il-Malti.
messages.zh: 是的，他来自波兰，现在正在学习马耳他语。
messages.en: Yes, he comes from Poland and is now learning Maltese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Antarjoli 与一张标着“来自波兰”的人物卡配对，按本条给定词义记住它表示波兰人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Situated at the front of a body or structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于身体或某一结构前部的，常用于描述解剖位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab fil-parti ta' quddiem tal-ġisem jew ta' struttura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 前部的；位于身体或结构前方的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab fuq in-naħa ta' quddiem tal-ġisem jew ta' struttura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The anterior part of a body or structure is the part situated at the front.

collocations.en: the anterior surface of the heart

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-wiċċ anterjuri tal-qalb u l-vini ewlenin.
formal.en: The diagram shows the anterior surface of the heart and the main blood vessels.
formal.zh: 该图展示了心脏的前表面和主要血管。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'anterjuri' hawn? Pawlu: Tfisser li qiegħed fuq in-naħa ta' quddiem. Lara: Mela din hija l-parti ta' quddiem tal-qalb.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'anterior' mean here? Pawlu: It means situated at the front. Lara: So this is the front part of the heart.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的“anterjuri”是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是位于前方。Lara：那么，这就是心脏的前部。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“anterjuri”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'anterior' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li qiegħed fuq in-naħa ta' quddiem.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li qiegħed fuq in-naħa ta' quddiem.
messages.zh: 意思是位于前方。
messages.en: It means situated at the front.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela din hija l-parti ta' quddiem tal-qalb.
messages.mt_standard: Mela din hija l-parti ta' quddiem tal-qalb.
messages.zh: 那么，这就是心脏的前部。
messages.en: So this is the front part of the heart.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看人体示意图时，把 anterjuri 写在朝向观察者的前表面，联想“前部的”；用位置图帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A medicine used to treat bacterial infections.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于治疗细菌感染的药物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mediċina li tintuża biex tikkura infezzjonijiet ikkawżati mill-batterji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抗生素；用于杀死细菌或抑制细菌生长、治疗细菌感染的药物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mediċina li toqtol il-batterji jew twaqqafhom milli jikbru, u li tintuża biex tikkura infezzjonijiet ikkawżati minnhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An antibiotic is a medicine that treats bacterial infections by killing bacteria or preventing their growth.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li t-tabib ippreskriva antibijotiku biex jikkura l-infezzjoni batterika.
formal.en: The report indicates that the doctor prescribed an antibiotic to treat the bacterial infection.
formal.zh: 报告指出，医生开了一种抗生素来治疗该细菌感染。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'kitiblek it-tabib? Ġanni: Kitibli riċetta għal antibijotiku. Marija: Se tmur l-ispiżerija issa? Ġanni: Iva, se niġbru minn hemm.
colloquial.en: Marija: What did the doctor prescribe for you? Ġanni: He gave me a prescription for an antibiotic. Marija: Are you going to the pharmacy now? Ġanni: Yes, I'm going to collect it there.
colloquial.zh: Marija：医生给你开了什么？Ġanni：他给我开了抗生素处方。Marija：你现在去药房吗？Ġanni：是的，我去那里取药。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生给你开了什么？
messages.en: What did the doctor prescribe for you?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.zh: 他给我开了抗生素处方。
messages.en: He gave me a prescription for an antibiotic.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你现在去药房吗？
messages.en: Are you going to the pharmacy now?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我去那里取药。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going to collect it there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 antibijotiku 和“细菌感染”画在同一张词卡上，再配上“服用抗生素”的搭配，按用途记住这个药物名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A medicine used to treat depression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于治疗抑郁症的药物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mediċina li tintuża biex tikkura d-dipressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抗抑郁药；用于治疗抑郁症、帮助减轻其症状的药物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mediċina użata fil-kura tad-dipressjoni biex tgħin ittaffi s-sintomi tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An antidepressant is a medicine used to treat depression and help relieve its symptoms.

formal.mt: It-tabiba spjegat lill-pazjent għaliex kienet qed tippreskrivi antidipressiv għall-kura tad-dipressjoni.
formal.en: The doctor explained to the patient why she was prescribing an antidepressant to treat depression.
formal.zh: 医生向患者解释了她为什么开具抗抑郁药来治疗抑郁症。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-tabiba kitbitli antidipressiv. Sara: Spjegatlek kif tieħdu? Nina: Iva, u għandi appuntament ieħor magħha x-xahar id-dieħel.
colloquial.en: Nina: The doctor prescribed an antidepressant for me. Sara: Did she explain how to take it? Nina: Yes, and I have another appointment with her next month.
colloquial.zh: Nina：医生给我开了抗抑郁药。Sara：她解释怎么服用了吗？Nina：解释了，而且我下个月还约了她复诊。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生给我开了抗抑郁药。
messages.en: The doctor prescribed an antidepressant for me.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 她解释怎么服用了吗？
messages.en: Did she explain how to take it?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għandi appuntament ieħor magħha x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għandi appuntament ieħor magħha x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 解释了，而且我下个月还约了她复诊。
messages.en: Yes, and I have another appointment with her next month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 antidipressiv 放进“医生开药、治疗抑郁症”的情景中记忆；本词是药物名词，可搭配“服用”和“开具”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Old or belonging to an earlier period, including the distant past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 年代较久或属于过去某一时期的；依语境可指古董、旧物或古代事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ilu jeżisti għal żmien twil jew li jappartjeni għal żmien imgħoddi, anki għall-qedem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 古董的；指器物因年代久远而具有收藏价值或历史价值的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi oġġett magħmul żmien twil ilu u apprezzat għall-età jew għall-valur storiku tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An antique object was made a long time ago and is valued for its age or historical interest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旧的；存在或使用已有较长时间的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ilu jeżisti jew jintuża għal żmien twil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is old has existed or been used for a long time.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 古代的；属于遥远过去、尤其是早期历史时期的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni għal żmien imbiegħed ħafna fil-passat, speċjalment għall-ewwel żminijiet tal-istorja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something ancient belongs to a very distant period of the past, especially an early historical period.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-mużew jiddeskrivi arloġġ antik b'valur storiku u jinkludi ritratt ta' tempju antik.
formal.en: The museum catalogue describes an antique clock of historical value and includes a photograph of an ancient temple.
formal.zh: 博物馆目录介绍了一座具有历史价值的古董钟，并收录了一张古代神庙的照片。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ktieb antik għadek tużah? Lara: Iva, fih riċetti tan-nanna. Mark: U dak l-arloġġ antik? Lara: Dak ukoll kien tagħha, u għadu jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you still use this old book? Lara: Yes, it contains Grandma's recipes. Mark: And that antique clock? Lara: That was hers too, and it still works.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这本旧书你还在用吗？Lara：是的，里面有奶奶的食谱。Mark：那座古董钟呢？Lara：那也是她的，而且现在还走。

messages.mt_standard: Dak ukoll kien tagħha, u għadu jaħdem.
messages.zh: 那也是她的，而且现在还走。
messages.en: That was hers too, and it still works.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记 antik：收藏柜里的古董钟、书桌上的旧书、遗址中的古代神庙；根据所修饰的名词判断具体义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A room before a larger or more important room, often used for waiting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于较大或较重要房间外面的前厅，通常供人等候。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra li tinsab qabel kamra akbar jew aktar importanti u li spiss tintuża biex in-nies jistennew fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通往主要房间的前厅，常用作等候空间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kamra li minnha wieħed jgħaddi biex jidħol f'kamra prinċipali u fejn jista' jistenna qabel jidħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An antechamber is a small room where people often wait before entering a larger or more important room.

formal.mt: Il-mistednin intalbu jistennew fl-antikamra qabel ma jidħlu fis-sala tal-laqgħat.
formal.en: The guests were asked to wait in the antechamber before entering the meeting hall.
formal.zh: 来宾被请到前厅等候，然后再进入会议大厅。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nistenniek? Mark: Stennieni fl-antikamra, ħdejn il-bieb tas-sala.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I wait for you? Mark: Wait for me in the antechamber, beside the door to the hall.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我在哪里等你？马克：在前厅等我，就在大厅门旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在哪里等你？
messages.en: Where should I wait for you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在前厅等我，就在大厅门旁边。
messages.en: Wait for me in the antechamber, beside the door to the hall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象进入正式大厅前，先在一间小厅等候；把这个门外等候的画面与 antikamra 联系起来。

gloss_zh: 古代；古董、收藏品的统称

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ancient historical period, or a general term for antiques and collectable objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指古代这一历史时期，也可统称古董和具有收藏价值的物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-perjodu tal-qedem fl-istorja, jew terminu ġenerali għal oġġetti qodma li għandhom valur għall-kollezzjonisti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 古代，指历史上久远的时期。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-perjodu tal-qedem fl-istorja, meta kienu jeżistu ċiviltajiet bħall-Griegi u r-Rumani tal-qedem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Antiquity is the distant historical period associated with ancient civilizations, such as those of Greece and Rome.

sense_translations.en_definition: antiques (generic term for antiques and collectables)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 古董及收藏品的统称，指因年代、工艺或收藏价值而受重视的物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Terminu ġenerali għal oġġetti qodma u oġġetti tal-kollezzjoni li huma apprezzati minħabba l-età, is-sengħa jew il-valur tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Antiques are old or collectable objects that people value for their age, craftsmanship, or interest to collectors.

formal.mt: Il-wirja teżamina l-ħajja ta' kuljum fl-antikità permezz ta' għodod u oġġetti tad-dar.
formal.en: The exhibition examines everyday life in antiquity through tools and household objects.
formal.zh: 该展览通过工具和家居用品，探讨古代的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tip ta' affarijiet tiġbor? Pawlu: Niġbor oġġetti ta' antikità, speċjalment arloġġi qodma.
colloquial.en: Lara: What kind of things do you collect? Pawlu: I collect antiques, especially old clocks.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你收藏哪类东西？保罗：我收藏古董，尤其是老式钟表。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你收藏哪类东西？
messages.en: What kind of things do you collect?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (收藏者)
messages.mt_spoken: Niġbor oġġetti ta' antikità, speċjalment arloġġi qodma.
messages.mt_standard: Niġbor oġġetti ta' antikità, speċjalment arloġġi qodma.
messages.zh: 我收藏古董，尤其是老式钟表。
messages.en: I collect antiques, especially old clocks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 antikità：历史时间轴上的古代，以及收藏柜里的古董；遇到句子先判断是在谈时代还是物件。

gloss_zh: 古旧书物店；古董店；古董商

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shop selling old books or antiques, or a person who buys and sells antiques.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出售古旧书籍或古董的店铺，也可指买卖古董的商人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanut li jbigħ kotba qodma jew oġġetti ta' antikità, jew persuna li tixtri u tbigħ oġġetti ta' antikità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经营古旧书籍或具有收藏价值的旧物的商店。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħanut li jispeċjalizza fil-bejgħ ta' kotba qodma jew oġġetti qodma ta' interess għall-kollezzjonisti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An antiquarian shop is a shop that specializes in old books or other old objects of interest to collectors.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 古董店，出售因年代、工艺或历史价值而受重视的旧物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħanut fejn jinbiegħu oġġetti qodma li għandhom valur minħabba l-età, is-sengħa jew l-importanza storika tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An antique shop is a shop where old objects valued for their age, craftsmanship, or historical interest are sold.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 古董商，以收购和出售古董为业的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tixtri u tbigħ oġġetti ta' antikità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An antique dealer is a person whose business involves buying and selling old objects valued as antiques.

formal.mt: L-antikwarju eżamina l-mejda u spjega lill-klijent li l-valur tagħha jiddependi wkoll mill-kundizzjoni tagħha.
formal.en: The antique dealer examined the table and explained to the customer that its value also depended on its condition.
formal.zh: 古董商检查了这张桌子，并向顾客解释，它的价值也取决于保存状况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn fejn xtrajt dik il-lampa? Mark: Minn antikwarju ħdejn il-pjazza. Għandu ħafna affarijiet sbieħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did you buy that lamp? Mark: From an antique dealer near the square. He has lots of lovely things.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你那盏灯在哪里买的？马克：从广场附近的一位古董商那里买的。他那里有很多漂亮的东西。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你那盏灯在哪里买的？
messages.en: Where did you buy that lamp?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn antikwarju ħdejn il-pjazza. Għandu ħafna affarijiet sbieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Minn antikwarju ħdejn il-pjazza. Għandu ħafna affarijiet sbieħ.
messages.zh: 从广场附近的一位古董商那里买的。他那里有很多漂亮的东西。
messages.en: From an antique dealer near the square. He has lots of lovely things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 antikwarju 记成古董交易场景里的店与人：能走进去的是店，能检查物件并报价的是商人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small dish served before the main course to stimulate the appetite.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主菜之前供应的少量菜肴或小食，用来开胃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Porzjon żgħir ta' ikel li jiġi servut qabel il-platt prinċipali biex iqanqal l-aptit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开胃菜，在主菜之前供应的一小份食物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Platt żgħir li jittiekel qabel il-platt prinċipali biex iqanqal l-aptit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An appetizer is a small dish served before the main course of a meal to stimulate your appetite.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 餐前小食或小份冷、热开胃菜。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikel f'porzjonijiet żgħar, kiesaħ jew sħun, li jiġi servut qabel l-ikla prinċipali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An hors d'oeuvre is a small portion of savoury food served before the main part of a meal.

formal.mt: Bħala antipast, ir-ristorant joffri platt żgħir ta' ħaxix mixwi u ġobon lokali.
formal.en: As an appetizer, the restaurant offers a small plate of grilled vegetables and local cheese.
formal.zh: 这家餐厅供应一小盘烤蔬菜和本地奶酪作为开胃菜。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nieħdu antipast x'naqsmu bejnietna? Luqa: Iva, nieħdu platt żgħir ta' żebbuġ u ġobon.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall we get an appetizer to share? Luqa: Yes, let's get a small plate of olives and cheese.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们点一份开胃菜一起吃吧？卢卡：好，点一小盘橄榄和奶酪吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (用餐者)
messages.zh: 我们点一份开胃菜一起吃吧？
messages.en: Shall we get an appetizer to share?

messages.speaker: Luqa (用餐者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nieħdu platt żgħir ta' żebbuġ u ġobon.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nieħdu platt żgħir ta' żebbuġ u ġobon.
messages.zh: 好，点一小盘橄榄和奶酪吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's get a small plate of olives and cheese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象主菜上桌前，先端来一小盘橄榄和奶酪；把这份先吃一点、打开胃口的小菜记作 antipast。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of irritation caused by someone or something unpleasant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某人或某事令人讨厌而产生的烦厌或不快。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' dwejjaq jew irritazzjoni li persuna tħoss minħabba xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li ddejjaqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由令人讨厌的人、行为或事情引起的烦厌感。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sens ta' irritazzjoni jew dwejjaq ikkawżat minn persuna, imġiba jew sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Annoyance is the irritation you feel when someone or something bothers you.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人尴尬或不自在的；使交往显得别扭的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu skomdu jew imbarazzat waqt sitwazzjoni soċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something awkward makes people feel uncomfortable or embarrassed in a social situation.

formal.mt: Il-kummenti ripetuti tiegħu qajmu antipatija fost il-parteċipanti u fixklu d-diskussjoni.
formal.en: His repeated comments aroused annoyance among the participants and disrupted the discussion.
formal.zh: 他反复发表的那些评论引起了参与者的烦厌，并干扰了讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tħoss antipatija lejn Pawlu? Rita: Għax dejjem jaqtagħli kliemi meta nkun qed nitkellem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you feel annoyed with Pawlu? Rita: Because he always interrupts me when I am speaking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么对保罗感到烦厌？丽塔：因为我说话时，他总是打断我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么对保罗感到烦厌？
messages.en: Why do you feel annoyed with Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem jaqtagħli kliemi meta nkun qed nitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem jaqtagħli kliemi meta nkun qed nitkellem.
messages.zh: 因为我说话时，他总是打断我。
messages.en: Because he always interrupts me when I am speaking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象别人反复打断你说话，把心中升起的烦厌感与 antipatija 联系起来；另将所列形容词义单独记作令人不自在的。

gloss_zh: 讨人厌的；令人烦恼的（指女性）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a female person whose behaviour annoys other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容女性的行为令人烦恼、反感或觉得难以相处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tiddeskrivi mara jew tifla li bl-imġiba tagħha ddejjaq lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讨人厌的；行为令别人感到烦恼的（用于女性）。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tingħad għal mara jew tifla li ġġib ruħha b'mod li jirrita jew idejjaq lil ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A female person described this way behaves in a manner that other people find irritating.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ġara tidher antipatka għax tikkritika kontinwament lil kull min tiltaqa' miegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the female neighbour seems annoying because she constantly criticises everyone she meets.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，那位女邻居显得很讨人厌，因为她不停地批评遇到的每一个人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għedt li dik il-mara kienet antipatka? Nina: Għax bdiet tgħajjat magħna bla raġuni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you say that woman was annoying? Nina: Because she started shouting at us for no reason.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么说那个女人很讨人厌？妮娜：因为她无缘无故就开始冲我们大喊。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għedt li dik il-mara kienet antipatka?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għedt li dik il-mara kienet antipatka?
messages.zh: 你为什么说那个女人很讨人厌？
messages.en: Why did you say that woman was annoying?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax bdiet tgħajjat magħna bla raġuni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax bdiet tgħajjat magħna bla raġuni.
messages.zh: 因为她无缘无故就开始冲我们大喊。
messages.en: Because she started shouting at us for no reason.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mara antipatka 整组记成讨人厌的女人，想象她无故大喊的场景；重点记住这是评价女性令人烦恼的行为。

gloss_zh: 讨人厌的（指男性）；古怪或不合群的；行为烦人而愚蠢的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a male person whose behaviour annoys others or seems strange and unsociable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容男性的行为令人烦恼，或显得古怪、不合群。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi raġel jew tifel li jdejjaq lil ħaddieħor bl-imġiba tiegħu, jew li jidher stramb u ma tantx jitħallat man-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讨人厌的；行为令人烦恼的（用于男性）。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jingħad għal raġel jew tifel li bl-imġiba tiegħu jirrita jew idejjaq lil ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A male person described this way behaves in a manner that other people find irritating.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 古怪的、奇怪的或不愿与人交往的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jidher mhux tas-soltu jew stramb, jew li jevita l-kumpanija u l-kuntatt ma' nies oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone described this way seems unusual or prefers to avoid social contact with other people.

sense_translations.en_definition: A person behaving in an annoying manner (imbecilic)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 行为令人厌烦、显得愚蠢的人；带有贬损意味的称呼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġib ruħha b'mod tedjanti u iblah; din il-kelma tintuża bħala deskrizzjoni dispreġġjattiva.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone calls a person this, they mean that the person's behaviour is irritating and foolish.

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tar-rakkont, il-protagonist jidher antipatku għax jevita l-kumpanija tan-nies u jwieġeb b'mod xott.
formal.en: At the beginning of the story, the protagonist seems unsociable because he avoids people's company and answers curtly.
formal.zh: 在故事开头，主人公显得不合群，因为他回避与人来往，回答问题时也很生硬。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex qed tgħid li dak ir-raġel hu antipatku? Sara: Għax baqa' jagħmel l-istess ċajta anki wara li tlabnieh jieqaf.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are you saying that man is annoying? Sara: Because he kept making the same joke even after we asked him to stop.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么说那个男人很讨人厌？萨拉：因为我们已经请他别再说了，他却还在反复讲同一个笑话。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħid li dak ir-raġel hu antipatku?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħid li dak ir-raġel hu antipatku?
messages.zh: 你为什么说那个男人很讨人厌？
messages.en: Why are you saying that man is annoying?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax baqa' jagħmel l-istess ċajta anki wara li tlabnieh jieqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Għax baqa' jagħmel l-istess ċajta anki wara li tlabnieh jieqaf.
messages.zh: 因为我们已经请他别再说了，他却还在反复讲同一个笑话。
messages.en: Because he kept making the same joke even after we asked him to stop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面分别记忆：男人反复讲烦人笑话、独自回避交往、被称作烦人的蠢家伙；对应两个形容词义和一个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An inner door situated inside a building's entrance, beyond the outer door.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于建筑入口内部、在外门之后的内门。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bieb ta' ġewwa li jkun wara l-bieb ta' barra fid-daħla ta' bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑入口处位于外门内侧的门。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bieb li jinsab fuq in-naħa ta' ġewwa tad-daħla, wara l-bieb ta' barra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An inner door is a door inside an entrance, beyond the building's outer door.

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi għandhom jagħlqu l-antiporta wara li jidħlu sabiex il-kuritur jibqa' kwiet.
formal.en: Visitors should close the inner door after entering so that the corridor remains quiet.
formal.zh: 访客进入后应关上内门，以保持走廊安静。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għalaqt il-bieb ta' barra. Nagħlaq l-antiporta wkoll? Ġużeppi: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, għax dieħla l-arja kiesħa.
colloquial.en: Anna: I closed the outer door. Shall I close the inner door too? Ġużeppi: Yes, please, because cold air is coming in.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我关上外门了。也把内门关上吗？朱塞佩：好的，麻烦你，冷风正往里灌。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalaqt il-bieb ta' barra. Nagħlaq l-antiporta wkoll?
messages.mt_standard: Għalaqt il-bieb ta' barra. Nagħlaq l-antiporta wkoll?
messages.zh: 我关上外门了。也把内门关上吗？
messages.en: I closed the outer door. Shall I close the inner door too?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, għax dieħla l-arja kiesħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, għax dieħla l-arja kiesħa.
messages.zh: 好的，麻烦你，冷风正往里灌。
messages.en: Yes, please, because cold air is coming in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象进屋时先过外门，再推开里面一道门，把第二道门与 antiporta 联系起来，并搭配记住打开和关上内门。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substance used on skin or other living tissue to kill germs or prevent their growth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于皮肤等活体组织，以杀灭病菌或抑制其生长的物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tintuża fuq il-ġilda jew fuq tessuti ħajjin oħra biex toqtol il-mikrobi jew twaqqaf it-tkabbir tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于皮肤等活体组织、杀灭或抑制病菌的消毒剂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Antisettiku huwa prodott li jintuża fuq tessuti ħajjin, bħall-ġilda, biex joqtol il-mikrobi jew irażżan it-tkabbir tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An antiseptic is a substance used on living tissue to kill germs or prevent them from growing.

formal.mt: It-tikketta tal-antisettiku tagħti informazzjoni dwar l-użu u l-ħażna tal-prodott.
formal.en: The antiseptic's label provides information about the product's use and storage.
formal.zh: 消毒剂的标签提供了有关产品使用和储存的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn qiegħed il-flixkun tal-antisettiku? Mark: Fil-kaxxa tal-ewwel għajnuna, ħdejn il-faxex.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the bottle of antiseptic? Mark: In the first-aid kit, next to the bandages.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那瓶消毒剂放在哪里？马克：在急救箱里，绷带旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 那瓶消毒剂放在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the bottle of antiseptic?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 在急救箱里，绷带旁边。
messages.en: In the first-aid kit, next to the bandages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 antisettiku 和急救箱里贴有标签的小瓶联系起来，配合“皮肤用消毒剂”这一画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Words that have opposite meanings, such as big and small.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 意义相反的词，例如“大”和“小”；antonimi 是复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem li għandu tifsiriet opposti, bħal kbir u żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反义词，即与另一个词意义相反的词；本词形 antonimi 表示复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Antonimu huwa kelma li għandha tifsira opposta għal dik ta' kelma oħra; antonimi hija l-forma fil-plural.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An antonym is a word whose meaning is opposite to that of another word; antonimi is the plural form.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom isibu l-antonimi tal-kliem fil-lista.
formal.en: In this exercise, students should find the antonyms of the words in the list.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生应找出列表中各词的反义词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kbir u żgħir huma antonimi? Pawlu: Iva, għax għandhom tifsiriet opposti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are big and small antonyms? Pawlu: Yes, because they have opposite meanings.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“大”和“小”是反义词吗？保罗：是的，因为它们的意思相反。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “大”和“小”是反义词吗？
messages.en: Are big and small antonyms?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，因为它们的意思相反。
messages.en: Yes, because they have opposite meanings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kbir（大）和 żgħir（小）写在卡片两端，中间标上 antonimi，用成对的相反意义记住这个复数词。

gloss_zh: 冷漠；缺乏兴趣或积极性

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern about things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对事物缺乏兴趣、热情或关心的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' nuqqas ta' interess, ħeġġa jew tħassib dwar l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对事情漠不关心，缺乏兴趣、热情或参与积极性的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-apatija hija stat li fih persuna ma turix interess, ħeġġa jew tħassib dwar dak li jiġri madwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Apathy is a state in which someone shows little interest, enthusiasm, or concern about what happens.

collocations.zh: 一种提不起兴趣的感觉

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-apatija politika bħala nuqqas ta' interess fil-ħajja politika.
formal.en: The report describes political apathy as a lack of interest in political life.
formal.zh: 报告将政治冷漠描述为对政治生活缺乏兴趣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħadd ma wieġeb għall-idea tiegħi dwar il-festa. Mark: Forsi għadhom ma rawx il-messaġġ; mhux bilfors apatija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Nobody replied to my idea about the party. Mark: Perhaps they haven't seen the message yet; it isn't necessarily apathy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：没人回应我关于聚会的提议。马克：也许他们还没看到消息，不一定是漠不关心。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadd ma wieġeb għall-idea tiegħi dwar il-festa.
messages.mt_standard: Ħadd ma wieġeb għall-idea tiegħi dwar il-festa.
messages.zh: 没人回应我关于聚会的提议。
messages.en: Nobody replied to my idea about the party.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi għadhom ma rawx il-messaġġ; mhux bilfors apatija.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi għadhom ma rawx il-messaġġ; mhux bilfors apatija.
messages.zh: 也许他们还没看到消息，不一定是漠不关心。
messages.en: Perhaps they haven't seen the message yet; it isn't necessarily apathy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“没兴趣、没热情、不关心”三个短语围住 apatija，记住它描述的是缺少投入和关切的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An alcoholic drink served before a meal to stimulate the appetite.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在用餐前饮用、旨在增进食欲的酒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xarba alkoħolika li tiġi servuta qabel l-ikel biex tiftaħ l-aptit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正餐前饮用、用来增进食欲的开胃酒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Aperitiv huwa xarba alkoħolika li wieħed jixrob qabel ikla sabiex tiftaħlu l-aptit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An aperitif is an alcoholic drink that people have before a meal to stimulate their appetite.

formal.mt: Qabel l-ikla, il-mistednin ingħataw aperitiv fis-sala tal-akkoljenza.
formal.en: Before the meal, the guests were served an aperitif in the reception hall.
formal.zh: 用餐前，宾客们在接待厅获供应开胃酒。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nieħdu aperitiv qabel l-ikla? Maja: Iva, għandna ftit ħin qabel naslu fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Mark: Shall we have an aperitif before the meal? Maja: Yes, we have a little time before we sit down at the table.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们用餐前喝杯开胃酒吗？玛雅：好啊，离入席还有一点时间。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们用餐前喝杯开胃酒吗？
messages.en: Shall we have an aperitif before the meal?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna ftit ħin qabel naslu fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna ftit ħin qabel naslu fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 好啊，离入席还有一点时间。
messages.en: Yes, we have a little time before we sit down at the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把用餐顺序画成“aperitiv 开胃酒 → 正餐”，记住它出现在餐前，并与“打开胃口”的场景相连。

gloss_zh: 开放的；坦率的；说话直白的；露天；户外

teaching_sense.en_definition: Open rather than closed, or direct and uninhibited in expressing thoughts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 敞开而未封闭的；也指表达想法时坦率、不加掩饰或直言不讳的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex magħluq, jew li jesprimi ħsibijietu b'mod ċar u dirett, mingħajr ma joqgħod lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 敞开的；未关闭或封闭的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex magħluq u jħalli spazju minn fejn wieħed jista' jgħaddi jew jara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is open is not closed or sealed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坦率的；清楚直接地表达真实想法的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jgħid dak li jaħseb b'mod ċar u dirett, mingħajr ma jaħbi fehmtu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is forthright expresses their opinions clearly and directly.

sense_translations.en_definition: blunt (of a person who speaks without inhibition)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话毫不顾忌、过于直白的，可能不顾及他人的感受。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jitkellem bla tlaqliq u mingħajr rażan, xi drabi mingħajr ma jqis kif se jħossu ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is blunt speaks without restraint, sometimes without considering other people's feelings.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 露天；没有建筑物遮蔽的室外环境。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ambjent barra mill-bini, mingħajr saqaf li jgħattih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The open air is the outdoor environment outside enclosed buildings.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 户外；建筑物以外的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-postijiet li jinsabu barra mill-bini u mhux fi spazju magħluq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The outdoors consists of places outside buildings and other enclosed spaces.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, id-direttur kien apert dwar id-diffikultajiet li ltaqa' magħhom it-tim.
formal.en: In his report, the director was forthright about the difficulties the team had encountered.
formal.zh: 主任在报告中坦率说明了团队遇到的困难。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark dejjem jgħid eżatt x'jaħseb. Sara: Iva, hu apert ħafna, imma kultant kliemu jweġġa'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark always says exactly what he thinks. Sara: Yes, he is very blunt, but sometimes his words hurt.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark总是心里怎么想就怎么说。Sara：是啊，他说话很直白，不过有时候会伤人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark总是心里怎么想就怎么说。
messages.en: Mark always says exactly what he thinks.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu apert ħafna, imma kultant kliemu jweġġa'.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu apert ħafna, imma kultant kliemu jweġġa'.
messages.zh: 是啊，他说话很直白，不过有时候会伤人。
messages.en: Yes, he is very blunt, but sometimes his words hurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“敞开的门、敞开心扉、露天活动”连成三幅画面：前两幅帮助记形容词义，最后一幅用 fl-apert 记住露天、户外义；说人时再区分坦率与过于直白。

gloss_zh: 孔口；开口；建筑物的门或窗

teaching_sense.en_definition: An opening or aperture, or any door or window in a building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体上的孔口或开口；也可指建筑物中的任何一扇门或窗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fetħa f'oġġett jew f'wiċċ, jew kwalunkwe bieb jew tieqa f'bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 孔口；物体或表面上的开口。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fetħa f'oġġett jew f'wiċċ li minnha jistgħu jgħaddu, pereżempju, id-dawl jew l-arja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An aperture is an opening through which something such as light or air can pass.

sense_translations.en_definition: any of the doors and windows in a building
sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑物中的任何一扇门或窗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwalunkwe wieħed mill-bibien jew mit-twieqi ta' bini.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In a building, an apertura can be any individual door or window.

collocations.en: to replace a door or window

formal.mt: Il-perit spezzjona kull apertura tal-bini u nnota li t-tieqa tal-kċina kellha bżonn tiswija.
formal.en: The architect inspected every door and window in the building and noted that the kitchen window needed repair.
formal.zh: 建筑师检查了楼内的每一扇门窗，并指出厨房的窗户需要修理。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Irrid nibdel din l-apertura. Pawlu: It-tieqa tal-kċina? Lara: Iva, ma tagħlaqx sew.
colloquial.en: Lara: I want to replace this door or window. Pawlu: The kitchen window? Lara: Yes, it does not close properly.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我想把这扇门窗换掉。Pawlu：你是说厨房的窗户？Lara：对，它关不严。

messages.speaker: Lara (屋主)
messages.zh: 我想把这扇门窗换掉。
messages.en: I want to replace this door or window.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (维修师傅)
messages.zh: 你是说厨房的窗户？
messages.en: The kitchen window?

messages.speaker: Lara (屋主)
messages.zh: 对，它关不严。
messages.en: Yes, it does not close properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在墙上画一个开口，再给它装上门或窗：apertura 既可指孔口，也可指建筑物的一扇门窗。看到房屋维修语境时，先判断具体说的是门还是窗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Equipment or a device used to perform a particular task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于完成某项特定任务的设备、装置或器械。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmir jew mezz li jintuża biex isir xogħol partikolari jew biex titwettaq funzjoni speċifika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某种特定用途而使用的设备、器械或装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmir jew apparat magħmul biex jintuża għal skop jew xogħol partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An apparatus is equipment or a device used for a particular purpose.

formal.mt: Qabel jibda l-esperiment, it-tekniku għandu jiċċekkja li l-apparat tal-kejl ikun qed jaħdem sew.
formal.en: Before the experiment begins, the technician should check that the measuring apparatus is working properly.
formal.zh: 实验开始前，技术员应检查测量仪器是否正常工作。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Taf kif inħaddem dan l-apparat? David: Iva, agħfas din il-buttuna biex tixegħlu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you know how I can operate this apparatus? David: Yes, press this button to switch it on.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你知道这个设备怎么用吗？David：知道，按这个按钮就能开机。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你知道这个设备怎么用吗？
messages.en: Do you know how I can operate this apparatus?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, agħfas din il-buttuna biex tixegħlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, agħfas din il-buttuna biex tixegħlu.
messages.zh: 知道，按这个按钮就能开机。
messages.en: Yes, press this button to switch it on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 apparat 与实验台上的一台仪器联系起来，再用 apparat tal-kejl“测量仪器”和 tħaddem l-apparat“操作设备”配对记忆，同时记住它表示设备的名词身份。

gloss_zh: 温度受控的设备；温控装置

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device whose temperature is controlled during use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用过程中温度受到控制或调节的设备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li t-temperatura tiegħu tinżamm jew tiġi aġġustata skont il-ħtieġa waqt l-użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 温度由控制措施维持或调节的装置；温控设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li fih it-temperatura tinżamm f'livell jew f'medda magħżula permezz ta' kontroll.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A temperature controlled device has its temperature regulated to a chosen level or range.

collocations.en: to use a temperature controlled device
to check a temperature controlled device
a temperature controlled device in the laboratory

formal.mt: Għal dan it-test, intuża apparat bit-temperatura kkontrollata biex il-kampjun jinżamm fit-temperatura meħtieġa.
formal.en: For this test, a temperature controlled device was used to keep the sample at the required temperature.
formal.zh: 本次测试使用了温控设备，使样品保持在所需温度。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed tuża apparat bit-temperatura kkontrollata? Ġorġ: Għax il-kampjun irid jibqa' fl-istess temperatura matul it-test.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you using a temperature controlled device? Ġorġ: Because the sample needs to stay at the same temperature throughout the test.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你为什么要用温控设备？Ġorġ：因为整个测试过程中，样品都需要保持在同一温度。

messages.speaker: Marija (实验室同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tuża apparat bit-temperatura kkontrollata?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tuża apparat bit-temperatura kkontrollata?
messages.zh: 你为什么要用温控设备？
messages.en: Why are you using a temperature controlled device?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (实验员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-kampjun irid jibqa' fl-istess temperatura matul it-test.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-kampjun irid jibqa' fl-istess temperatura matul it-test.
messages.zh: 因为整个测试过程中，样品都需要保持在同一温度。
messages.en: Because the sample needs to stay at the same temperature throughout the test.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“设备 apparat—温度 temperatura—受控 kkontrollata”三个意义块记忆，脑中配一台带温度设定的装置。整条表示温度受控的设备，不必把温度受控理解为永远固定不变。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Electrical equipment used to manage reactive power in an electrical system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于管理电力系统中无功功率的电气设备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat elettriku li jintuża għall-immaniġġjar tal-potenza reattiva f'sistema elettrika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在电力系统中用于管理无功功率的装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża f'sistema elettrika biex jgħin fil-ġestjoni tal-potenza reattiva.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reactive power device is a piece of electrical equipment used to manage reactive power within an electrical system.

collocations.en: the installation of a reactive power device
maintenance of the reactive power device

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tekniku jiddeskrivi l-funzjoni tal-apparat tal-potenza reattiva fis-sistema elettrika tal-bini.
formal.en: The technical report describes the function of the reactive power device in the building's electrical system.
formal.zh: 技术报告说明了该无功功率装置在建筑电力系统中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan x'apparat hu? Rita: Dan hu apparat tal-potenza reattiva; jintuża fis-sistema elettrika tal-bini.
colloquial.en: Mark: What kind of device is this? Rita: This is a reactive power device; it is used in the building's electrical system.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这是什么装置？Rita：这是无功功率装置，用在这栋楼的电力系统中。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.zh: 这是什么装置？
messages.en: What kind of device is this?

messages.speaker: Rita (电气工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu apparat tal-potenza reattiva; jintuża fis-sistema elettrika tal-bini.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu apparat tal-potenza reattiva; jintuża fis-sistema elettrika tal-bini.
messages.zh: 这是无功功率装置，用在这栋楼的电力系统中。
messages.en: This is a reactive power device; it is used in the building's electrical system.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成配电室里标有“无功功率装置”的设备；记住 apparat 是装置，potenza reattiva 在电力语境中对应无功功率。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that something seems true from available information, although it is not certain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示根据现有信息或表面迹象，某事似乎属实，但尚未完全确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża biex juri li xi ħaġa tidher li hija vera skont l-informazzjoni disponibbli, għalkemm mhix ċerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 看来；根据所知信息或表面迹象判断，似乎如此。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jintuża meta xi ħaġa tidher li hija vera minn dak li wieħed jaf jew josserva, mingħajr ma jkun hemm ċertezza sħiħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use apparently to indicate that something seems to be true on the basis of available information, although you are not completely certain.

formal.mt: Apparentement, il-laqgħa ġiet posposta, iżda għadna qed nistennew konferma uffiċjali.
formal.en: Apparently, the meeting has been postponed, but we are still awaiting official confirmation.
formal.zh: 看来会议已经延期，但我们仍在等待正式确认。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħanut magħluq illum? Luke: Apparentement iva. Hemm avviż fuq il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the shop closed today? Luke: Apparently, yes. There is a notice on the door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这家店今天关门吗？Luke：看来是的，门上贴着通知。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这家店今天关门吗？
messages.en: Is the shop closed today?

messages.speaker: Luke (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Apparentement iva. Hemm avviż fuq il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Apparentement iva. Hemm avviż fuq il-bieb.
messages.zh: 看来是的，门上贴着通知。
messages.en: Apparently, yes. There is a notice on the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看见店门上的通知后说“看来关门了”：apparentement 表示有迹象支持的判断，记忆时给结论留一点不确定性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The outward look of a person or thing, or the impression it gives.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或事物呈现出来的外在样貌，或由此给人的印象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dehra esterna ta' persuna jew ħaġa, jew l-impressjoni li tagħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人或事物的外表、外观，或呈现于外的表象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mod kif persuna jew ħaġa tidher minn barra u l-impressjoni li tagħti lil min iħares lejha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The appearance of a person or thing is the way they look or the outward impression they give.

formal.mt: Il-bini għandu apparenza eleganti, iżda l-kundizzjoni tiegħu teħtieġ eżami dettaljat.
formal.en: The building has an elegant appearance, but its condition requires a detailed examination.
formal.zh: 这栋建筑外观优雅，但其实际状况仍需详细检查。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-kejk għandu apparenza sabiħa! Nina: Iva, imma ejja nduquh ukoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: This cake looks lovely! Nina: Yes, but let's taste it too.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个蛋糕看起来真漂亮！Nina：是啊，不过我们也尝尝味道吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个蛋糕看起来真漂亮！
messages.en: This cake looks lovely!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，不过我们也尝尝味道吧。
messages.en: Yes, but let's taste it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 apparenza 联想成蛋糕摆在橱窗里的样子：眼睛先看到外观，舌头之后才尝到味道，用这个画面记住“外表、表象”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A self-contained home consisting of rooms within a larger building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 较大建筑内由若干房间组成、可供独立居住的一套住房。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dar magħmula minn sett ta' kmamar f'bini akbar, li tifforma unità ta' abitazzjoni għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公寓；楼房内可独立居住的一套住房，英语通常用 flat 表达。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Unità ta' abitazzjoni magħmula minn sett ta' kmamar f'bini li jkun fih ukoll unitajiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flat is a self-contained home consisting of a set of rooms within a larger building.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公寓；较大建筑内供一个住户使用的一套独立住房。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett ta' kmamar f'bini akbar li flimkien jiffurmaw dar indipendenti għall-persuna jew għall-persuni li jgħixu fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An apartment is a set of rooms within a larger building that forms an independent home.

formal.mt: L-appartament jinsab fit-tieni sular u jinkludi żewġ kmamar tas-sodda, kċina u kamra tal-banju.
formal.en: The apartment is on the second floor and includes two bedrooms, a kitchen and a bathroom.
formal.zh: 这套公寓位于二层，包含两间卧室、一间厨房和一间浴室。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif inhu l-appartament il-ġdid? Lara: Komdu ħafna, u għandu gallarija żgħira.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's the new apartment like? Lara: It's very comfortable, and it has a small balcony.
colloquial.zh: Mark：新公寓怎么样？Lara：很舒适，而且有个小阳台。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 新公寓怎么样？
messages.en: What's the new apartment like?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Komdu ħafna, u għandu gallarija żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Komdu ħafna, u għandu gallarija żgħira.
messages.zh: 很舒适，而且有个小阳台。
messages.en: It's very comfortable, and it has a small balcony.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 appartament 与熟悉的英语 apartment 并排记忆，再想象打开一扇家门，里面有卧室和厨房：记住它是一整套住房。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state or feeling of being part of a group or community.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于某个群体或共同体的状态，或由此产生的归属感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda jew is-sentiment ta' persuna li tagħmel parti minn grupp jew komunità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为某个群体一员的归属状态或归属感。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-istat li persuna tagħmel parti minn grupp jew is-sentiment li għandha post f'dak il-grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Belonging is the state or feeling of being part of a particular group or community.

formal.mt: L-attivitajiet tal-iskola jgħinu lill-istudenti jiżviluppaw sens ta' appartenenza għall-komunità skolastika.
formal.en: School activities help students develop a sense of belonging to the school community.
formal.zh: 学校活动有助于学生建立对学校共同体的归属感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif qed tħossok fil-klabb il-ġdid? Lara: Għandi sens ta' appartenenza hemmhekk; kulħadd jilqagħni u jisma' x'għandi xi ngħid.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are you feeling at the new club? Lara: I feel a sense of belonging there; everyone welcomes me and listens to what I have to say.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在新俱乐部感觉怎么样？拉拉：我在那里有归属感；大家都欢迎我，也愿意听我说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在新俱乐部感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How are you feeling at the new club?

messages.speaker: Lara (俱乐部新成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi sens ta' appartenenza hemmhekk; kulħadd jilqagħni u jisma' x'għandi xi ngħid.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi sens ta' appartenenza hemmhekk; kulħadd jilqagħni u jisma' x'għandi xi ngħid.
messages.zh: 我在那里有归属感；大家都欢迎我，也愿意听我说话。
messages.en: I feel a sense of belonging there; everyone welcomes me and listens to what I have to say.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走进一个人人欢迎你的群体，用 sens ta' appartenenza 整体记住“归属感”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having strong enthusiasm for something or being very eager to take part.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事抱有强烈热情，或非常热切地想参与其中的。
