teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu entużjażmu u interess qawwi f'xi ħaġa, jew li jkun ħerqan ħafna biex jieħu sehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事物怀有强烈热爱和热情的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu mħabba, interess u entużjażmu qawwi għal xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are passionate about something, you have very strong feelings of interest and enthusiasm for it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兴趣浓厚、热心投入或热切想参与的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri interess kbir u jkun ħerqan ħafna li jagħmel xi ħaġa jew jieħu sehem fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is keen shows strong interest and is very eager to take part in an activity.

formal.mt: Bħala qarrej appassjonat, Daniel jieħu sehem regolarment fid-diskussjonijiet letterarji tal-librerija.
formal.en: As a keen reader, Daniel regularly takes part in the library's literary discussions.
formal.zh: 丹尼尔热爱阅读，经常参加图书馆的文学讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tmur għal tant kunċerti? Mark: Għax jien appassjonat dwar il-mużika; nieħu gost ħafna nisma' l-mużiċisti jdoqqu quddiemi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you go to so many concerts? Mark: Because I'm passionate about music; I really enjoy hearing musicians play in front of me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么去听那么多场音乐会？马克：因为我热爱音乐，特别喜欢现场听音乐家演奏。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么去听那么多场音乐会？
messages.en: Why do you go to so many concerts?

messages.speaker: Mark (乐迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jien appassjonat dwar il-mużika; nieħu gost ħafna nisma' l-mużiċisti jdoqqu quddiemi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jien appassjonat dwar il-mużika; nieħu gost ħafna nisma' l-mużiċisti jdoqqu quddiemi.
messages.zh: 因为我热爱音乐，特别喜欢现场听音乐家演奏。
messages.en: Because I'm passionate about music; I really enjoy hearing musicians play in front of me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“热爱音乐”和“热衷阅读”两个画面中记忆，重点是兴趣强烈、投入热情。

gloss_zh: 直接面向儿童的呼吁或劝勉

teaching_sense.en_definition: Explicit appeals addressed to children that urge them to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 直接以儿童为对象、敦促他们采取某种行动的呼吁或劝勉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sejħiet jew tħeġġiġ indirizzati direttament lit-tfal biex jagħmlu xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直接向儿童发出、敦促他们采取行动的劝告或呼吁。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Appelli li jkellmu lit-tfal direttament u jħeġġuhom jagħmlu azzjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Direct exhortations to children are appeals that address children themselves and urge them to take a particular action.

collocations.en: direct appeals to children to read
collocations.zh: 直接鼓励儿童阅读的呼吁

collocations.mt: appelli diretti lit-tfal biex jieħdu sehem
collocations.en: direct appeals to children to take part
collocations.zh: 直接鼓励儿童参与的呼吁

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jinkludi appelli diretti lit-tfal biex jaqraw kuljum u jaqsmu l-istejjer favoriti tagħhom ma' sħabhom.
formal.en: The leaflet includes direct appeals to children to read every day and share their favourite stories with their friends.
formal.zh: 这份宣传册直接呼吁儿童每天阅读，并与朋友分享自己最喜欢的故事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tip ta' messaġġi se niktbu fuq il-poster? Lara: Appelli diretti lit-tfal, bħal: Ejja aqraw magħna!
colloquial.en: Maja: What kind of messages shall we write on the poster? Lara: Direct appeals to children, such as: Come and read with us!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在海报上写哪类话语呢？拉拉：直接面向孩子们的呼吁，比如：来和我们一起阅读吧！

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tip ta' messaġġi se niktbu fuq il-poster?
messages.mt_standard: X'tip ta' messaġġi se niktbu fuq il-poster?
messages.zh: 我们在海报上写哪类话语呢？
messages.en: What kind of messages shall we write on the poster?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Appelli diretti lit-tfal, bħal: Ejja aqraw magħna!
messages.mt_standard: Appelli diretti lit-tfal, bħal: Ejja aqraw magħna!
messages.zh: 直接面向孩子们的呼吁，比如：来和我们一起阅读吧！
messages.en: Direct appeals to children, such as: Come and read with us!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象海报直接对孩子说“来参加吧”，将整组词记成“向儿童直接发出的行动呼吁”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Immediately when something happens, at the very moment it happens, or only barely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事一发生就随即发生另一事、恰在某事发生之时，或程度和数量仅仅勉强达到。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex turi li xi ħaġa sseħħ minnufih wara oħra, fl-istess waqt eżatt ta' oħra, jew bilkemm tilħaq ammont jew grad meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一……就……；表示前一件事发生后，另一件事立即发生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Turi li azzjoni sseħħ minnufih malli sseħħ azzjoni oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens as soon as another event occurs, it happens immediately after that event.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正当……时；恰在另一件事发生的那个时刻。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Turi li xi ħaġa sseħħ fl-istess waqt eżatt li tkun qed isseħħ xi ħaġa oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens just as another event occurs, both happen at precisely the same moment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刚好够；勉强达到所需的数量、程度或条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Turi li ammont jew grad ikun bilkemm biżżejjed biex jintlaħaq dak li jkun meħtieġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is just about enough, it meets the required amount or standard by only a small margin.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jibdew ix-xogħol appena jirċievu l-istruzzjonijiet, għax il-ħin disponibbli huwa appena biżżejjed biex ilestu kollox.
formal.en: Students should begin work as soon as they receive the instructions, because the available time is just about enough to finish everything.
formal.zh: 学生一收到指示就应开始作业，因为现有时间勉强够完成全部内容。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta ċempillek Mark? Lara: Ċempilli appena kont ħierġa mid-dar. Maja: U x'qallek? Lara: Qalli biex inċempillu appena nasal.
colloquial.en: Maja: When did Mark call you? Lara: He called just as I was leaving the house. Maja: And what did he tell you? Lara: He told me to call him as soon as I arrive.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克什么时候给你打电话的？拉拉：他打来时，我正要出门。玛雅：那他跟你说了什么？拉拉：他让我一到就给他打电话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克什么时候给你打电话的？
messages.en: When did Mark call you?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他打来时，我正要出门。
messages.en: He called just as I was leaving the house.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那他跟你说了什么？
messages.en: And what did he tell you?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他让我一到就给他打电话。
messages.en: He told me to call him as soon as I arrive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“刚”串联三个场景：刚到就打电话、刚要出门电话响、时间刚够；分别记住紧接、同时和勉强达到。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An additional section at the end of a book or document, or a small tube-shaped organ attached to the large intestine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 书籍或文件末尾提供补充资料的附录；也指连接大肠的细小管状器官，即阑尾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqsima fl-aħħar ta' ktieb jew dokument li tagħti tagħrif addizzjonali; il-kelma tirreferi wkoll għal organu żgħir f'għamla ta' tubu mqabbad mal-musrana l-kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 附录，书籍或文件末尾的补充部分；阑尾，连接大肠的细小管状器官。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Parti miżjuda fl-aħħar ta' ktieb jew dokument b'tagħrif supplimentari, jew organu żgħir f'għamla ta' tubu mqabbad mal-musrana l-kbira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An appendix is a supplementary section at the end of a document, or a small tube-shaped organ attached to the large intestine.

collocations.en: an operation to remove the appendix

formal.mt: L-appendiċi tar-rapport jinkludi t-tabelli kollha li jissemmew fit-test.
formal.en: The appendix to the report includes all the tables mentioned in the text.
formal.zh: 报告的附录收录了正文中提到的所有表格。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn nista' nsib il-lista sħiħa? Pawlu: Fl-appendiċi tal-ktieb, wara l-aħħar kapitlu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where can I find the complete list? Pawlu: In the appendix of the book, after the last chapter.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我在哪里能找到完整的清单？Pawlu：在书的附录里，最后一章后面。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 我在哪里能找到完整的清单？
messages.en: Where can I find the complete list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 在书的附录里，最后一章后面。
messages.en: In the appendix of the book, after the last chapter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记忆：翻到书后看到附录，再看人体图找到阑尾；同一个词要靠上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inflammation of the appendix, the small tube-shaped organ attached to the large intestine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 阑尾发生炎症的疾病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha l-appendiċi, organu żgħir imqabbad mal-musrana l-kbira, ikun infjammat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阑尾炎，即阑尾发生炎症的疾病。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marda li sseħħ meta l-appendiċi jkun infjammat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Appendicitis is a medical condition in which the appendix becomes inflamed.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jiddeskrivi każ ta' appendiċite akuta f'pazjent żagħżugħ.
formal.en: The medical report describes a case of acute appendicitis in a young patient.
formal.zh: 这份医疗报告描述了一名年轻患者的急性阑尾炎病例。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex daħal l-isptar ħuk? Mark: Kellu l-appendiċite, imma issa qed jirkupra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why was your brother admitted to hospital? Mark: He had appendicitis, but he is recovering now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你兄弟为什么住院了？Mark：他得了阑尾炎，不过现在正在康复。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟为什么住院了？
messages.en: Why was your brother admitted to hospital?

messages.speaker: Mark (患者的兄弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellu l-appendiċite, imma issa qed jirkupra.
messages.mt_standard: Kellu l-appendiċite, imma issa qed jirkupra.
messages.zh: 他得了阑尾炎，不过现在正在康复。
messages.en: He had appendicitis, but he is recovering now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 appendiċi 与 appendiċite 成对记：前者是阑尾这个器官，后者是阑尾发炎这种疾病。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very close to doing something or to an event happening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某个动作或事件马上就要发生，已经接近发生的临界时刻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika li azzjoni jew ġrajja tkun waslet biex isseħħ minn mument għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正要；马上就要，强调动作即将开始。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li xi ħadd ikun wasal biex jagħmel xi ħaġa minnufih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is just about to do something, they are going to begin it very soon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 濒临；眼看就要，强调已接近某种变化或状态发生的临界点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li persuna jew ħaġa tkun qrib ħafna li tgħaddi minn bidla jew tidħol fi stat partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is on the verge of a change, that change is extremely close to happening.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 即将发生，指某个事件很快就会出现。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li ġrajja tkun mistennija sseħħ minn mument għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an event is about to occur, it is expected to happen very soon.

formal.mt: Meta wasal l-għalliem, it-tifel kien appik jibki.
formal.en: When the teacher arrived, the boy was on the verge of crying.
formal.zh: 老师到达时，那个男孩眼看就要哭出来了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara l-ktieb! Appik jaqa' minn fuq il-mejda. Luqa: Rajtu! Se ndaħħlu ftit 'il ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look at the book! It is just about to fall off the table. Luqa: I see it! I'll move it a little further in.
colloquial.zh: Sara：看那本书！它眼看就要从桌上掉下来了。Luqa：看到了！我把它往里挪一点。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara l-ktieb! Appik jaqa' minn fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Ara l-ktieb! Appik jaqa' minn fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 看那本书！它眼看就要从桌上掉下来了。
messages.en: Look at the book! It is just about to fall off the table.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了！我把它往里挪一点。
messages.en: I see it! I'll move it a little further in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象书悬在桌边、下一秒就掉下去；用 appik 记住事情尚未发生却已迫在眼前的瞬间。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strike your hands together to show approval or appreciation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拍击双手发出掌声，以表达赞赏、欢迎或支持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċapċap b'idejk biex turi apprezzament, approvazzjoni jew appoġġ għal xi ħadd jew għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼓掌喝彩，以掌声表达赞赏或支持。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Turi apprezzament jew approvazzjoni billi ċċapċap b'idejk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you applaud someone, you clap your hands to show that you appreciate or approve of what they have done.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼓掌，反复拍击双手发出声音。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tolqot il-pali ta' idejk ma' xulxin ripetutament biex tagħmel il-ħoss taċ-ċapċip.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you clap, you repeatedly strike your hands together to make a sound.

formal.mt: Fi tmiem il-kunċert, il-pubbliku applawda lill-mużiċisti għal diversi minuti.
formal.en: At the end of the concert, the audience applauded the musicians for several minutes.
formal.zh: 音乐会结束时，观众为音乐家们鼓掌了好几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex applawdejt daqshekk? Toni: Għax il-kantanta kantat tassew tajjeb!
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you clap so much? Toni: Because the singer sang really well!
colloquial.zh: Nina：你怎么鼓掌鼓得那么起劲？Toni：因为那位女歌手唱得实在太好了！

messages.speaker: Nina (观众)
messages.zh: 你怎么鼓掌鼓得那么起劲？
messages.en: Why did you clap so much?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为那位女歌手唱得实在太好了！
messages.en: Because the singer sang really well!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象演出结束后双手拍出掌声，把 applawda 与“用掌声表达赞赏”的动作一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sound of people clapping their hands to show approval or appreciation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们为表示赞赏、感谢或认可而拍手发出的掌声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss taċ-ċapċip li jagħmlu n-nies biex juru apprezzament jew approvazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示赞赏、感谢或认可的掌声。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-applaws huwa l-ħoss li jagħmlu n-nies meta jċapċpu biex juru li għoġobhom jew apprezzaw xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Applause is the sound people make by clapping their hands to show appreciation or approval.

formal.mt: Fi tmiem il-kunċert, l-udjenza laqgħet lill-mużiċisti b'applaws twil.
formal.en: At the end of the concert, the audience greeted the musicians with prolonged applause.
formal.zh: 音乐会结束时，观众以经久不息的掌声向音乐家们致意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak l-applaws? Mark: Iva, kulħadd ħa gost bil-kanzunetta!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that applause? Mark: Yes, everyone enjoyed the song!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见那阵掌声了吗？马克：听见了，大家都很喜欢那首歌！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见那阵掌声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that applause?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 听见了，大家都很喜欢那首歌！
messages.en: Yes, everyone enjoyed the song!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把演出结束后全场拍手的声音与 applaws 联系起来，记成“赞赏化作掌声”。

gloss_zh: 我申请了；我运用了；我涂用了

teaching_sense.en_definition: I made an application for something, or put a method, rule, or substance into use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“我申请了某事物”，也可表示“我运用了某种方法或规则”或“我涂用了某种物质”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma tal-verb li tfisser li jien għamilt talba formali għal xi ħaġa, użajt metodu jew regola, jew poġġejt sustanza fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我提出了申请；也可依语境表示我运用了某种方法或规则，或涂用了某种物质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Applikajt tfisser li jien għamilt applikazzjoni għal xi ħaġa, użajt metodu jew regola f'sitwazzjoni partikolari, jew poġġejt sustanza fuq wiċċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you say 'I applied', you mean that you submitted an application, used a method or rule, or put a substance onto a surface.

formal.mt: Applikajt għal din il-pożizzjoni għax għandi esperjenza rilevanti fil-qasam.
formal.en: I applied for this position because I have relevant experience in the field.
formal.zh: 我申请了这个职位，因为我有相关领域的工作经验。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Applikajt għal dak ix-xogħol? Pawlu: Iva, applikajt ilbieraħ. Issa qed nistenna tweġiba.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you apply for that job? Pawlu: Yes, I applied yesterday. Now I'm waiting for a reply.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你申请那份工作了吗？保罗：申请了，我昨天申请的。现在正等回复。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你申请那份工作了吗？
messages.en: Did you apply for that job?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, applikajt ilbieraħ. Issa qed nistenna tweġiba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, applikajt ilbieraħ. Issa qed nistenna tweġiba.
messages.zh: 申请了，我昨天申请的。现在正等回复。
messages.en: Yes, I applied yesterday. Now I'm waiting for a reply.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 applikajt 放进“我昨天申请了工作”的完整场景中记忆；遇到方法或规则作宾语时，再联想“我运用了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used in practical situations or concerned with putting knowledge into practice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于实际情境的，或侧重把知识、理论付诸实践的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintuża fil-prattika jew li għandu x'jaqsam mat-tħaddim tal-għarfien u tat-teorija f'sitwazzjonijiet reali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应用的；把知识或理论用于实际问题的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa deskritta bħala applikata tuża l-għarfien jew it-teorija biex tittratta problemi u sitwazzjonijiet fil-prattika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An applied subject or approach uses knowledge and theory to deal with practical problems.

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi tagħlim applikat biex l-istudenti jużaw it-teorija f'sitwazzjonijiet reali.
formal.en: The programme includes applied learning so that students can use theory in real situations.
formal.zh: 该课程包含应用式学习，使学生能够在实际情境中运用理论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kors hu kollu teorija? David: Le, fih ukoll tagħlim applikat. Naħdmu fuq problemi reali.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this course all theory? David: No, it also includes applied learning. We work on real problems.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这门课全是理论吗？戴维：不是，也有应用式学习。我们会处理实际问题。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这门课全是理论吗？
messages.en: Is this course all theory?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fih ukoll tagħlim applikat. Naħdmu fuq problemi reali.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fih ukoll tagħlim applikat. Naħdmu fuq problemi reali.
messages.zh: 不是，也有应用式学习。我们会处理实际问题。
messages.en: No, it also includes applied learning. We work on real problems.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 applikat 想成“让书本知识走进实际问题”；搭配阴性名词时可见 applikata，如应用数学。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool or device used to put a substance onto a particular surface or area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于把液体、膏体等物质涂布或施用于特定表面、部位的工具或装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda jew apparat li jintuża biex ipoġġi jew ixerred sustanza fuq wiċċ jew żona partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂抹器；用于将某种物质施加到指定表面或部位的工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Applikatur huwa għodda jew apparat li bih titqiegħed jew tinfirex sustanza fuq wiċċ jew parti partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An applicator is a tool or device that you use to put a substance onto a particular surface or area.

formal.mt: Uża l-applikatur biex tifrex saff irqiq tal-prodott fuq il-wiċċ indikat.
formal.en: Use the applicator to spread a thin layer of the product over the indicated surface.
formal.zh: 请使用涂抹器，将本产品薄薄地涂在指定表面上。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-krema tiġi b'applikatur? Rita: Iva, qiegħed fil-kaxxa, ħdejn it-tubu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this cream come with an applicator? Rita: Yes, it's in the box, next to the tube.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这款乳霜附带涂抹器吗？丽塔：有，就在盒子里，软管旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 这款乳霜附带涂抹器吗？
messages.en: Does this cream come with an applicator?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 有，就在盒子里，软管旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the box, next to the tube.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象乳霜盒中附带的小涂抹棒，把 applikatur 直接记成“帮助你把东西涂上去的工具”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that uses a pipette to apply small quantities of liquid to a selected place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用移液管将少量液体施加到指定位置的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li juża pipetta biex japplika kwantitajiet żgħar ta' likwidu f'post magħżul.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 借助移液管施加少量液体的施用器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Applikatur mgħammar b'pipetta li tintuża biex jitqiegħed ammont żgħir ta' likwidu fejn ikun meħtieġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pipette applicator is a device that allows you to place small amounts of liquid in a particular location using a pipette.

collocations.zh: 给移液管式施用器装入液体

collocations.en: apply the liquid with the pipette applicator
collocations.zh: 用移液管式施用器施加液体

formal.mt: Għal dan l-eżerċizzju, uża l-applikatur bil-pipetta biex tqiegħed ammont żgħir ta' likwidu fiċ-ċentru tal-kampjun.
formal.en: For this exercise, use the pipette applicator to place a small amount of liquid in the centre of the sample.
formal.zh: 本练习中，请使用移液管式施用器，将少量液体施加到样品中央。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inqiegħed ftit likwidu hawn? Mark: Uża l-applikatur bil-pipetta; bih tista' tqiegħed ammont żgħir fil-post li trid.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do I put a little liquid here? Mark: Use the pipette applicator; it lets you place a small amount where you want it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：怎么在这里加一点液体？Mark：用移液管式施用器，就能把少量液体加到你想要的位置。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 怎么在这里加一点液体？
messages.en: How do I put a little liquid here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża l-applikatur bil-pipetta; bih tista' tqiegħed ammont żgħir fil-post li trid.
messages.mt_standard: Uża l-applikatur bil-pipetta; bih tista' tqiegħed ammont żgħir fil-post li trid.
messages.zh: 用移液管式施用器，就能把少量液体加到你想要的位置。
messages.en: Use the pipette applicator; it lets you place a small amount where you want it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pipetta 与“移液管”配对记忆，想象用细管把少量液体送到指定点，记住整词强调所用工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used to apply a substance directly to a small, specific area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于将某种物质直接施加到特定小范围区域的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża biex japplika sustanza direttament fuq żona żgħira u speċifika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将物质直接点涂或施加于特定局部位置的施用器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Applikatur maħsub biex iqiegħed sustanza direttament fuq post partikolari u limitat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spot-on applicator is a device that allows you to apply a substance directly to a particular small area.

collocations.mt: tqiegħed il-ponta tal-applikatur għal użu lokalizzat fuq il-post magħżul
collocations.en: place the tip of the spot-on applicator on the selected spot
collocations.zh: 将局部点涂施用器的尖端置于选定位置

formal.mt: F'din id-dimostrazzjoni, uża l-applikatur għal użu lokalizzat biex tqiegħed is-sustanza biss fuq iż-żona mmarkata tal-kampjun.
formal.en: In this demonstration, use the spot-on applicator to place the substance only on the marked area of the sample.
formal.zh: 本次演示中，请使用局部点涂施用器，仅将该物质施加到样品的标记区域。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Irrid inqiegħed is-sustanza fuq din it-tikka biss. Pawlu: Uża l-applikatur għal użu lokalizzat u żomm il-ponta fuq il-post immarkat.
colloquial.en: Nina: I want to put the substance only on this dot. Pawlu: Use the spot-on applicator and keep the tip on the marked spot.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我只想把这种物质加到这个点上。Pawlu：用局部点涂施用器，把尖端对准标记的位置。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid inqiegħed is-sustanza fuq din it-tikka biss.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid inqiegħed is-sustanza fuq din it-tikka biss.
messages.zh: 我只想把这种物质加到这个点上。
messages.en: I want to put the substance only on this dot.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (指导员)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża l-applikatur għal użu lokalizzat u żomm il-ponta fuq il-post immarkat.
messages.mt_standard: Uża l-applikatur għal użu lokalizzat u żomm il-ponta fuq il-post immarkat.
messages.zh: 用局部点涂施用器，把尖端对准标记的位置。
messages.en: Use the spot-on applicator and keep the tip on the marked spot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“只涂一个小点”的画面记住 lokalizzat 所表达的局部范围；整词重点是施用位置集中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An applicator intended for use in dredging work, which involves removing mud or sediment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于清除淤泥或沉积物的疏浚作业中的施用装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża bħala applikatur f'xogħol ta' tneħħija ta' ħama jew sediment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供清除淤泥或沉积物的疏浚作业使用的施用器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Applikatur maħsub biex jintuża waqt operazzjonijiet li jneħħu l-ħama jew is-sediment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dredging applicator is an applicator used in operations that involve removing mud or sediment.

collocations.zh: 准备疏浚作业用施用器

collocations.en: inspect the dredging applicator before use
collocations.zh: 使用前检查疏浚作业用施用器

formal.mt: Qabel tibda l-operazzjoni tat-tneħħija tas-sediment, it-tim għandu jispezzjona l-applikatur għat-tindif u jaqra l-istruzzjonijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: Before beginning the sediment removal operation, the team should inspect the dredging applicator and read its instructions.
formal.zh: 开始清除沉积物之前，团队应检查疏浚作业用施用器，并阅读其使用说明。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ħejjejt l-applikatur għat-tindif għax-xogħol ta' għada? Toni: Iva, qiegħed mal-bqija tat-tagħmir għat-tneħħija tas-sediment.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you prepared the dredging applicator for tomorrow's work? Toni: Yes, it is with the rest of the sediment removal equipment.
colloquial.zh: Rita：明天作业要用的疏浚施用器准备好了吗？Toni：准备好了，和其他清除沉积物的设备放在一起。

messages.speaker: Rita (作业主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħejjejt l-applikatur għat-tindif għax-xogħol ta' għada?
messages.mt_standard: Ħejjejt l-applikatur għat-tindif għax-xogħol ta' għada?
messages.zh: 明天作业要用的疏浚施用器准备好了吗？
messages.en: Have you prepared the dredging applicator for tomorrow's work?

messages.speaker: Toni (作业员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed mal-bqija tat-tagħmir għat-tneħħija tas-sediment.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed mal-bqija tat-tagħmir għat-tneħħija tas-sediment.
messages.zh: 准备好了，和其他清除沉积物的设备放在一起。
messages.en: Yes, it is with the rest of the sediment removal equipment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本条给定的 dredging 义项，联想清除淤泥的疏浚现场，把整词与该作业中的施用装置配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used to apply liquid in separate drops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于将液体以一滴一滴的方式施加的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża biex japplika likwidu fi qtar separati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过逐滴滴出液体进行施用的滴液器式装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Applikatur li jqiegħed il-likwidu fil-post mixtieq billi joħorġu qatra qatra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dropper applicator is a device that allows you to apply liquid one drop at a time.

collocations.en: add two drops with the dropper applicator
collocations.zh: 用滴液式施用器加入两滴液体

formal.mt: Billi tuża l-applikatur għat-tqattir, żid żewġ qatriet ta' likwidu mal-kampjun u osserva l-bidla fil-kulur.
formal.en: Using the dropper applicator, add two drops of liquid to the sample and observe the change in colour.
formal.zh: 使用滴液式施用器，向样品中加入两滴液体，并观察颜色变化。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm għandi nżid likwidu? David: Żid żewġ qatriet bl-applikatur għat-tqattir, qatra waħda kull darba.
colloquial.en: Sara: How much liquid should I add? David: Add two drops with the dropper applicator, one drop at a time.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我该加多少液体？David：用滴液式施用器加两滴，每次滴一滴。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 我该加多少液体？
messages.en: How much liquid should I add?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Żid żewġ qatriet bl-applikatur għat-tqattir, qatra waħda kull darba.
messages.mt_standard: Żid żewġ qatriet bl-applikatur għat-tqattir, qatra waħda kull darba.
messages.zh: 用滴液式施用器加两滴，每次滴一滴。
messages.en: Add two drops with the dropper applicator, one drop at a time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象液体“滴、滴”落下，把 tqattir 与逐滴施用联系起来；整词重点是液体一滴一滴地释放。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument used to perform a skin prick test.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于进行皮肤点刺试验的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex isir test tal-ġilda permezz ta' tingiża żgħira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 皮肤点刺试验中使用的施用器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strument li jintuża biex issir tingiża żgħira fil-ġilda waqt test.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A prick test applicator is an instrument used to make a small prick in the skin during a skin test.

collocations.mt: użu tal-applikatur li jintuża għall-eżami tat-tingiż
collocations.en: use of the prick test applicator
collocations.zh: 皮肤点刺试验施用器的使用

collocations.mt: preparazzjoni tal-applikatur li jintuża għall-eżami tat-tingiż
collocations.en: preparation of the prick test applicator
collocations.zh: 皮肤点刺试验施用器的准备

formal.mt: Il-lista tat-tagħmir tinkludi applikatur li jintuża għall-eżami tat-tingiż.
formal.en: The equipment list includes a prick test applicator.
formal.zh: 设备清单包括一件皮肤点刺试验施用器。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hu l-applikatur li jintuża għall-eżami tat-tingiż? Pawlu: Qiegħed fit-trej, ħdejn il-lista tat-tagħmir.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is the prick test applicator? Pawlu: It is in the tray, beside the equipment list.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：皮肤点刺试验施用器在哪里？保罗：在托盘里，就在设备清单旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-applikatur li jintuża għall-eżami tat-tingiż?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-applikatur li jintuża għall-eżami tat-tingiż?
messages.zh: 皮肤点刺试验施用器在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the prick test applicator?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (护士同事)
messages.zh: 在托盘里，就在设备清单旁边。
messages.en: It is in the tray, beside the equipment list.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组分块记：applikatur 是施用器，li jintuża 表示“被使用的”，后面的部分说明用途；联想“用于点刺检查的器具”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used to apply a substance inside the nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于将某种物质施用于鼻腔内的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex titqiegħed sustanza ġewwa l-imnieħer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于向鼻腔内施用物质的鼻用施用器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża biex tiġi applikata sustanza ġewwa l-imnieħer.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A nasal applicator is a device that allows a substance to be applied inside the nose.

collocations.en: instructions for using the nasal applicator
collocations.zh: 鼻用施用器的使用说明

formal.mt: Il-pakkett fih applikatur ta' l-imnieħer u fuljett bl-istruzzjonijiet għall-użu.
formal.en: The package contains a nasal applicator and an instruction leaflet.
formal.zh: 包装内有一个鼻用施用器和一份使用说明书。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Hemm applikatur ta' l-imnieħer f'dan il-pakkett? Lara: Iva, u hemm ukoll fuljett bl-istruzzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is there a nasal applicator in this package? Lara: Yes, and there is also an instruction leaflet.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个包装里有鼻用施用器吗？拉拉：有，还有一份使用说明书。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm applikatur ta' l-imnieħer f'dan il-pakkett?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm applikatur ta' l-imnieħer f'dan il-pakkett?
messages.zh: 这个包装里有鼻用施用器吗？
messages.en: Is there a nasal applicator in this package?

messages.speaker: Lara (药剂师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u hemm ukoll fuljett bl-istruzzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u hemm ukoll fuljett bl-istruzzjonijiet.
messages.zh: 有，还有一份使用说明书。
messages.en: Yes, and there is also an instruction leaflet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 imnieħer 就联想鼻子，把整个词组记成“给鼻子用的施用器”；用身体部位帮助区分不同施用器。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used to position or apply a needle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于放置或施用针的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex labra titqiegħed fil-pożizzjoni meħtieġa jew tiġi applikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于放置或施用针的针施用器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża biex titqiegħed jew tiġi applikata labra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A needle applicator is a device used to place or apply a needle in the required position.

formal.mt: Il-manwal jispjega l-użu tal-applikatur tal-labra permezz ta' test u stampi.
formal.en: The manual explains the use of the needle applicator through text and pictures.
formal.zh: 手册通过文字和图片说明针施用器的用法。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan hu l-applikatur tal-labra? David: Iva, u l-manwal tiegħu qiegħed ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this the needle applicator? David: Yes, and its manual is beside it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这就是针施用器吗？戴维：是的，它的手册就在旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (实习护士)
messages.zh: 这就是针施用器吗？
messages.en: Is this the needle applicator?

messages.speaker: David (带教护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u l-manwal tiegħu qiegħed ħdejh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u l-manwal tiegħu qiegħed ħdejh.
messages.zh: 是的，它的手册就在旁边。
messages.en: Yes, and its manual is beside it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 labra 记作“针”，再把 tal-labra 与前面的 applikatur 连起来理解为“针的施用器”，借助针的图像记住用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An applicator that uses a brush to spread a substance over a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过刷子将某种物质涂布在表面上的施用器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'pinzell li tintuża biex tinfirex sustanza fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用刷子将物质涂布于表面的刷式涂抹器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Applikatur li juża pinzell biex iqassam sustanza fuq wiċċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A brush applicator is a tool that uses a brush to spread a substance over a surface.

collocations.zh: 用于涂胶的刷式涂抹器

formal.mt: L-applikatur tal-pinzell jintuża biex il-kolla tinfirex b'mod uniformi fuq il-wiċċ.
formal.en: The brush applicator is used to spread the glue evenly over the surface.
formal.zh: 刷式涂抹器用于将胶水均匀地涂在表面上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek applikatur tal-pinzell għall-kolla? Toni: Iva, ħu dan; il-pinzell tiegħu għadu nadif.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have a brush applicator for the glue? Toni: Yes, take this one; its brush is still clean.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你有涂胶用的刷式涂抹器吗？托尼：有，拿这个吧；它的刷子还是干净的。

messages.speaker: Sara (手工课学员)
messages.zh: 你有涂胶用的刷式涂抹器吗？
messages.en: Do you have a brush applicator for the glue?

messages.speaker: Toni (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu dan; il-pinzell tiegħu għadu nadif.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu dan; il-pinzell tiegħu għadu nadif.
messages.zh: 有，拿这个吧；它的刷子还是干净的。
messages.en: Yes, take this one; its brush is still clean.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pinzell 与“小刷子”的画面相连，想象用刷头均匀涂胶；整个词组便可记成“用刷子涂抹的器具”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal request for duty that is payable to be reduced or cancelled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 请求减少或免除应缴关税的正式申请。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Talba uffiċjali biex dazju dovut jitnaqqas jew jitħassar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 请求减免应缴关税的正式申请。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Applikazzjoni li biha persuna jew kumpanija titlob li dazju dovut jitnaqqas jew jitħassar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An application for remission of duty is a formal request to reduce or cancel duty that would otherwise be payable.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关税减免申请，即请求减少或免除应缴关税的申请。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Talba formali għal tnaqqis jew tħassir ta' dazju li jkun dovut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A remission application asks the relevant authority to reduce or cancel an amount of duty owed.

collocations.mt: tissottometti applikazzjoni għal maħfra ta' dazju
collocations.en: submit an application for remission of duty

collocations.mt: teżamina applikazzjoni għal maħfra ta' dazju
collocations.en: examine an application for remission of duty

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ssottomettiet applikazzjoni għal maħfra ta' dazju u spjegat ir-raġunijiet għat-talba tagħha.
formal.en: The company submitted an application for remission of duty and explained the reasons for its request.
formal.zh: 公司提交了关税减免申请，并说明了申请理由。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandi nimla din l-applikazzjoni għal maħfra ta' dazju? Pawlu: Iva, jekk trid titlob li d-dazju jitnaqqas jew jitħassar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Should I fill in this application for remission of duty? Pawlu: Yes, if you want to request that the duty be reduced or cancelled.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我要填写这份关税减免申请吗？保罗：对，如果你想申请减少或免除关税。

messages.speaker: Anna (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi nimla din l-applikazzjoni għal maħfra ta' dazju?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi nimla din l-applikazzjoni għal maħfra ta' dazju?
messages.zh: 我要填写这份关税减免申请吗？
messages.en: Should I fill in this application for remission of duty?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk trid titlob li d-dazju jitnaqqas jew jitħassar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk trid titlob li d-dazju jitnaqqas jew jitħassar.
messages.zh: 对，如果你想申请减少或免除关税。
messages.en: Yes, if you want to request that the duty be reduced or cancelled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组分成三块记：applikazzjoni 是申请，għal maħfra 表示为了获得减免，ta' dazju 点明减免的是关税；联想填写一份关税减免申请表。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The punctuation mark ' used, for example, to show that letters have been omitted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形如 ' 的标点符号，例如用来表示字母被省略。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sinjal tal-kitba ' li jintuża, fost affarijiet oħra, biex juri li tħallew barra xi ittri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撇号，即形如 ' 的书写符号，可用于标示字母省略等。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sinjal tal-kitba f'għamla ta' virgola żgħira fuq il-linja, li jista' juri li tħallew barra xi ittri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An apostrophe is a punctuation mark placed above the line, often indicating that letters have been left out.

formal.mt: Fil-forma m'għandix, l-appostrofu juri li tħalliet barra l-ittra a minn ma.
formal.en: In the form m'għandix, the apostrophe indicates that the letter a has been omitted from ma.
formal.zh: 在 m'għandix 这一形式中，撇号表示 ma 中的字母 a 被省略了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi nikteb appostrofu f'm'għandix? David: Iva, iktbu wara l-m.
colloquial.en: Lara: Should I write an apostrophe in m'għandix? David: Yes, write it after the m.
colloquial.zh: Lara：写 m'għandix 时要加撇号吗？David：要，把它写在 m 后面。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 写 m'għandix 时要加撇号吗？
messages.en: Should I write an apostrophe in m'għandix?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.zh: 要，把它写在 m 后面。
messages.en: Yes, write it after the m.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把撇号想成悬在字母上方的小逗号；看到 m'għandix，就用这个小记号提醒自己这里省去了字母。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Help, encouragement, or something that holds a person or thing steady.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予人或事物的帮助、鼓励或支撑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajnuna jew inkoraġġiment mogħti lil xi ħadd, jew sostenn li jżomm xi ħaġa f'postha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 帮助、鼓励或赞同，也可指使物体保持稳固的支撑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għajnuna, inkoraġġiment jew approvazzjoni mogħtija lil persuna jew inizjattiva, jew sostenn fiżiku għal xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Support is help, encouragement, or approval given to someone or something, or something that holds an object steady.

formal.mt: L-appoġġ finanzjarju tal-għaqda għen lill-istudenti jixtru l-kotba meħtieġa.
formal.en: The organisation's financial support helped the students buy the books they needed.
formal.zh: 该组织提供的经济支持帮助学生购买了所需书籍。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għada għandi l-eżami u qed nibża'. Lara: Għandek l-appoġġ tiegħi; nistgħu nirrevedu flimkien illejla.
colloquial.en: Maja: I have my exam tomorrow, and I'm scared. Lara: You have my support; we can revise together tonight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我明天考试，有点害怕。拉拉：我支持你；今晚我们可以一起复习。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada għandi l-eżami u qed nibża'.
messages.mt_standard: Għada għandi l-eżami u qed nibża'.
messages.zh: 我明天考试，有点害怕。
messages.en: I have my exam tomorrow, and I'm scared.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek l-appoġġ tiegħi; nistgħu nirrevedu flimkien illejla.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek l-appoġġ tiegħi; nistgħu nirrevedu flimkien illejla.
messages.zh: 我支持你；今晚我们可以一起复习。
messages.en: You have my support; we can revise together tonight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 appoġġ 想成身后的一只扶持之手：给钱是经济支持，打气是精神支持，托住物体则是支撑；这里记的是名词“支持”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Financial assistance intended to support income without being directly tied to current production levels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旨在支持收入、但不直接与当前生产水平挂钩的经济援助。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajnuna finanzjarja biex issostni l-introjtu mingħajr ma tkun marbuta direttament mal-livell tal-produzzjoni attwali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不直接与当前生产水平挂钩的收入支持或补助。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Appoġġ finanzjarju għall-introjtu li ma jiddependix direttament minn kemm ikun qed jiġi prodott fil-preżent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: De-coupled income support is financial assistance that supports income without being directly linked to the recipient's current production level.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi skema ta' appoġġ diżakkoppjat għall-introjtu li mhijiex marbuta direttament mal-livell tal-produzzjoni attwali.
formal.en: The report describes a de-coupled income support scheme that is not directly linked to current production levels.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了一项不直接与当前生产水平挂钩的脱钩收入支持计划。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'jiġifieri appoġġ diżakkoppjat għall-introjtu? Rita: Huwa għajnuna għall-introjtu li mhijiex marbuta direttament ma' kemm tipproduċi bħalissa.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does de-coupled income support mean? Rita: It is help with income that is not directly linked to how much you currently produce.
colloquial.zh: 马克：脱钩收入支持是什么意思？丽塔：就是一种收入援助，不直接与你目前生产多少挂钩。

messages.speaker: Mark (农户)
messages.zh: 脱钩收入支持是什么意思？
messages.en: What does de-coupled income support mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (农业顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa għajnuna għall-introjtu li mhijiex marbuta direttament ma' kemm tipproduċi bħalissa.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa għajnuna għall-introjtu li mhijiex marbuta direttament ma' kemm tipproduċi bħalissa.
messages.zh: 就是一种收入援助，不直接与你目前生产多少挂钩。
messages.en: It is help with income that is not directly linked to how much you currently produce.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张卡片来记：一张写“收入补助”，一张写“当前产量”，两张之间不直接连线；整个词组强调收入获得支持，而补助与当前产量脱钩。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Help provided within a household, or support arising within a country or organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 家庭生活中提供的帮助，或来自一个国家、组织内部的支持；具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajnuna mogħtija fil-ħajja tad-dar, jew sostenn li jiġi minn ġewwa pajjiż jew organizzazzjoni, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在家庭生活中提供的帮助或支持。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għajnuna jew sostenn mogħti lil persuna jew familja biex tlaħħaq mal-ħajja u l-ħtiġijiet tad-dar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Domestic support is help that enables people to manage their household needs and everyday family life.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自某个国家、组织或群体内部的支持。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sostenn li jiġi minn membri jew riżorsi ta' pajjiż, organizzazzjoni jew grupp stess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Internal support is backing that comes from within the country, organization, or group concerned.

collocations.zh: 为家庭提供的生活支持

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-appoġġ domestiku mogħti lill-familji li għandhom bżonn l-għajnuna fil-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The report describes the domestic support provided to families who need help with everyday life.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了为需要日常生活帮助的家庭提供的支持。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Issa li missierek ġie lura d-dar, għandkom bżonn appoġġ domestiku? Pawlu: Iva, għandna bżonn lil xi ħadd jgħinna bit-tisjir u t-tindif.
colloquial.en: Marija: Now that your father is back home, do you need domestic support? Pawlu: Yes, we need someone to help us with cooking and cleaning.
colloquial.zh: Marija：现在你父亲回家了，你们需要家庭生活方面的帮助吗？Pawlu：需要，我们得找个人帮忙做饭和打扫。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa li missierek ġie lura d-dar, għandkom bżonn appoġġ domestiku?
messages.mt_standard: Issa li missierek ġie lura d-dar, għandkom bżonn appoġġ domestiku?
messages.zh: 现在你父亲回家了，你们需要家庭生活方面的帮助吗？
messages.en: Now that your father is back home, do you need domestic support?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna bżonn lil xi ħadd jgħinna bit-tisjir u t-tindif.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna bżonn lil xi ħadd jgħinna bit-tisjir u t-tindif.
messages.zh: 需要，我们得找个人帮忙做饭和打扫。
messages.en: Yes, we need someone to help us with cooking and cleaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把支持想成从圈子里面伸出的援手：圈子是家庭时指家庭帮助，是国家或组织时指内部支持，靠上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Assistance that helps maintain voltage at an appropriate level in an electrical system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 帮助电力系统将电压维持在适当水平的支撑作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sostenn li jgħin biex il-vultaġġ f'sistema elettrika jinżamm f'livell xieraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为维持电力系统适当电压水平而提供的支撑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sostenn mogħti lil sistema elettrika biex jgħin iżomm il-vultaġġ tagħha fil-livell meħtieġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Voltage support helps an electrical system maintain its voltage at the level needed for proper operation.

formal.mt: Is-sistema tipprovdi appoġġ għall-voltaġġ biex il-vultaġġ fin-netwerk jibqa' fil-limiti stabbiliti.
formal.en: The system provides voltage support to keep the voltage in the network within the established limits.
formal.zh: 该系统提供电压支撑，使电网电压保持在规定范围内。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għandna bżonn appoġġ għall-voltaġġ hawn? Mark: Biex il-vultaġġ jibqa' fil-livell meħtieġ meta tinbidel it-tagħbija.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do we need voltage support here? Mark: To keep the voltage at the required level when the load changes.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这里为什么需要电压支撑？Mark：为了在负载变化时，让电压保持在所需水平。

messages.speaker: Sara (实习技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandna bżonn appoġġ għall-voltaġġ hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandna bżonn appoġġ għall-voltaġġ hawn?
messages.zh: 这里为什么需要电压支撑？
messages.en: Why do we need voltage support here?

messages.speaker: Mark (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex il-vultaġġ jibqa' fil-livell meħtieġ meta tinbidel it-tagħbija.
messages.mt_standard: Biex il-vultaġġ jibqa' fil-livell meħtieġ meta tinbidel it-tagħbija.
messages.zh: 为了在负载变化时，让电压保持在所需水平。
messages.en: To keep the voltage at the required level when the load changes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电压表的指针有人稳稳托住：整个短语表示帮助电压维持合适水平的电压支撑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To help or encourage someone, or to show approval of an idea or action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 帮助或鼓励某人，或对某个想法、行动表示赞同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti għajnuna jew inkoraġġiment lil xi ħadd, jew turi li taqbel ma' idea jew azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给予帮助或鼓励，或表示赞同、支持。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħin jew tinkoraġġixxi persuna, jew turi l-approvazzjoni tiegħek għal proposta, idea jew azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you support someone or something, you give them help or encouragement, or show that you approve of them.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat appoġġa l-proposta biex il-librerija tibqa' miftuħa aktar filgħaxija.
formal.en: The committee supported the proposal to keep the library open later in the evening.
formal.zh: 委员会支持了延长图书馆晚间开放时间的提议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Missierek appoġġa l-għażla tiegħek li tistudja l-arti? Nina: Iva, feraħli u għenni nagħżel il-kors.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did your father support your choice to study art? Nina: Yes, he congratulated me and helped me choose the course.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你父亲支持你选择学艺术吗？妮娜：支持，他祝贺了我，还帮我选了课程。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missierek appoġġa l-għażla tiegħek li tistudja l-arti?
messages.mt_standard: Missierek appoġġa l-għażla tiegħek li tistudja l-arti?
messages.zh: 你父亲支持你选择学艺术吗？
messages.en: Did your father support your choice to study art?

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, feraħli u għenni nagħżel il-kors.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, feraħli u għenni nagħżel il-kors.
messages.zh: 支持，他祝贺了我，还帮我选了课程。
messages.en: Yes, he congratulated me and helped me choose the course.

cognitive_memory_aid: 与名词 appoġġ 配对记忆：appoġġ 是“支持”这件事，appoġġa 表达“给予支持”的动作；把例句中的父亲帮助选课当作动作画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Recognized as valuable or regarded with gratitude.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 其价值受到认可的，或因帮助、贡献而受到感激的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li l-valur tiegħu jkun rikonoxxut, jew li jintlaqa' b'għożża jew gratitudni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到重视、认可或感激的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun meqjus ta' valur u li n-nies juru stima jew gratitudni għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is appreciated, people recognize their value or feel grateful for what they contribute.

formal.mt: Il-kontribut tiegħek għall-proġett huwa apprezzat ħafna mit-tim kollu.
formal.en: Your contribution to the project is greatly appreciated by the whole team.
formal.zh: 整个团队都十分感谢你对这个项目的贡献。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Grazzi talli għentni lbieraħ; il-ġest tiegħek kien apprezzat ħafna. Luqa: Ta' xejn! Kuntent li stajt ngħinek.
colloquial.en: Anna: Thanks for helping me yesterday; your gesture was much appreciated. Luqa: You're welcome! I'm glad I could help.
colloquial.zh: Anna：谢谢你昨天帮我，你的这份心意让我十分感激。Luqa：不客气！能帮到你我很高兴。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi talli għentni lbieraħ; il-ġest tiegħek kien apprezzat ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi talli għentni lbieraħ; il-ġest tiegħek kien apprezzat ħafna.
messages.zh: 谢谢你昨天帮我，你的这份心意让我十分感激。
messages.en: Thanks for helping me yesterday; your gesture was much appreciated.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ta' xejn! Kuntent li stajt ngħinek.
messages.mt_standard: Ta' xejn! Kuntent li stajt ngħinek.
messages.zh: 不客气！能帮到你我很高兴。
messages.en: You're welcome! I'm glad I could help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象你的付出被看见，对方点头并道谢；apprezzat 就是受到重视或感激的，可和英语 appreciated 联想记忆。

gloss_zh: 被拨作特定用途的；被没收的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Taken or allocated for a particular use, or seized by an authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指财物被取用或拨作特定用途的，也可指财物被有关机关没收的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ittieħed jew ġie allokat għal użu partikolari, jew li jkun ġie kkonfiskat minn awtorità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被取用或拨作某一特定用途的，常用于资金或其他资源。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ittieħed jew ġie allokat għal skop partikolari, bħal flus jew riżorsi oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Money or resources that are appropriated have been taken or allocated for a particular purpose.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被有关机关依其权力收走或没收的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ittieħed mingħand min kellu l-pussess tiegħu minn awtorità li teżerċita s-setgħat tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Property that is confiscated has been taken away by an authority exercising its powers.

collocations.zh: 拨作该项目用途的资金
被有关机关没收的设备

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika l-ammont ta' fondi approprjati għall-proġett u jelenka separatament it-tagħmir approprjat mill-awtoritajiet.
formal.en: The report states the amount of funds appropriated for the project and separately lists the equipment confiscated by the authorities.
formal.zh: 报告列明拨作该项目用途的资金额，并另行列出被有关机关没收的设备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn huma l-fondi approprjati għat-tiswijiet? Toni: Iva, dawn il-flus ġew allokati għat-tiswijiet tal-bini.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are these the funds appropriated for the repairs? Toni: Yes, this money was allocated for repairs to the building.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这些就是拨作维修用途的资金吗？Toni：对，这笔钱是拨来维修这栋楼的。

messages.speaker: Maja (项目助理)
messages.zh: 这些就是拨作维修用途的资金吗？
messages.en: Are these the funds appropriated for the repairs?

messages.speaker: Toni (财务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dawn il-flus ġew allokati għat-tiswijiet tal-bini.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dawn il-flus ġew allokati għat-tiswijiet tal-bini.
messages.zh: 对，这笔钱是拨来维修这栋楼的。
messages.en: Yes, this money was allocated for repairs to the building.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景区分本条义项：资金贴上“专门拨用”标签，对应 appropriated；设备被机关收走，对应 confiscated。遇到 approprjat 时先看财物去了哪里。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Accepted or permitted by a person or body with the authority to decide.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已获有权作出决定的人或机构同意、许可或认可的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ingħata l-kunsens jew il-permess minn persuna jew korp li għandu s-setgħa li jiddeċiedi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经得到有关人员或机构同意、批准或认可的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie aċċettat jew ingħata l-permess mill-persuna jew mill-korp responsabbli għad-deċiżjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is approved has been accepted or permitted by the person or body responsible for the decision.

formal.mt: Il-pjan approvat mill-kumitat jinkludi skeda tax-xogħol u baġit dettaljat.
formal.en: The plan approved by the committee includes a work schedule and a detailed budget.
formal.zh: 经委员会批准的计划包括工作进度表和详细预算。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan hu l-pjan approvat? David: Iva, il-maniġer tah il-kunsens tiegħu lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this the approved plan? David: Yes, the manager gave his approval yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这就是获批准的计划吗？David：对，经理昨天已经同意了。

messages.speaker: Sara (职员)
messages.zh: 这就是获批准的计划吗？
messages.en: Is this the approved plan?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-maniġer tah il-kunsens tiegħu lbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-maniġer tah il-kunsens tiegħu lbieraħ.
messages.zh: 对，经理昨天已经同意了。
messages.en: Yes, the manager gave his approval yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 approvat 和英语 approved 配对记忆，想象计划书上盖着“已批准”的印章；pjan approvat 就是已经得到同意的计划。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An approach that uses flows through a system as the basis for analysis or decisions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以系统中的流量及其流动情况为依据进行分析或决策的方法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Metodu li juża l-flussi f'sistema bħala bażi għall-analiżi jew għat-teħid ta' deċiżjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以流量或流动情况作为分析、规划或决策依据的方法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Metodu ta' analiżi, ippjanar jew teħid ta' deċiżjonijiet li jkun ibbażat fuq il-flussi f'sistema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flow based approach uses flows within a system to guide analysis, planning, or decisions.

collocations.en: a flow based approach is used
analysis using a flow based approach
collocations.zh: 采用基于流量的方法进行的分析

formal.mt: L-istudju juża approċċ abbażi tal-fluss biex janalizza kif il-flussi jitqassmu fin-netwerk.
formal.en: The study uses a flow based approach to analyse how flows are distributed through the network.
formal.zh: 该研究采用基于流量的方法，分析流量在网络中如何分布。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għal din l-analiżi se nużaw approċċ abbażi tal-fluss? Mark: Iva, se nħarsu lejn kif il-flussi jitqassmu fin-netwerk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are we going to use a flow based approach for this analysis? Mark: Yes, we will look at how flows are distributed through the network.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这次分析我们要采用基于流量的方法吗？Mark：对，我们会看流量在网络中如何分布。

messages.speaker: Lara (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal din l-analiżi se nużaw approċċ abbażi tal-fluss?
messages.mt_standard: Għal din l-analiżi se nużaw approċċ abbażi tal-fluss?
messages.zh: 这次分析我们要采用基于流量的方法吗？
messages.en: Are we going to use a flow based approach for this analysis?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nħarsu lejn kif il-flussi jitqassmu fin-netwerk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nħarsu lejn kif il-flussi jitqassmu fin-netwerk.
messages.zh: 对，我们会看流量在网络中如何分布。
messages.en: Yes, we will look at how flows are distributed through the network.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句分成三个意义块记：approċċ 是“方法”，abbażi 是“基于”，tal-fluss 指“流量的”；想象沿网络中的流动箭头展开分析。

exact_key: approċċ koordinat tal-kapaċità netta ta' trażmissjoni

teaching_sense.en_definition: A coordinated approach that uses net transmission capacity as the basis for planning or decisions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以净传输容量为依据，由相关各方协调进行规划或决策的方法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Metodu li fih il-partijiet involuti jikkoordinaw l-ippjanar jew id-deċiżjonijiet tagħhom abbażi tal-kapaċità netta ta' trażmissjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由相关各方协调运用净传输容量进行规划或决策的方法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Approċċ li juża l-kapaċità netta ta' trażmissjoni bħala bażi għall-ippjanar jew għad-deċiżjonijiet, b'koordinazzjoni bejn il-partijiet involuti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A coordinated net transmission capacity approach brings the parties involved together to plan or make decisions using net transmission capacity.

collocations.mt: l-applikazzjoni tal-approċċ koordinat tal-kapaċità netta ta' trażmissjoni
collocations.en: the application of the coordinated net transmission capacity approach
collocations.zh: 协调净传输容量方法的应用

collocations.mt: jintuża approċċ koordinat tal-kapaċità netta ta' trażmissjoni
collocations.en: a coordinated net transmission capacity approach is used
collocations.zh: 采用协调净传输容量方法

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-approċċ koordinat tal-kapaċità netta ta' trażmissjoni u jispjega kif il-partijiet involuti jikkoordinaw id-deċiżjonijiet tagħhom.
formal.en: The report describes the coordinated net transmission capacity approach and explains how the parties involved coordinate their decisions.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了协调净传输容量方法，并说明相关各方如何协调决策。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'approċċ se nużaw għall-ippjanar? Pawlu: Se nużaw approċċ koordinat tal-kapaċità netta ta' trażmissjoni u niddiskutu d-deċiżjonijiet mal-partijiet l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Nina: What approach are we going to use for planning? Pawlu: We will use a coordinated net transmission capacity approach and discuss the decisions with the other parties.
colloquial.zh: Nina：规划时我们要采用什么方法？Pawlu：我们会采用协调净传输容量方法，并与其他各方讨论相关决策。

messages.speaker: Nina (规划员)
messages.zh: 规划时我们要采用什么方法？
messages.en: What approach are we going to use for planning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nużaw approċċ koordinat tal-kapaċità netta ta' trażmissjoni u niddiskutu d-deċiżjonijiet mal-partijiet l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Se nużaw approċċ koordinat tal-kapaċità netta ta' trażmissjoni u niddiskutu d-deċiżjonijiet mal-partijiet l-oħra.
messages.zh: 我们会采用协调净传输容量方法，并与其他各方讨论相关决策。
messages.en: We will use a coordinated net transmission capacity approach and discuss the decisions with the other parties.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“方法—协调—净容量—传输”四块记忆：approċċ、koordinat、kapaċità netta、trażmissjoni。想象各方围着同一张净传输容量表讨论规划。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning cannot be established from the supplied unreadable entry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给词条文本无法辨读，因此目前只能确认其标注为名词，不能确定具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu ma tistax tiġi stabbilita mill-entrata mogħtija għax it-test ma jinqarax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原词义说明无法辨读，具体含义未能确定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom mhijiex magħrufa mill-entrata mogħtija, billi t-test tagħha ma jinqarax.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry is unreadable, so the meaning of this noun cannot be reliably explained.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'apramorta' hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda t-tifsira tagħha għad trid tiġi ċċarata.
formal.en: The word 'apramorta' is marked as a noun, but its meaning still needs to be clarified.
formal.zh: “apramorta”一词标注为名词，但其含义仍需澄清。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'apramorta'? Pawlu: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja nħallu t-tifsira vojta għalissa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'apramorta' mean? Pawlu: I don't know yet. Let's leave the meaning blank for now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：apramorta 是什么意思？Pawlu：我还不知道。我们暂时先把词义空着吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: apramorta 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'apramorta' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja nħallu t-tifsira vojta għalissa.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja nħallu t-tifsira vojta għalissa.
messages.zh: 我还不知道。我们暂时先把词义空着吧。
messages.en: I don't know yet. Let's leave the meaning blank for now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把这个词放进“名词、词义待查”的记忆格，只认拼写，不凭声音猜意思；这里的搭配只练习如何谈论这个词。

gloss_zh: 食欲；想做某事的欲望；意愿

teaching_sense.en_definition: A desire to eat, or a desire or inclination to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 想吃东西的食欲，也可指想做某件事的欲望或意愿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa li tiekol, jew xewqa jew rieda li tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 食欲；想吃东西的欲望。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xewqa li tiekol jew li tieħu l-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your appetite is the desire you feel to eat food.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 想做某事的欲望或冲动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xewqa qawwija li tagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An urge is a strong desire that makes you want to do something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做某事的意愿；愿意或有兴致去做的心意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-rieda jew ix-xewqa li tagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your will to do something is your willingness or inclination to do it.

formal.mt: L-istudent spjega li qabel l-eżami ma kellux aptit jiekol, iżda wara kellu aptit joħroġ ma' sħabu.
formal.en: The student explained that before the exam he had no appetite, but afterwards he felt like going out with his friends.
formal.zh: 这名学生解释说，考试前他没有食欲，但考完后想和朋友们一起出去。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek aptit tiekol xi ħaġa? Mark: Iva, għandi aptit pizza. Wara għandek aptit noħorġu? Maja: Iva, immorru nimxu ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you feel like eating something? Mark: Yes, I feel like pizza. Do you feel like going out afterwards? Maja: Yes, let's go for a short walk.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想吃点东西吗？Mark：想，我想吃披萨。之后你想一起出去吗？Maja：想，我们去散会儿步吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃点东西吗？
messages.en: Do you feel like eating something?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi aptit pizza. Wara għandek aptit noħorġu?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi aptit pizza. Wara għandek aptit noħorġu?
messages.zh: 想，我想吃披萨。之后你想一起出去吗？
messages.en: Yes, I feel like pizza. Do you feel like going out afterwards?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，我们去散会儿步吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's go for a short walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 aptit 连到“我想……”：面对食物是食欲，面对活动是欲望或意愿。用“想吃披萨、想去散步”两个画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A drink made with orange juice or orange flavouring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用橙汁或橙味调味成分制成的饮料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xarba magħmula bil-meraq tal-larinġ jew b'togħma tal-larinġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 橙味饮料；用橙汁或橙味调味成分制成的饮品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xarba li ssir bil-meraq tal-larinġ jew li jkollha t-togħma tal-larinġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Orangeade is a drink made with orange juice or orange flavouring.

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, lill-mistednin ġew offruti ilma, kafè u aranċata kiesħa.
formal.en: During the meeting, the guests were offered water, coffee and cold orangeade.
formal.zh: 会议期间，主办方向来宾提供了水、咖啡和冰凉的橙味饮料。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tazza aranċata, jekk jogħġbok. Lara: Tridha bis-silġ? Mark: Iva, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Mark: A glass of orangeade, please. Lara: Would you like it with ice? Mark: Yes, thank you.
colloquial.zh: Mark：请给我一杯橙味饮料。Lara：要加冰吗？Mark：要，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我一杯橙味饮料。
messages.en: A glass of orangeade, please.

messages.speaker: Lara (服务员)
messages.zh: 要加冰吗？
messages.en: Would you like it with ice?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, thank you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象服务员端来一杯橙色饮料，把 aranċata 和 tazza aranċata“一杯橙味饮料”整体记住；这个画面只是记忆提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A process in which an independent person or panel considers a dispute and makes a decision to resolve it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由独立的仲裁人或仲裁小组审理争议并作出裁决，以解决纠纷的程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess li fih persuna indipendenti jew grupp ta' arbitri jeżaminaw tilwima u jieħdu deċiżjoni biex isolvuha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仲裁；将争议交由独立仲裁人或仲裁小组审理并裁决的解决方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mod kif tissolva tilwima billi titressaq quddiem arbitru jew grupp ta' arbitri indipendenti li jagħtu deċiżjoni dwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Arbitration is a process in which an independent person or panel decides how a dispute should be resolved.

collocations.en: to resolve a dispute through arbitration

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ kumpaniji qablu li jressqu t-tilwima għal arbitraġġ quddiem arbitru indipendenti.
formal.en: The two companies agreed to submit the dispute to arbitration before an independent arbitrator.
formal.zh: 两家公司同意将争议提交给一名独立仲裁人进行仲裁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se ssolvu t-tilwima mal-fornitur? Pawlu: Qbilna li mmorru għal arbitraġġ. Maja: Jiġifieri arbitru indipendenti se jisma' liż-żewġ naħat u jieħu deċiżjoni? Pawlu: Iva, hekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are you going to resolve the dispute with the supplier? Pawlu: We've agreed to go to arbitration. Maja: So an independent arbitrator will hear both sides and make a decision? Pawlu: Yes, that's right.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们打算怎么解决和供应商的争议？Pawlu：我们同意通过仲裁解决。Maja：就是说，一名独立仲裁人会听取双方的陈述，然后作出裁决？Pawlu：对，就是这样。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你们打算怎么解决和供应商的争议？
messages.en: How are you going to resolve the dispute with the supplier?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (采购负责人)
messages.zh: 我们同意通过仲裁解决。
messages.en: We've agreed to go to arbitration.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri arbitru indipendenti se jisma' liż-żewġ naħat u jieħu deċiżjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri arbitru indipendenti se jisma' liż-żewġ naħat u jieħu deċiżjoni?
messages.zh: 就是说，一名独立仲裁人会听取双方的陈述，然后作出裁决？
messages.en: So an independent arbitrator will hear both sides and make a decision?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (采购负责人)
messages.zh: 对，就是这样。
messages.en: Yes, that's right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“三方一张桌”的画面记仲裁：争议双方分别陈述，独立第三方听取后作裁决；把整个解决争议的程序对应到 arbitraġġ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official who applies the rules of a sporting contest and makes decisions during play.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在体育比赛中执行规则、判断比赛情况并作出裁决的人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċjal li japplika r-regoli ta' logħba sportiva u jieħu deċiżjonijiet waqt il-logħob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 足球等体育比赛中负责执行规则、判定犯规和作出裁决的裁判。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċjal li jmexxi logħba, bħal logħba tal-futbol, japplika r-regoli u jiddeċiedi dwar il-ksur tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A referee is an official who controls a sporting match and decides whether players have broken its rules.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 网球、板球等体育比赛中判断球是否有效、运动员是否出局等事项的裁判。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċjal f'logħob bħat-tennis jew il-cricket li jiddeċiedi jekk azzjoni jew ballun ikunx validu skont ir-regoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An umpire is an official who makes decisions about play in sports such as tennis or cricket.

formal.mt: L-arbitru waqqaf il-logħba wara li plejer weġġa' u talab l-għajnuna medika.
formal.en: The referee stopped the match after a player was injured and requested medical assistance.
formal.zh: 一名球员受伤后，裁判暂停了比赛并请求医疗援助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqfet il-logħba? Mark: L-arbitru saffar għax kien hemm foul.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why has the game stopped? Mark: The referee blew the whistle because there was a foul.
colloquial.zh: Maja：比赛怎么停了？Mark：有人犯规，裁判吹哨了。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.zh: 比赛怎么停了？
messages.en: Why has the game stopped?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-arbitru saffar għax kien hemm foul.
messages.mt_standard: L-arbitru saffar għax kien hemm foul.
messages.zh: 有人犯规，裁判吹哨了。
messages.en: The referee blew the whistle because there was a foul.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arbitru 与场边吹哨、执行规则的裁判联系起来；英语译成 referee 还是 umpire，要看具体运动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tall upright structure used on a boat to support sails, or a pole used to support a flag or another object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 船上支撑帆的桅杆，或用于悬挂旗帜、支撑其他物件的竖杆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura twila u wieqfa li żżomm il-qlugħ ta' dgħajsa, jew lasta li tintuża biex iġġorr bandiera jew oġġett ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船上竖立的、用于支撑帆及有关索具的桅杆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Struttura twila u wieqfa fuq dgħajsa jew vapur li żżomm il-qlugħ u l-ħbula marbuta miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mast is a tall upright structure on a boat or ship that supports its sails and associated ropes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通常竖立使用、用于支撑或悬挂物件的长杆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Lasta twila, ġeneralment wieqfa, li tintuża biex iżżomm jew iġġorr xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pole is a long upright support used to hold something such as a flag.

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, il-kaptan spezzjona l-arblu tad-dgħajsa u l-ħbula li jżommuh f'postu.
formal.en: Before departure, the captain inspected the boat's mast and the ropes that hold it in place.
formal.zh: 出发前，船长检查了船的桅杆以及将其固定的绳索。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se ndendlu l-bandiera? Pawlu: Mal-arblu ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall we hang the flag? Pawlu: On the pole beside the door.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们把旗挂在哪里？Pawlu：挂在门旁的杆子上。

messages.speaker: Sara (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 我们把旗挂在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we hang the flag?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (志愿者)
messages.zh: 挂在门旁的杆子上。
messages.en: On the pole beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一根直立长杆的画面：arblu 在帆船上是桅杆，在旗帜旁是旗杆，用所支撑的物件区分词义。

gloss_zh: 翻倒；使翻倒；吊起；在造船时定位船肋骨

teaching_sense.en_definition: To topple over or make something topple over, to hoist something up, or to position a boat's ribs in relation to its keel during construction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体从边缘等处翻倒、使物体翻倒、将物体吊起，或在造船时按照龙骨的位置安放船肋骨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqaleb minn fuq tarf jew iġiegħel xi ħaġa tinqaleb, itella' xi ħaġa 'l fuq, jew iqiegħed il-kustilji ta' dgħajsa fil-pożizzjoni tagħhom fir-rigward tal-karina waqt il-bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失去平衡，从边缘等处翻倒或翻落。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jitlef il-bilanċ u jinqaleb minn fuq tarf jew minn post simili.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something topples over an edge, it loses its balance and falls over that edge.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物失去平衡而翻倒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġiegħel oġġett jitlef il-bilanċ u jinqaleb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone causes an object to topple over, they make it lose its balance and fall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将物体向上吊起或升起。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Itella' oġġett 'il fuq, pereżempju permezz ta' ħabel jew tagħmir tal-irfigħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you hoist something up, you raise it to a higher position, often using lifting equipment.

sense_translations.en_definition: in boat building, to position the ribs of a boat in relation to its keel
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在造船过程中，依照船的龙骨位置安放、定位船肋骨。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Waqt il-bini ta' dgħajsa, iqiegħed il-kustilji tagħha fil-pożizzjoni meħtieġa fir-rigward tal-karina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In boat building, this means placing the boat's ribs in their required positions relative to its keel.

collocations.en: hoisted the load with the crane
positioned the boat's ribs in relation to its keel
collocations.zh: 按照龙骨位置安放了船肋骨

formal.mt: Waqt il-bini tad-dgħajsa, il-bennej arbula l-kustilji fir-rigward tal-karina skont il-pjanta.
formal.en: During the construction of the boat, the builder positioned the ribs in relation to the keel according to the plan.
formal.zh: 建造这艘船时，造船工按照图纸，依照龙骨的位置安放了船肋骨。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif tellgħu dak il-kontenitur fuq il-vapur? Toni: Il-ħaddiem arbula l-kontenitur bil-krejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did they get that container up onto the ship? Toni: The worker hoisted the container with the crane.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他们怎么把那个集装箱弄到船上的？Toni：工人用起重机把集装箱吊上去了。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif tellgħu dak il-kontenitur fuq il-vapur?
messages.mt_standard: Kif tellgħu dak il-kontenitur fuq il-vapur?
messages.zh: 他们怎么把那个集装箱弄到船上的？
messages.en: How did they get that container up onto the ship?

messages.speaker: Toni (码头工人)
messages.zh: 工人用起重机把集装箱吊上去了。
messages.en: The worker hoisted the container with the crane.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四幅动作画面记 arbula：物体翻落、把物体弄翻、向上吊起、按龙骨定位船肋骨；这些义项要结合上下文分别记忆。

gloss_zh: 直立的；已吊起的；已翻倒的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes something that is upright, has been hoisted up, or has toppled over, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据上下文，描述物体处于直立、已被吊起或已经翻倒的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tkun wieqfa, imtellgħa 'l fuq jew maqluba, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直立的；竖起的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun wieqaf f'pożizzjoni vertikali jew imqiegħed dritt 'il fuq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is erect stands upright in a vertical position.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被向上吊起或升起的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ittella' 'l fuq permezz ta' ħabel jew tagħmir tal-irfigħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is hoisted up has been raised to a higher position using a rope or lifting equipment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经失去平衡而翻倒的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun tilef il-bilanċ u nqaleb minn fejn kien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that has toppled over has lost its balance and fallen from its previous position.

collocations.en: a container hoisted up by crane
collocations.zh: 用起重机吊起的集装箱

collocations.en: a container toppled onto its side

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kontenitur bħala arbulat fuq ġenbu wara l-inċident.
formal.en: The report describes the container as having toppled onto its side after the incident.
formal.zh: 报告描述，该集装箱在事故后翻倒在一侧。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-kontenitur għadu arbulat bil-krejn? Ġorġ: Iva, għadu mdendel 'il fuq mill-art.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the container still hoisted up by the crane? Ġorġ: Yes, it is still hanging above the ground.
colloquial.zh: Nina：集装箱还被起重机吊着吗？Ġorġ：是的，还悬在地面上方。

messages.speaker: Nina (现场主管)
messages.zh: 集装箱还被起重机吊着吗？
messages.en: Is the container still hoisted up by the crane?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (起重机操作员)
messages.zh: 是的，还悬在地面上方。
messages.en: Yes, it is still hanging above the ground.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 arbulat 配三张状态卡：直立、吊起、翻倒。看到起重机或侧倒位置等语境线索，再选择对应中文义项。

gloss_zh: 少量灌木植被；几丛灌木

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small amount of vegetation consisting of bushes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由几丛灌木构成的少量植被。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftit veġetazzjoni magħmula minn xi arbuxelli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 少量草木植被，指几丛灌木。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftit veġetazzjoni li tinkludi xi arbuxelli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Arbuxel refers to a small amount of vegetation consisting of bushes.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport dwar il-ġnien, ġie nnutat li kien hemm arbuxel ħdejn il-ħajt.
formal.en: The report on the garden noted that there were some bushes beside the wall.
formal.zh: 关于花园的报告指出，墙边有几丛灌木。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm ħdejn il-ħajt? | Pawlu: Hemm arbuxel. Nistgħu nħalluh hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's beside the wall? | Pawlu: There are some bushes. We can leave them there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：墙边有什么？ | Pawlu：有几丛灌木。我们可以把它们留在那里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 墙边有什么？
messages.en: What's beside the wall?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 有几丛灌木。我们可以把它们留在那里。
messages.en: There are some bushes. We can leave them there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arbuxel 和“墙边几丛灌木”的小画面配对记忆；本词条强调少量植被，拼写末尾只有一个 l。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woody plant with several stems growing from near the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常从接近地面处分出多个茎干的木本植物，即灌木。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-injam li ġeneralment għandha diversi zkuk jew friegħi ħerġin minn qrib l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灌木，通常从接近地面处分枝的木本植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-injam b'diversi zkuk jew friegħi li jibdew minn qrib l-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shrub is a woody plant with several stems growing from near the ground.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灌木；枝叶较密的一丛木本植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-injam li tikber f'għamla ta' massa ta' friegħi u weraq qrib l-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bush is a woody plant that forms a mass of branches and leaves near the ground.

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-ġnien jipproponi li jitħawwel arbuxell ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: The garden plan proposes planting a shrub beside the entrance.
formal.zh: 花园规划建议在入口旁栽种一株灌木。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se nħawlu dan l-arbuxell? | Mark: Ħdejn il-bieb, imma ħalli biżżejjed spazju biex jgħaddu n-nies.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall we plant this shrub? | Mark: Beside the door, but leave enough space for people to pass.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这株灌木我们种在哪里？ | Mark：门旁边，不过要留出足够的空间让人通行。

messages.speaker: Sara (住户)
messages.zh: 这株灌木我们种在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we plant this shrub?

messages.speaker: Mark (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-bieb, imma ħalli biżżejjed spazju biex jgħaddu n-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-bieb, imma ħalli biżżejjed spazju biex jgħaddu n-nies.
messages.zh: 门旁边，不过要留出足够的空间让人通行。
messages.en: Beside the door, but leave enough space for people to pass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给一株灌木挂上 arbuxell 标签，再用“栽种”和“修剪”两个动作记住它；书写时注意末尾双写 ll。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Two or more woody plants with several stems growing from near the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 多株通常从接近地面处分出多个茎干的木本植物；灌木的复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aktar minn arbuxell wieħed, jiġifieri pjanti tal-injam b'diversi zkuk jew friegħi ħerġin minn qrib l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灌木的复数，指两株或更多灌木。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żewġ arbuxelli jew aktar, li huma pjanti tal-injam b'diversi zkuk jew friegħi ħerġin minn qrib l-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Shrubs are woody plants with several stems growing from near the ground.

formal.mt: Tul il-mogħdija se jitħawlu arbuxelli bil-fjuri biex iżejnu l-ġnien.
formal.en: Flowering shrubs will be planted along the path to decorate the garden.
formal.zh: 小径两侧将栽种开花的灌木，以装点花园。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm se nixtru arbuxelli? | Toni: Nixtru tlieta biex inħawluhom tul il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Lara: How many shrubs shall we buy? | Toni: Let's buy three to plant along the wall.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们买几株灌木？ | Toni：买三株吧，沿着墙种。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 我们买几株灌木？
messages.en: How many shrubs shall we buy?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtru tlieta biex inħawluhom tul il-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtru tlieta biex inħawluhom tul il-ħajt.
messages.zh: 买三株吧，沿着墙种。
messages.en: Let's buy three to plant along the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arbuxell 的一株灌木画成一排，旁边写 arbuxelli；用这组单复数对照记住末尾增加的 i，勿推广为所有名词的规则。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An edible plant that can be used as food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可以食用、用作食物的蔬菜植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa li tista' tittiekel u tintuża bħala ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种可以食用的蔬菜植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaxixa li hija tajba għall-ikel u li tista' tittiekel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Arcicoks refers to an edible plant that people can use as food.

collocations.zh: 这顿饭要用的 Arcicoks 蔬菜
市场上的 Arcicoks 蔬菜

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-ħxejjex li jittieklu, hemm ukoll l-isem Arcicoks.
formal.en: The list of edible plants also includes the name Arcicoks.
formal.zh: 可食用蔬菜植物的清单中也列有 Arcicoks 这个名称。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhi Arcicoks? | Marija: Hija ħaxixa li tittiekel. Nistaqsu jekk għandhomx fis-suq.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is Arcicoks? | Marija: It's an edible plant. Let's ask whether they have any at the market.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Arcicoks 是什么？ | Marija：是一种可以吃的蔬菜植物。我们问问市场上有没有卖。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: Arcicoks 是什么？
messages.en: What is Arcicoks?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija ħaxixa li tittiekel. Nistaqsu jekk għandhomx fis-suq.
messages.mt_standard: Hija ħaxixa li tittiekel. Nistaqsu jekk għandhomx fis-suq.
messages.zh: 是一种可以吃的蔬菜植物。我们问问市场上有没有卖。
messages.en: It's an edible plant. Let's ask whether they have any at the market.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Arcicoks 写在“可以食用的蔬菜植物”购物卡上，配一只菜篮子帮助记忆；给定释义未明确具体品种，不凭拼写猜认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arena is a place where sporting contests or public performances take place, usually with space for spectators.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 举行体育比赛或公开表演、通常设有观众区域的竞技场或体育场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arena hija post fejn isiru kompetizzjonijiet sportivi jew wirjiet pubbliċi, ġeneralment bi spazju għall-ispettaturi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 举行竞技比赛或公开表演的场地，通常四周设有观众席。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arena hija spazju fejn isiru kompetizzjonijiet jew wirjiet quddiem l-ispettaturi, li ġeneralment joqogħdu madwaru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An arena is a place where competitions or performances are held in front of an audience.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设有比赛场地和大量观众席的体育场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arena hija faċilità sportiva b'qasam għal-logħob jew għall-kompetizzjonijiet u b'postijiet għal ħafna spettaturi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An arena is a sports venue with a playing area and seating for many spectators.

formal.mt: L-arena se tiftaħ il-bibien tagħha siegħa qabel il-bidu tal-kompetizzjoni.
formal.en: The arena will open its doors one hour before the competition begins.
formal.zh: 竞技场将于比赛开始前一小时开放入场。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Niltaqgħu ħdejn l-arena qabel il-logħba? Mark: Iva, nistenniek ħdejn id-daħla prinċipali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we meet by the arena before the match? Mark: Yes, I'll wait for you by the main entrance.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：比赛前我们在体育场旁边见面好吗？马克：好，我在主入口旁等你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 比赛前我们在体育场旁边见面好吗？
messages.en: Shall we meet by the arena before the match?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我在主入口旁等你。
messages.en: Yes, I'll wait for you by the main entrance.
