cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arena 记成观众围着比赛场地的画面：重点是供人观看竞技或表演的场所，也可指体育场。

gloss_zh: 奴隶监工；驱使奴隶劳动的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arguzin is a person who supervises enslaved people and forces them to work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 监督并强迫奴隶劳动的监工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arguzin huwa persuna li tissorvelja lill-ilsiera u ġġegħelhom jaħdmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责看管奴隶并强迫其劳动的监工。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arguzin huwa persuna li żżomm lill-ilsiera taħt is-sorveljanza tagħha u ġġegħelhom jagħmlu x-xogħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An arguzin is someone who oversees enslaved people and compels them to work.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-arguzin iġiegħel lill-ilsiera jkomplu jaħdmu minkejja l-għeja tagħhom.
formal.en: In the story, the slave driver forces the enslaved people to continue working despite their exhaustion.
formal.zh: 故事中，奴隶监工强迫奴隶们不顾疲惫继续劳动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu l-arguzin f'dan ir-rakkont? Pawlu: Dak li jissorvelja lill-ilsiera u jġegħelhom jaħdmu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the slave driver in this story? Pawlu: The person who watches over the enslaved people and forces them to work.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个故事里谁是奴隶监工？保罗：就是那个看管奴隶并强迫他们劳动的人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里谁是奴隶监工？
messages.en: Who is the slave driver in this story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak li jissorvelja lill-ilsiera u jġegħelhom jaħdmu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak li jissorvelja lill-ilsiera u jġegħelhom jaħdmu.
messages.zh: 就是那个看管奴隶并强迫他们劳动的人。
messages.en: The person who watches over the enslaved people and forces them to work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用角色画面记 arguzin：有人站在旁边监督、下令，强迫奴隶劳动；把这个角色与“奴隶监工”对应。

gloss_zh: 鲱鱼；瘦得像根柴的人（比喻）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An aringa is a herring; figuratively, the word can also describe a very thin person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指鲱鱼，也可比喻身材非常瘦的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aringa hija ħuta tal-baħar li tittiekel; il-kelma tintuża wkoll b'mod figurattiv għal persuna rqiqa ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鲱鱼，一种可供食用的海鱼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Aringa hija tip ta' ħuta tal-baħar li tittiekel u li tista' tinbiegħ friska, immellħa jew affumikata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An aringa is a herring, a sea fish that people eat fresh or preserved.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who is very thin (figurative usage)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 比喻身材非常瘦削的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta tintuża b'mod figurattiv għal persuna, il-kelma aringa tfisser li dik il-persuna hija rqiqa ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is called an aringa, they are being described figuratively as very thin.

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi aringa affumikata servuta ma' patata mgħollija.
formal.en: The menu includes smoked herring served with boiled potatoes.
formal.zh: 菜单上有一道熏鲱鱼配水煮土豆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fir-rumanz jgħidu li Toni sar aringa. Xi jfisser? Lara: Ifisser li sar irqiq ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: In the novel, they say Toni has become an aringa. What does that mean? Lara: It means he has become very thin.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小说里说托尼变成了一条“鲱鱼”。这是什么意思？拉拉：意思是他变得非常瘦。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fir-rumanz jgħidu li Toni sar aringa. Xi jfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Fir-rumanz jgħidu li Toni sar aringa. Xi jfisser?
messages.zh: 小说里说托尼变成了一条“鲱鱼”。这是什么意思？
messages.en: In the novel, they say Toni has become an aringa. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 意思是他变得非常瘦。
messages.en: It means he has become very thin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 aringa 配两张学习卡：餐盘里的鲱鱼，以及标着“非常瘦”的人物剪影；分别记住本义和比喻义。

gloss_zh: 算术的；算术运算方面的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something aritmetiku relates to arithmetic, including calculations with numbers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与算术有关的，涉及数的加、减、乘、除等运算的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa aritmetika għandha x'taqsam mal-aritmetika, jiġifieri mal-kalkoli bin-numri bħall-għadd, it-tnaqqis, il-multiplikazzjoni u d-diviżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 算术的；与数及其基本运算有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-aġġettiv aritmetiku jiddeskrivi dak li għandu x'jaqsam mal-aritmetika u mal-operazzjonijiet bażiċi bin-numri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is aritmetiku involves arithmetic or the basic operations performed on numbers.

formal.mt: Żball aritmetiku fil-kalkolu wassal għal total mhux korrett.
formal.en: An arithmetic error in the calculation led to an incorrect total.
formal.zh: 计算中的一个算术错误导致了错误的总数。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex it-total tiegħi huwa differenti? Sara: Għandek żball aritmetiku hawn: sebgħa u tmienja jagħmlu ħmistax.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is my total different? Sara: You have an arithmetic error here: seven plus eight is fifteen.
colloquial.zh: 马克：为什么我算出的总数不一样？萨拉：你这里有个算术错误：七加八等于十五。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么我算出的总数不一样？
messages.en: Why is my total different?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek żball aritmetiku hawn: sebgħa u tmienja jagħmlu ħmistax.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek żball aritmetiku hawn: sebgħa u tmienja jagħmlu ħmistax.
messages.zh: 你这里有个算术错误：七加八等于十五。
messages.en: You have an arithmetic error here: seven plus eight is fifteen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 aritmetiku 与写满加减乘除的练习纸联系起来；记住它是形容词，可修饰“计算”“练习”和“错误”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system or process that cools and controls the air inside a building or vehicle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于冷却和调节建筑物或车辆内部空气的系统或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema jew proċess li jkessaħ u jirregola l-arja ġewwa bini jew vettura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 空调；对建筑物或车辆内部空气进行冷却和调节的系统或过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema jew proċess li jintuża biex ikessaħ u jirregola l-arja ġewwa bini jew vettura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Air conditioning is a system that keeps the air inside a building or vehicle cool and controlled.

collocations.en: to switch on the air conditioning

formal.mt: L-arja kkondizjonata fl-uffiċċju titħaddem biss matul il-ħin tax-xogħol biex jitnaqqas il-konsum tal-enerġija.
formal.en: The air conditioning in the office is operated only during working hours to reduce energy consumption.
formal.zh: 办公室的空调仅在工作时间运行，以减少能源消耗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn sħana kbira. Nista' nixgħel l-arja kkondizjonata? Mark: Iva, imma agħlaq it-tieqa l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: It's very hot in here. Can I turn on the air conditioning? Mark: Yes, but close the window first.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里太热了。我可以打开空调吗？Mark：可以，不过先把窗户关上。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn sħana kbira. Nista' nixgħel l-arja kkondizjonata?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn sħana kbira. Nista' nixgħel l-arja kkondizjonata?
messages.zh: 这里太热了。我可以打开空调吗？
messages.en: It's very hot in here. Can I turn on the air conditioning?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 可以，不过先把窗户关上。
messages.en: Yes, but close the window first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arja kkondizjonata 整体联想为“关上窗户、打开空调”的夏日场景，再用 tixgħel l-arja kkondizjonata 练习说“打开空调”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to peoples or languages called Aryan, or to racial ideas associated with that name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与被称为“雅利安”的民族、语言或与这一名称相关的种族观念有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' popli jew lingwi msejħa Arjani, jew ma' ideat razzjali marbuta ma' dan l-isem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雅利安的；与称为“雅利安”的民族、语言或相关种族观念有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirreferi għal popli jew lingwi msejħa Arjani, jew għal ideat razzjali li jużaw dan l-isem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a text describes something as Aryan, it connects it with peoples, languages, or racial ideas bearing that name.

formal.mt: L-awtur jispjega t-terminu 'arjan' fil-kuntest tal-ideoloġija razzjali diskussa fit-test.
formal.en: The author explains the term 'Aryan' in the context of the racial ideology discussed in the text.
formal.zh: 作者结合文中讨论的种族意识形态，解释了“雅利安的”这一术语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'arjan' f'dan it-test? Mark: Hawn jirreferi għal ideoloġija razzjali; irridu nifhmu l-kuntest.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'Aryan' mean in this text? Mark: Here it refers to a racial ideology; we need to understand the context.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇文章里的“雅利安的”是什么意思？Mark：这里指的是一种种族意识形态；我们需要结合上下文理解。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的“雅利安的”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Aryan' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn jirreferi għal ideoloġija razzjali; irridu nifhmu l-kuntest.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn jirreferi għal ideoloġija razzjali; irridu nifhmu l-kuntest.
messages.zh: 这里指的是一种种族意识形态；我们需要结合上下文理解。
messages.en: Here it refers to a racial ideology; we need to understand the context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arjan 与“雅利安的”配对记忆；遇到 lingwa arjana 时，注意形容词随阴性名词变为 arjana，并结合上下文判断具体所指。

gloss_zh: 空气流通的；微风吹拂的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having good air circulation or a pleasant light breeze.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容地方通风良好，或有轻柔宜人的风吹过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi post fejn l-arja tiċċirkola tajjeb jew fejn jonfoħ riħ ħafif u pjaċevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通风良好的；空气流通而不闷的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi post fejn tidħol ħafna arja u fejn hemm ventilazzjoni tajba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An airy room or building has plenty of fresh air circulating through it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有微风的；轻风吹拂而凉爽的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi post jew temp fejn jonfoħ riħ ħafif u frisk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A breezy place has a light wind blowing through it.

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju huwa arjuż, għax it-twieqi fuq iż-żewġ naħat jippermettu lill-arja tiċċirkola tajjeb.
formal.en: The office is airy because the windows on both sides allow air to circulate well.
formal.zh: 办公室通风良好，因为两侧的窗户让空气能够顺畅流通。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Noqogħdu fit-terrazzin? Huwa arjuż u frisk. Pawlu: Iva, hawn ġewwa sħun wisq. Nieħu t-tazzi barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we sit on the terrace? It's breezy and cool. Pawlu: Yes, it's too hot in here. I'll take the cups outside.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们去露台坐吧？那里有微风，很凉快。Pawlu：好，这里面太热了。我把杯子拿出去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Noqogħdu fit-terrazzin? Huwa arjuż u frisk.
messages.mt_standard: Noqogħdu fit-terrazzin? Huwa arjuż u frisk.
messages.zh: 我们去露台坐吧？那里有微风，很凉快。
messages.en: Shall we sit on the terrace? It's breezy and cool.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn ġewwa sħun wisq. Nieħu t-tazzi barra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn ġewwa sħun wisq. Nieħu t-tazzi barra.
messages.zh: 好，这里面太热了。我把杯子拿出去。
messages.en: Yes, it's too hot in here. I'll take the cups outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记住 arjuż：房间两侧开窗，表示通风；露台轻风拂面，表示有微风。搭配一起记：kamra arjuża、terrazzin arjuż。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An angel of high rank in a religious tradition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗教传统中地位较高的天使，称为天使长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Anġlu ta' grad għoli fi tradizzjoni reliġjuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天使长；宗教传统中具有较高等级的天使。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arkanġlu huwa anġlu li għandu grad għoli fi tradizzjoni reliġjuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An archangel is an angel who holds a high rank within a religious tradition.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-mużew jiddeskrivi l-figura fil-pittura bħala arkanġlu u jispjega r-rwol tagħha fix-xena reliġjuża.
formal.en: The museum catalogue identifies the figure in the painting as an archangel and explains its role in the religious scene.
formal.zh: 博物馆图录指出，画中的人物是一位天使长，并解释了其在这幅宗教场景中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu arkanġlu? Rajt il-kelma ħdejn dik l-istatwa. Mark: Huwa anġlu ta' grad għoli. Ejja naqraw it-tikketta flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's an archangel? I saw the word beside that statue. Mark: It's an angel of high rank. Let's read the label together.
colloquial.zh: Sara：什么是天使长？我在那尊雕像旁边看到了这个词。Mark：就是等级较高的天使。我们一起读读说明牌吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu arkanġlu? Rajt il-kelma ħdejn dik l-istatwa.
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu arkanġlu? Rajt il-kelma ħdejn dik l-istatwa.
messages.zh: 什么是天使长？我在那尊雕像旁边看到了这个词。
messages.en: What's an archangel? I saw the word beside that statue.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa anġlu ta' grad għoli. Ejja naqraw it-tikketta flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa anġlu ta' grad għoli. Ejja naqraw it-tikketta flimkien.
messages.zh: 就是等级较高的天使。我们一起读读说明牌吧。
messages.en: It's an angel of high rank. Let's read the label together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arkanġlu 和博物馆里的天使长雕像联系起来记忆；看到 statwa ta' arkanġlu，就在心中说“一尊天使长雕像”，突出“等级较高的天使”这一含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who studies past human life by investigating material remains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过调查和研究物质遗存，探索过去人类生活的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tistudja l-ħajja tal-bnedmin fil-passat billi tinvestiga fdalijiet materjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 考古学家；通过发掘、记录和分析物质遗存研究过去人类社会的专业人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna speċjalizzata fl-arkeoloġija li tistudja s-soċjetajiet tal-passat permezz tat-tħaffir, id-dokumentazzjoni u l-analiżi ta' fdalijiet materjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An archeologist is someone who investigates material remains to learn about people and societies in the past.

collocations.en: an archaeologist who leads the excavation

formal.mt: L-arkeologu rreġistra l-post eżatt ta' kull oġġett qabel ma neħħieh mill-ħamrija.
formal.en: The archaeologist recorded the exact location of each object before removing it from the soil.
formal.zh: 考古学家在从土中取出每件物品之前，都记录了它的准确位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jurina s-sit għada? Mark: Arkeologu li ħadem fit-tħaffir ta' dan is-sit. Maja: Mela jista' jispjegalna x'sabu hemm. Mark: Iva, u kif studjaw l-oġġetti li sabu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who's going to show us around the site tomorrow? Mark: An archaeologist who worked on the excavation of this site. Maja: Then he can explain what they found there. Mark: Yes, and how they studied the objects they found.
colloquial.zh: Maja：明天谁带我们参观遗址？Mark：一位参与过这里发掘工作的考古学家。Maja：那他可以讲讲他们在那里发现了什么。Mark：对，还可以讲讲他们怎样研究发现的物品。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 明天谁带我们参观遗址？
messages.en: Who's going to show us around the site tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Arkeologu li ħadem fit-tħaffir ta' dan is-sit.
messages.mt_standard: Arkeologu li ħadem fit-tħaffir ta' dan is-sit.
messages.zh: 一位参与过这里发掘工作的考古学家。
messages.en: An archaeologist who worked on the excavation of this site.

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 那他可以讲讲他们在那里发现了什么。
messages.en: Then he can explain what they found there.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u kif studjaw l-oġġetti li sabu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u kif studjaw l-oġġetti li sabu.
messages.zh: 对，还可以讲讲他们怎样研究发现的物品。
messages.en: Yes, and how they studied the objects they found.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个词配对记：arkeoloġija 是考古学这门学科，arkeologu 是研究它的人；想象一位正在记录陶片位置的考古学家。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The study of past human life through material remains, such as buildings, tools, and pottery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过建筑、工具、陶器等物质遗存研究过去人类生活的学科。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istudju tal-ħajja tal-bnedmin fil-passat permezz ta' fdalijiet materjali, bħal bini, għodod u fuħħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 考古学；通过物质遗存研究过去人类社会与生活的学科。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xjenza li tistudja s-soċjetajiet u l-ħajja tal-bnedmin fil-passat billi teżamina l-fdalijiet materjali li ħallew warajhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Archaeology is the study of past human societies through the buildings, objects, and other material remains they left behind.

formal.mt: L-arkeoloġija tgħinna nifhmu kif kienu jgħixu n-nies fil-passat billi nistudjaw il-bini u l-oġġetti li ħallew warajhom.
formal.en: Archaeology helps us understand how people lived in the past by studying the buildings and objects they left behind.
formal.zh: 考古学通过研究过去人们留下的建筑和物品，帮助我们了解他们当时的生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed tistudja l-università? Lara: Qed nistudja l-arkeoloġija. Maja: U x'tagħmlu fil-kors? Lara: Nistudjaw fdalijiet antiki biex nifhmu l-ħajja tan-nies fil-passat.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you studying at university? Lara: I'm studying archaeology. Maja: And what do you do on the course? Lara: We study ancient remains to understand people's lives in the past.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在大学学什么？Lara：我在学考古学。Maja：那你们的课程学些什么？Lara：我们研究古代遗存，了解过去人们的生活。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在大学学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying at university?

messages.speaker: Lara (大学生)
messages.zh: 我在学考古学。
messages.en: I'm studying archaeology.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那你们的课程学些什么？
messages.en: And what do you do on the course?

messages.speaker: Lara (大学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistudjaw fdalijiet antiki biex nifhmu l-ħajja tan-nies fil-passat.
messages.mt_standard: Nistudjaw fdalijiet antiki biex nifhmu l-ħajja tan-nies fil-passat.
messages.zh: 我们研究古代遗存，了解过去人们的生活。
messages.en: We study ancient remains to understand people's lives in the past.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把古陶片、旧工具和遗址连成一幅学习画面：arkeoloġija 就是借这些遗存研究过去生活的考古学。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the design, structure, or style of buildings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与建筑物的设计、结构或风格有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mad-disinn, l-istruttura jew l-istil tal-bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑的；与建筑设计、结构或风格有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-arkitettura, speċjalment id-disinn, l-istruttura u l-istil tal-bini.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Architectural means relating to the design, structure, or style of buildings.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza l-istil arkitettoniku tal-bini u jiddeskrivi l-forma tat-twieqi u tad-daħla prinċipali.
formal.en: The report analyses the building's architectural style and describes the shape of the windows and the main entrance.
formal.zh: 报告分析了这座建筑的建筑风格，并描述了窗户和正门的形状。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Togħġbok din id-dar? Mark: Iva, jogħġobni l-istil arkitettoniku tagħha. Lara: X'jogħġbok l-aktar? Mark: It-twieqi kbar u d-daħla wiesgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you like this house? Mark: Yes, I like its architectural style. Lara: What do you like most? Mark: The large windows and the wide entrance.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你喜欢这栋房子吗？Mark：喜欢，我喜欢它的建筑风格。Lara：你最喜欢哪一点？Mark：大窗户和宽敞的入口。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这栋房子吗？
messages.en: Do you like this house?

messages.speaker: Mark (看房者)
messages.zh: 喜欢，我喜欢它的建筑风格。
messages.en: Yes, I like its architectural style.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你最喜欢哪一点？
messages.en: What do you like most?

messages.speaker: Mark (看房者)
messages.zh: 大窗户和宽敞的入口。
messages.en: The large windows and the wide entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用固定搭配记形容词：看到建筑外观就说 stil arkitettoniku，看到设计图就想 disinn arkitettoniku，把词和具体画面连起来。

gloss_zh: 钟表匠；钟表制作及维修人员

teaching_sense.en_definition: A skilled person who makes or repairs watches and clocks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事钟表制作或修理的专业工匠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna tas-sengħa li tagħmel jew issewwi l-arloġġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钟表匠；以制作或修理手表、时钟为业的技术人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tagħmel l-arloġġi jew issewwi l-mekkaniżmi tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A watchmaker is a skilled worker who makes or repairs watches and clocks.

collocations.en: to take the watch to the watchmaker
collocations.zh: 把手表送到钟表匠那里

formal.mt: L-arloġġier eżamina l-mekkaniżmu tal-arloġġ u spjega lill-klijent liema partijiet kellhom jinbidlu.
formal.en: The watchmaker examined the watch's mechanism and explained to the customer which parts needed replacing.
formal.zh: 钟表匠检查了手表的机械装置，并向顾客说明哪些零件需要更换。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Int l-arloġġier? Pawlu: Iva, kif nista' ngħinek? Mark: L-arloġġ tiegħi waqaf. Tista' tagħtih daqqa t'għajn? Pawlu: Żgur, ħallini nara x'għandu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are you the watchmaker? Pawlu: Yes, how can I help you? Mark: My watch has stopped. Could you take a look at it? Pawlu: Of course, let me see what's wrong with it.
colloquial.zh: Mark：您是钟表匠吗？Pawlu：是的，有什么可以帮您？Mark：我的手表停了，您能帮忙看看吗？Pawlu：当然，让我看看它出了什么问题。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 您是钟表匠吗？
messages.en: Are you the watchmaker?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (钟表匠)
messages.zh: 是的，有什么可以帮您？
messages.en: Yes, how can I help you?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: L-arloġġ tiegħi waqaf. Tista' tagħtih daqqa t'għajn?
messages.mt_standard: L-arloġġ tiegħi waqaf. Tista' tagħtih daqqa t'għajn?
messages.zh: 我的手表停了，您能帮忙看看吗？
messages.en: My watch has stopped. Could you take a look at it?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (钟表匠)
messages.zh: 当然，让我看看它出了什么问题。
messages.en: Of course, let me see what's wrong with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手表停走后，把它交给戴着放大镜、检查细小齿轮的师傅；把这个修表场景与 arloġġier 一起记住。

gloss_zh: 刀刃、尖刺类武器；用于刺击或砍切的武器

teaching_sense.en_definition: A weapon with a blade, a sharp point, or both, used for cutting or thrusting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有刀刃、尖端或兼具两者，用于砍切或刺击的武器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arma b'xafra, b'ponta jew bit-tnejn, li tintuża biex taqta' jew tagħti daqqiet bil-ponta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带有刀刃、用于砍切等动作的武器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Armi li għandhom xafra li tintuża biex taqta'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bladed weapons have a sharpened blade used to cut or strike.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有尖端或锋利刃口的武器的统称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Armi li għandhom ponta jew xifer jaqta', jew it-tnejn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This category includes weapons with sharp points, cutting edges, or both.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于刺击或砍切的武器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Armi li jintużaw biex jagħtu daqqiet bil-ponta jew biex jaqtgħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: These weapons are used to deliver thrusts or cutting blows.

collocations.en: carry a bladed or pointed weapon
collocations.zh: 携带刀刃或尖刺类武器

collocations.en: a collection of bladed and pointed weapons
collocations.zh: 一批刀刃与尖刺类武器的收藏

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesebixxi xabla bħala eżempju ta' arma bjanka.
formal.en: The museum displays a sword as an example of a bladed weapon.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出一把剑，作为刀刃类武器的实例。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Din ix-xabla titqies bħala arma bjanka? Mark: Iva, għax għandha xafra li taqta'.
colloquial.en: Lina: Is this sword considered a bladed weapon? Mark: Yes, because it has a cutting blade.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这把剑算刀刃类武器吗？马克：算，因为它有锋利的刀刃。

messages.speaker: Lina (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Din ix-xabla titqies bħala arma bjanka?
messages.mt_standard: Din ix-xabla titqies bħala arma bjanka?
messages.zh: 这把剑算刀刃类武器吗？
messages.en: Is this sword considered a bladed weapon?

messages.speaker: Mark (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax għandha xafra li taqta'.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax għandha xafra li taqta'.
messages.zh: 算，因为它有锋利的刀刃。
messages.en: Yes, because it has a cutting blade.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arma bjanka 和博物馆里的剑联系起来，记住“有刃或有尖端的武器”；学习时把整个短语作为一个单位记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A calendar showing the days, weeks, and months of a year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按一年中的月份、星期和日期编排，供查阅日期使用的日历或历书。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kalendarju li juri l-ġranet, il-ġimgħat u x-xhur ta' sena u li jintuża biex wieħed jiċċekkja d-dati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 列出一年中各月和各日，供查阅日期的日历。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tabella jew ktieb li juri l-ġranet u x-xhur ta' sena biex wieħed ikun jista' jsib data.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An armanak is a calendar that you consult to check dates throughout the year.

formal.mt: Skont l-armanak, l-ewwel jum tax-xahar jaħbat il-Ħadd.
formal.en: According to the calendar, the first day of the month falls on a Sunday.
formal.zh: 根据日历，这个月的第一天是星期日。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tħares lejn l-armanak u tgħidli x'jum jaħbat l-għaxra tax-xahar? Pawlu: Iva, jaħbat it-Tlieta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you look at the calendar and tell me what day the tenth of the month falls on? Pawlu: Yes, it falls on Tuesday.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你能看看日历，告诉我这个月十号是星期几吗？保罗：可以，是星期二。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tħares lejn l-armanak u tgħidli x'jum jaħbat l-għaxra tax-xahar?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tħares lejn l-armanak u tgħidli x'jum jaħbat l-għaxra tax-xahar?
messages.zh: 你能看看日历，告诉我这个月十号是星期几吗？
messages.en: Can you look at the calendar and tell me what day the tenth of the month falls on?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，是星期二。
messages.en: Yes, it falls on Tuesday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在 armanak 上圈出自己的生日，再沿着那一行查星期几；用“圈日期、查星期”的动作记住日历义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cabinet or cupboard used to store clothes or belongings, or to display objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于存放衣物、个人物品，或用于陈列物件的柜子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamara bil-bibien li fiha jinżammu ħwejjeġ jew oġġetti oħra, jew li tintuża biex jintwerew oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于存放衣服等物品的衣柜或壁橱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għamara jew spazju magħluq bil-bibien fejn jinżammu l-ħwejjeġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An armarju is a cupboard or enclosed storage space where you keep clothes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通常可以上锁，供个人存放物品的储物柜。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kabinett, ġeneralment b'serratura, fejn persuna tista' żżomm l-affarijiet personali tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An armarju can be a locker where someone stores personal belongings securely.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于展示商品、藏品等物件的陈列柜，通常带有玻璃。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għamara, ġeneralment bil-ħġieġ, li fiha jitqiegħdu oġġetti biex ikunu jistgħu jidhru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An armarju can be a display cabinet in which objects are shown to visitors.

formal.mt: Il-midalji jitqiegħdu f'armarju tal-ħġieġ ħdejn id-daħla tas-sala.
formal.en: The medals are placed in a glass display cabinet beside the entrance to the hall.
formal.zh: 奖章被放置在大厅入口旁的玻璃陈列柜中。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn poġġejt il-ġakketta tiegħi? David: Fl-armarju tal-ħwejjeġ, ħdejn il-kowt tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where did you put my jacket? David: In the wardrobe, next to your coat.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你把我的夹克放哪儿了？戴维：衣柜里，就在你的大衣旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 你把我的夹克放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put my jacket?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.zh: 衣柜里，就在你的大衣旁边。
messages.en: In the wardrobe, next to your coat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一个柜子切换三幅画面：挂衣服是衣柜，锁私人物品是储物柜，透过玻璃看藏品是陈列柜，统一记住 armarju。

gloss_zh: 武装的；已搭设或装配好的；已准备就绪的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Carrying weapons, set up for use, or prepared for action, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境指携带武器的、已经搭设或装配好的，或已做好准备可以行动或使用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu arma jew armi, li ġie mwaqqaf jew immuntat għall-użu, jew li ġie ppreparat biex ikun lest għall-azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 携带或配备武器的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu arma jew armi miegħu jew għad-dispożizzjoni tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is armat carries weapons or has weapons available for use.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经搭建、安装或布置好，可以使用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie mwaqqaf, immuntat jew irranġat sabiex ikun jista' jintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is armat has been assembled or arranged so that it can be used.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经过必要准备，随时可以启动、使用或发挥作用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie ppreparat u jinsab lest biex jitħaddem, jintuża jew jaġixxi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is armat has been prepared and is ready to operate or act.

collocations.en: a stage that has been set up

formal.mt: Il-palk għandu jkun armat qabel ma tibda l-prova ġenerali.
formal.en: The stage must be set up before the dress rehearsal begins.
formal.zh: 舞台必须在正式彩排开始前搭设完毕。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-palk diġà armat? Ġorġ: Iva, kollox lest għall-prova.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has the stage been set up already? Ġorġ: Yes, everything is ready for the rehearsal.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：舞台已经搭好了吗？乔治：是的，彩排需要的一切都准备好了。

messages.speaker: Anna (演员)
messages.zh: 舞台已经搭好了吗？
messages.en: Has the stage been set up already?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (舞台工作人员)
messages.zh: 是的，彩排需要的一切都准备好了。
messages.en: Yes, everything is ready for the rehearsal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 armat，先判断它描述谁或什么：士兵是“有武器”，舞台是“已搭好”，机构是“待启动”；用对象帮助选择准确词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized military force trained and equipped for defence or combat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过组织、训练并配备装备，执行防卫或作战任务的军队。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forza militari organizzata, imħarrġa u mgħammra biex tiddefendi jew tiġġieled.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为军事组织的军队。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forza militari magħmula minn suldati organizzati u mħarrġa għad-difiża jew għall-ġlied.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An army is an organized military force whose soldiers are trained for defence or combat.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif l-armata ħadet sehem fl-operazzjoni ta' salvataġġ.
formal.en: The report describes how the army took part in the rescue operation.
formal.zh: 报告描述了军队如何参与救援行动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk jaħdem mal-armata? Toni: Iva, ingħaqad magħha sentejn ilu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does your brother work in the army? Toni: Yes, he joined two years ago.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥在军队工作吗？托尼：对，他两年前参军了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥在军队工作吗？
messages.en: Does your brother work in the army?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，他两年前参军了。
messages.en: Yes, he joined two years ago.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 armata 和整齐列队的士兵画面联系起来，再用 tingħaqad mal-armata“参军”这个短语巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shop window in which goods are displayed for people to see.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 商店用于向行人展示商品的橱窗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vetrina ta' ħanut fejn jintwerew oġġetti għall-bejgħ biex jarawhom in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于展示商品的商店橱窗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tieqa tal-wiri f'ħanut fejn jitqiegħdu oġġetti għall-bejgħ biex jiġbdu l-attenzjoni tan-nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A show window is a shop window where goods are arranged for people outside to see.

formal.mt: Il-prodotti l-ġodda tqiegħdu fl-armatur tal-ħanut biex jiġbdu l-attenzjoni tal-klijenti.
formal.en: The new products were placed in the shop's display window to attract customers' attention.
formal.zh: 新商品被摆放在商店的橱窗里，以吸引顾客的注意。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt dik il-libsa fl-armatur? Mark: Iva, ejja nidħlu nistaqsu kemm tiswa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see that dress in the display window? Mark: Yes, let's go in and ask how much it costs.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看到橱窗里的那条连衣裙了吗？马克：看到了，我们进去问问多少钱吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 你看到橱窗里的那条连衣裙了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that dress in the display window?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nidħlu nistaqsu kemm tiswa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nidħlu nistaqsu kemm tiswa.
messages.zh: 看到了，我们进去问问多少钱吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's go in and ask how much it costs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 armatur 时想象逛街停在玻璃橱窗前看商品，并把 fl-armatur“在橱窗里”作为一个整体练习。

gloss_zh: 亚美尼亚的；来自亚美尼亚的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming from Armenia or connected with its people or culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自亚美尼亚的，或与亚美尼亚及其人民、文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Armenja jew li għandu rabta mal-Armenja, mal-poplu tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亚美尼亚的；亚美尼亚人或文化的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Armenja, mal-poplu tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something Armenian is connected with Armenia, its people, or their culture.

sense_translations.en_definition: coming from or related to Armenia
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自亚美尼亚的，或与亚美尼亚有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joriġina mill-Armenja jew li għandu xi rabta ma' dak il-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something described as Armenian comes from Armenia or has a connection with that country.

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza kif kittieb armen jippreżenta l-ħajja ta' kuljum fir-rumanzi tiegħu.
formal.en: The study analyses how an Armenian writer presents everyday life in his novels.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了一位亚美尼亚作家如何在其小说中描写日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ktieb ta' kittieb armen? Pawlu: Iva, u qed nieħu gost naqrah.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this book by an Armenian writer? Pawlu: Yes, and I'm enjoying reading it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这本书是亚美尼亚作家写的吗？保罗：对，而且我读得很开心。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这本书是亚美尼亚作家写的吗？
messages.en: Is this book by an Armenian writer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u qed nieħu gost naqrah.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u qed nieħu gost naqrah.
messages.zh: 对，而且我读得很开心。
messages.en: Yes, and I'm enjoying reading it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 armen 放进 kittieb armen“亚美尼亚作家”中记忆，注意这里它修饰名词，表示来源或关联。

gloss_zh: Armil（所给名称，具体所指未说明）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supplied name Armil, whose specific referent is not identified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给名称 Armil；材料未说明该名称具体指什么。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem Armil kif mogħti, mingħajr tagħrif li jidentifika għal xiex jirreferi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Armil；所给材料未提供其具体所指或进一步释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-isem mogħti bħala Armil, li r-referent speċifiku tiegħu mhuwiex indikat fit-tagħrif ipprovdut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Armil is the name supplied here, although the available information does not identify what it refers to.

collocations.en: the spelling of the name Armil

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-isem Armil għandu jinkiteb b'ittra kapitali fil-bidu.
formal.en: In this exercise, the name Armil should be written with an initial capital letter.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，名称 Armil 的首字母应大写。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif jinkiteb l-isem Armil? Leon: A kapitali, imbagħad r, m, i, l.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do you spell the name Armil? Leon: A capital A, then r, m, i, l.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：Armil 这个名称怎么拼？莱昂：先写大写 A，再写 r、m、i、l。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: Armil 这个名称怎么拼？
messages.en: How do you spell the name Armil?

messages.speaker: Leon (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: A kapitali, imbagħad r, m, i, l.
messages.mt_standard: A kapitali, imbagħad r, m, i, l.
messages.zh: 先写大写 A，再写 r、m、i、l。
messages.en: A capital A, then r, m, i, l.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先按 A-r-m-i-l 五个字母记住 Armil 的写法，并记住首字母大写；具体所指需等待更多语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing harmony because its parts or participants work well together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 各部分或参与者相互配合良好，呈现和谐、协调状态的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri qbil u bilanċ bejn il-partijiet jew bejn il-persuni involuti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现出和谐或协调状态的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri li hemm qbil u bilanċ bejn il-partijiet jew il-persuni involuti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is harmonious shows that its parts or participants fit together well.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 和谐的；各部分搭配协调或人与人相处融洽的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu partijiet li jaqblu sew flimkien jew persuni li jiftiehmu bejniethom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You describe something as harmonious when its elements combine pleasantly or its participants get along well.

formal.mt: L-għan tal-proġett huwa li jinħoloq ambjent armonjuż fejn kulħadd jista' jaħdem tajjeb mal-oħrajn.
formal.en: The aim of the project is to create a harmonious environment where everyone can work well with others.
formal.zh: 该项目旨在营造和谐的环境，让每个人都能与他人良好合作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer ix-xogħol fit-tim il-ġdid? Mark: Tajjeb ħafna. L-ambjent huwa armonjuż u kulħadd jgħin lill-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is work going in the new team? Mark: Very well. The atmosphere is harmonious, and everyone helps each other.
colloquial.zh: Maja：在新团队里工作怎么样？Mark：很好。气氛很和谐，大家互相帮助。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 在新团队里工作怎么样？
messages.en: How is work going in the new team?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna. L-ambjent huwa armonjuż u kulħadd jgħin lill-oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna. L-ambjent huwa armonjuż u kulħadd jgħin lill-oħrajn.
messages.zh: 很好。气氛很和谐，大家互相帮助。
messages.en: Very well. The atmosphere is harmonious, and everyone helps each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 armonjuż 和“大家配合得很和谐”的团队画面绑定，再用 ambjent armonjuż 反复练习，记住它描述协调融洽的状态。

gloss_zh: Armunjaka（名称；所给资料未说明具体所指）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name Armunjaka, whose specific referent is not identified in the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名称 Armunjaka；所给资料未说明该名称具体指什么，学习时应保留原文。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem Armunjaka, li l-materjal mogħti ma jispjegax għal xiex jirreferi eżattament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Armunjaka；原文名称，所给资料未提供其具体含义或所指对象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-isem Armunjaka kif jidher fil-materjal mogħti, mingħajr tagħrif li jidentifika għal xiex jirreferi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Armunjaka is the name given here, although the supplied material does not identify what it refers to.

collocations.en: the spelling of the name Armunjaka

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-isem Armunjaka għandu jinżamm kif inhu, għax it-test ma jispjegax għal xiex jirreferi.
formal.en: In this exercise, the name Armunjaka should be kept unchanged because the text does not explain what it refers to.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，应原样保留 Armunjaka 这个名称，因为文本没有解释它的具体所指。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif nikteb l-isem Armunjaka fin-noti tiegħi? Pawlu: Ikkopjah kif jidher fit-test, b'A kbira fil-bidu.
colloquial.en: Lara: How should I write the name Armunjaka in my notes? Pawlu: Copy it as it appears in the text, with a capital A at the beginning.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我在笔记里应该怎样写 Armunjaka 这个名称？Pawlu：照文本里的样子抄写，开头的 A 要大写。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nikteb l-isem Armunjaka fin-noti tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nikteb l-isem Armunjaka fin-noti tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我在笔记里应该怎样写 Armunjaka 这个名称？
messages.en: How should I write the name Armunjaka in my notes?

messages.mt_spoken: Ikkopjah kif jidher fit-test, b'A kbira fil-bidu.
messages.mt_standard: Ikkopjah kif jidher fit-test, b'A kbira fil-bidu.
messages.zh: 照文本里的样子抄写，开头的 A 要大写。
messages.en: Copy it as it appears in the text, with a capital A at the beginning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Armunjaka 写在一张“名称卡”上，连同大写 A 一起记忆；当前只练辨认和拼写，不给它补造中文含义或词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pleasant smell, especially one that is noticeable and distinctive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 令人愉悦、可以辨认的香味或芳香。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Riħa pjaċevoli li tinħass u li tista' tkun karatteristika ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 香气，尤指食物、饮品等散发出的可辨认的香味。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Riħa pjaċevoli u karatteristika li toħroġ minn xi ħaġa, bħal ikel jew xorb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An aroma is a pleasant, distinctive smell that comes from something such as food or drink.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芳香；令人愉悦的香味。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Riħa tfuħ u pjaċevoli li tista' tinħass fl-arja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fragrance is a pleasant smell that you notice when something gives off a scent.

formal.mt: L-aroma tal-kafè frisk imliet il-kamra waqt li l-mistednin kienu qed jistennew.
formal.en: The aroma of fresh coffee filled the room while the guests were waiting.
formal.zh: 客人们等候时，新鲜咖啡的香气弥漫了整个房间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi aroma tajba! Għamilt il-kafè? Daniel: Iva, għadni kemm għamiltu. Trid kikkra?
colloquial.en: Sara: What a lovely aroma! Have you made coffee? Daniel: Yes, I have just made it. Would you like a cup?
colloquial.zh: Sara：好香啊！你煮咖啡了吗？Daniel：是啊，刚煮好。你要来一杯吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 好香啊！你煮咖啡了吗？
messages.en: What a lovely aroma! Have you made coffee?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni kemm għamiltu. Trid kikkra?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni kemm għamiltu. Trid kikkra?
messages.zh: 是啊，刚煮好。你要来一杯吗？
messages.en: Yes, I have just made it. Would you like a cup?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象端起咖啡先闻香气，再说 l-aroma tal-kafè；把 aroma 与“鼻子闻到的香”绑定，帮助记住它是表示香气的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plan or agreement about how something will be organized or carried out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 关于某件事如何组织、进行或落实而作出的安排或约定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjan jew ftehim dwar kif xi ħaġa se tiġi organizzata jew titwettaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安排；为组织或处理某事而制定的计划或达成的约定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjan jew ftehim li jistabbilixxi kif għandha tiġi organizzata jew titwettaq xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An arrangement is a plan or agreement that sets out how something will happen or be done.

formal.mt: Skont l-arranġament il-ġdid, il-laqgħa se ssir kull nhar ta' Tnejn fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: Under the new arrangement, the meeting will take place every Monday at nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 根据新的安排，会议将在每周一上午九点举行。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadna bl-istess arranġament għal għada? Mark: Iva, niġi għalik fit-tmienja u mmorru flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are we still keeping the same arrangement for tomorrow? Mark: Yes, I will pick you up at eight, and we will go together.
colloquial.zh: Nina：明天还是按原来的安排吗？Mark：是的，我八点来接你，我们一起去。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 明天还是按原来的安排吗？
messages.en: Are we still keeping the same arrangement for tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niġi għalik fit-tmienja u mmorru flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niġi għalik fit-tmienja u mmorru flimkien.
messages.zh: 是的，我八点来接你，我们一起去。
messages.en: Yes, I will pick you up at eight, and we will go together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arranġament 想成日历里已经商定的一项安排：谁来接、几点见、怎样去都写清楚；用“明天的安排”这个场景帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tariff arrangement that applies equally to all countries concerned, without favouring a particular country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对所有相关国家同等适用、不给予某个国家特别优惠的关税安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament dwar id-dazji doganali li japplika bl-istess mod għall-pajjiżi kollha kkonċernati, mingħajr preferenza għal pajjiż partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对所有相关国家普遍适用的关税安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġamenti dwar id-dazji doganali li japplikaw għall-pajjiżi kollha kkonċernati, mingħajr ma jagħtu preferenza lil pajjiż partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tariff arrangements erga omnes apply generally to all countries concerned, without granting a preference to a particular country.

collocations.en: apply a tariff arrangement equally to all countries concerned
collocations.zh: 实施对所有相关国家同等适用的关税安排

collocations.mt: l-ambitu ta' arranġament tariffarju erga omnes
collocations.en: the scope of a tariff arrangement applicable to all countries concerned
collocations.zh: 普遍适用关税安排的适用范围

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega l-ambitu tal-arranġament tariffarju erga omnes u jelenka l-prodotti koperti minnu.
formal.en: The report explains the scope of the tariff arrangement applicable to all countries concerned and lists the products it covers.
formal.zh: 报告说明了这项普遍适用关税安排的范围，并列出了所涵盖的产品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-arranġament tariffarju erga omnes jagħti vantaġġ lil pajjiż wieħed? Mark: Le, japplika bl-istess mod għall-pajjiżi kollha kkonċernati.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this erga omnes tariff arrangement give one country an advantage? Mark: No, it applies equally to all the countries concerned.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这项普遍适用的关税安排会让某一个国家获得优惠吗？Mark：不会，它对所有相关国家同等适用。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-arranġament tariffarju erga omnes jagħti vantaġġ lil pajjiż wieħed?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-arranġament tariffarju erga omnes jagħti vantaġġ lil pajjiż wieħed?
messages.zh: 这项普遍适用的关税安排会让某一个国家获得优惠吗？
messages.en: Does this erga omnes tariff arrangement give one country an advantage?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, japplika bl-istess mod għall-pajjiżi kollha kkonċernati.
messages.mt_standard: Le, japplika bl-istess mod għall-pajjiżi kollha kkonċernati.
messages.zh: 不会，它对所有相关国家同等适用。
messages.en: No, it applies equally to all the countries concerned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成一张关税表：所有相关国家都查同一张表，用“安排—关税—普遍适用”三个意义块帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who has been taken into custody by the police or another competent authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容已被警方或其他有权机关逮捕、拘捕的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ittieħed fil-kustodja tal-pulizija jew ta' awtorità kompetenti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被警方或其他有权机关逮捕的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie mċaħħad mil-libertà u ttieħed fil-kustodja tal-pulizija jew ta' awtorità kompetenti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is arrested has been taken into custody by the police or another competent authority.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika lir-raġel arrestat u jindika l-ħin tal-arrest.
formal.en: The report identifies the arrested man and states the time of the arrest.
formal.zh: 报告注明了被捕男子的身份及逮捕时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-raġel li semmew fl-aħbarijiet huwa arrestat? Mark: Iva, bħalissa jinsab fil-kustodja tal-pulizija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the man they mentioned in the news been arrested? Mark: Yes, he is currently in police custody.
colloquial.zh: Maja：新闻里提到的那个男子已经被捕了吗？Mark：是的，他目前由警方拘押。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-raġel li semmew fl-aħbarijiet huwa arrestat?
messages.mt_standard: Ir-raġel li semmew fl-aħbarijiet huwa arrestat?
messages.zh: 新闻里提到的那个男子已经被捕了吗？
messages.en: Has the man they mentioned in the news been arrested?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他目前由警方拘押。
messages.en: Yes, he is currently in police custody.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 arrested 作拼写联想，再把 arrestat 放进 raġel arrestat“被捕男子”中记忆，重点记住它描述已经被捕的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An attitude of excessive superiority, or disrespectful boldness shown in speech or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自视高人一等的傲慢态度，也可指言语或行为中不尊重他人的放肆、无礼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attitudni ta' min iqis lilu nnifsu aħjar mill-oħrajn, jew nuqqas ta' rispett li jidher fil-kliem jew fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自视优越、轻视他人的傲慢态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attitudni ta' min iqis lilu nnifsu aktar importanti jew aħjar mill-oħrajn u jħares lejhom minn fuq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Arrogance is an attitude in which someone considers themselves better or more important than other people.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 言语或行为中冒犯他人、缺乏应有尊重的无礼或放肆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' rispett li jidher meta persuna titkellem jew iġġib ruħha b'mod insolenti lejn ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Impertinence is rude or overly bold behaviour that shows a lack of respect for another person.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat talab li d-diskussjoni ssir b'rispett, mingħajr arroganza jew insulti.
formal.en: The committee asked for the discussion to be conducted respectfully, without arrogance or insults.
formal.zh: 委员会要求以尊重他人的方式进行讨论，避免傲慢态度或侮辱性言语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma għoġobnix kif weġibni; tkellem b'arroganza. Mark: Lanqas lili. Seta' qal l-istess ħaġa b'aktar rispett.
colloquial.en: Maja: I didn't like the way he answered me; he spoke arrogantly. Mark: Neither did I. He could have said the same thing more respectfully.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我不喜欢他回答我的方式，语气太傲慢了。Mark：我也不喜欢。同样的话，他完全可以说得更尊重人一些。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma għoġobnix kif weġibni; tkellem b'arroganza.
messages.mt_standard: Ma għoġobnix kif weġibni; tkellem b'arroganza.
messages.zh: 我不喜欢他回答我的方式，语气太傲慢了。
messages.en: I didn't like the way he answered me; he spoke arrogantly.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Lanqas lili. Seta' qal l-istess ħaġa b'aktar rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Lanqas lili. Seta' qal l-istess ħaġa b'aktar rispett.
messages.zh: 我也不喜欢。同样的话，他完全可以说得更尊重人一些。
messages.en: Neither did I. He could have said the same thing more respectfully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人抬着下巴说话：看不起别人是“傲慢”，回答时冒犯别人是“无礼”。用这两个场景区分 arroganza 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Creative activity that uses skill and imagination to express ideas, feelings, or beauty, and the works produced through it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 运用技巧和想象力表达思想、情感或美的创造性活动，以及由此产生的作品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività kreattiva li tuża l-ħila u l-immaġinazzjoni biex tesprimi ideat, sentimenti jew sbuħija, kif ukoll ix-xogħlijiet li jinħolqu permezz tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过绘画、雕塑等形式，运用技巧和想象力进行表达的艺术活动及其作品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attività li fiha persuna tuża l-ħila u l-immaġinazzjoni biex toħloq xogħlijiet, bħal pitturi jew skulturi, li jesprimu ideat, sentimenti jew sbuħija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Art consists of creative activities and works through which people use skill and imagination to express ideas, feelings, or beauty.

formal.mt: Il-mużew organizza wirja tal-arti biex juri kif l-artisti jesprimu l-esperjenzi tagħhom permezz tal-kulur u l-forma.
formal.en: The museum organised an art exhibition to show how artists express their experiences through colour and form.
formal.zh: 博物馆举办了一场艺术展览，展示艺术家如何通过色彩和形式表达自身经历。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi miegħi għal wirja tal-arti nhar is-Sibt? Mark: Iva, niġi! Inħobb nara kif l-artisti jużaw il-kuluri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to come to an art exhibition with me on Saturday? Mark: Yes, I'll come! I love seeing how artists use colours.
colloquial.zh: Maja：星期六想和我一起去看艺术展吗？Mark：好啊，我去！我喜欢看艺术家怎样运用色彩。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi miegħi għal wirja tal-arti nhar is-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi miegħi għal wirja tal-arti nhar is-Sibt?
messages.zh: 星期六想和我一起去看艺术展吗？
messages.en: Would you like to come to an art exhibition with me on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niġi! Inħobb nara kif l-artisti jużaw il-kuluri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niġi! Inħobb nara kif l-artisti jużaw il-kuluri.
messages.zh: 好啊，我去！我喜欢看艺术家怎样运用色彩。
messages.en: Yes, I'll come! I love seeing how artists use colours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arti 与英语 art 放在一起作拼写联想，再想象走进 wirja tal-arti“艺术展”，看到一件 xogħol tal-arti“艺术作品”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made or produced by people rather than occurring naturally.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由人制造或通过人工方式产生的，而非天然形成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħmul jew prodott mill-bniedem minflok ma jseħħ fin-natura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人工制造或产生的；非天然的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun magħmul jew prodott mill-bniedem u ma jkunx naturali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is artificial is made or produced by people rather than occurring naturally.

formal.mt: Il-kamra għandha twieqi żgħar, għalhekk jintuża dawl artifiċjali matul il-ġurnata.
formal.en: The room has small windows, so artificial light is used during the day.
formal.zh: 房间的窗户很小，因此白天也使用人造光照明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħaxix veru? Mark: Le, huwa artifiċjali, għalhekk m'għandux bżonn ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this grass real? Mark: No, it is artificial, so it does not need water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是真草吗？马克：不是，是人造的，所以不用浇水。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是真草吗？
messages.en: Is this grass real?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa artifiċjali, għalhekk m'għandux bżonn ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa artifiċjali, għalhekk m'għandux bżonn ilma.
messages.zh: 不是，是人造的，所以不用浇水。
messages.en: No, it is artificial, so it does not need water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 artifiċjali 和不用浇水的人造草坪联系起来：外观看着像天然草，实际由人工制造。

gloss_zh: 文章；冠词；定冠词或不定冠词

teaching_sense.en_definition: A written text in a publication, or a grammatical word that helps specify a noun phrase.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刊物等出版物中的一篇文章；也指语法中用于限定名词短语的冠词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kitba f'gazzetta, rivista jew pubblikazzjoni oħra; fil-grammatika, kelma li tgħin tispeċifika frażi nominali.

sense_translations.en_definition: article (piece of written text in a periodical or other publication)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 报纸、期刊或其他出版物中刊载的一篇文章。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kitba dwar suġġett partikolari li tidher f'gazzetta, rivista jew pubblikazzjoni oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An article is a piece of writing about a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or other publication.

sense_translations.en_definition: in grammar, a part of speech usually specifying nominal phrases
sense_translations.zh_definition: 冠词：一种通常用于限定名词短语的词类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fil-grammatika, parti mid-diskors li normalment tispeċifika frażi nominali u tgħin turi kif għandha tinftiehem ir-referenza tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In grammar, an article is a word belonging to a class that helps specify the reference of a noun phrase.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 定冠词或不定冠词，分别用于标示所指对象的确定性或不确定性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma grammatikali li tista' tkun definita jew indefinita u turi jekk ir-referenza ta' frażi nominali hijiex speċifika jew mhux speċifika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A definite or indefinite article helps indicate whether a noun refers to something identifiable or something unspecified.

formal.mt: L-artiklu jispjega d-differenza bejn l-artiklu definit u l-artiklu indefinit fl-Ingliż.
formal.en: The article explains the difference between the definite article and the indefinite article in English.
formal.zh: 这篇文章解释了英语中定冠词与不定冠词之间的区别。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qrajt l-artiklu li bgħattlek? Ben: Iva, issa nifhem aħjar meta nuża l-artiklu definit fl-Ingliż.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you read the article I sent you? Ben: Yes, now I understand better when to use the definite article in English.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你读了我发给你的那篇文章吗？本：读了，我现在更明白什么时候该用英语的定冠词了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你读了我发给你的那篇文章吗？
messages.en: Did you read the article I sent you?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa nifhem aħjar meta nuża l-artiklu definit fl-Ingliż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa nifhem aħjar meta nuża l-artiklu definit fl-Ingliż.
messages.zh: 读了，我现在更明白什么时候该用英语的定冠词了。
messages.en: Yes, now I understand better when to use the definite article in English.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读一篇讲冠词的文章：整篇文章是 artiklu，文中讨论的冠词也叫 artiklu，用同一场景记住两个领域的意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The production of speech sounds through movements of the mouth and other speech organs; also, a joint where bones meet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过口腔等发音器官的运动形成语音；也指骨与骨相接的关节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-produzzjoni tal-ħsejjes tad-diskors permezz tal-movimenti tal-organi tat-taħdit; il-kelma tfisser ukoll ġog fejn jiltaqgħu l-għadam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发音，即通过发音器官的协调运动形成语音的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jiġu ffurmati l-ħsejjes tad-diskors permezz tal-movimenti tal-organi tat-taħdit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Articulation is the process of forming speech sounds by moving the organs used in speaking.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肢体的关节，即骨与骨相接的部位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġog f'driegħ jew f'riġel fejn jiltaqgħu żewġ għadam jew aktar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An articulation is a joint where bones meet in an arm or a leg.

formal.mt: Waqt il-qari b'leħen għoli, artikolazzjoni ċara tgħin lis-semmiegħa jifhmu kull kelma.
formal.en: When reading aloud, clear articulation helps listeners understand every word.
formal.zh: 朗读时，清晰的发音有助于听众听懂每一个词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'artikolazzjoni' f'din l-istampa tal-irkoppa? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser il-ġog, fejn jiltaqgħu l-għadam.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'artikolazzjoni' mean in this picture of the knee? Pawlu: Here it means the joint, where the bones meet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张膝盖图片里的'artikolazzjoni'是什么意思？保罗：这里指关节，也就是骨头相接的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这张膝盖图片里的'artikolazzjoni'是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'artikolazzjoni' mean in this picture of the knee?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser il-ġog, fejn jiltaqgħu l-għadam.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser il-ġog, fejn jiltaqgħu l-għadam.
messages.zh: 这里指关节，也就是骨头相接的地方。
messages.en: Here it means the joint, where the bones meet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记忆：嘴巴清楚发音、膝盖关节弯曲；前者对应语音语境，后者对应身体语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A numbered provision in a law that states a particular rule or requirement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 法律中通常带有编号、规定某项规则或要求的条文。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dispożizzjoni f'liġi, normalment identifikata b'numru, li tistabbilixxi regola jew rekwiżit partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法律的一条条文，通常以编号标明并规定具体事项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Parti minn liġi, normalment identifikata b'numru, li fiha dispożizzjoni dwar suġġett partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An article of law is a numbered provision that sets out a particular legal rule or requirement.

formal.mt: Għall-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jaqraw l-artikolu tal-liġi u jispjegaw ir-regola fi kliemhom.
formal.en: For the exercise, students should read the article of law and explain the rule in their own words.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生应阅读该法律条文，并用自己的话解释其中的规定。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema artikolu rridu naqraw għal għada? Mark: L-artikolu numru ħamsa; l-għalliem immarkah fuq il-kopja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which article do we need to read for tomorrow? Mark: Article five; the teacher marked it on the copy.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们明天要读哪一条法条？马克：第五条，老师在复印件上标出来了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema artikolu rridu naqraw għal għada?
messages.mt_standard: Liema artikolu rridu naqraw għal għada?
messages.zh: 我们明天要读哪一条法条？
messages.en: Which article do we need to read for tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-artikolu numru ħamsa; l-għalliem immarkah fuq il-kopja.
messages.mt_standard: L-artikolu numru ħamsa; l-għalliem immarkah fuq il-kopja.
messages.zh: 第五条，老师在复印件上标出来了。
messages.en: Article five; the teacher marked it on the copy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把artikolu写在一张标着“第五条”的法律学习卡上，连同tal-liġi一起记，建立法条编号的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who creates works of art, such as paintings, drawings, or sculptures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 创作绘画、素描或雕塑等艺术作品的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li toħloq xogħlijiet tal-arti, bħal pitturi, tpinġijiet jew skulturi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 艺术家，即从事艺术创作的人，例如画家或雕塑家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem fil-qasam tal-arti u toħloq xogħlijiet bħal pitturi jew skulturi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An artist is someone who creates works of art, such as paintings, drawings, or sculptures.

formal.mt: Il-mużew qed juri xogħlijiet ta' artist lokali li juża l-kulur biex jesprimi l-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The museum is displaying works by a local artist who uses colour to express everyday life.
formal.zh: 博物馆正在展出一位当地艺术家的作品，他运用色彩表现日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min għamel din il-pittura? David: Artist lokali li ltqajt miegħu fil-wirja. Lara: Jogħġbuni ħafna l-kuluri li uża.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who made this painting? David: A local artist I met at the exhibition. Lara: I really like the colours he used.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这幅画是谁画的？戴维：一位当地艺术家，我在展览上认识他的。拉拉：我很喜欢他用的这些颜色。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这幅画是谁画的？
messages.en: Who made this painting?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Artist lokali li ltqajt miegħu fil-wirja.
messages.mt_standard: Artist lokali li ltqajt miegħu fil-wirja.
messages.zh: 一位当地艺术家，我在展览上认识他的。
messages.en: A local artist I met at the exhibition.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我很喜欢他用的这些颜色。
messages.en: I really like the colours he used.

cognitive_memory_aid: artist与英语artist拼写相同，可用熟悉的英语词作记忆桥梁，再配上“当地艺术家”的展览画面练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who creates artistic works, for example through painting, drawing, or sculpture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过绘画、素描或雕塑等方式创作艺术作品的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li toħloq xogħlijiet artistiċi permezz tal-pittura, it-tpinġija, l-iskultura jew forom oħra tal-arti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 艺术家，即运用艺术技巧和想象力创作作品的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tuża l-ħila u l-immaġinazzjoni tagħha biex toħloq xogħlijiet tal-arti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An artist is a person who uses artistic skill and imagination to create works of art.

formal.mt: L-artista ppreżentat sensiela ta' pitturi li jesploraw ir-relazzjoni bejn il-bniedem u n-natura.
formal.en: The artist presented a series of paintings exploring the relationship between people and nature.
formal.zh: 这位艺术家展出了一组探索人与自然关系的绘画作品。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'tagħmel oħtok? Marija: Hija artista; tpinġi pajsaġġi u taħdem fl-istudjo tagħha. Nina: Nixtieq nara xi xogħol tagħha.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does your sister do? Marija: She is an artist; she paints landscapes and works in her studio. Nina: I would like to see some of her work.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你姐姐是做什么的？玛丽娅：她是艺术家，画风景画，在自己的工作室里创作。妮娜：我想看看她的作品。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你姐姐是做什么的？
messages.en: What does your sister do?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija artista; tpinġi pajsaġġi u taħdem fl-istudjo tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Hija artista; tpinġi pajsaġġi u taħdem fl-istudjo tagħha.
messages.zh: 她是艺术家，画风景画，在自己的工作室里创作。
messages.en: She is an artist; she paints landscapes and works in her studio.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想看看她的作品。
messages.en: I would like to see some of her work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把artista连同例句Hija artista一起记，想象她在工作室画风景；抄写时留意词尾的a。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to art or showing skill and creativity in making art.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与艺术有关的，或体现艺术技巧和创造力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-arti jew li juri ħila u kreattività fl-arti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与艺术有关的；具有艺术性或艺术表现力的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-arti jew li juri kwalitajiet ta' kreattività u espressjoni fl-arti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something artistic is connected with art or shows creative skill and imagination.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-valur artistiku tal-pitturi esebiti fil-mużew.
formal.en: The report highlights the artistic value of the paintings exhibited in the museum.
formal.zh: 报告强调了博物馆所展出画作的艺术价值。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-tpinġija tiegħek? Leo: Iva, għamiltha lbieraħ. Maja: Għandek talent artistiku!
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this your drawing? Leo: Yes, I made it yesterday. Maja: You have artistic talent!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是你画的吗？利奥：对，我昨天画的。玛雅：你有艺术天赋！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是你画的吗？
messages.en: Is this your drawing?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，我昨天画的。
messages.en: Yes, I made it yesterday.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有艺术天赋！
messages.en: You have artistic talent!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 artistiku 和画展、绘画天赋连在一起记；看到 talent artistiku，就想到“艺术天赋”。

gloss_zh: 手工艺；手工艺品；工艺水平

teaching_sense.en_definition: The making of objects by hand, the objects produced, or the skill shown in making them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以手工制作物品的技艺或活动，也指制成的手工艺品及制作中体现的工艺水平。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol ta' oġġetti magħmulin bl-idejn, l-oġġetti prodotti, jew il-ħila li tidher fil-mod kif isiru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以手工制作物品的工艺活动，或由此制成的手工艺品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attivitajiet li fihom isiru oġġetti bl-idejn, jew l-oġġetti li jinħolqu b'dan ix-xogħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Handicrafts are objects made by hand using practical skills, or the activities involved in making them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作物品时体现出的熟练技艺、精细程度和工艺水平。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħila, il-preċiżjoni u l-kwalità li jidhru fil-mod kif ikun magħmul oġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Craftsmanship is the skill and care that someone shows when making an object.

formal.mt: Il-wirja tal-artiġjanat tinkludi xogħlijiet fl-injam li juru ħila u preċiżjoni kbira.
formal.en: The handicraft exhibition includes wooden works that demonstrate great skill and precision.
formal.zh: 这场手工艺展包括一些木制作品，展示了高超的技艺和精细的制作水平。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tiġi miegħi għall-fiera tal-artiġjanat? Pawlu: Iva, irrid nara l-oġġetti magħmulin bl-idejn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Will you come with me to the craft fair? Pawlu: Yes, I want to see the handmade objects.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你和我一起去手工艺品集市吗？保罗：好啊，我想看看那些手工制作的物品。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你和我一起去手工艺品集市吗？
messages.en: Will you come with me to the craft fair?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irrid nara l-oġġetti magħmulin bl-idejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irrid nara l-oġġetti magħmulin bl-idejn.
messages.zh: 好啊，我想看看那些手工制作的物品。
messages.en: Yes, I want to see the handmade objects.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在手工艺集市上拿起一件木雕：作品本身帮助记住“手工艺品”，精细的雕刻帮助记住“工艺水平”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: People who make objects by hand using skilled practical work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 凭借熟练的手工技艺制作物品的人；本词形表示复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuni li jagħmlu oġġetti bl-idejn b'ħila u sengħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凭借专门手艺制作物品的工匠、手工艺人；此处词形为复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuni tas-sengħa li jużaw idejhom u l-ħila tagħhom biex jagħmlu oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Artisans or craftsmen are people who make objects by hand using specialized practical skills.

formal.mt: L-artiġjani lokali se juru kif jagħmlu oġġetti tal-injam waqt il-wirja.
formal.en: The local artisans will demonstrate how they make wooden objects during the exhibition.
formal.zh: 当地工匠将在展览期间演示如何制作木制物品。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min għamel dawn il-bwieqi? Toni: Għamluhom artiġjani lokali. Kull waħda hija magħmula bl-idejn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who made these bowls? Toni: Local artisans made them. Each one is handmade.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这些碗是谁做的？托尼：当地的工匠做的。每一只都是手工制作的。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 这些碗是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made these bowls?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamluhom artiġjani lokali. Kull waħda hija magħmula bl-idejn.
messages.mt_standard: Għamluhom artiġjani lokali. Kull waħda hija magħmula bl-idejn.
messages.zh: 当地的工匠做的。每一只都是手工制作的。
messages.en: Local artisans made them. Each one is handmade.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 artiġjani 配上一群正在做木碗的人来记：它指制作物品的“工匠们”；再用 artiġjanat 联系他们的手工艺。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition involving inflammation of the joints, often causing pain and stiffness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 关节发生炎症的病症，常伴有关节疼痛和僵硬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li tinvolvi infjammazzjoni fil-ġogi u li spiss tikkawża uġigħ u ebusija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关节炎，指涉及关节炎症、常引起疼痛和僵硬的病症。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha jkun hemm infjammazzjoni fil-ġogi, ħafna drabi b'uġigħ u ebusija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Arthritis is a condition in which joints become inflamed and may feel painful or stiff.

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jispjega li l-artrite tista' tikkawża uġigħ u ebusija fil-ġogi.
formal.en: The leaflet explains that arthritis can cause pain and stiffness in the joints.
formal.zh: 宣传册说明，关节炎可能引起关节疼痛和僵硬。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tiftaħ il-vażett bil-mod? Nina: Għandi l-artrite u llum idejja juġgħuni. Sara: Tridni niftħu jien?
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you opening the jar so slowly? Nina: I have arthritis, and my hands hurt today. Sara: Would you like me to open it?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么开罐子开得这么慢？妮娜：我有关节炎，今天手疼。萨拉：要我帮你打开吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么开罐子开得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you opening the jar so slowly?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi l-artrite u llum idejja juġgħuni.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi l-artrite u llum idejja juġgħuni.
messages.zh: 我有关节炎，今天手疼。
messages.en: I have arthritis, and my hands hurt today.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 要我帮你打开吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to open it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 artrite 时，想象手指关节僵硬、拧罐盖困难的画面，把词义牢牢对应到“关节炎”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A water-dwelling mollusc with a shell consisting of two joined halves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蛤蜊，一种生活在水中、具有两片相连外壳的软体动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mollusk li jgħix fl-ilma u għandu qoxra magħmula minn żewġ nofsijiet magħqudin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蛤蜊，一种具有两片可开合外壳的水生软体动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal mollusk li jgħix fl-ilma u għandu żewġ nofsijiet ta' qoxra li jistgħu jinfetħu u jingħalqu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A clam is a mollusc that lives in water and has a shell with two hinged halves.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-qoxra ta' arzella u nnutaw iż-żewġ nofsijiet magħqudin tagħha.
formal.en: The students observed a clam shell and noted its two joined halves.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一个蛤蜊壳，并注意到它由相连的两片壳组成。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara din il-qoxra! Ta' arzella? Pawlu: Iva, ara ż-żewġ nofsijiet tagħha. Lara: Ħa nieħu ritratt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at this shell! Is it from a clam? Pawlu: Yes, look at its two halves. Lara: Let me take a photo.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看这个贝壳！是蛤蜊壳吗？保罗：对，看看它的两片壳。拉拉：我拍张照片。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 看这个贝壳！是蛤蜊壳吗？
messages.en: Look at this shell! Is it from a clam?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 对，看看它的两片壳。
messages.en: Yes, look at its two halves.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 我拍张照片。
messages.en: Let me take a photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arzella 想成沙地里露出的蛤蜊，两片壳像小盒子一样开合；配合 qoxra“壳”一起记。

gloss_zh: 亚洲的；来自亚洲的；与亚洲有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming from Asia or connected with Asia, its people, or its cultures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自亚洲的，或与亚洲及其居民、文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Asja jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Asja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kulturi tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亚洲的；与亚洲、亚洲居民或亚洲文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-Asja, l-abitanti tagħha jew il-kulturi tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something Asian is connected with Asia, its people, or its cultures.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or related to Asia
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自亚洲的，或在来源、地域或其他方面与亚洲有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu l-oriġini tiegħu fl-Asja jew xi rabta ma' dan il-kontinent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or thing described as Asian comes from Asia or has a connection with that continent.

formal.mt: Għall-proġett tal-ġeografija, kull student għażel pajjiż asjatiku u ddeskriva l-pożizzjoni tiegħu fuq il-mappa.
formal.en: For the geography project, each student chose an Asian country and described its position on the map.
formal.zh: 在地理课项目中，每名学生选择了一个亚洲国家，并描述了它在地图上的位置。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid tiekol ikel asjatiku llejla? Anna: Iva, hemm restorant Ġappuniż ħdejn id-dar. Mark: Tajjeb, immorru hemm.
colloquial.en: Mark: Would you like to have Asian food tonight? Anna: Yes, there is a Japanese restaurant near the house. Mark: Great, let's go there.
colloquial.zh: 马克：今晚想吃亚洲菜吗？安娜：想，家附近有一家日本餐厅。马克：好，我们去那里。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚想吃亚洲菜吗？
messages.en: Would you like to have Asian food tonight?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm restorant Ġappuniż ħdejn id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm restorant Ġappuniż ħdejn id-dar.
messages.zh: 想，家附近有一家日本餐厅。
messages.en: Yes, there is a Japanese restaurant near the house.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我们去那里。
messages.en: Great, let's go there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 asjatiku 贴在亚洲地图旁，连读 pajjiż asjatiku“亚洲国家”和 ikel asjatiku“亚洲食物”，记住地域关联。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular part or feature of something, or a particular way of considering it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物的一个方面或特征，也可指考虑某事物的特定视角。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aspett huwa parti jew karatteristika ta' xi ħaġa, jew mod partikolari kif wieħed iħares lejha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 方面；讨论或分析某事物时所关注的一个部分或特征。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Aspett huwa parti jew karatteristika partikolari ta' suġġett, sitwazzjoni jew ħaġa li wieħed jista' jikkunsidra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An aspect of something is a particular part or feature that you consider.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 侧面；复杂事物所具有的多个不同特征或表现之一。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Aspett huwa waħda mill-karatteristiċi jew mill-manifestazzjonijiet differenti ta' xi ħaġa kumplessa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A facet of something is one of the different features that together make it complex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 视角；从某一立场或角度理解、审视事物的方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Aspett huwa l-angolu jew il-mod li minnu wieħed jara, jifhem jew jikkunsidra xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A perspective is a particular way of looking at and understanding a situation.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-aspett finanzjarju tal-proġett u l-effett tiegħu fuq il-komunità.
formal.en: The report examines the financial aspect of the project and its effect on the community.
formal.zh: 报告考察了该项目的财务方面及其对社区的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'taħseb dwar dan il-pjan? Pawlu: Jogħġobni, imma hemm aspett wieħed li għadni ma fhimtx. Maja: Liema aspett? Pawlu: Kemm se jiswa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you think of this plan? Pawlu: I like it, but there is one aspect I still haven't understood. Maja: Which aspect? Pawlu: How much it will cost.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得这个计划怎么样？保罗：我挺喜欢，但有一个方面我还没弄明白。玛雅：哪个方面？保罗：它要花多少钱。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得这个计划怎么样？
messages.en: What do you think of this plan?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jogħġobni, imma hemm aspett wieħed li għadni ma fhimtx.
messages.mt_standard: Jogħġobni, imma hemm aspett wieħed li għadni ma fhimtx.
messages.zh: 我挺喜欢，但有一个方面我还没弄明白。
messages.en: I like it, but there is one aspect I still haven't understood.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 哪个方面？
messages.en: Which aspect?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 它要花多少钱。
messages.en: How much it will cost.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一个项目想成多面体：成本是一个方面，影响是另一个侧面，换个观察角度又是一个视角；这三种联系帮助记住 aspett。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A medicine used to relieve pain and reduce fever.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 阿司匹林，一种可用于缓解疼痛和降低发热的药物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-aspirina hija mediċina li tintuża biex ittaffi l-uġigħ u tnaqqas id-deni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阿司匹林；一种可用于镇痛、退热的药物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-aspirina hija mediċina li tista' tintuża biex ittaffi l-uġigħ u tnaqqas id-deni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Aspirin is a medicine that people use to relieve pain and reduce fever.

formal.mt: L-ispiżjar spjega lill-klijent kif għandu jaqra l-informazzjoni fuq il-pakkett tal-aspirina.
formal.en: The pharmacist explained to the customer how to read the information on the aspirin packet.
formal.zh: 药剂师向顾客解释了如何阅读阿司匹林包装上的信息。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan huwa l-pakkett tal-aspirina? Rita: Iva, dak hu. Mark: Tista' tispjegali x'hemm miktub fuqu? Rita: Żgur, naqrawh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this the aspirin packet? Rita: Yes, that's it. Mark: Can you explain what's written on it? Rita: Of course, let's read it together.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这是阿司匹林的包装吗？丽塔：对，就是这个。马克：你能解释一下上面写的内容吗？丽塔：当然，我们一起看。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这是阿司匹林的包装吗？
messages.en: Is this the aspirin packet?

messages.speaker: Rita (药剂师)
messages.zh: 对，就是这个。
messages.en: Yes, that's it.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你能解释一下上面写的内容吗？
messages.en: Can you explain what's written on it?

messages.speaker: Rita (药剂师)
messages.zh: 当然，我们一起看。
messages.en: Of course, let's read it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 aspirina 与英语 aspirin 和中文“阿司匹林”并排记忆，再想象药盒里的一片药，巩固它作为药物名词的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The deliberate killing of a prominent person, often for political reasons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对知名或重要人物实施的蓄意杀害，常出于政治动机。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Assassinazzjoni hija l-qtil intenzjonat ta' persuna magħrufa jew importanti, spiss għal raġunijiet politiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暗杀；通常出于政治等动机，蓄意杀害知名或重要人物的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Assassinazzjoni hija att ta' qtil intenzjonat ta' persuna magħrufa jew importanti, ħafna drabi minħabba raġunijiet politiċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An assassination is the deliberate killing of a prominent person, often for political reasons.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-assassinazzjoni tal-ministru twassal għal investigazzjoni li tikxef kunflitti politiċi.
formal.en: In the novel, the minister's assassination leads to an investigation that uncovers political conflicts.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，部长遭暗杀引发了一项调查，揭露了政治冲突。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara fil-kapitlu li qrajt? Toni: Kien hemm tentattiv ta' assassinazzjoni. Lara: Il-ministru baqa' ħaj? Toni: Iva, u issa l-pulizija qed tinvestiga.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened in the chapter you read? Toni: There was an assassination attempt. Lara: Did the minister survive? Toni: Yes, and now the police are investigating.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你读的那一章发生了什么？托尼：有人企图行刺。拉拉：部长活下来了吗？托尼：活下来了，现在警方正在调查。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 你读的那一章发生了什么？
messages.en: What happened in the chapter you read?

messages.speaker: Toni (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 有人企图行刺。
messages.en: There was an assassination attempt.

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 部长活下来了吗？
messages.en: Did the minister survive?

messages.speaker: Toni (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u issa l-pulizija qed tinvestiga.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u issa l-pulizija qed tinvestiga.
messages.zh: 活下来了，现在警方正在调查。
messages.en: Yes, and now the police are investigating.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用小说情节记忆：重要人物遭蓄意杀害是 assassinazzjoni；若只是企图行刺，就加上 tentattiv ta'，同时记住事件与企图的区别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Surrounded by hostile forces trying to capture a place or force its surrender.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被敌对武装包围、面临攻占或被迫投降的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post assedjat ikun imdawwar minn forzi tal-għadu li jippruvaw jaħtfuh jew iġiegħlu lil min jiddefendih iċedi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被围困的；被敌军包围，并受到攻占或迫降威胁的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post assedjat ikun imdawwar minn forzi ostili li jkunu qed jippruvaw jaħtfuh jew iġiegħlu lid-difensuri tiegħu jċedu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A besieged place is surrounded by hostile forces trying to capture it or force its surrender.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-forti assedjat kien għadu jirreżisti, iżda l-ikel kien qed jonqos.
formal.en: In the story, the besieged fort was still resisting, but food was running low.
formal.zh: 在故事中，被围困的堡垒仍在抵抗，但食物已越来越少。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma jistgħux joħorġu mill-forti fil-film? David: Għax il-forti huwa assedjat. Nina: Jiġifieri l-għadu dawru minn kull naħa? David: Iva, u qed jipprova jġiegħel lid-difensuri jċedu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why can't they leave the fort in the film? David: Because the fort is besieged. Nina: So the enemy has surrounded it on all sides? David: Yes, and is trying to force the defenders to surrender.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：电影里的人为什么不能离开堡垒？戴维：因为堡垒被围困了。妮娜：就是说敌人已经从四面包围了它？戴维：对，而且正试图迫使守军投降。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma jistgħux joħorġu mill-forti fil-film?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma jistgħux joħorġu mill-forti fil-film?
messages.zh: 电影里的人为什么不能离开堡垒？
messages.en: Why can't they leave the fort in the film?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为堡垒被围困了。
messages.en: Because the fort is besieged.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri l-għadu dawru minn kull naħa?
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri l-għadu dawru minn kull naħa?
messages.zh: 就是说敌人已经从四面包围了它？
messages.en: So the enemy has surrounded it on all sides?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u qed jipprova jġiegħel lid-difensuri jċedu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u qed jipprova jġiegħel lid-difensuri jċedu.
messages.zh: 对，而且正试图迫使守军投降。
messages.en: Yes, and is trying to force the defenders to surrender.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上的堡垒被敌军画圈包围，再把 assedjat 贴在堡垒旁，记住它描述“被围困的”状态；连读 forti assedjat 加深印象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A military operation in which forces surround a place and restrict access to make its defenders surrender.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 军队包围某个地方并阻断人员或物资进出，以迫使守军投降的军事行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Azzjoni militari li fiha forzi jdawru post u jwaqqfu d-dħul u l-ħruġ biex iġiegħlu lid-difensuri jċedu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 军队为迫使守军投降而对城镇、要塞等实施的包围和封锁。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Operazzjoni militari li fiha belt, fortizza jew post ieħor jinżamm imdawwar u ma jitħallewx jidħlu nies jew provvisti biex id-difensuri jkollhom iċedu.
