sense_translations.zh_definition: 被归于某人或某事物的；被认为出自或由其造成的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meqjus li sar minn persuna partikolari jew li seħħ minħabba kawża partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is attributed to someone or something, that person or thing is regarded as its creator, source, or cause.

collocations.en: attributed to a lack of time

formal.mt: Dan il-manuskritt huwa attribwit lil awtur mhux magħruf.
formal.en: This manuscript is attributed to an unknown author.
formal.zh: 这份手稿被认为出自一位身份不详的作者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kwadru huwa attribwit lil min? Mark: Lil pittur lokali, imma għadna ma nafux żgur.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is this painting attributed to? Mark: A local painter, but we still do not know for sure.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这幅画被认为是谁画的？Mark：一位本地画家，不过我们还不能确定。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kwadru huwa attribwit lil min?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kwadru huwa attribwit lil min?
messages.zh: 这幅画被认为是谁画的？
messages.en: Who is this painting attributed to?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil pittur lokali, imma għadna ma nafux żgur.
messages.mt_standard: Lil pittur lokali, imma għadna ma nafux żgur.
messages.zh: 一位本地画家，不过我们还不能确定。
messages.en: A local painter, but we still do not know for sure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成作品旁的归属标签：看到 attribwit，就问“归于谁，或归因于什么”。

gloss_zh: 使自动化；将流程改为自动运行

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a task or process operate automatically with less direct human intervention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使任务或流程自动执行，从而减少人工直接操作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħmel kompitu jew proċess jaħdem awtomatikament b'inqas intervent dirett mill-bniedem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使任务或流程自动运行，减少对人工直接操作的依赖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tbiddel il-mod kif isir kompitu jew proċess sabiex jitwettaq awtomatikament b'inqas intervent mill-bniedem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you make a process operate automatically, you arrange for its tasks to be performed with less direct human intervention.

collocations.en: an example of the use of 'automation'

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'automation' ifisser li tagħmel proċess jaħdem awtomatikament b'inqas intervent mill-bniedem.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'automation' means to make a process operate automatically with less human intervention.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，“automation”表示使流程自动运行，减少人工干预。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'automation' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Ifisser li tagħmel kompitu jsir awtomatikament, bħal meta s-sistema tibgħat tfakkira waħedha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'automation' mean in this exercise? Mark: It means making a task happen automatically, as when the system sends a reminder by itself.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个练习中的“automation”是什么意思？Mark：就是让任务自动完成，比如让系统自行发送提醒。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个练习中的“automation”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'automation' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li tagħmel kompitu jsir awtomatikament, bħal meta s-sistema tibgħat tfakkira waħedha.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li tagħmel kompitu jsir awtomatikament, bħal meta s-sistema tibgħat tfakkira waħedha.
messages.zh: 就是让任务自动完成，比如让系统自行发送提醒。
messages.en: It means making a task happen automatically, as when the system sends a reminder by itself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本条的动词标签记成“使自动化”：想象设好规则后，系统每天自动发送提醒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move forward or make progress towards a goal or a later stage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向前移动，或朝目标及后续阶段取得进展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li timxi 'l quddiem jew tagħmel progress lejn għan jew stadju aktar 'il quddiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向前行进；在工作、计划或其他活动中取得进展。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li timxi 'l quddiem minn fejn tkun jew tagħmel progress f'xogħol, fi pjan jew f'attività oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something advances, they move forward or make progress towards a goal or a later stage.

formal.mt: Il-proġett avanza għall-fażi li jmiss wara li tlestiet l-ewwel parti.
formal.en: The project advanced to the next stage after the first part was completed.
formal.zh: 第一部分完成后，项目进入了下一阶段。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tim tagħna avanza għall-fażi li jmiss? Mark: Iva! Rebaħ il-logħba tal-bieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did our team advance to the next stage? Mark: Yes! It won yesterday's match.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们队晋级下一阶段了吗？Mark：晋级了！我们队赢了昨天的比赛。

messages.speaker: Maja (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tim tagħna avanza għall-fażi li jmiss?
messages.mt_standard: It-tim tagħna avanza għall-fażi li jmiss?
messages.zh: 我们队晋级下一阶段了吗？
messages.en: Did our team advance to the next stage?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 晋级了！我们队赢了昨天的比赛。
messages.en: Yes! It won yesterday's match.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用向前箭头记住 avanza：人可以向前走，项目可以推进，球队也可以晋级下一阶段。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb whose intended meaning cannot be reliably established from the information provided.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个暂时无法根据现有信息可靠确定具体含义的动词；学习时应保留词形，等待明确释义后再用于表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb li t-tifsira preċiża tiegħu ma tistax tiġi stabbilita b'mod affidabbli mill-informazzjoni mogħtija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义仅写作“english”，不足以确定该动词的中文含义；此义项需要核实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tikketta 'english' waħedha ma tagħtix biżżejjed informazzjoni biex tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira ta' dan il-verb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The label provided does not establish a usable meaning for this verb.

formal.mt: It-tifsira tal-verb 'aviva' trid tiġi kkonfermata qabel ma jintuża f'eżerċizzju ta' traduzzjoni.
formal.en: The meaning of the verb 'aviva' must be confirmed before it is used in a translation exercise.
formal.zh: 在翻译练习中使用动词“aviva”之前，必须先确认其含义。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi jfisser 'aviva'? Pawlu: Għadna rridu nikkonfermaw it-tifsira tiegħu qabel nużawh.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'aviva' mean? Pawlu: We still need to confirm its meaning before using it.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：“aviva”是什么意思？保罗：我们还需要先确认它的含义，再使用它。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: “aviva”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'aviva' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna rridu nikkonfermaw it-tifsira tiegħu qabel nużawh.
messages.mt_standard: Għadna rridu nikkonfermaw it-tifsira tiegħu qabel nużawh.
messages.zh: 我们还需要先确认它的含义，再使用它。
messages.en: We still need to confirm its meaning before using it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 aviva 暂记在“动词待核实”卡片上，先认词形，不把 english 猜成具体动作。

gloss_zh: 标注为“Advanced”、具体义项待核实的名词

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose precise referent remains unclear and requires confirmation before ordinary use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个具体所指尚不明确的名词；现有“Advanced”标签不足以确定它表示的事物或概念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li għadu mhux ċar għal xiex jirreferi u li jeħtieġ tifsira aktar preċiża qabel jintuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: “Advanced”通常可表达“高级的”或“先进的”，但此处词性为名词，尚不能据此确定准确的名词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tikketta 'Advanced' ma tiċċarax għal xiex jirreferi dan in-nom, u għalhekk it-tifsira tiegħu teħtieġ konferma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied label leaves the intended noun meaning unclear and in need of confirmation.

formal.mt: Għall-eżerċizzju, żomm 'avvanzata' bħala nom u kkonferma t-tifsira tiegħu qabel tagħżel traduzzjoni.
formal.en: For the exercise, retain 'avvanzata' as a noun and confirm its meaning before choosing a translation.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，将“avvanzata”保留为名词，并在选择译法之前确认其含义。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif nittraduċi n-nom 'avvanzata'? David: L-ewwel irridu nkunu nafu eżatt għal xiex jirreferi.
colloquial.en: Marta: How do I translate the noun 'avvanzata'? David: First we need to know exactly what it refers to.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：名词“avvanzata”怎么翻译？戴维：我们首先需要弄清楚它具体指什么。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 名词“avvanzata”怎么翻译？
messages.en: How do I translate the noun 'avvanzata'?

messages.speaker: David (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel irridu nkunu nafu eżatt għal xiex jirreferi.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel irridu nkunu nafu eżatt għal xiex jirreferi.
messages.zh: 我们首先需要弄清楚它具体指什么。
messages.en: First we need to know exactly what it refers to.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 avvanzata 放在“名词待核实”栏，提醒自己不能仅凭 Advanced 就直接背成形容词“高级的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that happens, especially an important occurrence or an organized occasion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生的事情，尤其指重要事件，也可指经过组织安排的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tiġri, speċjalment ġrajja importanti jew attività organizzata għal okkażjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事件；也可指有组织、有安排的活动或场合。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġrajja li sseħħ jew attività organizzata li n-nies jieħdu sehem fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An event is something that happens or an organized occasion that people attend.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生的事情；某一具体事件，不一定经过事先安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tiġri f'ħin jew f'post partikolari, anki jekk ma tkunx ippjanata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A happening is an occurrence that takes place, whether it was planned or unexpected.

formal.mt: Il-mużew se jorganizza avveniment kulturali nhar is-Sibt biex jippreżenta l-wirja l-ġdida lill-pubbliku.
formal.en: The museum will organize a cultural event on Saturday to introduce the new exhibition to the public.
formal.zh: 博物馆将于星期六举办文化活动，向公众介绍新展览。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tiġi għall-avveniment fil-mużew is-Sibt? Mark: Iva, niġi. X'ħin jibda?
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you coming to the event at the museum on Saturday? Mark: Yes, I'll come. What time does it start?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你星期六会来参加博物馆的活动吗？马克：会，我来。几点开始？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你星期六会来参加博物馆的活动吗？
messages.en: Are you coming to the event at the museum on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 会，我来。几点开始？
messages.en: Yes, I'll come. What time does it start?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 avveniment 联想成日历上圈出的“一件事”：可以是发生的事件，也可以是安排好的活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The arrival or beginning of something important; in Christian usage, the period of preparation before Christmas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重要事物的到来或开始；在基督宗教语境中，指圣诞节前的准备时期，即将临期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-wasla jew il-bidu ta' xi ħaġa importanti; fil-kuntest Nisrani, iż-żmien ta' tħejjija qabel il-Milied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重要事物的出现、到来或开始；用于基督宗教时，指圣诞节前的将临期。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bidu jew il-wasla ta' xi ħaġa sinifikanti; bħala żmien Nisrani, il-perjodu ta' tħejjija għall-Milied.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The advent of something is its arrival or beginning; Advent also names the Christian period of preparation before Christmas.

formal.mt: Matul żmien l-Avvent, il-parroċċa torganizza laqgħat ta' talb bi tħejjija għall-Milied.
formal.en: During Advent, the parish organizes prayer meetings in preparation for Christmas.
formal.zh: 在将临期，堂区组织祈祷聚会，为圣诞节作准备。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi jfisser l-Avvent? Marija: Huwa ż-żmien ta' tħejjija għall-Milied.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does Advent mean? Marija: It is the period of preparation for Christmas.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：将临期是什么意思？玛丽亚：就是为圣诞节作准备的那段时期。

messages.speaker: Anna (女儿)
messages.zh: 将临期是什么意思？
messages.en: What does Advent mean?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 就是为圣诞节作准备的那段时期。
messages.en: It is the period of preparation for Christmas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“等待重要事物到来”的画面记 avvent；想到圣诞节前的准备，就能联想到宗教义“将临期”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adversary is a person or group that opposes another in a conflict, argument, or competition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在冲突、争论或竞赛中与另一方相对抗的人或团体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew grupp li jkun kontra persuna jew grupp ieħor f'kunflitt, argument jew kompetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在冲突或斗争中与某一方相对抗的敌手。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew grupp li jiġġieled jew jaħdem kontra persuna jew grupp ieħor f'kunflitt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your adversary is someone who actively opposes you in a conflict or struggle.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在比赛、辩论或其他竞争活动中与某人较量的对手。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew grupp li jikkompeti kontra persuna jew grupp ieħor f'logħba, dibattitu jew kompetizzjoni oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your opponent is the person or team you compete against in a contest.

formal.mt: Fid-dibattitu, il-kandidat wieġeb għall-argumenti tal-avversarju tiegħu b'rispett.
formal.en: During the debate, the candidate responded respectfully to his opponent's arguments.
formal.zh: 在辩论中，这名候选人以尊重的态度回应了对手的论点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-avversarju tiegħek illum? Pawlu: Mark. Jilgħab tajjeb ħafna, imma jien lest.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is your opponent today? Pawlu: Mark. He plays very well, but I'm ready.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天的对手是谁？保罗：马克。他打得很好，不过我已经准备好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天的对手是谁？
messages.en: Who is your opponent today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (参赛者)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark. Jilgħab tajjeb ħafna, imma jien lest.
messages.mt_standard: Mark. Jilgħab tajjeb ħafna, imma jien lest.
messages.zh: 马克。他打得很好，不过我已经准备好了。
messages.en: Mark. He plays very well, but I'm ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象比赛场地另一端站着一个人：比赛时是“对手”，发生冲突时是“敌手”，都可用 avversarju 来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To embarrass or humiliate someone is to make them feel ashamed, uncomfortable, or less worthy of respect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过言语或行为使某人感到难堪、羞耻，或觉得自己的尊严受到贬损。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu mistħi, skomdu jew imċekken permezz ta' kliem jew imġiba li jweġġgħu d-dinjità tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人感到尴尬、难堪或不好意思。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu mistħi jew skomdu minħabba xi ħaġa li tgħid jew tagħmel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you embarrass someone, you make them feel awkward or ashamed in a situation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以贬低或侮辱的方式使某人感到受辱、失去尊严。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu mċekken u bla dinjità billi tittrattah b'mod degradanti jew offensiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you humiliate someone, you make them feel deeply ashamed and deprived of dignity.

collocations.en: he humiliated the student in front of the class
collocations.zh: 他当着全班的面羞辱了那名学生

collocations.en: he humiliated others with his words

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, l-impjegata spjegat li l-maniġer avvilixxa lil kollega waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: In her report, the employee explained that the manager had humiliated a colleague during the meeting.
formal.zh: 这名员工在报告中说明，经理在会议期间羞辱了一位同事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark telaq hekk malajr? Pawlu: Xi ħadd avvilixxa lil Mark quddiem kulħadd. Se nċempillu biex nara kif inhu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark leave so quickly? Pawlu: Someone humiliated Mark in front of everyone. I'll call him to see how he is.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么那么快就走了？保罗：有人当着大家的面羞辱了马克。我会打电话问问他怎么样。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么那么快就走了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave so quickly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd avvilixxa lil Mark quddiem kulħadd. Se nċempillu biex nara kif inhu.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd avvilixxa lil Mark quddiem kulħadd. Se nċempillu biex nara kif inhu.
messages.zh: 有人当着大家的面羞辱了马克。我会打电话问问他怎么样。
messages.en: Someone humiliated Mark in front of everyone. I'll call him to see how he is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“当众让人抬不起头”的场景记 avvilixxa：程度较轻是使人难堪，伤及尊严时就是羞辱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To approach someone is to move nearer to them or contact them to discuss something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人靠近，或为商谈某事而与某人接触；avviċinat 可在被动表达中表示“被接近、被接洽”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tersaq lejn xi ħadd jew tagħmel kuntatt miegħu biex titkellem dwar xi ħaġa; il-forma avviċinat tista' tintuża biex tindika li xi ħadd irċieva dan il-kuntatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 走近某人，或主动联系某人以提出问题、请求或建议。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tersaq qrib xi ħadd jew tikkuntattjah biex tagħmillu mistoqsija, talba jew proposta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you approach someone, you move closer to them or contact them about something.

collocations.zh: 有人联系他，希望进行采访

collocations.en: was approached with a job offer
collocations.zh: 有人联系他，提出工作机会

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur ġie avviċinat minn ġurnalist li xtaq jiddiskuti r-riżultati tal-istudju.
formal.en: The researcher was approached by a journalist who wanted to discuss the study's findings.
formal.zh: 一名记者联系了这位研究人员，希望讨论该研究的结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed taħseb li tibdel ix-xogħol? Pawlu: Ġejt avviċinat minn kumpanija oħra. Għadhom kemm offrewli xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you thinking of changing jobs? Pawlu: I was approached by another company. They've just offered me a job.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么在考虑换工作？保罗：另一家公司联系了我。他们刚给了我一个工作机会。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed taħseb li tibdel ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed taħseb li tibdel ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 你为什么在考虑换工作？
messages.en: Why are you thinking of changing jobs?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġejt avviċinat minn kumpanija oħra. Għadhom kemm offrewli xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Ġejt avviċinat minn kumpanija oħra. Għadhom kemm offrewli xogħol.
messages.zh: 另一家公司联系了我。他们刚给了我一个工作机会。
messages.en: I was approached by another company. They've just offered me a job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 avviċinat 放进 ġie avviċinat minn… 整块记忆：想象有人走近并开口联系，理解为“他被……接洽”。

gloss_zh: 拟采购公告；计划采购公告

teaching_sense.en_definition: A notice of planned procurement is an announcement describing goods, services, or works that an organization intends to obtain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 机构就其计划采购的货物、服务或工程所发布的公告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avviż li jħabbar oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet li organizzazzjoni għandha l-ħsieb li takkwista.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说明某机构拟开展采购活动的公告。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Avviż li jagħti informazzjoni dwar akkwist li organizzazzjoni għandha l-intenzjoni li tagħmel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A notice of intended procurement announces a purchase or contracting activity that an organization intends to undertake.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 介绍某机构已纳入计划的采购活动的公告。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Avviż li jippreżenta informazzjoni dwar akkwist li organizzazzjoni tkun inkludiet fil-pjanijiet tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A notice of planned procurement provides information about purchasing activity included in an organization's plans.

collocations.en: to publish a notice of planned procurement
to read a notice of planned procurement
the details in the notice of planned procurement
collocations.zh: 计划采购公告中的详细信息

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni ppubblikat avviż ta' akkwist ippjanat biex tinforma lill-fornituri dwar is-servizzi li biħsiebha takkwista.
formal.en: The organization published a notice of planned procurement to inform suppliers about the services it intends to obtain.
formal.zh: 该机构发布了计划采购公告，向供应商介绍其拟采购的服务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt l-avviż ta' akkwist ippjanat fuq is-sit tagħhom? Mark: Iva, qed ifittxu servizzi ta' tindif. Se naqra d-dettalji wara l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the notice of planned procurement on their website? Mark: Yes, they're looking for cleaning services. I'll read the details after lunch.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到他们网站上的计划采购公告了吗？马克：看到了，他们在寻找清洁服务。我午饭后会看看详细内容。

messages.speaker: Maja (供应商同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt l-avviż ta' akkwist ippjanat fuq is-sit tagħhom?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt l-avviż ta' akkwist ippjanat fuq is-sit tagħhom?
messages.zh: 你看到他们网站上的计划采购公告了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the notice of planned procurement on their website?

messages.speaker: Mark (供应商负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed ifittxu servizzi ta' tindif. Se naqra d-dettalji wara l-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed ifittxu servizzi ta' tindif. Se naqra d-dettalji wara l-ikel.
messages.zh: 看到了，他们在寻找清洁服务。我午饭后会看看详细内容。
messages.en: Yes, they're looking for cleaning services. I'll read the details after lunch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三个信息块记忆：avviż 是“公告”，akkwist 是“采购”，ippjanat 是“计划好的”；连起来就是“计划采购公告”。

gloss_zh: 合同授予公告；中标公告

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official notice announcing that a contract has been awarded to a selected supplier or contractor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式公布某项合同已授予选定供应商或承包商的公告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avviż uffiċjali li jħabbar li kuntratt ingħata lil fornitur jew kuntrattur magħżul.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 授予公告，指公布合同授予结果的正式通知。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Avviż uffiċjali li jħabbar ir-riżultat tal-għoti ta' kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An award notice is an official announcement stating that a contract has been awarded.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合同授予公告，正式说明合同已授予哪一供应商或承包商的公告。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Avviż uffiċjali li jindika lil liema fornitur jew kuntrattur ingħata kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contract award notice formally identifies the supplier or contractor selected to receive a contract.

collocations.mt: jippubblika avviż ta' għoti ta' kuntratt
jaqra avviż ta' għoti ta' kuntratt

formal.mt: L-awtorità ppubblikat avviż ta' għoti ta' kuntratt li jidentifika l-fornitur magħżul.
formal.en: The authority published a contract award notice identifying the selected supplier.
formal.zh: 主管机构发布了合同授予公告，列明获选的供应商。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Rajt l-avviż ta' għoti ta' kuntratt? Pawlu: Iva, fih hemm l-isem tal-fornitur magħżul.
colloquial.en: Marta: Have you seen the contract award notice? Pawlu: Yes, it contains the name of the selected supplier.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你看过合同授予公告了吗？保罗：看过，里面有获选供应商的名称。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt l-avviż ta' għoti ta' kuntratt?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt l-avviż ta' għoti ta' kuntratt?
messages.zh: 你看过合同授予公告了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the contract award notice?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fih hemm l-isem tal-fornitur magħżul.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fih hemm l-isem tal-fornitur magħżul.
messages.zh: 看过，里面有获选供应商的名称。
messages.en: Yes, it contains the name of the selected supplier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语分块记忆：avviż 是公告，għoti 是授予，kuntratt 是合同；联想“公告说明合同给了谁”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official notice announcing that a concession has been awarded to a selected operator.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式公布某项特许经营权已授予选定经营者的公告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avviż uffiċjali li jħabbar li konċessjoni ngħatat lil operatur magħżul.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 特许经营权授予公告，即正式公布特许经营权授予结果的通知。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Avviż uffiċjali li jħabbar ir-riżultat tal-għoti ta' konċessjoni u jidentifika l-operatur magħżul.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A concession award notice formally announces which operator has been selected to receive a concession.

collocations.zh: 发布特许经营权授予公告
查阅特许经营权授予公告

formal.mt: L-avviż tal-għoti tal-konċessjoni jindika liema operatur intgħażel biex imexxi s-servizz.
formal.en: The concession award notice indicates which operator was selected to run the service.
formal.zh: 特许经营权授予公告列明获选负责运营该服务的经营者。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn nista' nara min se jmexxi s-servizz? Mark: Ħares lejn l-avviż tal-għoti tal-konċessjoni; hemm issib l-isem tal-operatur.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where can I see who will run the service? Mark: Look at the concession award notice; you will find the operator's name there.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我在哪里能查到谁将运营这项服务？马克：看看特许经营权授予公告，那里有经营者的名称。

messages.speaker: Lara (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nara min se jmexxi s-servizz?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nara min se jmexxi s-servizz?
messages.zh: 我在哪里能查到谁将运营这项服务？
messages.en: Where can I see who will run the service?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares lejn l-avviż tal-għoti tal-konċessjoni; hemm issib l-isem tal-operatur.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares lejn l-avviż tal-għoti tal-konċessjoni; hemm issib l-isem tal-operatur.
messages.zh: 看看特许经营权授予公告，那里有经营者的名称。
messages.en: Look at the concession award notice; you will find the operator's name there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句想成“公告公布特许经营权给了谁”：看到 avviż 想到公告，看到 konċessjoni 想到特许经营权。

gloss_zh: 商誉；企业声誉及客户关系带来的商业价值

teaching_sense.en_definition: The business value arising from an established reputation, customer loyalty, and commercial relationships.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 企业因既有声誉、客户忠诚度和商业关系而具有的商誉价值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-valur kummerċjali li negozju jkollu minħabba r-reputazzjoni tiegħu, il-lealtà tal-klijenti u r-relazzjonijiet kummerċjali tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 商誉，指企业的良好声誉、稳定客源和商业关系所形成的价值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-valur ta' negozju marbut mar-reputazzjoni tajba tiegħu, mal-klijenti regolari u mar-relazzjonijiet kummerċjali stabbiliti tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The goodwill of a business is the value associated with its reputation, loyal customers, and established commercial relationships.

formal.mt: Il-valutazzjoni tan-negozju tqis ukoll l-avvjament marbut mar-reputazzjoni tiegħu u mal-klijenti regolari.
formal.en: The business valuation also takes into account the goodwill associated with its reputation and regular customers.
formal.zh: 企业估值也考虑了其声誉和稳定客源所带来的商誉。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dan il-ħanut jiswa daqshekk? David: Il-prezz jinkludi wkoll l-avvjament: għandu reputazzjoni tajba u ħafna klijenti regolari.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is this shop worth so much? David: The price also includes goodwill: it has a good reputation and many regular customers.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这家店为什么值这么多钱？戴维：价格里也包括商誉：它口碑好，还有很多老顾客。

messages.speaker: Sara (买家)
messages.zh: 这家店为什么值这么多钱？
messages.en: Why is this shop worth so much?

messages.speaker: David (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-prezz jinkludi wkoll l-avvjament: għandu reputazzjoni tajba u ħafna klijenti regolari.
messages.mt_standard: Il-prezz jinkludi wkoll l-avvjament: għandu reputazzjoni tajba u ħafna klijenti regolari.
messages.zh: 价格里也包括商誉：它口碑好，还有很多老顾客。
messages.en: The price also includes goodwill: it has a good reputation and many regular customers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 avvjament 和一家老店的口碑、熟客联系起来：买下的不只有货架，还有顾客愿意再来的商誉价值。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large bird that feeds mainly on the bodies of dead animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主要以动物尸体为食的大型鸟类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur kbir li jiekol l-aktar il-fdalijiet ta' annimali mejta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秃鹫，主要取食动物尸体的大型鸟类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għasfur kbir li jfittex u jiekol l-aktar il-fdalijiet ta' annimali mejta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vulture is a large bird that feeds mainly on the bodies of dead animals.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw avvultun jiekol il-fdalijiet ta' annimal mejjet.
formal.en: The students observed a vulture feeding on the remains of a dead animal.
formal.zh: 学生们观察到一只秃鹫正在啄食动物尸体的残骸。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dak l-għasfur kbir hemm fuq? Toni: Dak avvultun! Ħares lejn il-ġwienaħ tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is that big bird up there? Toni: That is a vulture! Look at its wings.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：上面那只大鸟是什么？托尼：那是秃鹫！看看它的翅膀。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak l-għasfur kbir hemm fuq?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak l-għasfur kbir hemm fuq?
messages.zh: 上面那只大鸟是什么？
messages.en: What is that big bird up there?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak avvultun! Ħares lejn il-ġwienaħ tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak avvultun! Ħares lejn il-ġwienaħ tiegħu.
messages.zh: 那是秃鹫！看看它的翅膀。
messages.en: That is a vulture! Look at its wings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 avvultun 配上一幅秃鹫展翅、寻找动物尸体的画面，同时记住“大鸟”和“食腐”这两个识别点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone advice or information, or to warn them about a possible problem or danger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人提供建议或告知有关情况，也可指提醒某人注意可能出现的问题或危险。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti parir jew tagħrif lil xi ħadd, jew twissih dwar problema jew periklu li jista' jinqala'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某人提供建议或告知其需要了解的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħti parir lil xi ħadd dwar x'jista' jagħmel, jew tgħarrfu b'xi ħaġa li għandu jkun jaf.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you advise someone, you give them guidance or information that helps them decide what to do.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预先提醒某人注意可能发生的危险、问题或不良后果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiġbed l-attenzjoni ta' xi ħadd għal periklu, problema jew konsegwenza ħażina li tista' sseħħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you warn someone, you tell them about a possible danger or problem so that they can take care.

collocations.en: informed the customers of the change
warned the drivers about the danger
collocations.zh: 提醒了驾驶员注意危险

formal.mt: Il-maniġer avża lill-klijenti bil-bidla fil-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ u talabhom jiċċekkjaw l-iskeda l-ġdida qabel iżuru l-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The manager informed the customers of the change in opening hours and asked them to check the new schedule before visiting the office.
formal.zh: 经理将营业时间的变更告知了顾客，并请他们在前往办公室之前查看新时间表。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi ħadd avżak li t-triq magħluqa? Pawlu: Iva, Mark avżani dalgħodu. Se ngħaddi minn triq oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did anyone warn you that the road is closed? Pawlu: Yes, Mark told me this morning. I'll take another road.
colloquial.zh: Maja：有人提醒你那条路封闭了吗？Pawlu：有，Mark 今天早上告诉我了。我会走另一条路。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd avżak li t-triq magħluqa?
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd avżak li t-triq magħluqa?
messages.zh: 有人提醒你那条路封闭了吗？
messages.en: Did anyone warn you that the road is closed?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Mark avżani dalgħodu. Se ngħaddi minn triq oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Mark avżani dalgħodu. Se ngħaddi minn triq oħra.
messages.zh: 有，Mark 今天早上告诉我了。我会走另一条路。
messages.en: Yes, Mark told me this morning. I'll take another road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 avża 放进“提前告诉你一声”的场景：告诉安排是告知，提出做法是建议，提醒危险是警告；根据后面的内容判断词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An independent examination of an organization's accounts or activities by auditors from outside the organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由组织外部的独立审计人员对该组织的账目或活动进行的审查。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżami indipendenti tal-kontijiet jew tal-attivitajiet ta' organizzazzjoni, imwettaq minn awdituri li mhumiex parti minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由组织以外的独立审计人员实施的审计，用于审查其账目或相关活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Verifika tal-kontijiet jew tal-attivitajiet ta' organizzazzjoni minn awdituri indipendenti li jiġu minn barra l-organizzazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An external audit is an examination of an organization's accounts or activities carried out by independent auditors from outside it.

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni kkummissjonat awditjar estern tal-kontijiet annwali tagħha biex awdituri indipendenti jeżaminaw ir-rekords finanzjarji.
formal.en: The organization commissioned an external audit of its annual accounts so that independent auditors could examine the financial records.
formal.zh: 该组织委托开展年度账目的外部审计，由独立审计人员审查财务记录。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ġejjin dawn l-awdituri għada? David: Għall-awditjar estern. Qed inħejji l-fatturi u l-kontijiet li talbu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are these auditors coming tomorrow? David: For the external audit. I'm getting the invoices and accounts they requested ready.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这些审计人员明天为什么要来？David：来做外部审计。我正在准备他们要求的发票和账目。

messages.speaker: Sara (行政同事)
messages.zh: 这些审计人员明天为什么要来？
messages.en: Why are these auditors coming tomorrow?

messages.speaker: David (财务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-awditjar estern. Qed inħejji l-fatturi u l-kontijiet li talbu.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-awditjar estern. Qed inħejji l-fatturi u l-kontijiet li talbu.
messages.zh: 来做外部审计。我正在准备他们要求的发票和账目。
messages.en: For the external audit. I'm getting the invoices and accounts they requested ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“谁来查账”记住整个词组：看到 estern，就想象组织外面的独立审计人员走进办公室检查账目，对应“外部审计”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A systematic examination of accounts, records, or activities, including checks on the accuracy and proper handling of accounting information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对账目、记录或活动进行的系统审查，也可指核查会计信息是否准确、处理是否妥当。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżami sistematiku tal-kontijiet, tar-rekords jew tal-attivitajiet, li jista' jinkludi verifiki tal-eżattezza u tat-trattament xieraq tat-tagħrif kontabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对组织的账目、记录或活动进行的系统审查，以评估其准确性或是否符合有关要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eżami sistematiku tal-kontijiet, tar-rekords jew tal-attivitajiet ta' organizzazzjoni biex jiġi vvalutat jekk humiex eżatti jew konformi mar-rekwiżiti rilevanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An audit is a systematic examination of accounts, records, or activities to assess their accuracy or compliance with relevant requirements.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对会计记录和账务处理进行的核查，以确认记录准确、处理妥当。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kontroll tar-rekords u tal-operazzjonijiet kontabbli biex jiġi żgurat li l-entrati jkunu eżatti u li t-tranżazzjonijiet ikunu ġew trattati kif suppost.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Accounting control involves checking financial records and accounting procedures to ensure that entries are accurate and transactions are handled properly.

formal.mt: L-awditu tar-rekords finanzjarji identifika żewġ ħlasijiet irreġistrati darbtejn, u d-dipartiment tal-kontabilità kkoreġa l-entrati.
formal.en: The audit of the financial records identified two payments that had been recorded twice, and the accounting department corrected the entries.
formal.zh: 对财务记录的审计发现两笔付款被重复登记，会计部门随后更正了相关分录。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tqabbel il-fatturi mal-ħlasijiet? Mark: Qed inħejji kollox għall-awditu ta' għada. Irrid niżgura li kull ħlas għandu fattura.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you matching the invoices to the payments? Mark: I'm getting everything ready for tomorrow's audit. I want to make sure every payment has an invoice.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么在核对发票和付款？Mark：我在为明天的审计准备资料。我想确认每笔付款都有对应的发票。

messages.speaker: Lara (办公室同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么在核对发票和付款？
messages.en: Why are you matching the invoices to the payments?

messages.speaker: Mark (会计同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħejji kollox għall-awditu ta' għada. Irrid niżgura li kull ħlas għandu fattura.
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħejji kollox għall-awditu ta' għada. Irrid niżgura li kull ħlas għandu fattura.
messages.zh: 我在为明天的审计准备资料。我想确认每笔付款都有对应的发票。
messages.en: I'm getting everything ready for tomorrow's audit. I want to make sure every payment has an invoice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 awditu 记成“拿着凭证逐项核对”的画面：整体审查对应“审计”，着重检查账务记录是否准确时对应“会计核查”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An examination of how economically, efficiently, and effectively an organization, programme, or activity uses resources and achieves its objectives.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 审查组织、项目或活动在使用资源和实现目标方面是否经济、高效且有效的审计。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżami ta' kemm organizzazzjoni, programm jew attività tuża r-riżorsi b'mod ekonomiku u effiċjenti, u ta' kemm tilħaq l-għanijiet tagħha b'mod effettiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对组织、项目或活动的经济性、效率和效果进行审查，评估其资源使用及目标实现情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eżami tal-ekonomija, tal-effiċjenza u tal-effettività ta' organizzazzjoni, programm jew attività, li jivvaluta kif jintużaw ir-riżorsi u kemm jintlaħqu l-għanijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A performance audit examines whether an organization, programme, or activity uses resources economically and efficiently and achieves its intended results.

formal.mt: L-awditu tal-prestazzjoni tas-servizz tat-trasport eżamina l-ispejjeż, l-użu tal-vetturi u kemm is-servizz laħaq il-miri tiegħu għall-puntwalità.
formal.en: The performance audit of the transport service examined costs, vehicle use, and the extent to which the service met its punctuality targets.
formal.zh: 对运输服务的绩效审计审查了成本、车辆使用情况，以及该服务在多大程度上实现了准点率目标。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'se jeżamina l-awditu tal-prestazzjoni? Joseph: Kemm nużaw tajjeb il-flus u l-ħin, u jekk is-servizz hux qed jilħaq il-miri tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What will the performance audit examine? Joseph: How well we use money and time, and whether the service is meeting its targets.
colloquial.zh: Nina：绩效审计会检查什么？Joseph：我们使用资金和时间的情况，以及这项服务是否正在实现既定目标。

messages.speaker: Nina (服务团队同事)
messages.zh: 绩效审计会检查什么？
messages.en: What will the performance audit examine?

messages.speaker: Joseph (项目负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm nużaw tajjeb il-flus u l-ħin, u jekk is-servizz hux qed jilħaq il-miri tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm nużaw tajjeb il-flus u l-ħin, u jekk is-servizz hux qed jilħaq il-miri tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我们使用资金和时间的情况，以及这项服务是否正在实现既定目标。
messages.en: How well we use money and time, and whether the service is meeting its targets.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个问题记住“绩效审计”：资源买得划算吗，办事效率高吗，预定目标达到了吗；把整组问题与 awditu tal-prestazzjoni 一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 令人惊叹的；使人心生敬畏的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing a strong feeling of wonder, admiration, or awe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因宏伟、力量或非凡之处而使人惊叹、赞叹或心生敬畏的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqanqal sens qawwi ta' għaġeb, ammirazzjoni jew rispett profond minħabba l-kobor jew il-qawwa tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人心生敬畏或惊叹的；带有敬畏之感的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jqanqal għaġeb u rispett profond, jew li jkun immarkat minn dawn is-sentimenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something awesome inspires profound wonder or respect, or is marked by a feeling of awe.

formal.mt: Il-kittieb juża l-aġġettiv 'awesome' biex jiddeskrivi l-kobor tal-muntanji u s-sens ta' għaġeb li jqanqlu.
formal.en: The writer uses the adjective 'awesome' to describe the grandeur of the mountains and the wonder they inspire.
formal.zh: 作者用形容词 awesome 描写群山的雄伟，以及它们激起的惊叹之情。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kienet il-veduta minn fuq il-muntanja? Mark: Kienet awesome; il-kobor tagħha ħallieni bla kliem.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the view from the mountain like? Mark: It was awesome; its grandeur left me speechless.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：从山上看下去，景色怎么样？马克：令人惊叹，那种雄伟让我说不出话来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kienet il-veduta minn fuq il-muntanja?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kienet il-veduta minn fuq il-muntanja?
messages.zh: 从山上看下去，景色怎么样？
messages.en: What was the view from the mountain like?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet awesome; il-kobor tagħha ħallieni bla kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet awesome; il-kobor tagħha ħallieni bla kliem.
messages.zh: 令人惊叹，那种雄伟让我说不出话来。
messages.en: It was awesome; its grandeur left me speechless.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象站在雄伟群山前惊叹到说不出话，用这个画面记住 awesome 的惊叹与敬畏感。

gloss_zh: 可能指“在夜间”（原释义存疑）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Provisionally understood as during the night; the supplied meaning is uncertain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂理解为“在夜间、夜里”，但所给释义带有疑问标记，含义及词类尚未确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma li tista' tfisser 'matul il-lejl', iżda t-tifsira mogħtija hija dubjuża u l-klassi grammatikali mhijiex stabbilita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可能指“在夜间、夜里”；原释义明确存疑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Possibbilment tfisser li xi ħaġa sseħħ matul il-lejl, iżda din it-tifsira mhijiex ikkonfermata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This form may refer to something happening during the night, although the supplied meaning remains uncertain.

collocations.zh: 笔记中的 awillejl 这一形式

formal.mt: Fin-noti, il-forma 'awillejl' għandha t-tifsira possibbli 'matul il-lejl', iżda din l-interpretazzjoni teħtieġ konferma.
formal.en: In the notes, the form 'awillejl' has the possible meaning 'during the night', but this interpretation requires confirmation.
formal.zh: 笔记中，awillejl 这一形式可能表示“在夜间”，但这一解释仍需确认。

colloquial.mt: Maja: 'Awillejl' tfisser 'matul il-lejl'? Pawlu: Forsi, imma n-noti juru li t-tifsira għadha mhix ċerta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'awillejl' mean 'during the night'? Pawlu: Perhaps, but the notes show that the meaning is still uncertain.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：awillejl 是“在夜间”的意思吗？保罗：可能是，但笔记表明这个意思还不确定。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: awillejl 是“在夜间”的意思吗？
messages.en: Does 'awillejl' mean 'during the night'?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi, imma n-noti juru li t-tifsira għadha mhix ċerta.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi, imma n-noti juru li t-tifsira għadha mhix ċerta.
messages.zh: 可能是，但笔记表明这个意思还不确定。
messages.en: Perhaps, but the notes show that the meaning is still uncertain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 awillejl 暂放进“夜间？”记忆卡，连同问号一起记；这是待确认的提示，不能当作已确定的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sea bream, a type of marine fish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海鲷，一种生活在海中的鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' ħuta tal-baħar magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala 'sea bream'.

sense_translations.en_definition: Sea bream a type of fish
sense_translations.zh_definition: 海鲷，一种海鱼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħuta tal-baħar li bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ 'sea bream'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An awrata is a marine fish known in English as a sea bream.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海鲷；所给英文形式应指 sea bream。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' ħuta tal-baħar; il-forma Ingliża mogħtija tidher li tirreferi għal 'sea bream'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This supplied spelling appears to refer to sea bream, a type of marine fish.

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi awrata moħmija, servuta bil-ħaxix u l-lumi.
formal.en: The menu includes baked sea bream, served with vegetables and lemon.
formal.zh: 菜单包括烤海鲷，配蔬菜和柠檬。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek awrata friska llum? Rita: Iva, trid waħda għall-forn?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have fresh sea bream today? Rita: Yes, would you like one to bake?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你今天有新鲜海鲷吗？丽塔：有，你想买一条回去烤吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你今天有新鲜海鲷吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh sea bream today?

messages.speaker: Rita (鱼贩)
messages.zh: 有，你想买一条回去烤吗？
messages.en: Yes, would you like one to bake?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 awrata 和鱼摊上标着“海鲷”的一条鱼配成图卡，再用“新鲜海鲷、烤海鲷”两个搭配反复记忆。

gloss_zh: 简朴的；朴素无华的；严肃克制的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Plain and without luxury or decoration, or serious and restrained in manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指环境或生活方式简朴、缺少奢华装饰，或指人的态度严肃克制；所给资料未标明词类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun sempliċi u bla lussu jew tiżjin, jew serju u mrażżan fl-imġiba; il-klassi grammatikali mhijiex speċifikata fid-dejta mogħtija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简朴而无奢华装饰的；也可指态度严肃、克制的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkollu ftit tiżjin jew kumditajiet, jew li juri serjetà u rażan fl-imġiba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something austere is plain and lacks luxury, while an austere person is serious and restrained.

formal.mt: Id-disinn tal-bini għandu stil awster, bi ftit tiżjin u għamara sempliċi.
formal.en: The building's design has an austere style, with little decoration and simple furniture.
formal.zh: 这座建筑的设计风格朴素无华，装饰很少，家具也很简单。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sibt l-uffiċċju l-ġdid? Toni: Għandu stil awster: mejda, żewġ siġġijiet u ebda tiżjin.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you think of the new office? Toni: It has an austere style: a desk, two chairs, and no decoration.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得新办公室怎么样？托尼：风格很简朴：一张桌子、两把椅子，没有任何装饰。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你觉得新办公室怎么样？
messages.en: What did you think of the new office?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu stil awster: mejda, żewġ siġġijiet u ebda tiżjin.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu stil awster: mejda, żewġ siġġijiet u ebda tiżjin.
messages.zh: 风格很简朴：一张桌子、两把椅子，没有任何装饰。
messages.en: It has an austere style: a desk, two chairs, and no decoration.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象只有桌椅、没有装饰的简朴办公室，用这幅画面记住 awster 的朴素与克制感，再联系严肃的神情。

gloss_zh: 澳大利亚的；来自澳大利亚的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone from Australia or something connected with Australia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某人来自澳大利亚，或某事物与澳大利亚有关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Awstralja jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Awstralja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 澳大利亚的；澳大利亚人的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa tal-Awstralja jew tan-nies tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something Australian comes from Australia or is associated with that country.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Australia
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自澳大利亚的，或与澳大利亚有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joriġina mill-Awstralja jew li għandu rabta ma' dan il-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You describe a person or thing this way when they originate in Australia or have a connection with it.

formal.mt: Student awstraljan se jieħu sehem fil-programm ta' skambju tal-università.
formal.en: An Australian student will participate in the university's exchange programme.
formal.zh: 一名澳大利亚学生将参加该大学的交流项目。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn hu l-istudent il-ġdid? Mark: Hu awstraljan, minn Sydney.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the new student from? Mark: He's Australian, from Sydney.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：新来的学生是哪里人？马克：他是澳大利亚人，来自悉尼。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 新来的学生是哪里人？
messages.en: Where is the new student from?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 他是澳大利亚人，来自悉尼。
messages.en: He's Australian, from Sydney.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 awstraljan 与 Australia 配对记忆，再用 student awstraljan 想象一位来自悉尼的学生；注意不要与表示奥地利的 awstrijaku 混淆。

gloss_zh: 奥地利的；来自奥地利的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone from Austria or something connected with Austria.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某人来自奥地利，或某事物与奥地利有关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Awstrija jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Awstrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奥地利的；奥地利人的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa tal-Awstrija jew tan-nies tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something Austrian comes from Austria or is associated with that country.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Austria
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自奥地利的，或与奥地利有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joriġina mill-Awstrija jew li għandu rabta ma' dan il-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You describe a person or thing this way when they originate in Austria or have a connection with it.

formal.mt: Il-mużew stieden kittieb awstrijaku biex jitkellem dwar ix-xogħol tiegħu.
formal.en: The museum invited an Austrian writer to speak about his work.
formal.zh: 博物馆邀请了一位奥地利作家介绍他的作品。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-mużiċist il-ġdid hu Ġermaniż? Pawlu: Le, hu awstrijaku, minn Vjenna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the new musician German? Pawlu: No, he's Austrian, from Vienna.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：新来的音乐家是德国人吗？保罗：不是，他是奥地利人，来自维也纳。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 新来的音乐家是德国人吗？
messages.en: Is the new musician German?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，他是奥地利人，来自维也纳。
messages.en: No, he's Austrian, from Vienna.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 awstrijaku 放进“来自维也纳的奥地利音乐家”这个画面，并与 awstraljan 的“来自悉尼的澳大利亚学生”成对区分；这是场景记忆法，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 自闭症的；汽车驾驶员；专职司机

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person who is on the autism spectrum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某人属于自闭症谱系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab fl-ispettru tal-awtiżmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自闭症的；属于自闭症谱系的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab fl-ispettru tal-awtiżmu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An autistic person is someone who is on the autism spectrum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驾驶汽车的人；汽车驾驶员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ssuq karozza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A car driver is a person who drives a car.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受雇为他人驾驶汽车的专职司机。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna impjegata biex issuq karozza għal persuna oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chauffeur is someone employed to drive a car for another person.

formal.mt: L-iskola se tiddiskuti mal-istudent awtista x'appoġġ ikun utli għalih fil-klassi.
formal.en: The school will discuss with the autistic student what support would be useful to him in class.
formal.zh: 学校将与这名自闭症学生讨论哪些课堂支持对他有帮助。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jsuqna sal-lukanda? David: L-awtista privat li bbukkjajna. Qed jistenniena barra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who's going to drive us to the hotel? David: The private chauffeur we booked. He's waiting for us outside.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁开车送我们去酒店？戴维：我们预约的私人司机。他正在外面等我们。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅客)
messages.zh: 谁开车送我们去酒店？
messages.en: Who's going to drive us to the hotel?

messages.speaker: David (同行旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: L-awtista privat li bbukkjajna. Qed jistenniena barra.
messages.mt_standard: L-awtista privat li bbukkjajna. Qed jistenniena barra.
messages.zh: 我们预约的私人司机。他正在外面等我们。
messages.en: The private chauffeur we booked. He's waiting for us outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 awtista 的用法分成三张卡：student awtista 是形容学生属于自闭症谱系，awtista tal-karozza 指汽车驾驶员，awtista privat 指私人专职司机；靠词性与搭配判断含义，不把这些义项编成词源故事。

gloss_zh: 自闭症；自闭症谱系中的状况

teaching_sense.en_definition: Autism, understood as a condition within the autism spectrum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自闭症，指属于自闭症谱系的状况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li taqa' fl-ispettru tal-awtiżmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自闭症。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni magħrufa bħala parti mill-ispettru tal-awtiżmu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Autism is the name used for a condition within the autism spectrum.

sense_translations.en_definition: a condition falling on the Autism Spectrum
sense_translations.zh_definition: 属于自闭症谱系的一种状况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li tinsab fi ħdan l-ispettru tal-awtiżmu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This sense refers to a condition that falls within the autism spectrum.

formal.mt: Il-librerija se torganizza laqgħa biex iżżid l-għarfien dwar l-awtiżmu u tipprovdi informazzjoni lill-pubbliku.
formal.en: The library will organise a meeting to raise awareness of autism and provide information to the public.
formal.zh: 图书馆将举办一场活动，提高公众对自闭症的认识并提供相关信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dwar xiex se tkun il-laqgħa fil-librerija? Toni: Dwar l-awtiżmu. Trid tiġi miegħi? Maja: Iva, nixtieq nitgħallem aktar dwaru.
colloquial.en: Maja: What will the meeting at the library be about? Toni: Autism. Would you like to come with me? Maja: Yes, I'd like to learn more about it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：图书馆的活动要谈什么？托尼：自闭症。你想和我一起去吗？玛雅：想，我希望多了解一些。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar xiex se tkun il-laqgħa fil-librerija?
messages.mt_standard: Dwar xiex se tkun il-laqgħa fil-librerija?
messages.zh: 图书馆的活动要谈什么？
messages.en: What will the meeting at the library be about?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 自闭症。你想和我一起去吗？
messages.en: Autism. Would you like to come with me?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，我希望多了解一些。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to learn more about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“主题与人物”对照记忆：dwar l-awtiżmu 表示“关于自闭症”，其中 awtiżmu 是状况名称；student awtista 则是在描述学生。先辨名词与形容词，再选用对应形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shop or other place where goods are sold to customers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向顾客出售商品的商店或销售地点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanut jew post ieħor fejn jinbiegħu prodotti lill-klijenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 销售门店，指向顾客出售商品的地点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post kummerċjali fejn il-klijenti jistgħu jixtru prodotti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An outlet is a shop or another place where a business sells its goods.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija se tiftaħ awtlett ġdid fiċ-ċentru kummerċjali biex tbigħ il-prodotti tagħha direttament lill-klijenti.
formal.en: The company will open a new outlet in the shopping centre to sell its products directly to customers.
formal.zh: 该公司将在购物中心开设一家新门店，直接向顾客销售其产品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn xtrajt din il-ġakketta? Mark: Minn awtlett tal-ħwejjeġ ħdejn l-istazzjon. Maja: Tajjeb, immur nagħti daqqa t'għajn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you buy this jacket? Mark: From a clothing outlet near the station. Maja: Great, I'll go and have a look.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你这件夹克在哪里买的？Mark：在车站附近的一家服装门店。Maja：好，我去看看。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你这件夹克在哪里买的？
messages.en: Where did you buy this jacket?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在车站附近的一家服装门店。
messages.en: From a clothing outlet near the station.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我去看看。
messages.en: Great, I'll go and have a look.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 awtlett 和购物画面绑定：走进一家店、挑选衣服、付款离开，记住它可以表示销售门店。

gloss_zh: 自传的；具有自传性质的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Based on or concerned with the writer's own life and experiences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以作者本人的生活与经历为内容或基础的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jittratta l-ħajja u l-esperjenzi personali tal-awtur jew ikun ibbażat fuqhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自传性的，指作品记述作者本人的生活，或以作者的亲身经历为基础。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrakkonta l-ħajja tal-awtur stess jew juża l-esperjenzi personali tiegħu bħala bażi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An autobiographical work describes its writer's own life or draws on experiences the writer has personally had.

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rakkont awtobijografiku, l-awtur jiddeskrivi t-tfulija tiegħu u l-ewwel snin tiegħu fl-iskola.
formal.en: In this autobiographical account, the author describes his childhood and his first years at school.
formal.zh: 在这篇自传性叙述中，作者描写了自己的童年以及最初几年的学校生活。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan ir-rumanz awtobijografiku? Pawlu: Iva, huwa bbażat fuq it-tfulija tal-awtur. Lara: Mela qed naqraw ukoll dwar ħajtu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this novel autobiographical? Pawlu: Yes, it is based on the author's childhood. Lara: So we're also reading about his life.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这部小说是自传性质的吗？Pawlu：是的，它以作者的童年为基础。Lara：那我们也在了解他的人生。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这部小说是自传性质的吗？
messages.en: Is this novel autobiographical?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa bbażat fuq it-tfulija tal-awtur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa bbażat fuq it-tfulija tal-awtur.
messages.zh: 是的，它以作者的童年为基础。
messages.en: Yes, it is based on the author's childhood.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela qed naqraw ukoll dwar ħajtu.
messages.mt_standard: Mela qed naqraw ukoll dwar ħajtu.
messages.zh: 那我们也在了解他的人生。
messages.en: So we're also reading about his life.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象作者翻开童年相册，把自己的经历写进小说；用“作者写自己”记住 awtobijografiku 的自传性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement in which a person declares information about themselves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由本人作出、申明自身情况或相关事实的声明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li persuna tagħmel hi stess biex tagħti informazzjoni dwarha jew dwar iċ-ċirkostanzi tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 本人自行作出的申报或声明，用于说明自身情况或确认相关信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stqarrija magħmula mill-persuna kkonċernata stess li fiha tiddikjara l-qagħda tagħha jew tikkonferma informazzjoni dwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A self-declaration is a statement in which you personally provide or confirm information about yourself.

formal.mt: Kull applikant għandu jimla u jiffirma awtodikjarazzjoni li tikkonferma li l-informazzjoni mogħtija hija korretta.
formal.en: Each applicant must complete and sign a self-declaration confirming that the information provided is correct.
formal.zh: 每位申请人均须填写并签署一份本人声明，确认所提供的信息正确。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għandi nagħmel b'din l-awtodikjarazzjoni? Rita: Imla d-dettalji tiegħek u ffirmaha fl-aħħar. Nina: Tajjeb, niċċekkja kollox qabel niffirma.
colloquial.en: Nina: What should I do with this self-declaration? Rita: Fill in your details and sign it at the end. Nina: All right, I'll check everything before I sign.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这份本人声明我该怎么处理？Rita：填上你的个人信息，然后在末尾签名。Nina：好的，我签名前会全部核对一遍。

messages.speaker: Nina (申请人)
messages.zh: 这份本人声明我该怎么处理？
messages.en: What should I do with this self-declaration?

messages.speaker: Rita (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Imla d-dettalji tiegħek u ffirmaha fl-aħħar.
messages.mt_standard: Imla d-dettalji tiegħek u ffirmaha fl-aħħar.
messages.zh: 填上你的个人信息，然后在末尾签名。
messages.en: Fill in your details and sign it at the end.

messages.speaker: Nina (申请人)
messages.zh: 好的，我签名前会全部核对一遍。
messages.en: All right, I'll check everything before I sign.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“自己的情况，自己声明”：想象本人填写信息并签字的场景，把 awtodikjarazzjoni 与自行申报联系起来。

gloss_zh: 自我禁入；自愿排除参与

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of voluntarily preventing yourself from entering a place or taking part in an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自愿采取措施，使自己不得进入某个场所或参与某项活动的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih persuna minn jeddha teskludi lilha nnifisha milli tidħol f'post jew tieħu sehem f'attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自我禁入或自我禁参与，即本人主动为自己设定进入某场所或参加某活动的禁令。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li bih persuna timponi fuqha nnifisha projbizzjoni milli tidħol f'post jew tipparteċipa f'attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Self-banning is the act of voluntarily placing yourself under a ban on entering a place or taking part in an activity.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自愿将自己排除在某项活动、服务或参与范围之外。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għażla volontarja ta' persuna li teskludi lilha nnifisha mill-użu ta' servizz jew mill-parteċipazzjoni f'attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Self-exclusion occurs when you voluntarily arrange to be excluded from a service or activity.

formal.mt: L-utent talab awtoesklużjoni mill-pjattaforma għal sitt xhur, sabiex ma jkunx jista' juża s-servizz matul dak il-perjodu.
formal.en: The user requested self-exclusion from the platform for six months so that they would be unable to use the service during that period.
formal.zh: 该用户申请在六个月内自愿停用该平台，使自己在这段时间内无法使用其服务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma tistax tidħol fuq il-pjattaforma? David: Tlabt awtoesklużjoni għal xahar għax ridt nieħu pawża. Sara: Fhimt, int stess tlabt li ma jkollokx aċċess.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why can't you access the platform? David: I requested self-exclusion for a month because I wanted a break. Sara: I see, you asked to have your own access blocked.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么无法进入这个平台？David：我想休息一下，所以申请了一个月的自我排除。Sara：明白了，是你自己申请暂停访问权限的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tistax tidħol fuq il-pjattaforma?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tistax tidħol fuq il-pjattaforma?
messages.zh: 你为什么无法进入这个平台？
messages.en: Why can't you access the platform?

messages.speaker: David (平台用户)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlabt awtoesklużjoni għal xahar għax ridt nieħu pawża.
messages.mt_standard: Tlabt awtoesklużjoni għal xahar għax ridt nieħu pawża.
messages.zh: 我想休息一下，所以申请了一个月的自我排除。
messages.en: I requested self-exclusion for a month because I wanted a break.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fhimt, int stess tlabt li ma jkollokx aċċess.
messages.mt_standard: Fhimt, int stess tlabt li ma jkollokx aċċess.
messages.zh: 明白了，是你自己申请暂停访问权限的。
messages.en: I see, you asked to have your own access blocked.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己主动在入口挂上“暂不进入”的牌子：awtoesklużjoni 强调本人选择限制自己的进入或参与。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of evaluating your own performance, abilities, or progress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据一定标准，对自己的表现、能力或进步进行评价的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih persuna tevalwa l-prestazzjoni, il-ħiliet jew il-progress tagħha stess skont ċerti kriterji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对自己的能力、表现或学习成果所作的评估。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Evalwazzjoni li persuna tagħmel tal-ħiliet, tal-prestazzjoni jew tar-riżultati tat-tagħlim tagħha stess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Self-assessment is the process of judging your own abilities, performance, or progress against relevant criteria.

formal.mt: Fi tmiem il-kors, kull student għandu jagħmel awtoevalwazzjoni biex jidentifika l-punti b'saħħithom tiegħu u l-oqsma li jeħtieġ itejjeb.
formal.en: At the end of the course, each student should complete a self-assessment to identify their strengths and the areas they need to improve.
formal.zh: 课程结束时，每位学生都应进行自我评估，找出自己的优势和需要改进的方面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif taf x'għandek tirrevedi qabel l-eżami? Toni: Nagħmel awtoevalwazzjoni qasira u nara fejn għadni niżbalja.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do you know what to revise before the exam? Toni: I do a short self-assessment and see where I'm still making mistakes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么知道考试前该复习什么？托尼：我做个简短的自我评估，看看自己还在哪些地方出错。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif taf x'għandek tirrevedi qabel l-eżami?
messages.mt_standard: Kif taf x'għandek tirrevedi qabel l-eżami?
messages.zh: 你怎么知道考试前该复习什么？
messages.en: How do you know what to revise before the exam?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmel awtoevalwazzjoni qasira u nara fejn għadni niżbalja.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmel awtoevalwazzjoni qasira u nara fejn għadni niżbalja.
messages.zh: 我做个简短的自我评估，看看自己还在哪些地方出错。
messages.en: I do a short self-assessment and see where I'm still making mistakes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象学习结束后自己拿着评分表，逐项检查表现；把整个词与“自己给自己作评估”的画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Exercising power by making decisions alone and allowing others little or no influence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 独自掌握决策权，很少或完全不允许他人参与或提出异议的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jeżerċita s-setgħa billi jieħu d-deċiżjonijiet waħdu u jagħti ftit jew ebda sehem lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指统治者、领导者或管理方式独揽权力、专断决策的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi mexxej jew stil ta' tmexxija fejn id-deċiżjonijiet jittieħdu minn persuna waħda mingħajr sehem effettiv minn ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An autocratic leader makes decisions independently and expects others to obey without having a meaningful say.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi stil awtokratiku ta' tmexxija li jħalli ftit spazju għall-parteċipazzjoni tal-ħaddiema fid-deċiżjonijiet.
formal.en: The report describes an autocratic leadership style that leaves little room for employees to participate in decisions.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一种专断的领导方式，员工几乎没有参与决策的空间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kap jisma' l-ideat tagħkom? Mark: Rari. Huwa awtokratiku wisq u jrid jiddeċiedi kollox waħdu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does your boss listen to your ideas? Mark: Rarely. He's too autocratic and wants to decide everything himself.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们老板会听取你们的想法吗？马克：很少。他太专断了，什么都想自己决定。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们老板会听取你们的想法吗？
messages.en: Does your boss listen to your ideas?

messages.speaker: Mark (公司职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Rari. Huwa awtokratiku wisq u jrid jiddeċiedi kollox waħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Rari. Huwa awtokratiku wisq u jrid jiddeċiedi kollox waħdu.
messages.zh: 很少。他太专断了，什么都想自己决定。
messages.en: Rarely. He's too autocratic and wants to decide everything himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住会议桌上只有一个人说话、其他人只能服从的画面，用它联想“独裁的、专断的”这一形容词。

gloss_zh: 消费者赋权；增强消费者自主选择和行动的能力

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of giving consumers the information, skills, and means to make informed choices and act in their own interests.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过提供信息、技能和行动条件，使消费者能够自主作出知情选择并维护自身利益的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li jagħti lill-konsumaturi l-informazzjoni, il-ħiliet u l-mezzi biex jagħmlu għażliet infurmati u jaġixxu fl-interess tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消费者赋权，即增强消费者获取信息、自主选择和维护自身利益的能力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tisħiħ tal-kapaċità tal-konsumaturi li jiksbu informazzjoni, jagħmlu għażliet għalihom infushom u jħarsu l-interessi tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consumer empowerment involves helping people understand their options and exercise greater control over their purchasing decisions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赋予消费者更充分的信息、能力和手段，使其能够自主决策并维护自身利益。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' informazzjoni, ħiliet u mezzi lill-konsumaturi sabiex ikunu jistgħu jieħdu deċiżjonijiet infurmati u jħarsu l-interessi tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The empowerment of consumers gives buyers the knowledge and practical means to make choices and pursue their interests.

collocations.zh: 增强消费者自主能力的举措

formal.mt: Il-programm jippromwovi l-awtonomizzazzjoni tal-konsumatur billi jispjega kif jitqabblu l-prezzijiet, jinftiehmu l-kundizzjonijiet u jitressaq ilment.
formal.en: The programme promotes consumer empowerment by explaining how to compare prices, understand terms, and make a complaint.
formal.zh: 该项目通过讲解如何比较价格、理解条款和提出投诉，增强消费者的自主行动能力。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'tfisser l-awtonomizzazzjoni tal-konsumatur? Pawlu: Ifisser li jkollok l-informazzjoni u l-mezzi biex tagħżel sew u tkun taf x'tagħmel jekk ikun hemm problema.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does consumer empowerment mean? Pawlu: It means having the information and means to choose well and knowing what to do if there's a problem.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：消费者赋权是什么意思？保罗：就是有信息、有办法作出合适的选择，也知道出了问题该怎么办。

messages.speaker: Sara (社区居民)
messages.zh: 消费者赋权是什么意思？
messages.en: What does consumer empowerment mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (消费者教育讲师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jkollok l-informazzjoni u l-mezzi biex tagħżel sew u tkun taf x'tagħmel jekk ikun hemm problema.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jkollok l-informazzjoni u l-mezzi biex tagħżel sew u tkun taf x'tagħmel jekk ikun hemm problema.
messages.zh: 就是有信息、有办法作出合适的选择，也知道出了问题该怎么办。
messages.en: It means having the information and means to choose well and knowing what to do if there's a problem.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“看懂信息、比较选择、主动维权”三个连续动作记住整条短语：消费者具备自主决定和行动的能力。

gloss_zh: 自我禁限；自愿禁止自己参与或进入

teaching_sense.en_definition: A voluntary restriction that prevents you from taking part in an activity or entering a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主动对自己设置禁限，使自己不能参与某项活动或进入某个场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Restrizzjoni volontarja li persuna timponi fuqha nnifisha biex ma tiħux sehem f'attività jew ma tidħolx f'post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自我禁止，即主动禁止自己从事某项活动或进入某个场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li bih persuna tipprojbixxi lilha nnifisha milli tagħmel xi attività jew tidħol f'ċertu post.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Self-banning occurs when someone voluntarily places a prohibition on their own participation in an activity.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自愿排除，即本人主动要求被排除在某项活动、服务或场所之外。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-esklużjoni volontarja li persuna titlob għaliha nnifisha minn attività, servizz jew post.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Self-exclusion is an arrangement in which someone asks to be prevented from accessing an activity or service.

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, il-parteċipant talab awtoprojbizzjoni għal sitt xhur sabiex ma jitħalliex jidħol fis-sala tal-logħob matul dak il-perjodu.
formal.en: In his letter, the participant requested self-exclusion for six months so that he would not be allowed to enter the gaming venue during that period.
formal.zh: 该参与者在信中申请了六个月的自我排除，要求在此期间不准自己进入该博彩场所。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed timla dik il-formola? Toni: Qed nitlob awtoprojbizzjoni għax irrid nieħu pawża mil-logħob tal-azzard.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you filling in that form? Toni: I'm requesting self-exclusion because I want to take a break from gambling.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么在填那张表？托尼：我在申请自我排除，因为我想暂停赌博。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在填那张表？
messages.en: Why are you filling in that form?

messages.speaker: Toni (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nitlob awtoprojbizzjoni għax irrid nieħu pawża mil-logħob tal-azzard.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nitlob awtoprojbizzjoni għax irrid nieħu pawża mil-logħob tal-azzard.
messages.zh: 我在申请自我排除，因为我想暂停赌博。
messages.en: I'm requesting self-exclusion because I want to take a break from gambling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己主动在入口挂上“请暂时不要让我进入”的牌子，把这个词记成自己提出、对自己生效的禁限。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A medical examination of a body after death to investigate the cause of death.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在死亡后对遗体进行的医学检查，通常包括解剖，以调查死因。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżami mediku ta' ġisem wara l-mewt, li normalment jinkludi dissezzjoni, biex tiġi investigata l-kawża tal-mewt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为调查死因而在死后对遗体进行的医学检查，通常包括解剖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eżami mediku li jsir fuq ġisem wara l-mewt biex tiġi investigata l-kawża tal-mewt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An autopsy is a medical examination of a dead person's body to investigate how they died.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-awtopsija jinkludi s-sejbiet tal-eżami u l-konklużjoni dwar il-kawża tal-mewt.
formal.en: The autopsy report includes the examination findings and the conclusion about the cause of death.
formal.zh: 尸检报告包括检查发现及对死因的结论。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għadhom qed jinvestigaw il-kawża tal-mewt? Pawlu: Iva, qed jistennew ir-riżultati tal-awtopsija.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are they still investigating the cause of death? Pawlu: Yes, they are waiting for the autopsy results.
colloquial.zh: Marija：他们还在调查死因吗？Pawlu：是的，他们正在等待尸检结果。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们还在调查死因吗？
messages.en: Are they still investigating the cause of death?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他们正在等待尸检结果。
messages.en: Yes, they are waiting for the autopsy results.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“调查死因—进行尸检—等待报告”的情境链中记忆，重点联想死后医学检查。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or function by which a device cleans itself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设备借助自身功能进行清洁的过程或功能。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew il-funzjoni li biha apparat inaddaf lilu nnifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设备自行完成清洁的过程或功能。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindif li apparat iwettaq fuqu nnifsu permezz ta' funzjoni apposta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Self-cleaning is a process in which a device uses its own mechanism to clean itself.

formal.mt: Qabel ma tibda ċ-ċiklu ta' awtopulitura tal-forn, aqra l-istruzzjonijiet tal-manifattur.
formal.en: Before starting the oven's self-cleaning cycle, read the manufacturer's instructions.
formal.zh: 启动烤箱的自清洁程序前，请阅读制造商的说明。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-forn għandu funzjoni ta' awtopulitura? Mark: Iva, imma ejja naqraw l-istruzzjonijiet qabel nużawha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this oven have a self-cleaning function? Mark: Yes, but let's read the instructions before using it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这台烤箱有自清洁功能吗？Mark：有，不过我们先看说明再用吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-forn għandu funzjoni ta' awtopulitura?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-forn għandu funzjoni ta' awtopulitura?
messages.zh: 这台烤箱有自清洁功能吗？
messages.en: Does this oven have a self-cleaning function?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客的伴侣)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ejja naqraw l-istruzzjonijiet qabel nużawha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ejja naqraw l-istruzzjonijiet qabel nużawha.
messages.zh: 有，不过我们先看说明再用吧。
messages.en: Yes, but let's read the instructions before using it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象烤箱面板上的“自清洁”按钮，用“设备自己清洁自己”的画面记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or practice of deliberately limiting one's own actions or choices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主动对自己的行为或选择设定限制的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-prattika li persuna tagħżel li tillimita l-azzjonijiet jew l-għażliet tagħha stess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由自己施加的限制，或主动限制自身行为与选择的做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Limitazzjoni li persuna timponi fuqha nnifisha biex tikkontrolla l-imġiba jew l-għażliet tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Self-restriction is the practice of setting limits on your own behaviour or choices.

collocations.zh: 在社交媒体使用上的自我限制

formal.mt: L-awtorestrizzjoni fl-infiq tista' tgħin lil persuna żżomm mal-baġit li tkun stabbiliet għaliha nnifisha.
formal.en: Self-restriction in spending can help a person stick to the budget they have set for themselves.
formal.zh: 在开支上的自我约束可以帮助一个人遵守自己设定的预算。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex m'intix tixtri kafè kuljum? David: Qed nipprova ftit awtorestrizzjoni fl-infiq biex infaddal għal vaganza.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why aren't you buying coffee every day? David: I'm trying a little self-restriction in spending to save for a holiday.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你怎么不每天买咖啡了？David：我想在花钱上约束一下自己，攒钱去度假。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么不每天买咖啡了？
messages.en: Why aren't you buying coffee every day?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nipprova ftit awtorestrizzjoni fl-infiq biex infaddal għal vaganza.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nipprova ftit awtorestrizzjoni fl-infiq biex infaddal għal vaganza.
messages.zh: 我想在花钱上约束一下自己，攒钱去度假。
messages.en: I'm trying a little self-restriction in spending to save for a holiday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己给购物车设定金额上限：限制由自己提出并遵守，就能记住“自我限制”的含义。

gloss_zh: 采购机关；合同授予机关

teaching_sense.en_definition: A public authority or other body responsible for procuring goods, services, or works and awarding the relevant contracts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责采购货物、服务或工程并授予相关合同的公共机关或其他机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Awtorità pubblika jew korp ieħor responsabbli għax-xiri ta' oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet u għall-għoti tal-kuntratti relatati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在公共采购中负责组织采购并授予合同的机关或机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Awtorità jew korp li jorganizza proċedura ta' akkwist pubbliku u jagħti l-kuntratt għall-oġġetti, is-servizzi jew ix-xogħlijiet meħtieġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contracting authority is an organisation that conducts public procurement and awards contracts for the required goods, services, or works.

collocations.en: a request for clarification addressed to the contracting authority
collocations.zh: 向采购机关提出的澄清请求

formal.mt: L-awtorità kontraenti ppubblikat kjarifika dwar ir-rekwiżiti tekniċi tat-tender.
formal.en: The contracting authority published a clarification concerning the tender's technical requirements.
formal.zh: 采购机关就该招标的技术要求发布了澄清说明。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Lil min nibagħtu l-mistoqsijiet dwar it-tender? Ġużepp: Lill-awtorità kontraenti, permezz tal-kanal indikat fid-dokumenti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who do we send our questions about the tender to? Ġużepp: To the contracting authority, through the channel specified in the documents.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们把关于这次招标的问题发给谁？Ġużepp：发给采购机关，使用文件中指定的渠道。

messages.speaker: Sara (投标团队成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nibagħtu l-mistoqsijiet dwar it-tender?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nibagħtu l-mistoqsijiet dwar it-tender?
messages.zh: 我们把关于这次招标的问题发给谁？
messages.en: Who do we send our questions about the tender to?

messages.speaker: Ġużepp (投标团队同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Lill-awtorità kontraenti, permezz tal-kanal indikat fid-dokumenti.
messages.mt_standard: Lill-awtorità kontraenti, permezz tal-kanal indikat fid-dokumenti.
messages.zh: 发给采购机关，使用文件中指定的渠道。
messages.en: To the contracting authority, through the channel specified in the documents.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与“发布采购要求、接收投标问题、授予合同的机构”联系起来，整组记忆为采购机关。

gloss_zh: 请求机关；提出请求的主管机关

teaching_sense.en_definition: An authority that formally requests information, assistance, or action from another authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式向另一机关请求提供信息、协助或采取行动的主管机关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Awtorità li tagħmel talba formali lil awtorità oħra għal informazzjoni, għajnuna jew azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在机关之间的信息交换、协助或其他程序中，正式提出请求的一方机关。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Awtorità li titlob formalment informazzjoni, għajnuna jew azzjoni mingħand awtorità oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A requesting authority is the official body that asks another authority to provide information, assistance, or action.

collocations.en: a request from the requesting authority
a reply to the requesting authority

formal.mt: L-awtorità rikjedenti għandha tispeċifika liema dokumenti teħtieġ u għaliex qed titlobhom.
formal.en: The requesting authority should specify which documents it needs and why it is requesting them.
formal.zh: 请求机关应说明需要哪些文件，以及请求提供这些文件的原因。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min talab dawn id-dokumenti? Pawlu: L-awtorità rikjedenti. Irridu nibagħtulha t-tweġiba llum.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who requested these documents? Pawlu: The requesting authority. We need to send it our reply today.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些文件是谁要求提供的？保罗：请求机关。我们今天得把答复发给它。

messages.speaker: Sara (行政助理)
messages.zh: 这些文件是谁要求提供的？
messages.en: Who requested these documents?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-awtorità rikjedenti. Irridu nibagħtulha t-tweġiba llum.
messages.mt_standard: L-awtorità rikjedenti. Irridu nibagħtulha t-tweġiba llum.
messages.zh: 请求机关。我们今天得把答复发给它。
messages.en: The requesting authority. We need to send it our reply today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象公函上写着“请提供文件”的机关：它是提出请求的一方，记住整词组表示“请求机关”。

gloss_zh: 市场监督机关；市场监管机构

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official body responsible for checking that products on the market meet applicable requirements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责监督市场上的产品是否符合适用要求的官方机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Korp uffiċjali responsabbli biex jissorvelja l-prodotti fis-suq u jivverifika jekk jissodisfawx ir-rekwiżiti applikabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责检查市场上产品的合规情况，并针对不符合适用要求的产品采取相应措施的主管机关。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Awtorità responsabbli biex tivverifika li l-prodotti fis-suq jissodisfaw ir-rekwiżiti applikabbli u biex tieħu miżuri meta dawn ma jkunux konformi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A market surveillance authority is an official body that checks products offered on the market and takes action when they fail to meet applicable requirements.

collocations.en: an inspection by the market surveillance authority
collocations.zh: 市场监督机关开展的检查

collocations.en: a report to the market surveillance authority
collocations.zh: 向市场监督机关提交的报告

formal.mt: L-awtorità tas-sorveljanza tas-suq talbet lill-importatur jipprovdi d-dokumentazzjoni dwar is-sigurtà tal-prodott.
formal.en: The market surveillance authority asked the importer to provide documentation concerning the product's safety.
formal.zh: 市场监督机关要求进口商提供有关该产品安全性的文件。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jiċċekkja jekk dan il-prodott huwiex sigur? David: L-awtorità tas-sorveljanza tas-suq. Diġà bgħattilha r-rapport.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who will check whether this product is safe? David: The market surveillance authority. I have already sent it the report.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：谁来检查这个产品是否安全？戴维：市场监督机关。我已经把报告发过去了。

messages.speaker: Marija (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jiċċekkja jekk dan il-prodott huwiex sigur?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jiċċekkja jekk dan il-prodott huwiex sigur?
messages.zh: 谁来检查这个产品是否安全？
messages.en: Who will check whether this product is safe?

messages.speaker: David (进口商)
messages.mt_spoken: L-awtorità tas-sorveljanza tas-suq. Diġà bgħattilha r-rapport.
messages.mt_standard: L-awtorità tas-sorveljanza tas-suq. Diġà bgħattilha r-rapport.
messages.zh: 市场监督机关。我已经把报告发过去了。
messages.en: The market surveillance authority. I have already sent it the report.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“机关—监督—市场”三个意义块记忆，再想象工作人员检查货架上的产品，整词组就是“市场监督机关”。

gloss_zh: 经授权的；获准的；被允许的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having official approval or permission to act, enter, or do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经获得正式授权或许可，可以行动、进入某处或做某事的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu approvazzjoni jew permess uffiċjali biex jaġixxi, jidħol f'post jew jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经正式授权或批准的，具有执行某项事务或采取某种行动的权限的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ngħata setgħa jew approvazzjoni uffiċjali biex iwettaq kompitu jew jaġixxi f'isem persuna jew organizzazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is authorised has been officially given the power or approval to perform a particular task or act on another party's behalf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到允许的；依照相关许可或规定可以进行的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu permess biex jagħmel xi ħaġa, jew li huwa permess skont ir-regoli jew l-approvazzjoni mogħtija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is allowed, the relevant permission or rules make the activity or situation acceptable.

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant awtorizzat jista' jiffirma d-dokumenti f'isem il-kumpanija.
formal.en: The authorised representative may sign the documents on behalf of the company.
formal.zh: 获授权的代表可以代表公司签署文件。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nidħol f'din il-kamra? Rita: Iva, ismek qiegħed fuq il-lista. Int awtorizzat tidħol.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I enter this room? Rita: Yes, your name is on the list. You are allowed to enter.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我可以进这个房间吗？丽塔：可以，名单上有你的名字。你获准进入。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: 我可以进这个房间吗？
messages.en: Can I enter this room?

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ismek qiegħed fuq il-lista. Int awtorizzat tidħol.
