messages.zh: 我们在筹款帮助有需要的儿童。
messages.en: We're collecting it to help children in need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象公益海报上写着 b'risq，后面紧接受帮助的人；把整组表达记成“为了让……受益”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having considerable physical strength or a solid, robust build.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体有力、能够承受较大体力负荷的；也可形容体格结实壮实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna saħħa fiżika jew ġisem sod u robust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强壮的；身体有力量、能够用力或承受体力负荷的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna saħħa fiżika u kapaċi jerfa' jew iċaqlaq affarijiet tqal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is strong has considerable physical power and can perform tasks that require force.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 壮实的；体格结实、粗壮的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu ġisem sod, robust u mibni sew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone described as stout has a solid, robust body and a sturdy physical build.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem kien b'saħħtu biżżejjed biex jerfa' l-kaxxa mingħajr għajnuna.
formal.en: The worker was strong enough to lift the box without help.
formal.zh: 这名工人力气足够大，无需帮助就能抬起箱子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min jista' jgħinna nġorru din il-mejda? Mark: Pawlu b'saħħtu; jista' jgħinna hu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who can help us carry this table? Mark: Pawlu is strong; he can help us.
colloquial.zh: Sara：谁能帮我们搬这张桌子？Mark：Pawlu 很强壮，他能帮我们。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jgħinna nġorru din il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jgħinna nġorru din il-mejda?
messages.zh: 谁能帮我们搬这张桌子？
messages.en: Who can help us carry this table?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 很强壮，他能帮我们。
messages.en: Pawlu is strong; he can help us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人稳稳抬起重箱：动作突出“有力量”，体格突出“壮实”，用同一画面区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 以某种办法；总能想个办法

teaching_sense.en_definition: By some means, even if the precise method is unknown or uncertain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以某种尚未确定或没有明确说明的办法做到某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'xi mezz, anki jekk il-mod kif se ssir il-ħaġa għadu mhux magħruf jew mhux ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以某种办法；虽然还不知道具体怎么做，但会设法做到。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'xi mezz jew mod, għalkemm mhux magħruf jew mhux spjegat eżatt kif.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you do something somehow or other, you manage to do it by a method that is uncertain or not specified.

collocations.mt: insolvu l-problema b'xi mod jew ieħor
collocations.en: solve the problem somehow or other

collocations.mt: naslu fil-ħin b'xi mod jew ieħor
collocations.en: arrive on time somehow or other

formal.mt: Minkejja d-diffikultajiet, it-tim se jlesti l-proġett b'xi mod jew ieħor.
formal.en: Despite the difficulties, the team will complete the project somehow or other.
formal.zh: 尽管困难重重，团队仍会设法完成这个项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tlift il-karozza tal-linja. Kif se nasal? Toni: Tinkwetax, b'xi mod jew ieħor naslu fil-ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: I missed the bus. How am I going to get there? Toni: Don't worry, we'll get there on time somehow or other.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我没赶上公交车。我要怎么过去？托尼：别担心，我们总能想个办法准时到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlift il-karozza tal-linja. Kif se nasal?
messages.mt_standard: Tlift il-karozza tal-linja. Kif se nasal?
messages.zh: 我没赶上公交车。我要怎么过去？
messages.en: I missed the bus. How am I going to get there?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tinkwetax, b'xi mod jew ieħor naslu fil-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Tinkwetax, b'xi mod jew ieħor naslu fil-ħin.
messages.zh: 别担心，我们总能想个办法准时到。
messages.en: Don't worry, we'll get there on time somehow or other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象错过公交后还在寻找其他交通办法：办法暂时不明确，但总会设法做到，用整句情境记住这个表达。

gloss_zh: 以某种方式；不知怎么地

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that is not known, clearly understood, or specified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以没有明确说明或尚不清楚的方式发生或做到某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li mhux magħruf, mhux mifhum sew jew mhux speċifikat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以某种未说明的方式；不知怎么地；设法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'xi mezz jew b'xi mod li mhux magħruf jew mhux spjegat b'mod ċar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens somehow, it happens in a way that you do not know or cannot explain clearly.

collocations.mt: insib soluzzjoni b'xi mod jew ieħor

formal.mt: B'xi mod jew ieħor, l-iżball baqa' fir-rapport finali minkejja l-kontrolli.
formal.en: Somehow, the error remained in the final report despite the checks.
formal.zh: 尽管经过检查，不知怎么地，这个错误仍留在了最终报告中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif irranġajt ir-rota? Pawlu: Ma nafx eżatt, imma b'xi mod jew ieħor irnexxieli.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did you fix the bicycle? Pawlu: I'm not sure exactly, but somehow I managed.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你是怎么把自行车修好的？保罗：我也说不清，但不知怎么就修好了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是怎么把自行车修好的？
messages.en: How did you fix the bicycle?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx eżatt, imma b'xi mod jew ieħor irnexxieli.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx eżatt, imma b'xi mod jew ieħor irnexxieli.
messages.zh: 我也说不清，但不知怎么就修好了。
messages.en: I'm not sure exactly, but somehow I managed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和修好自行车后的疑惑连起来记：结果已经出现，具体过程却说不清，就是“不知怎么地”。

gloss_zh: 鬼魂；吓唬小孩的虚构怪物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ghost, or an imaginary frightening figure used to scare children.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鬼魂，也可指用来吓唬儿童的虚构可怕形象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spirtu ta' persuna mejta, jew figura immaġinarja tal-biża' li tintuża biex jitbeżżgħu t-tfal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鬼魂；被认为可能显现于人前的死者灵魂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spirtu ta' persuna mejta li jingħad li jista' jidher lin-nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ghost is the spirit of a dead person that some people believe can appear to the living.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用来吓唬儿童的虚构怪物或可怕人物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Figura immaġinarja u tal-biża' li tissemma biex jitbeżżgħu t-tfal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bogeyman is an imaginary frightening figure that adults sometimes mention to scare children.

collocations.en: to scare children with the bogeyman

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-babaw jidher fid-dar vojta bħala spirtu ta' raġel li miet hemm.
formal.en: In the story, the ghost appears in the empty house as the spirit of a man who died there.
formal.zh: 故事中，空屋里出现的鬼魂是一名死于该处的男子的亡灵。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Hemm babaw taħt is-sodda? Marija: Le, dak biss fil-ħrejjef. Ejja nħarsu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lina: Is there a bogeyman under the bed? Marija: No, that's only in stories. Let's look together.
colloquial.zh: Lina：床底下有吓人的怪物吗？Marija：没有，那只是故事里的。我们一起看看吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (女儿)
messages.zh: 床底下有吓人的怪物吗？
messages.en: Is there a bogeyman under the bed?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dak biss fil-ħrejjef. Ejja nħarsu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dak biss fil-ħrejjef. Ejja nħarsu flimkien.
messages.zh: 没有，那只是故事里的。我们一起看看吧。
messages.en: No, that's only in stories. Let's look together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅故事画面记住 babaw：空屋里飘出的亡灵对应 ghost，孩子想象的床底怪物对应 bogeyman。两者都可怕，但要根据上下文区分具体义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person described insultingly as very foolish or lacking good judgement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对被认为非常愚蠢或缺乏判断力的人的侮辱性称呼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma ta' disprezz għal persuna li titqies iblah ħafna jew nieqsa minn ġudizzju tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蠢货；傻瓜，用于侮辱被认为十分愚蠢或判断力很差的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li titqies iblah ħafna jew li ma tużax ġudizzju tajjeb; il-kelma tintuża bħala insult.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone calls a person an imbecile, they are insulting that person's intelligence or judgement.

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tad-djalogu, il-kelma 'babbu' hija eżempju ta' insult dirett lejn persuna oħra.
formal.en: In the analysis of the dialogue, the word 'babbu' is an example of a direct insult aimed at another person.
formal.zh: 在这段对话的分析中，babbu 一词是直接侮辱他人的用语实例。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex sejjaħtli babbu? Maja: Kont irrabjata. Skużani, ma kellix ninsultak.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you call me an imbecile? Maja: I was angry. Sorry, I shouldn't have insulted you.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你为什么骂我是蠢货？Maja：我当时很生气。对不起，我不该侮辱你。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么骂我是蠢货？
messages.en: Why did you call me an imbecile?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont irrabjata. Skużani, ma kellix ninsultak.
messages.mt_standard: Kont irrabjata. Skużani, ma kellix ninsultak.
messages.zh: 我当时很生气。对不起，我不该侮辱你。
messages.en: I was angry. Sorry, I shouldn't have insulted you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 babbu 配上争吵后道歉的画面，记住它是骂人愚蠢的词。再与 babaw 对照：babaw 联系鬼怪故事，babbu 联系人际冲突，注意结尾拼写不同。

gloss_zh: 介于苹果与梨之间、据称对肠道有疗效的一种水果

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fruit intermediate between an apple and a pear, described as having healing properties for the intestine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种介于苹果与梨之间、据描述对肠道具有疗效的水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta bejn tuffieħa u lanġasa, li jingħad li għandha proprjetajiet ta' fejqan għall-musrana.

sense_translations.en_definition: a fruit in between an apple and a pear with healing properties for the intestine
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种介于苹果与梨之间、据称对肠道具有疗效的水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Frotta bejn tuffieħa u lanġasa, deskritta bħala frotta bi proprjetajiet ta' fejqan għall-musrana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Baccamart is a fruit intermediate between an apple and a pear and is described as having healing properties for the intestine.

formal.mt: Il-baccamart huwa frott bejn it-tuffieħ u l-lanġas, u jingħad li għandu proprjetajiet ta' fejqan għall-musrana.
formal.en: Baccamart is a fruit intermediate between apples and pears and is said to have healing properties for the intestine.
formal.zh: Baccamart 是一种介于苹果与梨之间的水果，据称对肠道具有疗效。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan tuffieħ jew lanġas? Mark: Dan baccamart, frott bejn it-tuffieħ u l-lanġas. Trid biċċa?
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this an apple or a pear? Mark: This is baccamart, a fruit intermediate between apples and pears. Would you like a piece?
colloquial.zh: Maja：这是苹果还是梨？Mark：这是 baccamart，一种介于苹果与梨之间的水果。你要尝一块吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是苹果还是梨？
messages.en: Is this an apple or a pear?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan baccamart, frott bejn it-tuffieħ u l-lanġas. Trid biċċa?
messages.mt_standard: Dan baccamart, frott bejn it-tuffieħ u l-lanġas. Trid biċċa?
messages.zh: 这是 baccamart，一种介于苹果与梨之间的水果。你要尝一块吗？
messages.en: This is baccamart, a fruit intermediate between apples and pears. Would you like a piece?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“苹果—baccamart—梨”的三格图记住水果位置，再把词条所述肠道疗效作为附加语义记忆；这只是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A floating object used to mark a position on the water or provide a mooring point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 漂浮在水面上，用于标示位置或提供系泊点的浮标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jżomm f'wiċċ l-ilma biex jimmarka post jew biex miegħu tintrabat dgħajsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 漂浮于水面、用于标示位置或系泊船只的浮标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett li jżomm f'wiċċ l-ilma u jintuża bħala sinjal jew bħala punt fejn tintrabat dgħajsa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A buoy is a floating object that marks a location on the water or provides a point for mooring a boat.

formal.mt: Il-baga safra timmarka t-tarf taż-żona tal-għawm.
formal.en: The yellow buoy marks the edge of the swimming area.
formal.zh: 黄色浮标标示着游泳区域的边界。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara dik il-baga safra. Leo: Iva, żomm id-dgħajsa 'l bogħod minnha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look at that yellow buoy. Leo: Yes, keep the boat away from it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：看那个黄色浮标。Leo：看到了，让船离它远一点。

messages.speaker: Sara (乘船的朋友)
messages.zh: 看那个黄色浮标。
messages.en: Look at that yellow buoy.

messages.speaker: Leo (掌舵的朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，让船离它远一点。
messages.en: Yes, keep the boat away from it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baga 想成水面上一上一下的黄色浮标，并搭配 baga safra 一起读；safra 的阴性形式也帮助记住 baga 的搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A suitcase handed over at airport check-in to be carried in the aircraft's baggage hold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在机场办理值机时交给航空公司、放入飞机行李舱运输的行李箱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bagalja li l-passiġġier jagħti lill-kumpanija tal-ajru waqt iċ-check-in biex tinġarr fl-istiva tal-ajruplan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 办理托运后交由航空公司放入飞机行李舱运输的行李。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bagalja li tingħata lill-kumpanija tal-ajru waqt iċ-check-in biex tinġarr fl-istiva tal-ajruplan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Checked baggage is luggage that you hand over at check-in so that the airline can carry it in the aircraft's hold.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由航空公司接收并放在飞机行李舱内运输的托运行李。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bagalja li tiġi aċċettata mill-kumpanija tal-ajru waqt iċ-check-in u tinġarr fl-istiva tal-ajruplan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hold baggage is luggage accepted by the airline at check-in and transported in the aircraft's baggage hold.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 办理托运并存放于飞机行李舱运输的行李。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bagalja li l-passiġġier jgħaddi miċ-check-in biex titpoġġa fl-istiva tal-ajruplan u tinġarr hemm matul it-titjira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hold luggage is luggage that travels in the aircraft's hold after you hand it over to the airline at check-in.

collocations.en: the weight of the checked suitcase
the tag on the checked suitcase

formal.mt: Il-passiġġier għandu jiċċekkja l-piż tal-bagalja li tgħaddi miċ-check-in qabel ma jasal l-ajruport.
formal.en: The passenger should check the weight of the suitcase being checked in before arriving at the airport.
formal.zh: 旅客应在到达机场前检查托运行李箱的重量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-bagalja li tgħaddi miċ-check-in fejn niġborha? Mark: Mal-wasla, tiġborha miż-żona tal-ġbir tal-bagalji.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where do I collect this suitcase that is being checked in? Mark: On arrival, you collect it from the baggage reclaim area.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个办理托运的行李箱在哪里领取？Mark：抵达后，你到行李提取区领取。

messages.speaker: Maja (旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-bagalja li tgħaddi miċ-check-in fejn niġborha?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-bagalja li tgħaddi miċ-check-in fejn niġborha?
messages.zh: 这个办理托运的行李箱在哪里领取？
messages.en: Where do I collect this suitcase that is being checked in?

messages.speaker: Mark (值机工作人员)
messages.zh: 抵达后，你到行李提取区领取。
messages.en: On arrival, you collect it from the baggage reclaim area.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语分成“bagalja 行李箱＋li tgħaddi 经过的＋miċ-check-in 从值机环节”，想象交箱、贴签、抵达后领取的连续画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Baggage carried in an aircraft's hold rather than kept with the passenger in the cabin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 交给航空公司运输、放在飞机货舱内而非随身带入客舱的行李。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bagalja li l-passiġġier jagħti lill-kumpanija tal-ajru biex tinġarr fl-istiva tal-ajruplan minflok fil-kabina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 办理托运手续后交由航空公司运输的行李。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bagalja li tingħata lill-kumpanija tal-ajru waqt iċ-check-in biex tinġarr fl-istiva tal-ajruplan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Checked baggage is baggage that you hand over to an airline before your flight to be carried in the aircraft's hold.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放在飞机货舱内运输的行李。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bagalja li tinġarr fl-istiva tal-ajruplan u ma tinżammx mal-passiġġier fil-kabina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hold baggage is baggage that travels in the aircraft's storage compartment rather than in the passenger cabin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 存放于飞机货舱、供旅客托运的行李。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bagalja tal-passiġġier li titqiegħed fl-istiva tal-ajruplan matul it-titjira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hold luggage consists of the bags and suitcases that an airline carries in the aircraft's hold during a flight.

collocations.en: the weight of the checked baggage
a tag for the checked baggage

formal.mt: Il-passiġġier għandu jiżgura li t-tikketta fuq il-bagalja tal-istiva turi d-destinazzjoni korretta.
formal.en: The passenger should ensure that the tag on the checked baggage shows the correct destination.
formal.zh: 旅客应确保托运行李上的标签标明正确的目的地。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn inħalli l-bagalja tal-istiva? Rita: Ħalliha hawn fuq il-miżien, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where do I leave my checked baggage? Rita: Put it here on the scales, please.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我的托运行李放在哪里？Rita：请放在这里的秤上。

messages.speaker: Mark (旅客)
messages.zh: 我的托运行李放在哪里？
messages.en: Where do I leave my checked baggage?

messages.speaker: Rita (值机工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħalliha hawn fuq il-miżien, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Ħalliha hawn fuq il-miżien, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请放在这里的秤上。
messages.en: Put it here on the scales, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词组和机场托运柜台、行李秤及货舱连成一幅图，记住它指交运的行李。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ship that is large in size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体积或规模较大的船。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vapur kbir fid-daqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船体较大、规模较大的船只。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Vapur ta' daqs kbir li jista' jidher fil-port jew fuq il-baħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A big ship is a vessel that is large in size.

collocations.en: a big ship in the harbour

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt tidher bagassa ħdejn id-daħla tal-port.
formal.en: The photograph shows a big ship near the harbour entrance.
formal.zh: 照片中可以看到港口入口附近的一艘大船。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara dik il-bagassa fil-port? Mark: Iva, tidher enormi ħdejn id-dgħajjes!
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see that big ship in the harbour? Mark: Yes, it looks enormous next to the boats!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看到港口里的那艘大船了吗？Mark：看到了，和那些小船相比，它显得特别大！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到港口里的那艘大船了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that big ship in the harbour?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，和那些小船相比，它显得特别大！
messages.en: Yes, it looks enormous next to the boats!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象港口里一艘大船旁边停着几只小船，用大小对照把 bagassa 和“大船”联系起来。

gloss_zh: 他寄给了我们；他给我们送来了

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression stating that he sent something to us.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“他把某物寄给或送给了我们”的表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser li hu bagħat xi ħaġa lilna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他把某物寄给了我们，或通过其他方式送给了我们。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li hu bagħat xi ħaġa lil min qed jitkellem u lil persuni oħra miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to say that he sent something to you and the other people included in your group.

collocations.zh: 他给我们寄了一个包裹

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju 'baghtielna ittra', il-kelma 'ittra' tindika x'bagħat hu lilna.
formal.en: In the example 'baghtielna ittra', the word 'ittra' identifies what he sent us.
formal.zh: 在例子“baghtielna ittra”中，“ittra”这个词指出他寄给我们的东西是一封信。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'baghtielna ittra'? Paul: Tfisser li hu bagħat ittra lilna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'baghtielna ittra' mean? Paul: It means that he sent us a letter.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“baghtielna ittra”是什么意思？Paul：意思是他给我们寄了一封信。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “baghtielna ittra”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'baghtielna ittra' mean?

messages.speaker: Paul (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li hu bagħat ittra lilna.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li hu bagħat ittra lilna.
messages.zh: 意思是他给我们寄了一封信。
messages.en: It means that he sent us a letter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“他→寄送→我们”的箭头画面记忆整个表达，再接上信或包裹，练习说清寄来的东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An egg cooked by frying it in a pan with oil or fat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用油或其他脂肪在平底锅中煎熟的鸡蛋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bajda msajra f'taġen biż-żejt jew b'xaħam ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放入有油或其他脂肪的锅中煎制的鸡蛋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bajda li tissajjar billi tinqela f'taġen bi ftit żejt jew xaħam ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fried egg is an egg that you cook in a pan using hot oil or another type of fat.

formal.mt: Għall-kolazzjon, il-menu joffri bajda moqlija ma' porzjon ħobż u tadam frisk.
formal.en: For breakfast, the menu offers a fried egg with a portion of bread and fresh tomatoes.
formal.zh: 早餐菜单提供一份煎蛋，配有面包和新鲜番茄。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Trid bajda moqlija mal-ħobż? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma sajjarha ftit aktar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Would you like a fried egg with your bread? Mark: Yes, please, but cook it a little longer.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你想要一个煎蛋配面包吗？Mark：好的，麻烦你，不过请多煎一会儿。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 你想要一个煎蛋配面包吗？
messages.en: Would you like a fried egg with your bread?

messages.speaker: Mark (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma sajjarha ftit aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma sajjarha ftit aktar.
messages.zh: 好的，麻烦你，不过请多煎一会儿。
messages.en: Yes, please, but cook it a little longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bajda 联想到鸡蛋，把 moqlija 联想到锅里煎制的动作，合起来就是早餐盘里的煎蛋。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A slender stick used as a wand or as a baton for conducting music.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 细长的棒，可指魔杖，也可指乐队指挥使用的指挥棒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Virga rqiqa li tintuża bħala oġġett maġiku fi storja jew biex direttur imexxi orkestra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 魔杖，故事或魔术表演中用来施展魔法的细棒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Virga rqiqa li tintuża biex issir il-maġija fi storja jew fi spettaklu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wand is a slender stick used to perform magic in stories or entertainments.

sense_translations.en_definition: baton (e.g. used by an orchestra conductor)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指挥棒，例如管弦乐队指挥用来示意节拍和演奏动作的细棒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Virga rqiqa li direttur ta' orkestra juża biex juri r-ritmu u jiggwida lill-mużiċisti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A baton is a thin stick that a conductor moves to guide an orchestra.

formal.mt: Id-direttur għolla l-bakketta biex jagħti sinjal lill-orkestra tibda ddoqq.
formal.en: The conductor raised the baton to signal the orchestra to begin playing.
formal.zh: 指挥举起指挥棒，示意管弦乐队开始演奏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-bakketta maġika għall-ispettaklu? Pawlu: Qiegħda fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-kappell.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the magic wand for the show? Pawlu: It's on the table, next to the hat.
colloquial.zh: Maja：演出用的魔杖在哪里？Pawlu：在桌上，帽子旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (演员)
messages.zh: 演出用的魔杖在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the magic wand for the show?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (舞台助手)
messages.zh: 在桌上，帽子旁边。
messages.en: It's on the table, next to the hat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bakketta 想成手中挥动的细棒：魔术师挥它是魔杖，乐队指挥挥它是指挥棒。

gloss_zh: 栏杆柱；栏杆的竖向支柱（复数）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The upright posts that support a handrail along stairs, a balcony, or a terrace.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 楼梯、阳台或露台栏杆中支撑扶手的一根根竖向栏杆柱；此词为复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pilastri żgħar weqfin li jsostnu l-parti ta' fuq ta' poġġaman fuq taraġ, gallarija jew terrazzin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 栏杆柱，沿楼梯、阳台等排列并支撑扶手的竖向小柱，指多根。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pilastri żgħar imqiegħda f'ringiela taħt il-parti ta' fuq ta' poġġaman biex isostnuha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Balusters are upright posts arranged beneath a handrail to support it.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirrakkomanda t-tiswija tal-balavostri tal-ġebel fil-gallarija prinċipali.
formal.en: The report recommends repairing the stone balusters on the main balcony.
formal.zh: 报告建议修缮主阳台上的石制栏杆柱。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għalqu l-gallarija? Toni: Għax xi balavostri huma miksura u jridu jsewwuhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did they close off the balcony? Toni: Because some balusters are broken and need repairing.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他们为什么把阳台封起来了？Toni：因为有几根栏杆柱坏了，需要修理。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.zh: 他们为什么把阳台封起来了？
messages.en: Why did they close off the balcony?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax xi balavostri huma miksura u jridu jsewwuhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax xi balavostri huma miksura u jridu jsewwuhom.
messages.zh: 因为有几根栏杆柱坏了，需要修理。
messages.en: Because some balusters are broken and need repairing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 balavostri 时，想象阳台扶手下面一排竖直小柱；它指这些栏杆柱，并且是复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A covering held above a person, object, or place for shelter or decoration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 架设在人物、物品或某处上方，用于遮蔽或装饰的华盖、罩篷或顶篷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għata miżmuma fl-għoli fuq persuna, oġġett jew post biex tipproteġi jew iżżejjen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 华盖或顶篷，支设在上方以遮蔽或装饰下方人物、物品或空间的覆盖物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għata, ħafna drabi tad-drapp, li tkun sostnuta fuq persuna, oġġett jew spazju għal kenn jew tiżjin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A canopy is a covering supported above someone or something to provide shelter or decoration.

formal.mt: Għaċ-ċerimonja, tqiegħed baldakkin tad-drapp fuq is-siġġu prinċipali.
formal.en: For the ceremony, a fabric canopy was placed above the main chair.
formal.zh: 为举行仪式，主座上方设置了一顶布制华盖。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se noqogħdu waqt iċ-ċerimonja? Mark: Taħt il-baldakkin, ħdejn il-fjuri.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are we going to sit during the ceremony? Mark: Under the canopy, next to the flowers.
colloquial.zh: Sara：仪式期间我们坐在哪里？Mark：在华盖下面，鲜花旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (来宾)
messages.zh: 仪式期间我们坐在哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going to sit during the ceremony?

messages.speaker: Mark (来宾)
messages.zh: 在华盖下面，鲜花旁边。
messages.en: Under the canopy, next to the flowers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baldakkin 记成座位上方撑起的一顶华盖，再用 taħt il-baldakkin 记住“在华盖下”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large sea mammal that breathes air through an opening on top of its head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生活在海中、通过头顶的呼吸孔呼吸空气的大型哺乳动物，即鲸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mammiferu kbir tal-baħar li jieħu n-nifs minn fetħa fin-naħa ta' fuq ta' rasu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鲸，生活在海洋中、用肺呼吸的大型哺乳动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal mammiferu kbir li jgħix fil-baħar u jitla' fil-wiċċ biex jieħu n-nifs.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A whale is a large marine mammal that comes to the surface to breathe air.

formal.mt: Il-filmat juri baliena titla' fil-wiċċ tal-baħar biex tieħu n-nifs.
formal.en: The video shows a whale rising to the surface of the sea to breathe.
formal.zh: 视频展示了一头鲸浮上海面呼吸的情景。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt il-baliena fil-filmat? David: Iva, kienet enormi! Erġa' urini l-filmat.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see the whale in the video? David: Yes, it was enormous! Show me the video again.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你看到视频里的鲸了吗？David：看到了，真大啊！再给我看一遍视频。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到视频里的鲸了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the whale in the video?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet enormi! Erġa' urini l-filmat.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet enormi! Erġa' urini l-filmat.
messages.zh: 看到了，真大啊！再给我看一遍视频。
messages.en: Yes, it was enormous! Show me the video again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 baliena 时想象一头大鲸浮上海面换气，并把 baliena kbira 连起来记作“一头大鲸”。

gloss_zh: 巴尔干的；巴尔干化的、分裂成小单位的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Balkans, or describing something fragmented into smaller separate units.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与巴尔干地区有关的；也可指某个整体分裂成较小、彼此分立的单位的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Balkani, jew li jiddeskrivi ħaġa maqsuma f'unitajiet iżgħar u separati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与巴尔干地区及其国家、人民或文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mar-reġjun tal-Balkani, mal-pajjiżi tiegħu, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-kultura tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something Balkan is connected with the Balkan region, its countries, its people, or their cultures.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴尔干化的；由一个整体分裂成多个较小、彼此分立的国家、群体或单位的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun inqasam minn ħaġa waħda f'diversi stati, gruppi jew unitajiet iżgħar u separati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A balkanised territory or organisation has been divided into smaller units that remain separate from one another.

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel it-tradizzjonijiet mużikali ta' pajjiż balkaniku ma' dawk ta' Malta.
formal.en: The study compares the musical traditions of a Balkan country with those of Malta.
formal.zh: 这项研究比较了一个巴尔干国家与马耳他的音乐传统。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb dwar liema pajjiż hu? Mark: Dwar pajjiż balkaniku; fih ħafna ritratti tal-bliet u tal-muntanji.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which country is this book about? Mark: A Balkan country; it has lots of photos of the towns and mountains.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书介绍的是哪个国家？马克：一个巴尔干国家；里面有很多城镇和山脉的照片。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb dwar liema pajjiż hu?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb dwar liema pajjiż hu?
messages.zh: 这本书介绍的是哪个国家？
messages.en: Which country is this book about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar pajjiż balkaniku; fih ħafna ritratti tal-bliet u tal-muntanji.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar pajjiż balkaniku; fih ħafna ritratti tal-bliet u tal-muntanji.
messages.zh: 一个巴尔干国家；里面有很多城镇和山脉的照片。
messages.en: A Balkan country; it has lots of photos of the towns and mountains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 balkaniku 配上巴尔干地图记忆：谈地理时是“巴尔干的”，谈整体分裂时则是“巴尔干化的”，依上下文区分两义。

gloss_zh: 一团、一块；大量；子弹；炮弹

teaching_sense.en_definition: A compact lump of material, a large quantity, a bullet, or a cannonball, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指聚成一团或一块的物质、大量的某物，也可指子弹或球形炮弹，具体意义由上下文决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Massa magħquda ta' xi materjal, kwantità kbira ta' xi ħaġa, projettili ta' arma tan-nar jew projettili tond ta' kanun, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某种物质聚成的一团或一块。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa jew massa ta' xi materjal magħqud flimkien f'għamla waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lump is a piece or mass of material gathered together into a single shape.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量的某物，强调数量很多。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ammont kbir ta' xi ħaġa, b'enfasi fuq kemm hemm minnha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A large quantity of something means that there is a great deal of it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由枪械发射的子弹弹头。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Projettili żgħir, ġeneralment tal-metall, li jiġi sparat minn arma tan-nar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bullet is a small projectile fired from a gun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由火炮发射的实心球形炮弹。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Projettili solidu u tond li jiġi sparat minn kanun.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cannonball is a solid round projectile fired from a cannon.

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesibixxi balla ta' kanun ħdejn mudell tal-fortizza.
formal.en: The museum displays a cannonball beside a model of the fortress.
formal.zh: 博物馆在堡垒模型旁展出了一颗球形炮弹。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm swielek issewwi l-karozza? Pawlu: Balla flus! Kelli nibdel ħafna partijiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: How much did repairing the car cost you? Pawlu: A lot of money! I had to replace lots of parts.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：修车花了你多少钱？保罗：一大笔钱！我得更换好多零件。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 修车花了你多少钱？
messages.en: How much did repairing the car cost you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Balla flus! Kelli nibdel ħafna partijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Balla flus! Kelli nibdel ħafna partijiet.
messages.zh: 一大笔钱！我得更换好多零件。
messages.en: A lot of money! I had to replace lots of parts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四张场景卡记 balla：黏土对应“一团”，钱对应“大量”，步枪对应“子弹”，火炮对应“球形炮弹”；这是辨义提示，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form of theatrical dance using trained, controlled movements, or a performance in this form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种以经过训练、受到精确控制的舞蹈动作为特点的舞台艺术，也指采用这种形式的演出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma ta' żfin teatrali b'movimenti mħarrġa u kkontrollati, jew spettaklu li juża din il-forma ta' żfin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芭蕾舞；运用规范技巧和受控动作的舞台舞蹈艺术，也指芭蕾舞演出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arti taż-żfin fuq il-palk li tuża tekniki speċifiċi u movimenti preċiżi u kkontrollati, kif ukoll spettaklu ta' dan iż-żfin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ballet is a form of theatrical dance in which performers use carefully trained movements and established techniques.

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat spettaklu tal-ballett biex l-istudenti juru dak li tgħallmu matul is-sena.
formal.en: The school organised a ballet performance so that the students could show what they had learned during the year.
formal.zh: 学校组织了一场芭蕾舞演出，让学生展示他们这一年所学的内容。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tiġi tara l-ispettaklu tal-ballett tiegħi nhar is-Sibt? Nina: Żgur! F'liema ħin jibda?
colloquial.en: Lara: Will you come and watch my ballet performance on Saturday? Nina: Of course! What time does it start?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：星期六你会来看我的芭蕾舞演出吗？妮娜：当然！几点开始？

messages.speaker: Lara (学习芭蕾的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tiġi tara l-ispettaklu tal-ballett tiegħi nhar is-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Tiġi tara l-ispettaklu tal-ballett tiegħi nhar is-Sibt?
messages.zh: 星期六你会来看我的芭蕾舞演出吗？
messages.en: Will you come and watch my ballet performance on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 当然！几点开始？
messages.en: Of course! What time does it start?

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ballett 就联想芭蕾课堂和舞台上的规范动作；把整词与“芭蕾舞”配图记忆，再用 lezzjoni tal-ballett 巩固搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dancing as an activity, or a social event at which people gather to dance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随音乐起舞的活动；也指人们聚集跳舞的社交活动，即舞会。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività taż-żfin, jew okkażjoni soċjali li fiha n-nies jiltaqgħu biex jiżfnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舞蹈或跳舞，即身体随音乐有节奏地运动的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha persuna ċċaqlaq ġisimha bir-ritmu tal-mużika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dance is the activity of moving your body rhythmically to music.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舞会；人们聚集跳舞的社交活动，通常较为正式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Laqgħa soċjali, ġeneralment formali, li fiha n-nies jiltaqgħu biex jiżfnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ball is a social event, usually formal, at which people gather to dance.

formal.mt: L-għaqda se torganizza ballu tal-karità biex tiġbor fondi għat-tfal.
formal.en: The association will organise a charity ball to raise funds for children.
formal.zh: 该协会将举办一场慈善舞会，为儿童筹款。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tiġi miegħi għall-ballu għada? Ġanni: Iva, imma l-ewwel għinni nagħżel x'nilbes!
colloquial.en: Marija: Will you come to the ball with me tomorrow? Ġanni: Yes, but first help me choose what to wear!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：明天你和我一起去舞会吗？詹尼：好，不过先帮我选选穿什么！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天你和我一起去舞会吗？
messages.en: Will you come to the ball with me tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel għinni nagħżel x'nilbes!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel għinni nagħżel x'nilbes!
messages.zh: 好，不过先帮我选选穿什么！
messages.en: Yes, but first help me choose what to wear!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ballu 记成两个相连画面：一个人随音乐跳舞是“舞蹈”，许多人盛装聚集跳舞是“舞会”；与专指芭蕾的 ballett 分开记。

gloss_zh: 波罗的海的；来自波罗的海地区的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with the Baltic Sea or the surrounding region.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与波罗的海或其周边地区有关的，也可指来自该地区的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Baħar Baltiku jew mar-reġjun ta' madwaru, jew li ġej minn dak ir-reġjun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 波罗的海的；波罗的海地区的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirreferi għall-Baħar Baltiku jew għar-reġjun ta' madwaru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Baltic describes something connected with the Baltic Sea or the region surrounding it.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or related to the Baltic
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自波罗的海地区的，或与该地区有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġej mir-reġjun tal-Baħar Baltiku jew li għandu rabta ma' dak ir-reġjun.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something described this way comes from the Baltic region or has a connection with it.

collocations.en: the climate of the Baltic region

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-klima tar-reġjun baltiku u l-effett tagħha fuq l-agrikoltura.
formal.en: The report describes the climate of the Baltic region and its effect on agriculture.
formal.zh: 这份报告介绍了波罗的海地区的气候及其对农业的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dwar liema reġjun qed taqra? Mark: Dwar ir-reġjun baltiku. Nixtieq nżuru fis-sajf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which region are you reading about? Mark: The Baltic region. I'd like to visit it in summer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在读哪个地区的资料？马克：波罗的海地区。我想夏天去那里看看。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在读哪个地区的资料？
messages.en: Which region are you reading about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar ir-reġjun baltiku. Nixtieq nżuru fis-sajf.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar ir-reġjun baltiku. Nixtieq nżuru fis-sajf.
messages.zh: 波罗的海地区。我想夏天去那里看看。
messages.en: The Baltic region. I'd like to visit it in summer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baltiku 与地图上的波罗的海绑定记忆：看到 reġjun baltiku，就想到海域周边的整个地区。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mischievous person, or a dishonest person whose behavior deserves criticism.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指爱捣蛋的人，也可用于责骂行为不诚实、品行恶劣的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel il-praspar, jew persuna diżonesta li ġġib ruħha ħażin ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捣蛋鬼；淘气而常惹麻烦的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tħobb tagħmel il-praspar u ddaħħal lil ħaddieħor fl-inkwiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rascal is someone who behaves mischievously and often causes trouble for other people.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无赖；恶棍；行为卑劣或不诚实的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna diżonesta li tqarraq b'ħaddieħor jew iġġib ruħha b'mod ħażin u ta' min jikkundannah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A scoundrel is a dishonest person who treats others badly and deserves strong criticism.

collocations.en: to behave like a rascal or scoundrel
collocations.zh: 像捣蛋鬼或无赖一样行事

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-banavolja jqarraq bin-nies biex jieħu flushom.
formal.en: In the story, the scoundrel deceives people to take their money.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个无赖欺骗人们，骗取他们的钱财。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ja banavolja! Int ħbejtli ċ-ċwievet? Mark: Iva, kont qed niċċajta. Qegħdin fil-kexxun.
colloquial.en: Maja: You rascal! Did you hide my keys? Mark: Yes, I was joking. They're in the drawer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你这个捣蛋鬼！是你把我的钥匙藏起来了吗？马克：是啊，我开玩笑的。钥匙在抽屉里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你这个捣蛋鬼！是你把我的钥匙藏起来了吗？
messages.en: You rascal! Did you hide my keys?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kont qed niċċajta. Qegħdin fil-kexxun.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kont qed niċċajta. Qegħdin fil-kexxun.
messages.zh: 是啊，我开玩笑的。钥匙在抽屉里。
messages.en: Yes, I was joking. They're in the drawer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记 banavolja：朋友藏钥匙时是“捣蛋鬼”，骗子骗钱时是“无赖”；结合行为和语气判断轻重。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In or to a place other than the one being discussed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在当前所说地点以外的其他地方，或到其他地方去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'post ieħor li mhuwiex dak li qed jissemma, jew lejn post ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在别的地方；到其他地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'xi post ieħor minbarra dak li qed nitkellmu dwaru, jew lejn xi post ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens elsewhere, it happens in a different place from the one being discussed.

formal.mt: Peress li s-sala mhijiex disponibbli, il-laqgħa se ssir band'oħra.
formal.en: As the hall is unavailable, the meeting will take place elsewhere.
formal.zh: 由于礼堂无法使用，会议将在别处举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn m'hemmx mejda vojta. Immorru band'oħra? Mark: Iva, hemm kafetterija oħra ftit passi minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: There isn't a free table here. Shall we go elsewhere? Mark: Yes, there's another café a few steps from here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里没有空桌了。我们去别处好吗？马克：好，离这里几步远还有一家咖啡馆。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn m'hemmx mejda vojta. Immorru band'oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn m'hemmx mejda vojta. Immorru band'oħra?
messages.zh: 这里没有空桌了。我们去别处好吗？
messages.en: There isn't a free table here. Shall we go elsewhere?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm kafetterija oħra ftit passi minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm kafetterija oħra ftit passi minn hawn.
messages.zh: 好，离这里几步远还有一家咖啡馆。
messages.en: Yes, there's another café a few steps from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 band'oħra 与“这里没座位，换个地方”绑定记忆：配合移动动作理解“到别处”，配合事情发生的地点理解“在别处”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of cloth displaying words or a design, hung or carried as a banner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 写有文字或绘有图案、供悬挂或举持展示的布幅或旗幡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp bi kliem jew disinn fuqha, li tiddendel jew tinġarr biex turi messaġġ jew simbolu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于展示文字、图案或标志的横幅或旗幡。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp li ġġorr kliem, disinn jew simbolu u tintwera mdendla jew tinġarr waqt xi attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A banner is a piece of cloth displaying a message or design that people hang up or carry.

formal.mt: L-organizzaturi dendlu bandalora bid-data tal-attività fuq id-daħla tas-sala.
formal.en: The organizers hung a banner showing the event date above the entrance to the hall.
formal.zh: 组织者在礼堂入口上方悬挂了一条标有活动日期的横幅。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se ndendlu l-bandalora? Mark: Fuq il-bieb, biex kulħadd jaraha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we hang the banner? Mark: Above the door, so everyone can see it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们把横幅挂在哪里？马克：挂在门上方，让大家都能看见。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动志愿者)
messages.zh: 我们把横幅挂在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we hang the banner?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动志愿者)
messages.zh: 挂在门上方，让大家都能看见。
messages.en: Above the door, so everyone can see it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bandalora 想成礼堂门口写着活动日期的大横幅，再连同 idendel“悬挂”一起记，形成清楚的动作画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stall where a seller displays and sells goods, especially at a market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供商贩陈列和出售货物的摊位，尤其指市场里的售货摊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post f'suq fejn bejjiegħ juri u jbigħ il-prodotti tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: stall (e.g as used by market hawkers)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 摊位，指市场商贩等用来陈列和出售商品的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post fejn bejjiegħ iqiegħed il-merkanzija tiegħu għall-wiri u għall-bejgħ, speċjalment f'suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stall is a place where a seller displays goods and sells them to customers, especially in a market.

formal.mt: Il-bejjiegħ jarma l-banka tiegħu fis-suq kull nhar ta' Sibt.
formal.en: The seller sets up his stall at the market every Saturday.
formal.zh: 这位商贩每周六都在市场摆摊。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn xtrajt dan it-tadam? Pawlu: Mill-banka ħdejn id-daħla tas-suq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you buy these tomatoes? Pawlu: From the stall near the market entrance.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些西红柿你是在哪儿买的？保罗：在市场入口附近的摊位买的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些西红柿你是在哪儿买的？
messages.en: Where did you buy these tomatoes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 在市场入口附近的摊位买的。
messages.en: From the stall near the market entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 banka 和市场里摆满蔬菜的摊位画面绑定，再用 banka tal-ħaxix 整组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A seat without a back or armrests, usually for one person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常供一人坐、没有靠背和扶手的凳子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sedil għal persuna waħda, mingħajr dahar jew postijiet fejn isserraħ id-dirgħajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凳子，通常指没有靠背和扶手的单人座具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa għamara li tintuża biex toqgħod bilqiegħda fuqha u li ma jkollhiex dahar jew postijiet fejn isserraħ id-dirgħajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stool is a seat for one person that has no back or armrests.

formal.mt: Fil-kċina hemm banketta tal-injam ħdejn il-mejda.
formal.en: There is a wooden stool beside the table in the kitchen.
formal.zh: 厨房里，桌子旁边放着一张木凳。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn nista' noqgħod bilqiegħda? Mark: Ħu dik il-banketta ħdejn il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where can I sit? Mark: Take that stool beside the table.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我可以坐哪儿？马克：拿桌子旁边那张凳子坐吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (客人)
messages.zh: 我可以坐哪儿？
messages.en: Where can I sit?

messages.speaker: Mark (主人)
messages.zh: 拿桌子旁边那张凳子坐吧。
messages.en: Take that stool beside the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 banketta 就想象桌旁一张没有靠背的木凳，并配合“坐上去”的动作记忆。

gloss_zh: 横幅广告；网页横幅广告

teaching_sense.en_definition: An advertisement displayed as a banner on a web page.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在网页上以横幅形式展示的广告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reklam li jidher bħala strixxa jew kaxxa grafika fuq paġna tal-web.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 横幅广告，此处指网页上以横幅形式展示的广告。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strixxa jew kaxxa grafika fuq paġna tal-web li tintuża biex turi reklam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A banner in this context is a graphic advertisement displayed in a designated area of a web page.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 网页横幅广告，以横幅式图文版面呈现的网络广告。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reklam fuq paġna tal-web li juża strixxa jew kaxxa grafika biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni lejn prodott, servizz jew offerta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A banner ad is an online advertisement presented as a graphic panel on a web page.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 网页广告横幅，用于展示广告内容的网页图形区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona grafika f'paġna tal-web li turi messaġġ ta' reklamar, ħafna drabi b'rabta għal paġna oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A web banner is a graphic area on a website used to display advertising content.

collocations.mt: banner ad fil-parti ta' fuq tal-paġna
collocations.en: a banner ad at the top of the page

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija poġġiet banner ad fil-parti ta' fuq tal-paġna biex tirreklama l-kors il-ġdid.
formal.en: The company placed a banner ad at the top of the page to advertise the new course.
formal.zh: 该公司在页面顶部放置了一则横幅广告，宣传新课程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn rajt ir-reklam tal-kors? Ben: Kien hemm banner ad fin-naħa ta' fuq tal-paġna. Għafast fuqu biex naqra aktar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you see the course advertisement? Ben: There was a banner ad at the top of the page. I clicked on it to read more.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在哪儿看到课程广告的？本：页面顶部有一则横幅广告。我点进去看了更多介绍。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你在哪儿看到课程广告的？
messages.en: Where did you see the course advertisement?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm banner ad fin-naħa ta' fuq tal-paġna. Għafast fuqu biex naqra aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm banner ad fin-naħa ta' fuq tal-paġna. Għafast fuqu biex naqra aktar.
messages.zh: 页面顶部有一则横幅广告。我点进去看了更多介绍。
messages.en: There was a banner ad at the top of the page. I clicked on it to read more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 banner ad 想成网页顶部的一条广告横幅，用“看到横幅、点击广告”的连续画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have remained alive after danger or a life-threatening event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经历危险或可能致命的事件后仍然活着；该形式表示“他活了下来”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompla jgħix wara periklu jew ġrajja li setgħet wasslet għall-mewt tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在危险、事故或其他可能致命的情况中幸存下来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jekk xi ħadd baqa' ħaj, kompla jgħix minkejja periklu jew ġrajja li setgħet qatletu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone survived, they remained alive after an event that could have killed them.

collocations.zh: 尽管受了伤，仍然活了下来

formal.mt: Ir-raġel baqa' ħaj wara l-inċident u ttieħed l-isptar għall-kura.
formal.en: The man survived the accident and was taken to hospital for treatment.
formal.zh: 这名男子在事故中幸存，随后被送往医院接受治疗。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'ġara mix-xufier wara l-inċident? Leo: Baqa' ħaj, u issa qed jirkupra l-isptar.
colloquial.en: Marta: What happened to the driver after the accident? Leo: He survived, and now he is recovering in hospital.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：事故发生后，那位司机怎么样了？莱奥：他活下来了，现在正在医院康复。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 事故发生后，那位司机怎么样了？
messages.en: What happened to the driver after the accident?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Baqa' ħaj, u issa qed jirkupra l-isptar.
messages.mt_standard: Baqa' ħaj, u issa qed jirkupra l-isptar.
messages.zh: 他活下来了，现在正在医院康复。
messages.en: He survived, and now he is recovering in hospital.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baqa' ħaj 连着记成“他仍然活着”：脑中想象事故后获救的人，用完整情境记住“幸存”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that I still have something left.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某物经过使用、花费或减少后，我仍有剩余。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex ngħid li għad għandi xi ħaġa wara li użajt jew nefaq parti minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我还剩下；表示我仍有某物可用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li turi li għad għandi xi ħaġa disponibbli jew li xi ħaġa għadha ma ntemmitlix.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to say that you still have something left after some has been used or spent.

collocations.en: I still have a little time left
I still have a little money left
I still have one book left

formal.mt: Wara li ħallast il-kont, baqagħli euro wieħed biss.
formal.en: After paying the bill, I had only one euro left.
formal.zh: 付完账后，我只剩下一欧元。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek ħin għal kafè? Adam: Iva, baqagħli ftit ħin qabel il-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have time for a coffee? Adam: Yes, I still have a little time before the lesson.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你有时间喝杯咖啡吗？亚当：有，上课前我还剩下一点时间。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你有时间喝杯咖啡吗？
messages.en: Do you have time for a coffee?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, baqagħli ftit ħin qabel il-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, baqagħli ftit ħin qabel il-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 有，上课前我还剩下一点时间。
messages.en: Yes, I still have a little time before the lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baqagħli 整体记成“我还剩下”，想象付账后数零钱，再替换练习剩余的钱或时间。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person regarded as uncivilized or as behaving with extreme cruelty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被认为缺乏文明教养或行为极其残暴的人；用于评价人时带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna meqjusa bla ċiviltà jew li ġġib ruħha bi krudeltà kbira; il-kelma tintuża b'sens ta' disprezz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 野蛮人；被认为没有文明教养或行为残暴的人，含贬义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Barbaru huwa bniedem meqjus bla ċiviltà jew li jittratta lil ħaddieħor bi krudeltà u mingħajr rispett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you call someone a barbarian, you are expressing disapproval of behaviour you consider uncivilized or cruel.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-awtur jippreżenta lill-karattru bħala barbaru li jittratta lil ħaddieħor bi krudeltà.
formal.en: In the story, the author presents the character as a barbarian who treats others cruelly.
formal.zh: 在这篇故事中，作者把这个角色描写成一个残酷对待他人的野蛮人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex sejjaħtlu barbaru? Mark: Għax daħal jgħajjat u kisser is-siġġijiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you call him a barbarian? Mark: Because he came in shouting and smashed the chairs.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么叫他野蛮人？马克：因为他一进来就大喊大叫，还砸坏了椅子。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么叫他野蛮人？
messages.en: Why did you call him a barbarian?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax daħal jgħajjat u kisser is-siġġijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għax daħal jgħajjat u kisser is-siġġijiet.
messages.zh: 因为他一进来就大喊大叫，还砸坏了椅子。
messages.en: Because he came in shouting and smashed the chairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用短语 bħal barbaru“像个野蛮人”联想粗暴砸椅子的场景；记住这里指人，而且带有贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular type of necklace worn as an ornament around the neck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种戴在颈部作装饰的项链，名称为 barbazzall。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' ġiżirana li tintlibes madwar l-għonq bħala tiżjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种项链的名称，指佩戴在颈部的饰物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Barbazzall huwa tip ta' ġiżirana li persuna tilbes madwar għonqha bħala ornament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A barbazzall is a particular kind of necklace that someone wears around their neck as jewellery.

collocations.zh: 佩戴一条 barbazzall 项链
购买一条 barbazzall 项链

formal.mt: Għall-okkażjoni, għażlet barbazzall li jaqbel mal-libsa tagħha.
formal.en: For the occasion, she chose a barbazzall necklace that matched her dress.
formal.zh: 为了出席这次活动，她选了一条与连衣裙相配的 barbazzall 项链。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'se tilbes ma' dik il-libsa? Rita: Se nilbes il-barbazzall li xtrajt ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you going to wear with that dress? Rita: I am going to wear the barbazzall necklace I bought yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你打算用什么搭配那条连衣裙？丽塔：我打算戴昨天买的那条 barbazzall 项链。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算用什么搭配那条连衣裙？
messages.en: What are you going to wear with that dress?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nilbes il-barbazzall li xtrajt ilbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Se nilbes il-barbazzall li xtrajt ilbieraħ.
messages.zh: 我打算戴昨天买的那条 barbazzall 项链。
messages.en: I am going to wear the barbazzall necklace I bought yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 barbazzall 写在项链图旁，再配上 tilbes barbazzall“戴这种项链”；用佩戴动作记住它是项链的一种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A kind of owl called a barn owl.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鸮类鸟，英语称为 barn owl，中文称为仓鸮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur li huwa tip ta' kokka u li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ barn owl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仓鸮，一种鸮类鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-barbaġann huwa għasfur tat-tip tal-kokki, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala barn owl.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A barn owl is a particular kind of owl.

collocations.en: the flight of the barn owl

formal.mt: Fl-attività tal-iskola, l-istudenti ħarsu lejn ritratt ta' barbaġann u kitbu deskrizzjoni qasira tiegħu.
formal.en: During the school activity, the students looked at a photograph of a barn owl and wrote a short description of it.
formal.zh: 在学校活动中，学生们观看了一张仓鸮的照片，并为它写了一段简短的描述。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Dak barbaġann. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ barn owl.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is the bird in this photograph called? Pawlu: That is a barbaġann. In English, it is called a barn owl.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：照片里的这种鸟叫什么？保罗：那是仓鸮，马耳他语叫 barbaġann，英语叫 barn owl。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这种鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is the bird in this photograph called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak barbaġann. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ barn owl.
messages.mt_standard: Dak barbaġann. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ barn owl.
messages.zh: 那是仓鸮，马耳他语叫 barbaġann，英语叫 barn owl。
messages.en: That is a barbaġann. In English, it is called a barn owl.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张仓鸮图片卡，正面写 barbaġann，背面写“仓鸮／barn owl”，每次看图都完整读出这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strip of hair growing down the side of the face in front of an ear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长在耳朵前方、沿脸颊侧面向下延伸的一条毛发，即鬓角。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strixxa ta' xagħar li tikber mal-ġenb tal-wiċċ, quddiem il-widna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鬓角；耳朵前方沿脸部侧面生长的一条毛发。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strixxa ta' xagħar quddiem il-widna li tinżel mal-ġenb tal-wiċċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sideburn is a strip of hair that grows down the side of someone's face in front of an ear.

formal.mt: Il-barbier qassar il-barbetta fuq in-naħa tax-xellug skont ix-xewqa tal-klijent.
formal.en: The barber shortened the sideburn on the left according to the client's wishes.
formal.zh: 理发师按照顾客的意愿剪短了左侧的鬓角。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tqassarli ftit il-barbetta fuq ix-xellug? Pawlu: Żgur. Hekk tajjeb? Mark: Iva, grazzi!
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you shorten my left sideburn a little? Pawlu: Of course. Is that all right? Mark: Yes, thanks!
colloquial.zh: Mark：你能把我左边的鬓角稍微剪短一点吗？Pawlu：当然。这样可以吗？Mark：可以，谢谢！

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tqassarli ftit il-barbetta fuq ix-xellug?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tqassarli ftit il-barbetta fuq ix-xellug?
messages.zh: 你能把我左边的鬓角稍微剪短一点吗？
messages.en: Can you shorten my left sideburn a little?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (理发师)
messages.zh: 当然。这样可以吗？
messages.en: Of course. Is that all right?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 可以，谢谢！
messages.en: Yes, thanks!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 barbetta 和耳前的一条鬓角配成图卡，指着脸部两侧练习记忆，避免与整个胡须混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose job is to cut hair and shave or trim beards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以剪发、剃须或修整胡须为职业的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li taqta' x-xagħar u tqaxxar jew tirranġa d-daqna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 理发师；从事剪发、剃须及修整胡须工作的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taqta' x-xagħar u tieħu ħsieb id-daqna tal-klijenti bħala xogħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A barber is someone whose job is to cut people's hair and shave or trim their beards.

formal.mt: Il-barbier jiddiskuti mal-klijent kif jixtieq jaqta' xagħru qabel jibda jaħdem.
formal.en: The barber discusses with the client how he would like his hair cut before starting work.
formal.zh: 理发师在开始工作前，会与顾客讨论他希望剪成什么样的发型。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Fejn sejjer? Mark: Għand il-barbier. Għandi appuntament fl-erbgħa. Luca: Tajjeb, narak wara!
colloquial.en: Luca: Where are you going? Mark: To the barber. I have an appointment at four. Luca: All right, see you later!
colloquial.zh: Luca：你要去哪里？Mark：去理发师那里。我约了四点。Luca：好，回头见！

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 去理发师那里。我约了四点。
messages.en: To the barber. I have an appointment at four.

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，回头见！
messages.en: All right, see you later!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 barbier 放进理发店的画面：手拿剪刀、替顾客剪发的人就是 barbier，再连读 għand il-barbier。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A meal or gathering where food is cooked on a grill, usually outdoors.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常在户外用烤架烹制食物的一餐，或以这种食物为主的聚会。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikla jew laqgħa fejn l-ikel jissajjar fuq gradilja, normalment fil-beraħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烧烤；通常在户外用烤架烹制食物的用餐活动或聚餐。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikla li għaliha l-ikel jissajjar fuq gradilja, spiss barra, jew laqgħa fejn jittiekel dan l-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A barbecue is a meal or social gathering at which food is cooked on a grill, usually outdoors.

formal.mt: L-għaqda se torganizza barbikju fil-ġnien nhar is-Sibt biex tiġbor fondi għall-attivitajiet tagħha.
formal.en: The association will organize a barbecue in the garden on Saturday to raise funds for its activities.
formal.zh: 该协会将于星期六在花园举办烧烤聚会，为协会活动筹款。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nhar is-Sibt se nagħmlu barbikju fil-ġnien. Tiġi? Sara: Iva! X'għandi nġib? Maja: Ġib ftit ħaxix biex nixwuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: We're having a barbecue in the garden on Saturday. Are you coming? Sara: Yes! What should I bring? Maja: Bring some vegetables for us to grill.
colloquial.zh: Maja：星期六我们要在花园烧烤。你来吗？Sara：来！我该带什么？Maja：带些蔬菜来烤吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (聚会主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Nhar is-Sibt se nagħmlu barbikju fil-ġnien. Tiġi?
messages.mt_standard: Nhar is-Sibt se nagħmlu barbikju fil-ġnien. Tiġi?
messages.zh: 星期六我们要在花园烧烤。你来吗？
messages.en: We're having a barbecue in the garden on Saturday. Are you coming?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 来！我该带什么？
messages.en: Yes! What should I bring?

messages.speaker: Maja (聚会主人)
messages.zh: 带些蔬菜来烤吧。
messages.en: Bring some vegetables for us to grill.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 barbikju 与花园、烤架和朋友聚餐连成一幅画，整句记住 nagħmlu barbikju，表示我们办烧烤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Maltese dish made by cooking tomatoes and eggs together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将番茄与鸡蛋一起烹制而成的一道马耳他菜肴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Platt Malti magħmul mit-tadam u l-bajd imsajra flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他的一道番茄鸡蛋菜，以番茄和鸡蛋共同烹制而成。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Platt tal-kċina Maltija li jitħejja billi jissajru t-tadam u l-bajd flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Barbuljata is a Maltese dish in which tomatoes and eggs are cooked together.

collocations.zh: 制作马耳他番茄鸡蛋菜
一盘马耳他番茄鸡蛋菜

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni tat-tisjir, l-istudenti se jippreparaw il-barbuljata billi jsajru t-tadam u l-bajd flimkien.
formal.en: In this cooking lesson, the students will prepare barbuljata by cooking tomatoes and eggs together.
formal.zh: 在这节烹饪课上，学生将把番茄与鸡蛋一起烹制，做成马耳他番茄鸡蛋菜。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'se nsajru llejla? Toni: Nagħmlu barbuljata? Għandna t-tadam u l-bajd. Nina: Iva, jien naħsel it-tadam.
colloquial.en: Nina: What shall we cook tonight? Toni: Shall we make barbuljata? We have tomatoes and eggs. Nina: Yes, I'll wash the tomatoes.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们今晚做什么菜？Toni：做马耳他番茄鸡蛋菜怎么样？我们有番茄和鸡蛋。Nina：好，我来洗番茄。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 我们今晚做什么菜？
messages.en: What shall we cook tonight?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmlu barbuljata? Għandna t-tadam u l-bajd.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmlu barbuljata? Għandna t-tadam u l-bajd.
messages.zh: 做马耳他番茄鸡蛋菜怎么样？我们有番茄和鸡蛋。
messages.en: Shall we make barbuljata? We have tomatoes and eggs.

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我来洗番茄。
messages.en: Yes, I'll wash the tomatoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 barbuljata 配一张番茄与鸡蛋同锅烹制的图卡，再加上马耳他标签，用食材和菜名一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flounder of the species Platichthys flesus flesus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Platichthys flesus flesus 的欧洲川鲽，是一种身体扁平的鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta ċatta tal-ispeċi Platichthys flesus flesus.

sense_translations.en_definition: flounder (fish of the species Platichthys flesus flesus)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 欧洲川鲽，学名为 Platichthys flesus flesus 的比目鱼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħuta b'ġisem ċatt li tappartjeni għall-ispeċi Platichthys flesus flesus.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A barbun is a flatfish belonging to the species Platichthys flesus flesus.

formal.mt: Il-barbun huwa ħuta ċatta tal-ispeċi Platichthys flesus flesus.
formal.en: The flounder is a flatfish of the species Platichthys flesus flesus.
formal.zh: 欧洲川鲽是一种学名为 Platichthys flesus flesus 的扁平鱼类。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ħuta se nsajru llum? Toni: Se nsajru barbun fil-forn.
colloquial.en: Maja: What fish are we cooking today? Toni: We are going to bake a flounder.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们今天做什么鱼？托尼：我们准备烤一条欧洲川鲽。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今天做什么鱼？
messages.en: What fish are we cooking today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们准备烤一条欧洲川鲽。
messages.en: We are going to bake a flounder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 barbun 和一条身体扁平的欧洲川鲽配成词图卡，再用 barbun frisk（新鲜的欧洲川鲽）整组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of the city Barcelona.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 城市名称“巴塞罗那”，书写时首字母大写。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju tal-belt ta' Barcelona, li jinkiteb b'ittra kapitali fil-bidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴塞罗那，城市的专有名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-isem proprju li bih tissejjaħ il-belt ta' Barcelona.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Barcelona is a proper name used to identify the city of that name.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-vjaġġ jinkludi żjara f'Barcelona.
formal.en: The travel itinerary includes a visit to Barcelona.
formal.zh: 旅行行程包括游览巴塞罗那。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Mark: Se mmur Barcelona għal ftit jiem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I am going to Barcelona for a few days.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你准备去哪里度假？马克：我准备去巴塞罗那待几天。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你准备去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur Barcelona għal ftit jiem.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur Barcelona għal ftit jiem.
messages.zh: 我准备去巴塞罗那待几天。
messages.en: I am going to Barcelona for a few days.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Barcelona 直接对应中文地名“巴塞罗那”，并记住地名首字母大写；用 lejn Barcelona 记“前往巴塞罗那”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A machine-readable code represented by a linear arrangement of bars and spaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由条线和空隙按一定顺序排列、供机器读取信息的一维条形码。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kodiċi magħmul minn sensiela ta' vireg u spazji li jista' jinqara minn apparat biex tinkiseb informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一维条形码，以单一方向上条线和空隙的排列编码信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kodiċi b'dimensjoni waħda li jaħżen informazzjoni permezz ta' vireg u spazji rranġati f'direzzjoni waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A 1D barcode represents information through bars and spaces arranged along a single direction.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 条形码，由机器可读的条线及空隙组成的信息标记。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kodiċi magħmul minn vireg u spazji li apparat jista' jaqra biex jidentifika oġġett jew jikseb informazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A barcode is a machine-readable arrangement of bars and spaces that represents information.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 线性条形码，通过沿一个方向排列的条线和空隙表示信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kodiċi lineari li jirrappreżenta informazzjoni b'sensiela ta' vireg u spazji rranġati f'direzzjoni waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A linear barcode encodes information in a sequence of bars and spaces along one direction.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一维条码，仅利用一个方向上的条线和空隙变化来编码信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kodiċi li juża dimensjoni waħda biex jirrappreżenta informazzjoni permezz tal-varjazzjoni fil-vireg u fl-ispazji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A one-dimensional barcode stores information through variations in bars and spaces along a single direction.

formal.mt: Qabel tirreġistra l-prodott, skennja l-barcode fuq it-tikketta.
formal.en: Before registering the product, scan the barcode on the label.
formal.zh: 登记产品之前，请扫描标签上的条形码。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu l-barcode fuq din il-kaxxa? Rita: Fuq wara, ħdejn il-prezz.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the barcode on this box? Rita: On the back, next to the price.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个盒子的条形码在哪里？丽塔：在背面，价格旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-barcode fuq din il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-barcode fuq din il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 这个盒子的条形码在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the barcode on this box?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 在背面，价格旁边。
messages.en: On the back, next to the price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 barcode 和商品标签上一排粗细不同的竖条联系起来；四个释义围绕同一类条码，1D、linear 和 one-dimensional 都提示一维排列。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Smallpox, an infectious viral disease associated with fever and a characteristic skin rash.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天花，一种可引起发热和特征性皮疹的病毒性传染病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marda infettiva kkawżata minn virus, li tista' ġġib deni u raxx karatteristiku fuq il-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天花，由病毒引起、可出现发热和特征性皮疹的传染病。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marda virali li tittieħed u li tista' tikkawża deni u raxx karatteristiku fuq il-ġilda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Smallpox is an infectious viral disease that causes fever and a distinctive skin rash.

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi każ ta' barjola u s-sintomi tal-marda.
formal.en: The text describes a case of smallpox and the symptoms of the disease.
formal.zh: 这篇文章描述了一例天花病例及这种疾病的症状。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser il-kelma barjola f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Hija l-isem ta' marda; bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ smallpox.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the word barjola mean in this text? Pawlu: It is the name of a disease; in English it is called smallpox.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这篇文章里的 barjola 是什么意思？保罗：这是一种疾病的名称，英语叫 smallpox，也就是天花。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma barjola f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma barjola f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 barjola 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word barjola mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija l-isem ta' marda; bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ smallpox.
messages.mt_standard: Hija l-isem ta' marda; bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ smallpox.
messages.zh: 这是一种疾病的名称，英语叫 smallpox，也就是天花。
messages.en: It is the name of a disease; in English it is called smallpox.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 barjola、天花、smallpox 写在同一张三语词卡上，再用 każ ta' barjola（一个天花病例）练习，固定疾病名称的对应关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who operates a small boat, often carrying passengers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 操纵小船的人，常负责用船接送乘客。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi dgħajsa, spiss biex iġġorr il-passiġġieri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船夫；操纵小船或用小船接送人的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Barklor huwa persuna li tmexxi dgħajsa u tista' ġġorr in-nies minn post għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A boatsman is someone who operates a small boat, often taking passengers from one place to another.

formal.mt: Il-barklor wassal lill-passiġġieri lejn ix-xatt l-ieħor tal-port.
formal.en: The boatman took the passengers to the other side of the harbour.
formal.zh: 船夫把乘客送到了港口的另一岸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jwassalna sax-xatt l-ieħor? Mark: Il-barklor qed jistenniena ħdejn id-dgħajsa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will take us to the other shore? Mark: The boatman is waiting for us by the boat.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁来送我们到对岸？Mark：船夫正在船边等我们。

messages.speaker: Maja (旅客)
messages.zh: 谁来送我们到对岸？
messages.en: Who will take us to the other shore?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 船夫正在船边等我们。
messages.en: The boatman is waiting for us by the boat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 barklor 和“船边等候、接送乘客的船夫”这一画面绑定，记住它指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A floating platform or supporting structure, or a large flat-bottomed boat used to carry goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作平台或支撑物的浮体；也指运输货物的大型平底驳船。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura li żżomm f'wiċċ l-ilma u tintuża bħala pjattaforma jew appoġġ, jew dgħajsa kbira b'qiegħ ċatt għat-trasport tal-merkanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浮台或浮箱：漂浮在水面上，用作平台或支撑浮桥等设施的结构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Barkun huwa struttura li żżomm f'wiċċ l-ilma u tintuża bħala pjattaforma jew bħala appoġġ għal pont jew struttura oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pontoon is a floating structure used as a platform or to support something such as a bridge.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驳船：主要用于水上运输货物的大型平底船。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Barkun huwa dgħajsa kbira b'qiegħ ċatt li tintuża l-aktar biex iġġorr il-merkanzija fuq l-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A barge is a large flat-bottomed boat used mainly for carrying goods along waterways.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema użaw barkun bħala pjattaforma waqt it-tiswija tal-moll; barkun ieħor ġarr il-materjal meħtieġ.
formal.en: The workers used a pontoon as a platform while repairing the quay; another barge carried the necessary materials.
formal.zh: 工人在维修码头时用一座浮台作为作业平台；另一艘驳船运送了所需材料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-barkun x'qed iġorr? Mark: Qed iġorr ir-ramel għax-xogħol fil-port.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that barge carrying? Mark: It is carrying sand for the work in the harbour.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那艘驳船在运什么？Mark：它在运港口施工用的沙子。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 那艘驳船在运什么？
messages.en: What is that barge carrying?

messages.speaker: Mark (港口工人)
messages.zh: 它在运港口施工用的沙子。
messages.en: It is carrying sand for the work in the harbour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 barkun 配两幅学习图：托住平台的浮箱、装满货物的驳船；用具体用途区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In or to a country other than one's own.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示在本国以外的国家，或前往本国以外的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'pajjiż ieħor li mhuwiex pajjiżek, jew lejn pajjiż bħal dan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在国外或到国外，表示位于或前往本国以外的国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-espressjoni tfisser li persuna tinsab f'pajjiż ieħor jew sejra lejn pajjiż li mhuwiex pajjiżha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone lives or travels overseas, they live in or travel to a country other than their own.

formal.mt: Il-programm jagħti lill-istudenti l-opportunità li jistudjaw barra mill-pajjiż għal sena.
formal.en: The programme gives students the opportunity to study abroad for a year.
formal.zh: 该项目为学生提供到国外学习一年的机会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tkun hawn is-sena d-dieħla? Mark: Le, se nistudja barra mill-pajjiż għal sena.
colloquial.en: Maja: Will you be here next year? Mark: No, I will be studying abroad for a year.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你明年会在这里吗？Mark：不会，我要去国外学习一年。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你明年会在这里吗？
messages.en: Will you be here next year?

messages.speaker: Mark (准备留学的同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, se nistudja barra mill-pajjiż għal sena.
messages.mt_standard: Le, se nistudja barra mill-pajjiż għal sena.
messages.zh: 不会，我要去国外学习一年。
messages.en: No, I will be studying abroad for a year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 barra mill-pajjiż 整块记成“在国外／到国外”，配合学习、工作、旅行三个场景反复练习。

gloss_zh: 除……之外还；除……之外不包括

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to add someone or something to what has already been mentioned, or to exclude someone or something from a statement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于表示在已提及的人或事物之外另有补充，也可表示从某一范围中排除某人或某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex iżżid persuna jew ħaġa ma' dak li diġà ssemma, jew biex teskludi persuna jew ħaġa minn dak li jingħad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 除……之外还；表示在已有的人或事物之外再作补充。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tindika persuna jew ħaġa oħra flimkien ma' dik li diġà ssemmiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression when adding another person or thing to those already mentioned.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 除……之外；表示某人或某物不包括在所述范围内。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tindika persuna jew ħaġa li mhix inkluża fil-grupp jew fis-sitwazzjoni msemmija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression when excluding someone or something from a general statement.

formal.mt: Barra minn żewġ kotba, l-istudenti għandhom iġibu wkoll pitazz.
formal.en: Besides two books, the students should also bring a notebook.
formal.zh: 学生除了两本书之外，还应带一本笔记本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kulħadd ġie għal-laqgħa? Lara: Iva, kulħadd barra minn Mark. Maja: Mela nistennewh ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did everyone come to the meeting? Lara: Yes, everyone except Mark. Maja: Then let's wait for him a little.
colloquial.zh: Maja：大家都来开会了吗？Lara：是的，除了 Mark 都来了。Maja：那我们等他一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 大家都来开会了吗？
messages.en: Did everyone come to the meeting?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 是的，除了 Mark 都来了。
messages.en: Yes, everyone except Mark.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 那我们等他一会儿吧。
messages.en: Then let's wait for him a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进两个句框记忆：搭配“还、也”时想到补充，搭配“所有人”并指出例外时想到排除；同一句式要结合上下文判断。

gloss_zh: 失去知觉的；处于无意识状态的

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a state in which a person is not awake or aware of what is happening around them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人失去知觉，不能清醒地感知周围所发生的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fi stat li fih persuna tkun tilfet is-sensi u ma tkunx konxja ta' dak li qed jiġri madwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失去知觉的；无法清醒地感知周围情况的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li tkun tilfet is-sensi u ma tkunx konxja ta' dak li qed jiġri madwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is in this state has lost consciousness and is unaware of their surroundings.

collocations.zh: 他们发现了一名失去知觉的男子

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jgħid li r-raġel kien barra minn sensih meta waslet l-ambulanza.
formal.en: The report states that the man was unconscious when the ambulance arrived.
formal.zh: 报告指出，救护车到达时，该男子处于无意识状态。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu sema' dak li għedt? Mark: Le, kien barra minn sensih dak il-ħin. Lara: U issa kif inhu? Mark: Issa jinsab aħjar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Pawlu hear what I said? Mark: No, he was unconscious at the time. Lara: And how is he now? Mark: He is better now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu 听见我说的话了吗？Mark：没有，他当时失去了知觉。Lara：那他现在怎么样？Mark：他现在好些了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 听见我说的话了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu hear what I said?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien barra minn sensih dak il-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien barra minn sensih dak il-ħin.
messages.zh: 没有，他当时失去了知觉。
messages.en: No, he was unconscious at the time.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那他现在怎么样？
messages.en: And how is he now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他现在好些了。
messages.en: He is better now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“叫他却没有清醒回应”的场景一起记，学习时整块对应“失去知觉”，避免只记住其中的 barra minn。

gloss_zh: 梭鱼；海中体形细长、牙齿尖利的捕食性鱼类

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long, predatory sea fish with a large mouth and sharp teeth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种身体细长、嘴大且牙齿尖利的海洋捕食性鱼类，称为梭鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta tal-baħar b'ġisem twil, ħalq kbir u snien jaqtgħu, li tikkaċċja ħut ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梭鱼：身体细长、嘴大、牙齿尖利，以其他鱼类为食的海鱼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Barrakuda hija ħuta tal-baħar b'ġisem twil u snien jaqtgħu li titma' minn ħut ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A barracuda is a long sea fish with sharp teeth that hunts and eats other fish.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni taħt l-ilma, it-tim ra barrakuda tgħum qrib il-blat.
formal.en: During the underwater observation, the team saw a barracuda swimming near the rocks.
formal.zh: 在水下观察期间，团队看到一条梭鱼在岩石附近游动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik il-ħuta twila fir-ritratt? Mark: Dik barrakuda. Ara kemm għandha snien jaqtgħu!
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that long fish in the photograph? Mark: That is a barracuda. Look how sharp its teeth are!
colloquial.zh: Maja：照片里那条长长的鱼是什么鱼？Mark：那是梭鱼。看它的牙齿多尖利！

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里那条长长的鱼是什么鱼？
messages.en: What is that long fish in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik barrakuda. Ara kemm għandha snien jaqtgħu!
messages.mt_standard: Dik barrakuda. Ara kemm għandha snien jaqtgħu!
messages.zh: 那是梭鱼。看它的牙齿多尖利！
messages.en: That is a barracuda. Look how sharp its teeth are!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 barrakuda 与英语 barracuda 对照记忆，再配上“细长身体、尖牙捕食”的海鱼图像。

gloss_zh: 路障；用于阻挡通行的障碍物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A barrier placed across a road or entrance to prevent people or vehicles from passing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设置在道路或入口处，用来阻止人员或车辆通过的障碍物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ostaklu mqiegħed fi triq jew quddiem daħla biex ma jħallix nies jew vetturi jgħaddu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 路障；为阻止人员或车辆通行而设置的障碍物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ostaklu li jitqiegħed biex jagħlaq passaġġ u jwaqqaf il-mogħdija tan-nies jew tal-vetturi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A barricade is a barrier put across a route to stop people or vehicles from passing.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema waqqfu barrikata fid-daħla tat-triq biex il-vetturi ma jgħaddux waqt ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The workers put up a barricade at the entrance to the road to prevent vehicles from passing during the work.
formal.zh: 工人在道路入口设置了路障，以防车辆在施工期间通行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn? Mark: Hemm barrikata quddiemna. Maja: Mela ngħaddu mit-triq l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't we go through here? Mark: There is a barricade in front of us. Maja: Then let's take the other road.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们为什么不能从这里过去？Mark：前面有一道路障。Maja：那我们走另一条路吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn?
messages.zh: 我们为什么不能从这里过去？
messages.en: Why can't we go through here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 前面有一道路障。
messages.en: There is a barricade in front of us.

messages.speaker: Maja (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们走另一条路吧。
messages.en: Then let's take the other road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一条被横向障碍物挡住的道路，把 barrikata 写在障碍物上，再配对练习“设置路障”和“移除路障”。

gloss_zh: 使停止；制止（所给词条标作名词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: In this entry, a noun associated with the action of making something stop.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本词条按所给名词标签处理，释义指使某事停止或不再继续这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'din l-entrata, il-kelma hija mmarkata bħala nom u tirreferi għall-azzjoni li twaqqaf xi ħaġa milli tkompli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使停止；制止。所给英文释义采用动词不定式，但本义项保留所给名词标签。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija hija li twaqqaf xi ħaġa milli tkompli, għalkemm il-kelma hija mmarkata bħala nom f'din l-entrata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss describes making something stop, although this entry labels the word as a noun.

formal.mt: F'dan il-glossarju, 'barring' huwa mmarkat bħala nom, iżda t-tifsira bl-Ingliż hija 'to stop'.
formal.en: In this glossary, 'barring' is labelled as a noun, but its English gloss is 'to stop'.
formal.zh: 在这份词汇表中，“barring”标作名词，但其英文释义是“to stop（使停止）”。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'barring' f'din il-lista? Pawlu: It-tifsira mogħtija hija 'to stop', jiġifieri twaqqaf xi ħaġa. Maja: U kif inhi mmarkata l-kelma? Pawlu: Bħala nom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'barring' mean in this list? Pawlu: The supplied meaning is 'to stop', meaning to make something stop. Maja: And how is the word labelled? Pawlu: As a noun.
