colloquial.zh: Maja：这份表里的“barring”是什么意思？Pawlu：给出的释义是“to stop”，也就是使某事停止。Maja：那这个词标的是什么词性？Pawlu：名词。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这份表里的“barring”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'barring' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifsira mogħtija hija 'to stop', jiġifieri twaqqaf xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: It-tifsira mogħtija hija 'to stop', jiġifieri twaqqaf xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 给出的释义是“to stop”，也就是使某事停止。
messages.en: The supplied meaning is 'to stop', meaning to make something stop.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 那这个词标的是什么词性？
messages.en: And how is the word labelled?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 名词。
messages.en: As a noun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作双栏记忆卡：一栏写“所给词性：名词”，另一栏写“所给释义：使停止”；分开记住两项信息，暂不据此推造词形或搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose specific meaning is not established here.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个具体词义尚未确定的名词；学习时应暂时保留原词，不猜测其所指。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira preċiża tiegħu mhijiex stabbilita hawn u li għandu jinżamm fil-forma oriġinali sakemm tiġi ċċarata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义尚未确定；问号表示缺少可用的释义，并非这个词本身的含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom għadha mhix magħrufa hawn; is-sinjal tal-mistoqsija jindika n-nuqqas ta' definizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning of this noun remains unspecified, so a particular interpretation cannot be taught reliably.

formal.mt: L-istudent għandu jivverifika t-tifsira ta' 'barumbara' qabel juża din il-kelma fil-kitba.
formal.en: The student should verify the meaning of 'barumbara' before using this word in writing.
formal.zh: 学生在写作中使用“barumbara”之前，应先核实它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'barumbara'? Mark: Ma nafx żgur. Ejja nsibu definizzjoni ċara qabel nużawha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'barumbara' mean? Mark: I'm not sure. Let's find a clear definition before using it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：‘barumbara’是什么意思？Mark：我不确定。我们先找到明确的释义，再使用它吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: ‘barumbara’是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'barumbara' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx żgur. Ejja nsibu definizzjoni ċara qabel nużawha.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx żgur. Ejja nsibu definizzjoni ċara qabel nużawha.
messages.zh: 我不确定。我们先找到明确的释义，再使用它吧。
messages.en: I'm not sure. Let's find a clear definition before using it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 barumbara 写在“待查名词”卡片上，先记拼写与名词身份，释义栏暂留问号，避免用猜测形成错误记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An item written as Baruni, with its meaning and grammatical class unspecified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 写作 Baruni 的词项，其具体含义和语法词类尚未明确；学习时保留这一书写形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element miktub fil-forma Baruni li t-tifsira u l-kategorija grammatikali tiegħu mhumiex speċifikati hawn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保留形式 Baruni；尚不能确定它的具体所指或词类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-forma Baruni tinżamm kif inhi, għax it-tifsira speċifika u l-kategorija grammatikali tagħha mhumiex stabbiliti hawn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Baruni is retained in its given form because its specific meaning and grammatical class are not established.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, il-forma 'Baruni' għandha tiġi kkupjata eżattament, bl-ittra B kbira.
formal.en: In the exercise, the form 'Baruni' should be copied exactly, with a capital B.
formal.zh: 在练习中，应准确抄写“Baruni”这一形式，保留大写字母 B。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif nikteb 'Baruni' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Pawlu: Ikkopjaha kif inhi, bl-ittra B kbira.
colloquial.en: Lara: How should I write 'Baruni' in this exercise? Pawlu: Copy it as it is, with a capital B.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这道练习里的‘Baruni’该怎么写？Pawlu：照原样抄写，B 要大写。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这道练习里的‘Baruni’该怎么写？
messages.en: How should I write 'Baruni' in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikkopjaha kif inhi, bl-ittra B kbira.
messages.mt_standard: Ikkopjaha kif inhi, bl-ittra B kbira.
messages.zh: 照原样抄写，B 要大写。
messages.en: Copy it as it is, with a capital B.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆卡正面保留 Baruni 的大写 B，背面标注“词义、词类待明确”；不要仅凭外形联想就指定中文含义。

gloss_zh: 巴斯克的；来自巴斯克地区的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming from or connected with the Basque Country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自巴斯克地区的，或与该地区有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Pajjiż Bask jew li għandu rabta ma' dan ir-reġjun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴斯克的，表示与巴斯克地区有关的属性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Pajjiż Bask, bħall-poplu jew il-kultura tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Basque is connected with the Basque Country, its people, or its culture.

sense_translations.en_definition: coming from or related to the Basque Country
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自巴斯克地区的，或与巴斯克地区存在关联的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joriġina mill-Pajjiż Bask jew li għandu xi rabta ma' dak ir-reġjun.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or thing described this way comes from the Basque Country or has a connection with it.

formal.mt: L-istudenti se jaqraw test ta' kittieb bask u jiddiskutu r-rabta tiegħu mal-Pajjiż Bask.
formal.en: The students will read a text by a Basque writer and discuss his connection with the Basque Country.
formal.zh: 学生们将阅读一位巴斯克作家的作品，并讨论他与巴斯克地区的联系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid nippruvaw xi ikel bask illejla? Mark: Iva! Qatt ma ppruvajtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we try some Basque food tonight? Mark: Yes! I've never tried it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚我们尝尝巴斯克食物好吗？Mark：好啊！我还从没吃过。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid nippruvaw xi ikel bask illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Trid nippruvaw xi ikel bask illejla?
messages.zh: 今晚我们尝尝巴斯克食物好吗？
messages.en: Shall we try some Basque food tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好啊！我还从没吃过。
messages.en: Yes! I've never tried it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bask 与中文“巴斯克”的读音联系起来，再记整块 ikel bask“巴斯克食物”；这里 bask 是说明地域关联的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bag used to carry personal belongings, books, or other items.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来携带个人物品、书本等东西的包；也可具体指书包。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Borża li tintuża biex jinġarru affarijiet personali, kotba jew oġġetti oħra, u li tista' tkun borża tal-iskola.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包，供装入并携带个人物品或其他东西使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Borża li fiha jitqiegħdu oġġetti biex ikunu jistgħu jinġarru minn post għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bag is a container that you use to carry your belongings or other items.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 书包，通常带有肩带，用于携带书本、文件等物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Borża, ġeneralment b'ċinga għall-ispalla, li tintuża biex jinġarru kotba, karti jew affarijiet tal-iskola.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A satchel is a bag, usually with a shoulder strap, used for carrying books or papers.

formal.mt: Kull student għandu jġib basket tal-iskola bil-kotba u l-pitazzi meħtieġa.
formal.en: Each student should bring a school bag containing the required books and exercise books.
formal.zh: 每位学生都应带上书包，装好所需的书籍和练习本。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-basket tiegħi? Omm: Fuq is-siġġu ħdejn il-bieb. Poġġejt il-kotba fih? Lara: Iva, lest għall-iskola.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where's my bag? Mum: On the chair next to the door. Have you put your books in it? Lara: Yes, it's ready for school.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我的包在哪儿？妈妈：在门旁边的椅子上。你把书放进去了吗？Lara：放好了，上学要带的东西都准备好了。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 我的包在哪儿？
messages.en: Where's my bag?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq is-siġġu ħdejn il-bieb. Poġġejt il-kotba fih?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq is-siġġu ħdejn il-bieb. Poġġejt il-kotba fih?
messages.zh: 在门旁边的椅子上。你把书放进去了吗？
messages.en: On the chair next to the door. Have you put your books in it?

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 放好了，上学要带的东西都准备好了。
messages.en: Yes, it's ready for school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把课本放进 basket tal-iskola，连着画面记“书包”；本词条的 basket 对应包或书包，别被英语同形词带偏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sport in which two teams try to score by throwing a ball through the opposing team's raised hoop.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两个队通过将球投入对方高处篮筐来得分的运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sport bejn żewġ timijiet li jippruvaw jiskurjaw billi jitfgħu ballun fil-qoffa għolja tat-tim l-ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 篮球运动：两队通过运球、传球和投篮争取得分的运动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Logħba sportiva bejn żewġ timijiet li jmexxu u jgħaddu ballun b'idejhom u jippruvaw idaħħluh fil-qoffa tat-tim l-ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Basketball is a sport in which two teams score points by throwing a ball through a raised hoop.

formal.mt: L-iskola se torganizza logħba tal-baskitboll bejn żewġ timijiet tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The school will organize a basketball game between two student teams.
formal.zh: 学校将组织两个学生队进行一场篮球比赛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tilgħab il-baskitboll wara l-iskola? Mark: Iva, inġib il-ballun tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to play basketball after school? Mark: Yes, I'll bring my ball.
colloquial.zh: Maja：放学后想打篮球吗？Mark：想，我会带上我的球。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 放学后想打篮球吗？
messages.en: Do you want to play basketball after school?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 想，我会带上我的球。
messages.en: Yes, I'll bring my ball.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baskitboll 和球场上的投篮动作一起记，再用 logħba tal-baskitboll 练习表达“一场篮球比赛”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large vessel used to travel on water and carry people or goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在水上航行、运送人员或货物的大型船只。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mezz kbir tat-trasport li jbaħħar u jintuża biex iġorr passiġġieri jew merkanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船，尤指用于海上航行、载客或运货的大型船只。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dgħajsa kbira li tintuża għall-ivvjaġġar fuq il-baħar jew għat-trasport ta' nies u merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ship is a large vessel that carries people or goods across water.

formal.mt: Il-bastiment tal-passiġġieri wasal fil-port kmieni filgħodu.
formal.en: The passenger ship arrived at the port early in the morning.
formal.zh: 客船于清晨抵达港口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tara dak il-bastiment fil-port? Mark: Iva, huwa kbir ħafna!
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see that ship in the port? Mark: Yes, it's very big!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看见港口里的那艘船了吗？Mark：看见了，真大啊！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见港口里的那艘船了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that ship in the port?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看见了，真大啊！
messages.en: Yes, it's very big!

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 bastiment，就想象港口里的一艘大船；再分别给它贴上“载客”和“运货”的标签，记住两个常用搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ship equipped with machinery for processing products, especially fish, at sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 配有加工机械、可在海上处理产品，尤其是鱼类的船舶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastiment mgħammar b'makkinarju biex jipproċessa prodotti, speċjalment ħut, waqt li jkun fuq il-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工厂船：设有加工设备、可在海上加工鱼类等产品的船。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bastiment li għandu tagħmir ta' fabbrika abbord biex jipproċessa prodotti bħall-ħut fuq il-baħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A factory ship is a ship fitted with equipment for processing products, especially fish, while at sea.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加工船：装有生产加工设施、承担海上产品加工作业的船舶。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bastiment b'faċilitajiet industrijali abbord li jintużaw għall-ipproċessar ta' prodotti waqt li jkun fuq il-baħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A factory vessel is a vessel that carries industrial facilities for processing products at sea.

collocations.en: to work on a factory ship

collocations.zh: 一艘设备齐全的工厂船

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tuża bastiment fabbrika biex tipproċessa u tiffriża l-ħut fuq il-baħar.
formal.en: The company uses a factory ship to process and freeze fish at sea.
formal.zh: 该公司使用工厂船在海上加工并冷冻鱼类。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn jaħdem ħuk? Mark: Fuq bastiment fabbrika. Jipproċessaw il-ħut abbord.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where does your brother work? Mark: On a factory ship. They process fish on board.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你兄弟在哪里工作？Mark：在一艘工厂船上。他们在船上加工鱼。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟在哪里工作？
messages.en: Where does your brother work?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq bastiment fabbrika. Jipproċessaw il-ħut abbord.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq bastiment fabbrika. Jipproċessaw il-ħut abbord.
messages.zh: 在一艘工厂船上。他们在船上加工鱼。
messages.en: On a factory ship. They process fish on board.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bastiment fabbrika 想象成“船上装着加工车间”：一边看见海上的船，一边看见船内处理鱼的设备，就能记住工厂船这一用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An edible root vegetable with a sweet taste, often cooked by baking, boiling, or roasting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种味甜的可食用块根蔬菜，常通过烘烤、水煮等方式烹制，即甘薯或红薯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa b'għerq oħxon li jittiekel u għandu togħma ħelwa, u li jista' jissajjar fil-forn jew jitgħalla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甘薯，俗称红薯：块根可食用、通常带甜味的一种蔬菜。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għerq oħxon ta' pjanta li jittiekel bħala ħaxixa, għandu togħma ħelwa u spiss jissajjar fil-forn jew jitgħalla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sweet potato is a root vegetable with sweet flesh that can be baked, boiled, or roasted.

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, qaxxar il-batata u qattagħha f'biċċiet żgħar qabel issajjarha.
formal.en: For this recipe, peel the sweet potato and cut it into small pieces before cooking it.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，先将红薯去皮并切成小块，再进行烹煮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif tridha l-batata llejla? Mark: Moħmija, jekk jogħġbok. Inħobbha b'naqra żejt.
colloquial.en: Maja: How would you like your sweet potato tonight? Mark: Baked, please. I like it with a little oil.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚红薯想怎么做？Mark：请烤着做吧。我喜欢加一点油。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 今晚红薯想怎么做？
messages.en: How would you like your sweet potato tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Moħmija, jekk jogħġbok. Inħobbha b'naqra żejt.
messages.mt_standard: Moħmija, jekk jogħġbok. Inħobbha b'naqra żejt.
messages.zh: 请烤着做吧。我喜欢加一点油。
messages.en: Baked, please. I like it with a little oil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 batata 配上一张切开后香甜冒热气的烤红薯图片，再连着读 batata moħmija，用食物画面记住“红薯”和“烤红薯”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that stores energy and supplies electricity to equipment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 储存能量并为设备供电的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jaħżen l-enerġija u jipprovdi l-elettriku biex jitħaddem tagħmir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为设备提供电力的电池。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Batterija hija apparat li jaħżen l-enerġija u jipprovdi l-elettriku lil apparat ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A battery is a device that stores energy and supplies electricity to equipment such as a phone or torch.

formal.mt: Qabel tuża l-apparat għall-ewwel darba, iċċarġja l-batterija skont l-istruzzjonijiet.
formal.en: Before using the device for the first time, charge the battery according to the instructions.
formal.zh: 首次使用设备前，请按照说明给电池充电。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-batterija tat-telefon tiegħi kważi spiċċat. Mark: Għandi ċarġer hawn. Tridu? Maja: Iva, grazzi!
colloquial.en: Maja: My phone battery is almost flat. Mark: I have a charger here. Do you want it? Maja: Yes, thanks!
colloquial.zh: Maja：我的手机快没电了。Mark：我这里有充电器。你要用吗？Maja：要，谢谢！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的手机快没电了。
messages.en: My phone battery is almost flat.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我这里有充电器。你要用吗？
messages.en: I have a charger here. Do you want it?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 要，谢谢！
messages.en: Yes, thanks!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 batterija 和手机电量图标一起记：电量见底，就需要给 batterija 充电。

gloss_zh: 费力的大工程；艰巨的活儿

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substantial task that requires considerable effort or trouble.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要投入很多精力、费一番周折才能完成的大任务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa xogħol kbira jew diffiċli li teħtieġ ħafna sforz jew taħbit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工作量大、做起来很费劲的任务或活儿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Battikata hija biċċa xogħol li teħtieġ ħafna sforz u taħbit biex titlesta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you describe a task as a big job, you mean that completing it requires considerable work and effort.

collocations.en: after a great deal of effort

formal.mt: It-tindif tal-maħżen kien battikata kbira, iżda t-tim temm ix-xogħol fi żmien jumejn.
formal.en: Cleaning the storeroom was a major job, but the team completed the work within two days.
formal.zh: 清理仓库是一项艰巨的任务，但团队在两天内完成了工作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif mar it-tindif tal-garaxx? Pawlu: Kienet battikata! Domna l-ġurnata kollha. Lara: Għallinqas issa għandkom iktar spazju.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did cleaning the garage go? Pawlu: It was a huge job! It took us all day. Lara: At least you have more space now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：车库清理得怎么样？Pawlu：可真是个大工程！我们干了一整天。Lara：至少现在你们有更多空间了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 车库清理得怎么样？
messages.en: How did cleaning the garage go?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 可真是个大工程！我们干了一整天。
messages.en: It was a huge job! It took us all day.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 至少现在你们有更多空间了。
messages.en: At least you have more space now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清理堆满杂物的车库，忙了一整天才结束：这种费劲的大工程就是 battikata。

gloss_zh: 蠢事；一阵放纵的玩乐或消费

teaching_sense.en_definition: A foolish act, or a short period of unrestrained enjoyment or spending.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指欠考虑的愚蠢行为，也可指一阵尽情玩乐、消费等放纵活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għemil iblah jew bla ħsieb, jew perjodu qasir ta' divertiment jew infiq bla rażan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因愚蠢或考虑不周而做出的事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bawxata hija għemil iblah jew bla ħsieb li juri nuqqas ta' għaqal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A foolish deed is something someone does without enough thought or good judgement.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一阵尽情甚至过度的玩乐、购物或其他放纵活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bawxata hija perjodu qasir li fih persuna tagħmel xi ħaġa, bħax-xiri jew id-divertiment, bla rażan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spree is a short period during which someone indulges freely or excessively in an activity.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru jiddeskrivi d-deċiżjoni tiegħu li jonfoq it-tfaddil kollu f'bawxata ta' xiri bħala bawxata li wara ddispjaċih għaliha.
formal.en: In the story, the character describes his decision to spend all his savings on a shopping spree as a foolish deed that he later regretted.
formal.zh: 故事中，人物将自己一次疯狂购物花光全部积蓄的决定，形容为后来令他后悔的一件蠢事。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għamilt bawxata ta' xiri lbieraħ u xtrajt tliet pari żraben. Nina: Imma ma kontx qed tfaddal għal vjaġġ? Rita: Iva, kienet bawxata li nfaqt daqshekk.
colloquial.en: Rita: I went on a shopping spree yesterday and bought three pairs of shoes. Nina: But weren't you saving for a trip? Rita: Yes, spending that much was foolish.
colloquial.zh: Rita：我昨天疯狂购物，买了三双鞋。Nina：可你不是在攒钱旅行吗？Rita：是啊，花这么多钱真是件蠢事。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt bawxata ta' xiri lbieraħ u xtrajt tliet pari żraben.
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt bawxata ta' xiri lbieraħ u xtrajt tliet pari żraben.
messages.zh: 我昨天疯狂购物，买了三双鞋。
messages.en: I went on a shopping spree yesterday and bought three pairs of shoes.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Imma ma kontx qed tfaddal għal vjaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Imma ma kontx qed tfaddal għal vjaġġ?
messages.zh: 可你不是在攒钱旅行吗？
messages.en: But weren't you saving for a trip?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet bawxata li nfaqt daqshekk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet bawxata li nfaqt daqshekk.
messages.zh: 是啊，花这么多钱真是件蠢事。
messages.en: Yes, spending that much was foolish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用购物情景串联两个义项：一阵疯狂购物是 bawxata，事后觉得自己做了蠢事，也可说 bawxata；具体含义看上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lower one's head, especially as a gesture of respect or acknowledgement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把头低下，尤其指以低头的动作表示尊重或致意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed iniżżel rasu 'l isfel, speċjalment bħala sinjal ta' rispett jew tislima.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低下头，常用于表示尊敬、致意或回应。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li wieħed ibaxxi rasu bħala sinjal ta' rispett, tislima jew għarfien tal-preżenza ta' xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone bows their head, they lower it, often to show respect or acknowledge another person.

collocations.en: he bowed his head in greeting

formal.mt: Fi tmiem iċ-ċerimonja, ir-rappreżentant baxxa rasu b'rispett quddiem il-mistednin.
formal.en: At the end of the ceremony, the representative bowed his head respectfully before the guests.
formal.zh: 仪式结束时，代表在来宾面前恭敬地低头致意。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Rajt kif sellmilna Ġanni? Marija: Iva, baxxa rasu u tbissem. Anna: Kien ġest sabiħ.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you see how Ġanni greeted us? Marija: Yes, he bowed his head and smiled. Anna: It was a lovely gesture.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你看到 Ġanni 怎么向我们打招呼了吗？Marija：看到了，他低头致意，还笑了笑。Anna：这个举动很有礼貌。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到 Ġanni 怎么向我们打招呼了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how Ġanni greeted us?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，他低头致意，还笑了笑。
messages.en: Yes, he bowed his head and smiled.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个举动很有礼貌。
messages.en: It was a lovely gesture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baxxa rasu 配上一个动作记忆：他向来宾轻轻低头致意。整句记作“他低下了头”，保留其过去时和第三人称含义。

gloss_zh: 船坞；供船舶停泊的坞池

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dock where ships can be moored or brought for maintenance and repairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供船舶停泊，或进行保养和修理的船坞或坞池。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post f'port jew f'tarzna fejn il-vapuri jistgħu jintrabtu jew jiddaħħlu għall-manutenzjoni u t-tiswija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供船舶停泊或维修的船坞、坞池。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post fejn il-vapuri jidħlu biex jintrabtu jew biex issirilhom manutenzjoni u tiswija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dock is a place where ships are moored or brought for maintenance and repairs.

formal.mt: Il-vapur iddaħħal fil-baċir biex isiru t-tiswijiet meħtieġa.
formal.en: The ship was brought into the dock for the necessary repairs.
formal.zh: 这艘船被送入船坞，以进行必要的维修。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-vapur illum? Leo: Fil-baċir; qed isewwuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the ship today? Leo: In the dock; they are repairing it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那艘船今天在哪里？Leo：在船坞里，工人们正在修它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那艘船今天在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the ship today?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.zh: 在船坞里，工人们正在修它。
messages.en: In the dock; they are repairing it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baċir 和“大船进入坞池检修”的画面绑定；记住 fil-baċir 表示“在船坞里”。

gloss_zh: 煮得过烂的食物；煮成的糊状物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Food that has become excessively soft or mushy through overcooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因烹煮时间过长而变得过分软烂、呈糊状的食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel li jkun issajjar iżżejjed u jkun sar artab ħafna jew qisu għaġna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 煮得过久、已经软烂成糊的食物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikel li, minħabba tisjir żejjed, ikun tilef il-konsistenza tiegħu u sar artab wisq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If food has turned into a soft, mushy mass because it was cooked too long, you can describe the resulting food with this noun.

formal.mt: Biex l-għaġin ma jsirx bażina, għandu jitneħħa mill-ilma malli jkun imsajjar biżżejjed.
formal.en: To prevent the pasta from turning to mush, it should be removed from the water as soon as it is sufficiently cooked.
formal.zh: 为防止意大利面煮得稀烂，应在煮熟后立即将其从水中捞出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-għaġin sar bażina! Mark: Ħallejtu fuq in-nar wisq. Id-darba li jmiss noqgħod aktar attent.
colloquial.en: Maja: This pasta has turned to mush! Mark: I left it on the heat too long. I'll be more careful next time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这意大利面都煮成糊了！Mark：我把它放在火上太久了，下次会更注意。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这意大利面都煮成糊了！
messages.en: This pasta has turned to mush!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallejtu fuq in-nar wisq. Id-darba li jmiss noqgħod aktar attent.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallejtu fuq in-nar wisq. Id-darba li jmiss noqgħod aktar attent.
messages.zh: 我把它放在火上太久了，下次会更注意。
messages.en: I left it on the heat too long. I'll be more careful next time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一锅意大利面煮到失去形状：用 bażina 给这团软烂食物命名，重点记住它在这里是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Banking services such as accepting deposits, providing loans, and handling payments for individuals and businesses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为个人和企业提供吸收存款、发放贷款及办理支付等服务的商业银行业务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività bankarja li tipprovdi servizzi bħal depożiti, self u pagamenti lil individwi u negozji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 商业银行向个人及企业提供存款、贷款、支付等金融服务的业务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-provvista ta' servizzi bankarji lil individwi u negozji, fosthom iż-żamma ta' depożiti, l-għoti ta' self u l-ipproċessar ta' pagamenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Commercial banking is the business of providing services such as deposit accounts, loans, and payments to individuals and businesses.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza r-rwol tal-bbankjar kummerċjali fil-finanzjament tan-negozji ż-żgħar.
formal.en: The report examines the role of commercial banking in financing small businesses.
formal.zh: 该报告分析了商业银行业务在小企业融资中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'liema qasam tal-bank taħdem? Mark: Naħdem fil-bbankjar kummerċjali. Ngħin lill-klijenti bil-kontijiet u bis-self.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which area of the bank do you work in? Mark: I work in commercial banking. I help customers with accounts and loans.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在银行的哪个业务领域工作？Mark：我做商业银行业务，帮客户处理账户和贷款。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在银行的哪个业务领域工作？
messages.en: Which area of the bank do you work in?

messages.speaker: Mark (银行职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħdem fil-bbankjar kummerċjali. Ngħin lill-klijenti bil-kontijiet u bis-self.
messages.mt_standard: Naħdem fil-bbankjar kummerċjali. Ngħin lill-klijenti bil-kontijiet u bis-self.
messages.zh: 我做商业银行业务，帮客户处理账户和贷款。
messages.en: I work in commercial banking. I help customers with accounts and loans.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把存款、贷款、支付画成银行柜台上的三张卡片，再把整组服务标为 bbankjar kummerċjali，联想记住“商业银行业务”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Using something as the foundation, evidence, or starting point for an idea, decision, or work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以某事物作为思想、决定或作品的基础、依据或出发点的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu xi ħaġa bħala l-bażi, l-evidenza jew il-punt tat-tluq tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以某事物为基础、依据或创作出发点的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jistrieħ fuq xi ħaġa bħala bażi jew sors, bħal fatti, riċerka jew storja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is based on particular facts, ideas, or events, those things provide its foundation or starting point.

formal.mt: Dan ir-rapport huwa bbażat fuq dejta miġbura permezz ta' stħarriġ fost ir-residenti.
formal.en: This report is based on data collected through a survey of residents.
formal.zh: 本报告以面向居民开展调查所收集的数据为依据。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-film huwa bbażat fuq storja vera? Mark: Iva, imma xi dettalji nbidlu għall-film.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this film based on a true story? Mark: Yes, but some details were changed for the film.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这部电影是根据真实故事改编的吗？Mark：是的，不过拍成电影时改动了一些细节。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-film huwa bbażat fuq storja vera?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-film huwa bbażat fuq storja vera?
messages.zh: 这部电影是根据真实故事改编的吗？
messages.en: Is this film based on a true story?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma xi dettalji nbidlu għall-film.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma xi dettalji nbidlu għall-film.
messages.zh: 是的，不过拍成电影时改动了一些细节。
messages.en: Yes, but some details were changed for the film.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把报告想成放在事实底座上的模型：bbażat fuq 后面接它所依据的内容，整块记成“基于……的”。

gloss_zh: 均衡的；处于平衡状态的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having parts in suitable proportions, or being in a stable state of physical balance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 各部分比例适当、协调均衡的，或在物理上保持稳定平衡的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-partijiet tiegħu fi proporzjon xieraq, jew li jinsab fi stat ta' bilanċ fiżiku stabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 各组成部分比例适当、协调均衡的；对不同方面给予适当考虑的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu l-elementi tiegħu fi proporzjon xieraq jew li jqis aspetti differenti mingħajr ma jagħti piż eċċessiv lil wieħed minnhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is balanced gives suitable weight or proportion to its different parts or aspects.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于平衡状态的；所受作用相互平衡而保持稳定的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab fi stat fejn il-forzi jew il-piżijiet li jaġixxu fuqu jibbilanċjaw lil xulxin u jżommuh stabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An object that is in equilibrium remains stable because the forces or weights acting on it balance one another.

collocations.en: an object balanced on a support
collocations.zh: 在支撑物上保持平衡的物体

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta rendikont bbilanċjat tad-dibattitu, billi jiddiskuti kemm il-vantaġġi kif ukoll l-iżvantaġġi tal-proposta.
formal.en: The report presents a balanced account of the debate by discussing both the advantages and the disadvantages of the proposal.
formal.zh: 该报告同时讨论提案的优点和缺点，对这场辩论作出了兼顾各方面的说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-mudell għadu bbilanċjat fuq l-appoġġ? Mark: Iva, jibqa' dritt sakemm ma ċċaqlaqx il-piżijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the model still balanced on the support? Mark: Yes, it stays upright as long as you don't move the weights.
colloquial.zh: Maja：模型还在支撑物上保持平衡吗？Mark：是的，只要你不移动那些配重，它就会保持直立。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 模型还在支撑物上保持平衡吗？
messages.en: Is the model still balanced on the support?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jibqa' dritt sakemm ma ċċaqlaqx il-piżijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jibqa' dritt sakemm ma ċċaqlaqx il-piżijiet.
messages.zh: 是的，只要你不移动那些配重，它就会保持直立。
messages.en: Yes, it stays upright as long as you don't move the weights.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图记 bbilanċjat：一幅是各类食物搭配均衡的餐盘，一幅是配重相抵、保持稳定的模型，分别对应“均衡”和“处于平衡”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of travelling in or controlling a boat that is moved by the wind using sails.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用风力和船帆使船航行的活动，也指驾驶帆船的运动或技能。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li tivvjaġġa b'dgħajsa bil-qlugħ jew tmexxiha bl-użu tal-forza tar-riħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 借助风力和船帆进行的航行或驾驶帆船活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bburdjar huwa l-attività li tmexxi dgħajsa bil-qlugħ jew tivvjaġġa biha billi tuża r-riħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sailing is the activity of travelling in or controlling a boat whose sails use the wind to move it.

formal.mt: Il-kors tal-bburdjar jinkludi taħriġ dwar l-użu tal-qlugħ u s-sigurtà fuq il-baħar.
formal.en: The sailing course includes training in the use of sails and safety at sea.
formal.zh: 帆船驾驶课程包括船帆使用和海上安全方面的培训。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tixtieq titgħallem il-bburdjar miegħi? Mark: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid insib kors għal min għadu jibda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like to learn sailing with me? Mark: Yes, but first I need to find a course for beginners.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想和我一起学驾驶帆船吗？马克：想，不过我得先找个初学者课程。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想和我一起学驾驶帆船吗？
messages.en: Would you like to learn sailing with me?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid insib kors għal min għadu jibda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid insib kors għal min għadu jibda.
messages.zh: 想，不过我得先找个初学者课程。
messages.en: Yes, but first I need to find a course for beginners.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bburdjar 和“风吹船帆、掌舵前进”的画面绑定，记住它表示帆船航行这项活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person trained to fly and control an aircraft.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受过驾驶训练、负责操纵飞机等航空器的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna mħarrġa biex ittajjar u tikkontrolla ajruplan jew inġenju ieħor tal-ajru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驾驶飞机或其他航空器的飞行员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bdot huwa persuna li tmexxi ajruplan jew inġenju ieħor tal-ajru waqt it-titjira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pilot is a person who operates an aircraft and controls its movement during a flight.

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, il-bdot ivverifika t-tagħmir u informa lill-passiġġieri dwar it-titjira.
formal.en: Before departure, the pilot checked the equipment and informed the passengers about the flight.
formal.zh: 起飞前，飞行员检查了设备，并向乘客介绍了本次飞行的相关情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min qed isuq l-ajruplan? Pawlu: Il-bdot, hemm quddiem fil-kabina.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is flying the plane? Pawlu: The pilot, up front in the cockpit.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁在开飞机呀？保罗：飞行员，就在前面的驾驶舱里。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.zh: 谁在开飞机呀？
messages.en: Who is flying the plane?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 飞行员，就在前面的驾驶舱里。
messages.en: The pilot, up front in the cockpit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bdot 放进飞机驾驶舱的画面里：坐在操纵杆前驾驶飞机的人，就是飞行员。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small animal with a soft body and a spiral shell that moves slowly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体柔软、通常背有螺旋形外壳、移动缓慢的小动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir b'ġisem artab u qoxra f'għamla ta' spirali fuq dahru, li jimxi bil-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种身体柔软、背着螺旋形壳、爬行缓慢的软体动物，即蜗牛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bebbuxa hija mollusk b'ġisem artab u qoxra f'għamla ta' spirali, li jiċċaqlaq bil-mod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A snail is a small soft-bodied animal that moves slowly and carries a spiral shell on its back.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenti raw bebbuxa timxi bil-mod fuq werqa mxarrba.
formal.en: During an observation session in the garden, the students saw a snail moving slowly across a wet leaf.
formal.zh: 在花园进行观察时，学生们看到一只蜗牛在湿润的叶子上缓慢爬行。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dik il-bebbuxa fuq il-werqa! Ġanni: Rajtha! Ejja nħalluha hemm u narawha timxi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that snail on the leaf! Ġanni: I see it! Let's leave it there and watch it move.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看叶子上的那只蜗牛！詹尼：看见啦！我们让它待在那里，看它慢慢爬吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 看叶子上的那只蜗牛！
messages.en: Look at that snail on the leaf!

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha! Ejja nħalluha hemm u narawha timxi.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha! Ejja nħalluha hemm u narawha timxi.
messages.zh: 看见啦！我们让它待在那里，看它慢慢爬吧。
messages.en: I see it! Let's leave it there and watch it move.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 bebbuxa 时想象一只背着螺旋小屋、在湿叶上慢慢爬行的蜗牛，用画面记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A member of an Arab people traditionally associated with a nomadic way of life in desert regions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贝都因群体的成员；这一阿拉伯人群体传统上与沙漠地区的游牧生活相关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Membru ta' poplu Għarbi tradizzjonalment marbut ma' ħajja nomada fir-reġjuni tad-deżert.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贝都因人，指传统上与沙漠游牧生活相关的阿拉伯人群体的成员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bedwi huwa membru ta' komunità Għarbija li tradizzjonalment tgħix ħajja nomada fid-deżert.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Bedouin is a member of an Arab people whose traditional way of life involves moving between places in desert regions.

collocations.zh: 沙漠中的一位贝都因人

formal.mt: Fl-intervista, bedwi ddeskriva l-ħajja tal-familja tiegħu u l-bidliet li rat il-komunità tiegħu.
formal.en: In the interview, a Bedouin described his family's life and the changes his community had experienced.
formal.zh: 在访谈中，一位贝都因人讲述了自己家庭的生活，以及其社群经历的变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dwar min hu dan il-ktieb? Samir: Dwar bedwi li jirrakkonta l-ħajja tiegħu u l-istejjer tal-familja tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is this book about? Samir: It's about a Bedouin who tells the story of his life and shares stories about his family.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书写的是谁？萨米尔：是一位贝都因人，他讲述了自己的人生和家里的故事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书写的是谁？
messages.en: Who is this book about?

messages.speaker: Samir (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar bedwi li jirrakkonta l-ħajja tiegħu u l-istejjer tal-familja tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar bedwi li jirrakkonta l-ħajja tiegħu u l-istejjer tal-familja tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是一位贝都因人，他讲述了自己的人生和家里的故事。
messages.en: It's about a Bedouin who tells the story of his life and shares stories about his family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bedwi 与英语 Bedouin、中文“贝都因人”并排记忆；它指群体成员，不能泛指所有住在沙漠里的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Members of Arab communities associated with nomadic life in desert regions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贝都因人，指与沙漠游牧生活相关的阿拉伯社群成员；此处为复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Membri ta' komunitajiet Għarab marbuta mal-ħajja nomada f'reġjuni tad-deżert.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贝都因人，阿拉伯沙漠游牧社群的成员，复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nies li jagħmlu parti minn komunitajiet Għarab marbuta mal-ħajja nomada fid-deżert.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bedouins are people belonging to Arab communities associated with nomadic life in desert regions.

formal.mt: L-istudenti ħejjew preżentazzjoni dwar il-ħajja u l-kultura tal-Bedwin.
formal.en: The students prepared a presentation about the life and culture of the Bedouins.
formal.zh: 学生们准备了一份介绍贝都因人生活与文化的演示报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq min qed taqra? Mark: Fuq il-Bedwin. Għandi nagħmel preżentazzjoni għal-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who are you reading about? Mark: The Bedouins. I have to give a presentation for class.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在读关于什么人的资料？马克：贝都因人。我得在课堂上做个报告。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你在读关于什么人的资料？
messages.en: Who are you reading about?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-Bedwin. Għandi nagħmel preżentazzjoni għal-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-Bedwin. Għandi nagħmel preżentazzjoni għal-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 贝都因人。我得在课堂上做个报告。
messages.en: The Bedouins. I have to give a presentation for class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bedwin 与英文 Bedouins 配对记忆，并在脑中标上“一群贝都因人”，提醒自己此处表示复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pale brown colour with a slight yellow tone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 米色，即略带黄色的浅褐色，可用于描述衣物、家具等物品的颜色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kulur kannella ċar b'lewn ħafif isfar, li jista' jintuża biex jiddeskrivi ħwejjeġ jew oġġetti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 米色，略带黄色的浅褐色。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kulur ċar bejn l-isfar u l-kannella, bħal dak li jista' jkollhom xi drappijiet jew ħwejjeġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is beige has a pale brown colour with a slight yellow tone.

formal.mt: Għall-kamra tal-laqgħat intgħażlu purtieri beige biex jaqblu mal-għamara.
formal.en: Beige curtains were chosen for the meeting room to match the furniture.
formal.zh: 会议室选用了米色窗帘，以搭配家具。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tippreferi l-ġakketta beige jew dik sewda? Mark: Il-beige. Naħseb li taqbel aħjar ma' dan il-qmis.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you prefer the beige jacket or the black one? Mark: The beige one. I think it goes better with this shirt.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你更喜欢米色夹克还是黑色那件？马克：米色的。我觉得它跟这件衬衫更搭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tippreferi l-ġakketta beige jew dik sewda?
messages.mt_standard: Tippreferi l-ġakketta beige jew dik sewda?
messages.zh: 你更喜欢米色夹克还是黑色那件？
messages.en: Do you prefer the beige jacket or the black one?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-beige. Naħseb li taqbel aħjar ma' dan il-qmis.
messages.mt_standard: Il-beige. Naħseb li taqbel aħjar ma' dan il-qmis.
messages.zh: 米色的。我觉得它跟这件衬衫更搭。
messages.en: The beige one. I think it goes better with this shirt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 beige 与英文相同拼写及米色色卡一起记，想象一件浅黄褐色夹克，用 ġakketta beige 巩固颜色搭配。

gloss_zh: 临时照看儿童的人；临时保姆

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who looks after children temporarily while their parents or usual carers are away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在父母或日常照护者外出时，临时照看儿童的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu ħsieb it-tfal għal żmien qasir meta l-ġenituri jew il-persuni li normalment jieħdu ħsiebhom ikunu assenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在父母或日常照护者不在场时临时照看儿童的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bejbisiter huwa persuna li tieħu ħsieb it-tfal temporanjament waqt li l-ġenituri jew dawk li normalment jieħdu ħsiebhom ikunu barra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A babysitter is someone who temporarily looks after children while their parents or usual carers are away.

formal.mt: Il-ġenituri qablu mal-bejbisiter dwar il-ħinijiet u ħallew numru tat-telefon għal kull emerġenza.
formal.en: The parents agreed on the hours with the babysitter and left a telephone number for any emergency.
formal.zh: 父母与临时保姆商定了照看时间，并留下了供紧急情况使用的电话号码。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Sibt bejbisiter għal-lejla? Pawlu: Iva, se tasal fis-sebgħa biex tieħu ħsieb it-tfal.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you find a babysitter for tonight? Pawlu: Yes, she'll arrive at seven to look after the children.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你找到今晚的临时保姆了吗？Pawlu：找到了，她七点到，来照看孩子们。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 你找到今晚的临时保姆了吗？
messages.en: Did you find a babysitter for tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se tasal fis-sebgħa biex tieħu ħsieb it-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se tasal fis-sebgħa biex tieħu ħsieb it-tfal.
messages.zh: 找到了，她七点到，来照看孩子们。
messages.en: Yes, she'll arrive at seven to look after the children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bejbisiter 与“父母出门，有人临时看孩子”的画面绑定；重点记住临时照看儿童这一职责。

gloss_zh: 搭售；附带购买条件的销售

teaching_sense.en_definition: A selling practice in which buying one product or service is made conditional on buying another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将购买某项商品或服务作为购买另一项商品或服务的必要条件的销售做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prattika ta' bejgħ li fiha x-xiri ta' prodott jew servizz ikun jiddependi fuq ix-xiri ta' prodott jew servizz ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搭售，即卖方要求顾客必须同时购买另一项商品或服务，才出售其所需商品或服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bejgħ li fih il-bejjiegħ jitlob li l-klijent jixtri prodott jew servizz ieħor bħala kundizzjoni biex jixtri dak li jkun irid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tied selling occurs when a seller makes the purchase of one product or service conditional on the purchase of another.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将两项交易附条件地捆绑，使购买其中一项必须以购买另一项为前提的做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-irbit tax-xiri ta' prodott jew servizz max-xiri ta' ieħor, b'tali mod li l-klijent ikollu jixtrihom it-tnejn biex jikseb dak li jkun irid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tying is the practice of requiring customers to buy another product or service in order to obtain the one they want.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搭售做法，即在销售条件中要求顾客购买额外商品或服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prattika kummerċjali li tagħmel ix-xiri ta' prodott jew servizz addizzjonali kundizzjoni għax-xiri tal-prodott jew tas-servizz mixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tying practice is a commercial arrangement under which customers must purchase an additional product or service to obtain their chosen item.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' bejgħ abbinat li fih il-klijent seta' jixtri l-apparat biss jekk jixtri wkoll kuntratt ta' manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes a case of tied selling in which the customer could buy the device only if they also bought a maintenance contract.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起搭售案例：顾客只有同时购买维护合同，才能购买该设备。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qaluli li biex nixtri l-apparat irrid nixtri wkoll kuntratt ta' manutenzjoni. Sara: Mela dak hu bejgħ abbinat: ma jbigħulekx l-apparat waħdu.
colloquial.en: Mark: They told me that to buy the device I also have to buy a maintenance contract. Sara: Then that's tied selling: they won't sell you the device on its own.
colloquial.zh: Mark：他们说，要买这台设备，我还必须购买维护合同。Sara：那就是搭售：他们不肯把设备单独卖给你。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Qaluli li biex nixtri l-apparat irrid nixtri wkoll kuntratt ta' manutenzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Qaluli li biex nixtri l-apparat irrid nixtri wkoll kuntratt ta' manutenzjoni.
messages.zh: 他们说，要买这台设备，我还必须购买维护合同。
messages.en: They told me that to buy the device I also have to buy a maintenance contract.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela dak hu bejgħ abbinat: ma jbigħulekx l-apparat waħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Mela dak hu bejgħ abbinat: ma jbigħulekx l-apparat waħdu.
messages.zh: 那就是搭售：他们不肯把设备单独卖给你。
messages.en: Then that's tied selling: they won't sell you the device on its own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象商品甲的购买按钮被商品乙锁住：“想买甲，必须也买乙。”用这个条件关系记住 bejgħ abbinat。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sale of goods through orders sent by correspondence, with the goods delivered to the customer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 顾客通过书信等通信方式订货，再由卖方将商品寄送给顾客的销售方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mod ta' bejgħ li fih il-klijent jibgħat l-ordni bil-korrispondenza u l-bejjiegħ jibgħatlu l-oġġetti fl-indirizz indikat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邮购，即通过寄送订单等通信方式订购商品，并由卖方寄送商品的购物或销售方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema ta' xiri u bejgħ li fiha l-klijent jordna l-oġġetti bil-korrispondenza u jirċevihom fl-indirizz li jkun ta lill-bejjiegħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mail order is a method of buying goods by sending an order to a seller who then delivers the goods to you.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邮购贸易，即通过通信接收订单并向顾客寄送商品的商业经营活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attività kummerċjali li fiha negozju jirċievi ordnijiet bil-korrispondenza u jibgħat l-oġġetti ordnati direttament lill-klijenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mail order trading is the business activity of receiving customers' orders by correspondence and sending the purchased goods to them.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija toffri servizz ta' bejgħ bil-korrispondenza: il-klijenti jibagħtu l-formola tal-ordni bil-posta u jirċievu l-oġġetti d-dar.
formal.en: The company offers a mail-order service: customers send the order form by post and receive the goods at home.
formal.zh: 该公司提供邮购服务：顾客通过邮局寄出订购表，然后在家中收取商品。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-katalgu hu għall-bejgħ bil-korrispondenza? Pawlu: Iva, timla l-formola, tibgħatha bil-posta u l-oġġetti jaslulek id-dar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this catalogue for mail order? Pawlu: Yes, you fill in the form, send it by post, and the goods arrive at your home.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这本目录是用来邮购的吗？Pawlu：是的，你填好表格，邮寄出去，商品就会送到家里。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 这本目录是用来邮购的吗？
messages.en: Is this catalogue for mail order?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, timla l-formola, tibgħatha bil-posta u l-oġġetti jaslulek id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, timla l-formola, tibgħatha bil-posta u l-oġġetti jaslulek id-dar.
messages.zh: 是的，你填好表格，邮寄出去，商品就会送到家里。
messages.en: Yes, you fill in the form, send it by post, and the goods arrive at your home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“看目录、填订单、寄出去、收包裹”四步联想 bejgħ bil-korrispondenza，把整个词组与邮购流程一起记住。

gloss_zh: 所有权完全转让的出售；买断式出售

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outright sale in which ownership passes fully to the buyer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将标的物的所有权完整转让给买方的出售，与仅出租使用权的安排不同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bejgħ li bih is-sjieda tal-oġġett jew tal-proprjetà tgħaddi kollha għand ix-xerrej, minflok jingħata biss id-dritt li jużaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使买方完全取得标的物所有权的出售。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tranżazzjoni li fiha l-bejjiegħ jittrasferixxi s-sjieda kollha tal-oġġett jew tal-proprjetà lix-xerrej.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An outright sale is a transaction in which the buyer acquires full ownership of the property or goods being sold.

collocations.en: an outright sale of the property

collocations.zh: 所有权完全转让的出售协议

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jipprevedi bejgħ dirett tal-bini, u s-sjieda kollha tgħaddi għand ix-xerrej meta jiġi ffirmat il-kuntratt.
formal.en: The agreement provides for an outright sale of the building, with full ownership passing to the buyer when the contract is signed.
formal.zh: 协议约定将该建筑物买断式出售，全部所有权在合同签署时转移给买方。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Is-sid irid jikri l-garaxx? Pawlu: Le, irid bejgħ dirett. Min jixtrih isir is-sid tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Does the owner want to rent out the garage? Pawlu: No, he wants an outright sale. Whoever buys it becomes its owner.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：房主想把车库租出去吗？保罗：不，他想直接卖断。谁买下，谁就成为车库的所有人。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 房主想把车库租出去吗？
messages.en: Does the owner want to rent out the garage?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, irid bejgħ dirett. Min jixtrih isir is-sid tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, irid bejgħ dirett. Min jixtrih isir is-sid tiegħu.
messages.zh: 不，他想直接卖断。谁买下，谁就成为车库的所有人。
messages.en: No, he wants an outright sale. Whoever buys it becomes its owner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象买下车库后拿到钥匙和完整产权：本词条里的 bejgħ dirett 要记成“卖断、所有权全转移”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sales made within a country's own market rather than to customers abroad.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面向本国市场、在国内实现的销售，与出口销售相区别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bejgħ li jsir fis-suq tal-pajjiż stess lil klijenti f'dak il-pajjiż, aktar milli lil klijenti barra mill-pajjiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向本国市场中的客户销售商品或服务的业务或销售额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bejgħ ta' prodotti jew servizzi lil klijenti fis-suq tal-pajjiż stess, jew il-valur ta' dak il-bejgħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A company's domestic sales are the goods or services it sells within its own country, or the value of those sales.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport annwali juri li l-bejgħ domestiku żdied, filwaqt li l-bejgħ lil klijenti barra mill-pajjiż baqa' stabbli.
formal.en: The annual report shows that domestic sales increased, while sales to customers abroad remained stable.
formal.zh: 年度报告显示，国内销售有所增长，而面向国外客户的销售保持稳定。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dawn l-ordnijiet kollha huma minn barra? Mark: Le, ħafna minnhom huma mingħand klijenti f'Malta. Il-bejgħ domestiku sejjer tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are all these orders from abroad? Mark: No, many of them are from customers in Malta. Domestic sales are going well.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这些订单全是国外来的吗？马克：不是，很多来自马耳他的客户。国内销售情况不错。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn l-ordnijiet kollha huma minn barra?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn l-ordnijiet kollha huma minn barra?
messages.zh: 这些订单全是国外来的吗？
messages.en: Are all these orders from abroad?

messages.speaker: Mark (销售同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħafna minnhom huma mingħand klijenti f'Malta. Il-bejgħ domestiku sejjer tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħafna minnhom huma mingħand klijenti f'Malta. Il-bejgħ domestiku sejjer tajjeb.
messages.zh: 不是，很多来自马耳他的客户。国内销售情况不错。
messages.en: No, many of them are from customers in Malta. Domestic sales are going well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张国境内的订单地图，把 bejgħ domestiku 放在境内客户旁，记住它表示“内销”，不是家庭采购。

gloss_zh: 不提供个性化咨询建议的销售

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sale made without giving the customer a personal recommendation about which product to choose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 销售方不就客户应选择何种产品提供个性化推荐的销售方式，常用于金融产品语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bejgħ li jsir mingħajr ma l-klijent jingħata rakkomandazzjoni personali dwar liema prodott għandu jagħżel, speċjalment fil-qasam finanzjarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不向客户提供针对其个人情况的产品选择建议而进行的销售。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tranżazzjoni ta' bejgħ li fiha l-bejjiegħ ma jagħtix lill-klijent parir personali dwar liema prodott ikun adattat għaċ-ċirkostanzi tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A non-advised sale takes place when a customer buys a product without receiving a personal recommendation from the seller about its suitability.

collocations.mt: bejgħ mingħajr konsulenza ta' prodotti finanzjarji
collocations.zh: 不提供个性化建议的金融产品销售
不提供个性化建议的销售流程

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispjega li dan huwa bejgħ mingħajr konsulenza: il-klijent jingħata informazzjoni dwar il-prodott, iżda ma jingħatax rakkomandazzjoni personali.
formal.en: The document explains that this is a non-advised sale: the customer receives information about the product but does not receive a personal recommendation.
formal.zh: 文件说明，这是一项不提供个性化咨询建议的销售：客户会获得产品信息，但不会获得针对个人情况的推荐。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tgħidli liema prodott hu l-aħjar għalija? David: Dan huwa bejgħ mingħajr konsulenza. Nista' nispjegalek il-karatteristiċi, iżda ma nagħtikx rakkomandazzjoni personali.
colloquial.en: Sara: Will you tell me which product is best for me? David: This is a non-advised sale. I can explain the features, but I do not give you a personal recommendation.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你会告诉我哪种产品最适合我吗？戴维：这里采用不提供个性化建议的销售方式。我可以解释产品特点，但不会向你提供个人化推荐。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tgħidli liema prodott hu l-aħjar għalija?
messages.mt_standard: Se tgħidli liema prodott hu l-aħjar għalija?
messages.zh: 你会告诉我哪种产品最适合我吗？
messages.en: Will you tell me which product is best for me?

messages.speaker: David (销售人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan huwa bejgħ mingħajr konsulenza. Nista' nispjegalek il-karatteristiċi, iżda ma nagħtikx rakkomandazzjoni personali.
messages.mt_standard: Dan huwa bejgħ mingħajr konsulenza. Nista' nispjegalek il-karatteristiċi, iżda ma nagħtikx rakkomandazzjoni personali.
messages.zh: 这里采用不提供个性化建议的销售方式。我可以解释产品特点，但不会向你提供个人化推荐。
messages.en: This is a non-advised sale. I can explain the features, but I do not give you a personal recommendation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“销售＋没有＋咨询建议”串起整个短语：可以介绍产品信息，但不替客户作个性化推荐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A seller who sells goods directly to consumers for their own use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 直接向消费者出售供其自用的商品的商家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew negozju li jbigħ prodotti direttament lill-konsumaturi għall-użu tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直接向最终消费者销售商品的零售商。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew negozju li jbigħ prodotti direttament lill-konsumaturi, normalment fi kwantitajiet żgħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A retailer is a person or business that sells goods directly to the people who use them.

formal.mt: Il-bejjiegħ bl-imnut joffri dawn il-prodotti direttament lill-konsumaturi fil-ħanut tiegħu.
formal.en: The retailer offers these products directly to consumers in his shop.
formal.zh: 这位零售商在自己的店里直接向消费者销售这些商品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi bżonn tazza waħda biss. Fejn nista' nixtriha? Mark: Tista' tixtriha mingħand bejjiegħ bl-imnut; m'għandekx bżonn tixtri kaxxa sħiħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: I only need one cup. Where can I buy it? Mark: You can buy it from a retailer; you don't need to buy a whole box.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我只需要一个杯子，去哪儿买呢？Mark：可以找零售商买，不用买一整箱。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn tazza waħda biss. Fejn nista' nixtriha?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn tazza waħda biss. Fejn nista' nixtriha?
messages.zh: 我只需要一个杯子，去哪儿买呢？
messages.en: I only need one cup. Where can I buy it?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tixtriha mingħand bejjiegħ bl-imnut; m'għandekx bżonn tixtri kaxxa sħiħa.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tixtriha mingħand bejjiegħ bl-imnut; m'għandekx bżonn tixtri kaxxa sħiħa.
messages.zh: 可以找零售商买，不用买一整箱。
messages.en: You can buy it from a retailer; you don't need to buy a whole box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与“顾客到店里只买一个杯子”的场景绑定，记住它指直接面向消费者的零售商。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A seller who supplies goods in large quantities, usually to other businesses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大批量供应商品，通常向其他商家销售的批发商。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew negozju li jbigħ prodotti fi kwantitajiet kbar, normalment lil negozji oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经营商品批量销售，通常向其他商家供货的批发商。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Negozjant li jbigħ prodotti fi kwantitajiet kbar, normalment lil ħwienet jew lil negozji oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wholesale dealer is a trader who sells goods in large quantities, usually to other businesses.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以大批量方式销售商品，通常向零售商等商业客户供货的商家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tbigħ prodotti fi kwantitajiet kbar lil bejjiegħa bl-imnut jew lil klijenti kummerċjali oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wholesaler is a person or company that supplies large quantities of goods to retailers or other business customers.

formal.mt: Il-ħanut jordna mitt kaxxa mingħand bejjiegħ bl-ingrossa biex ikollu biżżejjed prodotti għall-bejgħ.
formal.en: The shop orders one hundred boxes from a wholesaler to have enough products for sale.
formal.zh: 这家商店向批发商订购一百箱货物，以备足销售所需的商品。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandna bżonn ħamsin kaxxa għall-ħanut. Lil min se nordnawhom? Pawlu: Ejja nordnawhom mingħand bejjiegħ bl-ingrossa.
colloquial.en: Sara: We need fifty boxes for the shop. Who shall we order them from? Pawlu: Let's order them from a wholesaler.
colloquial.zh: Sara：店里需要五十箱货，我们找谁订呢？Pawlu：找批发商订吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna bżonn ħamsin kaxxa għall-ħanut. Lil min se nordnawhom?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna bżonn ħamsin kaxxa għall-ħanut. Lil min se nordnawhom?
messages.zh: 店里需要五十箱货，我们找谁订呢？
messages.en: We need fifty boxes for the shop. Who shall we order them from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.zh: 找批发商订吧。
messages.en: Let's order them from a wholesaler.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象店主一次订五十箱货，把整个短语与“大批进货找批发商”联系起来，并与只买一件的零售场景对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who sells goods in streets or other public places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在街道或其他公共场所售卖商品的小贩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tbigħ oġġetti fit-toroq jew f'postijiet pubbliċi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在街头等公共场所售货的小贩，常以沿街招徕顾客的方式经营。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tbigħ oġġetti fit-toroq jew f'postijiet pubbliċi, spiss billi ddur u ssejjaħ lin-nies biex jixtru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hawker is someone who sells goods in streets or public places, often calling out to attract customers.

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tas-suq, l-awtur isemmi bejjiegħ fit-toroq li jsejjaħ lill-klijenti biex jixtru l-frott tiegħu.
formal.en: In the description of the market, the author mentions a hawker who calls out to customers to buy his fruit.
formal.zh: 作者描写市场时，提到一位吆喝着招徕顾客购买水果的街头小贩。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn xtrajt dan it-tuffieħ? Ninu: Mingħand bejjiegħ fit-toroq ħdejn is-suq. Kien qed jgħajjat biex jiġbed il-klijenti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you buy these apples? Ninu: From a hawker near the market. He was calling out to attract customers.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这些苹果你在哪儿买的？Ninu：在市场附近一个街头小贩那里买的。他当时正吆喝着招徕顾客。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些苹果你在哪儿买的？
messages.en: Where did you buy these apples?

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mingħand bejjiegħ fit-toroq ħdejn is-suq. Kien qed jgħajjat biex jiġbed il-klijenti.
messages.mt_standard: Mingħand bejjiegħ fit-toroq ħdejn is-suq. Kien qed jgħajjat biex jiġbed il-klijenti.
messages.zh: 在市场附近一个街头小贩那里买的。他当时正吆喝着招徕顾客。
messages.en: From a hawker near the market. He was calling out to attract customers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象市场旁有人在街上吆喝卖苹果，用“街上卖东西的人”这一完整画面记住整个短语。

gloss_zh: 马耳他风笛上用于将旋律管固定在管轭中的两片附加苇片之一

teaching_sense.en_definition: Either of two additional pieces of cane used to secure the chanter tubes in the yoke of the Maltese żaqq bagpipe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他风笛 żaqq 上的一个部件，指用于将旋律管固定在管轭中的两片附加苇片中的任意一片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda minn żewġ biċċiet addizzjonali tal-qasba li jintużaw biex iżommu t-tubi tal-melodija mwaħħlin fil-madmad taż-żaqq.

sense_translations.en_definition: ??? (Each of the 2 additional pieces of cane used to secure the chanter tubes into the yoke of the Żaqq [bagpipe])
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他风笛 żaqq 上用于将旋律管固定在管轭中的两片附加苇片中的每一片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kull waħda miż-żewġ biċċiet addizzjonali tal-qasba li jżommu t-tubi tal-melodija mwaħħlin fil-madmad tal-istrument mużikali msejjaħ żaqq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bejjienna is one of two additional cane pieces that hold the chanter tubes securely in the yoke of the żaqq bagpipe.

collocations.en: the bejjienna of the żaqq bagpipe
collocations.zh: 马耳他风笛的固定苇片

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-istrument, il-bejjienna hija waħda minn żewġ biċċiet addizzjonali tal-qasba li jżommu t-tubi tal-melodija mwaħħlin fil-madmad taż-żaqq.
formal.en: In the description of the instrument, the bejjienna is one of two additional cane pieces that secure the chanter tubes in the yoke of the żaqq bagpipe.
formal.zh: 在这份乐器说明中，bejjienna 指马耳他风笛上用于将旋律管固定在管轭中的两片附加苇片之一。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi l-bejjienna fiż-żaqq? Toni: Hija waħda minn żewġ biċċiet żejda tal-qasba li jżommu t-tubi tal-melodija f'posthom fil-madmad.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the bejjienna in the żaqq bagpipe? Toni: It's one of two extra cane pieces that keep the chanter tubes in place in the yoke.
colloquial.zh: Maja：马耳他风笛里的 bejjienna 是什么？Toni：就是把旋律管固定在管轭中的两片附加苇片之一。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 马耳他风笛里的 bejjienna 是什么？
messages.en: What is the bejjienna in the żaqq bagpipe?

messages.speaker: Toni (音乐教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija waħda minn żewġ biċċiet żejda tal-qasba li jżommu t-tubi tal-melodija f'posthom fil-madmad.
messages.mt_standard: Hija waħda minn żewġ biċċiet żejda tal-qasba li jżommu t-tubi tal-melodija f'posthom fil-madmad.
messages.zh: 就是把旋律管固定在管轭中的两片附加苇片之一。
messages.en: It's one of two extra cane pieces that keep the chanter tubes in place in the yoke.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“风笛、两片附加苇片、固定旋律管”三个提示串联记忆；这个词指其中一片，抓住它的固定作用即可。

gloss_zh: 义项未明的名词；所给资料未提供释义

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning is not established by the supplied entry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给词条标为名词，但没有提供可确定其含义的释义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu ma ġietx stabbilita fl-informazzjoni mogħtija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含义未明；所给资料没有说明这个名词的具体意义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom mhix speċifikata fl-informazzjoni mogħtija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry does not establish this noun's meaning.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'bejka' hija mniżżla bħala nom, iżda l-informazzjoni mogħtija ma tispeċifikax it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The word 'bejka' is listed as a noun, but the supplied information does not specify its meaning.
formal.zh: “bejka”被列为名词，但所给资料没有说明它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'bejka'? Mark: Ma nafx; il-lista ma tagħtix it-tifsira tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'bejka' mean? Mark: I don't know; the list doesn't give its meaning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：bejka 是什么意思？马克：我不知道，列表里没有给出它的释义。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: bejka 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'bejka' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; il-lista ma tagħtix it-tifsira tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; il-lista ma tagħtix it-tifsira tagħha.
messages.zh: 我不知道，列表里没有给出它的释义。
messages.en: I don't know; the list doesn't give its meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bejka 暂记在“名词待释义”卡片上，只记拼写与已给词性，不用问号猜造词义；这里的搭配仅用于讨论这个词。

gloss_zh: 乘小艇向船舶售卖、运送补给品的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who sells and delivers provisions to ships from a small boat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用小艇向船舶售卖并运送食品等补给品的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tuża dgħajsa żgħira biex tbigħ u twassal provvisti lill-vapuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乘补给小艇向船舶售卖和运送物资的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li minn fuq dgħajsa żgħira tbigħ u twassal ikel u provvisti oħra lill-vapuri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bumboats man sells and delivers supplies to ships from a small boat.

collocations.en: buy supplies from the bumboat supplier
collocations.zh: 向小艇补给商购买物资

collocations.en: the bumboat supplier delivers food to the ship
collocations.zh: 小艇补给商向船上运送食品

formal.mt: Il-bejlik resaq bid-dgħajsa tiegħu lejn il-vapur biex iwassal l-ikel ordnat mill-kaptan.
formal.en: The bumboat supplier approached the ship in his boat to deliver the food ordered by the captain.
formal.zh: 小艇补给商驾驶自己的小艇靠近船舶，运送船长订购的食品。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Mingħand min se nixtru l-ikel għall-vapur? Maja: Mingħand il-bejlik; se jġibulna bid-dgħajsa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who are we going to buy the food for the ship from? Maja: From the bumboat supplier; he'll bring it to us by boat.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们向谁买船上要用的食品？玛雅：向小艇补给商买；他会用小艇给我们送来。

messages.speaker: Mark (船员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mingħand min se nixtru l-ikel għall-vapur?
messages.mt_standard: Mingħand min se nixtru l-ikel għall-vapur?
messages.zh: 我们向谁买船上要用的食品？
messages.en: Who are we going to buy the food for the ship from?

messages.speaker: Maja (船员)
messages.zh: 向小艇补给商买；他会用小艇给我们送来。
messages.en: From the bumboat supplier; he'll bring it to us by boat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“小艇靠大船，商人送补给”的画面记住 bejlik，重点记它指提供补给的人；这只是场景联想，并非词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Beijing, the capital city of China.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 北京，中国的首都；这是一个城市专名。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bejġing hija l-belt kapitali taċ-Ċina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 北京，中国的首都。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bejġing huwa l-isem tal-belt kapitali taċ-Ċina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Beijing is the name of the capital city of China.

formal.mt: Id-delegazzjoni se tivvjaġġa lejn Bejġing biex tieħu sehem f'laqgħa internazzjonali.
formal.en: The delegation will travel to Beijing to take part in an international meeting.
formal.zh: 代表团将前往北京参加一次国际会议。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn se tmur għall-vaganza? Mark: Se mmur Bejġing biex inżur ħabib tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Beijing to visit a friend of mine.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你打算去哪里度假？Mark：我要去北京看望一位朋友。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur Bejġing biex inżur ħabib tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur Bejġing biex inżur ħabib tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我要去北京看望一位朋友。
messages.en: I'm going to Beijing to visit a friend of mine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Bejġing 写在想象中的北京旅行车票上；作为城市专名，正文中首字母 B 大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give goods, property, or services to someone in exchange for money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将商品、财产或服务提供给他人，以换取金钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti prodott jew proprjetà, jew tipprovdi servizz, lil xi ħadd bi ħlas ta' flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把商品、财产或服务出售给他人，并收取价款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħaddi oġġett jew proprjetà lil ħaddieħor, jew tipprovdilu servizz, bi skambju għal ammont ta' flus.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you sell something, you give it to another person in exchange for an agreed amount of money.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tbiegħ il-prodotti tagħha lil ħwienet lokali u tibgħat fattura għal kull ordni.
formal.en: The company sells its products to local shops and sends an invoice for each order.
formal.zh: 该公司向本地商店销售产品，并为每笔订单开具发票。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se tbiegħ ir-rota tiegħek? Toni: Iva, se nbiegħha lil ġar tiegħi għal ħamsin ewro.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you going to sell your bicycle? Toni: Yes, I am going to sell it to a neighbour for fifty euros.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你打算把自行车卖掉吗？托尼：是的，我打算以五十欧元卖给一位邻居。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算把自行车卖掉吗？
messages.en: Are you going to sell your bicycle?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nbiegħha lil ġar tiegħi għal ħamsin ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nbiegħha lil ġar tiegħi għal ħamsin ewro.
messages.zh: 是的，我打算以五十欧元卖给一位邻居。
messages.en: Yes, I am going to sell it to a neighbour for fifty euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bejħ 的“卖”义配成双向箭头：商品交给买家，钱交给卖家；再用“卖面包、卖房子”反复造句。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cheat someone, especially by making them pay unfairly or receive less than they should.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 欺骗或坑骗某人，尤其指使对方多付钱或未得到应得的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqarraq b'xi ħadd, speċjalment billi jġiegħlu jħallas iżżejjed jew jagħtih inqas milli suppost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坑骗某人，尤其是在交易中让对方吃亏。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iqarraq b'persuna fi ftehim jew fi tranżazzjoni, b'mod li din tħallas iżżejjed jew ma tieħux dak li jistħoqqilha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone gyps you, they cheat you by charging unfairly or failing to give you what you should receive.

collocations.en: cheated the customer over the price

formal.mt: Skont l-ilment, il-bejjiegħ bella' kanna lix-xerrej billi ħallasu għal għaxar oġġetti iżda tah tmienja biss.
formal.en: According to the complaint, the seller cheated the buyer by charging for ten items but providing only eight.
formal.zh: 根据投诉，卖家收取了十件商品的费用，却只交付八件，坑骗了买家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħallast għal għaxra, imma tani tmienja biss! Mark: Mela bella' kanna lilek ukoll!
colloquial.en: Maja: I paid for ten, but he only gave me eight! Mark: So he cheated you too!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我付了十件的钱，可他只给了我八件！马克：原来他也坑了你！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallast għal għaxra, imma tani tmienja biss!
messages.mt_standard: Ħallast għal għaxra, imma tani tmienja biss!
messages.zh: 我付了十件的钱，可他只给了我八件！
messages.en: I paid for ten, but he only gave me eight!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 原来他也坑了你！
messages.en: So he cheated you too!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bella' kanna 整体配上“付十件的钱，只拿到八件”的交易画面，记作“被人坑骗”；不要逐词猜测这个表达的来历。

gloss_zh: 比利时的；来自比利时的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming from Belgium or connected with Belgium and its people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自比利时的，或与比利时及其人民有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Belġju jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Belġju u man-nies tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比利时的；与比利时或比利时人有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Belġju jew man-nies ta' dan il-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something Belgian comes from Belgium or is connected with the country or its people.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or related to Belgium
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自比利时的，或与比利时有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joriġina mill-Belġju jew li għandu rabta ma' dan il-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You describe a person or thing as Belgian when they come from Belgium or have a connection with it.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi dan il-prodott bħala belġjan u jagħti l-indirizz tal-manifattur fil-Belġju.
formal.en: The catalogue describes this product as Belgian and gives the manufacturer's address in Belgium.
formal.zh: 目录将这件产品描述为比利时产品，并列出了制造商在比利时的地址。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-prodott ġej mill-Belġju? Mark: Iva, huwa prodott belġjan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this product come from Belgium? Mark: Yes, it's a Belgian product.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这件产品来自比利时吗？马克：是的，它是比利时产品。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件产品来自比利时吗？
messages.en: Does this product come from Belgium?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 是的，它是比利时产品。
messages.en: Yes, it's a Belgian product.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象产品旁贴着“来自比利时”的标签，把 prodott belġjan 连成一组记忆；本条两个释义都按形容词理解。

gloss_zh: 本笃会的；形容属于本笃会的修士

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a friar who belongs to the Benedictine religious community.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于形容属于本笃会的修士。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi patri li jagħmel parti mill-ordni reliġjuż tal-Benedittini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 本笃会的，用于修饰属于本笃会的修士。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jintuża biex jiddeskrivi patri li jappartjeni għall-ordni tal-Benedittini.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Benedictine friar is a member of the Benedictine religious community.

formal.mt: Il-patri benedittin wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet tal-istudenti dwar il-ħajja fil-komunità reliġjuża.
formal.en: The Benedictine friar answered the students' questions about life in the religious community.
formal.zh: 这位本笃会修士回答了学生们关于修会团体生活的问题。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jkellimna llum? Pawlu: Patri benedittin. Anna: Nistgħu nistaqsuh dwar il-ħajja tiegħu? Pawlu: Iva, wara t-taħdita.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is going to speak to us today? Pawlu: A Benedictine friar. Anna: Can we ask him about his life? Pawlu: Yes, after the talk.
colloquial.zh: Anna：今天谁来给我们讲话？Pawlu：一位本笃会修士。Anna：我们可以问问他的生活吗？Pawlu：可以，讲座结束后问。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 今天谁来给我们讲话？
messages.en: Who is going to speak to us today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 一位本笃会修士。
messages.en: A Benedictine friar.

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 我们可以问问他的生活吗？
messages.en: Can we ask him about his life?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 可以，讲座结束后问。
messages.en: Yes, after the talk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 patri benedittin 整组记作“本笃会修士”，再用 komunità benedittina“本笃会团体”对照记忆形容词的词形变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An advantage or helpful effect that someone gains from something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某件事给人带来的有利结果或实际好处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vantaġġ jew effett tajjeb li persuna tikseb minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 益处；某事物带来的有利影响或好处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Riżultat pożittiv jew vantaġġ li xi ħaġa ġġib lil persuna jew lil grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A benefit is an advantage or helpful result that you gain from something.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega l-benefiċċju li l-programm ta' taħriġ jista' jġib lill-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The report explains the benefit that the training programme can bring to workers.
formal.zh: 这份报告说明了培训计划能够给员工带来的益处。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'benefiċċju għandu dan il-kors? Mark: Jgħinek titkellem bil-Malti b'aktar kunfidenza. Lara: Mela jista' jgħinni fuq ix-xogħol ukoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: What benefit does this course offer? Mark: It helps you speak Maltese with more confidence. Lara: Then it could help me at work too.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这门课有什么好处？Mark：它能帮助你更自信地说马耳他语。Lara：那它也能帮到我的工作。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这门课有什么好处？
messages.en: What benefit does this course offer?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 它能帮助你更自信地说马耳他语。
messages.en: It helps you speak Maltese with more confidence.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela jista' jgħinni fuq ix-xogħol ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Mela jista' jgħinni fuq ix-xogħol ukoll.
messages.zh: 那它也能帮到我的工作。
messages.en: Then it could help me at work too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习 benefiċċju 时，想象课程带来的一个具体好处：开口更有信心。把“得到什么益处”与这个名词连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of being healthy, comfortable, and well cared for.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体健康、心理舒适且生活得到良好照顾的状态，也指与此有关的福祉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' persuna li tkun f'saħħitha, tħossha tajba u jkollha l-kura u l-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa biex tgħix tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身心健康与生活安适的整体状态；个人或群体的福祉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ġid fiżiku, mentali u soċjali ta' persuna jew ta' grupp, flimkien mal-kundizzjonijiet li jippermettulhom jgħixu tajjeb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's wellbeing or welfare is their overall condition of health, comfort, and quality of life.

formal.mt: L-iskola introduċiet servizz ġdid ta' appoġġ biex tippromwovi l-benesseri tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The school introduced a new support service to promote students' wellbeing.
formal.zh: 学校推出了一项新的支持服务，以促进学生的身心福祉。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-ġimgħa għajjiena ħafna. Nina: Ħu ftit ħin għalik; il-benesseri tiegħek hu importanti. Sara: Għandek raġun. Illejla se nistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: I'm very tired this week. Nina: Take some time for yourself; your wellbeing matters. Sara: You're right. I'll rest this evening.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这星期我特别累。Nina：留点时间给自己吧，你的身心健康很重要。Sara：你说得对，我今晚要休息一下。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这星期我特别累。
messages.en: I'm very tired this week.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu ftit ħin għalik; il-benesseri tiegħek hu importanti.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu ftit ħin għalik; il-benesseri tiegħek hu importanti.
messages.zh: 留点时间给自己吧，你的身心健康很重要。
messages.en: Take some time for yourself; your wellbeing matters.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你说得对，我今晚要休息一下。
messages.en: You're right. I'll rest this evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 benesseri 想成一张生活状态检查表：身体舒服、心情平稳、生活有照顾；三项合起来就是“身心福祉”。

gloss_zh: 孟加拉的；来自孟加拉地区的；与孟加拉有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming from Bengal or connected with its people or culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自孟加拉地区的，或与该地区的人民、文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mir-reġjun tal-Bengal jew li għandu x'jaqsam man-nies jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 孟加拉的，尤指与孟加拉人民或文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-poplu jew mal-kultura tal-Bengal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something Bengali is connected with the people or culture of Bengal.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or related to Bengal
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自孟加拉地区的，或与孟加拉地区有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joriġina mir-reġjun tal-Bengal jew li għandu rabta ma' dak ir-reġjun.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or thing described this way comes from Bengal or has a connection with that region.

formal.mt: L-artiklu jippreżenta kittieb bengaliż u jiddiskuti r-rabta bejn ix-xogħol tiegħu u l-kultura tal-Bengal.
formal.en: The article introduces a Bengali writer and discusses the connection between his work and the culture of Bengal.
formal.zh: 这篇文章介绍了一位孟加拉作家，并讨论了他的作品与孟加拉文化之间的联系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qatt doqt ikel bengaliż? David: Le, imma nixtieq nipprova. Maja: Mela mmorru nieklu flimkien is-Sibt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you ever tried Bengali food? David: No, but I'd like to try it. Maja: Then let's go and eat together on Saturday.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你吃过孟加拉菜吗？David：没有，不过我想尝尝。Maja：那我们星期六一起去吃吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你吃过孟加拉菜吗？
messages.en: Have you ever tried Bengali food?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，不过我想尝尝。
messages.en: No, but I'd like to try it.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们星期六一起去吃吧。
messages.en: Then let's go and eat together on Saturday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“孟加拉作家、孟加拉菜肴、孟加拉文化”三个画面记住 bengaliż，并通过 kultura bengaliża 记住阴性名词旁的形容词形式。

gloss_zh: 公共物品；集体共享的资源

teaching_sense.en_definition: Goods or resources provided for the use or benefit of a community or the public.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供集体或公众共同使用、享有或受益的物品与资源。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti jew riżorsi pprovduti għall-użu jew għall-ġid tal-komunità jew tal-pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供某一集体的成员共同使用或共同受益的物品与资源。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti jew riżorsi li membri ta' grupp jew ta' komunità jużaw flimkien jew li minnhom jibbenefikaw flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Collective goods are goods or resources that members of a group use together or benefit from collectively.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供公众共同受益的公共物品；在经济学中，通常指难以排除他人享用、且一人的享用不减少他人可享用程度的物品或服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti jew servizzi għall-ġid tal-pubbliku li, fis-sens ekonomiku, ikun diffiċli li xi ħadd jiġi eskluż milli jużahom u li l-użu tagħhom minn persuna ma jnaqqasx dak disponibbli għal oħrajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Public goods are goods or services whose benefits are generally difficult to restrict and whose use by one person does not reduce their availability to others.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif il-finanzjament tal-beni pubbliċi jista' jtejjeb il-kwalità tal-ħajja fil-komunità.
formal.en: The report explains how funding public goods can improve quality of life in the community.
formal.zh: 这份报告解释了为公共物品提供资金如何改善社区的生活质量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhuma l-beni pubbliċi? Mark: Aħseb fid-dawl tat-toroq: jibbenefika minnu kull min jgħaddi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are public goods? Mark: Think of street lighting: everyone passing by benefits from it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：什么是公共物品？Mark：想想路灯照明吧，每个经过的人都能受益。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 什么是公共物品？
messages.en: What are public goods?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħseb fid-dawl tat-toroq: jibbenefika minnu kull min jgħaddi.
messages.mt_standard: Aħseb fid-dawl tat-toroq: jibbenefika minnu kull min jgħaddi.
messages.zh: 想想路灯照明吧，每个经过的人都能受益。
messages.en: Think of street lighting: everyone passing by benefits from it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和夜间路灯联系起来：一盏灯照亮所有路人，帮助记住“公众共同受益的物品”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person belonging to one of the Indigenous peoples of North Africa known as Berbers or Amazigh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 柏柏尔人，即北非阿马齐格各族群的成员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tappartjeni għal wieħed mill-popli indiġeni tal-Afrika ta' Fuq magħrufa bħala Berberi jew Amażigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柏柏尔人；北非阿马齐格各族群中的一员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna minn wieħed mill-popli indiġeni tal-Afrika ta' Fuq li jissejħu Berberi jew Amażigħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Berber is a person who belongs to one of the Indigenous Amazigh peoples of North Africa.

collocations.zh: 一位来自摩洛哥的柏柏尔人

formal.mt: Fil-laqgħa, kittieb Berberu tkellem dwar l-esperjenzi tiegħu u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet tal-istudenti.
