formal.en: At the meeting, a Berber writer spoke about his experiences and answered the students' questions.
formal.zh: 在会上，一位柏柏尔作家讲述了自己的经历，并回答了学生们的问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak il-kittieb? Sami: Hu Berberu mill-Marokk. Qrajt ktieb tiegħu dan l-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that writer? Sami: He is a Berber from Morocco. I read a book of his recently.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那位作家是谁？Sami：他是一位来自摩洛哥的柏柏尔人。我最近读了他的一本书。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那位作家是谁？
messages.en: Who is that writer?

messages.speaker: Sami (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu Berberu mill-Marokk. Qrajt ktieb tiegħu dan l-aħħar.
messages.mt_standard: Hu Berberu mill-Marokk. Qrajt ktieb tiegħu dan l-aħħar.
messages.zh: 他是一位来自摩洛哥的柏柏尔人。我最近读了他的一本书。
messages.en: He is a Berber from Morocco. I read a book of his recently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用拼写联想记忆：Berberu 与英语 Berber 共享醒目的 Berber 字母串，再配上“一位柏柏尔人”的人物卡片。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming from the Italian city of Bergamo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自意大利贝加莫市的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-belt ta' Bergamo fl-Italja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自意大利贝加莫市的；以贝加莫为家乡的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu l-oriġini tiegħu fil-belt ta' Bergamo fl-Italja jew li ġej minn dik il-belt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is Bergamasque comes from the Italian city of Bergamo.

collocations.zh: 一位来自贝加莫的艺术家
一位来自贝加莫的音乐家

formal.mt: Il-mużew stieden artist bergamiż biex jippreżenta x-xogħol tiegħu u jiddiskutih mal-pubbliku.
formal.en: The museum invited an artist from Bergamo to present his work and discuss it with the public.
formal.zh: 博物馆邀请了一位来自贝加莫的艺术家展示自己的作品，并与公众交流。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Minn fejn hu l-mużiċist li se jdoqq illejla? Mark: Hu bergamiż, jiġifieri ġej minn Bergamo.
colloquial.en: Elena: Where is the musician playing tonight from? Mark: He is Bergamasque, meaning he comes from Bergamo.
colloquial.zh: Elena：今晚演出的那位音乐家是哪里人？Mark：他是贝加莫人，也就是说，他来自贝加莫。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn hu l-mużiċist li se jdoqq illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn hu l-mużiċist li se jdoqq illejla?
messages.zh: 今晚演出的那位音乐家是哪里人？
messages.en: Where is the musician playing tonight from?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu bergamiż, jiġifieri ġej minn Bergamo.
messages.mt_standard: Hu bergamiż, jiġifieri ġej minn Bergamo.
messages.zh: 他是贝加莫人，也就是说，他来自贝加莫。
messages.en: He is Bergamasque, meaning he comes from Bergamo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Bergamo 和 bergamiż 并排记在地图卡上，再配一句 artist bergamiż，记住这是说明人物来自贝加莫的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An orange with a bitter taste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 味道苦的橙子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bergamott huwa larinġa li għandha togħma morra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苦橙；味道苦的橙子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bergamott huwa tip ta' larinġa b'togħma morra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bitter orange is an orange that has a bitter taste.

collocations.en: the peel of the bitter orange
the bitter taste of the bitter orange

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob il-qoxra ta' bergamott biex tagħti togħma morra lid-deżerta.
formal.en: The recipe calls for the peel of a bitter orange to give the dessert a bitter taste.
formal.zh: 这份食谱要求加入一个苦橙的果皮，让甜点带有苦味。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan hu bergamott? Pawlu: Iva, oqgħod attent, għax għandu togħma morra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this a bitter orange? Pawlu: Yes, be careful, because it tastes bitter.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是苦橙吗？保罗：是的，注意哦，它的味道是苦的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是苦橙吗？
messages.en: Is this a bitter orange?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, oqgħod attent, għax għandu togħma morra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, oqgħod attent, għax għandu togħma morra.
messages.zh: 是的，注意哦，它的味道是苦的。
messages.en: Yes, be careful, because it tastes bitter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bergamott 和“苦橙皮、苦味”一起记；想象尝到一口苦橙，再说 togħma morra，巩固味觉联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of the city of Berlin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 城市名称“柏林”，用作专有名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Berlin huwa isem proprju li jirreferi għall-belt ta' Berlin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柏林，城市的专有名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Berlin huwa l-isem proprju ta' belt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Berlin is a proper name used to identify a particular city.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir f'Berlin, u l-parteċipanti għandhom jaslu l-ġurnata ta' qabel.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Berlin, and participants should arrive the day before.
formal.zh: 会议将在柏林举行，参会者应提前一天抵达。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer għada? Mark: Sejjer Berlin biex niltaqa' ma' ħabib.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going tomorrow? Mark: I'm going to Berlin to meet a friend.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你明天去哪里？马克：我去柏林见一个朋友。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer Berlin biex niltaqa' ma' ħabib.
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer Berlin biex niltaqa' ma' ħabib.
messages.zh: 我去柏林见一个朋友。
messages.en: I'm going to Berlin to meet a friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Berlin 当作地图上的城市标签来记，注意首字母大写；再配对练习 f'Berlin“在柏林”和 lejn Berlin“往柏林”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden, brief flash of light, including a flash of lightning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突然出现、持续很短的闪光，也可指天空中的一道闪电。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Berqa hija dawl qawwi li jidher għal waqt qasir ħafna, u tista' tirreferi wkoll għal dawl ta' sajjetta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪光；突然出现、转瞬即逝的一道亮光。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Berqa hija dehra f'daqqa ta' dawl qawwi li ddum għal waqt qasir ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flash is a sudden bright light that lasts only a very short time.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一道闪电；雷电产生的瞬间亮光。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Berqa hija dawl qawwi ta' sajjetta li jidher għal waqt qasir fis-sema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lightning flash is a brief bright light that appears in the sky during lightning.

collocations.en: a lightning flash in the sky

formal.mt: Waqt il-maltemp, dehret berqa qawwija fis-sema, u ftit wara nstema' r-ragħad.
formal.en: During the storm, a bright lightning flash appeared in the sky, and thunder was heard shortly afterwards.
formal.zh: 暴风雨期间，天空中闪过一道强烈的闪电，不久后传来了雷声。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt dik il-berqa? Toni: Iva, għal mument dawwlet il-kamra kollha!
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see that flash of lightning? Toni: Yes, it lit up the whole room for a moment!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看见刚才那道闪电了吗？托尼：看见了，整个房间一下子都亮了！

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你看见刚才那道闪电了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that flash of lightning?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għal mument dawwlet il-kamra kollha!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għal mument dawwlet il-kamra kollha!
messages.zh: 看见了，整个房间一下子都亮了！
messages.en: Yes, it lit up the whole room for a moment!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 berqa 的共同画面是“突然亮一下”：普通场景可指闪光，放到天空和雷雨的语境中就理解为一道闪电。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An inn or lodging house that accommodates travellers or guests.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接待旅客或宾客并提供住宿的旅舍、客栈或馆舍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dar jew bini fejn jiġu milqugħa vjaġġaturi jew mistednin u jingħataw post fejn joqogħdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旅舍或客栈，即供旅客或宾客住宿的馆舍。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post ta' alloġġ fejn vjaġġaturi jew mistednin jistgħu joqogħdu waqt iż-żjara tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An auberge is an inn or lodging house where travellers or guests can stay during a visit.

formal.mt: Wara r-restawr, il-berġa l-antika nfetħet għall-viżitaturi, li setgħu jaraw il-bitħa u l-kmamar tagħha.
formal.en: After restoration, the old auberge opened to visitors, who could see its courtyard and rooms.
formal.zh: 修复后，这座古老的旅舍向游客开放，游客可以参观它的庭院和房间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dak il-bini bil-bitħa? Pawlu: Dik berġa antika. Trid tidħol taraha?
colloquial.en: Nina: What is that building with the courtyard? Pawlu: That is an old auberge. Would you like to go inside and see it?
colloquial.zh: Nina：那座带庭院的建筑是什么？Pawlu：那是一座古老的旅舍。想进去看看吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.zh: 那座带庭院的建筑是什么？
messages.en: What is that building with the courtyard?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (当地朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik berġa antika. Trid tidħol taraha?
messages.mt_standard: Dik berġa antika. Trid tidħol taraha?
messages.zh: 那是一座古老的旅舍。想进去看看吗？
messages.en: That is an old auberge. Would you like to go inside and see it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 berġa 写在一张带庭院和客房的旅舍图片上，想象旅客推门入住，用住宿场景记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A melon, a fruit with a firm rind and soft flesh inside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 甜瓜，一种外有较硬果皮、内部有柔软果肉的水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bettieħa hija frotta b'qoxra soda u laħam artab ġewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甜瓜；一种有外皮、果肉及内部种子的水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bettieħa hija frotta b'qoxra fuq barra u b'laħam u żrieragħ fuq ġewwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A melon is a fruit with a firm outer rind and soft flesh inside.

formal.mt: Qabel ma sservi l-bettieħa, neħħi ż-żrieragħ u aqta' l-frotta f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: Before serving the melon, remove the seeds and cut the fruit into small pieces.
formal.zh: 上桌前，先去掉甜瓜籽，再把果肉切成小块。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid ftit bettieħa wara l-ikel? David: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Aqtagħli biċċa żgħira.
colloquial.en: Nina: Would you like some melon after the meal? David: Yes, please. Cut me a small piece.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：饭后想吃点甜瓜吗？戴维：好的，谢谢。给我切一小块吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 饭后想吃点甜瓜吗？
messages.en: Would you like some melon after the meal?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Aqtagħli biċċa żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Aqtagħli biċċa żgħira.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。给我切一小块吧。
messages.en: Yes, please. Cut me a small piece.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bettieħa 和“切开甜瓜、去籽、分块”的动作连起来记；书写时留意双写 tt，以及带横线的字母 ħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large round container used for storing liquids such as wine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于储存葡萄酒等液体的大型圆桶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent kbir u tond li jintuża biex jinżammu fih likwidi bħall-inbid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于储存液体等物品的大桶。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent kbir u tond li jintuża għall-ħażna ta' likwidi jew prodotti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A barrel is a large round container used for storing liquids or other goods.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于储存葡萄酒等饮品的大桶。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent kbir li fih jinżammu xorb bħall-inbid u likwidi oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cask is a large container in which drinks such as wine are stored.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盛装或储存液体等物品的大型圆桶。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent kbir b'forma tonda li fih jistgħu jinżammu likwidi jew prodotti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A barrel is a large container that holds liquids or other goods for storage.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema mlew il-bettija bl-inbid u għalquha sew.
formal.en: The workers filled the barrel with wine and closed it securely.
formal.zh: 工人们把桶装满葡萄酒，并将它封好。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'hemm f'dik il-bettija? Pawlu: Inbid. Il-bettija l-oħra għadha vojta.
colloquial.en: Marija: What's in that barrel? Pawlu: Wine. The other barrel is still empty.
colloquial.zh: Marija：那只大桶里装着什么？Pawlu：葡萄酒。另一只桶还是空的。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 那只大桶里装着什么？
messages.en: What's in that barrel?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 葡萄酒。另一只桶还是空的。
messages.en: Wine. The other barrel is still empty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bettija 和一只圆鼓鼓的葡萄酒桶一起画在词卡上，再配对记忆“tal-inbid＝盛葡萄酒的、vojta＝空的”，用桶的画面巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short spell of rain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续时间较短的一阵降雨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xita li tinżel għal ħin qasir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 持续一小段时间的一阵雨。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Perjodu qasir li matulu tinżel ix-xita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rain shower is a short period during which rain falls.

formal.mt: Wara bexxa xita qasira, il-viżitaturi komplew il-mixja tagħhom fil-ġnien.
formal.en: After a brief rain shower, the visitors continued their walk in the garden.
formal.zh: 短暂的一阵雨过后，游客们继续在花园里散步。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadna ħerġin nimxu? Mark: Iva, kienet biss bexxa xita. Issa waqfet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are we still going out for a walk? Mark: Yes, it was only a rain shower. It's stopped now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们还出去散步吗？Mark：去呀，只是下了一阵雨。现在已经停了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们还出去散步吗？
messages.en: Are we still going out for a walk?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet biss bexxa xita. Issa waqfet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet biss bexxa xita. Issa waqfet.
messages.zh: 去呀，只是下了一阵雨。现在已经停了。
messages.en: Yes, it was only a rain shower. It's stopped now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bexxa xita 配一幅三格图：晴天、下雨、雨停；整组记成“一阵雨”，再用 qasira 提醒自己关注降雨时间短这一特点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a plan or intention to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示有做某事的计划或意图，常用于说明接下来打算采取的行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollok intenzjoni jew pjan li tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打算做某事；具有实施某项行动的意图。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikollok il-ħsieb li twettaq azzjoni jew tagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you intend to do something, you have a plan or purpose to do it.

formal.mt: Għandna beħsieb norganizzaw laqgħa biex niddiskutu l-proposti tal-istudenti.
formal.en: We intend to organize a meeting to discuss the students' proposals.
formal.zh: 我们打算组织一次会议，讨论学生们的提议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għandek beħsieb tagħmel għada? Mark: Għandi beħsieb immur il-librerija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you intend to do tomorrow? Mark: I intend to go to the library.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你明天打算做什么？马克：我打算去图书馆。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天打算做什么？
messages.en: What do you intend to do tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我打算去图书馆。
messages.en: I intend to go to the library.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għandi beħsieb 连成“我有个打算”一起记，再接具体行动；用“明天打算做什么”练习整句。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To intend to do something, with the intention attributed to the speaker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示说话者本人打算做某事，相当于“我打算”或“我有意”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser li jien għandi l-intenzjoni li nagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打算；在 beħsiebni 这一形式中，具体表示“我打算”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Turi li l-persuna li qed titkellem għandha intenzjoni jew pjan li tagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you say beħsiebni, you mean that you intend to do something yourself.

formal.mt: Beħsiebni nkompli l-istudji tiegħi wara li nlesti dan il-kors.
formal.en: I intend to continue my studies after I finish this course.
formal.zh: 我打算在完成这门课程后继续深造。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se tibda titgħallem il-Malti? Mark: Beħsiebni nibda l-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
colloquial.en: Maja: When are you going to start learning Maltese? Mark: I intend to start next week.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你准备什么时候开始学马耳他语？马克：我打算下周开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你准备什么时候开始学马耳他语？
messages.en: When are you going to start learning Maltese?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我打算下周开始。
messages.en: I intend to start next week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 beħsiebni 整体贴上“我打算”的标签，用 beħsiebni nibda“我打算开始”反复造句，记牢说话者是我。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel fear; the past-tense form beża' means that he felt afraid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到恐惧或害怕；过去时形式 beża' 表示“他害怕了”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħass biża' jew tħassib minħabba xi ħaġa li dehritlu ta' theddida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到害怕；作为此处的动词过去时，表示“他害怕了”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħass biża' minn xi ħadd, minn xi ħaġa jew minn sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone felt afraid, they experienced fear about someone, something, or a situation.

collocations.en: he was afraid of the dark
he was afraid of the dog

formal.mt: It-tifel beża' mill-ħoss qawwi u mar ħdejn ommu.
formal.en: The boy was frightened by the loud noise and went over to his mother.
formal.zh: 男孩被巨响吓到了，走到母亲身边。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Pawlu ma daħalx fil-kamra? David: Beża' mid-dlam. Dħalt miegħu u xgħelt id-dawl.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why didn't Pawlu go into the room? David: He was afraid of the dark. I went in with him and turned on the light.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Pawlu 为什么没进房间？David：他怕黑。我陪他进去，把灯打开了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么没进房间？
messages.en: Why didn't Pawlu go into the room?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Beża' mid-dlam. Dħalt miegħu u xgħelt id-dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Beża' mid-dlam. Dħalt miegħu u xgħelt id-dawl.
messages.zh: 他怕黑。我陪他进去，把灯打开了。
messages.en: He was afraid of the dark. I went in with him and turned on the light.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象男孩听见巨响后躲到母亲身边，把 beża' 整体记成“他害怕了”；用这个过去发生的画面提醒自己，它在这里是动词形式。

gloss_zh: 具体词义未明的形容词（所给释义为 Cucubiet）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adjective supplied with the gloss 'Cucubiet', without enough information to establish its precise meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 标注为形容词、所给释义为“Cucubiet”的词；现有信息不足以确定其具体描述意义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġġettiv mogħti bit-tifsira 'Cucubiet', iżda mingħajr biżżejjed tagħrif biex it-tifsira preċiża tiegħu tkun ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给释义标签为“Cucubiet”；无法仅凭此标签确定该形容词的确切中文意义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija għal dan l-aġġettiv hija 'Cucubiet', iżda din waħedha ma tiċċarax x'jiddeskrivi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This adjective is glossed as 'Cucubiet', but the supplied information does not establish what it describes.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'Bhajra' hija mmarkata bħala aġġettiv bit-tifsira 'Cucubiet', iżda hemm bżonn aktar tagħrif biex jiġi spjegat l-użu tagħha.
formal.en: The word 'Bhajra' is marked as an adjective with the gloss 'Cucubiet', but more information is needed to explain its use.
formal.zh: “Bhajra”一词被标作形容词，释义为“Cucubiet”，但还需要更多信息才能说明其用法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'Bhajra' hawn? Daniel: Hawn miktub 'Cucubiet', imma t-tifsira mhix ċara. Għandna bżonn eżempju.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'Bhajra' mean here? Daniel: It says 'Cucubiet' here, but the meaning isn't clear. We need an example.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“Bhajra”在这里是什么意思？Daniel：这里写着“Cucubiet”，但意思还不清楚。我们需要一个例句。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: “Bhajra”在这里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Bhajra' mean here?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub 'Cucubiet', imma t-tifsira mhix ċara. Għandna bżonn eżempju.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub 'Cucubiet', imma t-tifsira mhix ċara. Għandna bżonn eżempju.
messages.zh: 这里写着“Cucubiet”，但意思还不清楚。我们需要一个例句。
messages.en: It says 'Cucubiet' here, but the meaning isn't clear. We need an example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Bhajra 写在词卡正面，背面写“形容词；Cucubiet；具体含义待明”，先记住已有对应关系，等有明确语境后再补上意义画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to introduce information that the listener already knows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于引出听话人已经知道的信息，相当于“正如你所知”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex tintroduċi informazzjoni li l-persuna li qed tisma' diġà taf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正如你所知；用于提醒对方某件双方已经知道的事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser li dak li se jingħad huwa diġà magħruf mill-persuna li qed tisma'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression when introducing something that the person you are addressing already knows.

collocations.mt: bħal ma taf int, il-laqgħa tibda fid-disgħa
collocations.en: as you know, the meeting starts at nine
collocations.zh: 正如你所知，会议九点开始

collocations.mt: bħal ma taf int, għad għandna ħafna xogħol
collocations.en: as you know, we still have a lot of work
collocations.zh: 正如你所知，我们还有很多工作要做

formal.mt: Bħal ma taf int, ir-rapport għandu jitlesta qabel tmiem ix-xahar.
formal.en: As you know, the report must be completed before the end of the month.
formal.zh: 正如你所知，报告必须在月底之前完成。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Bħal ma taf int, għada ma nkunx hawn. Pawlu: Iva, niftakar. Narak il-Ħamis.
colloquial.en: Marta: As you know, I won't be here tomorrow. Pawlu: Yes, I remember. See you on Thursday.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你也知道，我明天不在这里。保罗：嗯，我记得。周四见。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħal ma taf int, għada ma nkunx hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Bħal ma taf int, għada ma nkunx hawn.
messages.zh: 你也知道，我明天不在这里。
messages.en: As you know, I won't be here tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 嗯，我记得。周四见。
messages.en: Yes, I remember. See you on Thursday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成谈话中的“共同知识提醒”：先说“你也知道”，再接双方熟悉的事情。例句中的完整表达为 bħal ma taf int，可整句朗读记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to express what accompanies an action or the means or manner of doing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示做某事时所伴随的事物、使用的手段或采取的方式，相当于“用”“带着”或“以”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex turi x'jakkumpanja azzjoni, jew il-mezz jew il-mod kif issir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示伴随、手段或方式：用，带着，以。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li turi xi ħaġa li takkumpanja azzjoni jew il-mezz jew il-mod li bih issir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use bi to indicate something accompanying an action or the means or manner in which it is performed.

collocations.zh: 耐心一点；带着一点耐心

formal.mt: Bi ftit paċenzja, l-istudenti jistgħu jifhmu aħjar dan it-test.
formal.en: With a little patience, the students can understand this text better.
formal.zh: 只要多一点耐心，学生们就能更好地理解这篇文章。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Tista' tgħinni naqra din l-ittra? Pawlu: Bi pjaċir! Ejja naqrawha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can you help me read this letter? Pawlu: With pleasure! Let's read it together.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你能帮我读这封信吗？保罗：很乐意！我们一起读吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能帮我读这封信吗？
messages.en: Can you help me read this letter?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 很乐意！我们一起读吧。
messages.en: With pleasure! Let's read it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bi 放进完整短语记忆：bi pjaċir 是“带着愉快心情”，自然表达就是“很乐意”；bi ftit paċenzja 则是“带着一点耐心”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling sleepy and finding it difficult to stay awake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到困倦、想睡觉，难以保持清醒的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fi stat ta' ngħas, meta persuna tkun trid torqod u ssibha diffiċli tibqa' mqajma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困倦而想睡觉的；昏昏欲睡的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fi stat ta' ngħas, meta persuna tħossha bi bżonn l-irqad u ssibha diffiċli tibqa' mqajma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are drowsy, you feel sleepy and have difficulty staying awake.

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, l-istudent kien bi ngħas għax ma kienx raqad biżżejjed.
formal.en: During the meeting, the student was drowsy because he had not slept enough.
formal.zh: 会议期间，这名学生因睡眠不足而昏昏欲睡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed titħaddet daqshekk ftit? Mark: Għax jien bi ngħas. Se mmur norqod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you so quiet? Mark: Because I'm drowsy. I'm going to bed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么话这么少？马克：因为我困了。我准备去睡觉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么话这么少？
messages.en: Why are you so quiet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jien bi ngħas. Se mmur norqod.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jien bi ngħas. Se mmur norqod.
messages.zh: 因为我困了。我准备去睡觉。
messages.en: Because I'm drowsy. I'm going to bed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bi ngħas 当作完整表达来记，联想眼皮下垂、不断打哈欠的困倦状态。

gloss_zh: 双数；表示两个的语法形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a grammatical number or form that refers specifically to two people or things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示双数，即专门指两个对象的语法数或形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi għadd jew forma grammatikali li tirreferi speċifikament għal żewġ persuni jew żewġ affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 双数的；在语法上专门表示两个对象的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jindika għadd grammatikali ta' żewġ persuni jew żewġ affarijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dual grammatical form refers specifically to two people or things.

collocations.zh: 一个采用双数形式的名词

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jidentifikaw il-forma bi tnejn u jispjegaw li tirreferi għal żewġ affarijiet.
formal.en: In this exercise, students should identify the dual form and explain that it refers to two things.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，学生应找出双数形式，并说明它指的是两个事物。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser forma bi tnejn? Rita: Tfisser forma grammatikali li tirreferi għal żewġ persuni jew żewġ affarijiet.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does a dual form mean? Rita: It means a grammatical form that refers to two people or two things.
colloquial.zh: Nina：双数形式是什么意思？Rita：就是指两个人或两个事物的语法形式。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 双数形式是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a dual form mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser forma grammatikali li tirreferi għal żewġ persuni jew żewġ affarijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser forma grammatikali li tirreferi għal żewġ persuni jew żewġ affarijiet.
messages.zh: 就是指两个人或两个事物的语法形式。
messages.en: It means a grammatical form that refers to two people or two things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一个圆、两个圆、三个圆作对照，只给两个圆标上 bi tnejn，记住这里的双数专指两个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with the Bible or the accounts and teachings it contains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与《圣经》或其中的记述、教导有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Bibbja jew mar-rakkonti u t-tagħlim li fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 《圣经》的；与《圣经》内容有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-Bibbja, il-kontenut tagħha jew it-tagħlim tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is bibliku is connected with the Bible or with the accounts and teachings found in it.

formal.mt: L-artiklu janalizza rakkont bibliku u jiddiskuti t-temi ewlenin tiegħu.
formal.en: The article analyses a biblical account and discusses its main themes.
formal.zh: 这篇文章分析了一则圣经记述，并讨论了其中的主要主题。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan ir-rakkont huwa bibliku? Ġużeppi: Iva, jinsab fil-Bibbja. Nistgħu naqrawh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is this a biblical account? Ġużeppi: Yes, it is in the Bible. We can read it together.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这是一则圣经记述吗？朱塞佩：是的，圣经里有。我们可以一起读。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 这是一则圣经记述吗？
messages.en: Is this a biblical account?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jinsab fil-Bibbja. Nistgħu naqrawh flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jinsab fil-Bibbja. Nistgħu naqrawh flimkien.
messages.zh: 是的，圣经里有。我们可以一起读。
messages.en: Yes, it is in the Bible. We can read it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“文本”和“记述”两个搭配记忆：test bibliku、rakkont bibliku。看到 bibliku，就想到给名词加上“与圣经有关的”这一说明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where beer is produced.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 酿造、生产啤酒的工厂或场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post jew fabbrika fejn tiġi prodotta l-birra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啤酒厂；酿造啤酒的生产场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fabbrika jew stabbiliment fejn issir il-birra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bibrerija is a place where beer is made.

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara fil-bibrerija, il-parteċipanti tgħallmu kif tiġi prodotta l-birra.
formal.en: During the visit to the brewery, the participants learned how beer is produced.
formal.zh: 参观啤酒厂期间，参与者了解了啤酒的生产过程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn issir din il-birra? Mark: F'bibrerija lokali. Għada sejrin inżuruha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is this beer made? Mark: At a local brewery. We are going to visit it tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这种啤酒是在哪里酿造的？马克：在一家本地啤酒厂。我们明天要去参观。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这种啤酒是在哪里酿造的？
messages.en: Where is this beer made?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在一家本地啤酒厂。我们明天要去参观。
messages.en: At a local brewery. We are going to visit it tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用生产场景记忆 bibrerija：想象参观工厂时看到酿造设备，并问“啤酒在哪里生产？”把这个词和“啤酒酿造厂”整块对应。

gloss_zh: 楼宇管理员；校舍管理员

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose job is to look after a building, such as a school.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责照管建筑物、处理日常管理事务的人，例如校舍管理员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tieħu ħsieb binja, bħal skola, u l-ħtiġijiet tagħha ta' kuljum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责照管和日常管理楼宇或校舍的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna responsabbli mill-kura u l-ħarsien ta' binja u minn xogħlijiet ta' kuljum fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bidillu is someone whose job is to look after a building and attend to its everyday needs.

collocations.en: to ask for the caretaker's help

formal.mt: Il-bidillu tal-iskola jiftaħ il-bieb prinċipali qabel jaslu l-istudenti.
formal.en: The school caretaker opens the main door before the students arrive.
formal.zh: 学校的校舍管理员在学生到校前打开大门。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-bieb tas-sala magħluq. Min jista' jiftħu? David: Staqsi lill-bidillu. Hu għandu ċ-ċavetta.
colloquial.en: Nina: The hall door is locked. Who can open it? David: Ask the caretaker. He has the key.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：礼堂的门锁着。谁能开门？戴维：问问校舍管理员吧。他有钥匙。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bieb tas-sala magħluq. Min jista' jiftħu?
messages.mt_standard: Il-bieb tas-sala magħluq. Min jista' jiftħu?
messages.zh: 礼堂的门锁着。谁能开门？
messages.en: The hall door is locked. Who can open it?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 问问校舍管理员吧。他有钥匙。
messages.en: Ask the caretaker. He has the key.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bidillu 和校园里拿着钥匙、照管校舍的人联系起来：门打不开时去找 il-bidillu tal-iskola，用具体人物场景记住“校舍管理员”。

gloss_zh: 就业状况或工作方面的变动

teaching_sense.en_definition: A change in a person's employment situation, such as moving to another job or taking on a different role.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人的就业状况或工作发生的变化，例如换工作或改变工作岗位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tibdil fis-sitwazzjoni tax-xogħol ta' persuna, bħal meta tibda xogħol ieħor jew tieħu rwol differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 就业状况或工作岗位的变化。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bidla fis-sitwazzjoni tax-xogħol ta' persuna, li tista' tinkludi impjieg ġdid jew rwol differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A change in employment occurs when someone's work situation changes, for example when they move to a different job.

formal.mt: Jekk ikun hemm bidla fl-impjieg tiegħek, jekk jogħġbok aġġorna d-dettalji fil-formola.
formal.en: If there is a change in your employment, please update the details on the form.
formal.zh: 如果你的就业状况发生变化，请更新表格中的相关信息。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Qed taħseb f'bidla fl-impjieg? Pawlu: Iva, nixtieq insib xogħol eqreb lejn id-dar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are you thinking about a change in employment? Pawlu: Yes, I'd like to find a job closer to home.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你在考虑换工作吗？Pawlu：是的，我想找一份离家更近的工作。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在考虑换工作吗？
messages.en: Are you thinking about a change in employment?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq insib xogħol eqreb lejn id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq insib xogħol eqreb lejn id-dar.
messages.zh: 是的，我想找一份离家更近的工作。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to find a job closer to home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与“工作信息需要更新”的场景绑定记忆；看到换岗位、换工作，就联想到 bidla fl-impjieg。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Purslane, a plant with fleshy green leaves that can be eaten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马齿苋，一种叶片肥厚、可供食用的绿色植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta b'weraq ħodor u mlaħħmin li jistgħu jittieklu, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala purslane.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马齿苋，一种具有肉质叶片的可食用植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta li għandha weraq imlaħħmin u li tista' tintuża bħala ikel; bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ purslane.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Purslane is a plant with fleshy green leaves which people can use as food.

formal.mt: Qabel ma żżid il-bidlieqa mal-insalata, aħsel il-weraq sew.
formal.en: Before adding the purslane to the salad, wash the leaves thoroughly.
formal.zh: 把马齿苋加入沙拉之前，请先彻底洗净叶片。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jisimha din il-pjanta bil-weraq ħodor? Nina: Din tissejjaħ bidlieqa; bl-Ingliż jgħidulha purslane.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this plant with green leaves called? Nina: It's called bidlieqa; in English, it's called purslane.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这种长着绿叶的植物叫什么？Nina：它叫 bidlieqa，英语叫 purslane，也就是马齿苋。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这种长着绿叶的植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant with green leaves called?

messages.speaker: Nina (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din tissejjaħ bidlieqa; bl-Ingliż jgħidulha purslane.
messages.mt_standard: Din tissejjaħ bidlieqa; bl-Ingliż jgħidulha purslane.
messages.zh: 它叫 bidlieqa，英语叫 purslane，也就是马齿苋。
messages.en: It's called bidlieqa; in English, it's called purslane.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张马齿苋叶片的识图卡，正面写 bidlieqa，背面写“马齿苋、purslane”，用同一植物串联三种语言。

gloss_zh: 比德尼亚（马耳他的一个村庄）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bidnija is the name of a village in Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 比德尼亚，马耳他的一个村庄的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidnija huwa l-isem ta' raħal f'Malta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比德尼亚，位于马耳他的一个村庄。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-Bidnija hija raħal li jinsab f'Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bidnija is a place name referring to a village in Malta.

collocations.zh: 到比德尼亚的一次参访

formal.mt: L-istudenti kitbu deskrizzjoni qasira tar-raħal tal-Bidnija bħala parti mill-proġett tagħhom.
formal.en: The students wrote a short description of the village of Bidnija as part of their project.
formal.zh: 学生们写了一篇比德尼亚村的简短介绍，作为他们项目的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn sejrin il-Ħadd? Sara: Se mmorru l-Bidnija biex naraw ir-raħal.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where are we going on Sunday? Sara: We're going to Bidnija to see the village.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A food made by mashing beans into a soft mixture.

gloss_zh: 具有生物活性的；资料将该条目标作名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry labelled as a noun whose supplied meaning concerns having biological activity or an effect on living organisms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资料标作名词、释义为“具有生物活性的”的条目，表达具有生物活性或能对生物体产生作用的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mmarkata bħala nom li t-tifsir mogħti tagħha jirrigwarda l-fatt li xi ħaġa għandha attività bijoloġika jew effett fuq organiżmi ħajjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有生物活性的，即具有生物学作用或能够对生物体产生作用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu attività bijoloġika jew li jista' jkollu effett fuq organiżmi ħajjin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is bioactive has biological activity or produces an effect on living organisms.

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, 'bijoattivi' għandu t-tifsira 'bioactive', jiġifieri li għandu attività bijoloġika; it-tikketta grammatikali mogħtija hija dik ta' nom.
formal.en: In this list, 'bijoattivi' has the meaning 'bioactive', referring to biological activity; the supplied grammatical label is noun.
formal.zh: 在这份列表中，“bijoattivi”的释义是“bioactive”，表达具有生物活性；资料提供的语法标签为名词。

colloquial.zh: Sara：这份列表里的“bijoattivi”是什么意思？Mark：它表示某物具有生物活性，或能对生物体产生作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The scientific field that uses computing to organize, analyse, and interpret biological data.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用计算机技术整理、分析和解释生物数据的学科。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qasam xjentifiku li juża l-kompjuters biex jorganizza, janalizza u jinterpreta data bijoloġika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生物信息学，即运用计算方法处理和研究生物数据的学科。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bijoinformatika hija qasam tax-xjenza li juża metodi tal-kompjuter biex jaħżen, janalizza u jinterpreta data bijoloġika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bioinformatics is the scientific field in which computing methods are used to store, analyse, and interpret biological data.

formal.mt: It-tim juża l-bijoinformatika biex iqabbel sekwenzi tad-DNA u jidentifika differenzi bejn il-kampjuni.
formal.en: The team uses bioinformatics to compare DNA sequences and identify differences between the samples.
formal.zh: 该团队利用生物信息学比较DNA序列，并识别样本之间的差异。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed tistudja dan is-semestru? Ninu: Il-bijoinformatika. Qed nitgħallem kif nuża l-kompjuter biex nanalizza data dwar il-ġeni. Lara: Mela qed tgħaqqad ix-xjenza mal-kompjuters!
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you studying this semester? Ninu: Bioinformatics. I'm learning how to use a computer to analyse data about genes. Lara: So you're combining science with computers!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你这学期在学什么？尼努：生物信息学。我正在学习如何用计算机分析基因数据。拉拉：这么说，你是在把科学和计算机结合起来！

teaching_sense.en_definition: The science that studies living organisms and their processes, structures, and relationships.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究生物及其生命过程、结构和相互关系的科学。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xjenza li tistudja l-organiżmi ħajjin, l-istrutturi tagħhom, il-proċessi tal-ħajja u r-relazzjonijiet bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生物学，研究生命和生物体，包括其结构、功能及相互关系的科学。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bijoloġija hija x-xjenza li tistudja l-ħajja u l-organiżmi ħajjin, inklużi l-istruttura tagħhom, kif jaħdmu u kif jirrelataw ma' xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Biology is the science concerned with living organisms, including their structures, functions, and relationships with one another.

formal.mt: Fil-kors tal-bijoloġija, l-istudenti jistudjaw kif il-pjanti jużaw id-dawl biex jipproduċu l-ikel tagħhom.
formal.en: In the biology course, students study how plants use light to produce their own food.
formal.zh: 在生物学课程中，学生研究植物如何利用光来制造自身所需的养分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema suġġett jogħġbok l-aktar? Pawlu: Il-bijoloġija, għax inħobb nitgħallem dwar l-annimali u l-pjanti. Maja: Jien ukoll! Illum għandna lezzjoni dwar iċ-ċelloli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which subject do you like best? Pawlu: Biology, because I like learning about animals and plants. Maja: Me too! Today we have a lesson about cells.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你最喜欢哪门科目？保罗：生物学，因为我喜欢了解动物和植物。玛雅：我也是！今天我们有一堂讲细胞的课。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to living organisms, their processes, or the scientific study of life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与生物体、生命过程或生物学研究有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-organiżmi ħajjin, mal-proċessi tal-ħajja jew mal-istudju xjentifiku tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生物的；生物学的，指与生物体、生命活动或生物学有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun bijoloġika meta jkollha x'taqsam mal-organiżmi ħajjin, mal-funzjonijiet tagħhom jew max-xjenza li tistudjahom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is biological relates to living organisms, their natural processes, or the scientific study of life.

formal.mt: It-tkabbir ta' pjanta huwa proċess bijoloġiku li jiddependi fuq kundizzjonijiet ambjentali xierqa.
formal.en: The growth of a plant is a biological process that depends on suitable environmental conditions.
formal.zh: 植物生长是一个依赖适宜环境条件的生物过程。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tħossok bi ngħas fl-istess ħin kull filgħaxija? Mark: Naħseb li għandu x'jaqsam mar-ritmu bijoloġiku tiegħi. Sara: Mela ġismek qed jgħidlek li wasal ħin l-irqad!
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you feel sleepy at the same time every evening? Mark: I think it has something to do with my biological rhythm. Sara: So your body is telling you it's bedtime!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么每天晚上都在同一时间犯困？马克：我想这和我的生物节律有关。萨拉：这么说，你的身体是在告诉你该睡觉了！

gloss_zh: 生物安全；防范生物威胁的安全措施

teaching_sense.en_definition: Protection against biological threats through measures that prevent the introduction, spread, or misuse of harmful organisms and biological materials.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过预防有害生物或生物材料的传入、传播和滥用，保护人、动物、植物及环境的安全。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħarsien kontra theddid bijoloġiku permezz ta' miżuri li jipprevjenu d-dħul, it-tixrid jew l-użu ħażin ta' organiżmi u materjali bijoloġiċi ta' ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生物安全，指防止有害生物、生物性病原体或相关材料传入、传播或被滥用的防护措施与管理。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bijosigurtà hija l-ħarsien tan-nies, tal-annimali, tal-pjanti u tal-ambjent permezz ta' miżuri li jnaqqsu r-riskju tad-dħul, tat-tixrid jew tal-użu ħażin ta' organiżmi u materjali bijoloġiċi ta' ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Biosecurity consists of measures designed to protect people, animals, plants, and the environment from the introduction, spread, or misuse of harmful biological agents.

formal.mt: Il-pjan ta' bijosigurtà tar-razzett jinkludi kontroll tad-dħul u tindif tat-tagħmir biex jitnaqqas ir-riskju tat-tixrid tal-mard.
formal.en: The farm's biosecurity plan includes access control and equipment cleaning to reduce the risk of disease spreading.
formal.zh: 该农场的生物安全计划包括出入管控和设备清洁，以降低疾病传播的风险。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandi nnaddaf l-istvali qabel nidħol fir-razzett? Ġużeppi: Iva, dik hija waħda mill-miżuri ta' bijosigurtà tagħna. Anna: Tajjeb, nurini fejn nista' nnaddafhom?
colloquial.en: Anna: Should I clean my boots before entering the farm? Ġużeppi: Yes, that's one of our biosecurity measures. Anna: All right, can you show me where I can clean them?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：进入农场前，我需要清洁靴子吗？朱塞佩：需要，这是我们的一项生物安全措施。安娜：好的，你能指给我看在哪里清洁吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi nnaddaf l-istvali qabel nidħol fir-razzett?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi nnaddaf l-istvali qabel nidħol fir-razzett?
messages.zh: 进入农场前，我需要清洁靴子吗？
messages.en: Should I clean my boots before entering the farm?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农场工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dik hija waħda mill-miżuri ta' bijosigurtà tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dik hija waħda mill-miżuri ta' bijosigurtà tagħna.
messages.zh: 需要，这是我们的一项生物安全措施。
messages.en: Yes, that's one of our biosecurity measures.

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: 好的，你能指给我看在哪里清洁吗？
messages.en: All right, can you show me where I can clean them?

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 bijosigurtà 时，想象进入农场前清洁靴子、阻止病原体随脚步传入的场景；用“守住入口，防止传播”联想生物安全。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Looking unhappy or showing annoyance by being quiet and unfriendly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 显得情绪低落，或因不满而沉默、态度冷淡的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidher imdejjaq jew li juri li hu urtat billi jibqa' sieket u ma jitkellimx bil-ħlewwa ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神情忧郁、闷闷不乐的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jidher imdejjaq u bla ferħ, spiss b'wiċċ serju u mingħajr tbissima.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is glum looks unhappy and shows little interest or pleasure in what is happening.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因不高兴或不满而生闷气、沉默冷淡的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri li hu urtat jew mhux kuntent billi jibqa' sieket u jġib ruħu b'mod kiesaħ ma' ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is sulky shows annoyance or disappointment by being unusually quiet and unfriendly.

formal.mt: Wara li sema' li l-vjaġġ kien tħassar, it-tifel baqa' bil-buri u ma ħax sehem fid-diskussjoni.
formal.en: After hearing that the trip had been cancelled, the boy remained sulky and did not take part in the discussion.
formal.zh: 听说旅行取消后，男孩一直生闷气，没有参与讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qiegħed bil-buri? Pawlu: Għax ħriġtu mingħajri u lanqas għedtuli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you sulking? Pawlu: Because you went out without me and did not even tell me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么在生闷气？保罗：因为你们出去没带上我，连说都没跟我说。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在生闷气？
messages.en: Why are you sulking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħriġtu mingħajri u lanqas għedtuli.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħriġtu mingħajri u lanqas għedtuli.
messages.zh: 因为你们出去没带上我，连说都没跟我说。
messages.en: Because you went out without me and did not even tell me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人板着脸不说话：只是低落时对应 glum，因不满而冷淡时对应 sulky，两种情境都练习 bil-buri。

teaching_sense.en_definition: With care and attention, or by proceeding slowly through successive stages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示做事时小心留意，或通过缓慢、连续的步骤逐渐进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'attenzjoni u b'kawtela, jew billi wieħed jimxi pass pass mingħajr għaġla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小心地；仔细地，注意避免损坏或出错。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'attenzjoni u b'kawtela sabiex jiġu evitati żbalji jew ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you do something bil-galbu, you pay attention to what you are doing so that you avoid mistakes or damage.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐地；循序进行，而不是一下子完成。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pass pass matul iż-żmien, aktar milli f'daqqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens bil-galbu, it develops in stages over time rather than happening all at once.

formal.mt: Matul it-taħriġ, żid il-piż bil-galbu u agħmel kull moviment bil-galbu biex tevita korriment.
formal.en: During training, increase the weight gradually and perform each movement carefully to avoid injury.
formal.zh: 训练时，要逐渐增加重量，并小心完成每个动作，以免受伤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' niftaħ din il-kaxxa? Toni: Iva, imma iftaħha bil-galbu. Fiha tazzi tal-ħġieġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I open this box? Toni: Yes, but open it carefully. There are glass tumblers inside.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我可以打开这个箱子吗？Toni：可以，不过要小心打开。里面有玻璃杯。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我可以打开这个箱子吗？
messages.en: Can I open this box?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma iftaħha bil-galbu. Fiha tazzi tal-ħġieġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma iftaħha bil-galbu. Fiha tazzi tal-ħġieġ.
messages.zh: 可以，不过要小心打开。里面有玻璃杯。
messages.en: Yes, but open it carefully. There are glass tumblers inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象搬玻璃杯时小心翼翼、一步一步走：用这个画面同时记住“小心地”和“逐渐地”，再按上下文选择意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Using words to express or communicate something, especially by speaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用言语表达或传达某事，尤指通过口头说话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Permezz tal-kliem biex tesprimi jew twassal xi ħaġa, speċjalment meta titkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用言语表达地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Billi tuża l-kliem biex tesprimi ħsieb jew twassal messaġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you express something verbally, you communicate it using words.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口头地；通过说话而非书写。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Billi tgħid xi ħaġa b'leħnek minflok ma tiktibha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you communicate something orally, you say it aloud instead of writing it.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom iwieġbu bil-kliem u mbagħad jiktbu sommarju tat-tweġiba tagħhom.
formal.en: Students should answer orally and then write a summary of their answer.
formal.zh: 学生应先口头回答，再写出答案的摘要。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tridni niktiblek kif nasal? Pawlu: Le, spjegali bil-kliem u nifhem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want me to write down how to get there? Pawlu: No, explain it to me orally and I'll understand.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：要我把怎么去那里写给你吗？保罗：不用，你口头解释一下，我就明白了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 要我把怎么去那里写给你吗？
messages.en: Do you want me to write down how to get there?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 不用，你口头解释一下，我就明白了。
messages.en: No, explain it to me orally and I'll understand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象放下笔、开口解释路线的画面，把 bil-kliem 与“用言语、口头表达”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: By walking from one place to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以走路的方式从一处前往另一处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Billi timxi fuq saqajk biex tmur minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 步行地；靠走路前往。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Billi tmur minn post għal ieħor fuq saqajk, mingħajr ma tuża vettura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you go somewhere on foot, you walk there instead of using transport.

formal.mt: Il-mużew jinsab għaxar minuti bil-mixi mill-istazzjon, u r-rotta hija mmarkata b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The museum is ten minutes on foot from the station, and the route is clearly marked.
formal.zh: 从车站步行十分钟即可到达博物馆，沿途有清晰的路线标识。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nieħdu l-karozza tal-linja sal-ħanut? Toni: Le, ejja mmorru bil-mixi. Qiegħed viċin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we take the bus to the shop? Toni: No, let's go on foot. It's nearby.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们坐公交车去商店吗？托尼：不用，我们走着去吧。就在附近。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们坐公交车去商店吗？
messages.en: Shall we take the bus to the shop?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ejja mmorru bil-mixi. Qiegħed viċin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ejja mmorru bil-mixi. Qiegħed viċin.
messages.zh: 不用，我们走着去吧。就在附近。
messages.en: No, let's go on foot. It's nearby.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上通往商店的一串脚印，将 bil-mixi 和“靠双脚走过去”的步行场景绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At a slow speed or taking time over an action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以较慢的速度行动，或不急于完成某个动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'pass kajman jew billi tieħu l-ħin tiegħek biex tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缓慢地；以较低的速度进行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'veloċità baxxa jew b'ritmu kajman, mingħajr għaġla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you do something slowly, you do it at a low speed or take your time.

formal.mt: L-għalliema talbet lill-istudent jaqra bil-mogħod sabiex il-klassi tkun tista' tifhem kull kelma.
formal.en: The teacher asked the student to read slowly so that the class could understand every word.
formal.zh: 老师请这名学生慢慢读，以便全班理解每一个词。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed timxi malajr wisq! Adam: Tajjeb, nimxi bil-mogħod biex inlaħħqu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: You're walking too fast! Adam: Okay, I'll walk slowly so we can keep pace together.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你走得太快了！亚当：好，我慢慢走，这样我们就能并排走了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你走得太快了！
messages.en: You're walking too fast!

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, nimxi bil-mogħod biex inlaħħqu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, nimxi bil-mogħod biex inlaħħqu flimkien.
messages.zh: 好，我慢慢走，这样我们就能并排走了。
messages.en: Okay, I'll walk slowly so we can keep pace together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把播放速度调低，边听边慢慢跟读；用这个放慢节奏的动作记住 bil-mogħod 表示“缓慢地”。

gloss_zh: 偷偷地；暗中；以隐秘的方式

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a secretive manner, so that other people do not notice or discover what is being done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以不让别人察觉或发现的方式，偷偷地或暗中做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod sigriet, sabiex ħaddieħor ma jindunax b'dak li jkun qed isir.

sense_translations.en_definition: in an underhand or surreptitious manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以偷偷摸摸、暗中进行或瞒着他人的方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod mistur jew qarrieqi, mingħajr ma ħaddieħor ikun jaf jew jinduna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone does something bil-moħbi, they do it secretly, often because they do not want other people to discover it.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif id-dokumenti nħarġu mill-uffiċċju bil-moħbi.
formal.en: The report describes how the documents were secretly taken out of the office.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这些文件如何被偷偷带出办公室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed titkellmu bil-moħbi? Lara: Qed nippjanaw sorpriża għal ommi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you talking in secret? Lara: We're planning a surprise for my mother.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们为什么偷偷说话？拉拉：我们在给我妈妈策划一个惊喜。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们为什么偷偷说话？
messages.en: Why are you talking in secret?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在给我妈妈策划一个惊喜。
messages.en: We're planning a surprise for my mother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友躲在门后小声筹备惊喜，把 bil-moħbi 和“偷偷地、暗中”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: With great strength or intensity, or by applying considerable physical force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示程度强烈、力量很大，或在动作中施加较大的力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'saħħa jew intensità kbira, jew billi tintuża forza fiżika konsiderevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈地；以很高的程度、明显的力度或坚定的态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'intensità kbira jew b'konvinzjoni soda, bħal meta wieħed jesprimi appoġġ jew oppożizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you feel or express something bil-qawwa, you feel or express it with great intensity or conviction.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力地；有力地；通过施加明显的力量来完成动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Billi tintuża forza qawwija biex isir moviment jew titwettaq azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you perform an action bil-qawwa, you apply considerable force while doing it.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat oppona bil-qawwa l-proposta minħabba l-ispejjeż għoljin tagħha.
formal.en: The committee strongly opposed the proposal because of its high costs.
formal.zh: 委员会因该提案成本高昂而表示强烈反对。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-bieb ma jinfetaħx. Nina: Iġbed bil-qawwa; il-manku ftit iebes.
colloquial.en: Mark: The door won't open. Nina: Pull hard; the handle is a little stiff.
colloquial.zh: 马克：门打不开。妮娜：用力拉，门把手有点紧。

messages.speaker: Mark (住户)
messages.zh: 门打不开。
messages.en: The door won't open.

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 用力拉，门把手有点紧。
messages.en: Pull hard; the handle is a little stiff.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bil-qawwa 配上两个画面：发言时态度强烈，拉门时身体用力；分别记住程度和力量。

gloss_zh: 向前；朝前的方向或移动

teaching_sense.en_definition: The direction or movement toward the front, understood as forward progress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 朝向前方的方向或移动，也可用来理解向前推进。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-direzzjoni jew il-moviment lejn in-naħa ta' quddiem, meqjus bħala avvanz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 朝前的方向；向前移动或推进。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Direzzjoni lejn in-naħa ta' quddiem jew moviment li jwassal aktar 'il quddiem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Forward refers to a direction or movement toward the front, taking someone or something further ahead.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju ta' direzzjonijiet, 'bil-quddiem' tirreferi għal moviment lejn in-naħa ta' quddiem.
formal.en: In this directions exercise, 'bil-quddiem' refers to movement toward the front.
formal.zh: 在这项方向练习中，bil-quddiem 指朝前方移动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawnhekk, xi tfisser 'bil-quddiem'? David: Tfisser moviment lejn in-naħa ta' quddiem, bħal meta tagħmel pass 'il quddiem.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'bil-quddiem' mean here? David: It means movement toward the front, as when you take a step forward.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 bil-quddiem 是什么意思？戴维：指朝前方移动，就像向前迈一步。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 bil-quddiem 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'bil-quddiem' mean here?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser moviment lejn in-naħa ta' quddiem, bħal meta tagħmel pass 'il quddiem.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser moviment lejn in-naħa ta' quddiem, bħal meta tagħmel pass 'il quddiem.
messages.zh: 指朝前方移动，就像向前迈一步。
messages.en: It means movement toward the front, as when you take a step forward.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习本词条所给的 forward 义时，画一支朝前的箭头，再想象沿箭头迈一步，记住向前的方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At a fast pace or with little delay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以很快的速度行动，或几乎不耽搁地完成某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'veloċità għolja jew mingħajr dewmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迅速地；以很快的速度或极少的耽搁行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod mgħaġġel, billi wieħed jaġixxi jew jimxi mingħajr dewmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone acts bil-ħeffa, they move or do something quickly, with very little delay.

formal.mt: It-tim wieġeb bil-ħeffa għat-talba u bagħat l-informazzjoni meħtieġa fl-istess jum.
formal.en: The team responded swiftly to the request and sent the necessary information on the same day.
formal.zh: 团队迅速回应了请求，并在当天发送了所需信息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn sejjer bil-ħeffa? Mark: Se naqbad il-karozza tal-linja. Tasal fi żmien żewġ minuti!
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you going in such a hurry? Mark: I'm going to catch the bus. It arrives in two minutes!
colloquial.zh: Sara：你这么急着去哪儿？Mark：我要去赶公交车。车还有两分钟就到了！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你这么急着去哪儿？
messages.en: Where are you going in such a hurry?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se naqbad il-karozza tal-linja. Tasal fi żmien żewġ minuti!
messages.mt_standard: Se naqbad il-karozza tal-linja. Tasal fi żmien żewġ minuti!
messages.zh: 我要去赶公交车。车还有两分钟就到了！
messages.en: I'm going to catch the bus. It arrives in two minutes!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“公交车快到了，脚步立刻加快”的画面记住 bil-ħeffa；它强调行动迅速、没有耽搁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An accounting statement listing ledger balances in debit and credit columns to check whether their totals agree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把分类账各账户余额分别列入借方和贷方，用于检查两方合计是否相等的会计报表。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prospett tal-kontabilità li jelenka l-bilanċi tal-kontijiet fil-kolonni tad-debitu u tal-kreditu biex jiġi ċċekkjat jekk it-totali jaqblux.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 列示分类账账户借方和贷方余额，以核对借贷合计是否相等的试算平衡表。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prospett li fih jitniżżlu l-bilanċi tal-kontijiet fuq in-naħa tad-debitu jew tal-kreditu biex jitqabblu t-totali taż-żewġ naħat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trial balance is an accounting statement used to check whether the total debit balances equal the total credit balances.

collocations.en: the totals of the trial balance

formal.mt: Il-kontabilista ħejja bilanċ ta' tqabbil preliminari biex jivverifika li t-total tad-debitu kien daqs it-total tal-kreditu.
formal.en: The accountant prepared a trial balance to verify that total debits equalled total credits.
formal.zh: 会计师编制了试算平衡表，以核实借方合计与贷方合计相等。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħejjejt il-bilanċ ta' tqabbil preliminari? Mark: Iva, imma t-totali ma jaqblux. Se nerġa' niċċekkja l-kontijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you prepared the trial balance? Mark: Yes, but the totals do not match. I will check the accounts again.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你编好试算平衡表了吗？马克：编好了，但两边的合计不一致。我会再检查一下各个账户。

messages.speaker: Lara (会计主管)
messages.zh: 你编好试算平衡表了吗？
messages.en: Have you prepared the trial balance?

messages.speaker: Mark (会计助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma t-totali ma jaqblux. Se nerġa' niċċekkja l-kontijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma t-totali ma jaqblux. Se nerġa' niċċekkja l-kontijiet.
messages.zh: 编好了，但两边的合计不一致。我会再检查一下各个账户。
messages.en: Yes, but the totals do not match. I will check the accounts again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组配上一张左右两栏的会计表来记：先列借贷余额，再比较两边合计，就是试算平衡表。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having different parts or elements arranged in suitable proportions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 各部分或各种要素比例适当、彼此协调的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-partijiet jew l-elementi differenti tiegħu fi proporzjonijiet xierqa u f'armonija bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 各部分比例适当或各种因素得到适当兼顾的；均衡的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu proporzjon xieraq bejn il-partijiet tiegħu jew li jagħti attenzjoni xierqa lill-fatturi differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is balanced has its different parts in suitable proportions or gives appropriate attention to different factors.

collocations.zh: 兼顾各方面的处理方式

formal.mt: Ir-rapport joffri rendikont bilanċjat tal-vantaġġi u l-iżvantaġġi tal-proposta.
formal.en: The report offers a balanced account of the advantages and disadvantages of the proposal.
formal.zh: 这份报告均衡地阐述了该提案的优点和缺点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-ikel huwa bilanċjat? Pawlu: Iva, fih ħaxix, ross u ħut.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this food balanced? Pawlu: Yes, it contains vegetables, rice and fish.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些食物营养均衡吗？保罗：均衡，有蔬菜、米饭和鱼。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些食物营养均衡吗？
messages.en: Is this food balanced?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fih ħaxix, ross u ħut.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fih ħaxix, ross u ħut.
messages.zh: 均衡，有蔬菜、米饭和鱼。
messages.en: Yes, it contains vegetables, rice and fish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象餐盘里蔬菜、米饭和鱼各占合适比例，用这个画面记住 bilanċjat 的“均衡”。

gloss_zh: 票；拜访用名片；商务名片

teaching_sense.en_definition: A document that allows travel or admission, or a small card used to introduce someone socially or professionally.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于乘车、入场等的票；也可指社交拜访时使用的名片，或载有职业及联系方式的商务名片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument li jippermetti vjaġġ jew dħul f'post, jew karta żgħira bl-isem ta' persuna, u xi drabi bid-dettalji tax-xogħol u tal-kuntatt tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 票；证明持有人有权乘坐交通工具、入场或使用某项服务的凭证。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li juri li persuna għandha d-dritt tivvjaġġa, tidħol għal avveniment jew tuża servizz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A biljett is a document that shows you are entitled to travel, enter an event, or use a service.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拜访用名片；用于社交拜访或自我介绍、印有姓名的小卡片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Karta żgħira bl-isem ta' persuna, li tingħata jew titħalla waqt żjara soċjali biex il-persuna tintroduċi ruħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A biljett is a small card bearing your name that you give or leave when making a social visit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 商务名片；载有姓名、职业或公司及联系方式的小卡片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Karta żgħira bl-isem ta' persuna, ix-xogħol jew il-kumpanija tagħha, u d-dettalji biex wieħed jagħmel kuntatt magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A biljett is a small card giving your name, professional details, and information that others can use to contact you.

formal.mt: Mal-wasla fil-konferenza, kull parteċipant għandu juri l-biljett tad-dħul. Waqt il-laqgħat, il-parteċipanti jistgħu jiskambjaw il-biljetti tan-negozju tagħhom.
formal.en: On arrival at the conference, each participant must show their admission ticket. During the meetings, participants may exchange their business cards.
formal.zh: 抵达会议现场时，每位参会者都须出示入场券。在会谈期间，参会者可以交换商务名片。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi bżonn biljett għat-tmienja ta' filgħaxija. Għad hemm post? Pawlu: Iva, hemm. Trid biljett wieħed? Lara: Iva, wieħed, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: I need a ticket for eight this evening. Is there still a seat available? Pawlu: Yes, there is. Would you like one ticket? Lara: Yes, one, please.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我想买一张今晚八点的票。还有座位吗？Pawlu：有的。您要一张票吗？Lara：对，一张，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn biljett għat-tmienja ta' filgħaxija. Għad hemm post?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn biljett għat-tmienja ta' filgħaxija. Għad hemm post?
messages.zh: 我想买一张今晚八点的票。还有座位吗？
messages.en: I need a ticket for eight this evening. Is there still a seat available?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (售票员)
messages.zh: 有的。您要一张票吗？
messages.en: Yes, there is. Would you like one ticket?

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 对，一张，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, one, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项画成三张小卡：乘车用的是票，登门介绍用的是拜访名片，工作联络用的是商务名片；根据使用场景辨义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Only to a very small extent, or only just enough for something to be possible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示程度或数量极少，接近没有；也可表示勉强达到某种程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sa grad żgħir ħafna, jew biss biżżejjed biex xi ħaġa tkun possibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 几乎不；几乎没有；程度极低或只是勉强达到。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kważi xejn jew sa grad żgħir ħafna, b'mod li xi ħaġa tkun biss kemm jista' jkun possibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use bilkemm to say that something happens or is possible only to a very small degree.

formal.mt: Minħabba l-istorbju fis-sala, il-parteċipanti bilkemm setgħu jisimgħu lill-kelliem.
formal.en: Because of the noise in the hall, the participants could hardly hear the speaker.
formal.zh: 由于大厅内噪声很大，参会者几乎听不清发言人的话。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed tismagħni? Adam: Bilkemm! Hemm ħafna storbju hawn. Nina: Se nerġa' nċempillek aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you hear me? Adam: Hardly! It's very noisy here. Nina: I'll call you again later.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你听得见我说话吗？Adam：几乎听不见！我这里很吵。Nina：我晚点再打给你。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听得见我说话吗？
messages.en: Can you hear me?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.zh: 几乎听不见！我这里很吵。
messages.en: Hardly! It's very noisy here.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我晚点再打给你。
messages.en: I'll call you again later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把音量调到只剩一丝声音：bilkemm nisma' 就是“我几乎听不见”。记住程度接近零，但可能还剩一点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: During the night, when it is normally dark.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在夜间，即通常天黑的时段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Matul il-ħin tal-lejl, meta normalment ikun id-dlam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在夜里；在夜间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fil-ħin tal-lejl, wara li jidlam u qabel ma jisbaħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens at night, it happens during the hours of darkness.

formal.mt: Xi ħaddiema jaħdmu billejl biex is-servizzi jibqgħu disponibbli erbgħa u għoxrin siegħa kuljum.
formal.en: Some employees work at night so that services remain available twenty-four hours a day.
formal.zh: 一些员工在夜间工作，以确保服务全天二十四小时持续提供。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex se torqod issa? Mark: Għax naħdem billejl u għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you going to sleep now? Mark: Because I work at night and need to rest.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么现在要睡觉？马克：因为我晚上上班，需要休息。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你怎么现在要睡觉？
messages.en: Why are you going to sleep now?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax naħdem billejl u għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għax naħdem billejl u għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
messages.zh: 因为我晚上上班，需要休息。
messages.en: Because I work at night and need to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗外天黑、屋内仍有人工作的画面，用“夜间工作”这个场景记住 billejl 表示“在夜里”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act or period of sitting, with the body supported in a seated position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坐这一行为，或身体处于坐姿的一段时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed joqgħod bilqiegħda, jew il-ħin li jqatta' f'dik il-qagħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坐这一行为；坐着休息的一段时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Att jew perjodu ta' mistrieħ li fih persuna tkun bilqiegħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sit is an occasion or period during which someone rests in a seated position.

formal.mt: Għal dan l-eżerċizzju, il-parteċipanti għandhom jibqgħu bilqeda fuq siġġu, b'saqajhom mal-art.
formal.en: For this exercise, participants should remain seated on a chair with their feet on the floor.
formal.zh: 进行这项练习时，参与者应保持坐在椅子上，双脚着地。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Trid tqum issa? Pawlu: Le, se nibqa' bilqeda ftit ieħor biex nistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you want to get up now? Pawlu: No, I'll stay seated a little longer to rest.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你现在想起来吗？保罗：不，我再坐一会儿，休息一下。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你现在想起来吗？
messages.en: Do you want to get up now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, se nibqa' bilqeda ftit ieħor biex nistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, se nibqa' bilqeda ftit ieħor biex nistrieħ.
messages.zh: 不，我再坐一会儿，休息一下。
messages.en: No, I'll stay seated a little longer to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走累后坐到椅子上，双脚落地，把 bilqeda 和“坐着休息的这一会儿”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At a fast pace or with little delay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以较快的速度，或没有多少耽搁地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'ħeffa jew mingħajr ħafna dewmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迅速地；以较快速度或在很短时间内。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod mgħaġġel jew fi żmien qasir, mingħajr ħafna dewmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you do something quickly, you do it at a fast pace or without much delay.

formal.mt: L-impjegat wieġeb bilġri għat-talba u bagħat id-dokumenti meħtieġa.
formal.en: The employee replied quickly to the request and sent the required documents.
formal.zh: 该员工迅速回应了请求，并发送了所需文件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tiġi bilġri? Għandi bżonn l-għajnuna. Mark: Iva, ġej issa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you come quickly? I need some help. Mark: Yes, I am coming now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你能快点过来吗？我需要帮忙。马克：可以，我现在就来。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tiġi bilġri? Għandi bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tiġi bilġri? Għandi bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 你能快点过来吗？我需要帮忙。
messages.en: Can you come quickly? I need some help.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 可以，我现在就来。
messages.en: Yes, I am coming now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同事一叫你就立刻赶过去，把 bilġri 和“动作快、耽搁少”的情境一起记住。

gloss_zh: 闷闷不乐的；烦躁易怒的

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a bad mood, either withdrawn and unfriendly or easily annoyed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人心情不好，表现为阴沉、不愿理人，或容易烦躁、发怒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jkun f'burdata ħażina, magħluq fih innifsu jew li jiddejjaq u jirrabja malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闷闷不乐、沉着脸而不愿与人交流的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jkun imdejjaq, magħluq fih innifsu u ma tantx ikun irid jitkellem ma' ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is sullen looks unhappy and is unwilling to speak or be friendly.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烦躁易怒、容易因小事而生气的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jiddejjaq jew jirrabja malajr, anki minħabba affarijiet żgħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is irritable becomes annoyed or angry very easily.

collocations.en: wake up in a bad mood

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, Pawlu deher bin-nervi u wieġeb biss meta saritlu mistoqsija.
formal.en: During the meeting, Pawlu seemed sullen and answered only when he was asked a question.
formal.zh: 会议期间，保罗显得闷闷不乐，只有别人向他提问时才回答。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed twieġeb hekk? Int bin-nervi llum? Mark: Iva, kull ħoss qed idejjaqni. Għandi bżonn ftit kwiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you answering like that? Are you feeling irritable today? Mark: Yes, every sound is bothering me. I need a little quiet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么这样回答？你今天很烦躁吗？马克：是啊，什么声音都让我烦。我需要安静一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed twieġeb hekk? Int bin-nervi llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed twieġeb hekk? Int bin-nervi llum?
messages.zh: 你怎么这样回答？你今天很烦躁吗？
messages.en: Why are you answering like that? Are you feeling irritable today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kull ħoss qed idejjaqni. Għandi bżonn ftit kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kull ħoss qed idejjaqni. Għandi bżonn ftit kwiet.
messages.zh: 是啊，什么声音都让我烦。我需要安静一会儿。
messages.en: Yes, every sound is bothering me. I need a little quiet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个表达配上两张表情卡：一张沉脸不语，一张一点就怒，分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling a need to sleep or finding it difficult to stay fully awake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人感到困倦、想睡觉，或已经昏昏欲睡、难以保持清醒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jkollu aptit jorqod jew li jkun qed isibha diffiċli jibqa' mqajjem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到困倦、想睡觉的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jħoss il-bżonn li jorqod u jkun jixtieq imur jistrieħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are sleepy, you feel tired and want to sleep.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 昏昏欲睡、清醒程度下降的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jkun bejn irqad u qawmien u jsibha diffiċli jżomm għajnejh miftuħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are drowsy, you are only partly awake and may fall asleep.

formal.mt: Wara lejl ta' ftit irqad, l-istudent kien bin-ngħas u sabha diffiċli jsegwi l-lezzjoni.
formal.en: After a night of little sleep, the student was drowsy and found it difficult to follow the lesson.
formal.zh: 由于前一晚睡得很少，这名学生昏昏欲睡，难以跟上课堂内容。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid naraw film ieħor? Luqa: Le, qed inħossni bin-ngħas. Se mmur norqod.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want to watch another film? Luqa: No, I'm feeling sleepy. I'm going to bed.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你想再看一部电影吗？卢卡：不了，我困了。我要去睡觉。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想再看一部电影吗？
messages.en: Do you want to watch another film?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qed inħossni bin-ngħas. Se mmur norqod.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qed inħossni bin-ngħas. Se mmur norqod.
messages.zh: 不了，我困了。我要去睡觉。
messages.en: No, I'm feeling sleepy. I'm going to bed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看电影时眼皮慢慢合上：先是想睡，再到半睡半醒，用同一画面串起两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A railway track along which a train travels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供火车沿着行驶的轨道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-linji tal-ħadid li fuqhom timxi ferrovija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供火车行驶的轨道。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-linji tal-ħadid li fuqhom timxi ferrovija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A track is a pair of rails along which trains travel.

formal.mt: Il-binarju tal-ferrovija se jingħalaq temporanjament minħabba xogħlijiet ta' manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The railway track will close temporarily because of maintenance work.
formal.zh: 铁路轨道将因维护工程暂时关闭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq liema binarju se tasal il-ferrovija tagħna? Mark: Fuq il-binarju numru tnejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which track will our train arrive on? Mark: On track number two.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们的火车会到哪条轨道？马克：二号轨道。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq liema binarju se tasal il-ferrovija tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq liema binarju se tasal il-ferrovija tagħna?
messages.zh: 我们的火车会到哪条轨道？
messages.en: Which track will our train arrive on?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 二号轨道。
messages.en: On track number two.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 binarju 放进火车进站的画面里记：先看轨道号码，再看火车沿轨道驶来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of the day when there is natural daylight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一天中有自然日光的时段，即白天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-jum meta jkun hemm id-dawl tax-xemx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白天，即一天中有日光的时段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħin tal-jum meta jkun hemm id-dawl tax-xemx, bejn il-lejl u l-lejl ta' wara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Daytime is the part of the day when there is natural light from the sun.

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol ta' manutenzjoni se jsir binhar sabiex il-ħaddiema jkollhom biżżejjed dawl naturali.
formal.en: The maintenance work will take place during the daytime so that the workers have enough natural light.
formal.zh: 维护工作将在白天进行，以便工人有充足的自然光线。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tippreferi tivvjaġġa binhar jew billejl? Mark: Binhar, għax inħobb nara l-pajsaġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you prefer travelling during the daytime or at night? Mark: During the daytime, because I like seeing the scenery.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你更喜欢白天出行还是晚上出行？马克：白天，因为我喜欢看沿途风景。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你更喜欢白天出行还是晚上出行？
messages.en: Do you prefer travelling during the daytime or at night?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 白天，因为我喜欢看沿途风景。
messages.en: During the daytime, because I like seeing the scenery.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 binhar 和阳光下出行的画面绑定，练习说“白天工作、白天旅行”来巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The son of the people being addressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指说话者正在交谈的你们的儿子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-iben tagħkom, jiġifieri t-tifel tagħkom bħala ġenituri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你们的儿子，指对交谈中的多位听者而言的儿子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-iben tal-persuni li l-kelliem qed jindirizza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your son is your male child, with this form addressing more than one person.

formal.mt: Għeżież ġenituri, binkom wera progress tajjeb fil-qari matul dan it-terminu.
formal.en: Dear parents, your son has made good progress in reading during this term.
formal.zh: 亲爱的家长们，你们的儿子本学期在阅读方面取得了良好进步。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Binkom ġej għall-festa għada? Pawlu: Iva, ġej magħna. Qed jistenna bil-ħerqa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is your son coming to the party tomorrow? Pawlu: Yes, he's coming with us. He's looking forward to it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你们的儿子明天来参加聚会吗？保罗：来，他和我们一起来。他很期待。

messages.speaker: Marija (向父母二人提问的朋友)
messages.zh: 你们的儿子明天来参加聚会吗？
messages.en: Is your son coming to the party tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej magħna. Qed jistenna bil-ħerqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej magħna. Qed jistenna bil-ħerqa.
messages.zh: 来，他和我们一起来。他很期待。
messages.en: Yes, he's coming with us. He's looking forward to it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师面对父母两人说 binkom：手势指向他们的儿子，整词记作“你们的儿子”。

gloss_zh: 两极格局；双相情感障碍

teaching_sense.en_definition: A division into two main opposing poles in politics or beliefs; also, bipolar mood disorder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 政治或信念体系中形成两个主要对立中心的两极格局；也指具有躁狂或轻躁狂发作及抑郁发作等表现的双相情感障碍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qagħda fejn il-politika jew sistema ta' twemmin tinqasam f'żewġ poli ewlenin opposti; tintuża wkoll għad-disturb bipolari tal-burdata, b'episodji ta' manija jew ipomanija u episodji ta' dipressjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: bipolarity (in politics or other belief systems)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 政治或其他信念体系中由两个主要对立中心构成的两极格局。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qagħda fil-politika jew f'sistemi oħra ta' twemmin fejn ikun hemm żewġ poli ewlenin li jkunu opposti għal xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bipolarity is a situation in which politics or beliefs are organized around two main opposing poles.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 双相情感障碍，一种涉及躁狂或轻躁狂发作以及抑郁发作的心境障碍。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Disturb tal-burdata li jinvolvi episodji ta' manija jew ipomanija u episodji ta' dipressjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bipolar mood disorder is a condition involving episodes of mania or hypomania and episodes of depression.

collocations.en: the diagnosis of bipolar mood disorder

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza l-bipolariżmu politiku u r-relazzjoni bejn iż-żewġ poli ewlenin.
formal.en: The study analyses political bipolarity and the relationship between the two main poles.
formal.zh: 该研究分析政治上的两极格局，以及两个主要中心之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawnhekk, il-kelma bipolariżmu tirreferi għall-politika jew għas-saħħa mentali? Pawlu: Għall-politika. It-test jitkellem dwar żewġ poli opposti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Here, does the word bipolariżmu refer to politics or mental health? Pawlu: Politics. The text discusses two opposing poles.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 bipolariżmu 指政治，还是心理健康？保罗：指政治。文章讨论的是两个相互对立的中心。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, il-kelma bipolariżmu tirreferi għall-politika jew għas-saħħa mentali?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, il-kelma bipolariżmu tirreferi għall-politika jew għas-saħħa mentali?
messages.zh: 这里的 bipolariżmu 指政治，还是心理健康？
messages.en: Here, does the word bipolariżmu refer to politics or mental health?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-politika. It-test jitkellem dwar żewġ poli opposti.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-politika. It-test jitkellem dwar żewġ poli opposti.
messages.zh: 指政治。文章讨论的是两个相互对立的中心。
messages.en: Politics. The text discusses two opposing poles.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给词条画两张语境卡：政治卡写两个对立中心，医学卡写双相情感障碍；阅读时先看上下文再选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to describe weather with noticeable wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于描述有明显风力的天气，意思是有风的或多风的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tiddeskrivi temp li fih ikun hemm ir-riħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有风的；形容天气中有明显的风。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi temp li fih ikun hemm riħ li jinħass.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If the weather is windy, there is a noticeable amount of wind.

formal.mt: Minħabba t-temp bir-riħ, l-attività fil-beraħ ġiet posposta.
formal.en: Because of the windy weather, the outdoor activity was postponed.
formal.zh: 由于天气多风，户外活动被推迟了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Illum ġurnata bir-riħ. Xorta se mmorru ħdejn il-baħar? Mark: Aħjar immorru kafetterija u nistennew sakemm jonqos ir-riħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: It's a windy day today. Are we still going to the seaside? Mark: We'd better go to a café and wait until the wind eases.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今天风挺大。我们还去海边吗？Mark：还是去咖啡馆，等风小一点吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum ġurnata bir-riħ. Xorta se mmorru ħdejn il-baħar?
messages.mt_standard: Illum ġurnata bir-riħ. Xorta se mmorru ħdejn il-baħar?
messages.zh: 今天风挺大。我们还去海边吗？
messages.en: It's a windy day today. Are we still going to the seaside?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar immorru kafetterija u nistennew sakemm jonqos ir-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar immorru kafetterija u nistennew sakemm jonqos ir-riħ.
messages.zh: 还是去咖啡馆，等风小一点吧。
messages.en: We'd better go to a café and wait until the wind eases.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象天气图上的树枝被风吹弯，把 temp bir-riħ 整组记成“有风的天气”，开口描述天气时一起调用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A type of beer known as white beer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为白啤酒的啤酒类型，整个短语用作饮品名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' birra magħruf bħala birra bajda; l-espressjoni kollha sservi bħala isem ta' din ix-xarba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白啤酒，一类啤酒的名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xarba alkoħolika li tagħmel parti mit-tipi ta' birra u li tissejjaħ birra bajda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: White beer is a type of alcoholic drink within the beer category.

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi birra bajda, li tista' tiġi ordnata f'tazza jew fi flixkun.
formal.en: The menu includes white beer, which can be ordered by the glass or bottle.
formal.zh: 菜单上有白啤酒，可以按杯或按瓶点单。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom birra bajda? Rita: Iva. Trid tazza jew flixkun?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have white beer? Rita: Yes. Would you like a glass or a bottle?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们有白啤酒吗？丽塔：有。您要一杯还是一瓶？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们有白啤酒吗？
