colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a stamp for this letter? Mark: Yes, take this one and stick it on the envelope.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有寄这封信用的邮票吗？马克：有，拿这张贴在信封上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有寄这封信用的邮票吗？
messages.en: Do you have a stamp for this letter?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din u waħħalha fuq l-envelop.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din u waħħalha fuq l-envelop.
messages.zh: 有，拿这张贴在信封上。
messages.en: Yes, take this one and stick it on the envelope.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bolla 和信封右上角的小邮票一起记，再连读 tixtri bolla，记住“买邮票”的实际动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of the city of Bologna.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 城市博洛尼亚的专有名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem proprju tal-belt ta' Bolonja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 博洛尼亚，城市名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bolonja huwa l-isem proprju ta' belt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bologna is the name of a city that is called Bolonja in Maltese.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir f'Bolonja nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Bologna on Monday.
formal.zh: 会议将于星期一在博洛尼亚举行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn sejjer għada? Pawlu: Sejjer Bolonja biex niltaqa' ma' ħabib.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you going tomorrow? Pawlu: I'm going to Bologna to meet a friend.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你明天去哪里？保罗：我要去博洛尼亚见一位朋友。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer Bolonja biex niltaqa' ma' ħabib.
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer Bolonja biex niltaqa' ma' ħabib.
messages.zh: 我要去博洛尼亚见一位朋友。
messages.en: I'm going to Bologna to meet a friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Bolonja 当作旅行目的地记：在车票旁写“博洛尼亚”，并用大写 B 提醒自己这是地名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to describe someone who comes from Bologna.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某人来自博洛尼亚的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-belt ta' Bolonja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自博洛尼亚的；用于描述人的来源地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta persuna tkun bolonjiża, tkun ġejja mill-belt ta' Bolonja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is described as bolonjiż comes from Bologna.

collocations.zh: 一名来自博洛尼亚的男学生
一位来自博洛尼亚的男作家

formal.mt: Kittieb bolonjiż se jippreżenta l-ktieb il-ġdid tiegħu waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: A writer from Bologna will present his new book at the meeting.
formal.zh: 一位来自博洛尼亚的男作家将在会上介绍他的新书。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-istudent il-ġdid minn fejn hu? Mark: Hu bolonjiż, ġej minn Bolonja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the new student from? Mark: He's from Bologna; that's where he comes from.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：新来的那名男学生是哪里人？马克：他是博洛尼亚人，来自博洛尼亚。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 新来的那名男学生是哪里人？
messages.en: Where is the new student from?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 他是博洛尼亚人，来自博洛尼亚。
messages.en: He's from Bologna; that's where he comes from.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Bolonja 和 bolonjiż 成对记：前者是地图上的城市，后者放在 student 后面说明这名学生来自哪里。

gloss_zh: 狡猾而善于骗人之计的；能耍手段骗人的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to describe a cunning person who is capable of tricking someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人狡猾、有心计，能够用计谋欺骗别人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun makakk u kapaċi jqarraq b'xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: A cunning person able to trick someone
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容人狡猾而善于耍手段，能够欺骗别人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta persuna tiġi deskritta bħala Bonavolja, ikun ifisser li hija makakka u kapaċi tqarraq b'ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is described as Bonavolja, they are cunning and capable of deceiving another person.

collocations.en: a cunning man capable of tricking others
collocations.zh: 一个狡猾而会骗人的男人

collocations.en: a cunning trader capable of deceiving others
collocations.zh: 一个狡猾而会骗人的商人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, in-negozjant hu Bonavolja u jirnexxilu jqarraq b'xerrej permezz ta' wegħda falza.
formal.en: In the story, the trader is cunning and manages to deceive a buyer with a false promise.
formal.zh: 故事中的商人狡猾而会骗人，凭借一个虚假的承诺骗过了一名买家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma temminx lil dak ir-raġel? Pawlu: Għax hu Bonavolja; darba diġà qarraq bija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you believe that man? Pawlu: Because he's cunning and can trick people; he has already deceived me once.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么不相信那个男人？保罗：因为他狡猾又会骗人，他已经骗过我一次了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma temminx lil dak ir-raġel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma temminx lil dak ir-raġel?
messages.zh: 你为什么不相信那个男人？
messages.en: Why don't you believe that man?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu Bonavolja; darba diġà qarraq bija.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu Bonavolja; darba diġà qarraq bija.
messages.zh: 因为他狡猾又会骗人，他已经骗过我一次了。
messages.en: Because he's cunning and can trick people; he has already deceived me once.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事场景记 Bonavolja：一个人用假承诺骗过买家；把“狡猾”和“能骗人”两个意思一起记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A greeting used when meeting or addressing someone in the morning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 早晨见到别人或向别人打招呼时使用的问候语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima li tintuża meta tiltaqa' ma' xi ħadd jew tkellmu filgħodu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 早安；早晨向他人致意时使用的问候语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tislima li tgħid lil xi ħadd filgħodu biex issellimlu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You say bonġornu when you greet someone in the morning.

formal.mt: Fid-diskors tal-ftuħ, id-direttriċi qalet: 'Bonġornu lil kulħadd, u merħba għal din il-laqgħa.'
formal.en: In her opening address, the director said, 'Good morning, everyone, and welcome to this meeting.'
formal.zh: 主任在开场致辞中说：“大家早上好，欢迎参加这次会议。”

colloquial.mt: Marija: Bonġornu, Pawlu! Kif int illum? Pawlu: Bonġornu, Marija! Tajjeb, grazzi. U int?
colloquial.en: Marija: Good morning, Pawlu! How are you today? Pawlu: Good morning, Marija! I'm well, thanks. And you?
colloquial.zh: Marija：早上好，Pawlu！你今天怎么样？Pawlu：早上好，Marija！我很好，谢谢。你呢？

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 早上好，Pawlu！你今天怎么样？
messages.en: Good morning, Pawlu! How are you today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Bonġornu, Marija! Tajjeb, grazzi. U int?
messages.mt_standard: Bonġornu, Marija! Tajjeb, grazzi. U int?
messages.zh: 早上好，Marija！我很好，谢谢。你呢？
messages.en: Good morning, Marija! I'm well, thanks. And you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bonġornu 和清晨见到邻居的画面绑定，开口先说早上好，再接 Kif int?，整组练习更好记。

gloss_zh: 董事会；理事会；负责特定事务的委员会

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of people who direct an organisation or have responsibility for a particular task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 领导某个组织或承担某项特定职责的集体机构，如董事会、理事会或委员会。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' persuni li jmexxi organizzazzjoni jew ikun responsabbli għal xogħol jew qasam partikolari.

sense_translations.en_definition: board (group or committee that leads an organisation or is tasked with a specific responsibility)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 董事会、理事会或委员会，指领导某个组织或受命承担特定职责的一组人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp jew kumitat ta' persuni li jmexxi organizzazzjoni jew jingħata responsabbiltà speċifika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A board is a group of people who manage an organisation or take responsibility for a particular area of its work.

formal.mt: Il-bord approva l-baġit għas-sena li ġejja wara li eżamina r-rapport finanzjarju.
formal.en: The board approved the budget for the coming year after examining the financial report.
formal.zh: 董事会审阅财务报告后，批准了下一年度的预算。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-bord iddeċieda dwar il-proġett? Pawlu: Għadu le. Għada għandhom laqgħa oħra.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has the board made a decision about the project? Pawlu: Not yet. They have another meeting tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Marija：董事会对这个项目作出决定了吗？Pawlu：还没有。他们明天还要开一次会。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 董事会对这个项目作出决定了吗？
messages.en: Has the board made a decision about the project?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu le. Għada għandhom laqgħa oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu le. Għada għandhom laqgħa oħra.
messages.zh: 还没有。他们明天还要开一次会。
messages.en: Not yet. They have another meeting tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bord 记成围桌开会、共同作决定的一组人，再用“董事会成员”和“董事会会议”两个搭配巩固机构义。

gloss_zh: 外部带有环绕式包裹部分的小袋

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pouch with a covering section that wraps around its body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有可绕着袋身包裹的覆盖部分的小袋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Borża żgħira b'parti li titgeżwer madwar il-borża biex tgħattiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 环绕包裹式小袋，带有绕着袋身包覆的部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Borża żgħira li għandha parti li ddur u titgeżwer madwarha bħala għata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wraparound pouch is a small bag with a covering section that folds or wraps around the body of the bag.

collocations.zh: 装首饰的环绕包裹式小袋

formal.mt: L-oġġett deskritt fil-katalgu huwa borża b'perpura titgeżwer madwarha, maħsuba biex iżżomm ġojjelli żgħar.
formal.en: The item described in the catalogue is a wraparound pouch intended to hold small pieces of jewellery.
formal.zh: 目录中描述的物品是一款环绕包裹式小袋，用于存放小件首饰。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Qed infittex borża b'perpura titgeżwer madwarha għall-ġojjelli tiegħi. Pawlu: Ara din. Tista' tgeżwer din il-parti madwar il-borża.
colloquial.en: Marija: I'm looking for a wraparound pouch for my jewellery. Pawlu: Look at this one. You can wrap this section around the pouch.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我想找一个装首饰的环绕包裹式小袋。Pawlu：看看这个。你可以把这一部分绕着袋身包起来。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed infittex borża b'perpura titgeżwer madwarha għall-ġojjelli tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Qed infittex borża b'perpura titgeżwer madwarha għall-ġojjelli tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我想找一个装首饰的环绕包裹式小袋。
messages.en: I'm looking for a wraparound pouch for my jewellery.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara din. Tista' tgeżwer din il-parti madwar il-borża.
messages.mt_standard: Ara din. Tista' tgeżwer din il-parti madwar il-borża.
messages.zh: 看看这个。你可以把这一部分绕着袋身包起来。
messages.en: Look at this one. You can wrap this section around the pouch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动作记住长短语：先想象一个小袋，再想象外面的覆盖部分绕袋身包一圈；把 titgeżwer madwarha 和“绕着它包裹”的画面连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bag or pouch with a flat bottom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 底部平坦、用于装小件物品的袋子或小袋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Borża żgħira li għandha qiegħ ċatt u tintuża biex iżżomm oġġetti żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平底小袋，即底部呈平面的小型收纳袋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Borża żgħira b'qiegħ ċatt li fiha jistgħu jitqiegħdu oġġetti żgħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flat-bottomed pouch is a small bag whose base is flat rather than rounded or pointed.

formal.mt: Il-kampjun huwa borża bil-qiegħ ċatt magħmula mid-drapp, maħsuba biex iżżomm oġġetti żgħar.
formal.en: The sample is a flat-bottomed pouch made of cloth, intended to hold small objects.
formal.zh: 该样品是一个布制平底小袋，用于存放小件物品。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandek borża bil-qiegħ ċatt għall-muniti? Pawlu: Iva, din żgħira u għandha biżżejjed spazju.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you have a flat-bottomed pouch for coins? Pawlu: Yes, this one is small and has enough room.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你这里有装硬币的平底小袋吗？Pawlu：有，这个小巧，空间也够用。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 你这里有装硬币的平底小袋吗？
messages.en: Do you have a flat-bottomed pouch for coins?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, din żgħira u għandha biżżejjed spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, din żgħira u għandha biżżejjed spazju.
messages.zh: 有，这个小巧，空间也够用。
messages.en: Yes, this one is small and has enough room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按画面分块记：borża 是袋子，qiegħ 是底部，ċatt 是平的；想象手指沿小袋的平底划过，就能记住整个短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bag made of plastic, used for carrying or storing things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用塑料制成、用于携带或存放物品的袋子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Borża magħmula mill-plastik li tintuża biex iġġorr jew taħżen affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用塑料制成、用于装载、携带或存放物品的袋子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Borża magħmula mill-plastik li tintuża biex jitpoġġew, jinġarru jew jinħażnu fiha diversi affarijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A plastic bag is a bag made of plastic that you use to carry or store things.

collocations.mt: borża tal-plastik li tista' terġa' tintuża

formal.mt: Il-klijenti huma mitluba jużaw l-istess borża tal-plastik aktar minn darba biex inaqqsu l-iskart.
formal.en: Customers are asked to use the same plastic bag more than once to reduce waste.
formal.zh: 请顾客多次使用同一个塑料袋，以减少垃圾。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek bżonn borża tal-plastik? Mark: Le, grazzi. Ġibt borża miegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you need a plastic bag? Mark: No, thanks. I brought a bag with me.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你需要塑料袋吗？Mark：不用，谢谢。我自己带了袋子。

messages.speaker: Sara (收银员)
messages.zh: 你需要塑料袋吗？
messages.en: Do you need a plastic bag?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 不用，谢谢。我自己带了袋子。
messages.en: No, thanks. I brought a bag with me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上购物塑料袋的画面：先记 borża 是袋子，再把 tal-plastik 与塑料材质联系起来。

gloss_zh: 自立袋；可直立放置的包装袋

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pouch with a base that allows it to stand upright, used for packaging products.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 底部具有支撑结构、能够自行直立放置的包装袋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Borża għall-ippakkjar b'qiegħ li jippermettilha tibqa' wieqfa waħedha fuq wiċċ ċatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自立式软包装袋，底部展开后可支撑袋身直立。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Borża flessibbli għall-ippakkjar li għandha qiegħ li jinfetaħ biex iżommha wieqfa waħedha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stand-up pouch is a flexible package whose base allows it to remain upright without support.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够依靠自身底部直立摆放的袋状包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Borża għall-ippakkjar iddisinjata biex toqgħod wieqfa fuq il-qiegħ tagħha mingħajr appoġġ minn barra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A standing pouch is a packaging bag designed to rest upright on its own base.

collocations.mt: borża wieqfa li tista' terġa' tingħalaq

formal.mt: Il-prodott jiġi ppakkjat f'borża wieqfa li tista' terġa' tingħalaq wara kull użu.
formal.en: The product is packaged in a stand-up pouch that can be resealed after each use.
formal.zh: 该产品采用自立袋包装，每次使用后均可重新封口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi din il-borża wieqfa tal-kafè? Pawlu: Poġġiha fuq l-ixkaffa; toqgħod wieqfa waħedha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put this stand-up pouch of coffee? Pawlu: Put it on the shelf; it stands up on its own.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这袋自立包装的咖啡放在哪里？Pawlu：放到架子上吧，它自己就能立住。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inpoġġi din il-borża wieqfa tal-kafè?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inpoġġi din il-borża wieqfa tal-kafè?
messages.zh: 这袋自立包装的咖啡放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this stand-up pouch of coffee?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġiha fuq l-ixkaffa; toqgħod wieqfa waħedha.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġiha fuq l-ixkaffa; toqgħod wieqfa waħedha.
messages.zh: 放到架子上吧，它自己就能立住。
messages.en: Put it on the shelf; it stands up on its own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一袋咖啡不用靠墙也能站稳，把 borża wieqfa 整体记作“站得住的包装袋”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bag carried by hand or over the shoulder for keeping personal belongings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手提着或背在肩上、用于携带个人随身物品的包。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Borża li tinġarr fl-id jew fuq l-ispalla u li tintuża biex jinżammu fiha affarijiet personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于携带钱包、钥匙等个人物品的手提包或肩包，通常指女式随身包。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Borża, ġeneralment tan-nisa, li tinġarr fl-id jew fuq l-ispalla u li fiha jitqiegħdu affarijiet personali bħall-portmoni u ċ-ċwievet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A handbag is a bag that you carry by hand or over your shoulder to hold personal belongings.

collocations.en: a handbag with a long strap

formal.mt: Instabet borżetta sewda ħdejn id-daħla tal-librerija u ngħatat lill-persuna responsabbli.
formal.en: A black handbag was found near the library entrance and handed to the person in charge.
formal.zh: 有人在图书馆入口附近发现了一个黑色手提包，并将其交给负责人。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Rajt il-borżetta tiegħi? Anna: Iva, qiegħda fuq is-siġġu ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you seen my handbag? Anna: Yes, it's on the chair by the door.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你看见我的手提包了吗？Anna：看见了，在门旁边的椅子上。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见我的手提包了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen my handbag?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħda fuq is-siġġu ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħda fuq is-siġġu ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 看见了，在门旁边的椅子上。
messages.en: Yes, it's on the chair by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前把钱包、钥匙和手机放进手提包，边做动作边念 borżetta，把词音与随身包的用途绑定。

gloss_zh: 植物学的；与植物研究有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to plants or to the scientific study of plants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与植物或对植物的科学研究有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-pjanti jew mal-istudju xjentifiku tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物学的；涉及植物或植物科学研究的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-pjanti, il-karatteristiċi tagħhom jew ix-xjenza li tistudjahom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is botanical relates to plants or to the scientific study of plants.

formal.mt: L-istudju botaniku jiddeskrivi l-pjanti li jikbru f'din iż-żona u l-kundizzjonijiet li jeħtieġu.
formal.en: The botanical study describes the plants growing in this area and the conditions they require.
formal.zh: 这项植物学研究描述了该地区生长的植物及其所需的环境条件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tmur il-ġnien botaniku nhar is-Sibt? Mark: Iva, nixtieq nara l-pjanti u nitgħallem isimhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to go to the botanical garden on Saturday? Mark: Yes, I'd like to see the plants and learn their names.
colloquial.zh: Lara：星期六想去植物园吗？Mark：想，我想看看那些植物，学学它们的名字。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tmur il-ġnien botaniku nhar is-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tmur il-ġnien botaniku nhar is-Sibt?
messages.zh: 星期六想去植物园吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go to the botanical garden on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq nara l-pjanti u nitgħallem isimhom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq nara l-pjanti u nitgħallem isimhom.
messages.zh: 想，我想看看那些植物，学学它们的名字。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to see the plants and learn their names.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 botanical 辅助联想 botaniku，再记住 ġnien botaniku“植物园”，通过熟悉搭配记牢形容词的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container that releases its contents as a fine spray when its nozzle is pressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按压喷嘴时，能将内装物以细小雾滴形式喷出的容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li joħroġ il-kontenut tiegħu fi qtar fin meta tagħfas iż-żennuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过喷嘴将内装物喷成细雾的罐状容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bott b'żennuna li tintuża biex il-kontenut tiegħu jinxtered fi qtar fin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spray container holds a substance that you release as a fine mist by pressing its nozzle.

collocations.en: the nozzle of the spray can

formal.mt: Qabel tuża l-bott sprej, aqra sew l-istruzzjonijiet fuq it-tikketta.
formal.en: Before using the spray can, read the instructions on the label carefully.
formal.zh: 使用喷雾罐之前，请仔细阅读标签上的说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn qiegħed il-bott sprej taż-żebgħa? Mark: Fuq l-ixkaffa, ħdejn il-pinzell.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the can of spray paint? Mark: On the shelf, next to the paintbrush.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那罐喷漆在哪里？Mark：在架子上，油漆刷旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那罐喷漆在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the can of spray paint?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在架子上，油漆刷旁边。
messages.en: On the shelf, next to the paintbrush.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组和“按下喷嘴，罐里喷出细雾”的画面绑定，再用“喷漆罐”这一具体物品反复记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Electric light bulbs, considered as more than one item.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通电后发光的灯泡；此处表示不止一个灯泡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti li jitwaħħlu f'lampa u jagħtu d-dawl bl-elettriku; din il-forma tindika aktar minn wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电灯泡，指安装在灯具中、通电后发光的部件，数量为复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti li jipproduċu d-dawl meta jgħaddi minnhom l-elettriku u li jitwaħħlu f'lampi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Light bulbs are the parts of lamps that produce light when supplied with electricity.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema bidlu l-bozzoz fil-kuritur biex itejbu d-dawl.
formal.en: The workers replaced the light bulbs in the corridor to improve the lighting.
formal.zh: 工人更换了走廊里的灯泡，以改善照明。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandna bozzoz ġodda? Mark: Iva, hemm tnejn fil-kexxun.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do we have any new light bulbs? Mark: Yes, there are two in the drawer.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们有新灯泡吗？Mark：有，抽屉里有两个。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 我们有新灯泡吗？
messages.en: Do we have any new light bulbs?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 有，抽屉里有两个。
messages.en: Yes, there are two in the drawer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象抽屉里并排放着两个灯泡，把 bozzoz 与“两只灯泡”的画面一起记，特别提醒自己这里是复数。

gloss_zh: 波斯尼亚的；来自波斯尼亚的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming from Bosnia or connected with its people, culture, or country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自波斯尼亚的，或与其人民、文化及国家有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Bożnija jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' dan il-pajjiż, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 波斯尼亚的；与波斯尼亚及其人民或文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Bożnija, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as Bosnian is connected with Bosnia, its people, or its culture.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or related to the Republic of Bosnia
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自波斯尼亚共和国的，或与该共和国有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġej mir-Repubblika tal-Bożnija jew li għandu rabta magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or thing described this way comes from or is associated with the Republic of Bosnia.

formal.mt: Il-festival se juri film bożnijaku li jittratta l-ħajja ta' familja f'Sarajevo.
formal.en: The festival will screen a Bosnian film about the life of a family in Sarajevo.
formal.zh: 电影节将放映一部波斯尼亚电影，讲述萨拉热窝一个家庭的生活。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-kittieb bożnijaku? Pawlu: Iva, ġej minn Sarajevo.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this writer Bosnian? Pawlu: Yes, he comes from Sarajevo.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这位作家是波斯尼亚人吗？Pawlu：是的，他来自萨拉热窝。

messages.speaker: Sara (读者)
messages.zh: 这位作家是波斯尼亚人吗？
messages.en: Is this writer Bosnian?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他来自萨拉热窝。
messages.en: Yes, he comes from Sarajevo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在波斯尼亚地图旁写上 bożnijaku，再配“作家”和“电影”两张图片，记住它表示来源或关联，是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An undergarment worn over the breasts to cover and support them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿在外衣里面，用来遮盖和承托乳房的内衣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies ta' taħt li jintlibes biex jgħatti u jsostni s-sider.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胸罩；覆盖并承托乳房的贴身内衣。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa lbies ta' taħt li tgħatti s-sider u tagħtih appoġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bra is an undergarment that covers and supports the breasts.

formal.mt: Din il-bra tal-isport tipprovdi appoġġ waqt l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: This sports bra provides support during exercise.
formal.zh: 这款运动文胸在锻炼时提供承托。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandkom din il-bra b'qies akbar? Rita: Iva, nista' nġiblek waħda biex tipprovaha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have this bra in a larger size? Rita: Yes, I can get you one to try on.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这款文胸有大一号的吗？Rita：有，我可以拿一件给你试穿。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这款文胸有大一号的吗？
messages.en: Do you have this bra in a larger size?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nista' nġiblek waħda biex tipprovaha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nista' nġiblek waħda biex tipprovaha.
messages.zh: 有，我可以拿一件给你试穿。
messages.en: Yes, I can get you one to try on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bra 和衣柜里的文胸直接对应，再连记 bra tal-isport“运动文胸”，用熟悉的穿衣场景巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong alcoholic drink made by distilling wine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由葡萄酒蒸馏制成的一种烈性酒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xarba alkoħolika qawwija magħmula bid-distillazzjoni tal-inbid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白兰地，一种由葡萄酒蒸馏制成的烈性酒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xarba alkoħolika qawwija li ssir billi jiġi ddistillat l-inbid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Brandy is a strong alcoholic drink produced by distilling wine.

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob żewġ imgħaref brandi biex jagħtu togħma liz-zalza.
formal.en: The recipe calls for two tablespoons of brandy to flavour the sauce.
formal.zh: 这份食谱需要加入两汤匙白兰地，为酱汁增添风味。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandna brandi għar-riċetta? Pawlu: Iva, hemm flixkun fl-armarju.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do we have any brandy for the recipe? Pawlu: Yes, there's a bottle in the cupboard.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我们有做这道菜要用的白兰地吗？保罗：有，橱柜里有一瓶。

messages.speaker: Marta (家人)
messages.zh: 我们有做这道菜要用的白兰地吗？
messages.en: Do we have any brandy for the recipe?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 有，橱柜里有一瓶。
messages.en: Yes, there's a bottle in the cupboard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 brandi 和英语 brandy 对照记忆，再联想厨房里标着“白兰地”的酒瓶；用 tazza brandi 记住“一杯白兰地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A computer program used to open and view websites.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于打开、查看和浏览网站的计算机程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Programm tal-kompjuter li jintuża biex tiftaħ siti u tara paġni fuq l-internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 网页浏览器，用于访问网站和显示网页的软件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Programm li bih wieħed jista' jaċċessa siti fuq l-internet u jara l-paġni tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A web browser is a program that allows you to access websites and view their pages.

formal.mt: Biex taċċessa s-servizz, iftaħ il-brawżer u daħħal l-indirizz tas-sit.
formal.en: To access the service, open the browser and enter the website address.
formal.zh: 要使用该服务，请打开浏览器并输入网站地址。

colloquial.mt: Lara: F'liema brawżer ftaħt is-sit? Mark: Ftaħtu f'dak li nuża kuljum.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which browser did you open the website in? Mark: I opened it in the one I use every day.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你用哪个浏览器打开了这个网站？马克：我用平时每天用的那个打开的。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你用哪个浏览器打开了这个网站？
messages.en: Which browser did you open the website in?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我用平时每天用的那个打开的。
messages.en: I opened it in the one I use every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 brawżer 与英语 browser 对照，想象点击浏览器图标后打开网页；整句记忆 iftaħ il-brawżer，意思是“打开浏览器”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of severe mental or emotional distress that makes ordinary daily activities difficult to manage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 精神或情绪遭受严重困扰，以致难以应付日常生活的一段状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' tbatija mentali jew emozzjonali qawwija li jagħmilha diffiċli għal persuna tlaħħaq mal-ħajja ta' kuljum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精神崩溃，指严重的精神或情绪困扰使人难以维持日常活动的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat ta' tbatija mentali jew emozzjonali kbira li fih persuna ssibha diffiċli tlaħħaq mal-attivitajiet tas-soltu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone has a mental breakdown, they experience severe mental or emotional distress and struggle to manage everyday life.

collocations.en: he went through a mental breakdown
collocations.zh: 他经历了一次精神崩溃

formal.mt: Wara li għaddiet minn brejkdawn, il-protagonista tar-rumanz terġa' tibni r-rutina tagħha bl-appoġġ tal-familja.
formal.en: After going through a mental breakdown, the novel's protagonist rebuilds her routine with her family's support.
formal.zh: 小说女主人公经历精神崩溃后，在家人的支持下重新建立起日常生活规律。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ħija għadda minn brejkdawn u bħalissa għandu bżonn ħafna appoġġ. Sara: Nifhem. Nista' ngħinkom b'xi ħaġa?
colloquial.en: Nina: My brother went through a mental breakdown and needs a lot of support at the moment. Sara: I understand. Can I help you with anything?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我哥哥经历了一次精神崩溃，现在很需要支持。萨拉：我明白。我有什么可以帮你们的吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija għadda minn brejkdawn u bħalissa għandu bżonn ħafna appoġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija għadda minn brejkdawn u bħalissa għandu bżonn ħafna appoġġ.
messages.zh: 我哥哥经历了一次精神崩溃，现在很需要支持。
messages.en: My brother went through a mental breakdown and needs a lot of support at the moment.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我明白。我有什么可以帮你们的吗？
messages.en: I understand. Can I help you with anything?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 brejkdawn 与英语 breakdown 对照，记成“心理承受能力暂时崩溃”；搭配 għadda minn 表示“经历过”，帮助理解整句。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A style of lettering with thick, dark strokes, used to make text stand out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 笔画较粗、颜色显得较深，用来突出文字的字体样式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stil ta' kitba b'ittri eħxen u aktar skuri, użat biex ċertu kliem jispikka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗体，指以较粗笔画显示文字、使其更加醒目的字体样式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stil tipografiku li fih l-ittri jkollhom linji eħxen sabiex jidhru aktar ċari u jiġbdu l-attenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bold is a style of lettering with thicker strokes that makes words stand out from surrounding text.

formal.mt: F'dan id-dokument, it-titli huma bil-brezun biex il-qarrej ikun jista' jsib is-sezzjonijiet malajr.
formal.en: In this document, the headings are in bold so that the reader can find the sections quickly.
formal.zh: 本文件的标题使用粗体，方便读者快速找到各个章节。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Inpoġġi t-titlu bil-brezun? Toni: Iva, hekk jidher aħjar fuq il-paġna.
colloquial.en: Marija: Shall I put the title in bold? Toni: Yes, that will make it stand out better on the page.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我把标题设成粗体好吗？托尼：好，这样它在页面上会更醒目。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 我把标题设成粗体好吗？
messages.en: Shall I put the title in bold?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk jidher aħjar fuq il-paġna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk jidher aħjar fuq il-paġna.
messages.zh: 好，这样它在页面上会更醒目。
messages.en: Yes, that will make it stand out better on the page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 brezun 与文档中醒目的粗体标题联系起来，整块记忆 titlu bil-brezun，表示“粗体标题”，用视觉效果帮助记词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who robs people, often using force or threats.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 抢劫他人财物的人，常使用暴力或威胁手段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tisraq lin-nies, ħafna drabi billi tuża l-forza jew theddidhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以抢劫他人财物为生或实施抢劫的匪徒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Brigant huwa ħalliel li jisraq lin-nies, spiss bl-użu tal-forza jew tat-theddid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bandit is someone who robs people, often using force or threats.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, brigant armat waqqaf lill-vjaġġaturi u serqilhom flushom.
formal.en: In the story, an armed bandit stopped the travellers and stole their money.
formal.zh: 在故事中，一名持械匪徒拦住旅客，抢走了他们的钱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel fl-istorja? Mark: Dak hu brigant li jisraq lill-vjaġġaturi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that man in the story? Mark: He is a bandit who robs travellers.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里的那个男人是谁？马克：他是一个抢劫旅客的强盗。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man in the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu brigant li jisraq lill-vjaġġaturi.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu brigant li jisraq lill-vjaġġaturi.
messages.zh: 他是一个抢劫旅客的强盗。
messages.en: He is a bandit who robs travellers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 brigant 放进“强盗拦路抢钱”的故事画面中，联想 brigant armat“持械匪徒”，用人物和动作一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small flakes of dead skin that come off the scalp and may appear in the hair or on clothing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从头皮脱落的细小死皮薄屑，可出现在头发中或衣服上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qxur żgħar ta' ġilda mejta li jinqalgħu mill-qorriegħa u jistgħu jidhru fix-xagħar jew fuq il-ħwejjeġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头皮脱落的细小皮屑，常呈白色，可散落在头发或肩部衣物上。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-brija hija qxur żgħar, ġeneralment bojod, ta' ġilda mejta li jinqalgħu mill-qorriegħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dandruff consists of small flakes of dead skin that come off your scalp.

formal.mt: Il-brija tista' tidher bħala qxur bojod fix-xagħar jew fuq l-ispallejn tal-qmis.
formal.en: Dandruff may appear as white flakes in the hair or on the shoulders of a shirt.
formal.zh: 头皮屑可能呈白色薄屑状，出现在头发中或衬衫的肩部。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi xi ħaġa bajda fuq il-qmis? Nina: Iva, hemm ftit brija fuq spalltek.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is there something white on my shirt? Nina: Yes, there is a little dandruff on your shoulder.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我的衬衫上有白色的东西吗？妮娜：有，你肩上有一点头皮屑。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi xi ħaġa bajda fuq il-qmis?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi xi ħaġa bajda fuq il-qmis?
messages.zh: 我的衬衫上有白色的东西吗？
messages.en: Is there something white on my shirt?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ftit brija fuq spalltek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ftit brija fuq spalltek.
messages.zh: 有，你肩上有一点头皮屑。
messages.en: Yes, there is a little dandruff on your shoulder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象深色衬衫肩上落着白色小皮屑，把这个画面标成 brija；再用 brija fix-xagħar“头发里的头皮屑”巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lively enjoyment and a cheerful atmosphere when people are having fun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们玩乐时表现出的欢乐、欢闹及热闹气氛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ferħ u ħajja f'atmosfera fejn in-nies ikunu qed jieħdu gost u jiddevertu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尽情玩乐时的欢乐和欢闹，也指由此形成的热闹气氛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-briju huwa l-ferħ u l-ħajja li jkun hemm meta n-nies jieħdu gost flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When there is briju, people are enjoying themselves in a lively and cheerful atmosphere.

formal.mt: Waqt il-festa kien hemm briju kbir fil-pjazza, bin-nies ikantaw u jiżfnu flimkien.
formal.en: During the celebration, there was great merriment in the square, with people singing and dancing together.
formal.zh: 庆典期间，广场上洋溢着欢乐的气氛，人们一起唱歌跳舞。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kienet il-festa lbieraħ? Pawlu: Kien hemm ħafna briju! Kantajna u żfinna sa tard.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the party yesterday? Pawlu: It was full of merriment! We sang and danced until late.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：昨天的聚会怎么样？保罗：可热闹了！我们唱歌跳舞，一直到很晚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的聚会怎么样？
messages.en: How was the party yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm ħafna briju! Kantajna u żfinna sa tard.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm ħafna briju! Kantajna u żfinna sa tard.
messages.zh: 可热闹了！我们唱歌跳舞，一直到很晚。
messages.en: It was full of merriment! We sang and danced until late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 briju 想成聚会上大家唱歌跳舞的欢乐气氛；记住 kien hemm ħafna briju“当时非常热闹”，按名词来学。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hard rectangular blocks used for building walls and other structures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于砌墙和建造其他结构的坚硬长方体砖块；此词表示复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Blokok iebsin ta' forma rettangolari li jintużaw biex jinbnew ħitan u strutturi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑用的砖块，通常为坚硬的长方体，用于砌墙等；这里是复数形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-briks huma blokok iebsin, ġeneralment ta' forma rettangolari, li jintużaw fil-bini.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bricks are hard rectangular blocks that builders use to construct walls and other structures.

formal.mt: Il-bennejja użaw briks ħomor biex jibnu l-ħajt il-ġdid madwar il-ġnien.
formal.en: The builders used red bricks to build the new wall around the garden.
formal.zh: 建筑工人用红砖在花园周围砌起了新墙。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-briks? Toni: Poġġihom ħdejn il-ħajt, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where should I put these bricks? Toni: Put them beside the wall, please.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些砖放在哪里？托尼：请把它们放在墙边。

messages.speaker: Mark (帮忙搬砖的朋友)
messages.zh: 这些砖放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these bricks?

messages.speaker: Toni (砌墙工人)
messages.zh: 请把它们放在墙边。
messages.en: Put them beside the wall, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 briks 与英语 bricks 的相似拼写配对记忆，再想象一堆红砖；用 dawn il-briks“这些砖”提醒自己这是复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A name referring to Great Britain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指大不列颠的名称，对应马耳他语 Gran Brittanja。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem li jirreferi għal Gran Brittanja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大不列颠这一地理名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-isem Brittain jirreferi għall-post magħruf bħala Gran Brittanja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Brittain is a name used to refer to Great Britain.

formal.mt: L-istudju jinkludi mappa ta' Brittain u deskrizzjoni tal-kosta tagħha.
formal.en: The study includes a map of Great Britain and a description of its coast.
formal.zh: 这项研究附有大不列颠地图及其海岸的描述。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'juri dan ir-ritratt? David: Juri parti mill-kosta ta' Brittain.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does this photograph show? David: It shows part of the coast of Great Britain.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这张照片拍的是什么？戴维：拍的是大不列颠的一段海岸。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张照片拍的是什么？
messages.en: What does this photograph show?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 拍的是大不列颠的一段海岸。
messages.en: It shows part of the coast of Great Britain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张配对卡：Brittain 对应 Gran Brittanja，再对应“大不列颠”；与表示布列塔尼的 Brittanja 分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The geographical name of the region known in English as Brittany.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布列塔尼这一地区的专有地名，英语为 Brittany。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem proprju tar-reġjun magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala Brittany.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 布列塔尼，地区名称，英语为 Brittany。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Brittanja huwa l-isem tar-reġjun li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ Brittany.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Brittanja refers to the region called Brittany in English.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta studju dwar il-kultura tal-Brittanja.
formal.en: The report presents a study of the culture of Brittany.
formal.zh: 这份报告介绍了一项关于布列塔尼文化的研究。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn sejra għall-vaganza? Nina: Se mmur il-Brittanja ma' ħabiba.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are you going on holiday? Nina: I'm going to Brittany with a friend.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你打算去哪里度假？妮娜：我要和一位女性朋友去布列塔尼。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要和一位女性朋友去布列塔尼。
messages.en: I'm going to Brittany with a friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Brittanja、Brittany 和“布列塔尼”写在同一张旅行卡上；本词条记地区名，另将 Brittain 配对“大不列颠”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A savoury liquid made by cooking meat, vegetables, or other ingredients in water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用肉、蔬菜等食材加水煮成的汤汁，可直接食用，也可作为烹调底汤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Likwidu magħmul billi jitgħallew laħam, ħaxix jew ingredjenti oħra fl-ilma, li jista' jittiekel jew jintuża fit-tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用肉或蔬菜等煮成的清汤或高汤，可饮用或用于烹调。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Soppa likwida magħmula bit-togħma ta' laħam, ħaxix jew ingredjenti oħra mgħollija fl-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Broth is a savoury liquid in which meat, vegetables, or other ingredients have been cooked.

formal.mt: Żid il-brodu tal-ħaxix mar-ross u ħallih isajjar fuq nar baxx.
formal.en: Add the vegetable broth to the rice and let it cook over low heat.
formal.zh: 把蔬菜高汤加入米中，用小火煮。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'qed issajjar? Rita: Qed nagħmel brodu tat-tiġieġ. Trid skutella?
colloquial.en: Mark: What are you cooking? Rita: I'm making chicken broth. Would you like a bowl?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你在煮什么？丽塔：我在煮鸡汤。你要来一碗吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 你在煮什么？
messages.en: What are you cooking?

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel brodu tat-tiġieġ. Trid skutella?
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel brodu tat-tiġieġ. Trid skutella?
messages.zh: 我在煮鸡汤。你要来一碗吗？
messages.en: I'm making chicken broth. Would you like a bowl?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象锅里盛着可以舀出的鲜汤，给锅贴上 brodu 标签；再用鸡汤和蔬菜高汤两个搭配巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vegetable with a thick stem and clusters of small, usually green flower buds that are eaten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种可食用的蔬菜，有较粗的茎和密集的小花蕾，花蕾通常呈绿色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa bi zokk oħxon u gruppi ta' blanzuni żgħar, ġeneralment ħodor, li jittieklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 西兰花，一种食用茎和密集绿色花蕾的蔬菜。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaxixa li titkabbar għall-blanzuni ħodor u z-zkuk tagħha, li jittieklu nejjin jew imsajrin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Broccoli is a vegetable whose green flower buds and stems are eaten raw or cooked.

formal.mt: Aħsel il-brokkla sew qabel taqtagħha u żżidha mas-soppa.
formal.en: Wash the broccoli thoroughly before cutting it and adding it to the soup.
formal.zh: 将西兰花充分洗净，再切开并加入汤中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit brokkla mal-patata? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma sajjarha ftit biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some broccoli with the potatoes? Mark: Yes, please, but cook it only briefly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：土豆配一点西兰花，你要吗？Mark：好的，谢谢，不过稍微煮一下就行。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 土豆配一点西兰花，你要吗？
messages.en: Would you like some broccoli with the potatoes?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma sajjarha ftit biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma sajjarha ftit biss.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢，不过稍微煮一下就行。
messages.en: Yes, please, but cook it only briefly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 brokkla 配上一幅绿色小树般的西兰花图，再连读 brokkla mgħollija，借食物画面记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A singular noun for broccoli, a vegetable with an edible stem and dense clusters of usually green flower buds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示西兰花的单数名词，指具有可食用茎和密集花蕾的蔬菜，花蕾通常为绿色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom fis-singular għal ħaxixa bi zokk li jittiekel u gruppi densi ta' blanzuni, ġeneralment ħodor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 西兰花；此处为单数形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma singulari għal ħaxixa li jittieklu minnha z-zokk u l-gruppi ta' blanzuni ħodor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Brokkola is a singular noun referring to broccoli, a vegetable with edible green buds and stems.

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, uża brokkola friska u sajjarha bil-fwar sakemm tirtab.
formal.en: For this recipe, use fresh broccoli and steam it until tender.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，使用新鲜西兰花，并用蒸汽蒸至软嫩。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-brokkola għadha friska? Pawlu: Iva, xtrajtha dalgħodu. Nistgħu nsajruha llejla.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the broccoli still fresh? Pawlu: Yes, I bought it this morning. We can cook it tonight.
colloquial.zh: Lara：西兰花还新鲜吗？Pawlu：新鲜，我今天早上买的。我们今晚可以把它做了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 西兰花还新鲜吗？
messages.en: Is the broccoli still fresh?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xtrajtha dalgħodu. Nistgħu nsajruha llejla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xtrajtha dalgħodu. Nistgħu nsajruha llejla.
messages.zh: 新鲜，我今天早上买的。我们今晚可以把它做了。
messages.en: Yes, I bought it this morning. We can cook it tonight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 brokkola 制作一张西兰花图片卡，并标注“单数形式”；再用 brokkola friska 联想刚买回来的新鲜蔬菜。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name Bromwich, written with an initial capital letter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专有名称 Bromwich，可音译为“布罗姆维奇”，书写时首字母大写。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem proprju Bromwich, li jinkiteb b'ittra kapitali fil-bidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Bromwich，专有名称，中文可音译为“布罗姆维奇”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem proprju miktub Bromwich, b'ittra kapitali fil-bidu, li jintuża biex jidentifika lil min jew lil dak li għandu dan l-isem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bromwich is a proper name, so its first letter is capitalized when it appears in a sentence.

formal.mt: Fid-dokument finali, l-isem Bromwich għandu jinkiteb eżatt kif jidher fir-reġistru.
formal.en: In the final document, the name Bromwich must be written exactly as it appears in the register.
formal.zh: 在最终文件中，Bromwich 这一名称必须按照登记册中的拼写准确书写。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif jinkiteb l-isem Bromwich? David: B-R-O-M-W-I-C-H, b'B kapitali fil-bidu.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do you spell the name Bromwich? David: B-R-O-M-W-I-C-H, with a capital B at the beginning.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Bromwich 这个名称怎么拼？David：B-R-O-M-W-I-C-H，开头的 B 要大写。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: Bromwich 这个名称怎么拼？
messages.en: How do you spell the name Bromwich?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.zh: B-R-O-M-W-I-C-H，开头的 B 要大写。
messages.en: B-R-O-M-W-I-C-H, with a capital B at the beginning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Bromwich 写在姓名卡上，与中文音译“布罗姆维奇”配对；用醒目的大写 B 提醒自己这是专名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The hard outer covering of a sea animal such as a mollusc.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海洋软体动物等海生动物身体外部的坚硬壳体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qoxra iebsa li tkopri u tipproteġi l-ġisem ta' annimal tal-baħar, bħal mollusk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海贝壳，海洋软体动物等海生动物的坚硬外壳。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qoxra iebsa ta' annimal tal-baħar, li tista' tinstab vojta fuq ix-xatt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sea shell is the hard outer covering of a marine animal, often found empty on a beach.

collocations.en: a sea shell on the sand

formal.mt: L-istudenta poġġiet bronja vojta fuq il-mejda biex tosserva l-forma u l-kulur tagħha.
formal.en: The student placed an empty sea shell on the table to observe its shape and colour.
formal.zh: 这名女学生把一枚空海贝壳放在桌上，观察它的形状和颜色。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dik il-bronja fuq ir-ramel! Toni: Kemm hi sabiħa! Ejja nieħdu ritratt tagħha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that sea shell on the sand! Toni: It's so beautiful! Let's take a photo of it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：看沙地上的那枚海贝壳！Toni：真漂亮！我们给它拍张照吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 看沙地上的那枚海贝壳！
messages.en: Look at that sea shell on the sand!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hi sabiħa! Ejja nieħdu ritratt tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hi sabiħa! Ejja nieħdu ritratt tagħha.
messages.zh: 真漂亮！我们给它拍张照吧。
messages.en: It's so beautiful! Let's take a photo of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象沙滩上躺着一枚空海贝壳，边看画面边读 bronja vojta，把 bronja 与坚硬的海贝壳联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inflammation of the bronchial tubes that carry air into the lungs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支气管发生炎症的疾病，常伴有咳嗽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Infjammazzjoni tal-bronki, jiġifieri t-tubi li jwasslu l-arja lejn il-pulmuni, li spiss tikkawża sogħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 支气管炎，即输送空气进入肺部的支气管发生炎症。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marda li tinvolvi infjammazzjoni tal-bronki u li spiss tkun akkumpanjata minn sogħla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bronchitis is an illness in which the bronchial tubes become inflamed, often causing a cough.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jindika li l-pazjent għandu bronkite akuta.
formal.en: The medical report indicates that the patient has acute bronchitis.
formal.zh: 医疗报告显示，患者患有急性支气管炎。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex għadek tisgħol? Pawlu: It-tabib qalli li għandi bronkite.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you still coughing? Pawlu: The doctor told me I have bronchitis.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你怎么还在咳嗽？Pawlu：医生说我得了支气管炎。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么还在咳嗽？
messages.en: Why are you still coughing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生说我得了支气管炎。
messages.en: The doctor told me I have bronchitis.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bronkite 和“支气管发炎、反复咳嗽”的画面一起记，再用“急性、慢性”两个搭配巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Maltese name for the city of Brussels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 城市名“布鲁塞尔”的马耳他语名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem bil-Malti tal-belt magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala Brussels.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 布鲁塞尔，城市专有名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem proprju li jirreferi għall-belt magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala Brussels.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Brussell is the Maltese name used to refer to the city of Brussels.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir fi Brussell nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Brussels on Monday.
formal.zh: 会议将于星期一在布鲁塞尔举行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn sejjer għada? Mark: Sejjer Brussell għal ftit jiem.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are you going tomorrow? Mark: I'm going to Brussels for a few days.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你明天去哪里？Mark：我去布鲁塞尔待几天。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我去布鲁塞尔待几天。
messages.en: I'm going to Brussels for a few days.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Brussell 写在旅行地图的“布鲁塞尔”位置，连读 fi Brussell 和 lejn Brussell，分别记住“在”和“前往”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or condition of having considerable physical strength.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体强壮、有较大力量的状态或特质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew il-qagħda ta' min għandu ħafna saħħa fiżika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强壮；身体有力量的状态或特质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' persuna li għandha ħafna saħħa fiżika u tiflaħ għall-isforz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This term expresses the quality of having considerable physical strength and being able to exert force.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-vokabularju, il-kelma 'bsaħittha' hija marbuta mal-idea tas-saħħa fiżika.
formal.en: In the vocabulary exercise, the word 'bsaħittha' is associated with the idea of physical strength.
formal.zh: 在词汇练习中，“bsaħittha”一词与身体强壮的概念相联系。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'bsaħittha' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Marija: Tirreferi għall-idea li persuna għandha ħafna saħħa fiżika.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'bsaħittha' mean in this exercise? Marija: It refers to the idea of a person having considerable physical strength.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这道练习里的“bsaħittha”是什么意思？Marija：它指的是一个人身体强壮、很有力量的概念。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这道练习里的“bsaħittha”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'bsaħittha' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tirreferi għall-idea li persuna għandha ħafna saħħa fiżika.
messages.mt_standard: Tirreferi għall-idea li persuna għandha ħafna saħħa fiżika.
messages.zh: 它指的是一个人身体强壮、很有力量的概念。
messages.en: It refers to the idea of a person having considerable physical strength.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bsaħittha 单独写成词卡，背面配“身体强壮”的画面；逐字核对拼写，避免与相似词条混记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An officially designated holiday observed by the public.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由官方规定、供公众庆祝或休息的假日。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jum ta' btala stabbilit uffiċjalment għall-pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 官方规定的公共假日。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jum ta' btala rikonoxxut uffiċjalment għall-pubbliku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public holiday is an officially designated day when many people do not have to work.

collocations.en: closed because of a public holiday

formal.mt: Il-librerija se tkun magħluqa nhar it-Tnejn minħabba l-btala pubblika.
formal.en: The library will be closed on Monday because of the public holiday.
formal.zh: 由于公共假日，图书馆星期一将闭馆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għada btala pubblika? Mark: Iva, u jien mhux se naħdem. Nistgħu noħorġu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is tomorrow a public holiday? Mark: Yes, and I won't be working. We can go out together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：明天是公共假日吗？Mark：是的，而且我明天不上班。我们可以一起出去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天是公共假日吗？
messages.en: Is tomorrow a public holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u jien mhux se naħdem. Nistgħu noħorġu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u jien mhux se naħdem. Nistgħu noħorġu flimkien.
messages.zh: 是的，而且我明天不上班。我们可以一起出去。
messages.en: Yes, and I won't be working. We can go out together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成日历上标出的公共假日：btala 记“假日”，pubblika 提醒你这是公众共同的假日。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun written as 'buawic', whose specific meaning is unspecified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 写作 buawic 的名词，具体所指尚未明确。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom miktub 'buawic' li t-tifsira speċifika tiegħu mhix magħrufa hawnhekk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: buawic：具体含义尚未明确的名词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma 'buawic' hija nom li t-tifsira tiegħu mhix speċifikata hawnhekk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The noun 'buawic' has no specific meaning established here, so its interpretation remains unresolved.

formal.mt: It-tifsira tal-kelma 'buawic' trid tiġi ċċarata qabel ma tintuża f'sentenza ta' eżempju.
formal.en: The meaning of the word 'buawic' must be clarified before it is used in an example sentence.
formal.zh: 在例句中使用“buawic”之前，必须先明确这个词的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'buawic'? Pawlu: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja niċċaraw it-tifsira tagħha qabel nużawha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'buawic' mean? Pawlu: I don't know yet. Let's clarify its meaning before we use it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“buawic”这个词是什么意思？Pawlu：我还不知道。我们先弄清楚它的意思，再使用它吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “buawic”这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'buawic' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja niċċaraw it-tifsira tagħha qabel nużawha.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja niċċaraw it-tifsira tagħha qabel nużawha.
messages.zh: 我还不知道。我们先弄清楚它的意思，再使用它吧。
messages.en: I don't know yet. Let's clarify its meaning before we use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 buawic 做一张“名词，词义待确认”的词卡，先记准确字形；用“这个词、这个词的含义”练习提问，不凭拼写猜意思。

gloss_zh: 布巴克拉（马耳他南部的村庄）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bubaqra is the name of a village in the south of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: Bubaqra 是马耳他南部一个村庄的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bubaqra huwa l-isem ta' raħal fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: A village in the south of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 布巴克拉，位于马耳他南部的一个村庄。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bubaqra huwa raħal li jinsab fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bubaqra is a place name referring to a village situated in southern Malta.

collocations.zh: 到布巴克拉的一次参访

formal.mt: L-istudenti kitbu deskrizzjoni ta' Bubaqra, raħal fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.
formal.en: The students wrote a description of Bubaqra, a village in the south of Malta.
formal.zh: 学生们写了一篇介绍布巴克拉的文章；这是马耳他南部的一个村庄。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn sejrin il-Ħadd? Toni: Se mmorru Bubaqra. Nixtieq nara r-raħal.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are we going on Sunday? Toni: We're going to Bubaqra. I'd like to see the village.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们星期天去哪里？Toni：我们去布巴克拉。我想看看那个村庄。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们星期天去哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmorru Bubaqra. Nixtieq nara r-raħal.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmorru Bubaqra. Nixtieq nara r-raħal.
messages.zh: 我们去布巴克拉。我想看看那个村庄。
messages.en: We're going to Bubaqra. I'd like to see the village.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在想象的马耳他地图南部放一个村庄标记，旁边写 Bubaqra；把“大写地名、马耳他南部、村庄”三个信息一起记住。

gloss_zh: 一阵骤起的风雪或活动；大风；狂风骤雨

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden burst of wind, snow, or activity, or a very strong wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突然出现的一阵风、雪或活动；也可指强烈的大风或骤起的狂风骤雨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żieda qasira u f'daqqa fir-riħ, fil-borra jew fl-attività; tista' tfisser ukoll riħ qawwi ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 短暂而突然的一阵风雪，或一阵集中出现的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żieda qasira u f'daqqa ta' riħ, borra jew attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flurry is a brief, sudden burst of snow, wind, or concentrated activity.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强劲的大风。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Riħ qawwi ħafna li jista' jagħmel il-mixi jew l-ivvjaġġar diffiċli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gale is a very strong wind that can make outdoor conditions difficult.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然增强、持续时间较短的强风，有时伴有雨雪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Riħ li jiżdied fil-qawwa f'daqqa għal żmien qasir, xi drabi flimkien ma' xita jew borra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A squall is a sudden, short period of strong wind, sometimes accompanied by rain or snow.

formal.mt: Buffura qawwija fetħet it-tieqa u xerrdet il-karti mal-art.
formal.en: A strong squall blew the window open and scattered the papers across the floor.
formal.zh: 一阵强风吹开了窗户，把纸张吹散在地上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tisma' dak ir-riħ? Toni: Iva, għaddiet buffura qawwija. Agħlaq it-tieqa, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you hear that wind? Toni: Yes, a strong squall just passed. Please close the window.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你听见那风声了吗？Toni：听见了，刚刚刮过一阵强风。请把窗户关上。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见那风声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that wind?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għaddiet buffura qawwija. Agħlaq it-tieqa, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għaddiet buffura qawwija. Agħlaq it-tieqa, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 听见了，刚刚刮过一阵强风。请把窗户关上。
messages.en: Yes, a strong squall just passed. Please close the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一阵风突然吹开窗户，纸张四散：用这个画面记 buffura 的骤起感。再分清 flurry 重在短暂一阵，gale 重在风力强，squall 重在风突然增强。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bufula is a bird known in English as a warbler.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鸟，英语称为 warbler，中文通常称为莺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bufula hija tip ta' għasfur li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ warbler.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 莺，指一种鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bufula hija għasfur ta' tip magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala warbler.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A warbler is a type of bird called bufula in Maltese.

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fil-ġnien, l-istudenti raw bufula u kitbu dwarha fin-noti tagħhom.
formal.en: During the visit to the garden, the students saw a warbler and wrote about it in their notes.
formal.zh: 参观花园时，学生们看见了一只莺，并在笔记中记录了它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, hemm bufula fuq il-fergħa! Mark: Fejn? Maja: Hemm fuq, ħdejn il-weraq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, there's a warbler on the branch! Mark: Where? Maja: Up there, beside the leaves.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看，树枝上有一只莺！Mark：在哪里？Maja：就在上面，叶子旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，树枝上有一只莺！
messages.en: Look, there's a warbler on the branch!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在哪里？
messages.en: Where?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 就在上面，叶子旁边。
messages.en: Up there, beside the leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bufula 和树枝上一只莺的画面配对，再用 nara bufula（看见一只莺）反复造句，连同鸟类含义一起记住。

gloss_zh: bugarun（名词；所给材料未说明具体词义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bugarun is a noun whose specific meaning is not explained in the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: bugarun 是一个名词；所给材料仅重复该词，未提供可确定其具体所指的释义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bugarun huwa nom, iżda l-materjal mogħti ma jispjegax għal xiex jirreferi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: bugarun；原释义仅重复词形，具体含义未说明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal mogħti jelenka bugarun bħala nom iżda jirrepeti biss il-kelma mingħajr ma jagħti tifsira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bugarun is listed as a noun, but the supplied gloss does not identify its meaning.

formal.mt: Il-kelma bugarun tidher fil-lista bħala nom, iżda l-materjal mogħti ma jagħtix definizzjoni li tiċċara t-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The word bugarun appears in the list as a noun, but the supplied material provides no definition that clarifies its meaning.
formal.zh: bugarun 一词在列表中被列为名词，但所给材料没有提供能说明其含义的定义。

colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word bugarun mean? Rita: It only says here that it's a noun. Maja: Then we need a clearer definition.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bugeddum is a shrew, a small mammal with a pointed snout.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼩鼱，一种体型小、吻部尖长的哺乳动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bugeddum huwa mammiferu żgħir b'geddum twil u ppuntat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼩鼱，指一种吻部尖长的小型哺乳动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bugeddum huwa annimal mammiferu ta' daqs żgħir li għandu geddum twil u ppuntat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shrew is a small mammal with a long, pointed snout.

formal.mt: L-istudenti ħarsu lejn ritratt ta' bugeddum u ddeskrivew il-geddum twil u ppuntat tiegħu.
formal.en: The students looked at a photograph of a shrew and described its long, pointed snout.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一张鼩鼱的照片，并描述了它尖长的吻部。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhu dan l-annimal fir-ritratt? Maja: Dak bugeddum. Mark: Ara kemm għandu geddumu twil!
colloquial.en: Mark: What's this animal in the photograph? Maja: That's a shrew. Mark: Look how long its snout is!
colloquial.zh: Mark：照片里的这只动物是什么？Maja：那是鼩鼱。Mark：看，它的吻部真长！

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这只动物是什么？
messages.en: What's this animal in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 那是鼩鼱。
messages.en: That's a shrew.

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 看，它的吻部真长！
messages.en: Look how long its snout is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bugeddum 写在鼩鼱图片下，重点观察尖长的吻部，再用“这是一只鼩鼱”的句子练习；这是图像记忆法，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small, soft-bodied animal that moves slowly and has no external shell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种身体柔软、行动缓慢且没有外壳的小动物，即蛞蝓，俗称鼻涕虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir b'ġisem artab, mingħajr qoxra esterna, li jiċċaqlaq bil-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蛞蝓，一种身体柔软、没有外壳、缓慢爬行的小动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir b'ġisem artab u mingħajr qoxra esterna, li jitkaxkar bil-mod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A slug is a small animal with a soft body that moves slowly and has no external shell.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudent innota bugharwien fuq werqa mxarrba.
formal.en: During an observation in the garden, the student noticed a slug on a wet leaf.
formal.zh: 在花园进行观察时，学生注意到一片湿叶子上有一只蛞蝓。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, hemm bugharwien fuq il-werqa! Mark: Rajtu. Ejja nħalluh hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, there's a slug on the leaf! Mark: I see it. Let's leave it there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看，叶子上有一只蛞蝓！Mark：我看见了。我们就让它待在那里吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，叶子上有一只蛞蝓！
messages.en: Look, there's a slug on the leaf!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看见了。我们就让它待在那里吧。
messages.en: I see it. Let's leave it there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bugharwien 和湿叶子上缓慢爬行的鼻涕虫画面联系起来，用“没有外壳”帮助辨认词义。

gloss_zh: 他加禄语（所给释义仅为语言标签，未说明该表达的具体含义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry labelled 'Tagalog' in the supplied material, which does not establish the expression's specific meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料中标为名词、释义仅写作“他加禄语”的词条；该标签未确定这一表达的具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mmarkata bħala nom li fil-materjal mogħti għandha biss it-tikketta 'Tagalog', mingħajr spjegazzjoni tat-tifsira speċifika tal-espressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他加禄语；此处提供的是语言名称，未给出该表达的具体词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-isem tal-lingwa Tagalog; f'din l-entrata jingħata biss dan l-isem u ma tiġix spjegata t-tifsira tal-espressjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss names Tagalog but does not explain what this expression means.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'Bukas na aklat' għandha l-glossa 'Tagalog', iżda din it-tikketta ma tispeċifikax it-tifsira tal-espressjoni.
formal.en: The entry 'Bukas na aklat' has the gloss 'Tagalog', but this label does not specify the expression's meaning.
formal.zh: “Bukas na aklat”这一词条的释义写作“Tagalog”，但这一标签并未说明该表达的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'Bukas na aklat'? Lara: Hawn miktub biss 'Tagalog'; it-tifsira mhix spjegata.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'Bukas na aklat' mean? Lara: It only says 'Tagalog' here; the meaning isn't explained.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“Bukas na aklat”是什么意思？Lara：这里仅写着“Tagalog”，没有解释词义。

messages.zh: “Bukas na aklat”是什么意思？

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub biss 'Tagalog'; it-tifsira mhix spjegata.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub biss 'Tagalog'; it-tifsira mhix spjegata.
messages.zh: 这里仅写着“Tagalog”，没有解释词义。
messages.en: It only says 'Tagalog' here; the meaning isn't explained.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Bukas na aklat 配一张“仅有语言标签、词义待核实”的学习卡，记住语言名称不能直接充当表达的翻译。

gloss_zh: 不知道（所给释义如此，具体词义未确定）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry marked as a verb whose supplied gloss, 'Don't know', leaves its specific meaning unresolved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料中标为动词、释义写作“不知道”的词条；材料未确定其具体含义，不能据此认定它表示“不知道”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mmarkata bħala verb bil-glossa 'Don't know', li ma tistabbilixxix tifsira speċifika għall-kelma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: “不知道”；此为所给释义的字面内容，尚不足以确定该动词的实际含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa mogħtija tgħid 'Ma nafx', iżda din l-informazzjoni mhix biżżejjed biex tistabbilixxi t-tifsira tal-verb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss says 'Don't know', so the verb's actual meaning remains unestablished.

formal.mt: Il-forma 'Bukkawig' hija mmarkata bħala verb, iżda l-glossa 'Don't know' ma tipprovdix tifsira ċara.
formal.en: The form 'Bukkawig' is marked as a verb, but the gloss 'Don't know' does not provide a clear meaning.
formal.zh: “Bukkawig”这一形式被标为动词，但“Don't know”这一释义未提供明确的词义。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nuża 'Bukkawig' f'sentenza? Lara: It-tifsira għadha mhix ċara; hawn miktub biss 'Don't know'.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I use 'Bukkawig' in a sentence? Lara: The meaning is still unclear; it only says 'Don't know' here.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我能用“Bukkawig”造句吗？Lara：它的含义还不明确，这里只写着“Don't know”。

messages.en: Can I use 'Bukkawig' in a sentence?

messages.mt_standard: It-tifsira għadha mhix ċara; hawn miktub biss 'Don't know'.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small tasty piece of food, or an amount of food that fits into the mouth at one time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一小块可口的食物，也可指一次能放入口中的一口食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira u tajba ta' ikel, jew ammont ta' ikel li jidħol fil-ħalq f'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小块可口的食物；少量供品尝的美食。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira ta' ikel tajjeb li wieħed jiekol biex iduqha jew igawdi t-togħma tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A titbit is a small piece of food that is especially pleasant to eat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一口食物；一次放入口中的食物量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ammont ta' ikel li wieħed idaħħal f'ħalqu f'daqqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mouthful is the amount of food that you put into your mouth at one time.

formal.mt: Waqt id-dewq, kull mistieden ingħata bukkun żgħir tal-kejk biex jevalwa t-togħma tiegħu.
formal.en: During the tasting, each guest was given a small morsel of cake to assess its flavour.
formal.zh: 在品尝活动中，每位来宾都得到了一小口蛋糕，以评价其风味。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid idduq il-kejk? Mark: Iva, agħtini bukkun żgħir. Maja: Hawn, ħu bukkun!
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to taste the cake? Mark: Yes, give me a small mouthful. Maja: Here, have a bite!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想尝尝蛋糕吗？Mark：想，给我一小口吧。Maja：来，吃一口！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想尝尝蛋糕吗？
messages.en: Would you like to taste the cake?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，给我一小口吧。
messages.en: Yes, give me a small mouthful.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 来，吃一口！
messages.en: Here, have a bite!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象叉子上的一小口蛋糕来记 bukkun：强调可口的小块时对应 titbit，强调入口的分量时对应 mouthful。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An edible plant with fleshy green leaves, known as purslane.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种叶片肥厚、可以食用的绿色植物，即马齿苋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-burdlieqa hija pjanta bi weraq ħodor u mlaħħmin li jistgħu jittieklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马齿苋，一种叶片肥厚、可供食用的植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-burdlieqa hija pjanta li għandha weraq imlaħħmin u li tista' tintuża bħala ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Purslane is a plant with fleshy green leaves that people can eat.

formal.mt: Aħsel il-weraq tal-burdlieqa sew qabel ma żżidhom mal-insalata.
formal.en: Wash the purslane leaves thoroughly before adding them to the salad.
formal.zh: 把马齿苋叶加入沙拉之前，先将叶子充分洗净。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se żżid mal-insalata? Lara: Se nżid ftit burdlieqa. Maja: Tajjeb, ħa naħsel il-weraq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you going to add to the salad? Lara: I'm going to add some purslane. Maja: All right, let me wash the leaves.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你准备往沙拉里加什么？拉拉：我准备加一点马齿苋。玛雅：好，我来洗叶子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你准备往沙拉里加什么？
messages.en: What are you going to add to the salad?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我准备加一点马齿苋。
messages.en: I'm going to add some purslane.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我来洗叶子。
messages.en: All right, let me wash the leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 burdlieqa 和“一把肥厚绿叶放进沙拉”的画面绑定，记住它是马齿苋；再连读 weraq tal-burdlieqa，巩固植物与叶子的联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dock worker whose job is to load and unload ships.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在港口负责往船上装货和从船上卸货的工人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Burdnar huwa ħaddiem fil-port li xogħlu hu li jgħabbi u jħott il-merkanzija minn fuq il-vapuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 码头装卸工，负责船舶货物的装卸。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Burdnar huwa ħaddiem li jieħu ħsieb it-tagħbija u l-ħatt tal-merkanzija fuq il-vapuri fil-port.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stevedore is a worker who loads cargo onto ships and unloads it at a port.

formal.mt: Il-burdnar għandu jiċċekkja li l-merkanzija tkun marbuta sew qabel ma titgħabba fuq il-vapur.
formal.en: The stevedore must check that the cargo is securely tied before it is loaded onto the ship.
formal.zh: 码头装卸工必须在货物装船之前，检查货物是否已经牢固捆扎。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn taħdem issa? Pawlu: Naħdem bħala burdnar fil-port. Mark: U x'ħin tibda x-xogħol?
colloquial.en: Mark: Where do you work now? Pawlu: I work as a stevedore at the port. Mark: And what time do you start work?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你现在在哪里工作？保罗：我在港口当装卸工。马克：那你几点开始上班？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你现在在哪里工作？
messages.en: Where do you work now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (码头装卸工)
messages.zh: 我在港口当装卸工。
messages.en: I work as a stevedore at the port.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那你几点开始上班？
messages.en: And what time do you start work?

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 burdnar，就想象港口里把货物装上船、再从船上卸下的工人；用“职业—地点—动作”三点记住码头装卸工这一含义。

gloss_zh: 布尔马拉德（马耳他的一个村庄）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Burmarrad, the name of a village in Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布尔马拉德，马耳他的一个村庄的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Burmarrad huwa l-isem ta' raħal f'Malta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他的一个村庄，名为布尔马拉德。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Burmarrad huwa raħal li jinsab f'Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Burmarrad is the name of a village located in Malta.

collocations.zh: 在布尔马拉德举行的会议

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir f'Burmarrad nhar it-Tnejn fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Burmarrad on Monday at ten in the morning.
formal.zh: 会议将于星期一上午十点在布尔马拉德举行。

colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall we meet tomorrow? David: In Burmarrad, next to the shop. Sara: All right, I'll arrive at ten.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们明天在哪里见面？戴维：在布尔马拉德，商店旁边。萨拉：好，我十点到。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet tomorrow?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 在布尔马拉德，商店旁边。
messages.en: In Burmarrad, next to the shop.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我十点到。
messages.en: All right, I'll arrive at ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Burmarrad 写在一张“马耳他村庄”的地点卡上，注意地名首字母大写；用 f'Burmarrad“在布尔马拉德”练习把名称放进完整句子。

gloss_zh: 官僚的；官僚主义的；涉及繁琐行政手续的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to administrative systems and their official rules and procedures, often with excessive paperwork.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与行政管理制度及其正式规则、程序有关的，常指手续繁琐、文书工作过多的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Burokratiku jiddeskrivi dak li għandu x'jaqsam ma' regoli u proċeduri amministrattivi, ħafna drabi b'ħafna formalitajiet u dokumenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 官僚的；与行政规章和办事程序有关的，常含手续繁琐或过分拘泥程序之意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun burokratika meta tkun marbuta mar-regoli u l-proċeduri tal-amministrazzjoni, speċjalment meta dawn ikunu twal jew ikkumplikati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bureaucratic system or process involves official administrative rules and procedures, often requiring excessive paperwork.

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju qed jirrevedi l-proċess burokratiku sabiex inaqqas in-numru ta' dokumenti meħtieġa.
formal.en: The office is reviewing the bureaucratic process to reduce the number of documents required.
formal.zh: 该办事处正在审查行政办理程序，以减少所需文件的数量。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadek ma ħadtx il-permess? Mark: Le, il-proċess burokratiku qed jieħu ħafna żmien. Nina: Nista' ngħinek timla l-formoli.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you still not received the permit? Mark: No, the bureaucratic process is taking a long time. Nina: I can help you fill in the forms.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你还没拿到许可证吗？马克：还没有，行政手续花的时间很长。妮娜：我可以帮你填表。

messages.mt_standard: Le, il-proċess burokratiku qed jieħu ħafna żmien.
