gloss_zh: 脾气急躁的；容易烦躁的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Easily annoyed and likely to respond impatiently or angrily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易因小事感到烦躁，并可能不耐烦或生气地回应的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddejjaq jew jirrabja malajr, anki minħabba affarijiet żgħar, u jista' jwieġeb bla sabar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易动怒、说话或回应时显得不耐烦的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li malajr jitlef is-sabar u jwieġeb b'ton irrabjat jew xejn ġentili.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is testy becomes impatient easily and may answer other people sharply.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易受到小事刺激而感到烦躁或生气的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li faċilment jiddejjaq jew jirrabja minħabba storbju, inkonvenjent jew affarijiet żgħar oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is irritable is easily annoyed by things that would not usually cause much difficulty.

collocations.zh: 显得不耐烦；看起来容易发火

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, l-għalliema kitbet li Mark kien buruż filgħodu u kien jitlef is-sabar malajr.
formal.en: In her report, the teacher wrote that Mark was irritable in the morning and quickly lost patience.
formal.zh: 老师在报告中写道，马克早上情绪烦躁，很容易失去耐心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex int daqshekk buruż illum? Mark: Ma rqadtx sew u kull ħoss qed idejjaqni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you so irritable today? Mark: I didn't sleep well, and every sound is bothering me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天怎么这么烦躁？马克：我没睡好，每一点声音都让我心烦。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天怎么这么烦躁？
messages.en: Why are you so irritable today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma rqadtx sew u kull ħoss qed idejjaqni.
messages.mt_standard: Ma rqadtx sew u kull ħoss qed idejjaqni.
messages.zh: 我没睡好，每一点声音都让我心烦。
messages.en: I didn't sleep well, and every sound is bothering me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 buruż 和“没睡好，一点声音就烦”的画面绑定；想到皱眉、急躁的回应，就回忆这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dense group of bushes or small trees growing close together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 灌木或小树紧密生长在一起形成的浓密植物丛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp dens ta' arbuxxelli jew siġar żgħar li jikbru qrib ħafna ta' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由密集生长的灌木或小树组成、通常不易穿过的植物丛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Medda ta' arbuxxelli jew siġar żgħar li jikbru magħqudin u jagħmluha diffiċli biex wieħed jgħaddi minn ġo fihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A thicket is a group of bushes or small trees growing so closely together that it can be difficult to pass through.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi buskett dens ħdejn ix-xmara, fejn diversi għasafar isibu kenn.
formal.en: The report describes a dense thicket beside the river, where several birds find shelter.
formal.zh: 报告描述了河边一片浓密的灌木丛，几种鸟类在那里栖身。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn mar il-qattus? Pawlu: Daħal f'dak il-buskett ħdejn il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did the cat go? Pawlu: It went into that thicket beside the wall.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：猫跑到哪里去了？保罗：它钻进墙边那片灌木丛了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 猫跑到哪里去了？
messages.en: Where did the cat go?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 它钻进墙边那片灌木丛了。
messages.en: It went into that thicket beside the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象猫钻进一团枝叶交错、难以穿过的矮树丛，用这个具体画面记住 buskett 的“灌木丛”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sculpture showing a person's head, shoulders, and upper chest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现人物头部、肩部及胸部上方的雕像。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skultura li turi r-ras, l-ispallejn u l-parti ta' fuq tas-sider ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 只表现人物头部、肩部和胸部上方的雕塑，即半身像或胸像。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xogħol ta' skultura li jirrappreżenta persuna mir-ras sal-parti ta' fuq tas-sider, mingħajr il-bqija tal-ġisem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bust is a sculpture of a person's head, shoulders, and upper chest.

formal.mt: Il-mużew esebixxa bust tal-bronż tal-poeta fid-daħla tas-sala prinċipali.
formal.en: The museum displayed a bronze bust of the poet at the entrance to the main hall.
formal.zh: 博物馆在主展厅入口处展出了一尊诗人的青铜半身像。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak fil-bust ħdejn it-tieqa? Ġanni: Huwa poeta; ismu hemm miktub taħtu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the person in that bust beside the window? Ġanni: He's a poet; his name is written underneath it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：窗边那尊半身像刻的是谁？詹尼：是一位诗人，下面写着他的名字。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak fil-bust ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak fil-bust ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 窗边那尊半身像刻的是谁？
messages.en: Who is the person in that bust beside the window?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa poeta; ismu hemm miktub taħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa poeta; ismu hemm miktub taħtu.
messages.zh: 是一位诗人，下面写着他的名字。
messages.en: He's a poet; his name is written underneath it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bust 想成博物馆里只刻到胸口的人像：有头、有肩、有上胸，用雕像的范围记住“半身像”。

gloss_zh: 制桶匠；葡萄酒桶制作工匠

teaching_sense.en_definition: A craftsperson who makes barrels for holding wine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作盛放葡萄酒的桶的工匠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna tas-sengħa li tagħmel btieti biex jinżamm fihom l-inbid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作葡萄酒桶的工匠，即制桶匠。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaddiem tas-sengħa li jagħmel il-btieti li jintużaw biex jinżamm fihom l-inbid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cooper is a craftsperson who makes barrels, including those used for storing wine.

formal.mt: Il-buttar għamel żewġ btieti ġodda għall-inbid u ċċekkja li ma jnixxux.
formal.en: The cooper made two new wine barrels and checked that they did not leak.
formal.zh: 制桶匠制作了两个新的葡萄酒桶，并检查它们是否漏液。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jagħmlilna l-bettija l-ġdida għall-inbid? Toni: Il-buttar tar-raħal; għada mmorru nkellmuh.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who will make our new wine barrel? Toni: The village cooper; we'll go and speak to him tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：谁来给我们做新的葡萄酒桶？托尼：村里的制桶匠，我们明天去找他谈谈。

messages.speaker: Marija (酒农)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jagħmlilna l-bettija l-ġdida għall-inbid?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jagħmlilna l-bettija l-ġdida għall-inbid?
messages.zh: 谁来给我们做新的葡萄酒桶？
messages.en: Who will make our new wine barrel?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 村里的制桶匠，我们明天去找他谈谈。
messages.en: The village cooper; we'll go and speak to him tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象作坊里一位工匠正在制作葡萄酒桶，把“做桶的人”这一职业画面与 buttar 反复配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The central part of a wheel through which it is connected to an axle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 车轮中央与车轴连接的部件，即轮毂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ċentrali tar-rota li biha r-rota tkun imqabbda mal-fus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轮毂，位于车轮中央、连接车轮与车轴的部件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti fin-nofs tar-rota li tgħaqqad ir-rota mal-fus.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The hub of a wheel is its central part, where the wheel connects to the axle.

formal.mt: Qabel terġa' tintuża r-rota, għandu jiġi ċċekkjat il-buttun tagħha.
formal.en: Before the wheel is used again, its hub should be checked.
formal.zh: 再次使用该车轮前，应检查其轮毂。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema parti hi l-buttun? Pawlu: Din il-parti fin-nofs tar-rota.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which part is the hub? Pawlu: This part in the middle of the wheel.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：哪个部件是轮毂？保罗：就是车轮正中间的这个部件。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 哪个部件是轮毂？
messages.en: Which part is the hub?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (修理工)
messages.zh: 就是车轮正中间的这个部件。
messages.en: This part in the middle of the wheel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个车轮并圈出正中央，在圈内写上 buttun，把词与轮毂的位置一起记住。

gloss_zh: 释为 buzbiz；所给材料未说明具体词义

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form given with the gloss 'buzbiz', whose specific meaning and part of speech are not established by the supplied entry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给词条用 buzbiz 作释义，但未提供足以确定具体含义和词性的说明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma li fl-entrata mogħtija hija spjegata bil-kelma 'buzbiz', mingħajr tagħrif biżżejjed biex jiġu stabbiliti t-tifsira preċiża u l-kategorija grammatikali tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义为 buzbiz；仅凭所给材料无法确定其具体中文含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-entrata tagħti 'buzbiz' bħala spjegazzjoni, iżda ma tipprovdix definizzjoni li tiċċara t-tifsira preċiża ta' din il-forma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry explains this form only as 'buzbiz', leaving its specific meaning undetermined.

formal.mt: L-entrata tagħti 'buzbiz' bħala spjegazzjoni ta' 'buzzbizz', iżda ma tiċċarax it-tifsira preċiża tagħha.
formal.en: The entry gives 'buzbiz' as the explanation of 'buzzbizz', but does not clarify its precise meaning.
formal.zh: 该词条用 buzbiz 解释 buzzbizz，但没有说明其确切含义。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser 'buzzbizz' f'din l-entrata? Mark: Hawn miktub biss 'buzbiz'; it-tifsira mhix ċara.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'buzzbizz' mean in this entry? Mark: It only says 'buzbiz' here; the meaning isn't clear.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个词条中的 buzzbizz 是什么意思？马克：这里只写了 buzbiz，含义还不清楚。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这个词条中的 buzzbizz 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'buzzbizz' mean in this entry?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub biss 'buzbiz'; it-tifsira mhix ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub biss 'buzbiz'; it-tifsira mhix ċara.
messages.zh: 这里只写了 buzbiz，含义还不清楚。
messages.en: It only says 'buzbiz' here; the meaning isn't clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作双栏卡片，左写 buzzbizz，右写原释 buzbiz 并加问号；先记字形对应，避免把猜测当成词义。

gloss_zh: 滑车；装有一个或多个滑轮的装置

teaching_sense.en_definition: A block containing one or more pulleys through which a rope can run.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内部装有一个或多个滑轮、供绳索绕行的滑车装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat b'taljola waħda jew aktar f'qafas, li minn fuqhom jgħaddi ħabel.

sense_translations.en_definition: block with one or more pulleys
sense_translations.zh_definition: 装有一个或多个滑轮的滑车。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qafas li fih tkun imwaħħla taljola waħda jew aktar biex jgħaddi ħabel minn fuqhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A buzzell is a block containing one or more pulleys that guide a rope.

collocations.en: the rope of the pulley block

formal.mt: Qabel l-użu, għandu jiġi ċċekkjat li l-ħabel jgħaddi sew minn fuq it-taljola tal-buzzell.
formal.en: Before use, check that the rope runs correctly over the pulley in the block.
formal.zh: 使用前，应检查绳索是否正确绕过滑车中的滑轮。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn għandu jgħaddi dan il-ħabel? Toni: Minn fuq it-taljola ta' dan il-buzzell.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where should this rope go? Toni: Over the pulley in this block.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这根绳子应该从哪里绕过去？托尼：绕过这个滑车里的滑轮。

messages.speaker: Sara (学徒)
messages.zh: 这根绳子应该从哪里绕过去？
messages.en: Where should this rope go?

messages.speaker: Toni (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fuq it-taljola ta' dan il-buzzell.
messages.mt_standard: Minn fuq it-taljola ta' dan il-buzzell.
messages.zh: 绕过这个滑车里的滑轮。
messages.en: Over the pulley in this block.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个框架，框内放一只或几只滑轮，再画绳索绕过；把整个装置标为 buzzell，记住它指滑车整体。

gloss_zh: 布吉巴（马耳他的一个城镇）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Buġibba is the name of a town in Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: Buġibba 是马耳他的一个城镇名，可音译为布吉巴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Buġibba huwa l-isem ta' belt f'Malta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他的一个城镇，名为布吉巴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Buġibba huwa isem proprju li jirreferi għal belt f'Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Buġibba is a proper name used for a town in Malta.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir f'Buġibba nhar it-Tnejn, u l-parteċipanti għandhom jaslu fid-disgħa.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Buġibba on Monday, and participants should arrive at nine.
formal.zh: 会议将于星期一在布吉巴举行，与会者应于九点到达。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Trid tiġi Buġibba miegħi għada? Pawlu: Iva, x'ħin se titlaq? Rita: Fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you want to come to Buġibba with me tomorrow? Pawlu: Yes, what time are you leaving? Rita: At ten in the morning.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你明天想和我一起去布吉巴吗？Pawlu：想，你几点出发？Rita：上午十点。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天想和我一起去布吉巴吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come to Buġibba with me tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，你几点出发？
messages.en: Yes, what time are you leaving?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 上午十点。
messages.en: At ten in the morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Buġibba 当作地图上的城镇标签记忆，首字母大写；将 f'Buġibba 和“在布吉巴”配对，建立地名与地点表达的联系。

gloss_zh: 难题；障碍；棘手的混乱局面

teaching_sense.en_definition: A problem, obstacle, or confusing situation that is difficult to deal with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要设法处理的难题、阻碍，或令人难以理清的混乱局面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Problema, ostaklu jew taħwida li tkun diffiċli biex tissolva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 难题、障碍或棘手的混乱局面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Diffikultà jew taħwida li toħloq problema u li ma tkunx faċli biex tissolva.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bużillis is a troublesome problem, obstacle, or confusing situation that someone has to resolve.

formal.mt: Il-bużillis ewlieni tal-proġett huwa n-nuqqas ta' fondi biex jitlesta x-xogħol.
formal.en: The project's main difficulty is the lack of funds to complete the work.
formal.zh: 该项目的主要难题是缺乏完成工程所需的资金。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ma nistgħux nitilqu issa? Ġużeppi: Hawn hu l-bużillis: ma nistax insib iċ-ċwievet!
colloquial.en: Marija: Why can't we leave now? Ġużeppi: Here's the problem: I can't find the keys!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我们为什么现在不能出发？朱塞佩：问题就在这里：我找不到钥匙了！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们为什么现在不能出发？
messages.en: Why can't we leave now?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn hu l-bużillis: ma nistax insib iċ-ċwievet!
messages.mt_standard: Hawn hu l-bużillis: ma nistax insib iċ-ċwievet!
messages.zh: 问题就在这里：我找不到钥匙了！
messages.en: Here's the problem: I can't find the keys!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bużillis 写在一团打结的线旁边，用“难题、障碍、混乱”三个中文提示帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Similar to you, or in the same way as you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某人与你相似，或做某事的方式与你相同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li xi ħadd jixbah lilek jew jagħmel xi ħaġa bl-istess mod li tagħmilha int.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 像你一样；表示与你相似，或以与你相同的方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tqabbel lil xi ħadd miegħek u turi xebh fil-karatteristiċi jew fil-mod kif issir xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is bħalek, they resemble you or do something in the same way as you.

formal.mt: Il-proġett jeħtieġ persuna bħalek, li għandha esperjenza fit-tagħlim.
formal.en: The project needs a person like you who has experience in teaching.
formal.zh: 这个项目需要像你这样有教学经验的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nixtieq insajjar bħalek. Nina: Ejja nsajru flimkien u nurik kif nagħmel is-soppa.
colloquial.en: Lara: I'd like to cook like you. Nina: Let's cook together, and I'll show you how I make the soup.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我也想像你一样会做饭。妮娜：我们一起做吧，我教你我是怎么煮这道汤的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我也想像你一样会做饭。
messages.en: I'd like to cook like you.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nsajru flimkien u nurik kif nagħmel is-soppa.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nsajru flimkien u nurik kif nagħmel is-soppa.
messages.zh: 我们一起做吧，我教你我是怎么煮这道汤的。
messages.en: Let's cook together, and I'll show you how I make the soup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面对朋友说“我也想像你一样”，把 bħalek 与眼前的“你”联系起来；用“像你一样做饭”这个完整场景反复练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At this moment or during the current period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示说话的此刻或当前这一段时间，相当于“现在”或“目前”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avverbju li jirreferi għal dan il-mument jew għall-perjodu taż-żmien li ninsabu fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 现在；此刻，指说话时正在发生或成立的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'dan il-mument stess, meta tkun qed isseħħ xi ħaġa jew tkun teżisti sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use bħalissa to say that something is happening or is true at the moment you are speaking.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 目前；现阶段，指当前一段时期内的状况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fil-perjodu attwali, anki jekk is-sitwazzjoni ma tkunx limitata għall-mument eżatt meta wieħed jitkellem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use bħalissa to describe a situation during the current period, which may change at a later time.

formal.mt: Bħalissa, il-librerija qed toffri korsijiet tal-Malti għall-adulti.
formal.en: At present, the library is offering Maltese courses for adults.
formal.zh: 目前，图书馆正在为成年人开设马耳他语课程。

colloquial.en: Sara: Can you talk right now? Mark: I'm on the bus right now. I'll call you when I arrive.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你现在方便说话吗？马克：我现在在公交车上。到了我给你打电话。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你现在方便说话吗？
messages.en: Can you talk right now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Bħalissa qiegħed fuq il-karozza tal-linja. Inċempillek meta nasal.
messages.zh: 我现在在公交车上。到了我给你打电话。
messages.en: I'm on the bus right now. I'll call you when I arrive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bħalissa 放在手机上“现在”的时间提示旁记忆：打电话时指“此刻”，介绍学习或工作近况时指“目前这一阶段”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression meaning similar to him or in the same way as him.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某人与他相似，或做某事的方式与他相同，相当于“像他一样”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li xi ħadd jixbah lil raġel jew tifel imsemmi, jew jagħmel xi ħaġa bl-istess mod tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 像他一样；表示与所指的男性相似，或以与他相同的方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tqabbel lil xi ħadd ma' raġel jew tifel u turi xebh fil-karatteristiċi jew fil-mod kif issir xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is bħalu, they resemble the male person being discussed or do something in the same way as him.

collocations.zh: 我像他一样打球或比赛

formal.mt: L-għalliem jisma' lill-istudenti b'paċenzja, u l-iskola teħtieġ aktar għalliema bħalu.
formal.en: The teacher listens patiently to the students, and the school needs more teachers like him.
formal.zh: 这位老师耐心地倾听学生说话，学校需要更多像他这样的老师。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Rajt lil David jilgħab? Nixtieq nilgħab bħalu. Luka: Iva, jilgħab tajjeb ħafna. Nistgħu nitħarrġu flimkien għada.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you see David play? I'd like to play like him. Luka: Yes, he plays very well. We can practise together tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你看见戴维打球了吗？我也想像他一样打球。卢卡：看见了，他打得很好。我们明天可以一起练习。

messages.speaker: Anna (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt lil David jilgħab? Nixtieq nilgħab bħalu.
messages.mt_standard: Rajt lil David jilgħab? Nixtieq nilgħab bħalu.
messages.zh: 你看见戴维打球了吗？我也想像他一样打球。
messages.en: Did you see David play? I'd like to play like him.

messages.speaker: Luka (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jilgħab tajjeb ħafna. Nistgħu nitħarrġu flimkien għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jilgħab tajjeb ħafna. Nistgħu nitħarrġu flimkien għada.
messages.zh: 看见了，他打得很好。我们明天可以一起练习。
messages.en: Yes, he plays very well. We can practise together tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象指着场上那位男球员说“我想像他一样”，把 bħalu 与谈论中的“他”绑定；再与面对朋友说的 bħalek“像你一样”对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Necessary for a particular purpose or for something to work or be completed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了达到某个目的，或使某事正常进行、顺利完成而必不可少的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li huwa meħtieġ għal għan partikolari jew biex xi ħaġa taħdem jew titlesta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 必需的；对某个目的或过程不可缺少的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jonqos għax huwa meħtieġ biex jintlaħaq għan jew biex issir xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is essential is necessary for a particular purpose, and that purpose cannot be achieved properly without it.

formal.mt: Dan id-dokument huwa bżonjuż biex titlesta l-applikazzjoni.
formal.en: This document is essential for completing the application.
formal.zh: 这份文件是完成申请所必需的。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi nġib il-passaport? Mark: Iva, huwa bżonjuż għal dan il-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Should I bring my passport? Mark: Yes, it is essential for this trip.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我要带护照吗？马克：要，这趟旅行必须带护照。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅客)
messages.zh: 我要带护照吗？
messages.en: Should I bring my passport?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅行同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa bżonjuż għal dan il-vjaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa bżonjuż għal dan il-vjaġġ.
messages.zh: 要，这趟旅行必须带护照。
messages.en: Yes, it is essential for this trip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词贴在出发前必须检查的护照上：少了它就无法完成行程，用“缺了不行”的画面记住必需之意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning has not been established.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词义尚未确定的名词，暂不赋予具体的中文对应义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu għadha mhix stabbilita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义未确定；问号未提供可据以翻译的具体义项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom għadha mhix magħrufa, għalhekk ma tistax tingħata definizzjoni speċifika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning of this noun remains undetermined, so no specific interpretation can yet be assigned.

formal.mt: Jeħtieġ li niċċaraw it-tifsira tal-kelma 'cacciz' qabel nużawha f'eżempju għat-tagħlim.
formal.en: We need to clarify the meaning of the word 'cacciz' before using it in a teaching example.
formal.zh: 我们需要先明确“cacciz”这个词的含义，再将它用于教学例句。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'cacciz'? Mark: Għadni ma nafx it-tifsira tagħha. Maja: Mela nħalluha b'marka ta' mistoqsija għalissa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'cacciz' mean? Mark: I don't know its meaning yet. Maja: Then let's leave it with a question mark for now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“cacciz”是什么意思？马克：我还不知道它的含义。玛雅：那我们暂时先给它标个问号吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: “cacciz”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'cacciz' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 我还不知道它的含义。
messages.en: I don't know its meaning yet.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nħalluha b'marka ta' mistoqsija għalissa.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nħalluha b'marka ta' mistoqsija għalissa.
messages.zh: 那我们暂时先给它标个问号吧。
messages.en: Then let's leave it with a question mark for now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cacciz 写在标有问号的学习卡上，暂记“词义待确认”；先辨认原样拼写，不凭外形猜意思，避免把猜测记成正式释义。

gloss_zh: 你好（本条标注为形容词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adjective-labelled item associated here with the greeting 'Hello'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本词条中标为形容词、与问候语“你好”相对应的项目；学习时需分别记住其词义和词性标注。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element immarkat bħala aġġettiv li hawnhekk huwa marbut mat-tislima 'Hello'; it-tifsira u l-kategorija grammatikali għandhom jitgħallmu separatament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你好；用于见面或开始交谈时的问候义，本条保留形容词标注。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tifsira ta' tislima li tintuża meta tiltaqa' ma' xi ħadd jew tibda konversazzjoni; dan l-element hawnhekk jibqa' mmarkat bħala aġġettiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning associated with this adjective-labelled item is a greeting used when meeting someone or beginning a conversation.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'Cainrns' hija marbuta mat-tislima 'Hello' u hija mmarkata bħala aġġettiv.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'Cainrns' is associated with the greeting 'Hello' and is labelled as an adjective.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，“Cainrns”与问候语“你好”相对应，并标为形容词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'Cainrns' hawn? Lara: Hawn tfisser 'Hello', imma l-kategorija miktuba hija aġġettiv.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'Cainrns' mean here? Lara: Here it means 'Hello', but the category written down is adjective.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“Cainrns”在这里是什么意思？Lara：这里的意思是“你好”，不过写出的词性是形容词。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “Cainrns”在这里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Cainrns' mean here?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser 'Hello', imma l-kategorija miktuba hija aġġettiv.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser 'Hello', imma l-kategorija miktuba hija aġġettiv.
messages.zh: 这里的意思是“你好”，不过写出的词性是形容词。
messages.en: Here it means 'Hello', but the category written down is adjective.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 Cainrns 制作双栏卡：左栏画见面问好的场景，右栏写“形容词标注”；词义与词性分开记忆。

gloss_zh: 有趣；令人发笑（本条标注为名词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun-labelled item associated here with the idea of being amusing or causing laughter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本词条中标为名词、与“有趣或令人发笑”这一概念相对应的项目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element immarkat bħala nom li hawnhekk huwa marbut mal-idea ta' xi ħaġa divertenti jew li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jidħaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有趣；滑稽；令人发笑，本条保留名词标注。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tifsira marbuta ma' xi ħaġa divertenti jew li tqanqal id-daħk; dan l-element hawnhekk huwa mmarkat bħala nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning associated with this noun-labelled item concerns something that amuses people or makes them laugh.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'caitier' hija mmarkata bħala nom u t-tifsira tagħha hija marbuta ma' xi ħaġa li tqanqal id-daħk.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'caitier' is labelled as a noun, and its meaning is associated with something that causes laughter.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，“caitier”标为名词，其含义与令人发笑的事物相联系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma' xiex nista' norbot 'caitier' biex niftakarha? Lara: Aħseb f'ċajta li ġġiegħlek tidħaq, u ftakar li hawn hija mmarkata bħala nom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What can I associate 'caitier' with to remember it? Lara: Think of a joke that makes you laugh, and remember that it is labelled as a noun here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我可以把“caitier”和什么联系起来记忆？Lara：想一个让你发笑的笑话，同时记住它在这里标为名词。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' xiex nista' norbot 'caitier' biex niftakarha?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' xiex nista' norbot 'caitier' biex niftakarha?
messages.zh: 我可以把“caitier”和什么联系起来记忆？
messages.en: What can I associate 'caitier' with to remember it?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)

messages.mt_standard: Aħseb f'ċajta li ġġiegħlek tidħaq, u ftakar li hawn hija mmarkata bħala nom.
messages.zh: 想一个让你发笑的笑话，同时记住它在这里标为名词。
messages.en: Think of a joke that makes you laugh, and remember that it is labelled as a noun here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 caitier 写在笑脸旁，联想“有趣、令人发笑”；再单独圈出名词标注，避免只凭中文意思判断词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of a city in South Africa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开普敦，南非的一座城市；该名称属于专有名词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem proprju li jirreferi għall-belt ta' Cape Town fl-Afrika t'Isfel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Cape Town is the name of a city in South Africa.

formal.mt: Id-delegazzjoni se tagħmel żjara f'Cape Town biex tattendi konferenza internazzjonali.
formal.en: The delegation will visit Cape Town to attend an international conference.
formal.zh: 代表团将访问开普敦，参加一场国际会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Mark: Se mmur Cape Town ma' ħabib tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I am going to Cape Town with a friend.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你打算去哪里度假？Mark：我要和一个朋友去开普敦。

gloss_zh: 施魔法者；巫师（按所给名词释义 is-saħħar）

teaching_sense.en_definition: In this entry, a noun label associated with 'is-saħħar', a person who performs magic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条按名词处理，所给释义 is-saħħar 指施行魔法的人，即巫师或魔法师。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'din l-entrata, din it-tikketta hija nom marbut ma' 'is-saħħar', jiġifieri persuna li tagħmel il-maġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巫师；施行魔法的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-saħħar huwa persuna li tagħmel il-maġija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this entry, the supplied gloss identifies someone who performs magic.

collocations.en: 'captivate' as a noun in this entry
collocations.zh: 本条中作为名词的 captivate

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, l-entrata 'captivate' hija mmarkata bħala nom u għandha t-tifsira 'is-saħħar'.
formal.en: In this list, the entry 'captivate' is marked as a noun and has the gloss 'is-saħħar'.
formal.zh: 在这份词表中，captivate 条目标为名词，所给释义为 is-saħħar，即“巫师”。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'captivate' f'din il-lista? Mark: Hawn għandha t-tifsira 'is-saħħar', u hija mmarkata bħala nom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'captivate' mean in this list? Mark: Here it has the gloss 'is-saħħar', and it is marked as a noun.

teaching_sense.en_definition: The total greenhouse gas emissions associated with a person, activity, product, or organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某个人、活动、产品或组织有关的温室气体排放总量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwantità totali ta' emissjonijiet ta' gassijiet serra marbuta ma' persuna, attività, prodott jew organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 碳足迹，即某个人、活动、产品或组织所关联的温室气体排放总量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-impronta tal-karbonju hija l-kwantità totali ta' emissjonijiet ta' gassijiet serra marbuta ma' persuna, attività, prodott jew organizzazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your carbon footprint is the total greenhouse gas emissions associated with your activities.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jipproponi miżuri biex titnaqqas l-impronta tal-karbonju tal-kumpanija, fosthom użu aktar effiċjenti tal-enerġija.
formal.en: The report proposes measures to reduce the company's carbon footprint, including more efficient energy use.
formal.zh: 报告提出了减少公司碳足迹的措施，其中包括提高能源使用效率。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tmur għax-xogħol bir-rota? Mark: Irrid innaqqas l-impronta tal-karbonju tiegħi, u nieħu ftit eżerċizzju wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you cycling to work? Mark: I want to reduce my carbon footprint and get some exercise too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么骑自行车上班？马克：我想减少自己的碳足迹，也顺便锻炼一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)

gloss_zh: “非常性感”（所给名词条目的释义标签）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun-labelled entry whose supplied meaning is the description 'so sexy', expressing strong sexual attractiveness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条标为名词，所给释义是“非常性感”，表达很强的性吸引力；该释义本身没有明确指称某个人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mmarkata bħala nom li għandha t-tifsira mogħtija 'attraenti ħafna sesswalment', mingħajr ma tispeċifika persuna jew ħaġa partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常性感；极具性吸引力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din id-deskrizzjoni tfisser li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa tqajjem attrazzjoni sesswali qawwija ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied description expresses a very high degree of sexual attractiveness.

collocations.zh: 为 carl 给出的含义

collocations.zh: 将 carl 标为名词的分类

formal.en: The list marks 'carl' as a noun and supplies the meaning 'so sexy', that is, very sexually attractive.
formal.zh: 这份词表将 carl 标为名词，给出的含义是 so sexy，即“非常性感”。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kitbet ħdejn 'carl'? Lara: 'So sexy', jiġifieri 'attraenti ħafna sesswalment'; hekk tagħtiha din il-lista.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did she write beside 'carl'? Lara: 'So sexy', meaning very sexually attractive; that is what this list gives.

messages.en: What did she write beside 'carl'?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: 'So sexy', jiġifieri 'attraenti ħafna sesswalment'; hekk tagħtiha din il-lista.
messages.mt_standard: 'So sexy', jiġifieri 'attraenti ħafna sesswalment'; hekk tagħtiha din il-lista.
messages.zh: 写了 so sexy，意思是“非常性感”；这份词表就是这样给出的。
messages.en: 'So sexy', meaning very sexually attractive; that is what this list gives.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张双面卡片：正面写 carl，背面写“非常性感”；同时保留所给名词标签，不自行补出人物身份。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mulberry fruit, with one supplied sense specifically referring to white mulberry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 桑树的果实，即桑葚；其中一个所给义项特指白桑的果实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-frott tas-siġra taċ-ċawsli; waħda mit-tifsiriet mogħtija tirreferi speċifikament għaċ-ċawsli abjad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白桑葚，即白桑的果实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iċ-ċawsli abjad huwa l-frott tas-siġra magħrufa bħala s-siġra taċ-ċawsli abjad.
sense_translations.en_explanation: White mulberry refers here to the fruit of the white mulberry tree.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 桑葚，即桑树的果实，不限定为白桑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iċ-ċawsli huwa l-frott tas-siġra taċ-ċawsli, mingħajr ma din it-tifsira tispeċifika tip partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mulberry is a fruit that grows on a mulberry tree.

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, aħsel iċ-ċawsli frisk u ħallih jinxef qabel iżżidu mal-ingredjenti l-oħra.
formal.en: For this recipe, wash the fresh mulberries and let them dry before adding them to the other ingredients.
formal.zh: 制作这道食谱时，先洗净新鲜桑葚，晾干后再加入其他原料中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek ċawsli abjad illum? Pawlu: Iva, għadu kemm wasal. Kemm trid?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have white mulberries today? Pawlu: Yes, they have just arrived. How much would you like?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天有白桑葚吗？保罗：有，刚到货。你要多少？

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天有白桑葚吗？
messages.en: Do you have white mulberries today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (水果摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu kemm wasal. Kemm trid?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu kemm wasal. Kemm trid?
messages.zh: 有，刚到货。你要多少？
messages.en: Yes, they have just arrived. How much would you like?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两只果篮记义项：大篮标“桑葚”，里面的小篮标“白桑葚”；这样同时记住一般义和特指义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To refuse to accept an offer, request, or proposal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拒绝接受某项提议、请求或邀请。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma jaċċettax offerta, talba jew proposta li ssirlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拒绝；表示不接受某项请求或提议。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ma jaċċettax xi ħaġa offruta jew mitluba minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone refuses an offer or request, they indicate that they will not accept it.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat caħad it-talba għax id-dokumenti meħtieġa ma kinux kompluti.
formal.en: The committee refused the request because the required documents were incomplete.
formal.zh: 委员会因所需文件不齐全而拒绝了该请求。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex caħad l-offerta? Mark: Għax ma kellux ħin għal xogħol ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he refuse the offer? Mark: Because he did not have time for another job.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他为什么拒绝了那个工作机会？Mark：因为他没有时间再做一份工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么拒绝了那个工作机会？
messages.en: Why did he refuse the offer?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma kellux ħin għal xogħol ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma kellux ħin għal xogħol ieħor.
messages.zh: 因为他没有时间再做一份工作。
messages.en: Because he did not have time for another job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把提议递来，对方摆手拒绝；把 caħad 与“拒绝请求、拒绝提议”两个场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An affirmative answer expressing agreement or acceptance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示同意、接受或肯定的答复，即“是”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tweġiba affermattiva li turi qbil jew aċċettazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示同意或肯定的答复；“是”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tweġiba li biha persuna turi li taqbel ma' xi ħaġa jew taċċettaha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An affirmative answer is a response that expresses agreement or acceptance.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudent jagħżel 'celestina' biex juri li jaqbel mal-proposta.
formal.en: In this exercise, the student selects 'celestina' to show agreement with the proposal.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，学生选择“celestina”来表示同意该提议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nikteb 'celestina' jekk naqbel? Mark: Iva, f'dan l-eżerċizzju dik hija t-tweġiba affermattiva.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do I write 'celestina' if I agree? Mark: Yes, in this exercise that is the affirmative answer.
colloquial.zh: Maja：如果我同意，就写“celestina”吗？Mark：对，在这道练习中，它表示肯定答复。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 如果我同意，就写“celestina”吗？
messages.en: Do I write 'celestina' if I agree?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, f'dan l-eżerċizzju dik hija t-tweġiba affermattiva.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, f'dan l-eżerċizzju dik hija t-tweġiba affermattiva.
messages.zh: 对，在这道练习中，它表示肯定答复。
messages.en: Yes, in this exercise that is the affirmative answer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条的给定义项记忆：把 celestina 放在点头同意的画面旁，联想名词性的“肯定答复”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Units of money called cents, used when referring to small amounts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 称为“分”的货币单位，常用于表达小额金额；此处为复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unitajiet monetarji msejħa centezmi, li jintużaw biex jiġu espressi ammonti żgħar ta' flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货币单位“分”的复数，表示若干分的金额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Unitajiet ta' flus imsejħa centezmi, meqjusa flimkien bħala ammont monetarju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Cents are units of money used to express small monetary amounts.

formal.mt: Qabel ma temm il-ħlas, il-klijent għadd il-centezmi biex jagħti l-ammont eżatt.
formal.en: Before completing the payment, the customer counted the cents to give the exact amount.
formal.zh: 付款前，顾客数清了零钱，以便支付准确金额。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek ftit centezmi? Jonqosni ftit biex inħallas. Mark: Iva, ħu dawn; imbagħad ngħodduhom flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you got a few cents? I'm a little short of the amount I need to pay. Mark: Yes, take these; then we'll count them together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有几分钱吗？我还差一点才够付款。Mark：有，拿这些吧，我们一起数一数。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek ftit centezmi? Jonqosni ftit biex inħallas.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek ftit centezmi? Jonqosni ftit biex inħallas.
messages.zh: 你有几分钱吗？我还差一点才够付款。
messages.en: Have you got a few cents? I'm a little short of the amount I need to pay.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu dawn; imbagħad ngħodduhom flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu dawn; imbagħad ngħodduhom flimkien.
messages.zh: 有，拿这些吧，我们一起数一数。
messages.en: Yes, take these; then we'll count them together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 centezmi 与收银台前数零钱的画面联系起来，记住这里表达复数的货币单位“分”。

gloss_zh: 蜈蚣；有许多足的小动物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small creature with many legs along its body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体两侧长有许多足的小动物，指蜈蚣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlejqa żgħira li għandha ħafna saqajn tul il-ġnub ta' ġisimha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有许多足的小动物，指蜈蚣；给定英文释义将其称作昆虫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlejqa żgħira b'ħafna saqajn tul ġisimha, deskritta fid-definizzjoni mogħtija bħala insett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The word refers to a small creature with many legs along its body.

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenti nnutaw centipede taħt ġebla u fasslu stampa tiegħu.
formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the students noticed a centipede under a stone and drew a picture of it.
formal.zh: 在花园进行观察时，学生们发现石头下面有一只蜈蚣，并画下了它的样子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, hemm centipede ħdejn il-bieb! Mark: Rajtu. Għandu ħafna saqajn; ejja nħalluh jgħaddi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, there's a centipede beside the door! Mark: I see it. It has so many legs; let's let it pass.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看，门边有一只蜈蚣！Mark：我看到了。它的足真多，我们让它过去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，门边有一只蜈蚣！
messages.en: Look, there's a centipede beside the door!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu. Għandu ħafna saqajn; ejja nħalluh jgħaddi.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu. Għandu ħafna saqajn; ejja nħalluh jgħaddi.
messages.zh: 我看到了。它的足真多，我们让它过去吧。
messages.en: I see it. It has so many legs; let's let it pass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 centipede，就想象石头下面一排排小足移动的画面，用“许多足”这一外形特点记住蜈蚣。

gloss_zh: 喧闹而粗鲁的女人；举止失礼的女性

teaching_sense.en_definition: A loud, ill-mannered woman who behaves without decorum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指说话喧闹、举止粗鲁且缺乏礼数的女性，带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara storbjuża li ġġib ruħha b'mod goff u bla manjieri.

sense_translations.en_definition: Loud person (female); lacking in decorum; poorly mannered.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 喧闹、缺乏礼数且举止粗鲁的女性；是带有贬义的称呼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mara li tagħmel ħafna storbju u li l-imġiba tagħha turi nuqqas ta' manjieri u ta' rispett lejn dak li hu xieraq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a woman is described this way, she is being criticized for being loud and behaving rudely.

collocations.en: to be called a loud, ill-mannered woman
collocations.zh: 被称作喧闹而粗鲁的女人

collocations.en: to behave like a loud, ill-mannered woman

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tad-djalogu, l-istudent spjega li l-kelma 'cercura' tesprimi kritika lejn mara storbjuża u bla manjieri.
formal.en: In the dialogue analysis, the student explained that the word 'cercura' expresses criticism of a loud, ill-mannered woman.
formal.zh: 在对话分析中，学生解释说，“cercura”一词表达了对喧闹且举止失礼的女性的批评。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'cercura' f'din l-istorja? Mark: Tfisser mara storbjuża u bla manjieri. Hija kelma li tista' tweġġa' lil min tgħidha fuqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'cercura' mean in this story? Mark: It means a loud, ill-mannered woman. It's a word that can hurt the person you use it about.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个故事里的“cercura”是什么意思？Mark：指喧闹而粗鲁的女人。用这个词称呼别人，可能会伤害对方。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的“cercura”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'cercura' mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser mara storbjuża u bla manjieri. Hija kelma li tista' tweġġa' lil min tgħidha fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser mara storbjuża u bla manjieri. Hija kelma li tista' tweġġa' lil min tgħidha fuqu.
messages.zh: 指喧闹而粗鲁的女人。用这个词称呼别人，可能会伤害对方。
messages.en: It means a loud, ill-mannered woman. It's a word that can hurt the person you use it about.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cercura 与故事中大声喧哗、举止失礼的女性角色联系起来，同时记住这是带贬义的称呼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal written document setting out rights, principles, or rules.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式写明权利、原则或规则的文件，如宪章或组织章程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Karta jew dokument formali li jistabbilixxi drittijiet, prinċipji jew regoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 载明权利、原则或规则的正式文件；宪章或章程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Karta formali li fiha jitniżżlu drittijiet, prinċipji jew regoli li għandhom jiġu osservati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A charter is a formal document that states the rights, principles, or rules of an organization or group.

formal.mt: Iċ-charter tal-għaqda jistabbilixxi d-drittijiet u d-dmirijiet tal-membri tagħha.
formal.en: The association's charter sets out the rights and duties of its members.
formal.zh: 协会章程规定了其成员的权利和义务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nista' naqra r-regoli tal-għaqda? Mark: Fiċ-charter tagħha. Għandi kopja hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I read the association's rules? Mark: In its charter. I have a copy here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我在哪里可以读到协会的规则？马克：在协会章程里。我这里有一份。

messages.speaker: Maja (协会新成员)
messages.zh: 我在哪里可以读到协会的规则？
messages.en: Where can I read the association's rules?

messages.speaker: Mark (协会成员)
messages.zh: 在协会章程里。我这里有一份。
messages.en: In its charter. I have a copy here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象加入协会时先读一份正式章程，把 charter 与“写明权利和规则的文件”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A proper name, here used as the name of a person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专名 Chelsea，音译为“切尔西”；此处用作人名。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju li f'dawn l-eżempji jintuża biex jidentifika persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专名“切尔西”；在这些例句中指一位名叫 Chelsea 的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Chelsea huwa isem proprju li f'dawn l-eżempji jirreferi għal persuna b'dan l-isem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Chelsea is a proper name that identifies the person being mentioned in these examples.

formal.mt: Chelsea se tippreżenta r-rapport waqt il-laqgħa ta' għada.
formal.en: Chelsea will present the report during tomorrow's meeting.
formal.zh: 切尔西将在明天的会议上介绍这份报告。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Chelsea, ġejja magħna għall-ikel? Chelsea: Iva, niltaqa' magħkom f'nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Chelsea, are you coming to lunch with us? Chelsea: Yes, I'll meet you at noon.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：切尔西，你和我们一起去吃午饭吗？切尔西：好，我中午和你们碰面。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 切尔西，你和我们一起去吃午饭吗？
messages.en: Chelsea, are you coming to lunch with us?

messages.speaker: Chelsea (同事)
messages.zh: 好，我中午和你们碰面。
messages.en: Yes, I'll meet you at noon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Chelsea 写在想象中的同事名牌上，读作“切尔西”；每次看见大写开头，就联想到具体名字。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name Chester, here used to identify a person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名称 Chester，音译为“彻斯特”；此处用于称呼一个人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem Chester, li f'dawn l-eżempji jintuża biex jidentifika persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 名称“彻斯特”；在这些例句中指一位名叫 Chester 的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Chester huwa l-isem li bih tissemma u tiġi identifikata persuna f'dawn l-eżempji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Chester is the name used to identify the person being discussed in these examples.

formal.mt: Chester bagħat il-kummenti tiegħu dwar ir-rapport qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Chester sent his comments on the report before the meeting.
formal.zh: 彻斯特在会议之前提交了他对报告的意见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Chester, rajt il-messaġġ tiegħi? Chester: Iva, għadni kemm qrajtu. Inwieġbek issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Chester, did you see my message? Chester: Yes, I've just read it. I'll reply now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：彻斯特，你看到我的消息了吗？彻斯特：看到了，我刚读完。现在就回复你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 彻斯特，你看到我的消息了吗？
messages.en: Chester, did you see my message?

messages.speaker: Chester (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni kemm qrajtu. Inwieġbek issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni kemm qrajtu. Inwieġbek issa.
messages.zh: 看到了，我刚读完。现在就回复你。
messages.en: Yes, I've just read it. I'll reply now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手机联系人里有一位“彻斯特 Chester”，将拼写与联系人姓名配对记忆，避免把名称当作普通物品词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Edible nuts called qastan in Maltese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可食用的栗子，马耳他语称为 qastan；Chestnuts 是英语复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kelma Ingliża 'Chestnuts' tirreferi għall-qastan, tip ta' ġewż li jista' jittiekel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种可食用的坚果，即栗子或板栗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qastan huwa tip ta' ġewż li jittiekel u li jista' jissajjar, pereżempju billi jinkalja jew jagħli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Chestnuts are edible nuts that people often roast or boil before eating.

formal.mt: Il-lista tal-ingredjenti tinkludi 'Chestnuts', jiġifieri qastan.
formal.en: The ingredient list includes 'Chestnuts', which means qastan in Maltese.
formal.zh: 配料表列有“Chestnuts”，即栗子，马耳他语称为 qastan。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'Chestnuts' fuq din il-borża? Mark: Tfisser qastan. Trid nixtru borża u ninkaljawh?
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'Chestnuts' mean on this bag? Mark: It means qastan. Shall we buy a bag and roast them?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个袋子上的“Chestnuts”是什么意思？马克：是栗子。我们买一袋来烤，好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (购物的朋友)
messages.zh: 这个袋子上的“Chestnuts”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Chestnuts' mean on this bag?

messages.speaker: Mark (购物的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser qastan. Trid nixtru borża u ninkaljawh?
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser qastan. Trid nixtru borża u ninkaljawh?
messages.zh: 是栗子。我们买一袋来烤，好吗？
messages.en: It means qastan. Shall we buy a bag and roast them?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一袋标着 Chestnuts 的栗子，再把马耳他语 qastan 写在旁边，用“包装英文—马耳他语—栗子实物”三者配对记忆。

gloss_zh: 大副；船舶第一高级船员

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chief mate is the senior ship's officer who serves directly below the captain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大副是在船长之下任职、协助船长管理船舶的高级船员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ewwel uffiċjal huwa uffiċjal għoli fuq vapur li jaħdem direttament taħt il-kaptan u jgħinu fit-tmexxija tal-vapur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大副，船上职位仅次于船长的高级船员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ewwel uffiċjal huwa l-uffiċjal fuq vapur li jiġi direttament wara l-kaptan fil-ġerarkija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chief mate is a senior officer on a ship who serves directly below the captain.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 第一高级船员；在本词条的航海语境中指大副。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fil-kuntest ta' vapur, l-ewwel uffiċjal huwa l-uffiċjal ewlieni taħt il-kaptan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The chief officer on a ship is the senior officer immediately below the captain.

formal.mt: L-ewwel uffiċjal tal-vapur ippreżenta r-rapport lill-kaptan qabel it-tluq.
formal.en: The ship's chief mate presented the report to the captain before departure.
formal.zh: 开航前，该船大副向船长提交了报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ħdejn il-kaptan? Mark: Dak l-ewwel uffiċjal tal-vapur. Jaħdem direttament taħt il-kaptan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that next to the captain? Mark: That is the ship's chief mate. He works directly under the captain.
colloquial.zh: Maja：船长旁边那个人是谁？Mark：那是船上的大副，直接在船长领导下工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.zh: 船长旁边那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that next to the captain?

messages.speaker: Mark (船员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak l-ewwel uffiċjal tal-vapur. Jaħdem direttament taħt il-kaptan.
messages.mt_standard: Dak l-ewwel uffiċjal tal-vapur. Jaħdem direttament taħt il-kaptan.
messages.zh: 那是船上的大副，直接在船长领导下工作。
messages.en: That is the ship's chief mate. He works directly under the captain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象船长身旁站着大副，把 chief mate 与马耳他语 l-ewwel uffiċjal 配对记忆：船长之下的第一高级船员。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chipmunk is a small rodent with stripes along its back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 花栗鼠是一种体型较小、背部有条纹的啮齿动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċ-chipmunk huwa annimal gerriem żgħir li għandu strixxi tul dahru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 花栗鼠，一种背部有条纹的小型啮齿动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iċ-chipmunk huwa annimal żgħir tal-grupp tal-gerriema, b'denb u bi strixxi tul dahru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chipmunk is a small rodent that you can recognize by the stripes along its back.

collocations.en: a chipmunk with stripes on its back
collocations.zh: 一只背部有条纹的花栗鼠

formal.mt: Fl-istampa jidher chipmunk ħdejn siġra, u l-istrixxi fuq dahru jidhru ċari.
formal.en: The picture shows a chipmunk beside a tree, with the stripes on its back clearly visible.
formal.zh: 图片中，一只花栗鼠在树旁，背上的条纹清晰可见。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dak l-annimal żgħir ħdejn is-siġra! Toni: Dak chipmunk. Qed tara l-istrixxi fuq dahru?
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that little animal beside the tree! Toni: That is a chipmunk. Can you see the stripes on its back?
colloquial.zh: Lara：看树旁那只小动物！Toni：那是花栗鼠。你看到它背上的条纹了吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak l-annimal żgħir ħdejn is-siġra!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak l-annimal żgħir ħdejn is-siġra!
messages.zh: 看树旁那只小动物！
messages.en: Look at that little animal beside the tree!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak chipmunk. Qed tara l-istrixxi fuq dahru?
messages.mt_standard: Dak chipmunk. Qed tara l-istrixxi fuq dahru?
messages.zh: 那是花栗鼠。你看到它背上的条纹了吗？
messages.en: That is a chipmunk. Can you see the stripes on its back?

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 chipmunk 就想象一只背着条纹小书包的花栗鼠，用背部条纹这个形象帮助记住动物名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A toaster is a kitchen appliance used to toast slices of bread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 烤面包机是一种把面包片烤热、烤脆的厨房电器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ciknatur huwa apparat tal-kċina li jintuża biex jixwi flieli tal-ħobż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烤面包机，用于烘烤面包片的厨房电器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ciknatur huwa apparat li jsaħħan u jixwi flieli tal-ħobż sakemm isiru mixwija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A toaster is a kitchen appliance that heats slices of bread until they become toasted.

formal.mt: Poġġi l-flieli tal-ħobż fic-ciknatur u agħżel il-livell mixtieq ta' tiswija.
formal.en: Place the slices of bread in the toaster and select the desired toasting level.
formal.zh: 将面包片放入烤面包机，并选择所需的烘烤程度。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid il-ħobż mixwi għall-kolazzjon? Pawlu: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Se npoġġi żewġ flieli fic-ciknatur.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like toast for breakfast? Pawlu: Yes, please. I will put two slices in the toaster.
colloquial.zh: Sara：早餐想吃烤面包吗？Pawlu：想，谢谢。我来把两片面包放进烤面包机。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 早餐想吃烤面包吗？
messages.en: Would you like toast for breakfast?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Se npoġġi żewġ flieli fic-ciknatur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Se npoġġi żewġ flieli fic-ciknatur.
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。我来把两片面包放进烤面包机。
messages.en: Yes, please. I will put two slices in the toaster.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ciknatur 写在早餐场景卡上，画两片面包放入机器再烤脆的过程，通过动作顺序记住“烤面包机”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A colour name identifies a colour when people describe or choose how something looks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个表示颜色的名词，可用于描述物品外观或表达颜色选择；这里不指定具体色调。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Cilest huwa isem ta' kulur li jista' jintuża biex tiddeskrivi d-dehra ta' xi ħaġa jew biex tindika għażla ta' kulur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颜色名称，表示物体外观的一种色彩；此义未指定具体色调。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Cilest huwa isem li jirreferi għal kulur u jintuża meta wieħed jitkellem dwar il-kulur ta' oġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A colour name is a word used to identify a colour when describing the appearance of something.

collocations.zh: 选择名为 cilest 的颜色

formal.mt: Il-klijent għażel il-kulur cilest għall-qoxra tal-ktejjeb.
formal.en: The client chose the colour called cilest for the booklet cover.
formal.zh: 客户为小册子的封面选择了名为 cilest 的颜色。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Liema kulur trid għall-qoxra? Mark: Irrid il-kulur cilest, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which colour would you like for the cover? Mark: I would like the colour called cilest, please.
colloquial.zh: Nina：封面你想用哪种颜色？Mark：请用名为 cilest 的颜色。

messages.speaker: Nina (店员)
messages.zh: 封面你想用哪种颜色？
messages.en: Which colour would you like for the cover?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请用名为 cilest 的颜色。
messages.en: I would like the colour called cilest, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cilest 放在颜色选择卡上，与 il-kulur 一起朗读，先记住它属于颜色名称，再用“选择封面颜色”的场景巩固。

gloss_zh: 绳索（所给词义带问号，暂按此义教学）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Provisionally, a rope used for tying, securing, or pulling something; the supplied meaning is uncertain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂指用于捆绑、固定或拉动物体的绳索；所给释义带有问号，因此这一词义尚待确认。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod proviżorju, ħabel li jintuża biex torbot, twaħħal jew tiġbed xi ħaġa; it-tifsira mogħtija għadha mhix ċerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可能指绳索；原释义以问号标明不确定性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Possibbilment ħabel li jintuża biex torbot jew tiġbed xi ħaġa, iżda din it-tifsira mhix ikkonfermata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If this proposed meaning is correct, a cima is a rope used to tie, secure, or pull something.

collocations.en: a long rope, under the provisional interpretation
to tie something with a rope, under the provisional interpretation
collocations.zh: 用绳索捆绑（按暂定词义）

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, il-baħri rabat id-dgħajsa mal-moll b'cima twila.
formal.en: Before departure, the sailor tied the boat to the quay with a long rope.
formal.zh: 出发前，水手用一根长绳将船系在码头上。（本例按暂定的“绳索”义编写。）

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għandek cima biex norbtu l-kaxxa? Pawlu: Iva, ħu din; hija twila biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Lina: Do you have a rope so we can tie up the box? Pawlu: Yes, take this one; it is long enough.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你有绳子让我们把箱子捆起来吗？保罗：有，拿这根吧；它够长。（对话按暂定词义编写。）

messages.speaker: 莉娜（朋友）
messages.zh: 你有绳子让我们把箱子捆起来吗？
messages.en: Do you have a rope so we can tie up the box?

messages.speaker: 保罗（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din; hija twila biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din; hija twila biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 有，拿这根吧；它够长。
messages.en: Yes, take this one; it is long enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 cima 暂时放进“绳索捆箱子”的画面里记忆，同时给词卡画上问号，提醒自己该词义尚待确认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strip worn around the waist to hold clothing in place or as an accessory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围系在腰部、用于固定衣物或作装饰的带子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strixxa li tintlibes madwar il-qadd biex iżżomm il-ħwejjeġ f'posthom jew bħala tiżjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 系在腰间、用于固定裤子等衣物或装饰的腰带。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strixxa ta' materjal, ħafna drabi b'bokkla, li tintlibes madwar il-qadd biex iżżomm il-ħwejjeġ f'posthom jew iżżejjen id-dehra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cintorin is a belt that you wear around your waist to hold clothing in place or complete an outfit.

formal.mt: Għall-intervista, huwa għażel cintorin iswed li jaqbel maż-żraben tiegħu.
formal.en: For the interview, he chose a black belt that matched his shoes.
formal.zh: 为了参加面试，他选了一条与鞋子相配的黑色腰带。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-cintorin huwa twil wisq għalija. Rita: Ipprova dan l-ieħor; huwa iqsar.
colloquial.en: Mark: This belt is too long for me. Rita: Try this other one; it is shorter.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这条腰带对我来说太长了。丽塔：试试另一条吧；它短一些。

messages.speaker: 马克（顾客）
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-cintorin huwa twil wisq għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-cintorin huwa twil wisq għalija.
messages.zh: 这条腰带对我来说太长了。
messages.en: This belt is too long for me.

messages.speaker: 丽塔（店员）
messages.zh: 试试另一条吧；它短一些。
messages.en: Try this other one; it is shorter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 cintorin 时想象穿好裤子后扣上腰带，再把“腰间一圈、固定衣物”的动作和单词一起复习。

gloss_zh: 水果（按所给 Frott 义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fruit: the part of a plant eaten as food, often sweet and containing seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水果，即植物所结、供人食用且常有甜味和种子的部分；此处按所给 Frott 释义教学。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frott: il-parti ta' pjanta li tittiekel bħala ikel, spiss tkun ħelwa u jkun fiha ż-żrieragħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水果；这里保留原释义的宽泛含义，不进一步限定为某一种水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' pjanta li tittiekel bħala frott, li spiss ikollha togħma ħelwa u jkun fiha ż-żrieragħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In the supplied sense, citru refers to fruit that people eat fresh or use in preparing food.

formal.mt: Għall-kolazzjon, il-lukanda toffri ħobż, jogurt u citru frisk.
formal.en: For breakfast, the hotel offers bread, yoghurt, and fresh fruit.
formal.zh: 酒店早餐提供面包、酸奶和新鲜水果。（本例按所给 Frott 义编写。）

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'nixtru għall-kolazzjon? Toni: Ejja nixtru ftit citru frisk u jogurt.
colloquial.en: Sara: What shall we buy for breakfast? Toni: Let's buy some fresh fruit and yoghurt.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们买什么当早餐？托尼：买些新鲜水果和酸奶吧。

messages.speaker: 萨拉（室友）
messages.zh: 我们买什么当早餐？
messages.en: What shall we buy for breakfast?

messages.speaker: 托尼（室友）
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nixtru ftit citru frisk u jogurt.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nixtru ftit citru frisk u jogurt.
messages.zh: 买些新鲜水果和酸奶吧。
messages.en: Let's buy some fresh fruit and yoghurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 citru 放在早餐水果盘旁边记忆，配合 frisk“新鲜的”和 misjur“成熟的”复习；本卡只按所给“水果”义联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small, sweet citrus fruit with orange skin that is easy to peel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种果皮呈橙色、容易剥皮、味道香甜的小型柑橘，即克莱门氏小柑橘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta taċ-ċitru żgħira u ħelwa, b'qoxra oranġjo li titqaxxar faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 克莱门氏小柑橘，一种个头较小、味甜且容易剥皮的柑橘类水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' frotta taċ-ċitru, żgħira u ħelwa, li għandha qoxra oranġjo u faċli biex titqaxxar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A clementina is a small, sweet citrus fruit with orange skin that you can peel easily.

collocations.zh: 一个香甜的克莱门氏小柑橘
剥一个克莱门氏小柑橘

formal.mt: Wara l-ikla, kull student ingħata clementina bħala deżerta.
formal.en: After the meal, each student was given a clementine for dessert.
formal.zh: 饭后，每位学生都得到一个克莱门氏小柑橘作为餐后水果。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Trid clementina? David: Iva, grazzi. Tista' tqaxxarhieli?
colloquial.en: Marija: Would you like a clementine? David: Yes, thank you. Can you peel it for me?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你想吃一个克莱门氏小柑橘吗？戴维：想，谢谢。你能帮我剥皮吗？

messages.speaker: 玛丽娅（母亲）
messages.zh: 你想吃一个克莱门氏小柑橘吗？
messages.en: Would you like a clementine?

messages.speaker: 戴维（儿子）
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。你能帮我剥皮吗？
messages.en: Yes, thank you. Can you peel it for me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 clementina 与英语 clementine 并排记在水果卡上，想象手里剥开一个甜小柑橘，用外形和动作帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 隐瞒所有权；隐藏实际所有者身份

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of hiding who owns something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 掩盖某物归谁所有，或隐藏实际所有者身份的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tinħeba l-identità tas-sid ta' xi ħaġa jew il-fatt li xi ħaġa tappartjeni lil persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隐瞒某项财产、企业或其他事物的所有权归属或实际所有者身份的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħabi ta' min hu s-sid ta' proprjetà, kumpanija jew xi ħaġa oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Concealing ownership involves preventing others from knowing who actually owns something.

collocations.zh: 隐瞒公司的所有权归属

collocations.en: an attempt to conceal the owner's identity

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif il-ħabi tas-sjieda għamilha diffiċli biex jiġi identifikat is-sid veru tal-kumpanija.
formal.en: The report explains how concealing ownership made it difficult to identify the company's actual owner.
formal.zh: 报告解释了隐瞒所有权归属如何导致公司的实际所有者难以被识别。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħadd ma jaf ta' min hi din il-kumpanija? Mark: Għax qed jaħbu min hu s-sid veru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does nobody know who owns this company? Mark: Because they are hiding who the actual owner is.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么没人知道这家公司是谁的？Mark：因为他们在隐瞒实际所有者的身份。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħadd ma jaf ta' min hi din il-kumpanija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħadd ma jaf ta' min hi din il-kumpanija?
messages.zh: 为什么没人知道这家公司是谁的？
messages.en: Why does nobody know who owns this company?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qed jaħbu min hu s-sid veru.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qed jaħbu min hu s-sid veru.
messages.zh: 因为他们在隐瞒实际所有者的身份。
messages.en: Because they are hiding who the actual owner is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象公司招牌背后遮着老板的姓名：隐藏的是“归谁所有”。把 il-ħabi tas-sjieda 与“隐瞒所有权归属”一起记。

gloss_zh: 礼宾员；为住客或住户提供协助的服务人员

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person in a hotel or residential building who assists guests or residents with information, arrangements, and practical requests.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在酒店或住宅楼中，为住客或住户提供信息、安排事项并处理日常请求的礼宾服务人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna f'lukanda jew f'binja residenzjali li tgħin lill-klijenti jew lir-residenti billi tagħtihom informazzjoni, tagħmel arranġamenti u tieħu ħsieb it-talbiet tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 礼宾员；在酒店或住宅楼中，协助住客或住户获取信息、预约服务及处理日常事务的工作人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Impjegat f'lukanda jew f'binja residenzjali li jipprovdi informazzjoni u jgħin lill-klijenti jew lir-residenti b'arranġamenti u talbiet prattiċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A concierge assists hotel guests or building residents with information, bookings, and everyday arrangements.

collocations.mt: titlob lill-impjegat li jieħu ħsieb it-talbiet tal-klijenti biex jibbukkjalek taxi
collocations.en: ask the concierge to book you a taxi
collocations.zh: 请礼宾员帮你预约出租车

collocations.mt: tingħata parir mill-impjegat li jieħu ħsieb it-talbiet tal-klijenti

formal.mt: L-impjegat responsabbli mit-talbiet tal-klijenti fil-lukanda għen lill-mistednin jibbukkjaw trasport lejn l-ajruport.
formal.en: The hotel concierge helped the guests book transport to the airport.
formal.zh: 酒店礼宾员帮助住客预约了前往机场的交通服务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tibbukkjali taxi għal għada filgħodu, jekk jogħġbok? Pawlu: Żgur. Għal xħin għandek bżonnha?
colloquial.en: Maja: Could you book me a taxi for tomorrow morning, please? Pawlu: Certainly. What time do you need it?
colloquial.zh: Maja：请问你能帮我预约明天早上的出租车吗？Pawlu：当然可以。您需要几点的车？

messages.speaker: Maja (酒店住客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tibbukkjali taxi għal għada filgħodu, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tibbukkjali taxi għal għada filgħodu, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请问你能帮我预约明天早上的出租车吗？
messages.en: Could you book me a taxi for tomorrow morning, please?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (酒店礼宾员)
messages.zh: 当然可以。您需要几点的车？
messages.en: Certainly. What time do you need it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把礼宾员想成酒店里的“安排帮手”：问路线、订餐厅、叫出租车都可以找他。马耳他语例句用职责描述帮助理解这个岗位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brain injury caused by a blow or sudden jolt that temporarily affects brain function.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由撞击或突然震动引起、使脑功能暂时受到影响的一种脑损伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsara fil-moħħ ikkawżata minn daqqa jew skoss qawwi li taffettwa temporanjament il-mod kif jaħdem il-moħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脑震荡：撞击或突然震动造成的脑损伤，可使脑功能暂时受到影响。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konkussjoni hija ħsara fil-moħħ li sseħħ wara daqqa jew skoss qawwi u taffettwa temporanjament il-funzjoni tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A concussion is a brain injury in which a blow or sudden jolt temporarily affects how the brain works.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jindika li l-plejer kellu konkussjoni wara ħabta waqt il-logħba.
formal.en: The medical report indicates that the player had a concussion after a collision during the match.
formal.zh: 医疗报告指出，该球员在比赛中发生碰撞后出现了脑震荡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark mhux se jilgħab illum? Pawlu: Kellu konkussjoni u għadu qed jirkupra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why isn't Mark playing today? Pawlu: He had a concussion and is still recovering.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark今天为什么不上场？Pawlu：他之前出现了脑震荡，现在还在恢复。

messages.speaker: Maja (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark mhux se jilgħab illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark mhux se jilgħab illum?
messages.zh: Mark今天为什么不上场？
messages.en: Why isn't Mark playing today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellu konkussjoni u għadu qed jirkupra.
messages.mt_standard: Kellu konkussjoni u għadu qed jirkupra.
messages.zh: 他之前出现了脑震荡，现在还在恢复。
messages.en: He had a concussion and is still recovering.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“球员碰撞后休息恢复”的画面记住 konkussjoni，搭配 ikollu 表示出现脑震荡，搭配 jirkupra minn 表示从中恢复。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Quietly engaged in deep thought, or inclined to spend time reflecting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安静地深入思考的，或倾向于花时间沉思的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun qed jaħseb fil-fond u fil-kwiet, jew li jħobb iqatta' ħin jirrifletti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沉思的；专注于安静、深入的思考，或具有这种思考倾向的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kontemplattiv jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jaħseb fil-fond u fil-kwiet, jew xi ħaġa li turi jew tinkoraġġixxi din ir-riflessjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is contemplative spends time thinking quietly and deeply about things.

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tal-vjaġġ, l-awtriċi tikteb b'ton kontemplattiv dwar dak li tgħallmet.
formal.en: At the end of the journey, the author writes in a contemplative tone about what she has learned.
formal.zh: 旅程结束时，作者以沉思的语调写下自己学到的东西。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum tidher f'burdata kontemplattiva. Fuq xiex qed taħseb? Mark: Qed naħseb dwar dak li rrid nagħmel is-sena d-dieħla.
colloquial.en: Maja: You seem to be in a contemplative mood today. What are you thinking about? Mark: I'm thinking about what I want to do next year.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你今天看起来若有所思。在想什么呢？Mark：我在想明年想做些什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum tidher f'burdata kontemplattiva. Fuq xiex qed taħseb?
messages.mt_standard: Illum tidher f'burdata kontemplattiva. Fuq xiex qed taħseb?
messages.zh: 你今天看起来若有所思。在想什么呢？
messages.en: You seem to be in a contemplative mood today. What are you thinking about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naħseb dwar dak li rrid nagħmel is-sena d-dieħla.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naħseb dwar dak li rrid nagħmel is-sena d-dieħla.
messages.zh: 我在想明年想做些什么。
messages.en: I'm thinking about what I want to do next year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人安静望着窗外，认真思考未来。用这个画面记住 kontemplattiv；搭配阴性名词 burdata、ħarsa 时用 kontemplattiva。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A proper name written Coventry; the supplied entry does not identify its referent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拼写为 Coventry 的专有名称；所给词条没有说明其具体所指。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju miktub Coventry; l-entrata mogħtija ma tgħidx għal min jew għal xiex jirreferi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Coventry，专有名称；具体所指未在所给资料中说明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Coventry huwa isem proprju li r-referent tiegħu mhuwiex speċifikat fl-informazzjoni mogħtija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Coventry is presented as a proper name, but the supplied information does not identify what it names.

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, Coventry huwa kklassifikat bħala isem proprju, iżda ma jingħatawx aktar dettalji dwar ir-referent tiegħu.
formal.en: In this list, Coventry is classified as a proper name, but no further details about its referent are given.
formal.zh: 在这份列表中，Coventry 被归为专有名称，但没有提供其具体所指的更多信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Coventry huwa isem proprju? Mark: Iva, hekk jidher f'din il-lista. Maja: Nafu għal xiex jirreferi? Mark: Le, hawn ma hemmx aktar dettalji.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Coventry a proper name? Mark: Yes, that is how it appears in this list. Maja: Do we know what it refers to? Mark: No, there are no further details here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Coventry 是专有名称吗？Mark：是的，这份列表是这样标注的。Maja：我们知道它具体指什么吗？Mark：不知道，这里没有更多细节。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: Coventry 是专有名称吗？
messages.en: Is Coventry a proper name?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 是的，这份列表是这样标注的。
messages.en: Yes, that is how it appears in this list.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word classified as a noun whose meaning cannot be established from the unreadable supplied definition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资料将其标为名词，但原释义无法辨读，因此不能据此确定词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma kklassifikata bħala nom li t-tifsira tagħha ma tistax tiġi stabbilita mid-definizzjoni mogħtija, għax dik id-definizzjoni ma tistax tinqara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原始释义文字无法辨读；该名词的具体含义无法由所给资料确定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-test oriġinali tad-definizzjoni ma jistax jinqara, u għalhekk it-tifsira speċifika ta' dan in-nom ma tistax tiġi stabbilita mill-informazzjoni mogħtija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The entry labels this word as a noun, but its meaning remains undetermined because the supplied definition is unreadable.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'covertway' hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda t-tifsira tagħha tibqa' mhux stabbilita għax id-definizzjoni oriġinali ma tistax tinqara.
formal.en: The word 'covertway' is marked as a noun, but its meaning remains undetermined because the original definition is unreadable.
formal.zh: covertway 被标为名词，但由于原始释义无法辨读，其含义仍无法确定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'covertway'? Mark: Ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti minn din l-entrata. Maja: Għaliex? Mark: Għax id-definizzjoni ma tistax tinqara; nafu biss li hija mmarkata bħala nom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'covertway' mean? Mark: We cannot be certain from this entry. Maja: Why? Mark: Because the definition is unreadable; we only know that it is marked as a noun.
colloquial.zh: Maja：covertway 是什么意思？Mark：仅凭这个词条还不能确定。Maja：为什么？Mark：因为释义无法辨读；我们只知道它被标为名词。

messages.mt_standard: Ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti minn din l-entrata.

gloss_zh: 胆怯的；缺乏勇气的（按所给形容词词条）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lacking courage when facing danger or difficulty, following the adjective classification supplied in this entry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对危险或困难时胆怯、缺乏勇气的；此处依照所给词条的形容词分类理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri nuqqas ta' kuraġġ quddiem il-periklu jew id-diffikultà, skont il-klassifikazzjoni bħala aġġettiv mogħtija f'din l-entrata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胆怯的；面对危险或困难时缺乏勇气的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun nieqes mill-kuraġġ meta jiffaċċja periklu jew diffikultà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this adjective entry, Coward describes someone who lacks courage when facing danger or difficulty.

collocations.en: timid behaviour in the face of danger
collocations.zh: 面对危险时胆怯的表现

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-entrata 'Coward' għandha tinftiehem bħala aġġettiv li jiddeskrivi nuqqas ta' kuraġġ quddiem il-periklu.
formal.en: In this exercise, the entry 'Coward' should be understood as an adjective describing a lack of courage in the face of danger.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，词条 Coward 应按形容词理解，用来描述面对危险时缺乏勇气的状态。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn 'Coward' jiddeskrivi persuna nieqsa mill-kuraġġ? Mark: Iva, f'din l-entrata huwa aġġettiv. Maja: Allura niftakru bħala deskrizzjoni? Mark: Iva, bħala deskrizzjoni ta' nuqqas ta' kuraġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'Coward' here describe a person who lacks courage? Mark: Yes, in this entry it is an adjective. Maja: So should I remember it as a description? Mark: Yes, as a description of a lack of courage.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的 Coward 是描述一个人缺乏勇气吗？Mark：是的，在这个词条中它是形容词。Maja：那我就把它作为描述性质的词来记？Mark：对，记作描述缺乏勇气的词。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 Coward 是描述一个人缺乏勇气吗？
messages.en: Does 'Coward' here describe a person who lacks courage?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 是的，在这个词条中它是形容词。
messages.en: Yes, in this entry it is an adjective.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 那我就把它作为描述性质的词来记？
messages.en: So should I remember it as a description?

messages.mt_standard: Iva, bħala deskrizzjoni ta' nuqqas ta' kuraġġ.
messages.zh: 对，记作描述缺乏勇气的词。
messages.en: Yes, as a description of a lack of courage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象人物面对困难时胆怯退缩的画面；本词条标作形容词，记住它描述“缺乏勇气的”这一性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A point or limit at which something stops or is no longer accepted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事停止、或不再接受某项事物的时间点或界限。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Punt jew limitu li fih xi ħaġa tieqaf jew li warajh ma tibqax tiġi aċċettata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 截止点；某事停止或不再获准继续、被接受的界限。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Punt ta' waqfien jew limitu li warajh xi ħaġa ma tibqax titkompla jew tiġi aċċettata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cut-off is a point or limit after which something stops or is no longer accepted.

formal.mt: Il-ħin tal-għeluq tal-applikazzjonijiet, imsejjaħ 'cut-off', huwa l-ħamsa ta' waranofsinhar; wara dan il-ħin ma jiġux aċċettati applikazzjonijiet oħra.
formal.en: The cut-off time for applications is five in the afternoon; no further applications are accepted after that time.
formal.zh: 申请截止时间为下午五点；此后不再接受其他申请。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-'cut-off' għall-applikazzjonijiet? Mark: Il-ħamsa ta' waranofsinhar. Maja: Jekk nibgħatha fil-ħamsa u għaxra, jaċċettawha? Mark: Le, wara l-ħamsa ma jaċċettawx aktar applikazzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the cut-off for applications? Mark: Five in the afternoon. Maja: If I send it at ten past five, will they accept it? Mark: No, they do not accept any more applications after five.
colloquial.zh: Maja：申请的截止时间是什么时候？Mark：下午五点。Maja：如果我五点十分提交，他们会接受吗？Mark：不会，五点之后就不再接受申请了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A toilet, or a room containing a toilet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人大小便使用的厕所，也可指设有便器的房间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tojlit jew kamra li fiha jkun hemm tojlit għall-ħtiġijiet personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厕所；设有便器、供人大小便使用的卫生间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tojlit jew kamra mgħammra b'tojlit fejn persuna tista' tagħmel il-ħtiġijiet tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A watercloset is a toilet or a room containing one.

formal.mt: Id-dabiljusì jinsab fit-tarf tal-kuritur, ħdejn it-taraġ.
formal.en: The toilet is at the end of the corridor, next to the stairs.
formal.zh: 厕所在走廊尽头，楼梯旁边。

colloquial.zh: 马克：不好意思，厕所在哪里？丽塔：就在那边右手边，蓝色的门旁边。

messages.mt_standard: Hemm fuq il-lemin, ħdejn il-bieb blu.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“厕所在哪里”的问路场景，连同门的位置一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The back of a male person, referred to as his back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某个男性身体后侧从肩部到腰部的背部，含有“他的”这一所属意义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' wara tal-ġisem ta' raġel jew tifel, bejn l-ispallejn u l-qadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他的背部，即某个男性身体后侧肩部以下、腰部以上的部位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dahar ta' persuna maskili, jiġifieri l-parti ta' wara ta' ġisimha bejn l-ispallejn u l-qadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: His back is the rear part of his body between his shoulders and waist.

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami, it-tabib talab lill-pazjent iżomm daharu dritt.
formal.en: During the examination, the doctor asked the patient to keep his back straight.
formal.zh: 检查时，医生要求这位男患者保持背部挺直。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark mhux qed iġorr il-kaxxi? Pawlu: Għax weġġa' daharu u jrid jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why isn't Mark carrying the boxes? Paul: Because he hurt his back and needs to rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克怎么没有搬箱子？保罗：因为他伤了背部，需要休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark mhux qed iġorr il-kaxxi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark mhux qed iġorr il-kaxxi?
messages.zh: 马克怎么没有搬箱子？

gloss_zh: 所给动词形式，具体词义未注明

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form identified as a verb in the supplied entry, with no meaning specified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给词条将此形式标为动词，但未提供可确定其具体含义的释义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma mniżżla bħala verb fl-entrata mogħtija, mingħajr tifsira speċifikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义仅重复该词形；已标为动词，具体意义未说明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-entrata tirrepeti biss il-forma 'dahlu' u tikklassifikaha bħala verb, iżda ma tispjegax xi tfisser.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This entry identifies 'dahlu' as a verb but does not specify what it means.

formal.mt: Il-forma 'dahlu' hija mniżżla bħala verb, iżda l-entrata ma tagħtix it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The form 'dahlu' is listed as a verb, but the entry does not provide its meaning.
formal.zh: “dahlu”这一形式被列为动词，但词条没有提供其含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'dahlu' f'din il-lista? Mark: Il-lista tgħid biss li hu verb; ma tagħtix it-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'dahlu' mean in this list? Mark: The list only says it is a verb; it does not give the meaning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份列表里的“dahlu”是什么意思？马克：列表只说它是动词，没有给出含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这份列表里的“dahlu”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'dahlu' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-lista tgħid biss li hu verb; ma tagħtix it-tifsira.
messages.mt_standard: Il-lista tgħid biss li hu verb; ma tagħtix it-tifsira.
messages.zh: 列表只说它是动词，没有给出含义。
messages.en: The list only says it is a verb; it does not give the meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 dahlu 记为“动词，词义待补”，不要凭相似拼写猜测意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The English language, as named in the supplied vocabulary list.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给词表中表示英语这门语言的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għal-lingwa Ingliża fil-lista ta' kliem mogħtija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英语，即用于英语口语和书面表达的语言。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-lingwa Ingliża, li tintuża fit-taħdit u fil-kitba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: English is the language that people use when they speak or write in English.

formal.mt: Fil-lista ta' kliem mogħtija, "Daighsoe" tirreferi għal-lingwa Ingliża.
formal.en: In the supplied vocabulary list, "Daighsoe" refers to the English language.
formal.zh: 在所给词表中，“Daighsoe”指英语这门语言。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser "Daighsoe" f'din il-lista? Marija: Hawn tfisser "Ingliż", jiġifieri l-lingwa Ingliża.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does "Daighsoe" mean in this list? Marija: Here it means "English", the English language.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这份词表里的“Daighsoe”是什么意思？玛丽娅：这里表示“英语”，也就是英语这门语言。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 这份词表里的“Daighsoe”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does "Daighsoe" mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.zh: 这里表示“英语”，也就是英语这门语言。
messages.en: Here it means "English", the English language.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作双面词卡，正面写 Daighsoe，背面写“英语／English”，按本词表给出的对应关系整体记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Everything that meets a stated condition or belongs to the situation being described.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 符合所述条件或属于所述情境的一切事物，常接后续从句说明范围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħwejjeġ kollha li jissodisfaw kundizzjoni msemmija jew li jagħmlu parti mis-sitwazzjoni deskritta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凡是符合后续说明的事物；所涉及的一切。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kull ħaġa li taqbel ma' dak li jingħad fil-kumplament tas-sentenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Whatever refers to anything or everything that satisfies the condition being described.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom iġibu magħhom dak kollu li għandhom bżonn għall-attività.
formal.en: Participants should bring whatever they need for the activity.
formal.zh: 参与者应携带活动所需的一切物品。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għandi nġib għall-piknik? Luqa: Ġib dak kollu li għandek bżonn biex tiekol; jien inġib ix-xorb.
colloquial.en: Sara: What should I bring for the picnic? Luqa: Bring whatever you need for eating; I'll bring the drinks.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：野餐我该带些什么？卢卡：带上你吃东西需要的一切；饮料我来带。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 野餐我该带些什么？
messages.en: What should I bring for the picnic?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġib dak kollu li għandek bżonn biex tiekol; jien inġib ix-xorb.
messages.mt_standard: Ġib dak kollu li għandek bżonn biex tiekol; jien inġib ix-xorb.
messages.zh: 带上你吃东西需要的一切；饮料我来带。
messages.en: Bring whatever you need for eating; I'll bring the drinks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把所需物品全部装进一个篮子，记住 dak kollu 强调“一切”，再用 li 后面的内容限定范围。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The thing or things that a following clause identifies or describes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由后续从句指明的事物或内容，相当于英语表示“所……的东西”的 what。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħaġa jew il-ħwejjeġ li jiġu identifikati jew deskritti fil-parti tas-sentenza li tiġi wara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所……的事物或内容；后续从句所指的东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħaġa jew il-kontenut li għalih tirreferi l-parti tas-sentenza li ssegwi.
