sense_translations.en_explanation: What can refer to the thing or things that a following clause describes.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi dak li ġara waqt il-laqgħa u jispjega d-deċiżjonijiet meħuda.
formal.en: The report describes what happened during the meeting and explains the decisions made.
formal.zh: 报告描述了会议期间发生的事情，并解释了所作的决定。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fhimt dak li għedt? Adam: Iva, fhimt li għandna niltaqgħu quddiem l-iskola fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you understand what I said? Adam: Yes, I understood that we should meet outside the school at eight.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你听懂我说的话了吗？亚当：听懂了，我们应该八点在学校门口见面。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你听懂我说的话了吗？
messages.en: Did you understand what I said?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fhimt li għandna niltaqgħu quddiem l-iskola fit-tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fhimt li għandna niltaqgħu quddiem l-iskola fit-tmienja.
messages.zh: 听懂了，我们应该八点在学校门口见面。
messages.en: Yes, I understood that we should meet outside the school at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dak li 想成装内容的小框，后面填“说过、看见、发生”，整个词组就是“所说、所见、所发生的事”。

gloss_zh: 这；这个（接在阳性单数名词前）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A demonstrative form attached to a masculine singular noun to indicate this particular person, thing, or time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 连接在阳性单数名词前的指示形式，表示说话人所指的“这”或“这个”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma li tingħaqad ma' nom maskil fis-singular biex tindika persuna, ħaġa jew żmien partikolari qrib il-kelliem jew li jkun qed jirreferi għalih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 这；这个。附在阳性单数名词前，指明当前所说的特定对象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma li titqiegħed magħquda ma' nom maskil fis-singular biex turi li l-kelliem qed jirreferi għal dan l-oġġett, din il-persuna jew dan iż-żmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use dal- before a masculine singular noun when referring to this particular person, thing, or time.

formal.mt: Dal-ktieb joffri introduzzjoni ċara għall-istorja tal-gżira.
formal.en: This book offers a clear introduction to the island's history.
formal.zh: 这本书清楚地介绍了这座岛屿的历史。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn xtrajt dal-ktieb? Mark: Mill-ħanut ħdejn l-iskola. Maja: Nista' nissellef dal-ktieb meta tlestih?
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you buy this book? Mark: From the shop near the school. Maja: Can I borrow this book when you finish it?
colloquial.zh: Maja：这本书你在哪里买的？Mark：学校旁边的书店。Maja：你看完以后，我可以借这本书吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书你在哪里买的？
messages.en: Where did you buy this book?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 学校旁边的书店。
messages.en: From the shop near the school.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看完以后，我可以借这本书吗？
messages.en: Can I borrow this book when you finish it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dal- 想成贴在名词前的“这个”标签：dal-ktieb 就是“这本书”；连字符提醒你把它与后面的名词连起来读。

gloss_zh: 严重且无法弥补的损害

teaching_sense.en_definition: Severe harm or loss that cannot be repaired or put right.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 程度严重，而且无法通过修复、补救或恢复原状来消除的损害。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsara serja li ma tistax tissewwa jew titneħħa billi s-sitwazzjoni terġa' lura għal kif kienet qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严重且不可修复或无法弥补的损害。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħsara ta' gravità kbira li ma jkunx possibbli li tissewwa jew li jiġu rrestawrati l-kundizzjonijiet li kien hemm qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Serious and irreparable damage is severe harm whose effects cannot be repaired or put right.

collocations.zh: 造成严重且无法弥补的损害
防止严重且无法弥补的损害

collocations.en: serious and irreparable damage to the environment
collocations.zh: 对环境造成的严重且无法弥补的损害

formal.mt: In-nar qered dokumenti uniċi u kkawża dannu gravi u irreparabbli lill-arkivju storiku.
formal.en: The fire destroyed unique documents and caused serious and irreparable damage to the historical archive.
formal.zh: 火灾烧毁了独一无二的文献，对历史档案造成了严重且无法弥补的损害。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma nistgħux nidħlu fl-għar? Pawlu: Għax jekk inkissru dawk il-formazzjonijiet, nistgħu nagħmlu dannu gravi u irreparabbli. Lara: Mela aħjar nibqgħu barra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why can't we go into the cave? Pawlu: Because if we break those formations, we could cause serious and irreparable damage. Lara: Then we'd better stay outside.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么我们不能进洞？Pawlu：因为如果弄断那些洞穴沉积物，就可能造成严重且无法修复的损害。Lara：那我们还是待在外面吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 为什么我们不能进洞？
messages.en: Why can't we go into the cave?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jekk inkissru dawk il-formazzjonijiet, nistgħu nagħmlu dannu gravi u irreparabbli.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jekk inkissru dawk il-formazzjonijiet, nistgħu nagħmlu dannu gravi u irreparabbli.
messages.zh: 因为如果弄断那些洞穴沉积物，就可能造成严重且无法修复的损害。
messages.en: Because if we break those formations, we could cause serious and irreparable damage.

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 那我们还是待在外面吧。
messages.en: Then we'd better stay outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“损害＋严重＋而且＋补不回来”四步串起整个短语，想象珍贵原件被烧毁，既损失重大，又无法恢复。

gloss_zh: 一巴掌；打在脸上的一记耳光

teaching_sense.en_definition: A blow delivered with an open hand, especially to someone's face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用张开的手掌打出的一击，尤其指打在别人脸上的一巴掌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqa mogħtija bil-pala tal-id miftuħa, speċjalment fuq wiċċ persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用张开的手掌打出的一巴掌。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Daqqa li tingħata lil xi ħadd bil-pala tal-id miftuħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A slap is a blow that someone gives another person with an open hand.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打在脸上的一巴掌；一记耳光。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Daqqa li tingħata fuq wiċċ persuna bil-pala tal-id miftuħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A slap in the face is a blow delivered to someone's face with an open hand.

formal.mt: Ix-xhud iddeskriva kif ir-raġel ta daqqa ta' ħarta lil persuna oħra waqt l-argument.
formal.en: The witness described how the man slapped another person during the argument.
formal.zh: 证人描述了那名男子如何在争吵中打了另一个人一巴掌。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara fil-bitħa? Ben: Tifel ta daqqa ta' ħarta lil sieħbu. Sara: Ejja ngħidu lill-għalliema biex tgħinhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened in the playground? Ben: A boy slapped his friend. Sara: Let's tell the teacher so she can help them.
colloquial.zh: Sara：操场上发生什么事了？Ben：一个男孩打了他的朋友一巴掌。Sara：我们去告诉老师，让她帮帮他们。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 操场上发生什么事了？
messages.en: What happened in the playground?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tifel ta daqqa ta' ħarta lil sieħbu.
messages.mt_standard: Tifel ta daqqa ta' ħarta lil sieħbu.
messages.zh: 一个男孩打了他的朋友一巴掌。
messages.en: A boy slapped his friend.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 我们去告诉老师，让她帮帮他们。
messages.en: Let's tell the teacher so she can help them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语记成“啪的一巴掌”，再用动作方向区分搭配：jagħti 是打出去，jaqla' 是自己挨到。

gloss_zh: 合约名义规模；合约名义价值

teaching_sense.en_definition: The reference quantity or value assigned to a contract for calculating the amounts associated with it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为合约设定、用来计算相关金额的参考数量或参考价值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwantità jew il-valur ta' referenza assenjat lil kuntratt biex jiġu kkalkulati l-ammonti marbuta miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合约名义规模，即合约规定的、作为计算依据的标的参考数量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwantità ta' referenza tal-assi sottostanti speċifikata fil-kuntratt u użata bħala bażi għall-kalkoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The notional contract size is the reference quantity of the underlying asset used in calculations for a contract.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合约名义价值，即合约规定的、作为相关金额计算依据的参考货币金额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ammont monetarju ta' referenza speċifikat fil-kuntratt u użat bħala bażi biex jiġu kkalkulati l-ammonti marbuta miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The notional contract value is the reference monetary amount used to calculate amounts associated with a contract.

collocations.en: the notional contract value expressed in euros
collocations.zh: 以欧元表示的合约名义价值

formal.mt: Ir-rapport għandu jispeċifika d-daqs nozzjonali tal-kuntratt u jindika jekk dan huwiex espress bħala kwantità ta' assi jew bħala ammont monetarju.
formal.en: The report must specify the notional contract size and indicate whether it is expressed as a quantity of assets or as a monetary amount.
formal.zh: 报告必须注明合约名义规模，并说明它是以资产数量还是以货币金额表示。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn insib id-daqs nozzjonali tal-kuntratt? Pawlu: Fl-ewwel tabella; hawnhekk huwa espress f'euro. Marta: Mela hawn qed nitkellmu dwar il-valur ta' referenza.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where can I find the notional contract size? Pawlu: In the first table; here it is expressed in euros. Marta: So here we are talking about the reference value.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：在哪里能找到合约名义规模？保罗：第一张表里；这里用欧元表示。玛尔塔：那么这里说的就是参考价值。

messages.speaker: Marta (实习生)
messages.zh: 在哪里能找到合约名义规模？
messages.en: Where can I find the notional contract size?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (分析员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-ewwel tabella; hawnhekk huwa espress f'euro.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-ewwel tabella; hawnhekk huwa espress f'euro.
messages.zh: 第一张表里；这里用欧元表示。
messages.en: In the first table; here it is expressed in euros.

messages.speaker: Marta (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela hawn qed nitkellmu dwar il-valur ta' referenza.
messages.mt_standard: Mela hawn qed nitkellmu dwar il-valur ta' referenza.
messages.zh: 那么这里说的就是参考价值。
messages.en: So here we are talking about the reference value.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词放进合约表格来记：先看参考规模，再看单位；单位是资产数量时理解为名义规模，单位是货币时理解为名义价值。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to indicate a particular degree, amount, or extent, often meaning so or that much.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示语境所指的程度、数量或范围，相当于“这么”“那么”或“到这种程度”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tindika grad, ammont jew firxa partikolari skont il-kuntest, bħal meta xi ħaġa tkun qasira jew importanti sa dak il-punt.

sense_translations.en_definition: such, so; exemples: daqsekk important - so high, such a big; daqsekk qasir - so short, such a brief;
sense_translations.zh_definition: 这么；那么；如此。用于指出程度，例如 daqsekk importanti 表示“这么重要”，daqsekk qasir 表示“这么短”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li turi li kwalità jew kwantità tilħaq grad jew ammont partikolari, kif f'xi ħaġa li tkun daqsekk importanti jew daqsekk qasira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use daqsekk to indicate that something has a quality or quantity to the degree being discussed.

formal.mt: Proġett daqsekk importanti jeħtieġ ippjanar bir-reqqa u riżorsi adegwati.
formal.en: A project this important requires careful planning and adequate resources.
formal.zh: 如此重要的项目需要周密的规划和充足的资源。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-filmat daqsekk qasir? Mark: Għax irridu nuru biss l-idea prinċipali. Maja: Issa fhimt għaliex huwa daqsekk qasir.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the video so short? Mark: Because we only want to show the main idea. Maja: Now I understand why it is so short.
colloquial.zh: Maja：视频为什么这么短？Mark：因为我们只想呈现主要想法。Maja：现在我明白它为什么这么短了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 视频为什么这么短？
messages.en: Why is the video so short?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax irridu nuru biss l-idea prinċipali.
messages.mt_standard: Għax irridu nuru biss l-idea prinċipali.
messages.zh: 因为我们只想呈现主要想法。
messages.en: Because we only want to show the main idea.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa fhimt għaliex huwa daqsekk qasir.
messages.mt_standard: Issa fhimt għaliex huwa daqsekk qasir.
messages.zh: 现在我明白它为什么这么短了。
messages.en: Now I understand why it is so short.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 daqsekk 想成手势比出的“这么个程度”：后接 qasir 就是“这么短”，后接 importanti 就是“这么重要”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word indicating that something will happen after a short time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某件事将在很短的时间之后发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tindika li xi ħaġa se sseħħ wara ftit ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不久；很快，表示距离某事发生只剩较短的时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Wara ftit ħin, mingħajr ma jgħaddi żmien twil qabel ma sseħħ xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something will happen soon, it will happen after only a short time.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa daqt tibda; jekk jogħġobkom, ħudu postkom.
formal.en: The meeting will begin soon; please take your seats.
formal.zh: 会议即将开始，请各位就座。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn wasalt? Mark: Daqt nasal, għadni fuq il-karozza tal-linja. Lara: Sewwa, nistenniek ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: How far have you got? Mark: I will be there soon; I am still on the bus. Lara: All right, I will wait for you by the door.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你到哪儿了？马克：我很快就到，还在公交车上。拉拉：好，我在门边等你。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你到哪儿了？
messages.en: How far have you got?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Daqt nasal, għadni fuq il-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Daqt nasal, għadni fuq il-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 我很快就到，还在公交车上。
messages.en: I will be there soon; I am still on the bus.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我在门边等你。
messages.en: All right, I will wait for you by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友发来“很快就到”的消息，把 daqt 和短短的等待时间联系起来，再用 daqt nasal 整句记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small pointed object thrown by hand at a target, especially in a game.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手投向靶子的带尖小物体，尤指飞镖游戏中使用的飞镖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir bil-ponta li jintefa' bl-id lejn mira, speċjalment f'logħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 飞镖，指用手掷向镖靶的带尖小型投掷物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir b'ponta li plejer jitfa' bl-id lejn bord b'mira biex jipprova jikseb punti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dart is a small pointed object that you throw at a target to score points in a game.

collocations.en: a dart in the centre of the target

formal.mt: Il-plejer tefa' dart lejn il-bord u laqat iċ-ċentru tal-mira.
formal.en: The player threw a dart at the board and hit the centre of the target.
formal.zh: 选手向镖靶投出一支飞镖，击中了靶心。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tini dart, jekk jogħġbok. David: Hawn wieħed. Immira lejn iċ-ċentru. Nina: Tajjeb, ħa nipprova.
colloquial.en: Nina: Pass me a dart, please. David: Here is one. Aim for the centre. Nina: All right, let me try.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：请递给我一支飞镖。戴维：给你一支。瞄准靶心。妮娜：好，让我试试。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 请递给我一支飞镖。
messages.en: Pass me a dart, please.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 给你一支。瞄准靶心。
messages.en: Here is one. Aim for the centre.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，让我试试。
messages.en: All right, let me try.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dart 配上一支带尖飞镖的画面，再做一次瞄准投掷的动作；这里记住的是手里的飞镖物件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Data describing the frequency of a signal at particular instants in time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述信号在各个具体时刻所具有的频率的数据。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Data li tiddeskrivi l-frekwenza ta' sinjal f'waqtiet speċifiċi fiż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瞬时频率数据，即记录或表示信号在各个特定时刻的频率的数据。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Data li tirreġistra jew tirrappreżenta l-frekwenza ta' sinjal f'kull waqt speċifiku li jkun qed jiġi analizzat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Instantaneous frequency data describes the frequency of a signal at individual moments during the period being analysed.

collocations.en: a graph of the instantaneous frequency data

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkaturi analizzaw id-data istantanja tal-frekwenza biex jiddeskrivu kif il-frekwenza tas-sinjal inbidlet matul ir-reġistrazzjoni.
formal.en: The researchers analysed the instantaneous frequency data to describe how the signal's frequency changed during the recording.
formal.zh: 研究人员分析了瞬时频率数据，以描述信号频率在记录期间如何变化。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'turi din il-graff? Daniel: Turi d-data istantanja tal-frekwenza tas-sinjal. Sara: Mela nistgħu naraw kif tinbidel il-frekwenza minn waqt għal ieħor.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does this graph show? Daniel: It shows the signal's instantaneous frequency data. Sara: So we can see how the frequency changes from one moment to the next.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张图显示什么？丹尼尔：显示信号的瞬时频率数据。萨拉：那么我们就能看到频率如何随时刻变化。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这张图显示什么？
messages.en: What does this graph show?

messages.speaker: Daniel (实验室助教)
messages.zh: 显示信号的瞬时频率数据。
messages.en: It shows the signal's instantaneous frequency data.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nistgħu naraw kif tinbidel il-frekwenza minn waqt għal ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nistgħu naraw kif tinbidel il-frekwenza minn waqt għal ieħor.
messages.zh: 那么我们就能看到频率如何随时刻变化。
messages.en: So we can see how the frequency changes from one moment to the next.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把信号变化逐帧定格，每个时刻都标出一个频率值；把这些数值连起来，就能记住“瞬时频率数据”。

gloss_zh: 投标文件提交截止日期；收标期限

teaching_sense.en_definition: The final date by which tender documents must be submitted or received.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 投标文件必须提交或由招标方收到的最后日期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-aħħar data li fiha għandhom jiġu ppreżentati jew jaslu d-dokumenti tal-offerti.

sense_translations.en_definition: closing date for submission of tenders
sense_translations.zh_definition: 提交投标文件的截止日期。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-data finali sa meta għandhom jiġu ppreżentati l-offerti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The closing date for submission of tenders is the final date on which bidders may submit their tender documents.

sense_translations.en_definition: time limit for the receipt of tenders
sense_translations.zh_definition: 招标方接收投标文件的最后期限。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-limitu taż-żmien sa meta l-offerti għandhom jaslu għand min qed jirċevihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The time limit for the receipt of tenders specifies when tender documents must have reached the receiving organization.

sense_translations.en_definition: time limit for the submission of tenders
sense_translations.zh_definition: 投标人提交投标文件的最后期限。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-limitu taż-żmien li fih l-offerenti għandhom jippreżentaw l-offerti tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The time limit for the submission of tenders specifies how long bidders have to submit their tender documents.

collocations.mt: tiġi estiża d-data tal-għeluq għall-preżentazzjoni tal-offerti
collocations.en: the closing date for submission of tenders is extended
collocations.zh: 投标文件提交截止日期获延长

collocations.en: before the closing date for submission of tenders
collocations.zh: 在投标文件提交截止日期之前

formal.mt: Id-data tal-għeluq għall-preżentazzjoni tal-offerti hija l-15 ta' Mejju f'nofsinhar; l-offerti għandhom jaslu għand l-awtorità sa dak il-ħin.
formal.en: The closing date for submission of tenders is 15 May at noon; tenders must reach the authority by that time.
formal.zh: 投标文件提交截止时间为5月15日中午；投标文件必须在该时间之前送达主管机构。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Taf meta hi d-data tal-għeluq għall-preżentazzjoni tal-offerti? Pawlu: Iva, nhar il-Ġimgħa f'nofsinhar. Ejja nibagħtu l-offerta llum.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you know when the closing date for submission of tenders is? Pawlu: Yes, Friday at noon. Let's send our tender today.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你知道投标文件提交截止时间是什么时候吗？Pawlu：知道，星期五中午。我们今天就把投标文件发出去吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (项目助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf meta hi d-data tal-għeluq għall-preżentazzjoni tal-offerti?
messages.mt_standard: Taf meta hi d-data tal-għeluq għall-preżentazzjoni tal-offerti?
messages.zh: 你知道投标文件提交截止时间是什么时候吗？
messages.en: Do you know when the closing date for submission of tenders is?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nhar il-Ġimgħa f'nofsinhar. Ejja nibagħtu l-offerta llum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nhar il-Ġimgħa f'nofsinhar. Ejja nibagħtu l-offerta llum.
messages.zh: 知道，星期五中午。我们今天就把投标文件发出去吧。
messages.en: Yes, Friday at noon. Let's send our tender today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组分成三段记：data是日期，tal-għeluq提示截止，għall-preżentazzjoni tal-offerti说明用于提交投标文件；联想日历上标出的最后交标日。

gloss_zh: 投标截止日期；收标期限

teaching_sense.en_definition: The final date for submitting or receiving documents for a tender.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某项招标中提交或接收投标文件的最后日期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-aħħar data li fiha jistgħu jiġu ppreżentati jew riċevuti d-dokumenti relatati ma' offerta.

sense_translations.en_definition: closing date for submission of tenders
sense_translations.zh_definition: 提交投标文件的截止日期。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-data li timmarka l-aħħar jum għall-preżentazzjoni tal-offerti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The closing date for submission of tenders tells bidders the last date on which they may submit their documents.

sense_translations.en_definition: time limit for the receipt of tenders
sense_translations.zh_definition: 招标方必须收到投标文件的最后期限。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-limitu taż-żmien sa meta min qed jirċievi l-offerti għandu jkun irċeviehom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The time limit for the receipt of tenders is the deadline by which the receiving organization must have the documents.

sense_translations.en_definition: time limit for the submission of tenders
sense_translations.zh_definition: 投标人必须完成投标文件提交的最后期限。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-limitu taż-żmien sa meta l-offerenti jridu jkunu ppreżentaw l-offerti tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The time limit for the submission of tenders is the deadline by which bidders must complete their submissions.

formal.mt: Id-data tal-għeluq tal-offerta ġiet posposta għall-20 ta' Ġunju, u l-offerenti ġew infurmati bil-bidla.
formal.en: The tender closing date has been postponed to 20 June, and bidders have been informed of the change.
formal.zh: 投标截止日期已推迟至6月20日，各投标人均已获知这一变更。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Id-data tal-għeluq tal-offerta għadha għada? Mark: Le, bidluha għat-Tnejn. Għandna ftit aktar ħin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the tender closing date still tomorrow? Mark: No, they changed it to Monday. We have a little more time.
colloquial.zh: Lara：投标截止日期还是明天吗？Mark：不是，改到星期一了。我们多了一点时间。

messages.speaker: Lara (投标助理)
messages.zh: 投标截止日期还是明天吗？
messages.en: Is the tender closing date still tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (投标同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, bidluha għat-Tnejn. Għandna ftit aktar ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, bidluha għat-Tnejn. Għandna ftit aktar ħin.
messages.zh: 不是，改到星期一了。我们多了一点时间。
messages.en: No, they changed it to Monday. We have a little more time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想投标日历上的红圈：先用data tal-għeluq记住截止日期，再用tal-offerta锁定投标事项；看到整组词就想到最后交标日。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The light that comes from the sun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 太阳发出的光，可照亮环境并供植物生长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dawl li ġej mix-xemx u li jdawwal l-ambjent ta' madwarna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 太阳照射出来的光；阳光。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dawl naturali li jasal mix-xemx u jdawwal l-art u l-affarijiet ta' madwarna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sunlight is the natural light that comes from the sun and illuminates the world around us.

formal.mt: Il-pjanti f'dan il-ġnien jirċievu dawl ix-xemx għal diversi sigħat kuljum.
formal.en: The plants in this garden receive sunlight for several hours each day.
formal.zh: 这座花园里的植物每天都能接受数小时的阳光照射。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex poġġejt il-pjanta ħdejn it-tieqa? Ben: Għax hemmhekk tieħu aktar dawl ix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did you put the plant by the window? Ben: Because it gets more sunlight there.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你为什么把植物放在窗边？Ben：因为它在那里能晒到更多阳光。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把植物放在窗边？
messages.en: Why did you put the plant by the window?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hemmhekk tieħu aktar dawl ix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hemmhekk tieħu aktar dawl ix-xemx.
messages.zh: 因为它在那里能晒到更多阳光。
messages.en: Because it gets more sunlight there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用窗边植物晒太阳的画面记忆：dawl对应光，xemx对应太阳，合起来把dawl ix-xemx整组记成阳光。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bright light that dazzles the eyes and makes it difficult to see clearly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使眼睛感到刺眼、妨碍清晰视物的强光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawl qawwi li jgħammex l-għajnejn u jagħmilha diffiċli biex wieħed jara ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人目眩、难以看清物体的刺眼强光。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dawl tant qawwi li jdejjaq l-għajnejn u jfixkel il-vista.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Glare is very bright light that dazzles your eyes and makes things difficult to see clearly.

formal.mt: L-iskrin għandu jitqiegħed b'mod li jiġi evitat dawl jgħammex rifless mit-tieqa.
formal.en: The screen should be positioned to avoid glare reflected from the window.
formal.zh: 屏幕应妥善摆放，以避免窗户反射的眩光。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tbaxxi ftit il-persjana? Hemm dawl jgħammex u ma nistax nara l-iskrin sew. Daniel: Żgur, inbaxxiha issa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you lower the blind a little? There's glare, and I can't see the screen properly. Daniel: Of course, I'll lower it now.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你能把百叶帘放低一点吗？光太刺眼，我看不清屏幕。Daniel：当然，我现在就放低。

messages.speaker: Sara (办公室同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tbaxxi ftit il-persjana? Hemm dawl jgħammex u ma nistax nara l-iskrin sew.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tbaxxi ftit il-persjana? Hemm dawl jgħammex u ma nistax nara l-iskrin sew.
messages.zh: 你能把百叶帘放低一点吗？光太刺眼，我看不清屏幕。
messages.en: Can you lower the blind a little? There's glare, and I can't see the screen properly.

messages.speaker: Daniel (办公室同事)
messages.zh: 当然，我现在就放低。
messages.en: Of course, I'll lower it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象强光照来时眯眼挡光：dawl记作光，jgħammex联系使人目眩的效果，把整组词与看不清屏幕的刺眼感绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Decorative lights used during the Christmas season in homes, streets, and public places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圣诞节期间用于装饰住宅、街道及公共场所的灯光或彩灯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dwal li jintużaw biex iżejnu d-djar, it-toroq u l-postijiet pubbliċi fi żmien il-Milied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣诞节期间用作装饰的彩灯或灯饰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dwal dekorattivi li jinxtegħlu fid-djar, fit-toroq jew f'postijiet oħra matul iż-żmien tal-Milied.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Christmas lights are decorative lights that people display during the Christmas season.

collocations.en: decorate the street with Christmas lights

formal.mt: Il-kunsill lokali ħabbar li d-dawl tal-Milied se jinxtegħel fil-pjazza nhar il-Ġimgħa filgħaxija.
formal.en: The local council announced that the Christmas lights would be switched on in the square on Friday evening.
formal.zh: 地方议会宣布，广场上的圣诞彩灯将于星期五晚上点亮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nixgħelu d-dawl tal-Milied issa? Toni: Iva, ħa nara kif jidher mit-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we switch on the Christmas lights now? Toni: Yes, let me see how they look from the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们现在把圣诞彩灯打开好吗？托尼：好，让我从窗边看看效果。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们现在把圣诞彩灯打开好吗？
messages.en: Shall we switch on the Christmas lights now?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħa nara kif jidher mit-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħa nara kif jidher mit-tieqa.
messages.zh: 好，让我从窗边看看效果。
messages.en: Yes, let me see how they look from the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和广场点亮圣诞彩灯的画面一起记，再搭配“打开彩灯”和“装饰街道”两个动作复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A demonstrative used to refer to more than one person or thing near the speaker or currently being indicated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于指称靠近说话者或正在被指示的多个人或多个事物，相当于“这些”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex tindika aktar minn persuna waħda jew ħaġa waħda li jkunu qrib min jitkellem jew li jkun qed jirreferi għalihom.

sense_translations.en_definition: these (proximal demonstrative referring to a plurality of people or things)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 这些，指靠近说话者或当前正在被指示的多个人或多个事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li tindika grupp ta' persuni jew affarijiet qrib min jitkellem, jew dawk li jkun qed juri jew isemmi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use these to refer to two or more people or things near you or being indicated.

formal.mt: Dawn id-dokumenti għandhom jintbagħtu lill-uffiċċju qabel tmiem il-ġimgħa.
formal.en: These documents must be sent to the office before the end of the week.
formal.zh: 这些文件必须在本周结束前送交办公室。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dawn il-kotba tiegħek? Mark: Iva, tista' tħallihom fuq il-mejda, jekk jogħġbok?
colloquial.en: Sara: Are these books yours? Mark: Yes, could you leave them on the table, please?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些书是你的吗？马克：是的，麻烦你把它们放在桌上，好吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 这些书是你的吗？
messages.en: Are these books yours?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' tħallihom fuq il-mejda, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' tħallihom fuq il-mejda, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 是的，麻烦你把它们放在桌上，好吗？
messages.en: Yes, could you leave them on the table, please?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己指着面前的几本书说 dawn：近处加复数就是“这些”，再换成几个人练习同一种指示。

gloss_zh: 侵吞；侵占受托管理的款项或财产

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dishonestly take for personal use money or property that has been entrusted to one's care.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用受托保管或管理财物的机会，以欺诈手段将其据为己有。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu għalih b'mod qarrieqi flus jew proprjetà li jkunu ġew fdati lilu biex jieħu ħsiebhom jew jamministrahom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 侵吞或侵占自己受托保管、管理的金钱或财产。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Japproprja għalih innifsu b'mod diżonest flus jew beni li jkunu ġew fdati f'idejh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone embezzles money or property, they dishonestly take assets that they were trusted to manage.

collocations.zh: 侵吞交由他管理的资金

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-awditjar sab li l-maniġer dawwar b'ingann parti mill-fondi li kienu fdati f'idejh.
formal.en: The audit report found that the manager had embezzled some of the funds entrusted to him.
formal.zh: 审计报告发现，该经理侵吞了部分交由他管理的资金。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex keċċew lit-teżorier tal-klabb? Pawlu: Għax dawwar b'ingann flus il-klabb u użahom għalih.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did they dismiss the club's treasurer? Pawlu: Because he embezzled the club's money and used it for himself.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他们为什么撤掉俱乐部的财务主管？保罗：因为他侵吞了俱乐部的钱，拿去给自己用了。

messages.speaker: Lara (俱乐部成员)
messages.zh: 他们为什么撤掉俱乐部的财务主管？
messages.en: Why did they dismiss the club's treasurer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (俱乐部成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dawwar b'ingann flus il-klabb u użahom għalih.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dawwar b'ingann flus il-klabb u użahom għalih.
messages.zh: 因为他侵吞了俱乐部的钱，拿去给自己用了。
messages.en: Because he embezzled the club's money and used it for himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“受托管钱却偷偷据为己有”的场景记住整个短语；抓住“受托管理”和“侵吞”两个要点，避免只记成普通偷窃。

gloss_zh: 哄劝；用温柔的话或讨好的方式劝动

teaching_sense.en_definition: To persuade someone to do something through gentle encouragement, affectionate words, or flattery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过温和鼓励、亲切言语或讨好的方式，使某人愿意做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipperswadi lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa permezz ta' kliem ħelu, inkoraġġiment ġentili jew tifħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用温柔的话、耐心鼓励或讨好的方式哄劝某人做某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iħajjar lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa billi jkellmu bil-ħlewwa, jinkoraġġih bil-mod jew ifaħħru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you coax someone into doing something, you persuade them with gentle encouragement or pleasing words.

collocations.mt: dawwar biż-żegħil lil ħabibu biex jingħaqad magħhom
collocations.en: coax his friend into joining them

formal.mt: L-għalliem dawwar biż-żegħil lill-istudent biex jaqra l-ewwel sentenza quddiem il-klassi.
formal.en: The teacher coaxed the student into reading the first sentence in front of the class.
formal.zh: 老师温和地哄劝那名学生，让他在全班面前读出第一句话。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif irnexxielek iġġiegħel lil Ben jiġi magħna? Rita: Dawwartu biż-żegħil; għedtlu li mingħajru ma kienx se jkun l-istess.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did you manage to get Ben to come with us? Rita: I coaxed him; I told him it wouldn't be the same without him.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你怎么说动本跟我们一起来的？丽塔：我哄了哄他，说少了他就没那个味道了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irnexxielek iġġiegħel lil Ben jiġi magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irnexxielek iġġiegħel lil Ben jiġi magħna?
messages.zh: 你怎么说动本跟我们一起来的？
messages.en: How did you manage to get Ben to come with us?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawwartu biż-żegħil; għedtlu li mingħajru ma kienx se jkun l-istess.
messages.mt_standard: Dawwartu biż-żegħil; għedtlu li mingħajru ma kienx se jkun l-istess.
messages.zh: 我哄了哄他，说少了他就没那个味道了。
messages.en: I coaxed him; I told him it wouldn't be the same without him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友起初不愿参加，你用“少了你就不一样”这样的贴心话慢慢说动他，把整个短语记作“温柔哄劝”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: a tax charged on goods, such as customs duty or excise
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对货物征收的税，具体可指关税或针对特定商品征收的消费税。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taxxa imposta fuq oġġetti, li tista' tkun dazju doganali jew taxxa tas-sisa fuq prodotti speċifiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关税：货物进出口时由海关征收的税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taxxa li tinġabar mid-dwana fuq oġġetti meta jiġu importati jew esportati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Customs duty is a tax collected on goods when they are imported or exported.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消费税：对特定类别商品的生产、销售或消费征收的税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taxxa tas-sisa imposta fuq il-produzzjoni, il-bejgħ jew il-konsum ta' kategoriji speċifiċi ta' prodotti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Excise is a tax charged on the production, sale, or consumption of particular types of goods.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, id-dazju doganali fuq l-importazzjonijiet huwa elenkat separatament mid-dazju tas-sisa fuq prodotti speċifiċi.
formal.en: In the report, customs duty on imports is listed separately from excise duty on specific products.
formal.zh: 报告将进口关税与针对特定产品征收的消费税分开列示。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-kont għal dan il-pakkett huwa ogħla milli stennejt? Mark: Għax hemm ukoll dazju fuq l-oġġetti importati.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the bill for this parcel higher than I expected? Mark: Because there is also duty on the imported goods.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个包裹的账单怎么比我预想的高？Mark：因为这些进口商品还要缴关税。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kont għal dan il-pakkett huwa ogħla milli stennejt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kont għal dan il-pakkett huwa ogħla milli stennejt?
messages.zh: 这个包裹的账单怎么比我预想的高？
messages.en: Why is the bill for this parcel higher than I expected?

messages.speaker: Mark (客服人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hemm ukoll dazju fuq l-oġġetti importati.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hemm ukoll dazju fuq l-oġġetti importati.
messages.zh: 因为这些进口商品还要缴关税。
messages.en: Because there is also duty on the imported goods.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dazju 想成商品账单上的“税”一栏：跨境情境联想关税，特定商品征税情境联想消费税，靠上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: a duty imposed on dumped imports to counter harm to domestic producers
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对以低于正常价值的价格进口并损害本国产业的商品征收的税。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dazju impost fuq prodotti importati bi prezz inqas mill-valur normali tagħhom biex tiġi miġġielda l-ħsara lill-industrija domestika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反倾销税：为抵消进口商品以低于正常价值的价格销售而对本国产业造成的损害所征收的税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dazju fuq importazzjonijiet mibjugħa bi prezz inqas mill-valur normali tagħhom, maħsub biex ipatti għall-ħsara li dan jikkawża lill-industrija domestika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An anti-dumping duty is a tax imposed on dumped imports to counter the harm they cause to domestic industry.

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tar-rapport, l-awtorità imponiet dazju antidumping wara li l-investigazzjoni sabet dumping li kkawża ħsara lill-industrija domestika.
formal.en: In the report's example, the authority imposed an anti-dumping duty after the investigation found dumping that caused harm to domestic industry.
formal.zh: 在报告所举的例子中，调查发现倾销行为损害了本国产业，主管机关随后征收了反倾销税。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan id-dazju antidumping jgħodd għall-prodotti kollha li nimportaw? Pawlu: Le, irridu niċċekkjaw liema prodotti jkopri.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this anti-dumping duty apply to all the products we import? Pawlu: No, we need to check which products it covers.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这项反倾销税适用于我们进口的所有产品吗？Pawlu：不，我们得查清楚它涵盖哪些产品。

messages.speaker: Nina (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-dazju antidumping jgħodd għall-prodotti kollha li nimportaw?
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-dazju antidumping jgħodd għall-prodotti kollha li nimportaw?
messages.zh: 这项反倾销税适用于我们进口的所有产品吗？
messages.en: Does this anti-dumping duty apply to all the products we import?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (进口业务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, irridu niċċekkjaw liema prodotti jkopri.
messages.mt_standard: Le, irridu niċċekkjaw liema prodotti jkopri.
messages.zh: 不，我们得查清楚它涵盖哪些产品。
messages.en: No, we need to check which products it covers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“低于正常价值销售—产业受损—反倾销税”这条情境链记忆整个词组，并把 dazju 对应到其中的“税”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: a customs duty set independently rather than through a negotiated trade agreement
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由征税方自主制定，而非通过贸易协定谈判确定的关税。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dazju doganali stabbilit b'mod indipendenti mill-awtorità li timponih, aktar milli permezz ta' ftehim kummerċjali nnegozjat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自主关税：征税方单方面自主确定，而非依据与其他贸易方谈判达成的协定确定的关税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dazju doganali li l-awtorità tistabbilixxi minn jeddha, mingħajr ma r-rata tkun ġiet innegozjata fi ftehim ma' sħab kummerċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An autonomous duty is a customs tax set independently by the imposing authority rather than negotiated in a trade agreement.

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju didattiku, l-awtorità stabbiliet dazju awtonomu fuq il-prodott mingħajr ma nnegozjat ir-rata fi ftehim kummerċjali.
formal.en: In the teaching example, the authority set an autonomous duty on the product without negotiating the rate in a trade agreement.
formal.zh: 在这个教学例子中，主管机关自主确定了该产品的关税，并未通过贸易协定谈判确定税率。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ifisser dazju awtonomu f'dan it-test? David: Ifisser li l-awtorità tistabbilixxih minn jeddha, mingħajr ma tinnegozjah fi ftehim kummerċjali.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does autonomous duty mean in this text? David: It means the authority sets it independently, without negotiating it in a trade agreement.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这篇文章里的自主关税是什么意思？David：意思是主管机关自行确定这项关税，不通过贸易协定谈判确定。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的自主关税是什么意思？
messages.en: What does autonomous duty mean in this text?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-awtorità tistabbilixxih minn jeddha, mingħajr ma tinnegozjah fi ftehim kummerċjali.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-awtorità tistabbilixxih minn jeddha, mingħajr ma tinnegozjah fi ftehim kummerċjali.
messages.zh: 意思是主管机关自行确定这项关税，不通过贸易协定谈判确定。
messages.en: It means the authority sets it independently, without negotiating it in a trade agreement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组贴在“自行制定税率”的想象文件夹上：记忆重点是关税由征税方自主确定，看到词组就问“谁来定税率”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tax charged on goods when they pass through customs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物通过海关时按规定征收的税。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Huwa taxxa imposta fuq merkanzija meta din tgħaddi mid-dwana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对通过海关的货物征收的关税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa dazju li jiġi impost fuq merkanzija meta din tgħaddi mid-dwana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Customs duty is a tax that is charged on goods when they pass through customs.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika l-valur tal-merkanzija u l-ammont tad-dazju doganali mħallas.
formal.en: The report states the value of the goods and the amount of customs duty paid.
formal.zh: 报告列明了货物价值和已缴纳的关税金额。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan l-ammont jinkludi d-dazju doganali? Mark: Le, id-dazju doganali jidher separatament fuq il-kont.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does this amount include the customs duty? Mark: No, the customs duty is shown separately on the bill.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个金额包括关税吗？马克：不包括，关税在账单上单独列出。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个金额包括关税吗？
messages.en: Does this amount include the customs duty?

messages.speaker: Mark (货运代理)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, id-dazju doganali jidher separatament fuq il-kont.
messages.mt_standard: Le, id-dazju doganali jidher separatament fuq il-kont.
messages.zh: 不包括，关税在账单上单独列出。
messages.en: No, the customs duty is shown separately on the bill.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组和“货物过海关、账单列关税”的画面一起记，再用“缴纳关税”和“关税税率”两个搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs duty established under a trade agreement between countries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据国家之间的贸易协定确定的关税。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Huwa dazju doganali stabbilit skont ftehim kummerċjali bejn pajjiżi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依据国家之间的贸易协定确定的协定关税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa dazju li r-rata tiegħu tkun stabbilita skont ftehim kummerċjali bejn pajjiżi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A conventional duty is a customs duty whose rate is established under a trade agreement between countries.

formal.mt: It-tabella turi r-rata tad-dazju konvenzjonali stabbilita fil-ftehim kummerċjali.
formal.en: The table shows the conventional duty rate established in the trade agreement.
formal.zh: 表格列出了贸易协定中确定的协定关税税率。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn insib ir-rata tad-dazju konvenzjonali? Pawlu: Fit-tabella mehmuża mal-ftehim; ejja narawha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where can I find the conventional duty rate? Pawlu: In the table attached to the agreement; let's look at it together.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：在哪里可以找到协定关税税率？保罗：在协定所附的表格里；我们一起看看吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (实习生)
messages.zh: 在哪里可以找到协定关税税率？
messages.en: Where can I find the conventional duty rate?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fit-tabella mehmuża mal-ftehim; ejja narawha flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Fit-tabella mehmuża mal-ftehim; ejja narawha flimkien.
messages.zh: 在协定所附的表格里；我们一起看看吧。
messages.en: In the table attached to the agreement; let's look at it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份贸易协定旁边放着税率表，把整个词组记成“协定里定下的关税”；这里的 conventional 应理解为“协定的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A temporary duty on imported goods intended to offset subsidies while a countervailing investigation is still in progress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在反补贴调查尚未结束时，为抵消补贴影响而对进口货物暂时征收的税。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Huwa dazju impost temporanjament fuq merkanzija importata biex jikkumpensa għall-effett tas-sussidji waqt li tkun għadha għaddejja investigazzjoni dwarhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反补贴调查期间，为抵消补贴影响而对进口货物暂时征收的临时反补贴税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa dazju temporanju fuq merkanzija importata li għandu l-għan li jikkumpensa għall-effett tas-sussidji qabel ma tintemm l-investigazzjoni dwarhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A provisional countervailing duty is a temporary tax on imported goods that is intended to offset subsidies while an investigation continues.

collocations.en: the imposition of a provisional countervailing duty

formal.mt: L-avviż jispeċifika l-prodotti soġġetti għad-dazju kumpensatorju provviżorju u d-data minn meta japplika.
formal.en: The notice specifies the products subject to the provisional countervailing duty and the date from which it applies.
formal.zh: 公告明确列出了适用临时反补贴税的产品及其起始适用日期。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan id-dazju kumpensatorju provviżorju huwa miżura temporanja? David: Iva, qed jiġi applikat waqt li l-investigazzjoni għadha għaddejja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this provisional countervailing duty a temporary measure? David: Yes, it is being applied while the investigation is still in progress.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这项临时反补贴税是一项临时措施吗？戴维：是的，目前调查还在进行，所以正在适用这项措施。

messages.speaker: Lara (进口商)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-dazju kumpensatorju provviżorju huwa miżura temporanja?
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-dazju kumpensatorju provviżorju huwa miżura temporanja?
messages.zh: 这项临时反补贴税是一项临时措施吗？
messages.en: Is this provisional countervailing duty a temporary measure?

messages.speaker: David (贸易顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed jiġi applikat waqt li l-investigazzjoni għadha għaddejja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed jiġi applikat waqt li l-investigazzjoni għadha għaddejja.
messages.zh: 是的，目前调查还在进行，所以正在适用这项措施。
messages.en: Yes, it is being applied while the investigation is still in progress.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按词序记三个信息块：dazju 是“税”，kumpensatorju 在这里表示“反补贴”，provviżorju 表示“临时”；连起来就是临时反补贴税。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tax charged on goods when they are exported from a country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物从一个国家出口时征收的税。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Huwa taxxa imposta fuq merkanzija meta din tiġi esportata minn pajjiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在货物出口时征收的税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa dazju li jiġi impost meta merkanzija tiġi esportata minn pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A duty on exportation is a tax charged when goods are sent out of a country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对出口货物征收的税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa dazju impost fuq oġġetti jew prodotti li jiġu esportati minn pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A duty on exports is a tax that applies to goods being exported from a country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出口税，即对运往国外的货物征收的关税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa dazju doganali fuq merkanzija li tintbagħat minn pajjiż lejn pajjiż ieħor għall-esportazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An export duty is a customs tax charged on goods leaving a country for another country.

formal.mt: Il-kalkolu tal-ispiża totali jinkludi t-trasport u d-dazju tal-esportazzjoni.
formal.en: The calculation of the total cost includes transport and export duty.
formal.zh: 总成本的计算包括运输费用和出口税。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Daħħalt id-dazju tal-esportazzjoni fil-kalkolu? Ġorġ: Iva, żidtu mal-ispiża tat-trasport.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you include the export duty in the calculation? Ġorġ: Yes, I added it to the transport cost.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你把出口税算进去了吗？乔治：算进去了，我把它加到了运输费用上。

messages.speaker: Marija (销售经理)
messages.zh: 你把出口税算进去了吗？
messages.en: Did you include the export duty in the calculation?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (会计)
messages.zh: 算进去了，我把它加到了运输费用上。
messages.en: Yes, I added it to the transport cost.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词组和“货物离开本国、费用表列出出口税”的画面绑定；tal-esportazzjoni 表示“出口的”，帮助记住征税涉及的方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tax charged on goods brought into a country from abroad.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对从国外进口的货物征收的税款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taxxa imposta fuq oġġetti li jiddaħħlu f'pajjiż minn barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关对进口货物征收的关税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taxxa doganali imposta fuq oġġetti importati minn pajjiż ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Customs duty on imports is a tax charged on goods entering a country from abroad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对进入本国的外国货物征收的进口关税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dazju li jiġi impost meta oġġetti jiddaħħlu fil-pajjiż minn barra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Import duty is a tax payable on goods brought into a country from another country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因货物从国外进口而征收的税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taxxa marbuta mal-importazzjoni ta' oġġetti minn barra l-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An import tax is a charge imposed on goods because they are imported from abroad.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri l-valur tal-oġġetti importati u l-ammont tad-dazju tal-importazzjoni mħallas fuqhom.
formal.en: The report shows the value of the imported goods and the amount of import duty paid on them.
formal.zh: 报告列明了进口货物的价值以及为这些货物缴纳的进口关税金额。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-kont tal-pakkett huwa ogħla milli stennejt? Pawlu: Għax jinkludi d-dazju tal-importazzjoni. Lara: Mela rrid inħallas dan ukoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the bill for the parcel higher than I expected? Pawlu: Because it includes import duty. Lara: So I need to pay that too.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么这个包裹的账单比我预想的高？保罗：因为里面包含进口关税。拉拉：那我还得付这笔钱。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kont tal-pakkett huwa ogħla milli stennejt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kont tal-pakkett huwa ogħla milli stennejt?
messages.zh: 为什么这个包裹的账单比我预想的高？
messages.en: Why is the bill for the parcel higher than I expected?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (快递柜台职员)
messages.zh: 因为里面包含进口关税。
messages.en: Because it includes import duty.

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 那我还得付这笔钱。
messages.en: So I need to pay that too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上“国外包裹入境缴税”的画面来记；看到 importazzjoni，就联想到进口，再把 dazju 一起记成进口关税。

gloss_zh: 特定商品消费税；货物税

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tax charged on particular goods, such as alcohol, tobacco, or fuel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对酒类、烟草或燃料等特定商品征收的消费税或货物税。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taxxa imposta fuq ċerti prodotti, bħall-alkoħol, it-tabakk jew il-fjuwil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对特定类别商品征收的消费税或货物税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dazju impost fuq kategoriji partikolari ta' prodotti, bħat-tabakk jew l-alkoħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Excise duty is a tax charged on particular types of goods, such as tobacco or alcohol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某些指定商品征收的特种消费税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taxxa li tapplika għal prodotti speċifiċi, bħall-fjuwil, it-tabakk jew l-alkoħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An excise tax is a tax imposed on selected goods rather than on every purchase.

formal.mt: L-analiżi tqabbel il-prezz tal-prodott qabel u wara żieda fid-dazju tas-sisa.
formal.en: The analysis compares the price of the product before and after an increase in excise duty.
formal.zh: 这项分析比较了提高特定商品消费税前后的产品价格。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex dan il-prodott sar jiswa aktar? David: Il-prezz żdied wara żieda fid-dazju tas-sisa. Marija: Issa nifhem għaliex qed inħallas aktar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why has this product become more expensive? David: The price went up after an increase in excise duty. Marija: Now I understand why I am paying more.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：为什么这个产品变贵了？戴维：特定商品消费税提高后，价格就涨了。玛丽亚：现在我明白为什么要多付钱了。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-prodott sar jiswa aktar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-prodott sar jiswa aktar?
messages.zh: 为什么这个产品变贵了？
messages.en: Why has this product become more expensive?

messages.speaker: David (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-prezz żdied wara żieda fid-dazju tas-sisa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-prezz żdied wara żieda fid-dazju tas-sisa.
messages.zh: 特定商品消费税提高后，价格就涨了。
messages.en: The price went up after an increase in excise duty.

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nifhem għaliex qed inħallas aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Issa nifhem għaliex qed inħallas aktar.
messages.zh: 现在我明白为什么要多付钱了。
messages.en: Now I understand why I am paying more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“烟、酒、燃料三张商品卡”记住 dazju tas-sisa：它指针对特定商品征收的税。把整个短语与这组三张卡反复配对。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deceive someone or trick them into believing something false.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以虚假的说法、承诺或其他手段欺骗某人，使其相信不真实的事情或上当。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqarraq b'xi ħadd billi jġiegħlu jemmen xi ħaġa falza jew jaġixxi fuq informazzjoni qarrieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺骗某人，使其把虚假的事情当作真实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jemmen xi ħaġa li mhijiex vera billi jagħtih informazzjoni falza jew jaħbilu l-verità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone deceives you, they deliberately make you believe something that is not true.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用计哄骗某人，使其上当或做出原本不会做的事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Juża qerq jew xi nassa biex iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jemmen xi ħaġa falza jew jagħmel xi ħaġa li altrimenti ma kienx jagħmel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone tricks you, they use deception to make you believe something or act as they want.

collocations.en: he tricked people with false promises
collocations.zh: 他用虚假承诺哄骗了人们

formal.mt: Il-bejjiegħ daħak bil-klijent meta qallu li l-prodott kien ġdid, għalkemm kien diġà ntuża.
formal.en: The seller deceived the customer by telling him the product was new, although it had already been used.
formal.zh: 卖家告诉顾客产品是新的，实际上它已经使用过，以此欺骗了顾客。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħallast għall-biljett, imma ma wasal xejn. Mark: Dak ir-raġel daħak bik; ejja nitolbu flusek lura.
colloquial.en: Maja: I paid for the ticket, but nothing arrived. Mark: That man tricked you; let's ask for your money back.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我付了票钱，但什么也没收到。马克：那个人骗了你；我们去要求退款吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (购票者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallast għall-biljett, imma ma wasal xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallast għall-biljett, imma ma wasal xejn.
messages.zh: 我付了票钱，但什么也没收到。
messages.en: I paid for the ticket, but nothing arrived.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel daħak bik; ejja nitolbu flusek lura.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel daħak bik; ejja nitolbu flusek lura.
messages.zh: 那个人骗了你；我们去要求退款吧。
messages.en: That man tricked you; let's ask for your money back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“卖家拿虚假承诺骗顾客”的情景记住这里的欺骗义，再联想到付钱后没有收到票。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To laugh quietly and gently, usually because something amuses you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因觉得某事有趣而轻轻地、低声地笑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tidħaq bil-mod u b'leħen baxx, ġeneralment għax xi ħaġa tkun daħħqitek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻声地笑，通常表示觉得有趣或暗自好笑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tidħaq ftit u bil-mod, mingħajr ma tagħmel ħafna storbju, għax xi ħaġa tkun daħħqitek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone chuckles, they laugh quietly because they find something amusing.

collocations.mt: daħak ħafif bejnu u bejn ruħu

formal.mt: Waqt il-qari tal-ittra, Pawlu daħak ħafif meta wasal għall-aħħar sentenza.
formal.en: While reading the letter, Paul chuckled when he reached the final sentence.
formal.zh: 保罗读信时，读到最后一句便轻声笑了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex daħak ħafif Mark? Luqa: Ftakar fiċ-ċajta li għedtlu lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark chuckle? Luke: He remembered the joke I told him yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么轻声笑了？卢克：他想起了我昨天给他讲的笑话。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么轻声笑了？
messages.en: Why did Mark chuckle?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 他想起了我昨天给他讲的笑话。
messages.en: He remembered the joke I told him yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读到有趣短信时嘴角上扬、轻轻笑出声，把整句记成“轻声笑了一下”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enter a place quietly and discreetly, trying to avoid being noticed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了不被人注意而轻手轻脚、悄悄地进入某处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tidħol f'post bil-kwiet u b'attenzjoni biex ħadd ma jinduna bik.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偷偷地行动或进入某处，尽量不让别人察觉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiċċaqlaq jew tidħol f'post bil-moħbi u bil-kwiet, waqt li tipprova tevita li xi ħadd jinduna bik.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone sneaks into a place, they enter quietly while trying to avoid being noticed.

collocations.mt: daħal baxx baxx mid-daħla ta' wara
collocations.en: sneaked in through the back entrance

formal.mt: L-istudent daħal baxx baxx fil-klassi wara li kienet bdiet il-lezzjoni, bit-tama li l-għalliem ma jindunax bih.
formal.en: The student sneaked into the classroom after the lesson had begun, hoping the teacher would not notice him.
formal.zh: 课程开始后，那名学生悄悄溜进教室，希望老师不会注意到他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk qajjem lil kulħadd meta wasal? Sara: Le, daħal baxx baxx u mar dritt jorqod.
colloquial.en: Maya: Did your brother wake everyone when he arrived? Sara: No, he sneaked in and went straight to bed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥回来时把大家都吵醒了吗？萨拉：没有，他悄悄进来，直接去睡觉了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk qajjem lil kulħadd meta wasal?
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk qajjem lil kulħadd meta wasal?
messages.zh: 你哥哥回来时把大家都吵醒了吗？
messages.en: Did your brother wake everyone when he arrived?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, daħal baxx baxx u mar dritt jorqod.
messages.mt_standard: Le, daħal baxx baxx u mar dritt jorqod.
messages.zh: 没有，他悄悄进来，直接去睡觉了。
messages.en: No, he sneaked in and went straight to bed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把重复的 baxx baxx 配上“轻一点，再轻一点”的脚步画面，记住偷偷进入、避免被发现。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enter someone else's land or property without permission or the right to do so.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未经允许或没有进入权利而进入他人的土地或处所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tidħol f'art jew fi proprjetà ta' ħaddieħor mingħajr permess jew mingħajr ma jkollok dritt tidħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未经许可或无权进入他人的土地、建筑物等私有处所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tidħol f'art, f'bini jew fi proprjetà ta' ħaddieħor mingħajr il-permess meħtieġ jew mingħajr id-dritt li tkun hemm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone trespasses, they enter another person's land or property without permission or a right to enter.

collocations.mt: daħal bla jedd fil-proprjetà ta' ħaddieħor

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, ir-raġel daħal bla jedd fil-ġnien privat minkejja t-tabella li kienet tipprojbixxi d-dħul.
formal.en: According to the report, the man trespassed in the private garden despite the sign prohibiting entry.
formal.zh: 据报告，该男子无视禁止进入的告示，擅自进入了私人花园。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex is-sid irrabja ma' dak ir-raġel? Nina: Għax daħal bla jedd fl-għalqa tiegħu biex jieħu r-ritratti.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why was the owner angry with that man? Nina: Because he trespassed in the owner's field to take photos.
colloquial.zh: 马克：主人为什么生那个男人的气？妮娜：因为他为了拍照，擅自进入了主人的田地。

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex is-sid irrabja ma' dak ir-raġel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex is-sid irrabja ma' dak ir-raġel?
messages.zh: 主人为什么生那个男人的气？
messages.en: Why was the owner angry with that man?

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax daħal bla jedd fl-għalqa tiegħu biex jieħu r-ritratti.
messages.mt_standard: Għax daħal bla jedd fl-għalqa tiegħu biex jieħu r-ritratti.
messages.zh: 因为他为了拍照，擅自进入了主人的田地。
messages.en: Because he trespassed in the owner's field to take photos.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象私人花园门口写着“未经许可不得进入”，把整句和“没有进入权却进去了”联系起来。

gloss_zh: 着手承担；接下；陷入麻烦

teaching_sense.en_definition: To undertake a task, take on a responsibility, or enter a troublesome situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 着手承担某项工作或责任；也可指使自己陷入问题或困境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tibda twettaq biċċa xogħol, taċċetta responsabbiltà, jew issib ruħek f'sitwazzjoni li ġġib magħha problemi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 承接并着手进行某项任务、工作或活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taċċetta li twettaq biċċa xogħol jew attività u tibda taħdem fuqha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you undertake a task, you agree to do it and begin working on it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接下或承担某项工作、责任或挑战。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taċċetta li ġġorr responsabbiltà jew li twettaq xogħol jew tiffaċċja sfida.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you take on work or a responsibility, you accept it as something you will handle.

sense_translations.en_definition: to walk into (a problem or fix)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因自己的行动或决定而陷入问题、麻烦或困境。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Issib ruħek f'inkwiet jew f'sitwazzjoni diffiċli minħabba pass li tkun ħadt jew deċiżjoni li tkun għamilt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you walk into a problem or fix, your actions bring you into a difficult situation.

collocations.en: got himself into a lot of trouble
collocations.zh: 使自己陷入了许多麻烦

formal.mt: Meta aċċetta li jmexxi l-proġett, id-direttur daħal għal responsabbiltà kbira li kienet teħtieġ ippjanar bir-reqqa.
formal.en: When he agreed to lead the project, the director took on a major responsibility that required careful planning.
formal.zh: 主管同意领导该项目时，承担了一项需要周密规划的重大责任。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu għadu jaħdem daqshekk tard? Mark: Daħal għal biċċa xogħol kbira wisq għalih. Maja: Mela daħal għal ħafna inkwiet!
colloquial.en: Maya: Why is Paul still working so late? Mark: He took on a job that was too big for him. Maya: So he got himself into a lot of trouble!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么这么晚还在工作？马克：他接下了一项超出自己能力的大任务。玛雅：那他可给自己惹了不少麻烦！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu għadu jaħdem daqshekk tard?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu għadu jaħdem daqshekk tard?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么这么晚还在工作？
messages.en: Why is Paul still working so late?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Daħal għal biċċa xogħol kbira wisq għalih.
messages.mt_standard: Daħal għal biċċa xogħol kbira wisq għalih.
messages.zh: 他接下了一项超出自己能力的大任务。
messages.en: He took on a job that was too big for him.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那他可给自己惹了不少麻烦！
messages.en: So he got himself into a lot of trouble!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“接下任务，也接下后果”串联记忆：后接工作或责任是承担，后接麻烦则是陷入困境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fool someone by making them believe something untrue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人相信不真实的事情，从而愚弄或欺骗对方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqarraq b'xi ħadd billi jġiegħlu jemmen xi ħaġa li mhijiex vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 愚弄或欺骗某人，使其信以为真。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jemmen xi ħaġa mhux vera u b'hekk iqarraq bih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone fools you, they make you believe something that is not true.

formal.mt: Il-bejjiegħ daħaq bil-klijent billi qallu li l-prodott kien ġdid, meta fil-fatt kien użat.
formal.en: The seller fooled the customer by telling him that the product was new when it was actually used.
formal.zh: 卖家把用过的产品说成新品，欺骗了顾客。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex mort l-istazzjon daqshekk kmieni? Mark: Pawlu daħaq bija; qalli li l-ferrovija titlaq fis-sebgħa, imma titlaq fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you go to the station so early? Mark: Pawlu fooled me; he told me the train leaves at seven, but it leaves at eight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么那么早去车站？马克：保罗骗了我；他说火车七点开，其实八点才开。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么那么早去车站？
messages.en: Why did you go to the station so early?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu daħaq bija; qalli li l-ferrovija titlaq fis-sebgħa, imma titlaq fit-tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu daħaq bija; qalli li l-ferrovija titlaq fis-sebgħa, imma titlaq fit-tmienja.
messages.zh: 保罗骗了我；他说火车七点开，其实八点才开。
messages.en: Pawlu fooled me; he told me the train leaves at seven, but it leaves at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把例句想成记错火车时间的受骗场景，整块记住 daħaq bija 表示“他骗了我”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: at the present time, especially in contrast with the past
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指现今这一时期，尤其用于与过去的情况作比较。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fiż-żmien ta' issa, speċjalment meta wieħed iqabbel il-preżent mal-imgħoddi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 如今；现今，常用于说明与过去不同的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fiż-żmien preżenti, ħafna drabi b'kuntrast ma' kif kienu l-affarijiet fil-passat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression when describing present conditions, especially when comparing them with the past.

formal.mt: Daż-żmien, ħafna studenti jużaw riżorsi diġitali biex jitgħallmu lingwi ġodda.
formal.en: Nowadays, many students use digital resources to learn new languages.
formal.zh: 如今，许多学生使用数字资源学习新的语言。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Daż-żmien, tixtri l-kotba minn fuq l-internet? Luqa: Iva, imma xorta nħobb immur fil-ħanut tal-kotba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you buy books online nowadays? Luqa: Yes, but I still like going to the bookshop.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你如今都在网上买书吗？Luqa：是啊，不过我还是喜欢去书店。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Daż-żmien, tixtri l-kotba minn fuq l-internet?
messages.mt_standard: Daż-żmien, tixtri l-kotba minn fuq l-internet?
messages.zh: 你如今都在网上买书吗？
messages.en: Do you buy books online nowadays?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma xorta nħobb immur fil-ħanut tal-kotba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma xorta nħobb immur fil-ħanut tal-kotba.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过我还是喜欢去书店。
messages.en: Yes, but I still like going to the bookshop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个表达放在时间轴的“如今”位置，再配一句“过去怎样、如今怎样”，帮助记住它常用于今昔对比。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enter a telephone number on a phone in order to make a call.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了打电话而在电话上输入或拨出号码。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħħal numru tat-telefon fuq telefon sabiex tagħmel telefonata.

sense_translations.en_definition: to dial (used for a phone number)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拨打电话号码，即在电话上输入号码以发起通话。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Agħżel iċ-ċifri ta' numru tat-telefon fuq telefon biex iċċempel lil xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you dial a telephone number, you enter its digits on a phone to make a call.

formal.mt: Biex tikkuntattja l-uffiċċju, ddajlja n-numru indikat fl-ittra u stenna sakemm iwieġeb impjegat.
formal.en: To contact the office, dial the number given in the letter and wait until a member of staff answers.
formal.zh: 如需联系办公室，请拨打信中列出的号码，并等待工作人员接听。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ma nistax naqbad ma' Sara. Mark: Ddajlja n-numru mill-ġdid; forsi għafast ċifra ħażina. Nina: Tajjeb, se nerġa' nipprova.
colloquial.en: Nina: I cannot get through to Sara. Mark: Dial the number again; perhaps you pressed the wrong digit. Nina: All right, I will try again.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我打不通萨拉的电话。马克：再拨一次号码，也许你按错了一位数字。妮娜：好，我再试一次。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我打不通萨拉的电话。
messages.en: I cannot get through to Sara.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddajlja n-numru mill-ġdid; forsi għafast ċifra ħażina.
messages.mt_standard: Ddajlja n-numru mill-ġdid; forsi għafast ċifra ħażina.
messages.zh: 再拨一次号码，也许你按错了一位数字。
messages.en: Dial the number again; perhaps you pressed the wrong digit.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我再试一次。
messages.en: All right, I will try again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ddajlja 与“手指逐个按下电话号码”的动作绑定；一边模拟拨号，一边说 ddajlja n-numru，记住它表示拨号码。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made more attractive by the addition of ornaments, colours, or other decorative features.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过添加饰物、色彩或其他装饰元素而变得更美观的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li sar isbaħ permezz ta' tiżjin, kuluri jew elementi oħra ta' dekorazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过装饰的；添加了饰物或其他美化元素的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu tiżjin jew elementi miżjuda biex jagħtuh dehra isbaħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is decorated has ornaments or other attractive details added to improve its appearance.

formal.mt: Il-mistednin intlaqgħu f'salon ddekorat bil-fjuri u bid-dwal għall-okkażjoni.
formal.en: The guests were welcomed in a hall decorated with flowers and lights for the occasion.
formal.zh: 宾客们在为这次活动用鲜花和灯光装饰的大厅里受到欢迎。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Ħares lejn dak il-kejk ddekorat biċ-ċikkulata! Luqa: Jogħġobni ħafna. Għandu anki fjuri żgħar fuqu. Emma: Ikun sabiħ għall-festa tagħna.
colloquial.en: Emma: Look at that cake decorated with chocolate! Luqa: I really like it. It even has little flowers on it. Emma: It would be lovely for our party.
colloquial.zh: 埃玛：看那个用巧克力装饰的蛋糕！卢卡：我很喜欢，上面甚至还有小花。埃玛：用在我们的聚会上会很漂亮。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares lejn dak il-kejk ddekorat biċ-ċikkulata!
messages.mt_standard: Ħares lejn dak il-kejk ddekorat biċ-ċikkulata!
messages.zh: 看那个用巧克力装饰的蛋糕！
messages.en: Look at that cake decorated with chocolate!

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jogħġobni ħafna. Għandu anki fjuri żgħar fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Jogħġobni ħafna. Għandu anki fjuri żgħar fuqu.
messages.zh: 我很喜欢，上面甚至还有小花。
messages.en: I really like it. It even has little flowers on it.

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 用在我们的聚会上会很漂亮。
messages.en: It would be lovely for our party.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个普通蛋糕加上巧克力和小花后的样子，把 ddekorat 贴在完成装饰的蛋糕旁，记住它描述“装饰过的”状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Firmly committed to doing something and unwilling to give up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 决心做成某事、遇到困难也不轻易放弃的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu rieda soda li jagħmel xi ħaġa u ma jaqtax qalbu faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 意志坚定的；下定决心要实现某个目标的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu deċiżjoni soda li jilħaq għan u jibqa' jipprova minkejja d-diffikultajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is determined has firmly decided to achieve something and keeps trying despite difficulties.

collocations.zh: 一名意志坚定的运动员

formal.mt: L-istudent huwa ddeterminat li jtemm l-istudji tiegħu minkejja d-diffikultajiet.
formal.en: The student is determined to complete his studies despite the difficulties.
formal.zh: 这名学生决心克服困难，完成学业。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se terġa' tipprova għada? Pawlu: Iva, jien ddeterminat li ngħaddi mill-eżami.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to try again tomorrow? Pawlu: Yes, I'm determined to pass the exam.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你明天还会再试吗？保罗：会，我下定决心要通过考试。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天还会再试吗？
messages.en: Are you going to try again tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (备考的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien ddeterminat li ngħaddi mill-eżami.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien ddeterminat li ngħaddi mill-eżami.
messages.zh: 会，我下定决心要通过考试。
messages.en: Yes, I'm determined to pass the exam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“决心通过考试”的画面记忆：ddeterminat li 后面接要做成的事，突出坚持到底的决心。

gloss_zh: 已声明的；已公开宣布的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressed, announced, or made known openly or officially.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经明确表达、公开宣布或正式宣告的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġie espress b'mod ċar jew imħabbar pubblikament jew uffiċjalment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已明确声明的；已正式表明或申报的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie espress jew irrappurtat b'mod ċar, speċjalment fi stqarrija jew f'dokument uffiċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is declared has been clearly stated or officially reported.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已公开宣告的；已向公众正式宣布的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie mħabbar lill-pubbliku b'mod ċar jew permezz ta' avviż uffiċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is proclaimed has been publicly announced, often in a formal or emphatic way.

collocations.zh: 已正式宣布的紧急状态

formal.mt: L-għan iddikjarat tal-proġett huwa li jitnaqqas l-iskart fl-iskejjel.
formal.en: The declared aim of the project is to reduce waste in schools.
formal.zh: 该项目已明确声明的目标是减少学校产生的废弃物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tiġbru l-flus? Pawlu: L-għan iddikjarat tagħna hu li nixtru kotba għal-librerija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you collecting money? Pawlu: Our declared aim is to buy books for the library.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们为什么筹款？保罗：我们已明确声明的目标是为图书馆买书。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们为什么筹款？
messages.en: Why are you collecting money?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (筹款活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għan iddikjarat tagħna hu li nixtru kotba għal-librerija.
messages.mt_standard: L-għan iddikjarat tagħna hu li nixtru kotba għal-librerija.
messages.zh: 我们已明确声明的目标是为图书馆买书。
messages.en: Our declared aim is to buy books for the library.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想一张已经贴出的正式公告：目标一经明确说出或公开宣布，就可以用 ddikjarat 来描述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To interrupt someone's activity, concentration, rest, or peace.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 打断某人的活动、注意力或休息，使其受到打扰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tfixkel lil xi ħadd waqt attività jew ittellef il-konċentrazzjoni, il-mistrieħ jew il-kwiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打扰或干扰，使某人无法继续安静地活动、专心或休息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tinterrompi dak li jkun qed jagħmel xi ħadd jew ittellef il-kwiet u l-mistrieħ tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something disturbs you, they interrupt your activity or prevent you from resting or concentrating.

formal.mt: L-istorbju mit-triq ddisturba lill-istudenti waqt l-eżami.
formal.en: The noise from the street disturbed the students during the exam.
formal.zh: 街上传来的噪声在考试期间干扰了学生。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Irqadt tajjeb? Pawlu: Le, l-istorbju ddisturba l-irqad tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you sleep well? Pawlu: No, the noise disturbed my sleep.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你睡得好吗？保罗：不好，噪声干扰了我的睡眠。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你睡得好吗？
messages.en: Did you sleep well?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 不好，噪声干扰了我的睡眠。
messages.en: No, the noise disturbed my sleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚睡着就被街头噪声吵醒，把 ddisturba 与“安静被打断”的画面一起记住。

gloss_zh: Dean Formosa（一个较流行的人名）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A popular personal name used to identify a person called Dean Formosa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个较流行的人名，用于指称名叫 Dean Formosa 的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem popolari ta' persuna, magħmul mill-isem Dean u l-kunjom Formosa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个较流行的人名，此处为 Dean Formosa。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem ta' persuna li huwa popolari; f'din l-entrata, l-isem huwa Dean Formosa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dean Formosa is presented here as a popular personal name used to identify someone.

collocations.zh: 一位名叫 Dean Formosa 的人

formal.mt: Fil-formola ta' dan l-eżerċizzju, l-isem imniżżel huwa Dean Formosa.
formal.en: In the form for this exercise, the name entered is Dean Formosa.
formal.zh: 在本练习的表格中，填写的姓名是 Dean Formosa。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'isem se niktbu fl-eżerċizzju? Pawlu: Ejja niktbu Dean Formosa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What name shall we write in the exercise? Pawlu: Let's write Dean Formosa.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：练习里我们写什么名字？保罗：我们写 Dean Formosa 吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 练习里我们写什么名字？
messages.en: What name shall we write in the exercise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 我们写 Dean Formosa 吧。
messages.en: Let's write Dean Formosa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Dean Formosa 当作练习表格上的完整姓名来记；两部分首字母大写，整组用于指称一个人。

gloss_zh: 富于感官诱惑的；充满感官享受的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Giving strong pleasure to the senses or expressing sensual enjoyment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能强烈吸引感官、带来感官享受，或表现出感官享乐意味的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti pjaċir qawwi lis-sensi jew jesprimi tgawdija tas-sensi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有强烈感官魅力、令人产生愉悦或享乐感受的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiġbed is-sensi b'mod qawwi u joħloq sensazzjoni ta' pjaċir jew tgawdija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something voluptuous appeals strongly to the senses and suggests rich sensual pleasure.

formal.mt: Il-kritiku ddeskriva l-istil tal-pittura bħala debuxxant, b'kuluri sinjuri li jiġbdu s-sensi.
formal.en: The critic described the painting's style as voluptuous, with rich colours that appeal to the senses.
formal.zh: 评论家将这幅画的风格描述为富于感官魅力，浓郁的色彩令人赏心悦目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif tiddeskrivi l-istil ta' din il-pittura? Mark: Debuxxant; il-kuluri tagħha jagħtuni sens ta' pjaċir.
colloquial.en: Maja: How would you describe the style of this painting? Mark: Voluptuous; its colours give me a feeling of pleasure.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你会怎样形容这幅画的风格？马克：富于感官魅力；它的色彩让我感到愉悦。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif tiddeskrivi l-istil ta' din il-pittura?
messages.mt_standard: Kif tiddeskrivi l-istil ta' din il-pittura?
messages.zh: 你会怎样形容这幅画的风格？
messages.en: How would you describe the style of this painting?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Debuxxant; il-kuluri tagħha jagħtuni sens ta' pjaċir.
messages.mt_standard: Debuxxant; il-kuluri tagħha jagħtuni sens ta' pjaċir.
messages.zh: 富于感官魅力；它的色彩让我感到愉悦。
messages.en: Voluptuous; its colours give me a feeling of pleasure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 debuxxant 联想成一幅色彩浓郁、让感官沉浸其中的画，用“感官受到吸引”的画面记住词义。

gloss_zh: 放荡的；生活糜烂的；挥霍无度的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Living without moral restraint, especially through excessive pleasure or reckless spending.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生活缺乏道德约束，尤其表现为纵情享乐、行为放荡或挥霍无度的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħix mingħajr rażan morali, speċjalment bi pjaċiri żejda jew infiq bla kontroll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沉溺于过度享乐、生活糜烂而有失道德约束的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li hu mogħti għal pjaċiri eċċessivi u jgħix ħajja mingħajr rażan morali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A debauched person indulges excessively in pleasure and behaves without moral restraint.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生活放荡、行为不受道德规范约束的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jrażżanx l-imġiba tiegħu skont il-prinċipji morali u jgħix ħajja ta' pjaċiri bla kontroll.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dissolute person leads a life of uncontrolled pleasure with little regard for moral standards.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挥霍无度、放纵享乐而缺乏责任感或道德约束的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jonfoq il-flus bla rażan u jgħix b'mod eċċessiv mingħajr sens ta' responsabbiltà jew rażan morali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A profligate person wastes money recklessly or lives extravagantly without moral restraint.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist huwa raġel debuxxat li jaħli ġidu fil-pjaċiri u jittraskura r-responsabbiltajiet tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist is a dissolute man who wastes his wealth on pleasure and neglects his responsibilities.
formal.zh: 小说中的主人公是一个生活放荡的男人，他把财富挥霍在享乐上，并忽视自己的责任。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tgħid li l-karattru hu debuxxat? Pawlu: Għax jgħix għall-pjaċiri biss, jaħli flusu kollha u ma jagħtix kas ta' ħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you say the character is dissolute? Pawlu: Because he lives only for pleasure, wastes all his money and cares about nobody.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么说这个人物生活放荡？保罗：因为他只顾享乐，挥霍掉所有的钱，也不关心任何人。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li l-karattru hu debuxxat?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li l-karattru hu debuxxat?
messages.zh: 你为什么说这个人物生活放荡？
messages.en: Why do you say the character is dissolute?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jgħix għall-pjaċiri biss, jaħli flusu kollha u ma jagħtix kas ta' ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jgħix għall-pjaċiri biss, jaħli flusu kollha u ma jagħtix kas ta' ħadd.
messages.zh: 因为他只顾享乐，挥霍掉所有的钱，也不关心任何人。
messages.en: Because he lives only for pleasure, wastes all his money and cares about nobody.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一个只顾享乐、花光积蓄又不负责任的小说人物记住 debuxxat；三个义项分别突出糜烂、放荡和挥霍。

gloss_zh: 尽心尽力的；致力于的；献给……的；专用于……的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing strong commitment to a person or activity, or intended for a particular person or purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某项活动投入心力的，也可指献给特定的人或专供某种用途的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri impenn u jagħti ħin u attenzjoni lil xi ħadd jew lil xi attività, jew li jkun maħsub għal persuna jew għan partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尽心尽力的；对工作、职责或活动十分投入的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jaħdem b'impenn u jagħti ħafna ħin, attenzjoni u sforz lix-xogħol jew lill-attività tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dedicated person gives considerable time and effort to work or an activity they care about.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 致力于……的；专用于……的；作为敬意献给……的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun mogħti b'impenn lil persuna jew attività, maħsub għal użu partikolari, jew offrut bħala ġieħ lil xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something dedicated to a person or purpose is offered in their honour or reserved for that use, while a person may be committed to an activity.

collocations.en: a book dedicated to one's parents

formal.mt: L-għalliem dedikat ħejja programm b'ħin dedikat għall-qari individwali.
formal.en: The dedicated teacher prepared a programme with time set aside for individual reading.
formal.zh: 这位尽心尽力的教师制定了一项计划，其中安排了专门用于个人阅读的时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb lil min hu dedikat? Mark: Huwa dedikat lill-ġenituri tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is this book dedicated to? Mark: It is dedicated to my parents.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这本书是献给谁的？Mark：是献给我父母的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb lil min hu dedikat?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb lil min hu dedikat?
messages.zh: 这本书是献给谁的？
messages.en: Who is this book dedicated to?

messages.speaker: Mark (作者)
messages.zh: 是献给我父母的。
messages.en: It is dedicated to my parents.
