gloss_zh: 坏名声；恶名（此处按名词义理解）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A label for malafama, meaning a bad reputation or ill repute.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 此处作为名词标签，表示坏名声或恶名，即别人普遍对某人或某事持有的不良评价。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikketta għan-nom 'malafama', jiġifieri reputazzjoni ħażina jew opinjoni negattiva li n-nies ikollhom dwar persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坏名声；恶名；在他人心目中的不良声誉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reputazzjoni ħażina li persuna, grupp jew ħaġa jkollhom f'għajnejn in-nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bad reputation is the unfavourable opinion that other people have of someone or something.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'defame' hija tikketta għan-nom 'malafama'. Eżempju ta' dan is-sens huwa: 'Il-ħanut tilef xi klijenti minħabba l-malafama tiegħu.'
formal.en: In this exercise, 'defame' is a label for the noun 'malafama'. An example of this meaning is: 'The shop lost some customers because of its bad reputation.'
formal.zh: 在这个练习中，“defame”是表示名词“malafama”的标签。这个词义的例句是：“这家商店因名声不好而流失了一些顾客。”

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi t-tifsira ta' 'defame' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Hawn tfisser 'malafama', jiġifieri reputazzjoni ħażina. Pereżempju, dak il-ħanut għandu malafama.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'defame' mean in this exercise? Mark: Here it means 'malafama', a bad reputation. For example, that shop has a bad reputation.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个练习里的“defame”是什么意思？Mark：这里表示“malafama”，也就是坏名声。比如，那家商店名声不好。

teaching_sense.en_definition: He supposed or thought that something was the case.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示他当时觉得或以为某种情况属实，并不一定表示已经证实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaseb li xi ħaġa kienet hekk, mingħajr ma bilfors kien ċert minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他觉得；他以为某种情况是如此。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaseb jew assuma li xi ħaġa kienet hekk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If he supposed something was true, he thought it was the case without necessarily being certain.

formal.mt: Wara li qara r-rapport, deherlu li l-proposta kienet tajba.
formal.en: After reading the report, he thought the proposal was good.
formal.zh: 读完报告后，他觉得这个提案不错。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex telaq Pawlu? Rita: Deherlu li l-laqgħa kienet spiċċat. Marta: Imma kien għad fadal ħafna x'niddiskutu!
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did Pawlu leave? Rita: He thought the meeting had finished. Marta: But we still had a lot to discuss!

gloss_zh: 为神父、国王等施行傅油礼的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who ceremonially anoints a priest, a king, or another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在仪式中为神父、国王等人涂抹油、施行傅油礼的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tidlek biż-żejt qassis, sultan jew persuna oħra waqt ċerimonja.

sense_translations.en_definition: one who anoints a priest, a king etc.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为神父、国王等人施行傅油礼的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel id-dilka biż-żejt lil qassis, lil sultan jew lil xi ħadd ieħor f'ċerimonja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An anointer is someone who applies oil to a priest, king, or another person during a ceremony.

collocations.en: the role of the person performing the anointing
the person performing the anointing during the ceremony
collocations.zh: 仪式中施行傅油礼的人

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi d-dehhien bħala l-persuna li tidlek lis-sultan biż-żejt waqt iċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The text describes the anointer as the person who applies oil to the king during the ceremony.
formal.zh: 文章将施行傅油礼者描述为在仪式中为国王涂抹油的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu d-dehhien f'dan ir-rakkont? Mark: Hu dak li jidlek lis-sultan biż-żejt waqt iċ-ċerimonja. Lara: Mela l-kelma tirreferi għall-persuna li tagħmel id-dilka.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the anointer in this story? Mark: He is the one who applies oil to the king during the ceremony. Lara: So the word refers to the person who performs the anointing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个故事里的施行傅油礼者是谁？马克：就是仪式中为国王涂抹油的人。拉拉：那么，这个词指的是施行傅油礼的人。

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象仪式中一人手持油，为神父或国王施行傅油礼；把 dehhien 贴在施礼者身上，记住它指人，而不是油或仪式本身。

gloss_zh: 神；女神；神性；上帝（英语词条）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An English noun referring to a god or goddess, divine status or nature, or the supreme creator in a monotheistic religion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英语名词，可指多神信仰中的神或女神，也可指神的地位、品质或本性；在一神信仰中，Deity 或 the Deity 可指创造万物的至高神。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom Ingliż li jista' jfisser alla jew alla mara, l-istat jew in-natura divina, jew Alla bħala l-ħallieq u l-esseri suprem f'reliġjon monoteista.

sense_translations.en_definition: a god or goddess (in a polytheistic religion). "a deity of ancient Greece" h Similar: god goddess divine being celestial being supreme being divinity immortal creator demiurge godhead daemon numen avatar divine status, quality, or nature. "a ruler driven by delusions of deity" the creator and supreme being (in a monotheistic religion such as Christianity). noun: Deity; noun: the Deity "she raised her head as if appealing to the Deity presiding over the church"
sense_translations.zh_definition: 可指多神宗教中的一位神或女神，如古希腊的一位神；也可指神的地位、品质或本性，如统治者妄想自己具有神格；在基督教等一神宗教中，Deity 或 the Deity 可指创造万物的至高神，即上帝。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tista' tirreferi għal alla jew alla mara f'reliġjon politeista, bħalma hi divinità tal-Greċja tal-qedem; tista' wkoll tfisser l-istat, il-kwalità jew in-natura divina. F'reliġjon monoteista bħall-Kristjaneżmu, 'Deity' jew 'the Deity' tista' tirreferi għal Alla bħala l-ħallieq u l-esseri suprem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A deity is a god or goddess, while the word can also describe divine status or nature and, as Deity or the Deity, the supreme creator in a monotheistic religion.

collocations.mt: Alla bħala l-ħallieq u l-esseri suprem
collocations.en: the Deity as creator and supreme being
collocations.zh: 作为创造者和至高存在的上帝

formal.mt: Fit-traduzzjoni tal-kelma Ingliża 'deity', il-kuntest juri jekk għandniex nifhmu alla jew alla mara, in-natura divina, jew Alla bħala l-ħallieq u l-esseri suprem.
formal.en: When translating the English word 'deity', the context shows whether it means a god or goddess, divine nature, or God as creator and supreme being.
formal.zh: 翻译英语词 deity 时，需要根据语境判断它指的是神或女神、神性，还是作为创造者和至高存在的上帝。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawn miktub 'a deity of ancient Greece'. Kif nittraduċiha? David: Tista' tgħid 'divinità tal-Greċja tal-qedem'. Sara: U jekk insib 'the Deity' f'test dwar il-Kristjaneżmu? David: F'dak il-kuntest tista' tfisser Alla, il-ħallieq u l-esseri suprem.
colloquial.en: Sara: It says 'a deity of ancient Greece' here. How do I translate it? David: You can say 'a divinity of ancient Greece'. Sara: And if I find 'the Deity' in a text about Christianity? David: In that context, it can mean God, the creator and supreme being.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里写着“a deity of ancient Greece”，该怎么翻译？戴维：可以译为“古希腊的一位神”。萨拉：如果在讨论基督教的文章中看到“the Deity”呢？戴维：在那个语境里，它可以指上帝，也就是创造者和至高存在。

gloss_zh: 海关债务；应向海关缴付的款项

teaching_sense.en_definition: An amount owed to Customs in respect of customs duties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因关税而产生、应向海关缴付的债务或款项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dejn li jikkonsisti f'ammont ta' dazji doganali li għandu jitħallas lid-Dwana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应向海关缴付的款项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ammont ta' flus li għandu jitħallas lid-Dwana bħala dazji doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An amount due to the Customs is money owed to the customs authority in respect of customs duties.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因应缴关税而形成的海关债务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dejn dovut lid-Dwana li jirrigwarda l-ħlas ta' dazji doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs debt is an amount that someone owes to the customs authority for customs duties.

collocations.en: the payment of the customs debt
the amount of the customs debt

formal.mt: Ir-rapport finanzjarju jindika l-ammont tad-dejn doganali li l-kumpanija għad trid tħallas.
formal.en: The financial report states the amount of the customs debt that the company still has to pay.
formal.zh: 财务报告列明了公司尚须缴付的海关债务金额。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kemm għad fadlilna nħallsu lid-Dwana? Pawlu: Id-dejn doganali huwa ta' mitejn ewro.
colloquial.en: Marija: How much do we still have to pay Customs? Pawlu: The customs debt is two hundred euros.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我们还要向海关缴多少钱？保罗：海关债务是两百欧元。

messages.speaker: Marija (会计)
messages.zh: 我们还要向海关缴多少钱？
messages.en: How much do we still have to pay Customs?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dejn doganali huwa ta' mitejn ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Id-dejn doganali huwa ta' mitejn ewro.
messages.zh: 海关债务是两百欧元。
messages.en: The customs debt is two hundred euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dejn doganali 与“海关账单上待缴的金额”一起记忆：看到这个词组，就想起一笔需要向海关缴付的款项。

gloss_zh: 出口海关债务；出口项下应缴关税款

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs debt arising in connection with the export of goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与货物出口有关、因应缴出口关税而形成的海关债务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dejn dovut lid-Dwana li jirrigwarda dazji fuq l-esportazzjoni ta' merkanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物出口项下产生的海关债务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dejn doganali marbut mal-ħlas ta' dazji fuq merkanzija esportata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs debt on export is money owed to the customs authority in connection with exporting goods.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因货物出口而产生的应缴海关债务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ammont dovut lid-Dwana bħala dazji marbuta mal-esportazzjoni ta' merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs debt on exportation is an amount payable to the customs authority in respect of goods being exported.

collocations.en: the calculation of the customs debt on export
the payment of the customs debt on export
the amount of the customs debt on export

formal.mt: It-tabella turi l-ammont tad-dejn doganali fuq l-esportazzjoni għal din il-kunsinna ta' merkanzija.
formal.en: The table shows the amount of the customs debt on export for this consignment of goods.
formal.zh: 表格列出了这批货物的出口海关债务金额。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan id-dejn doganali huwa fuq l-importazzjoni? Mark: Le, huwa dejn doganali fuq l-esportazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this customs debt on import? Mark: No, it is a customs debt on export.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这笔海关债务属于进口项下吗？马克：不是，是出口海关债务。

gloss_zh: 进口海关债务；进口项下应缴关税款

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs debt arising in connection with the import of goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与货物进口有关、因应缴进口关税而形成的海关债务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dejn dovut lid-Dwana li jirrigwarda dazji fuq l-importazzjoni ta' merkanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物进口项下产生的海关债务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dejn doganali marbut mal-ħlas ta' dazji fuq merkanzija importata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs debt on import is money owed to the customs authority in connection with importing goods.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因货物进口而产生的应缴海关债务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ammont dovut lid-Dwana bħala dazji marbuta mal-importazzjoni ta' merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs debt on importation is an amount payable to the customs authority in respect of goods being imported.

collocations.en: the calculation of the customs debt on import
the payment of the customs debt on import
the amount of the customs debt on import

formal.mt: Id-dokument juri kif ġie kkalkulat id-dejn doganali fuq l-importazzjoni ta' din il-merkanzija.
formal.en: The document shows how the customs debt on the import of these goods was calculated.
formal.zh: 文件说明了这批货物的进口海关债务是如何计算的。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dan l-ammont fid-dokument? David: Huwa d-dejn doganali fuq l-importazzjoni tal-merkanzija li waslet ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is this amount in the document? David: It is the customs debt on the import of the goods that arrived yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：文件里的这笔金额是什么？戴维：这是昨天到货的那批货物的进口海关债务。

messages.speaker: Nina (采购员)
messages.zh: 文件里的这笔金额是什么？
messages.en: What is this amount in the document?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa d-dejn doganali fuq l-importazzjoni tal-merkanzija li waslet ilbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa d-dejn doganali fuq l-importazzjoni tal-merkanzija li waslet ilbieraħ.
messages.zh: 这是昨天到货的那批货物的进口海关债务。
messages.en: It is the customs debt on the import of the goods that arrived yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“货物向里进，进口款待缴”的画面记忆；把 l-importazzjoni 对应进口，与出口词组并排练习，借货物流向区分两者。

gloss_zh: 坏账；预计无法收回的欠款

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money owed to a person or business that is considered unlikely to be repaid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 他人所欠、被认为很可能无法收回的款项，即坏账。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dejn li persuna jew negozju jqis li x'aktarx mhux se jkun jista' jiġbor mingħand min għandu jħallsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 债权人认为很可能无法收回的欠款；坏账。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ammont dovut lil persuna jew negozju li jitqies li x'aktarx mhux se jitħallas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bad debt is money owed to someone that is considered unlikely to be repaid.

collocations.en: to classify a debt as a bad debt
collocations.zh: 将一笔债务归类为坏账

collocations.en: the writing off of a bad debt
a loss from a bad debt

formal.mt: Wara diversi tentattivi biex tiġbor il-flus mingħand il-klijent, il-kumpanija kklassifikat l-ammont dovut bħala dejn mitluf.
formal.en: After several attempts to collect the money from the customer, the company classified the outstanding amount as a bad debt.
formal.zh: 在多次尝试向客户收款后，公司将这笔未收回的款项归类为坏账。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Taħseb li l-klijent għad se jħallasna? Ġużeppi: Ma naħsibx. Għalissa nqisu l-ammont bħala dejn mitluf.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you think the customer will still pay us? Ġużeppi: I don't think so. For now, we consider the amount a bad debt.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你觉得客户还会付钱给我们吗？朱塞佩：我觉得不会了。目前我们把这笔款项视为坏账。

messages.speaker: Rita (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li l-klijent għad se jħallasna?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li l-klijent għad se jħallasna?
messages.zh: 你觉得客户还会付钱给我们吗？
messages.en: Do you think the customer will still pay us?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (会计)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma naħsibx. Għalissa nqisu l-ammont bħala dejn mitluf.
messages.mt_standard: Ma naħsibx. Għalissa nqisu l-ammont bħala dejn mitluf.
messages.zh: 我觉得不会了。目前我们把这笔款项视为坏账。
messages.en: I don't think so. For now, we consider the amount a bad debt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dejn mitluf 配上“账本里记着，钱却难收回”的画面；从收款人的视角记住坏账，避免误解为普通的尚未付款。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money owed by households, including amounts borrowed through loans and other forms of credit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 家庭或住户因贷款及其他信贷安排而欠付的款项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flus li l-unitajiet domestiċi għandhom jagħtu minħabba self jew forom oħra ta' kreditu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 家庭或住户所承担的债务，包括贷款及其他信贷欠款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ammont ta' flus li l-unitajiet domestiċi għandhom jagħtu lil banek jew lil kredituri oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Household debt is the money that households owe to banks or other lenders.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina kif iż-żieda fid-dejn tal-unitajiet domestiċi tista' taffettwa l-infiq tal-familji.
formal.en: The report examines how an increase in household debt may affect family spending.
formal.zh: 该报告研究家庭债务增加可能如何影响家庭支出。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'ifisser dejn tal-unitajiet domestiċi? Pawlu: Huwa l-flus li l-familji għandhom jagħtu, pereżempju fuq self għad-dar.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does household debt mean? Pawlu: It is the money families owe, for example on a home loan.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：家庭债务是什么意思？保罗：就是家庭欠的钱，比如住房贷款的欠款。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 家庭债务是什么意思？
messages.en: What does household debt mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-flus li l-familji għandhom jagħtu, pereżempju fuq self għad-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-flus li l-familji għandhom jagħtu, pereżempju fuq self għad-dar.
messages.zh: 就是家庭欠的钱，比如住房贷款的欠款。
messages.en: It is the money families owe, for example on a home loan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组配上一张家庭收支表来记：收入栏旁边还有房贷等欠款，这些欠款合起来就是“家庭债务”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product applied to the body to prevent or reduce unpleasant body odour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涂抹或喷洒在身体上，用于预防或减轻体臭的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott li jitqiegħed fuq il-ġisem biex jipprevjeni jew inaqqas ir-riħa ħażina tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于身体、能够预防或减轻体臭的除臭产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott għall-ġisem, bħal sprej jew krema, li jintuża biex jipprevjeni jew inaqqas ir-riħa ħażina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A deodorant is a product you put on your body to prevent or reduce unpleasant smells.

formal.mt: Dan id-dejodorant mingħajr fwieħa huwa maħsub biex inaqqas ir-riħa ħażina tal-ġisem.
formal.en: This fragrance-free deodorant is intended to reduce unpleasant body odour.
formal.zh: 这款无香型体用除臭剂用于减轻体臭。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandkom dejodorant mingħajr fwieħa? Mark: Iva, għandna wieħed fuq din l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have fragrance-free deodorant? Mark: Yes, we have one on this shelf.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们有无香型体用除臭剂吗？马克：有，这个架子上有一款。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们有无香型体用除臭剂吗？
messages.en: Do you have fragrance-free deodorant?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna wieħed fuq din l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna wieħed fuq din l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 有，这个架子上有一款。
messages.en: Yes, we have one on this shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象洗澡后拿起一瓶体用除臭剂，一边做使用动作一边读 dejodorant，把词音与日常用品联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Facts, figures, or recorded observations collected for examination, processing, or use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为查考、处理或使用而收集的事实、数值或观察记录。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fatti, ċifri jew osservazzjonijiet irreġistrati li jinġabru biex jiġu eżaminati, ipproċessati jew użati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收集或记录下来、可供分析和使用的事实、数值或其他信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Informazzjoni magħmula minn fatti, ċifri jew osservazzjonijiet li jkunu nġabru jew ġew irreġistrati għal skop partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Data is information, such as facts or measurements, that is collected and used for a particular purpose.

formal.mt: Id-dejta miġbura permezz tal-istħarriġ se tintuża biex jiġu identifikati l-ħtiġijiet tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The data collected through the survey will be used to identify students' needs.
formal.zh: 通过调查收集的数据将用于确定学生的需求。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek id-dejta tal-istħarriġ? Samwel: Iva, qiegħda f'dan il-fajl. Nistgħu narawha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have the survey data? Samwel: Yes, it is in this file. We can look at it together.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你有调查数据吗？萨姆韦尔：有，在这个文件里。我们可以一起看。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你有调查数据吗？
messages.en: Do you have the survey data?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħda f'dan il-fajl. Nistgħu narawha flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħda f'dan il-fajl. Nistgħu narawha flimkien.
messages.zh: 有，在这个文件里。我们可以一起看。
messages.en: Yes, it is in this file. We can look at it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dejta 写在一张有数字、日期和调查答案的表格上，看到这些可供分析的记录，就联想到“数据”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Recorded information relating to the evaluation of frequency quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与频率质量评估有关的记录信息，包括评估所用的数据或评估产生的结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Informazzjoni rreġistrata marbuta mal-evalwazzjoni tal-kwalità tal-frekwenza, inkluża dik użata fl-evalwazzjoni jew miksuba minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于评估频率质量或由该评估产生的数据资料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dejta li tintuża biex tiġi evalwata l-kwalità tal-frekwenza jew li tinkiseb bħala riżultat ta' dik l-evalwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Frequency quality evaluation data is recorded information used in, or obtained from, an assessment of frequency quality.

collocations.en: collection of frequency quality evaluation data
collocations.zh: 频率质量评估数据的收集

collocations.en: analysis of frequency quality evaluation data
collocations.zh: 频率质量评估数据的分析

formal.mt: Id-dejta tal-evalwazzjoni tal-kwalità tal-frekwenza ġiet inkluża fl-anness tar-rapport biex ir-riżultati jkunu jistgħu jiġu eżaminati.
formal.en: The frequency quality evaluation data was included in the report's appendix so that the results could be examined.
formal.zh: 频率质量评估数据已列入报告附录，以便查阅和检查评估结果。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn hi d-dejta tal-evalwazzjoni tal-kwalità tal-frekwenza? David: Fl-anness tar-rapport. Niftħu u narawha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where is the frequency quality evaluation data? David: In the report's appendix. Let's open it and look at the data together.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：频率质量评估数据在哪里？戴维：在报告附录里。我们打开一起看吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi d-dejta tal-evalwazzjoni tal-kwalità tal-frekwenza?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi d-dejta tal-evalwazzjoni tal-kwalità tal-frekwenza?
messages.zh: 频率质量评估数据在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the frequency quality evaluation data?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-anness tar-rapport. Niftħu u narawha flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-anness tar-rapport. Niftħu u narawha flimkien.
messages.zh: 在报告附录里。我们打开一起看吧。
messages.en: In the report's appendix. Let's open it and look at the data together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义分块记忆：dejta 是数据，evalwazzjoni 是评估，kwalità 是质量，frekwenza 是频率；先理解“频率的质量”，再接上“评估”和“数据”。

gloss_zh: 脱咖啡因的；不含咖啡因的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing coffee or another drink from which caffeine has been removed, or which contains no caffeine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容咖啡或其他饮品经过脱咖啡因处理，或不含咖啡因。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi kafè jew xarba oħra li tkun tneħħiet minnha l-kaffeina, jew li ma jkunx fiha kaffeina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱咖啡因的；指经过处理，去除了咖啡因的咖啡或其他饮品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi kafè jew xarba oħra li tkun għaddiet minn proċess biex titneħħa minnha l-kaffeina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Decaffeinated coffee or another drink has been treated to remove caffeine from it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不含咖啡因的；强调饮品没有咖啡因这一特征。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xarba li ma jkun fiha ebda kaffeina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A caffeine-free drink is one that contains no caffeine.

formal.mt: Il-menu jindika b'mod ċar li l-kafè dekaffinat huwa disponibbli fuq talba.
formal.en: The menu clearly indicates that decaffeinated coffee is available on request.
formal.zh: 菜单明确注明，可应顾客要求提供脱咖啡因咖啡。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom kafè dekaffinat? Sara: Iva, għandna. Tridu bil-ħalib jew mingħajru?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have decaffeinated coffee? Sara: Yes, we do. Would you like it with or without milk?
colloquial.zh: Mark：你们有脱咖啡因咖啡吗？Sara：有的。您要加奶还是不加奶？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们有脱咖啡因咖啡吗？
messages.en: Do you have decaffeinated coffee?

messages.speaker: Sara (咖啡馆店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna. Tridu bil-ħalib jew mingħajru?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna. Tridu bil-ħalib jew mingħajru?
messages.zh: 有的。您要加奶还是不加奶？
messages.en: Yes, we do. Would you like it with or without milk?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kafè dekaffinat 与咖啡馆点单画面一起记：想喝咖啡又想避开咖啡因时，就说这组词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A senior official who leads a faculty or has responsibility for a particular area of university or college life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大学或学院中领导某个学院，或负责某一方面事务的高级负责人，如院长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċjal għoli f'università jew kulleġġ li jmexxi fakultà jew ikun responsabbli għal qasam partikolari tal-ħajja akkademika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 院长；大学或学院中负责某个学院或特定事务的高级管理人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha kariga għolja f'università jew kulleġġ u tmexxi fakultà jew tieħu ħsieb qasam partikolari tal-istituzzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dean is a senior official who leads a faculty or oversees a particular area of a university or college.

formal.mt: Id-dekan tal-fakultà bagħat ittra lill-istudenti biex jispjega l-bidliet fil-programm ta' studju.
formal.en: The dean of the faculty sent a letter to the students explaining the changes to the study programme.
formal.zh: 学院院长致信学生，说明培养方案的变更。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għada għandi laqgħa mad-dekan. Paul: Dwar il-kors il-ġdid? Lara: Iva, irrid nistaqsih ftit mistoqsijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: I have a meeting with the dean tomorrow. Paul: About the new course? Lara: Yes, I want to ask him a few questions.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我明天要和院长见面。Paul：是谈新课程吗？Lara：对，我想问他几个问题。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 我明天要和院长见面。
messages.en: I have a meeting with the dean tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Paul (同学)
messages.zh: 是谈新课程吗？
messages.en: About the new course?

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 对，我想问他几个问题。
messages.en: Yes, I want to ask him a few questions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dekan 放进大学场景记忆：fakultà 是学院，id-dekan tal-fakultà 就是该学院的院长。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An aquatic mammal with a streamlined body and flippers that breathes air and typically lives in the sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海豚；一种身体呈流线形、具有鳍肢、用肺呼吸且通常生活在海洋中的哺乳动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mammiferu akkwatiku b'ġisem tawwali adattat għall-għawm u bix-xewk, li jieħu n-nifs mill-arja u ġeneralment jgħix fil-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海豚；通常生活在海洋中、用肺呼吸、身体适于快速游泳的水生哺乳动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mammiferu li jgħix fl-ilma, ġeneralment fil-baħar, għandu ġisem adattat biex jgħum malajr u jitla' fil-wiċċ biex jieħu n-nifs.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dolphin is an aquatic mammal that breathes air and has a body adapted for swimming.

collocations.en: a dolphin leaping out of the water
a dolphin swimming beside the boat

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, ir-riċerkaturi raw delfin jitla' fil-wiċċ biex jieħu n-nifs.
formal.en: During the observation, the researchers saw a dolphin come to the surface to breathe.
formal.zh: 观察期间，研究人员看到一只海豚浮到水面呼吸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, delfin ħdejn id-dgħajsa! Toni: Fejn? Maja: Hemm, għadu kif qabeż mill-ilma!
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, a dolphin beside the boat! Toni: Where? Maja: Over there, it just jumped out of the water!
colloquial.zh: Maja：看，船旁边有一只海豚！Toni：在哪里？Maja：那边，它刚刚跃出了水面！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，船旁边有一只海豚！
messages.en: Look, a dolphin beside the boat!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 在哪里？
messages.en: Where?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那边，它刚刚跃出了水面！
messages.en: Over there, it just jumped out of the water!

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 delfin 就想象船边跃出水面的海豚，并配上短句 Ara, delfin!，把单词与动作画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 精巧秀气的；脆弱或敏感的；容易反胃的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fine and dainty, easily damaged or requiring careful handling, or easily upset by unpleasant sights or experiences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可形容事物精巧秀气、容易受损或需要谨慎处理，也可形容人见到令人不适的事物便容易反胃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa fina u pulita, xi ħaġa li tista' ssirilha ħsara faċilment jew li teħtieġ attenzjoni, jew persuna li titqalla' malajr quddiem affarijiet li jqajmu dardir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精巧秀气的；外观小巧、精致而悦目的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa fina, pulita u sabiħa fid-dehra, spiss żgħira u magħmula b'attenzjoni għad-dettall.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something dainty is small, attractive, and fine in its appearance or design.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脆弱的、敏感的或棘手的；容易受损、受影响，或需要小心处理的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tista' ssirilha ħsara faċilment, jew sitwazzjoni li teħtieġ ħafna attenzjoni u tattika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something delicate can be easily damaged or affected, or requires careful and sensitive handling.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易反胃的；看到血、伤口或其他令人不适的事物时容易恶心或难受的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li titqalla' jew tħossha ħażin faċilment meta tara demm, ġrieħi jew affarijiet oħra li jqajmu dardir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is squeamish easily feels sick or distressed when seeing blood, injuries, or other unpleasant things.

collocations.en: squeamish at the sight of blood

formal.mt: Dan huwa suġġett delikat; għalhekk, ir-rapport għandu juża lingwaġġ preċiż u rispettuż.
formal.en: This is a sensitive subject; therefore, the report should use precise and respectful language.
formal.zh: 这是一个敏感话题，因此报告应使用准确且尊重他人的措辞。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tara r-ritratt tal-ferita? Mark: Le, grazzi. Jien delikat ħafna meta nara d-demm. Lara: Mela ma nurihulekx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to see the photo of the wound? Mark: No, thanks. I get very squeamish when I see blood. Lara: Then I won't show it to you.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你想看那张伤口的照片吗？Mark：不了，谢谢。我一看到血就很容易反胃。Lara：那我就不给你看了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想看那张伤口的照片吗？
messages.en: Do you want to see the photo of the wound?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, grazzi. Jien delikat ħafna meta nara d-demm.
messages.mt_standard: Le, grazzi. Jien delikat ħafna meta nara d-demm.
messages.zh: 不了，谢谢。我一看到血就很容易反胃。
messages.en: No, thanks. I get very squeamish when I see blood.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我就不给你看了。
messages.en: Then I won't show it to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面区分 delikat 的义项：精巧的设计、需要小心护理的面料、见血就反胃的人；根据所描述的对象选择中文意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who breaks the law or commits offences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 违反法律或实施犯罪行为的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikser il-liġi jew twettaq reati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有违法或犯罪行为的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li twettaq atti li jmorru kontra l-liġi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A delinquent is someone who breaks the law or commits offences.

collocations.zh: 对违法者的矫治与社会回归支持

formal.mt: Il-programm joffri taħriġ u appoġġ biex delinkwent ikun jista' jerġa' jintegra ruħu fis-soċjetà.
formal.en: The programme offers training and support to help a delinquent reintegrate into society.
formal.zh: 该项目提供培训与支持，帮助违法者重新融入社会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser delinkwent? Mark: Persuna li tikser il-liġi. Maja: Allura mhux sempliċement xi ħadd li jġib ruħu ħażin.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does delinkwent mean? Mark: A person who breaks the law. Maja: So it does not simply mean someone who behaves badly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：delinkwent 是什么意思？马克：指违反法律的人。玛雅：所以不只是指行为不好的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: delinkwent 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does delinkwent mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 指违反法律的人。
messages.en: A person who breaks the law.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura mhux sempliċement xi ħadd li jġib ruħu ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Allura mhux sempliċement xi ħadd li jġib ruħu ħażin.
messages.zh: 所以不只是指行为不好的人。
messages.en: So it does not simply mean someone who behaves badly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 delinkwent 放进“违法者接受帮助、重新融入社会”的画面中记忆；它指人，不能仅凭一个人调皮就使用这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thin layer or mark left by spreading a substance over a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某种物质抹在表面后形成的一层薄涂层或痕迹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saff irqiq jew marka li titħalla meta sustanza tinfirex fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂抹物质时留下的薄层或抹痕。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marka jew saff irqiq ta' sustanza li tkun indilket fuq xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A smear is a thin layer or mark made by spreading a substance across a surface.

formal.mt: Wara x-xogħol ta' manutenzjoni, instabet delka ta' żebgħa fuq il-ħġieġa tat-tieqa.
formal.en: After the maintenance work, a smear of paint was found on the windowpane.
formal.zh: 维修工作结束后，窗玻璃上被发现留有一抹油漆。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek delka ta' ċikkulata fuq ħaddejk. Pawlu: Fejn? Lara: Hawn, ħdejn ħalqek. Ħu srievet.
colloquial.en: Lara: You have a smear of chocolate on your cheek. Pawlu: Where? Lara: Here, beside your mouth. Take a napkin.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你脸颊上有一抹巧克力。保罗：在哪里？拉拉：这里，嘴边。拿张餐巾纸吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek delka ta' ċikkulata fuq ħaddejk.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek delka ta' ċikkulata fuq ħaddejk.
messages.zh: 你脸颊上有一抹巧克力。
messages.en: You have a smear of chocolate on your cheek.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 在哪里？
messages.en: Where?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这里，嘴边。拿张餐巾纸吧。
messages.en: Here, beside your mouth. Take a napkin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指把巧克力轻轻抹开，脸上留下一道痕迹；用这个“一抹留下的痕迹”画面记住名词 delka。

gloss_zh: 企业迁移；经营活动转移

teaching_sense.en_definition: The relocation of a company or its business activities to another place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将企业或其经营活动从原所在地迁往另一地点的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih kumpanija jew l-attivitajiet tagħha jiġu ttrasferiti minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公司从原所在地向另一地点的迁移。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih kumpanija tiċċaqlaq mill-post fejn tkun stabbilita għal post ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Company migration is the process in which a company moves from its established location to another place.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将原本设在某地的经营活动转移至其他地点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-trasferiment ta' attivitajiet ekonomiċi mill-post fejn ikunu jsiru għal post ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Delocalisation occurs when business activities are transferred from their existing location to another place.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一家公司的迁移，或其经营活动所在地的转移。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-trasferiment ta' kumpanija jew tal-attivitajiet tagħha mill-post oriġinali għal post ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The delocalisation of a company involves moving the company or its operations to a different location.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 企业及其经营活动从原所在地向其他地点的迁移。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih impriżi jew l-attivitajiet tagħhom jiġu ttrasferiti minn post għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The migration of undertakings involves enterprises moving their businesses or operations from one location to another.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-ispejjeż tad-delokalizzazzjoni tal-produzzjoni u l-effetti tagħha fuq il-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The report examines the costs of relocating production and its effects on workers.
formal.zh: 该报告研究生产活动转移的成本及其对员工的影响。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Smajt li qed jippjanaw id-delokalizzazzjoni tal-produzzjoni. David: Jiġifieri se jmexxu l-produzzjoni għal post ieħor? Anna: Iva, imma għadhom ma qalux fejn.
colloquial.en: Anna: I heard they are planning to relocate production. David: Does that mean they will move production somewhere else? Anna: Yes, but they have not said where yet.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我听说他们正在计划转移生产活动。戴维：意思是要把生产搬到别的地方吗？安娜：是的，但还没说搬到哪里。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt li qed jippjanaw id-delokalizzazzjoni tal-produzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Smajt li qed jippjanaw id-delokalizzazzjoni tal-produzzjoni.
messages.zh: 我听说他们正在计划转移生产活动。
messages.en: I heard they are planning to relocate production.

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri se jmexxu l-produzzjoni għal post ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri se jmexxu l-produzzjoni għal post ieħor?
messages.zh: 意思是要把生产搬到别的地方吗？
messages.en: Does that mean they will move production somewhere else?

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għadhom ma qalux fejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għadhom ma qalux fejn.
messages.zh: 是的，但还没说搬到哪里。
messages.en: Yes, but they have not said where yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画两个地点，再画箭头把工厂的生产活动从甲地移到乙地；用“经营地点发生转移”的整幅图记住 delokalizzazzjoni。

gloss_zh: 公司迁移；公司经营活动转移

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of moving a company or its operations from one location to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把一家公司或其经营活动从一个地点迁往另一地点的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih kumpanija jew l-attivitajiet tagħha jitmexxew minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公司从原所在地迁往另一地点的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bidla fil-post fejn tkun stabbilita kumpanija meta din tiċċaqlaq għal post ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Company migration takes place when a company moves from its existing location to another place.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公司或其经营活动从原所在地向其他地点的转移。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-trasferiment ta' kumpanija jew tal-attivitajiet ekonomiċi tagħha lejn post differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Delocalisation is the transfer of a company or its business activities to a different location.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一家公司的迁址，或其经营活动地点的转移。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih kumpanija jew l-operazzjonijiet tagħha jiġu ttrasferiti mill-post oriġinali għal post ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The delocalisation of a company occurs when the company or its operations move to another location.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 企业或其经营活动向其他地点迁移。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-trasferiment ta' impriżi jew tal-attivitajiet tagħhom mill-post fejn ikunu stabbiliti għal post ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The migration of undertakings refers to enterprises transferring their businesses or activities from one place to another.

collocations.en: a plan for relocating a company
the impact of a company's relocation

formal.mt: Qabel tittieħed deċiżjoni dwar id-delokalizzazzjoni ta' kumpanija, għandhom jiġu evalwati l-ispejjeż u l-effetti fuq l-impjegati.
formal.en: Before a decision is made about relocating a company, the costs and effects on employees should be assessed.
formal.zh: 在作出公司迁移决定之前，应评估相关成本及其对员工的影响。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'jinvolvi l-pjan għad-delokalizzazzjoni ta' kumpanija? Ġużeppi: F'dan il-każ, iridu jmexxu l-uffiċċju u l-fabbrika għal belt oħra. Marija: U l-impjegati se jmorru magħhom? Ġużeppi: Għadhom qed jiddiskutu dan.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does the plan for relocating a company involve? Ġużeppi: In this case, they want to move the office and factory to another town. Marija: And will the employees move with them? Ġużeppi: They are still discussing that.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这个公司迁移计划涉及哪些内容？约瑟夫：这次他们想把办公室和工厂搬到另一个城镇。玛丽亚：员工也会一起搬过去吗？约瑟夫：他们还在讨论这个问题。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 这个公司迁移计划涉及哪些内容？
messages.en: What does the plan for relocating a company involve?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan il-każ, iridu jmexxu l-uffiċċju u l-fabbrika għal belt oħra.
messages.mt_standard: F'dan il-każ, iridu jmexxu l-uffiċċju u l-fabbrika għal belt oħra.
messages.zh: 这次他们想把办公室和工厂搬到另一个城镇。
messages.en: In this case, they want to move the office and factory to another town.

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 员工也会一起搬过去吗？
messages.en: And will the employees move with them?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (同事)
messages.zh: 他们还在讨论这个问题。
messages.en: They are still discussing that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成“delokalizzazzjoni＝迁移”和“ta' kumpanija＝一家公司的”两段理解，再想象公司把办公室搬到另一座城，连起来记成“公司迁移”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A channel through which water flows to irrigate agricultural land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供灌溉用水流过、将水输送到农田的渠道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kanal li minnu jgħaddi l-ilma biex jissaqqew l-għelieqi.

sense_translations.en_definition: Water passage for irrigation/kanal minnfejn jgħaddi l-ilma tat-tisqija
sense_translations.zh_definition: 输送灌溉用水的水道或渠道。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Demnuq huwa kanal li minnu jgħaddi l-ilma tat-tisqija lejn l-għelieqi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A demnuq is a channel that carries water used for irrigating fields.

collocations.en: the water flows through the irrigation channel

formal.mt: Qabel tibda t-tisqija, għandu jitnaddaf id-demnuq sabiex l-ilma jkun jista' jgħaddi mingħajr xkiel.
formal.en: Before irrigation begins, the channel should be cleaned so that water can flow without obstruction.
formal.zh: 开始灌溉前，应清理水渠，使水能够畅通流过。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex l-ilma mhux jasal sal-ħaxix? Pawlu: Id-demnuq mimli weraq. Ħa nnaddfu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why isn't the water reaching the vegetables? Pawlu: The irrigation channel is full of leaves. Let me clean it.
colloquial.zh: Marta：水怎么没流到蔬菜那里？Pawlu：灌溉水渠里全是树叶。我来清理一下。

messages.speaker: Marta (菜农)
messages.zh: 水怎么没流到蔬菜那里？
messages.en: Why isn't the water reaching the vegetables?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 灌溉水渠里全是树叶。我来清理一下。
messages.en: The irrigation channel is full of leaves. Let me clean it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 demnuq 放进农田画面记忆：水沿着一条小渠流到菜地，这条灌溉水道就是 demnuq。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deserving respect, trust, recognition, or a particular reward.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有相应的品质或表现，值得获得尊重、信任、认可或某种奖励。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jistħoqqlu rispett, fiduċja, rikonoxximent jew premju minħabba l-kwalitajiet jew l-għemil tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 值得获得某种尊重、信任或待遇的；配得上的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta xi ħadd ikun den ta' xi ħaġa, ikun jistħoqqlu dik il-ħaġa minħabba l-kwalitajiet jew l-għemil tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is worthy of something deserves it because of their qualities or actions.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat qies lill-kandidat den tal-premju minħabba s-servizz tiegħu lill-komunità.
formal.en: The committee considered the candidate worthy of the award because of his service to the community.
formal.zh: 委员会认为，该候选人为社区作出了贡献，配得上这一奖项。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taħseb li Mark den ta' fiduċja? Nina: Iva, dejjem iżomm kelmtu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you think Mark is worthy of trust? Nina: Yes, he always keeps his word.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你觉得 Mark 值得信任吗？Nina：值得，他一向说到做到。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li Mark den ta' fiduċja?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li Mark den ta' fiduċja?
messages.zh: 你觉得 Mark 值得信任吗？
messages.en: Do you think Mark is worthy of trust?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 值得，他一向说到做到。
messages.en: Yes, he always keeps his word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 den 与“配得上”一起记：配得上尊重、配得上信任、配得上奖项，重点是品质或表现值得肯定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show displeasure by becoming sullen and unwilling to talk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因不高兴而绷着脸、少说话或不愿理人，以此表现自己的不满。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri li mhux kuntent billi jqarras wiċċu u ma jkunx irid jitkellem jew jikkomunika ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因不满或受了委屈而闹别扭，绷着脸不愿与人交谈。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta xi ħadd idendel geddumu, juri n-nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon tiegħu billi jqarras wiċċu u ma jkunx irid jitkellem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone sulks, they show that they are upset by becoming sullen and refusing to talk normally.

collocations.zh: 他输了以后闹起了别扭

collocations.mt: dendel geddumu għax ma ngħatax dak li ried
collocations.en: he sulked because he was not given what he wanted
collocations.zh: 他因为没有得到想要的东西而生闷气

formal.mt: Meta sar jaf li ma kienx intgħażel għat-tim, it-tifel dendel geddumu u baqa' bilqiegħda waħdu.
formal.en: When he learned that he had not been selected for the team, the boy sulked and remained seated on his own.
formal.zh: 得知自己没有入选球队后，男孩闹起了别扭，独自坐着。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Ben ma jridx ikellimna? Toni: Dendel geddumu għax tlifna l-logħba.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why doesn't Ben want to talk to us? Toni: He's sulking because we lost the game.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Ben 怎么不愿意跟我们说话？Toni：我们输了比赛，他正闹别扭呢。

messages.speaker: Marija (队友)
messages.zh: Ben 怎么不愿意跟我们说话？
messages.en: Why doesn't Ben want to talk to us?

messages.speaker: Toni (队友)
messages.zh: 我们输了比赛，他正闹别扭呢。
messages.en: He's sulking because we lost the game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一个输了比赛后绷着脸、不肯说话的男孩，用整幅情景记 dendel geddumu：他闹起了别扭。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To push the lips forward to show annoyance or displeasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把嘴唇向前噘起，用表情表示恼怒或不满。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ xofftejh 'il barra biex juri li huwa mdejjaq jew mhux kuntent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 噘起嘴唇，以表示不高兴、恼怒或不满。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta xi ħadd idendel xofftejh, joħroġ xofftejh 'il barra bħala sinjal li huwa mdejjaq jew mhux kuntent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone pouts, they push their lips forward to show that they are annoyed or unhappy.

collocations.en: he pouted when he heard the answer
collocations.zh: 他听到答复后噘起了嘴

formal.mt: Meta l-għalliem spjega li l-ħin tal-logħob kien spiċċa, it-tifel dendel xofftejh iżda poġġa l-ġugarell f'postu.
formal.en: When the teacher explained that playtime was over, the boy pouted but put the toy back in its place.
formal.zh: 老师说明游戏时间已经结束时，男孩噘起了嘴，但还是把玩具放回了原处。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Leo dendel xofftejh? Rita: Ried ġelat ieħor, imma għedtlu li wieħed biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did Leo pout? Rita: He wanted another ice cream, but I told him one was enough.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Leo 怎么噘起嘴来了？Rita：他还想再吃一个冰淇淋，但我告诉他吃一个就够了。

messages.speaker: Anna (阿姨)
messages.zh: Leo 怎么噘起嘴来了？
messages.en: Why did Leo pout?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried ġelat ieħor, imma għedtlu li wieħed biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Ried ġelat ieħor, imma għedtlu li wieħed biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 他还想再吃一个冰淇淋，但我告诉他吃一个就够了。
messages.en: He wanted another ice cream, but I told him one was enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子没吃到第二个冰淇淋，嘴唇向前噘起；把这个嘴部表情与 dendel xofftejh 一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deserving respect, praise, trust, or some other valued response.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 值得获得尊重、赞扬、信任或其他肯定的；配得上某种待遇的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jistħoqqlu rispett, tifħir, fiduċja jew xi forma oħra ta' apprezzament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 值得获得某种肯定、尊重或待遇的；配得上的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu kwalitajiet jew merti li jagħmluh jistħoqqlu xi ħaġa tajba, bħar-rispett jew it-tifħir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is worthy of something, they deserve it because of their qualities or actions.

formal.mt: L-impenn tiegħu biex jgħin lill-komunità huwa denju ta' tifħir.
formal.en: His commitment to helping the community is worthy of praise.
formal.zh: 他致力于帮助社区的精神值得赞扬。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li Mark huwa denju ta' fiduċja? Lara: Iva, dejjem iżomm kelmtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think Mark is worthy of trust? Lara: Yes, he always keeps his word.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得马克值得信任吗？拉拉：值得，他总是信守承诺。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li Mark huwa denju ta' fiduċja?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li Mark huwa denju ta' fiduċja?
messages.zh: 你觉得马克值得信任吗？
messages.en: Do you think Mark is worthy of trust?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 值得，他总是信守承诺。
messages.en: Yes, he always keeps his word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 denju 与“值得”一起记：值得尊重是 denju ta' rispett，值得赞扬是 denju ta' tifħir。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The amount of mass in a given volume, or the concentration of people or things within a given space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 单位体积内物质的质量；也指一定空间内人口或事物的密集程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-massa ta' sustanza għal kull unità ta' volum, jew kemm hemm nies jew oġġetti fi spazju partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 物质在单位体积内的质量，或人口、事物在一定空间内的密集程度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kejl tal-massa f'volum partikolari ta' sustanza, jew tal-konċentrazzjoni ta' nies jew oġġetti f'żona jew spazju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The density of a substance is its mass per unit of volume, while the density of people or objects describes how closely they are concentrated.

formal.mt: Id-densità tal-popolazzjoni tiġi kkalkulata billi n-numru ta' abitanti jinqasam bl-erja taż-żona.
formal.en: Population density is calculated by dividing the number of inhabitants by the area of the region.
formal.zh: 人口密度通过将居民人数除以该地区的面积来计算。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex iż-żejt jibqa' fuq l-ilma? Mark: Għax għandu densità aktar baxxa minn dik tal-ilma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the oil stay on top of the water? Mark: Because it has a lower density than water.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么油会浮在水上？马克：因为它的密度比水低。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 为什么油会浮在水上？
messages.en: Why does the oil stay on top of the water?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandu densità aktar baxxa minn dik tal-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandu densità aktar baxxa minn dik tal-ilma.
messages.zh: 因为它的密度比水低。
messages.en: Because it has a lower density than water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个同样大的盒子，装得更重的那个密度更高；用这个画面记住 densità，也可联想到一片区域里人口的密集程度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A removable set of artificial teeth used to replace missing natural teeth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于替代缺失天然牙齿的一副可摘戴假牙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sett ta' snien artifiċjali li jista' jitneħħa mill-ħalq u li jieħu post snien naturali neqsin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 替代缺失天然牙齿的可摘戴义齿或假牙。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett ta' snien artifiċjali magħmul biex jitqiegħed fil-ħalq minflok snien naturali li jkunu neqsin u li jista' jitneħħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A denture is a removable set of artificial teeth that replaces some or all of a person's missing natural teeth.

formal.mt: Id-dentist spjega lill-pazjent kif juża d-dentiera l-ġdida.
formal.en: The dentist explained to the patient how to use the new denture.
formal.zh: 牙医向患者说明了新假牙的使用方法。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn poġġejt id-dentiera tiegħi? Pawlu: Qiegħda fil-kaxxa ħdejn is-sodda.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where did you put my denture? Pawlu: It's in the box beside the bed.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你把我的假牙放在哪里了？保罗：在床边的盒子里。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 你把我的假牙放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put my denture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.zh: 在床边的盒子里。
messages.en: It's in the box beside the bed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象床边盒子里放着一副假牙，把这个具体物品与 dentiera 配对记忆；注意它指假牙，不是给人看牙的牙医。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trained professional who examines and treats teeth, gums, and other parts of the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接受专业训练，负责检查和治疗牙齿、牙龈及其他口腔问题的医疗人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Professjonist imħarreġ li jeżamina u jittratta s-snien, il-ħanek u problemi oħra tal-ħalq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从事牙齿、牙龈及相关口腔疾病检查与治疗的医生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna kwalifikata fil-kura tas-snien u tal-ħanek li teżamina l-ħalq u tittratta problemi tas-saħħa orali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dentist is a qualified professional who examines and treats problems affecting your teeth, gums, and mouth.

formal.mt: Id-dentist eżamina s-snien tal-pazjent u spjega t-trattament propost.
formal.en: The dentist examined the patient's teeth and explained the proposed treatment.
formal.zh: 牙医检查了患者的牙齿，并说明了建议的治疗方案。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nixtieq appuntament għand id-dentist, jekk jogħġbok. Lara: Tista' tiġi għada fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu?
colloquial.en: Mark: I'd like a dental appointment, please. Lara: Can you come tomorrow at nine in the morning?
colloquial.zh: 马克：我想预约看牙医，谢谢。拉拉：你明天上午九点能来吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq appuntament għand id-dentist, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq appuntament għand id-dentist, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 我想预约看牙医，谢谢。
messages.en: I'd like a dental appointment, please.

messages.speaker: Lara (诊所接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tiġi għada fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tiġi għada fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu?
messages.zh: 你明天上午九点能来吗？
messages.en: Can you come tomorrow at nine in the morning?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dentist 记成诊所里拿着小镜子检查牙齿的人，再整句记住 appuntament għand id-dentist，表示预约看牙医。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A warehouse where goods are stored under customs control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在海关监管下存放货物的仓库，可指保税仓库或海关仓库。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħżen fejn tinżamm merkanzija taħt il-kontroll tad-dwana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保税仓库，指在海关监管下存放尚未缴纳相关进口税费货物的仓库。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Maħżen taħt il-kontroll tad-dwana fejn tinżamm merkanzija li d-dazju fuqha jkun għadu ma tħallasx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bonded warehouse is a place where imported goods are stored under customs control before the relevant duties are paid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关仓库，指在海关监管下储存货物的仓库。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Maħżen fejn il-merkanzija tinżamm taħt is-sorveljanza tad-dwana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs warehouse is a storage facility in which goods are kept under the supervision of customs authorities.

collocations.en: put the goods into the customs warehouse

formal.mt: Il-merkanzija se tinżamm fid-depost taħt il-kontroll tad-dwana sakemm jitlestew il-proċeduri meħtieġa.
formal.en: The goods will be kept in the customs warehouse under customs control until the required procedures are completed.
formal.zh: 货物将在海关仓库内接受海关监管，直至所需手续办理完毕。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn qegħdin il-kaxxi? Rita: Għadhom fid-depost. Mark: Mela għadna ma nistgħux niġbruhom? Rita: Le, irridu nistennew sakemm jitlestew il-proċeduri tad-dwana.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where are the boxes? Rita: They are still in the customs warehouse. Mark: So we cannot collect them yet? Rita: No, we need to wait until the customs procedures are completed.
colloquial.zh: 马克：箱子在哪里？丽塔：还在海关仓库里。马克：所以我们还不能去取吗？丽塔：还不能，我们得等海关手续办完。

messages.speaker: Mark (进口商)
messages.zh: 箱子在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the boxes?

messages.speaker: Rita (货运代理)
messages.zh: 还在海关仓库里。
messages.en: They are still in the customs warehouse.

messages.speaker: Mark (进口商)
messages.zh: 所以我们还不能去取吗？
messages.en: So we cannot collect them yet?

messages.speaker: Rita (货运代理)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, irridu nistennew sakemm jitlestew il-proċeduri tad-dwana.
messages.mt_standard: Le, irridu nistennew sakemm jitlestew il-proċeduri tad-dwana.
messages.zh: 还不能，我们得等海关手续办完。
messages.en: No, we need to wait until the customs procedures are completed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 depost 放进“货物等海关手续”的画面中记忆：箱子已经入库，却仍受海关监管。用这个场景联结“保税仓库”和“海关仓库”两个义项。

gloss_zh: 公共海关仓库；公用保税仓库

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs warehouse available for use by different traders.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可供不同商户使用、在海关监管下存放货物的公共仓库。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħżen taħt il-kontroll tad-dwana li jkun disponibbli għall-użu minn negozjanti differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共海关仓库，指供不同商户使用、用于在海关监管下储存货物的仓库。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Depost taħt is-sorveljanza tad-dwana li jista' jintuża minn negozjanti differenti biex jaħżnu l-merkanzija tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public customs warehouse is a facility where different traders can store their goods under customs supervision.

collocations.en: store goods in a public customs warehouse
collocations.zh: 在公共海关仓库内储存货物

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija se tuża depost pubbliku biex taħżen il-merkanzija importata taħt is-sorveljanza tad-dwana.
formal.en: The company will use a public customs warehouse to store the imported goods under customs supervision.
formal.zh: 公司将使用公共海关仓库，在海关监管下存放进口货物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandna bżonn maħżen tagħna stess għal din il-merkanzija? Pawlu: Nistgħu nużaw depost pubbliku. Lara: Jistgħu jużawh negozjanti oħra wkoll? Pawlu: Iva, mhux aħna biss.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do we need our own warehouse for these goods? Paul: We can use a public customs warehouse. Lara: Can other traders use it too? Paul: Yes, we are not the only ones.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这批货需要我们有自己的仓库吗？保罗：我们可以使用公共海关仓库。拉拉：其他商户也能用吗？保罗：可以，不只是我们能用。

messages.speaker: Lara (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna bżonn maħżen tagħna stess għal din il-merkanzija?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna bżonn maħżen tagħna stess għal din il-merkanzija?
messages.zh: 这批货需要我们有自己的仓库吗？
messages.en: Do we need our own warehouse for these goods?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (物流经理)
messages.zh: 我们可以使用公共海关仓库。
messages.en: We can use a public customs warehouse.

messages.speaker: Lara (采购员)
messages.zh: 其他商户也能用吗？
messages.en: Can other traders use it too?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (物流经理)
messages.zh: 可以，不只是我们能用。
messages.en: Yes, we are not the only ones.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 depost pubbliku 想成“多家商户共用的海关仓库”：depost 对应仓库场景，pubbliku 提醒你注意公用性质，不要据此推断仓库一定由政府拥有。

gloss_zh: 不可用的存款；暂时无法动用的存款

teaching_sense.en_definition: A deposit that cannot currently be accessed or used.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 目前无法提取或使用的存款；该短语本身不说明无法使用的具体原因。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Depożitu ta' flus li bħalissa ma jistax jiġi aċċessat jew użat, mingħajr ma l-espressjoni tispeċifika r-raġuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可用的存款，指当前无法提取或动用的存款，具体原因需由上下文说明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus depożitata li bħalissa ma tistax tinġibed jew tintuża; ir-raġuni trid tkun spjegata mill-kuntest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An unavailable deposit is money that has been deposited but cannot currently be accessed or used.

collocations.en: the status of an unavailable deposit

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri depożitu mhux disponibbli u jitlob kjarifika dwar meta l-flus ikunu jistgħu jintużaw.
formal.en: The report shows an unavailable deposit and requests clarification on when the money can be used.
formal.zh: 报告显示有一笔不可用的存款，并要求说明该笔资金何时可以使用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fl-app qed nara depożitu mhux disponibbli. Nista' nuża dawk il-flus? David: Bħalissa le. Nina: Taf meta se jkunu disponibbli? David: Irridu niċċekkjaw mad-dipartiment responsabbli.
colloquial.en: Nina: I can see an unavailable deposit in the app. Can I use that money? David: Not at the moment. Nina: Do you know when it will be available? David: We need to check with the department responsible.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：应用里显示一笔不可用的存款。我能用那笔钱吗？大卫：目前不能。妮娜：你知道什么时候可以用吗？大卫：我们需要向负责的部门核实。

messages.speaker: Nina (银行客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-app qed nara depożitu mhux disponibbli. Nista' nuża dawk il-flus?
messages.mt_standard: Fl-app qed nara depożitu mhux disponibbli. Nista' nuża dawk il-flus?
messages.zh: 应用里显示一笔不可用的存款。我能用那笔钱吗？
messages.en: I can see an unavailable deposit in the app. Can I use that money?

messages.speaker: David (银行客服)
messages.zh: 目前不能。
messages.en: Not at the moment.

messages.speaker: Nina (银行客户)
messages.zh: 你知道什么时候可以用吗？
messages.en: Do you know when it will be available?

messages.speaker: David (银行客服)
messages.zh: 我们需要向负责的部门核实。
messages.en: We need to check with the department responsible.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象账户里看得到一笔存款，但“使用”按钮暂时不可点：用这个画面记住 mhux disponibbli 表示当前不可用；不要自动把原因记成冻结或定期限制。

gloss_zh: 行李寄存处；行李寄存服务

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place or service where travellers can leave their luggage temporarily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供旅客暂时存放行李、稍后取回的寄存处或寄存服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post jew servizz fejn il-vjaġġaturi jistgħu jħallu l-bagalji tagħhom għal xi żmien u jiġbruhom aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行李寄存处或行李寄存服务，供旅客临时存放并稍后取回行李。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post jew servizz għall-ħażna temporanja tal-bagalji, sabiex il-vjaġġaturi jkunu jistgħu jħalluhom hemm u jerġgħu jiġbruhom aktar tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A baggage deposit is a place or service where travellers leave their luggage temporarily and collect it later.

collocations.en: leave luggage at the baggage deposit
collocations.zh: 把行李放在行李寄存处

collocations.en: the opening hours of the baggage deposit
collocations.zh: 行李寄存处的营业时间

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġaturi jistgħu jħallu l-bagalji tagħhom fid-depożitu tal-bagalji u jiġbruhom qabel il-ħin tal-għeluq.
formal.en: Travellers may leave their luggage at the baggage deposit and collect it before closing time.
formal.zh: 旅客可以将行李存放在行李寄存处，并在关门前取回。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn nista' nħalli din il-bagalja għal sagħtejn? Mark: Hemm depożitu tal-bagalji ħdejn id-daħla. Sara: Nista' niġborha qabel it-tlieta? Mark: Iva, inkunu miftuħin sa wara nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where can I leave this suitcase for two hours? Mark: There is a baggage deposit near the entrance. Sara: Can I collect it before three? Mark: Yes, we will be open into the afternoon.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这只行李箱可以在哪里寄存两个小时？马克：入口附近有行李寄存处。萨拉：我可以在三点前取回吗？马克：可以，我们会一直营业到下午。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nħalli din il-bagalja għal sagħtejn?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nħalli din il-bagalja għal sagħtejn?
messages.zh: 这只行李箱可以在哪里寄存两个小时？
messages.en: Where can I leave this suitcase for two hours?

messages.speaker: Mark (寄存处工作人员)
messages.zh: 入口附近有行李寄存处。
messages.en: There is a baggage deposit near the entrance.

messages.speaker: Sara (旅客)
messages.zh: 我可以在三点前取回吗？
messages.en: Can I collect it before three?

messages.speaker: Mark (寄存处工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inkunu miftuħin sa wara nofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inkunu miftuħin sa wara nofsinhar.
messages.zh: 可以，我们会一直营业到下午。
messages.en: Yes, we will be open into the afternoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 depożitu tal-bagalji 连成“放下行李、轻装游览、回来取走”三个动作记忆；看到 bagalji 就联想到行李，整组短语对应临时寄存的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The total depreciation recorded for an asset up to a particular date.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 截至某一日期，已为某项资产累计计提的折旧总额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-total tad-deprezzament irreġistrat għal assi sa data partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某项资产截至指定日期已计提的折旧累计总额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-somma tad-deprezzament kollu li jkun ġie rreġistrat għal assi sa data speċifika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Accumulated depreciation is the total depreciation recorded against an asset over time up to a specified date.

collocations.en: the accumulated depreciation of the machinery

formal.mt: Ir-rapport finanzjarju juri l-ispiża oriġinali tal-makkinarju u d-deprezzament akkumulat tiegħu sal-aħħar tas-sena.
formal.en: The financial report shows the original cost of the machinery and its accumulated depreciation up to the end of the year.
formal.zh: 财务报告列示了机器设备的原始成本及其截至年末的累计折旧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-ammont huwa d-deprezzament ta' din is-sena biss? Mark: Le, huwa d-deprezzament akkumulat; jiġbor id-deprezzament irreġistrat s'issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this amount just this year's depreciation? Mark: No, it is accumulated depreciation; it includes the depreciation recorded so far.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这笔金额只是今年的折旧吗？马克：不是，这是累计折旧，包含截至目前已计提的折旧。

messages.speaker: Maja (会计实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-ammont huwa d-deprezzament ta' din is-sena biss?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-ammont huwa d-deprezzament ta' din is-sena biss?
messages.zh: 这笔金额只是今年的折旧吗？
messages.en: Is this amount just this year's depreciation?

messages.speaker: Mark (会计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa d-deprezzament akkumulat; jiġbor id-deprezzament irreġistrat s'issa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa d-deprezzament akkumulat; jiġbor id-deprezzament irreġistrat s'issa.
messages.zh: 不是，这是累计折旧，包含截至目前已计提的折旧。
messages.en: No, it is accumulated depreciation; it includes the depreciation recorded so far.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把每年计提的折旧逐年相加：整叠金额就是累计折旧，别只记成当年折旧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sideways sliding movement of a vehicle, especially while taking a bend.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 车辆行驶时，尤其在转弯过程中，向侧面滑动的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment li fih vettura tiżżerżaq lejn il-ġenb, speċjalment waqt li tkun qed tieħu kurva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 车辆发生的横向滑动，尤指转弯时的漂移或侧滑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żliq lejn il-ġenb ta' vettura waqt li tkun miexja, b'mod partikolari meta tkun qed iddur f'kurva.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A drift is a movement in which a vehicle slides sideways, especially as it travels around a bend.

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni fuq il-korsa magħluqa, is-sewwieq wettaq derapata kkontrollata fil-kurva.
formal.en: During the demonstration on the closed track, the driver performed a controlled drift around the bend.
formal.zh: 在封闭赛道的演示中，驾驶员在弯道完成了一次受控漂移。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt id-derapata li għamlet dik il-karozza fil-kurva? Pawlu: Iva, żelqet lejn il-ġenb, imma s-sewwieq reġa' ħa l-kontroll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see that car drift around the bend? Pawlu: Yes, it slid sideways, but the driver regained control.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到那辆车在弯道侧滑了吗？保罗：看到了，车向侧面滑了一下，不过驾驶员重新控制住了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt id-derapata li għamlet dik il-karozza fil-kurva?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt id-derapata li għamlet dik il-karozza fil-kurva?
messages.zh: 你看到那辆车在弯道侧滑了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that car drift around the bend?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żelqet lejn il-ġenb, imma s-sewwieq reġa' ħa l-kontroll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żelqet lejn il-ġenb, imma s-sewwieq reġa' ħa l-kontroll.
messages.zh: 看到了，车向侧面滑了一下，不过驾驶员重新控制住了。
messages.en: Yes, it slid sideways, but the driver regained control.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用弯道上车身向侧面滑动的画面记住 derapata，把词义和车辆漂移的动作连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The reduction or removal of official rules controlling an industry or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 减少或取消对某个行业或某项活动实行的官方监管规定的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitnaqqsu jew jitneħħew regoli uffiċjali li jirregolaw settur jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减少或撤销政府等官方机构对行业或活动施加的管制规定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tnaqqis jew it-tneħħija ta' regoli imposti mill-awtoritajiet fuq settur ekonomiku jew attività partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Deregulation is the process of reducing or removing official rules that control how an industry or activity operates.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina jekk id-deregolamentazzjoni tas-settur tistax iżżid il-kompetizzjoni u tnaqqas il-prezzijiet.
formal.en: The study examines whether deregulation of the sector could increase competition and reduce prices.
formal.zh: 该研究考察放松该行业的管制是否可能增加竞争并降低价格。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser id-deregolamentazzjoni f'din il-proposta? David: Tfisser li jitnaqqsu xi regoli li jikkontrollaw kif jaħdmu l-kumpaniji fis-settur.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does deregulation mean in this proposal? David: It means reducing some of the rules that control how companies in the sector operate.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这份提案中的放松管制是什么意思？戴维：意思是减少一些约束该行业公司如何经营的规定。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 这份提案中的放松管制是什么意思？
messages.en: What does deregulation mean in this proposal?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li jitnaqqsu xi regoli li jikkontrollaw kif jaħdmu l-kumpaniji fis-settur.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li jitnaqqsu xi regoli li jikkontrollaw kif jaħdmu l-kumpaniji fis-settur.
messages.zh: 意思是减少一些约束该行业公司如何经营的规定。
messages.en: It means reducing some of the rules that control how companies in the sector operate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把行业规则清单中的部分限制划掉，用“减少管制”的画面记住这个长词。

gloss_zh: 衍生的；由其他事物得出的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Obtained, developed, or formed from something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从其他事物获得、发展或形成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun inkiseb, żviluppa jew ġie ffurmat minn xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由另一事物产生、形成或推导而来的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkollu l-oriġini tiegħu f'xi ħaġa oħra jew ikun inkiseb permezz tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is derived comes from another source or is obtained by using information or material from it.

collocations.en: a value derived from the data

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta valur derivat mill-kejl kollu li sar waqt l-esperiment.
formal.en: The report presents a value derived from all the measurements taken during the experiment.
formal.zh: 报告给出了一个根据实验期间全部测量结果推导出的数值。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-valur kejltu direttament? Mark: Le, huwa derivat minn tliet kejlijiet oħra; ikkalkulajtu minnhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you measure this value directly? Mark: No, it is derived from three other measurements; I calculated it from them.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个数值是你直接测出来的吗？马克：不是，它是由另外三次测量推导出来的；我是根据那些结果算出来的。

messages.speaker: Sara (实验搭档)
messages.zh: 这个数值是你直接测出来的吗？
messages.en: Did you measure this value directly?

messages.speaker: Mark (实验搭档)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa derivat minn tliet kejlijiet oħra; ikkalkulajtu minnhom.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa derivat minn tliet kejlijiet oħra; ikkalkulajtu minnhom.
messages.zh: 不是，它是由另外三次测量推导出来的；我是根据那些结果算出来的。
messages.en: No, it is derived from three other measurements; I calculated it from them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一支从原始数据指向计算结果的箭头：结果是 derivat，搭配 minn 表示其来源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A desk is a table used for writing, studying, or office work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于写字、学习或处理办公事务的桌子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Desk huwa mejda li tintuża għall-kitba, għall-istudju jew għax-xogħol tal-uffiċċju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供写字、学习或办公使用的书桌或办公桌。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Desk huwa mejda li fuqha persuna tikteb, tistudja jew tagħmel xogħol tal-uffiċċju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A desk is a table where you write, study, or do office work.

formal.mt: Kull impjegat għandu desk b'kompjuter u spazju għall-kitba.
formal.en: Each employee has a desk with a computer and space for writing.
formal.zh: 每位员工都有一张办公桌，桌上配有电脑，并留有书写空间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn ħallejt il-ktieb tiegħi? Mark: Fuq id-desk, ħdejn il-kompjuter.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you leave my book? Mark: On the desk, next to the computer.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你把我的书放在哪里了？Mark：在书桌上，电脑旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把我的书放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you leave my book?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在书桌上，电脑旁边。
messages.en: On the desk, next to the computer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把电脑、书本和抽屉想成一组书桌画面，连读 fuq id-desk，记住“在书桌上”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something described has had its features or details expressed in words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 其特征、情况或细节已用语言说明的；所述的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa deskritta tkun ġiet spjegata bil-kliem billi jkunu ngħataw il-karatteristiċi jew id-dettalji tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被用语言描述或说明的；文中或话语中所述的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta xi ħaġa tkun deskritta, il-karatteristiċi jew id-dettalji tagħha jkunu ġew espressi bil-kliem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is described, its features or details have been expressed in words.

formal.mt: Il-proċess deskritt f'dan ir-rapport jinkludi tliet stadji ewlenin.
formal.en: The process described in this report includes three main stages.
formal.zh: 本报告所述的过程包括三个主要阶段。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inhu l-appartament? Pawlu: Fir-reklam hu deskritt bħala żgħir iżda komdu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the apartment like? Pawlu: In the advert, it is described as small but comfortable.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那套公寓怎么样？Pawlu：广告上把它描述为面积小但很舒适。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那套公寓怎么样？
messages.en: What is the apartment like?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fir-reklam hu deskritt bħala żgħir iżda komdu.
messages.mt_standard: Fir-reklam hu deskritt bħala żgħir iżda komdu.
messages.zh: 广告上把它描述为面积小但很舒适。
messages.en: In the advert, it is described as small but comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象报告中某个过程已经被文字说明，用 il-proċess deskritt 整组记住“所述过程”；deskritt 是阳性单数形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A commercial or trade description gives information about goods or services offered for sale.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在商业销售中介绍商品或服务的性质、特点等信息的描述或说明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Deskrizzjoni kummerċjali hija tagħrif dwar in-natura u l-karatteristiċi ta' prodott jew servizz offrut għall-bejgħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为介绍或销售商品、服务而提供的商业性描述。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Deskrizzjoni kummerċjali hija preżentazzjoni bil-kliem ta' prodott jew servizz biex tagħti informazzjoni dwaru lil klijenti possibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A commercial description presents a product or service to people who may want to buy it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 商业活动中对商品的材料、尺寸、用途等特征所作的说明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Deskrizzjoni kummerċjali hija stqarrija dwar il-karatteristiċi ta' oġġett għall-bejgħ, bħall-materjal, id-daqs jew l-użu tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trade description states characteristics of goods offered for sale, such as their material, size, or intended use.

collocations.zh: 具有误导性的商品说明

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni kummerċjali tal-borża tispeċifika l-materjal, id-daqs u n-numru ta' bwiet.
formal.en: The bag's trade description specifies its material, size, and number of pockets.
formal.zh: 这款包的商品说明列明了材质、尺寸和口袋数量。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-borża hi tal-ġilda? David: Skont id-deskrizzjoni kummerċjali, hi magħmula minn materjal sintetiku.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this bag made of leather? David: According to the trade description, it is made of synthetic material.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个包是真皮的吗？David：根据商品说明，它是用合成材料做的。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个包是真皮的吗？
messages.en: Is this bag made of leather?

messages.speaker: David (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Skont id-deskrizzjoni kummerċjali, hi magħmula minn materjal sintetiku.
messages.mt_standard: Skont id-deskrizzjoni kummerċjali, hi magħmula minn materjal sintetiku.
messages.zh: 根据商品说明，它是用合成材料做的。
messages.en: According to the trade description, it is made of synthetic material.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象购物页上一栏写着材质、尺寸和用途，把整组 deskrizzjoni kummerċjali 对应为“商业中的商品说明”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tyrant is a ruler or person in authority who uses power cruelly or oppressively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 残酷或压迫性地行使权力的统治者，也可指行事专横、强迫别人服从的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Despota huwa ħakkiem jew persuna f'pożizzjoni ta' awtorità li tuża l-poter b'mod krudili jew oppressiv u ġġiegħel lill-oħrajn jobduha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滥用权力、残酷压迫他人的暴君；也用于形容专横地控制他人的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Despota huwa ħakkiem li jaħkem bil-moħqrija u ma jaċċettax oppożizzjoni; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għal persuna li tikkmanda lill-oħrajn b'mod aħrax u arbitrarju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tyrant is someone who uses authority cruelly and forces others to obey.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, id-despota jikkastiga lil kull min jikkritika d-deċiżjonijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the tyrant punishes anyone who criticizes his decisions.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，暴君会惩罚任何批评他决策的人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-kap jisma' l-opinjonijiet tagħkom? Karl: Qatt! Iġib ruħu bħal despota u jrid jiddeċiedi kollox hu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does the boss listen to your opinions? Karl: Never! He behaves like a tyrant and wants to decide everything himself.
colloquial.zh: Nina：老板会听你们的意见吗？Karl：从来不会！他像个暴君，什么都要自己决定。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 老板会听你们的意见吗？
messages.en: Does the boss listen to your opinions?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qatt! Iġib ruħu bħal despota u jrid jiddeċiedi kollox hu.
messages.mt_standard: Qatt! Iġib ruħu bħal despota u jrid jiddeċiedi kollox hu.
messages.zh: 从来不会！他像个暴君，什么都要自己决定。
messages.en: Never! He behaves like a tyrant and wants to decide everything himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个拍桌命令“全都听我的”的人物，用 bħal despota 记住“像暴君一样”，同时记住这个词带有强烈贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The person or entity to whom an offer is addressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要约所针对并向其提出的个人或实体，即接收要约的一方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-persuna jew l-entità li lilha tkun indirizzata offerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受要约人，即要约向其提出的个人或实体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità li tirċievi offerta indirizzata lilha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An offeree is the person or entity to whom someone makes an offer.

collocations.zh: 向受要约人发出的通知

formal.mt: Id-destinatarju tal-offerta għandu jaqra l-kundizzjonijiet kollha qabel ma jwieġeb.
formal.en: The offeree should read all the conditions before responding.
formal.zh: 受要约人在答复前应阅读全部条件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu d-destinatarju tal-offerta? Pawlu: Jien. L-offerta hi indirizzata lili, u għadni qed naħseb dwarha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the offeree? Pawlu: I am. The offer is addressed to me, and I am still thinking about it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁是这份要约的接收方？保罗：是我。这份要约是向我提出的，我还在考虑。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 谁是这份要约的接收方？
messages.en: Who is the offeree?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. L-offerta hi indirizzata lili, u għadni qed naħseb dwarha.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. L-offerta hi indirizzata lili, u għadni qed naħseb dwarha.
messages.zh: 是我。这份要约是向我提出的，我还在考虑。
messages.en: I am. The offer is addressed to me, and I am still thinking about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份写着收件人姓名的要约：姓名指向谁，谁就是 destinatarju tal-offerta；记住他是接收要约的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or entity that holds a particular right.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持有某项特定权利的个人或实体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità li għandha dritt partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 该项权利的持有人，即拥有所指权利的个人或实体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-persuna jew l-entità li għandha d-dritt imsemmi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The holder of the right is the person or entity that has the particular right being discussed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 权利人，即持有某项权利的个人或实体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità li għandha dritt partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A right holder is a person or entity that holds a particular right.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 权利持有人，即持有某项权利的个人或实体；对应英语带连字符的写法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità li għandha dritt partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A right-holder is a person or entity that holds a particular right.

collocations.en: the identity of the right holder

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika lid-detentur tad-dritt u jiddeskrivi d-dritt li għandu.
formal.en: The report identifies the right holder and describes the right they hold.
formal.zh: 报告指明了权利持有人，并描述了其持有的权利。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min hu d-detentur tad-dritt li jissemma fid-dokument? Ġorġ: Il-kumpanija tagħna. Isimha jidher fl-ewwel paġna.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who is the holder of the right mentioned in the document? Ġorġ: Our company. Its name appears on the first page.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：文件中提到的那项权利由谁持有？乔治：我们公司。公司名称就在第一页。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu d-detentur tad-dritt li jissemma fid-dokument?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu d-detentur tad-dritt li jissemma fid-dokument?
messages.zh: 文件中提到的那项权利由谁持有？
messages.en: Who is the holder of the right mentioned in the document?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpanija tagħna. Isimha jidher fl-ewwel paġna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpanija tagħna. Isimha jidher fl-ewwel paġna.
messages.zh: 我们公司。公司名称就在第一页。
messages.en: Our company. Its name appears on the first page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把某项权利想象成一张写着持有人姓名的卡片：看到 detentur tad-dritt，就问“这项权利在谁手里？”

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or entity that holds an authorisation to carry out a specified activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持有授权、获准开展某项特定活动的个人或实体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità li għandha awtorizzazzjoni biex twettaq attività speċifika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 授权持有人，即持有授权并获准开展特定活动的个人或实体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità li għandha awtorizzazzjoni biex twettaq attività partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An authorisation holder is a person or entity that has permission to carry out a specified activity.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 该项授权的持有人，即持有所指授权的个人或实体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-persuna jew l-entità li għandha l-awtorizzazzjoni msemmija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The holder of the authorisation is the person or entity that holds the particular permission being discussed.

collocations.en: the name of the authorisation holder
collocations.zh: 授权持有人的姓名或名称

collocations.en: the details of the authorisation holder
collocations.zh: 授权持有人的详细资料

formal.mt: Il-formola titlob l-isem u l-indirizz tad-detentur tal-awtorizzazzjoni.
formal.en: The form asks for the name and address of the authorisation holder.
formal.zh: 表格要求填写授权持有人的姓名或名称及地址。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min hu d-detentur tal-awtorizzazzjoni, int jew il-kumpanija? Mark: Il-kumpanija. Jien qed nimla l-formola f'isimha.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is the authorisation holder, you or the company? Mark: The company. I am filling in the form on its behalf.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：授权持有人是你，还是公司？马克：是公司。我是在代表公司填写表格。

messages.speaker: Anna (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu d-detentur tal-awtorizzazzjoni, int jew il-kumpanija?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu d-detentur tal-awtorizzazzjoni, int jew il-kumpanija?
messages.zh: 授权持有人是你，还是公司？
messages.en: Who is the authorisation holder, you or the company?

messages.speaker: Mark (公司职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpanija. Jien qed nimla l-formola f'isimha.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpanija. Jien qed nimla l-formola f'isimha.
messages.zh: 是公司。我是在代表公司填写表格。
messages.en: The company. I am filling in the form on its behalf.
