cognitive_memory_aid: 想象授权文件上“获授权方”一栏：填在那里的个人或公司就是 detentur tal-awtorizzazzjoni，可用“授权归谁”来记忆。

gloss_zh: 货物持有人；货物占有人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or entity that has goods in its possession or under its control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 实际持有或控制货物的个人或实体；这一称呼本身不表示其拥有货物所有权。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità li għandha merkanzija fil-pussess tagħha jew taħt il-kontroll tagħha, mingħajr ma bilfors tkun is-sid tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物持有人，即实际持有或控制货物的个人或实体，不一定是货物所有人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità li żżomm merkanzija fil-pussess tagħha jew taħt il-kontroll tagħha, iżda mhux bilfors tkun is-sid tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A holder of goods is a person or entity that possesses or controls goods, whether or not they own them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 该批货物的持有人，即实际持有或控制所指货物的个人或实体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-persuna jew l-entità li għandha l-merkanzija msemmija fil-pussess tagħha jew taħt il-kontroll tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The holder of the goods is the person or entity that possesses or controls the particular goods being discussed.

collocations.en: the details of the holder of the goods
collocations.zh: 货物持有人的详细资料

collocations.en: contact with the holder of the goods

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika min hu d-detentur tal-merkanzija u fejn qed tinżamm il-merkanzija.
formal.en: The report states who holds the goods and where the goods are being kept.
formal.zh: 报告说明了货物由谁持有，以及货物存放在何处。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min hu d-detentur tal-merkanzija bħalissa? Toni: Il-kumpanija tat-trasport. Il-kaxxi għadhom fil-maħżen tagħha.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who is the holder of the goods at the moment? Toni: The transport company. The boxes are still in its warehouse.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：目前货物由谁持有？托尼：运输公司。那些箱子还在它的仓库里。

messages.speaker: Rita (客户)
messages.zh: 目前货物由谁持有？
messages.en: Who is the holder of the goods at the moment?

messages.speaker: Toni (物流职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpanija tat-trasport. Il-kaxxi għadhom fil-maħżen tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpanija tat-trasport. Il-kaxxi għadhom fil-maħżen tagħha.
messages.zh: 运输公司。那些箱子还在它的仓库里。
messages.en: The transport company. The boxes are still in its warehouse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象仓库里一批等待领取的货箱：用“货现在由谁保管或控制”记住 detentur tal-merkanzija，再另问货物属于谁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The keeping of a person in official custody, with their freedom to leave restricted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由有关当局限制人身自由、将某人留置于看管之下的状态或措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żamma ta' persuna taħt il-kustodja tal-awtoritajiet, mingħajr il-libertà li titlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拘留；羁押，指有关当局将某人置于看管之下并限制其离开的自由。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat li fih persuna tinżamm mill-awtoritajiet f'post u ma titħalliex titlaq liberament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Detention is the act or state of keeping someone in official custody and restricting their freedom to leave.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-kundizzjonijiet ta' detenzjoni u l-aċċess għas-servizzi mediċi fiċ-ċentru.
formal.en: The report examines the conditions of detention and access to medical services at the centre.
formal.zh: 报告考察了该中心的羁押条件以及获得医疗服务的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser detenzjoni? Mark: Tfisser li persuna tinżamm mill-awtoritajiet u ma tkunx tista' titlaq liberament.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does detention mean? Mark: It means that a person is held by the authorities and cannot leave freely.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：detenzjoni 是什么意思？马克：意思是一个人被当局看管，不能自由离开。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: detenzjoni 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does detention mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li persuna tinżamm mill-awtoritajiet u ma tkunx tista' titlaq liberament.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li persuna tinżamm mill-awtoritajiet u ma tkunx tista' titlaq liberament.
messages.zh: 意思是一个人被当局看管，不能自由离开。
messages.en: It means that a person is held by the authorities and cannot leave freely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 detenzjoni 与“被看管、不能自由离开”的画面联系起来，再用 ċentru ta' detenzjoni“拘留中心”整组记忆。

gloss_zh: 坚定的；下定决心的（阴性单数）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Firmly resolved to achieve something despite difficulties, used in the feminine singular form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容意志坚定、决心克服困难实现目标的；此处为阴性单数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandha rieda soda biex tilħaq għan u ma taqtax qalbha quddiem id-diffikultajiet; forma femminili singular.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坚定的；下定决心的，指决意实现某个目标、不轻易放弃的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandha ħsieb ċar u rieda qawwija li tagħmel xi ħaġa, anki jekk tiltaqa' ma' ostakli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is determined has firmly decided to do something and will not easily give up.

formal.mt: Minkejja d-diffikultajiet inizjali, ir-riċerkatriċi baqgħet determinata li tlesti l-istudju.
formal.en: Despite the initial difficulties, the researcher remained determined to complete the study.
formal.zh: 尽管起初遇到困难，这位女研究员仍决心完成研究。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għadek se tagħmel l-eżami wara dak kollu? Maja: Iva, jien determinata li ngħaddi din id-darba.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are you still going to take the exam after all that? Maja: Yes, I'm determined to pass this time.
colloquial.zh: 马克：经历了那些事，你还打算参加考试吗？玛雅：是的，我下定决心这次要通过。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek se tagħmel l-eżami wara dak kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek se tagħmel l-eżami wara dak kollu?
messages.zh: 经历了那些事，你还打算参加考试吗？
messages.en: Are you still going to take the exam after all that?

messages.speaker: Maja (女学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien determinata li ngħaddi din id-darba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien determinata li ngħaddi din id-darba.
messages.zh: 是的，我下定决心这次要通过。
messages.en: Yes, I'm determined to pass this time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象玛雅坚定地说“我这次一定通过”：Jien determinata。把这个词与女性说话者和“不放弃”的决心一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a system or process whose outcome is fixed by its starting conditions and rules.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容系统或过程的结果由初始条件和规则确定的；相同条件下会产生相同结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi sistema jew proċess li fih ir-riżultat ikun stabbilit mill-kundizzjonijiet inizjali u mir-regoli, b'mod li l-istess kundizzjonijiet jagħtu l-istess riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 确定性的；决定论的，指结果由既定条件和规律决定，而非由随机因素决定的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li fih dak li jiġri jkun determinat mill-kundizzjonijiet ta' qabel u mir-regoli applikabbli, mingħajr għażla każwali bejn riżultati differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A deterministic system or process produces an outcome fixed by its initial conditions and governing rules.

formal.mt: Dan il-mudell huwa deterministiku: jekk il-kundizzjonijiet inizjali jibqgħu l-istess, ir-riżultat jibqa' l-istess ukoll.
formal.en: This model is deterministic: if the initial conditions remain the same, the result remains the same as well.
formal.zh: 这个模型是确定性的：只要初始条件保持相同，结果也会保持相同。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jekk nerġa' ndaħħal l-istess numri, nieħu l-istess tweġiba? Mark: Iva, dan il-proċess huwa deterministiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: If I enter the same numbers again, will I get the same answer? Mark: Yes, this process is deterministic.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：如果我再次输入相同的数字，会得到相同的答案吗？马克：会，这个过程是确定性的。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk nerġa' ndaħħal l-istess numri, nieħu l-istess tweġiba?
messages.mt_standard: Jekk nerġa' ndaħħal l-istess numri, nieħu l-istess tweġiba?
messages.zh: 如果我再次输入相同的数字，会得到相同的答案吗？
messages.en: If I enter the same numbers again, will I get the same answer?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.zh: 会，这个过程是确定性的。
messages.en: Yes, this process is deterministic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“相同起点和规则，得到相同结果”记 deterministiku；想象反复输入同一组数字，每次都出现同一个答案。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing many specific facts or particulars about a subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 包含许多具体信息、对各个细节交代充分的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti ħafna informazzjoni speċifika u jispjega l-partikolaritajiet ta' suġġett b'mod ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 详细的；详尽的，指提供丰富具体信息、充分说明细节的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinkludi ħafna dettalji u jagħti tagħrif preċiż dwar id-diversi aspetti ta' xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is detailed includes many specific facts and gives careful attention to individual particulars.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat talab rapport dettaljat li jinkludi l-ispejjeż, l-iskeda tax-xogħol u r-riżultati mistennija.
formal.en: The committee requested a detailed report including the costs, the work schedule and the expected results.
formal.zh: 委员会要求提交一份详细报告，列明费用、工作日程和预期成果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-pjan tal-vjaġġ lest? Mark: Iva, huwa dettaljat: fih il-ħinijiet, l-indirizzi u l-prezzijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the travel plan ready? Mark: Yes, it's detailed: it has the times, addresses and prices.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：旅行计划做好了吗？马克：做好了，很详细，里面有时间、地址和价格。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 旅行计划做好了吗？
messages.en: Is the travel plan ready?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa dettaljat: fih il-ħinijiet, l-indirizzi u l-prezzijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa dettaljat: fih il-ħinijiet, l-indirizzi u l-prezzijiet.
messages.zh: 做好了，很详细，里面有时间、地址和价格。
messages.en: Yes, it's detailed: it has the times, addresses and prices.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dettaljat 配上一张写满时间、地址和价格的旅行计划表：细节交代得越充分，就越适合用“详细的”来理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The difference between the time indicated by an electrical system and a reference time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电气系统所指示的时间与参考时间之间的差值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-differenza bejn il-ħin indikat minn sistema elettrika u l-ħin ta' referenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电气时间相对于参考时间的偏差。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-differenza li jkun hemm bejn il-ħin elettriku ta' sistema u ħin meħud bħala referenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Electrical time deviation is the amount by which electrical time differs from a reference time.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri d-devjazzjoni elettrika tal-ħin billi jqabbel il-ħin indikat mis-sistema mal-ħin ta' referenza.
formal.en: The report shows the electrical time deviation by comparing the time indicated by the system with the reference time.
formal.zh: 报告通过比较系统指示的时间与参考时间，展示电气时间偏差。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'jiġifieri devjazzjoni elettrika tal-ħin? Pawlu: Hija d-differenza bejn il-ħin li turi s-sistema u l-ħin ta' referenza. Marta: Mela nqabbel iż-żewġ ħinijiet? Pawlu: Iva, hekk tara kemm huma differenti.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does electrical time deviation mean? Pawlu: It is the difference between the time shown by the system and the reference time. Marta: So I compare the two times? Pawlu: Yes, that shows you how much they differ.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：电气时间偏差是什么意思？保罗：就是系统显示的时间与参考时间之间的差值。玛尔塔：所以我要比较这两个时间？保罗：对，这样就能看出它们相差多少。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 电气时间偏差是什么意思？
messages.en: What does electrical time deviation mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija d-differenza bejn il-ħin li turi s-sistema u l-ħin ta' referenza.
messages.mt_standard: Hija d-differenza bejn il-ħin li turi s-sistema u l-ħin ta' referenza.
messages.zh: 就是系统显示的时间与参考时间之间的差值。
messages.en: It is the difference between the time shown by the system and the reference time.

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 所以我要比较这两个时间？
messages.en: So I compare the two times?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk tara kemm huma differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk tara kemm huma differenti.
messages.zh: 对，这样就能看出它们相差多少。
messages.en: Yes, that shows you how much they differ.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个时钟并排想象：一个显示电气时间，一个显示参考时间；两者相差的量就是这里的偏差。看到 tal-ħin，先抓住“时间”这个比较对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The greatest instantaneous departure of a frequency from its reference value during the period being considered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在所考察的时段内，频率相对于参考值出现的最大瞬时偏离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-akbar devjazzjoni tal-frekwenza mill-valur ta' referenza f'mument wieħed matul il-perjodu li jkun qed jiġi kkunsidrat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所考察时段内，频率偏离参考值的最大瞬时偏差。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-akbar devjazzjoni mill-frekwenza ta' referenza li sseħħ f'xi mument fil-perjodu taħt osservazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The maximum instantaneous frequency deviation is the greatest departure from the reference frequency at any instant during the period considered.

collocations.en: calculation of the maximum instantaneous frequency deviation
collocations.zh: 最大瞬时频率偏差的计算

collocations.en: the limit on maximum instantaneous frequency deviation
collocations.zh: 最大瞬时频率偏差的限值

formal.mt: It-tabella tindika d-devjazzjoni massima istantanja tal-frekwenza osservata matul it-test, flimkien mal-mument meta seħħet.
formal.en: The table indicates the maximum instantaneous frequency deviation observed during the test, together with the instant at which it occurred.
formal.zh: 表格列出了测试期间观测到的最大瞬时频率偏差，以及该偏差出现的时刻。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema punt infittex fuq il-graff? David: Fittex il-punt fejn il-frekwenza titbiegħed l-aktar mill-valur ta' referenza; dak jurik id-devjazzjoni massima istantanja tal-frekwenza. Lara: Anki jekk dik il-quċċata ddum ftit biss? David: Iva, hawn qed inħarsu lejn il-valur f'dak il-mument.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which point should I look for on the graph? David: Look for the point where the frequency departs furthest from the reference value; that shows you the maximum instantaneous frequency deviation. Lara: Even if that peak lasts only briefly? David: Yes, here we are looking at the value at that instant.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我应该在图上找哪个点？戴维：找频率偏离参考值最远的那个点，它显示的就是最大瞬时频率偏差。拉拉：即使那个峰值只持续很短时间也算吗？戴维：算，这里看的是那个瞬间的数值。

messages.speaker: Lara (实习生)
messages.zh: 我应该在图上找哪个点？
messages.en: Which point should I look for on the graph?

messages.speaker: David (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Fittex il-punt fejn il-frekwenza titbiegħed l-aktar mill-valur ta' referenza; dak jurik id-devjazzjoni massima istantanja tal-frekwenza.
messages.mt_standard: Fittex il-punt fejn il-frekwenza titbiegħed l-aktar mill-valur ta' referenza; dak jurik id-devjazzjoni massima istantanja tal-frekwenza.
messages.zh: 找频率偏离参考值最远的那个点，它显示的就是最大瞬时频率偏差。
messages.en: Look for the point where the frequency departs furthest from the reference value; that shows you the maximum instantaneous frequency deviation.

messages.speaker: Lara (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Anki jekk dik il-quċċata ddum ftit biss?
messages.mt_standard: Anki jekk dik il-quċċata ddum ftit biss?
messages.zh: 即使那个峰值只持续很短时间也算吗？
messages.en: Even if that peak lasts only briefly?

messages.speaker: David (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn qed inħarsu lejn il-valur f'dak il-mument.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn qed inħarsu lejn il-valur f'dak il-mument.
messages.zh: 算，这里看的是那个瞬间的数值。
messages.en: Yes, here we are looking at the value at that instant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给频率曲线拍一张瞬间照片，再圈出偏离参考线最远的一点：massima 提醒“最大”，istantanja 提醒“瞬时”，合起来记成“最大瞬时频率偏差”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The greatest departure of the steady-state frequency from its reference value among the operating conditions considered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在所考察的运行条件中，系统达到稳态后频率相对于参考值的最大偏离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-akbar devjazzjoni tal-frekwenza mill-valur ta' referenza wara li s-sistema tkun stabbilizzat ruħha, fost il-kundizzjonijiet ta' tħaddim ikkunsidrati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在所考察的运行条件下，稳态频率偏离参考值的最大偏差。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-akbar differenza mill-frekwenza ta' referenza li tiġi osservata fi stat stabbli fost il-kundizzjonijiet ta' tħaddim taħt eżami.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The maximum steady-state frequency deviation is the greatest departure from the reference frequency after the system has settled under the conditions considered.

collocations.en: assessment of the maximum steady-state frequency deviation
collocations.zh: 最大稳态频率偏差的评估

collocations.mt: il-limitu permess għad-devjazzjoni statika massima tal-frekwenza
collocations.en: the permitted limit for maximum steady-state frequency deviation
collocations.zh: 最大稳态频率偏差的允许限值

formal.mt: Għal kull kundizzjoni ta' tħaddim, ġiet irreġistrata d-devjazzjoni wara li s-sistema stabbilizzat ruħha, u mbagħad ġiet identifikata d-devjazzjoni statika massima tal-frekwenza.
formal.en: For each operating condition, the deviation was recorded after the system had settled, and the maximum steady-state frequency deviation was then identified.
formal.zh: 针对每种运行条件，先在系统稳定后记录偏差，再确定最大稳态频率偏差。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Biex insib id-devjazzjoni statika massima tal-frekwenza, nieħu l-ogħla quċċata fil-bidu? Ġużeppi: L-ewwel ħares lejn il-valuri wara li s-sistema tistabbilizza ruħha. Nina: U mbagħad inqabbel id-devjazzjonijiet fil-kundizzjonijiet differenti? Ġużeppi: Eżatt, u tagħżel l-akbar waħda.
colloquial.en: Nina: To find the maximum steady-state frequency deviation, do I take the highest peak at the start? Ġużeppi: First look at the values after the system settles. Nina: And then compare the deviations under the different conditions? Ġużeppi: Exactly, and select the greatest one.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：要找最大稳态频率偏差，是取开始时最高的峰值吗？朱塞佩：先看系统稳定后的数值。妮娜：然后比较不同条件下的偏差？朱塞佩：对，再选出其中最大的一个。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex insib id-devjazzjoni statika massima tal-frekwenza, nieħu l-ogħla quċċata fil-bidu?
messages.mt_standard: Biex insib id-devjazzjoni statika massima tal-frekwenza, nieħu l-ogħla quċċata fil-bidu?
messages.zh: 要找最大稳态频率偏差，是取开始时最高的峰值吗？
messages.en: To find the maximum steady-state frequency deviation, do I take the highest peak at the start?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel ħares lejn il-valuri wara li s-sistema tistabbilizza ruħha.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel ħares lejn il-valuri wara li s-sistema tistabbilizza ruħha.
messages.zh: 先看系统稳定后的数值。
messages.en: First look at the values after the system settles.

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: U mbagħad inqabbel id-devjazzjonijiet fil-kundizzjonijiet differenti?
messages.mt_standard: U mbagħad inqabbel id-devjazzjonijiet fil-kundizzjonijiet differenti?
messages.zh: 然后比较不同条件下的偏差？
messages.en: And then compare the deviations under the different conditions?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教师)
messages.zh: 对，再选出其中最大的一个。
messages.en: Exactly, and select the greatest one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“先稳定，再比大”来记：statika 提醒等系统达到稳态，massima 提醒从所考察的稳态偏差中找最大值，最后用 tal-frekwenza 锁定频率。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The difference between the frequency of a system after it has settled and the reference frequency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 系统达到稳态后，其频率与参考频率之间的差值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-differenza bejn il-frekwenza tas-sistema wara li tkun stabbilizzat ruħha u l-frekwenza ta' referenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 系统处于稳态时，其频率相对于参考频率的偏差。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-devjazzjoni mill-frekwenza ta' referenza li jkun hemm meta s-sistema tkun laħqet stat stabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Steady state frequency deviation is the difference between the settled frequency of a system and its reference frequency.

formal.mt: Wara li s-sistema laħqet stat stabbli, ġiet ikkalkolata d-devjazzjoni tal-frekwenza statika billi tqabblet il-frekwenza mkejla mal-frekwenza ta' referenza.
formal.en: After the system reached a steady state, the steady-state frequency deviation was calculated by comparing the measured frequency with the reference frequency.
formal.zh: 系统达到稳态后，通过比较实测频率与参考频率，计算出稳态频率偏差。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Is-sistema stabbilizzat ruħha, imma l-frekwenza għadha differenti mill-valur ta' referenza. Mark: Dik id-differenza hija d-devjazzjoni tal-frekwenza statika. Sara: Mela issa nista' nirreġistraha? Mark: Iva, irreġistra l-frekwenza mkejla u l-valur ta' referenza wkoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: The system has settled, but the frequency still differs from the reference value. Mark: That difference is the steady-state frequency deviation. Sara: So can I record it now? Mark: Yes, record the measured frequency and the reference value as well.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：系统已经稳定了，但频率仍然与参考值不同。马克：这个差值就是稳态频率偏差。萨拉：那我现在可以记录它了吗？马克：可以，也把实测频率和参考值一起记下来。

messages.speaker: Sara (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sistema stabbilizzat ruħha, imma l-frekwenza għadha differenti mill-valur ta' referenza.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sistema stabbilizzat ruħha, imma l-frekwenza għadha differenti mill-valur ta' referenza.
messages.zh: 系统已经稳定了，但频率仍然与参考值不同。
messages.en: The system has settled, but the frequency still differs from the reference value.

messages.speaker: Mark (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik id-differenza hija d-devjazzjoni tal-frekwenza statika.
messages.mt_standard: Dik id-differenza hija d-devjazzjoni tal-frekwenza statika.
messages.zh: 这个差值就是稳态频率偏差。
messages.en: That difference is the steady-state frequency deviation.

messages.speaker: Sara (实习生)
messages.zh: 那我现在可以记录它了吗？
messages.en: So can I record it now?

messages.speaker: Mark (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irreġistra l-frekwenza mkejla u l-valur ta' referenza wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irreġistra l-frekwenza mkejla u l-valur ta' referenza wkoll.
messages.zh: 可以，也把实测频率和参考值一起记下来。
messages.en: Yes, record the measured frequency and the reference value as well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象频率曲线最终变平，却与参考线仍有距离；这段距离就是稳态频率偏差。用“稳定后，还差多少”记住整个词组。

gloss_zh: 贸易流向转移；贸易转移

teaching_sense.en_definition: A change in the routes, destinations, or sources of trade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贸易的运输路线、目的地或供应来源发生转变的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla fir-rotot, fid-destinazzjonijiet jew fis-sorsi tal-kummerċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贸易改道；贸易活动偏离原有路线或流向。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bidla li twassal biex il-kummerċ jgħaddi minn rotta jew lejn destinazzjoni differenti minn dik ta' qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Deflection of trade occurs when trade is redirected away from its previous route or destination.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贸易转移；采购或销售活动由原有供应方或市场转向其他供应方或市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bidla li fiha x-xiri jew il-bejgħ jiċċaqlaq minn fornituri jew swieq li kienu jintużaw qabel għal oħrajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Diversion of trade occurs when purchases or sales shift from established suppliers or markets to others.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贸易流向偏转；货物流通的路线或目的地发生改变。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fenomenu li fih il-fluss tal-merkanzija jieħu rotta jew destinazzjoni differenti minn dik li kellu qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Trade deflection is a change in the direction or route through which goods are traded.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贸易转移；贸易由原有来源或目的市场转至其他来源或市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fenomenu li fih il-kummerċ jitmexxa minn sorsi jew swieq li kienu jintużaw qabel lejn sorsi jew swieq oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Trade diversion is the movement of trade from previous sources or markets to alternative ones.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina d-devjazzjoni tat-traffiku kummerċjali lejn swieq ġodda u l-effetti tagħha fuq il-fornituri lokali.
formal.en: The report examines the diversion of trade towards new markets and its effects on local suppliers.
formal.zh: 该报告研究贸易向新市场转移的现象及其对本地供应商的影响。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tfisser devjazzjoni tat-traffiku kummerċjali? Pawlu: Tfisser li l-kummerċ ibiddel ir-rotta, is-sors jew is-suq tiegħu. Lara: Bħal meta ħanut jibda jixtri mingħand fornitur ieħor? Pawlu: Iva, dak jista' jkun eżempju.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does trade diversion mean? Pawlu: It means that trade changes its route, source, or market. Lara: Like when a shop starts buying from another supplier? Pawlu: Yes, that can be an example.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：贸易转移是什么意思？保罗：就是贸易改变了路线、来源或市场。拉拉：比如一家商店开始向另一家供应商进货？保罗：对，那可以算是一个例子。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 贸易转移是什么意思？
messages.en: What does trade diversion mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-kummerċ ibiddel ir-rotta, is-sors jew is-suq tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-kummerċ ibiddel ir-rotta, is-sors jew is-suq tiegħu.
messages.zh: 就是贸易改变了路线、来源或市场。
messages.en: It means that trade changes its route, source, or market.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħal meta ħanut jibda jixtri mingħand fornitur ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Bħal meta ħanut jibda jixtri mingħand fornitur ieħor?
messages.zh: 比如一家商店开始向另一家供应商进货？
messages.en: Like when a shop starts buying from another supplier?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 对，那可以算是一个例子。
messages.en: Yes, that can be an example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象贸易地图上的箭头转弯：货物换路线、换来源或换市场，就用这个短语记住“贸易流向转移”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having strong religious faith and showing sincere commitment to religious practice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗教信仰坚定，并真诚投入宗教实践的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu fidi reliġjuża qawwija u juri rabta sinċiera mat-talb u mal-prattika reliġjuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虔诚的；真诚信奉宗教并表现出敬神态度的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jemmen b'sinċerità fir-reliġjon tiegħu u juri rispett lejn Alla fit-talb u fl-imġiba tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is pious sincerely believes in their religion and expresses that belief through worship and conduct.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常虔诚的；宗教信仰深厚、生活中十分重视宗教的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħti importanza kbira lir-reliġjon f'ħajtu u jieħu sehem b'impenn fil-prattiki tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is very religious gives religion a central place in their life and follows its practices closely.

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lil Ġużeppi bħala raġel devot li jagħti importanza kbira lit-talb fil-ħajja tiegħu.
formal.en: The author describes Ġużeppi as a devout man who gives prayer great importance in his life.
formal.zh: 作者将朱塞佩描述为一位虔诚的男子，他在生活中十分重视祈祷。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nannuk imur il-knisja kuljum? Mark: Iva, hu devot ħafna u jitlob kull filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does your grandfather go to church every day? Mark: Yes, he is very devout and prays every morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你爷爷每天都去教堂吗？马克：是的，他非常虔诚，每天早上都祈祷。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爷爷每天都去教堂吗？
messages.en: Does your grandfather go to church every day?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu devot ħafna u jitlob kull filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu devot ħafna u jitlob kull filgħodu.
messages.zh: 是的，他非常虔诚，每天早上都祈祷。
messages.en: Yes, he is very devout and prays every morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 devot 配上一位每天认真祈祷的人物来记：这个词描写人的“虔诚”，可用 raġel devot 整块记忆。

gloss_zh: 虔敬；宗教上的热忱；宗教虔诚程度

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strong religious commitment expressed through faith, prayer, or worship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过信仰、祈祷或礼拜表现出来的宗教虔敬与热忱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabta qawwija mar-reliġjon li tintwera permezz tal-fidi, tat-talb jew tal-qima.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虔敬；对神或宗教信仰怀有的深切敬爱与投入。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imħabba u rabta sinċiera lejn Alla jew lejn il-fidi reliġjuża, li jintwerew fit-talb u fil-qima.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Devotion is a deep feeling of religious love and commitment that is expressed through prayer or worship.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宗教虔诚；个人或群体重视宗教信仰及参与宗教实践的程度或特征。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-grad jew il-mod kif persuna jew grupp jagħti importanza lill-fidi u lill-prattiki reliġjużi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Religiosity is the extent to which a person or group holds religious beliefs and participates in religious practices.

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi kif id-devozzjoni tal-komunità tidher fit-talb u fiċ-ċelebrazzjonijiet reliġjużi tagħha.
formal.en: The study describes how the community's devotion is expressed in its prayers and religious celebrations.
formal.zh: 该研究描述了这个群体如何通过祈祷和宗教庆典表达其虔敬。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex in-nanna tmur titlob f'dik il-kappella? Luqa: Għandha devozzjoni kbira lejn il-Madonna u hemmhekk issib il-kwiet.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why does Grandma go to pray in that chapel? Luqa: She has a deep devotion to Our Lady and finds peace there.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：奶奶为什么去那座小教堂祈祷？卢卡：她十分敬奉圣母，而且在那里能找到内心的平静。

messages.speaker: Anna (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex in-nanna tmur titlob f'dik il-kappella?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex in-nanna tmur titlob f'dik il-kappella?
messages.zh: 奶奶为什么去那座小教堂祈祷？
messages.en: Why does Grandma go to pray in that chapel?

messages.speaker: Luqa (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha devozzjoni kbira lejn il-Madonna u hemmhekk issib il-kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha devozzjoni kbira lejn il-Madonna u hemmhekk issib il-kwiet.
messages.zh: 她十分敬奉圣母，而且在那里能找到内心的平静。
messages.en: She has a deep devotion to Our Lady and finds peace there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 devozzjoni 想成祈祷时心中的那份“虔敬”：devot 用来描写人，devozzjoni 用来谈这种信仰投入。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to indicate that a person has died.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某人已经去世，处于不再在世的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika li persuna mietet u m'għadhiex ħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经死亡、已经去世的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li xi ħadd miet u għalhekk m'għadux ħaj.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is deceased, that person has died and is no longer alive.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport mediku ġie kkonfermat li l-pazjent kien diġà deċedut meta waslet l-ambulanza.
formal.en: The medical report confirmed that the patient was already deceased when the ambulance arrived.
formal.zh: 医疗报告确认，救护车到达时，病人已经去世。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'ifisser li fuq il-formola hemm miktub 'deċedut'? Toni: Ifisser li dik il-persuna mietet.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does it mean when the form says 'deceased'? Toni: It means that the person has died.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：表格上写着“已故”是什么意思？托尼：意思是那个人已经去世了。

messages.speaker: Marija (办事居民)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser li fuq il-formola hemm miktub 'deċedut'?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser li fuq il-formola hemm miktub 'deċedut'?
messages.zh: 表格上写着“已故”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean when the form says 'deceased'?

messages.speaker: Toni (办事处职员)
messages.zh: 意思是那个人已经去世了。
messages.en: It means that the person has died.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 deċedut 和表格中姓名旁的“已故”标记一起记忆，重点记住它表示死亡已经发生、此人已不在人世。

gloss_zh: 像样的；合乎标准的；正派的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of an acceptable standard, socially appropriate, or honest and respectful in behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 质量达到可接受水平、举止符合社会规范，或为人诚实正派、尊重他人的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jilħaq livell aċċettabbli, ikun xieraq fis-soċjetà, jew juri onestà u rispett lejn l-oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 达到合理或可接受标准的；体面得当的；形容人时可指诚实正派、待人厚道的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ta' kwalità aċċettabbli jew xieraq għas-sitwazzjoni; meta jingħad għal persuna, jindika li tkun onesta u tittratta lill-oħrajn b'rispett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something decent meets a reasonable standard, while a decent person behaves honestly and treats others with respect.

formal.mt: Il-programm għandu l-għan li jgħin liż-żgħażagħ isibu xogħol deċenti b'paga ġusta u kundizzjonijiet tajbin.
formal.en: The programme aims to help young people find decent work with fair pay and good conditions.
formal.zh: 该项目旨在帮助年轻人找到报酬公平、条件良好的体面工作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kien l-ikel fir-ristorant? Ben: Kien deċenti, u l-prezz kien tajjeb ukoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was the food at the restaurant? Ben: It was decent, and the price was good too.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那家餐馆的饭菜怎么样？本：还不错，价格也挺合适。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那家餐馆的饭菜怎么样？
messages.en: How was the food at the restaurant?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien deċenti, u l-prezz kien tajjeb ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Kien deċenti, u l-prezz kien tajjeb ukoll.
messages.zh: 还不错，价格也挺合适。
messages.en: It was decent, and the price was good too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“东西像样、行为得体、为人正派”三句话记住 deċenti：评价质量时是合格不错，评价人时是诚实厚道。

gloss_zh: 决定性的；对结果起关键作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an important effect that determines a result or settles a question.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对最终结果起决定作用，或能够使问题得到明确解决的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkollu effett importanti li jiddetermina r-riżultat jew iwassal biex kwistjoni tinqata'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 决定性的；足以确定结果或解决问题的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiddetermina kif tispiċċa sitwazzjoni jew li jagħti tweġiba ċara għal kwistjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something decisive determines the outcome of a situation or settles an important question.

formal.mt: L-aċċess għall-ilma kien fattur deċisiv fl-għażla tal-post għall-proġett.
formal.en: Access to water was a decisive factor in choosing the location for the project.
formal.zh: 能否获得水源，是选择项目地点的决定性因素。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-gowl ta' Sam kien deċisiv? Mark: Iva, bih irbaħna l-logħba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was Sam's goal decisive? Mark: Yes, we won the match thanks to it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Sam进的那个球决定了胜负吗？Mark：对，我们靠那个球赢了比赛。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Sam进的那个球决定了胜负吗？
messages.en: Was Sam's goal decisive?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，我们靠那个球赢了比赛。
messages.en: Yes, we won the match thanks to it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象比分相同时射进制胜球：这个球改变了最终结果，就可以说 gowl deċisiv。

gloss_zh: 词义未确认；所给释义为“dont know”

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb entry whose meaning is not established by the supplied information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给资料将其列为动词，但只提供“dont know”，不足以确认实际词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din l-entrata hija mniżżla bħala verb, iżda l-informazzjoni mogħtija ma tistabbilixxix it-tifsira tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不知道；此处所给释义未明确词义，不能据此确定该动词表示“不知道”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kliem mogħti bl-Ingliż ifisser li xi ħadd ma jafx, iżda f'din l-entrata ma jiċċarax it-tifsira tal-verb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied wording leaves this verb's actual meaning unresolved.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'deħer' hija mniżżla bħala verb, iżda t-tifsira tagħha għadha mhix ċara mill-informazzjoni mogħtija.
formal.en: The entry 'deħer' is listed as a verb, but its meaning remains unclear from the supplied information.
formal.zh: “deħer”这一词条被列为动词，但所给资料仍未明确其词义。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser 'deħer' hawn? Toni: Ma nafux mit-tagħrif li għandna; hemm biss 'dont know'. Nina: Mela nħallu t-tifsira mhux ikkonfermata.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'deħer' mean here? Toni: We cannot tell from the information we have; it only says 'dont know'. Nina: Then we should leave the meaning unconfirmed.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：“deħer”在这里是什么意思？托尼：根据现有资料还无法确定；这里只写了“dont know”。妮娜：那就先把词义标为未确认。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: “deħer”在这里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'deħer' mean here?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafux mit-tagħrif li għandna; hemm biss 'dont know'.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafux mit-tagħrif li għandna; hemm biss 'dont know'.
messages.zh: 根据现有资料还无法确定；这里只写了“dont know”。
messages.en: We cannot tell from the information we have; it only says 'dont know'.

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 那就先把词义标为未确认。
messages.en: Then we should leave the meaning unconfirmed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 deħer 的学习卡画一个问号，记住“动词标签已给，实际词义待确认”；不要把资料中的 dont know 直接背成这个词的确定含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sweet dish served at the end of a meal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一餐结束时食用的甜食，如蛋糕、冰淇淋或布丁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel ħelu li jittiekel fi tmiem ikla, bħal kejk, ġelat jew pudina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 餐后甜点；正餐之后食用的一道甜食。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Platt ħelu li jiġi servut wara l-platti l-oħra ta' ikla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dessert is a sweet dish that you eat after the main part of a meal.

formal.mt: Wara l-platt prinċipali, il-mistednin ingħataw deżerta taċ-ċikkulata bil-frott frisk.
formal.en: After the main course, the guests were served a chocolate dessert with fresh fruit.
formal.zh: 主菜之后，客人们享用了一道配有新鲜水果的巧克力甜点。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Trid deżerta wara l-ikel? David: Iva, nieħu ġelat. U int? Rita: Jien nieħu biċċa kejk.
colloquial.en: Rita: Would you like dessert after the meal? David: Yes, I'll have ice cream. And you? Rita: I'll have a slice of cake.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：吃完饭要来份甜点吗？戴维：要，我吃冰淇淋。你呢？丽塔：我吃一块蛋糕。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 吃完饭要来份甜点吗？
messages.en: Would you like dessert after the meal?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 要，我吃冰淇淋。你呢？
messages.en: Yes, I'll have ice cream. And you?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 我吃一块蛋糕。
messages.en: I'll have a slice of cake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 deżerta 放在一餐的最后一格：主菜吃完，蛋糕或冰淇淋上桌，这份收尾的甜食就是“餐后甜点”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes a place that is empty, bleak, and without signs of human activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容地方空寂荒凉、缺少人烟或生活气息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi post vojt u mwiegħer fejn ftit li xejn hemm sinjali ta' ħajja jew attività umana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 荒凉冷清、少有人烟或缺乏生活气息的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi post li jidher vojt, imwiegħer u nieqes mill-ħajja jew mill-attività tan-nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A desolate place is empty and bleak, with little sign of people or activity.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-post bħala deżolat, mingħajr nies jew sinjali ta' attività.
formal.en: The report describes the place as desolate, with no people or signs of activity.
formal.zh: 报告将该处描述为一片荒凉，既无人烟，也没有活动的迹象。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien il-post? Mark: Kien deżolat. Ma rajna lil ħadd hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the place like? Mark: It was desolate. We didn't see anyone there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个地方怎么样？马克：很荒凉。我们在那里一个人也没看到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个地方怎么样？
messages.en: What was the place like?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien deżolat. Ma rajna lil ħadd hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Kien deżolat. Ma rajna lil ħadd hemm.
messages.zh: 很荒凉。我们在那里一个人也没看到。
messages.en: It was desolate. We didn't see anyone there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 deżolat 配上一幅空地无人、四周寂静的画面，用“荒凉的地方”这个整体搭配来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun given as 'Dghejf', with no specified referent or meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给形式为 Dghejf 的名词；现有信息没有说明其具体所指或含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Huwa nom mogħti fil-forma 'Dghejf', iżda t-tifsira tiegħu u dak li jirreferi għalih mhumiex speċifikati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 名词 Dghejf；具体所指及中文对应义未注明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan in-nom jidher fil-forma 'Dghejf', mingħajr spjegazzjoni tat-tifsira tiegħu jew ta' dak li jirreferi għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The noun 'Dghejf' is given without enough information to identify what it refers to.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'Dghejf' tidher fil-lista bħala nom, iżda t-tifsira tagħha mhix spjegata.
formal.en: The word 'Dghejf' appears in the list as a noun, but its meaning is not explained.
formal.zh: “Dghejf”在列表中标为名词，但其含义没有得到说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'Dghejf'? Mark: Ma nafx. Hawn miktuba bħala nom, iżda m'hemmx spjegazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'Dghejf' mean? Mark: I don't know. It's written here as a noun, but there's no explanation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“Dghejf”是什么意思？马克：我不知道。这里把它标为名词，但没有解释。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “Dghejf”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Dghejf' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx. Hawn miktuba bħala nom, iżda m'hemmx spjegazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx. Hawn miktuba bħala nom, iżda m'hemmx spjegazzjoni.
messages.zh: 我不知道。这里把它标为名词，但没有解释。
messages.en: I don't know. It's written here as a noun, but there's no explanation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“Dghejf＝含义待确认的名词”制作词卡，保留原拼写，不凭相似字形猜测意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small boat that people move through the water by rowing with oars.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由人操纵船桨、通过划桨在水上前进的小船。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Hija dgħajsa żgħira li n-nies iċaqilqu fuq l-ilma billi jaqdfu bl-imqadef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以船桨划行的小船；划艇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Hija dgħajsa li timxi fuq l-ilma bis-saħħa ta' persuna jew persuni li jaqdfu bl-imqadef.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rowing boat is a small boat that you move through water by pulling oars.

collocations.en: we go out in a rowing boat

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti qasmu l-lag f'dgħajsa bl-imqadef u waslu fuq ix-xatt l-ieħor qabel nofsinhar.
formal.en: The participants crossed the lake in a rowing boat and reached the other shore before noon.
formal.zh: 参与者乘划艇横渡湖面，并在中午前抵达对岸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid nikru dgħajsa bl-imqadef? Mark: Iva, u nistgħu naqdfu t-tnejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we rent a rowing boat? Mark: Yes, and we can both row.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们租一条划艇好吗？马克：好啊，我们两个人都可以划。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们租一条划艇好吗？
messages.en: Shall we rent a rowing boat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好啊，我们两个人都可以划。
messages.en: Yes, and we can both row.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 dgħajsa 是小船，把 bl-imqadef 与双手划桨的动作配对，看到整句就想起“用桨的小船”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A boat that uses sails to catch the wind and move across the water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用船帆承接风力、在水上航行的船。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Hija dgħajsa li tuża l-qlugħ biex taqbad ir-riħ u timxi fuq l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依靠船帆利用风力航行的船；帆船。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Hija dgħajsa mgħammra bil-qlugħ li jippermettulha tuża l-qawwa tar-riħ biex tbaħħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sailing boat is a boat with sails that use the wind to move it across water.

collocations.en: we sail in a sailing boat

formal.mt: Il-grupp telaq mill-port f'dgħajsa tal-qlugħ u uża r-riħ biex jasal sal-bajja.
formal.en: The group left the harbour in a sailing boat and used the wind to reach the bay.
formal.zh: 一行人乘帆船离港，借助风力驶抵海湾。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik dgħajsa tal-qlugħ? Mark: Iva, ara l-qlugħ tagħha mimlijin bir-riħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that a sailing boat? Mark: Yes, look at its sails filled with wind.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是一条帆船吗？马克：是啊，看它的船帆被风鼓起来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是一条帆船吗？
messages.en: Is that a sailing boat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara l-qlugħ tagħha mimlijin bir-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara l-qlugħ tagħha mimlijin bir-riħ.
messages.zh: 是啊，看它的船帆被风鼓起来了。
messages.en: Yes, look at its sails filled with wind.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dgħajsa 想成小船，把 qlugħ 配上鼓起的船帆图像，整组 dgħajsa tal-qlugħ 就记作“帆船”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of strength or an aspect that makes someone or something less effective.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体、能力或事物缺乏力量的状态，也可指使人或事物不够有效的弱点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' saħħa jew qawwa, jew aspett li jagħmel lil persuna jew lil ħaġa inqas effettiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虚弱或力量不足的状态；也指能力、计划或事物中的薄弱之处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat ta' nuqqas ta' saħħa jew qawwa, jew punt dgħajjef f'persuna, fi pjan jew f'xi ħaġa oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A weakness is a lack of strength or a particular feature that reduces someone's or something's effectiveness.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika dgħjufija fil-pjan u jipproponi miżuri biex jissaħħaħ.
formal.en: The report identifies a weakness in the plan and proposes measures to strengthen it.
formal.zh: 报告指出了计划中的一个弱点，并提出了改进措施。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek tħoss dgħjufija wara l-marda? Pawlu: Iva, għadni bla saħħa, allura llum se nistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still feel weak after being ill? Pawlu: Yes, I still have little strength, so I'm going to rest today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：病过之后，你还觉得虚弱吗？保罗：是的，我还是没什么力气，所以今天打算休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 病过之后，你还觉得虚弱吗？
messages.en: Do you still feel weak after being ill?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni bla saħħa, allura llum se nistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni bla saħħa, allura llum se nistrieħ.
messages.zh: 是的，我还是没什么力气，所以今天打算休息。
messages.en: Yes, I still have little strength, so I'm going to rest today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词连到两个画面：病后身体没力气，以及计划中有薄弱环节；用“身体虚弱、方案弱点”成对记忆。

gloss_zh: 颇为审慎的；有些睿智且有远见的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat wise and cautious, showing care and foresight when making decisions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人颇为审慎、有些睿智，做决定时会小心考虑并顾及未来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri ċerta għaqal u prudenza, jaġixxi b'attenzjoni u jaħseb fil-ħtiġijiet tal-ġejjieni.

sense_translations.en_definition: somewhat prudent, sage, provident and careful
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有些审慎、睿智、有远见而且小心周到的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu ċerta prudenza u għaqal, jieħu ħsieb il-ġejjieni u joqgħod attent fl-għażliet u fl-azzjonijiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is dhejjen shows a degree of wisdom and caution, considering future needs before acting.

collocations.en: a somewhat prudent and careful man
collocations.zh: 一个颇为审慎、小心周到的男人

collocations.en: a leader with some wisdom and foresight
collocations.zh: 一位颇有智慧和远见的领导者

formal.mt: Mexxej dhejjen iqis il-ħtiġijiet tal-ġejjieni u jeżamina r-riskji qabel jieħu deċiżjoni.
formal.en: A leader with some wisdom and foresight considers future needs and examines the risks before making a decision.
formal.zh: 一位颇有智慧和远见的领导者，会在做决定之前考虑未来的需要并审视风险。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark ma jixtrix kollox illum? Toni: Hu raġel dhejjen; l-ewwel iqabbel il-prezzijiet u jaħseb x'se jkollu bżonn aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why doesn't Mark buy everything today? Toni: He's quite prudent; first he compares prices and thinks about what he'll need later.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么不今天把东西全买了？托尼：他这个人颇为审慎；他会先比较价格，再想想以后需要什么。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma jixtrix kollox illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma jixtrix kollox illum?
messages.zh: 马克为什么不今天把东西全买了？
messages.en: Why doesn't Mark buy everything today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu raġel dhejjen; l-ewwel iqabbel il-prezzijiet u jaħseb x'se jkollu bżonn aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Hu raġel dhejjen; l-ewwel iqabbel il-prezzijiet u jaħseb x'se jkollu bżonn aktar tard.
messages.zh: 他这个人颇为审慎；他会先比较价格，再想想以后需要什么。
messages.en: He's quite prudent; first he compares prices and thinks about what he'll need later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个买东西前先比价、又替以后留预算的人：他颇为审慎，也有远见；记住这里带有“一定程度上”的语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of ten years.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由十年组成的一段时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' għaxar snin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十年；连续十年的一段时期。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dicenju huwa perjodu li jdum għaxar snin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A decade is a period of ten years.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ikopri dicenju ta' bidliet fl-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: The report covers a decade of changes in education.
formal.zh: 这份报告涵盖了教育领域十年间的变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm ilek taħdem hawn? Mark: Għal dicenju, jiġifieri għaxar snin.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long have you worked here? Mark: For a decade, meaning ten years.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在这里工作多久了？Mark：十年，也就是一个十年期。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在这里工作多久了？
messages.en: How long have you worked here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 十年，也就是一个十年期。
messages.en: For a decade, meaning ten years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dicenju 对应成时间轴上的十个年份格：十格合成一段，就是“十年期”。

gloss_zh: 教学的；以传授知识或教导为目的的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Intended to teach knowledge, skills, or a lesson.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于传授知识、技能或道理的；具有教学目的的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-għan li jgħallem għarfien, ħiliet jew xi lezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教学的；旨在传授知识、技能或道理的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa hija didattika meta tkun maħsuba biex tgħallem għarfien, ħiliet jew xi lezzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is didactic is intended to teach people knowledge, skills, or a lesson.

formal.mt: L-għalliem għażel materjal didattiku biex jgħin lill-istudenti jifhmu s-suġġett.
formal.en: The teacher selected teaching material to help the students understand the subject.
formal.zh: 教师选择了教学材料，以帮助学生理解这门学科。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-filmat għad-divertiment biss? Mark: Le, għandu wkoll għan didattiku; jgħallmek kif tiffranka l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this video just for entertainment? Mark: No, it also has an educational purpose; it teaches you how to save water.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个视频只是用来娱乐的吗？Mark：不是，它也有教学目的，会教你怎样节约用水。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这个视频只是用来娱乐的吗？
messages.en: Is this video just for entertainment?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għandu wkoll għan didattiku; jgħallmek kif tiffranka l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għandu wkoll għan didattiku; jgħallmek kif tiffranka l-ilma.
messages.zh: 不是，它也有教学目的，会教你怎样节约用水。
messages.en: No, it also has an educational purpose; it teaches you how to save water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 materjal didattiku“教学材料”：看到这个形容词，就联想“它是用来教人东西的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Big Mac hamburger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指巨无霸汉堡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Hamburger magħruf bl-isem Big Mac.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巨无霸汉堡。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Diddy huwa hamburger magħruf bl-isem Big Mac.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A diddy refers here to a Big Mac hamburger.

formal.mt: Il-klijent ordna diddy mal-patata u tazza ilma.
formal.en: The customer ordered a Big Mac with fries and a glass of water.
formal.zh: 顾客点了一个巨无霸汉堡、一份薯条和一杯水。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nixtieq diddy, jekk jogħġbok. Maja: Trid il-patata miegħu? Mark: Iva, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'd like a Big Mac, please. Maja: Would you like fries with it? Mark: Yes, thanks.
colloquial.zh: Mark：请给我一个巨无霸汉堡。Maja：要配薯条吗？Mark：要，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我一个巨无霸汉堡。
messages.en: I'd like a Big Mac, please.

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.zh: 要配薯条吗？
messages.en: Would you like fries with it?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本条给定释义，把 diddy 放进点餐画面：说出这个词，面前出现一个巨无霸汉堡。

gloss_zh: Diehes（所给材料未说明具体词义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun given as Diehes, whose specific meaning is not supplied.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料中列为名词的 Diehes；其具体所指未提供，暂不能确定中文对应词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diehes huwa nom li t-tifsira preċiża tiegħu mhijiex speċifikata fil-materjal mogħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 材料仅提供“Diehes 的英语释义”这一表述，未给出可确定的具体词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal isemmi Diehes bħala nom, iżda ma jagħtix tifsira preċiża jew kelma ekwivalenti bl-Ingliż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Diehes is listed as a noun, but the supplied gloss does not establish its specific meaning.

formal.mt: Il-materjal mogħti jelenka l-kelma Diehes bħala nom, iżda ma jispjegax it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The supplied material lists the word Diehes as a noun but does not explain its meaning.
formal.zh: 所给材料将 Diehes 列为名词，但没有解释其含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma Diehes? Mark: Il-materjal ma jgħidx; irridu aktar informazzjoni biex inkunu nafu t-tifsira tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word Diehes mean? Mark: The material doesn't say; we need more information to know its meaning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Diehes 这个词是什么意思？Mark：材料没有说明；我们需要更多信息才能知道它的含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: Diehes 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word Diehes mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-materjal ma jgħidx; irridu aktar informazzjoni biex inkunu nafu t-tifsira tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Il-materjal ma jgħidx; irridu aktar informazzjoni biex inkunu nafu t-tifsira tagħha.
messages.zh: 材料没有说明；我们需要更多信息才能知道它的含义。
messages.en: The material doesn't say; we need more information to know its meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Diehes 制作一张“名词，词义待补”的词卡，先记拼写与词性，避免把猜测记成释义。

gloss_zh: 饮食；饮食方案；节食饮食

teaching_sense.en_definition: The food and drink a person usually consumes, or a planned way of eating followed for a particular purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人日常摄入的食物和饮料，也指为某种目的而遵循的饮食安排，包括节食方案。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ikel u x-xorb li persuna tieħu s-soltu, jew pjan ta' ikel li ssegwi għal għan partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 日常饮食，或为特定目的而遵循的饮食方案；并不一定指减肥节食。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ikel u x-xorb li persuna tieħu regolarment, jew mod ippjanat ta' kif tiekol għal skop partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your diet is the food and drink you usually consume, or a particular eating plan you follow.

collocations.zh: 正在按特定饮食方案进食；正在节食

formal.mt: Il-kwestjonarju jistaqsi lill-parteċipanti dwar id-dieta tagħhom u kemm-il darba jieklu barra mid-dar.
formal.en: The questionnaire asks participants about their diet and how often they eat away from home.
formal.zh: 问卷询问参与者的饮食情况，以及他们多久在外用餐一次。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ġibt l-ikel miegħek illum? Mark: Qed insegwi dieta ġdida u nipprepara l-ikel id-dar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you bring your food with you today? Mark: I'm following a new diet and preparing my food at home.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天为什么自己带饭？马克：我在遵循新的饮食方案，饭菜都在家里准备。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你今天为什么自己带饭？
messages.en: Why did you bring your food with you today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed insegwi dieta ġdida u nipprepara l-ikel id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Qed insegwi dieta ġdida u nipprepara l-ikel id-dar.
messages.zh: 我在遵循新的饮食方案，饭菜都在家里准备。
messages.en: I'm following a new diet and preparing my food at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dieta 和“一日三餐的安排”连起来记：它既可指平常吃什么，也可指特定饮食方案。看到 dieta bilanċjata，就想“餐盘里的均衡饮食”。

gloss_zh: 下一个的；即将到来的（阴性单数形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming immediately after the present period or occasion; used with a feminine singular noun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指紧接当前时段或场合之后的、即将到来的；此形式用于修饰阴性单数名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tiġi minnufih wara l-perjodu jew l-okkażjoni preżenti; din il-forma tintuża ma' nom femminili singular.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下一个的；紧接当前时段或场合之后的（阴性单数形式）。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tiġi eżatt wara l-perjodu jew l-okkażjoni li ninsabu fihom bħalissa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The next period or occasion is the one immediately after the present one.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa mal-ġenituri se ssir il-ġimgħa d-dieħla fis-sala tal-iskola.
formal.en: The meeting with parents will take place next week in the school hall.
formal.zh: 家长会议将于下周在学校礼堂举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se niltaqgħu din il-ġimgħa? Pawlu: Le, il-ġimgħa d-dieħla. Din il-ġimgħa għandi ħafna xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are we meeting this week? Pawlu: No, next week. I have a lot of work this week.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们这周见面吗？保罗：不，下周。这周我有很多工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们这周见面吗？
messages.en: Are we meeting this week?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-ġimgħa d-dieħla. Din il-ġimgħa għandi ħafna xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-ġimgħa d-dieħla. Din il-ġimgħa għandi ħafna xogħol.
messages.zh: 不，下周。这周我有很多工作。
messages.en: No, next week. I have a lot of work this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把日历向后翻一格来记：il-ġimgħa d-dieħla 是“下周”，is-sena d-dieħla 是“明年”。整组搭配一起背，并记住 dieħla 是阴性单数形式。

gloss_zh: 防守的；防御性的；带有戒备或自我辩护态度的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Intended to protect against attack, or showing a readiness to defend oneself against criticism.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旨在抵御攻击、保护自身的；也指面对批评时表现出戒备或急于自我辩护的。此形式为阳性单数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħsub biex jipproteġi kontra attakk, jew li juri ħtieġa li wieħed jiddefendi ruħu minn kritika; din hija l-forma maskili singular.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于防守或抵御攻击的；也形容面对批评时带有戒备、自我辩护态度的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu l-għan li jiddefendi jew jipproteġi, jew li juri reazzjoni ta' difiża meta persuna tħossha kkritikata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something defensive is intended to resist attack, while a defensive person reacts as though criticism is an attack.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-logħob difensiv tat-tim għen biex l-avversarji joħolqu inqas okkażjonijiet ta' gowl.
formal.en: The report describes how the team's defensive play helped limit the opponents' goalscoring opportunities.
formal.zh: 报告描述了球队的防守打法如何帮助减少对手的进球机会。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tkun daqshekk difensiv? Staqsejtek biss x'ġara. Mark: Ħsibt li kont qed twaħħal fija. Ħa nispjega.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you being so defensive? I only asked what happened. Mark: I thought you were blaming me. Let me explain.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么这么急着为自己辩护？我只是问发生了什么。马克：我以为你在怪我。让我解释一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tkun daqshekk difensiv? Staqsejtek biss x'ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tkun daqshekk difensiv? Staqsejtek biss x'ġara.
messages.zh: 你为什么这么急着为自己辩护？我只是问发生了什么。
messages.en: Why are you being so defensive? I only asked what happened.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħsibt li kont qed twaħħal fija. Ħa nispjega.
messages.mt_standard: Ħsibt li kont qed twaħħal fija. Ħa nispjega.
messages.zh: 我以为你在怪我。让我解释一下。
messages.en: I thought you were blaming me. Let me explain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“举起盾牌”的画面记 difensiv：球场上是防守打法，谈话中是觉得受批评后急于自辩。它描述性质或态度，可与表示人的 difensur 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who protects or supports someone or something, especially a player whose main role is to stop opponents from scoring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保护某人、某物或维护某种主张的人；在体育中，尤指主要负责阻止对方得分的防守球员或后卫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tipproteġi jew tappoġġja lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa; fl-isport, plejer li r-rwol ewlieni tiegħu hu li jwaqqaf lill-avversarji milli jiskurjaw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 防守者、保护者或捍卫者；体育语境中指防守球员，尤其是后卫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Min jiddefendi persuna, ħaġa jew prinċipju, jew plejer li jipproteġi lit-tim tiegħu billi jipprova jwaqqaf lill-avversarji milli jiskurjaw.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A defender protects someone or something, or plays in a position intended to stop the opposing team from scoring.

formal.mt: Il-klabb ħabbar li d-difensur ċentrali ffirma kuntratt għal żewġ staġuni oħra.
formal.en: The club announced that the central defender had signed a contract for another two seasons.
formal.zh: 俱乐部宣布，这名中后卫已签约再效力两个赛季。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu dak il-plejer ħdejn il-gowlkiper? Pawlu: Dak hu d-difensur il-ġdid tagħna. Jilgħab fin-nofs tad-difiża.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is that player next to the goalkeeper? Pawlu: That's our new defender. He plays in the centre of defence.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：守门员旁边那个球员是谁？保罗：那是我们的新后卫。他踢中后卫。

messages.speaker: Nina (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak il-plejer ħdejn il-gowlkiper?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak il-plejer ħdejn il-gowlkiper?
messages.zh: 守门员旁边那个球员是谁？
messages.en: Who is that player next to the goalkeeper?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu d-difensur il-ġdid tagħna. Jilgħab fin-nofs tad-difiża.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu d-difensur il-ġdid tagħna. Jilgħab fin-nofs tad-difiża.
messages.zh: 那是我们的新后卫。他踢中后卫。
messages.en: That's our new defender. He plays in the centre of defence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 difensur 记成“站出来守护的人”：在球门前守护球队的是后卫，维护权利的是捍卫者。先问“他守护什么”，就容易选对中文意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fault or imperfection in an object, system, or piece of work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品、系统或作品中影响其功能、质量或完善程度的问题或不足。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas jew ħsara f'oġġett, sistema jew xogħol li jnaqqas il-kwalità tiegħu jew jaffettwa kif jaħdem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使物品或系统无法正常工作，或无法达到应有标准的缺陷。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħsara jew nuqqas f'oġġett jew sistema li ma jħallihx jaħdem sew jew jilħaq il-livell meħtieġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A defect is a fault that prevents something from working properly or meeting the required standard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使事物不够完善的瑕疵、弱点或不足，可涉及外观、设计或推理。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nuqqas fid-dehra, fid-disinn jew fir-raġunament li jagħmel xi ħaġa inqas tajba jew inqas konvinċenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flaw is an imperfection or weakness that makes something less satisfactory or convincing.

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni identifikat difett fil-magna li jista' jaffettwa s-sigurtà tal-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The inspection identified a defect in the machine that could affect workers' safety.
formal.zh: 检查发现机器存在一处可能影响工人安全的缺陷。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din it-tazza għandha difett żgħir fit-tarf. Lara: Għandek raġun. Trid nibdilhielek?
colloquial.en: Mark: This cup has a small flaw on the rim. Lara: You're right. Would you like me to exchange it for you?
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个杯子的杯口有个小瑕疵。Lara：确实。要我帮你换一个吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-tazza għandha difett żgħir fit-tarf.
messages.mt_standard: Din it-tazza għandha difett żgħir fit-tarf.
messages.zh: 这个杯子的杯口有个小瑕疵。
messages.en: This cup has a small flaw on the rim.

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.zh: 确实。要我帮你换一个吗？
messages.en: You're right. Would you like me to exchange it for you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把杯口的小缺口和机器的故障并排想象：两者都可叫 difett，分别帮助记住“瑕疵”和“缺陷”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fault in the material from which an object is made.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品所用材料本身存在的缺陷，例如裂纹或内部不均匀，可能影响质量或强度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas fil-materjal li minnu jkun magħmul oġġett, bħal xaqq jew irregolarità interna, li jista' jaffettwa l-kwalità jew is-saħħa tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 物品所用材料本身的缺陷，可能降低其强度、质量或使用性能。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħsara jew nuqqas fil-materjal innifsu li jista' jnaqqas is-saħħa, il-kwalità jew il-kapaċità tal-oġġett li jaqdi l-funzjoni tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A material defect is a fault in the substance used to make an object that can reduce its quality or strength.

collocations.en: a material defect in the steel
an inspection for a material defect

formal.mt: L-analiżi tal-kampjun ikkonfermat difett materjali fl-azzar li naqqas is-saħħa tal-parti.
formal.en: Analysis of the sample confirmed a material defect in the steel that reduced the strength of the component.
formal.zh: 样品分析证实钢材存在材料缺陷，降低了该零件的强度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex inkisret din il-parti? Pawlu: Sibna difett materjali fil-metall. Se nibdlu l-parti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did this part break? Pawlu: We found a material defect in the metal. We'll replace the part.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个零件为什么断了？Pawlu：我们发现金属本身有材料缺陷。我们会更换这个零件。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个零件为什么断了？
messages.en: Why did this part break?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (维修技师)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibna difett materjali fil-metall. Se nibdlu l-parti.
messages.mt_standard: Sibna difett materjali fil-metall. Se nibdlu l-parti.
messages.zh: 我们发现金属本身有材料缺陷。我们会更换这个零件。
messages.en: We found a material defect in the metal. We'll replace the part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把断裂零件放到显微镜下，检查材料内部的问题；用这个画面把 difett materjali 整体记成“材料缺陷”。

gloss_zh: 弥散的；分散的；广泛存在的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Spread over an area rather than concentrated in one place, or present in many places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 散布于一定范围而非集中于一点的；也指在许多地方存在或广泛流行的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun mifrux fuq żona u mhux ikkonċentrat f'post wieħed, jew li jkun preżenti f'ħafna postijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弥散的；分散的，指光等散布在一定范围内，而非集中于一点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun mifrux f'diversi direzzjonijiet jew fuq żona, minflok ikun ikkonċentrat f'punt wieħed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is diffuse is spread over an area rather than concentrated in one place.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分布广泛的；普遍存在的，指在许多地方或许多人当中出现。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab jew iseħħ f'ħafna postijiet jew fost ħafna nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is widespread exists or happens in many places or among many people.

formal.mt: L-użu diffuż tat-telefowns intelliġenti biddel il-mod kif in-nies jaċċessaw l-informazzjoni.
formal.en: The widespread use of smartphones has changed how people access information.
formal.zh: 智能手机的广泛使用改变了人们获取信息的方式。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex poġġejt il-lampa wara dik il-purtiera rqiqa? Toni: Biex ikollna dawl diffuż u dellijiet aktar rotob fir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you put the lamp behind that thin curtain? Toni: So we get diffuse light and softer shadows in the photo.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么把灯放在那层薄窗帘后面？Toni：这样拍照时就有漫射光，阴影也更柔和。

messages.speaker: Sara (摄影学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex poġġejt il-lampa wara dik il-purtiera rqiqa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex poġġejt il-lampa wara dik il-purtiera rqiqa?
messages.zh: 你为什么把灯放在那层薄窗帘后面？
messages.en: Why did you put the lamp behind that thin curtain?

messages.speaker: Toni (摄影老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ikollna dawl diffuż u dellijiet aktar rotob fir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ikollna dawl diffuż u dellijiet aktar rotob fir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 这样拍照时就有漫射光，阴影也更柔和。
messages.en: So we get diffuse light and softer shadows in the photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象光穿过薄窗帘后散开，再联想到某种做法传遍许多地方；diffuż 的两个义项都可借“散布开来”的画面记忆。

gloss_zh: 用英语（所供释义；具体名词义未明确）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun supplied with the gloss 'In English', whose specific referent is not identified in the packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资料中标注为名词、所供英文释义为“In English”的词条；现有信息未明确其具体所指。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li fil-materjal mogħti għandu t-tifsira 'In English', iżda ma ġiex speċifikat għal xiex jirreferi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用英语；此处仅转述所供英文释义，资料未明确该名词的具体含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-espressjoni mogħtija bħala tifsira tindika l-użu tal-lingwa Ingliża, iżda ma tiċċarax għal xiex jirreferi dan in-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss indicates the use of English, but it does not establish a specific noun meaning for this entry.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'Dihes' hija mniżżla bħala nom bit-tifsira 'In English'; il-materjal mogħti ma jiċċarax it-tifsira speċifika tagħha.
formal.en: The word 'Dihes' is listed as a noun with the gloss 'In English'; the supplied material does not clarify its specific meaning.
formal.zh: “Dihes”被列为名词，所附释义为“In English”；现有资料未明确其具体词义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'Dihes' hawn? Mark: Hawn miktub 'In English', imma minn din it-tifsira biss ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti għal xiex tirreferi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'Dihes' mean here? Mark: It says 'In English', but that gloss alone does not let us be certain what it refers to.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的“Dihes”是什么意思？马克：上面写着“In English”，但仅凭这个释义，我们还不能确定它具体指什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“Dihes”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'Dihes' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub 'In English', imma minn din it-tifsira biss ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti għal xiex tirreferi.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub 'In English', imma minn din it-tifsira biss ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti għal xiex tirreferi.
messages.zh: 上面写着“In English”，但仅凭这个释义，我们还不能确定它具体指什么。
messages.en: It says 'In English', but that gloss alone does not let us be certain what it refers to.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Dihes 放进“词义待确认”卡片：记住所给释义是“In English”，不要据此自行补造名词含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A medical condition in which blood sugar remains too high because the body does not produce enough insulin or cannot use it effectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种因身体不能产生足够胰岛素或不能有效利用胰岛素而导致血糖持续过高的疾病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marda li fiha l-livell taz-zokkor fid-demm jibqa' għoli wisq għax il-ġisem ma jipproduċix biżżejjed insulina jew ma jużahiex b'mod effettiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 糖尿病，一种与胰岛素分泌不足或作用不佳有关、表现为血糖持续过高的疾病。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marda li tikkawża livell għoli wisq ta' zokkor fid-demm minħabba nuqqas ta' insulina jew diffikultà tal-ġisem biex jużaha sew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Diabetes is a condition in which the body has difficulty controlling the amount of sugar in the blood.

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jispjega x'inhi d-dijabete u kif din il-marda taffettwa l-livell taz-zokkor fid-demm.
formal.en: The leaflet explains what diabetes is and how this condition affects blood sugar levels.
formal.zh: 这份宣传册解释了什么是糖尿病，以及这种疾病如何影响血糖水平。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex inhu dan il-fuljett? Mark: Fuq id-dijabete. Jispjega l-marda bi kliem sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this leaflet about? Mark: Diabetes. It explains the condition in simple language.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份宣传册讲什么？马克：讲糖尿病，用简单的语言解释这种疾病。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这份宣传册讲什么？
messages.en: What is this leaflet about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq id-dijabete. Jispjega l-marda bi kliem sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq id-dijabete. Jispjega l-marda bi kliem sempliċi.
messages.zh: 讲糖尿病，用简单的语言解释这种疾病。
messages.en: Diabetes. It explains the condition in simple language.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dijabete 与英文 diabetes 并排记忆，再配一张血糖检测图；这个词表示疾病名称“糖尿病”。

gloss_zh: 患糖尿病的；与糖尿病有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having diabetes, or relating to diabetes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于描述患有糖尿病的人，或说明某事物与糖尿病有关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu d-dijabete, jew li għandu x'jaqsam mad-dijabete.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 患有糖尿病的；与糖尿病有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Aġġettiv li jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li għandu d-dijabete jew xi ħaġa marbuta ma' din il-marda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is diabetic has diabetes, while something described as diabetic is related to that condition.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-esperjenza ta' pazjent dijabetiku waqt iż-żjara tiegħu fil-klinika.
formal.en: The report describes the experience of a diabetic patient during his visit to the clinic.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一名糖尿病患者到诊所就诊时的经历。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'dijabetiku' f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Ifisser li l-pazjent għandu d-dijabete.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'dijabetiku' mean in this sentence? Mark: It means that the patient has diabetes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句话里的“dijabetiku”是什么意思？马克：意思是这位病人患有糖尿病。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的“dijabetiku”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'dijabetiku' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 意思是这位病人患有糖尿病。
messages.en: It means that the patient has diabetes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 成对记忆 dijabete“糖尿病”和 dijabetiku“患糖尿病的”：前者给疾病命名，后者可修饰 pazjent“病人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A drawing that uses lines, shapes, or labels to explain the parts of something or show how it works.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用线条、形状或文字标注来说明事物组成、关系或运作方式的图。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tpinġija li tuża linji, forom jew kliem biex turi l-partijiet ta' xi ħaġa, ir-relazzjonijiet bejniethom jew kif taħdem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 图解或示意图，用简化的图形及标注说明结构、关系、过程或原理。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rappreżentazzjoni viżiva ssimplifikata li tispjega struttura, relazzjoni jew proċess permezz ta' linji, forom u xi drabi kliem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A diagram is a simplified drawing that helps you understand how something is arranged, connected, or operated.

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi kif l-ilma jgħaddi mill-partijiet differenti tas-sistema.
formal.en: The diagram shows how water passes through the different parts of the system.
formal.zh: 这张示意图展示了水如何流经系统的各个部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma fhimtx kif taħdem din is-sistema. Mark: Ħares lejn id-dijagramma; il-vleġeġ juruk fejn imur l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: I didn't understand how this system works. Mark: Look at the diagram; the arrows show you where the water goes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我没看懂这个系统怎么运作。马克：看看示意图，箭头会告诉你水流向哪里。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma fhimtx kif taħdem din is-sistema.
messages.mt_standard: Ma fhimtx kif taħdem din is-sistema.
messages.zh: 我没看懂这个系统怎么运作。
messages.en: I didn't understand how this system works.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares lejn id-dijagramma; il-vleġeġ juruk fejn imur l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares lejn id-dijagramma; il-vleġeġ juruk fejn imur l-ilma.
messages.zh: 看看示意图，箭头会告诉你水流向哪里。
messages.en: Look at the diagram; the arrows show you where the water goes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dijagramma 与英文 diagram 对照记忆，脑中画出方框和箭头：能把结构或过程讲清楚的图就是示意图。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a method of reasoning that examines opposing ideas and the relationships between them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与辩证法有关的，指通过考察相互对立的观点及其关系来推进理解的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' metodu ta' ħsieb li jeżamina ideat opposti u r-relazzjonijiet bejniethom biex jasal għal fehim aktar sħiħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辩证的；运用对立观点之间的讨论与分析来深化认识的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi l-eżami u t-tqabbil ta' ideat opposti bħala mezz biex wieħed jiżviluppa l-ħsieb u l-fehim tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dialectical approach develops understanding by examining opposing ideas and exploring how they relate to each other.

collocations.zh: 辩证的研究或思考方式

formal.mt: L-awtur juża metodu dijalettiku biex jeżamina żewġ fehmiet opposti dwar il-libertà.
formal.en: The author uses a dialectical method to examine two opposing views of freedom.
formal.zh: 作者运用辩证方法，考察关于自由的两种对立观点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jiġifieri approċċ dijalettiku? Pawlu: Tqis ideat opposti u tara kif ir-relazzjoni bejniethom tgħinek tifhem is-suġġett aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does a dialectical approach mean? Pawlu: You consider opposing ideas and see how the relationship between them helps you understand the subject better.
colloquial.zh: Maja：辩证的思考方式是什么意思？Pawlu：就是考虑相互对立的观点，看看它们之间的关系如何帮助你更好地理解这个问题。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 辩证的思考方式是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a dialectical approach mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqis ideat opposti u tara kif ir-relazzjoni bejniethom tgħinek tifhem is-suġġett aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Tqis ideat opposti u tara kif ir-relazzjoni bejniethom tgħinek tifhem is-suġġett aħjar.
messages.zh: 就是考虑相互对立的观点，看看它们之间的关系如何帮助你更好地理解这个问题。
messages.en: You consider opposing ideas and see how the relationship between them helps you understand the subject better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dijalettiku 配上一幅两种相反观点互相对话的图，记住它表示“辩证的”；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A straight line through the centre of a circle connecting two points on its edge, or the length of that line.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿过圆心、连接圆周上两点的线段，也指这条线段的长度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Segment ta' linja dritta li jgħaddi miċ-ċentru ta' ċirku u jgħaqqad żewġ punti fuq iċ-ċirkonferenza tiegħu, jew it-tul ta' dan is-segment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直径：经过圆心并以圆周上的两点为端点的线段，或该线段的长度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Segment dritt minn punt fuq iċ-ċirkonferenza ta' ċirku għal punt ieħor, li jgħaddi miċ-ċentru; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għat-tul tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The diameter of a circle is the distance across it along a straight line passing through its centre.

formal.mt: Iċ-ċirku għandu dijametru ta' għaxar ċentimetri u raġġ ta' ħames ċentimetri.
formal.en: The circle has a diameter of ten centimetres and a radius of five centimetres.
formal.zh: 这个圆的直径为十厘米，半径为五厘米。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inkejjel id-dijametru ta' din l-għatu? Mark: Kejjel minn tarf għall-ieħor f'linja dritta li tgħaddi miċ-ċentru.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do I measure the diameter of this lid? Mark: Measure from one edge to the other along a straight line through the centre.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个盖子的直径怎么量？Mark：沿着穿过中心的直线，从一边量到另一边。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inkejjel id-dijametru ta' din l-għatu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inkejjel id-dijametru ta' din l-għatu?
messages.zh: 这个盖子的直径怎么量？
messages.en: How do I measure the diameter of this lid?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kejjel minn tarf għall-ieħor f'linja dritta li tgħaddi miċ-ċentru.
messages.mt_standard: Kejjel minn tarf għall-ieħor f'linja dritta li tgħaddi miċ-ċentru.
messages.zh: 沿着穿过中心的直线，从一边量到另一边。
messages.en: Measure from one edge to the other along a straight line through the centre.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 dijametru，就想象尺子穿过圆心横跨整个圆；记住“过圆心、从边到边”就是直径。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The identification of an illness or medical condition through examination of symptoms and other evidence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过检查症状和其他医学证据，判断疾病或健康问题的过程或结论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-identifikazzjoni ta' marda jew kundizzjoni medika permezz tal-eżami tas-sintomi u ta' evidenza oħra, jew il-konklużjoni li tirriżulta minn dan il-proċess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诊断；根据症状、检查及其他相关证据对疾病或健康问题作出的判断。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih tiġi identifikata marda jew kundizzjoni medika wara li jiġu eżaminati s-sintomi u informazzjoni oħra rilevanti, jew ir-riżultat ta' dan il-proċess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A diagnosis identifies the illness or medical condition that explains a person's symptoms, using examination and other available evidence.

formal.mt: It-tabib eżamina s-sintomi u r-riżultati tat-testijiet qabel ma għamel id-dijanjożi.
formal.en: The doctor examined the symptoms and test results before making the diagnosis.
formal.zh: 医生在作出诊断之前，检查了症状和检测结果。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-tabib għamel dijanjożi? Karl: Għadu le; qed jistenna r-riżultati tat-testijiet.
colloquial.en: Nina: Has the doctor made a diagnosis? Karl: Not yet; he is waiting for the test results.
colloquial.zh: Nina：医生作出诊断了吗？Karl：还没有，他在等检测结果。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生作出诊断了吗？
messages.en: Has the doctor made a diagnosis?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu le; qed jistenna r-riżultati tat-testijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu le; qed jistenna r-riżultati tat-testijiet.
messages.zh: 还没有，他在等检测结果。
messages.en: Not yet; he is waiting for the test results.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dijanjożi 放进“症状加检查，得出诊断”的画面里，并搭配“准确的诊断”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A colour photograph on transparent film that can be viewed by passing light through it or projected onto a screen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作在透明胶片上的彩色照片，可透光观看或通过投影机放映在屏幕上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ritratt bil-kulur fuq pellikola trasparenti li jista' jidher meta jgħaddi d-dawl minnu jew jiġi pproġettat fuq skrin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 彩色幻灯片；供透光观看或投影放映的彩色透明摄影正片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Immaġni fotografika bil-kulur fuq biċċa pellikola trasparenti, maħsuba biex titqies bid-dawl jgħaddi minnha jew biex tintwera fuq skrin permezz ta' projettur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A color slide is a photograph on transparent film that you view with light behind it or project onto a screen.

formal.mt: Waqt il-preżentazzjoni, l-għalliema pproġettat dijapożittiva bil-kulur li turi l-port.
formal.en: During the presentation, the teacher projected a colour slide showing the harbour.
formal.zh: 展示过程中，老师投影放映了一张呈现港口景色的彩色幻灯片。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'hemm f'din il-kaxxa żgħira? Toni: Dijapożittiva tal-vaganza tagħna; ejja narawha bil-projettur.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is in this little box? Toni: A colour slide from our holiday; let's view it with the projector.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个小盒子里有什么？Toni：一张我们度假时拍的彩色幻灯片，来用投影机看看吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个小盒子里有什么？
messages.en: What is in this little box?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dijapożittiva tal-vaganza tagħna; ejja narawha bil-projettur.
messages.mt_standard: Dijapożittiva tal-vaganza tagħna; ejja narawha bil-projettur.
messages.zh: 一张我们度假时拍的彩色幻灯片，来用投影机看看吧。
messages.en: A colour slide from our holiday; let's view it with the projector.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 dijapożittiva 时，想象灯光穿过一张彩色透明胶片，把度假照片投到墙上；这样把词和实物连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition in which a person frequently passes loose or watery stools.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 排便频繁，且粪便稀软或呈水样的身体状况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha persuna tgħaddi ħmieġ artab ħafna jew likwidu ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腹泻，指频繁排出稀软或水样粪便的状况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha persuna tgħaddi ħmieġ artab ħafna jew likwidu aktar ta' spiss mis-soltu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone has diarrhoea, they pass loose or watery stools more frequently than usual.

formal.mt: Il-pazjent irrapporta li kellu dijarea għal jumejn.
formal.en: The patient reported having diarrhoea for two days.
formal.zh: 患者报告说自己已经腹泻两天。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għadek ma tiflaħx? Pawlu: Iva, għandi dijarea u llum se nibqa' d-dar.
