colloquial.en: Marija: Are you still feeling unwell? Pawlu: Yes, I have diarrhoea, and I'm staying home today.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你还是不舒服吗？保罗：是啊，我腹泻了，今天打算待在家里。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还是不舒服吗？
messages.en: Are you still feeling unwell?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi dijarea u llum se nibqa' d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi dijarea u llum se nibqa' d-dar.
messages.zh: 是啊，我腹泻了，今天打算待在家里。
messages.en: Yes, I have diarrhoea, and I'm staying home today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dijarea 和“频繁上厕所、粪便稀软”的画面一起记；再用 għandi dijarea 练习表达“我腹泻了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes a formal statement or declaration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作出正式声明或提交正式申报的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel dikjarazzjoni formali jew tippreżenta informazzjoni permezz ta' dikjarazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 声明人或申报人，即作出正式声明或申报的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel dikjarazzjoni formali dwar fatti jew informazzjoni, pereżempju f'dokument uffiċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A declarant is a person who makes a formal declaration about facts or information.

formal.mt: Il-formola tinkludi l-isem, l-indirizz u l-firma tad-dikjarant.
formal.en: The form includes the declarant's name, address, and signature.
formal.zh: 该表格包含声明人的姓名、地址和签名。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min hu d-dikjarant fuq din il-formola? Rita: Jien, għax jien qed nagħmel id-dikjarazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who is the declarant on this form? Rita: I am, because I'm the one making the declaration.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这张表上的声明人是谁？丽塔：是我，因为这份声明是我作出的。

messages.speaker: Mark (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu d-dikjarant fuq din il-formola?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu d-dikjarant fuq din il-formola?
messages.zh: 这张表上的声明人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the declarant on this form?

messages.speaker: Rita (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, għax jien qed nagħmel id-dikjarazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, għax jien qed nagħmel id-dikjarazzjoni.
messages.zh: 是我，因为这份声明是我作出的。
messages.en: I am, because I'm the one making the declaration.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象表格签名栏旁站着作出声明的人：dikjarant 指这个“人”，学习时可与“声明这件事”分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal declaration giving customs authorities information about goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向海关正式申报货物信息的声明或申报记录。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni formali li tagħti lill-awtoritajiet tad-dwana informazzjoni dwar merkanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关申报，指向海关正式提供货物有关信息的声明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li biha persuna tipprovdi lill-awtoritajiet tad-dwana informazzjoni dwar il-merkanzija li tkun qed tiġi ddikjarata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs declaration is a formal statement that provides customs authorities with information about goods.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 报关申报或报关记录，指为办理海关手续而正式提交或登记的货物信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni jew reġistrazzjoni formali ta' informazzjoni dwar merkanzija għall-finijiet tal-proċeduri tad-dwana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs entry is a formal submission or record of goods information for customs processing.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供海关用途的申报或登记，指为办理海关事务而提交或记录的货物信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni jew reġistrazzjoni ta' informazzjoni dwar merkanzija magħmula għall-finijiet tad-dwana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An entry for customs purposes records or submits information about goods for use in customs procedures.

collocations.en: to fill in a customs declaration

formal.mt: Id-dikjarazzjoni doganali tagħti deskrizzjoni tal-merkanzija u tindika l-valur tagħha.
formal.en: The customs declaration describes the goods and states their value.
formal.zh: 该海关申报说明了货物的情况，并列明其价值。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Imlejt id-dikjarazzjoni doganali? David: Għadni le. Qed niċċekkja l-valur tal-merkanzija.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you filled in the customs declaration? David: Not yet. I'm checking the value of the goods.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你填好海关申报单了吗？戴维：还没有，我正在核对货物的价值。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 你填好海关申报单了吗？
messages.en: Have you filled in the customs declaration?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le. Qed niċċekkja l-valur tal-merkanzija.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le. Qed niċċekkja l-valur tal-merkanzija.
messages.zh: 还没有，我正在核对货物的价值。
messages.en: Not yet. I'm checking the value of the goods.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语贴到“向海关报告货物”的场景上记：看到货物描述和价值栏，就联想到 dikjarazzjoni doganali。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs declaration made in the standard form for the relevant customs procedure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 采用相关海关程序所用标准形式作出的海关申报。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni doganali magħmula fil-forma standard għall-proċedura doganali kkonċernata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 标准海关申报，指采用相关海关程序规定的标准形式作出的货物申报。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni dwar merkanzija ppreżentata lill-awtoritajiet tad-dwana fil-forma standard tal-proċedura doganali kkonċernata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A standard customs declaration presents goods information in the standard form used for the relevant customs procedure.

collocations.en: to fill in a standard customs declaration
to submit a standard customs declaration

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, id-dikjarant jippreżenta dikjarazzjoni doganali standard għall-merkanzija deskritta fil-fattura.
formal.en: In this example, the declarant submits a standard customs declaration for the goods described on the invoice.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，申报人为发票所列货物提交标准海关申报。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema dokument qed timla? Luqa: Dikjarazzjoni doganali standard. Qed niċċekkja d-dettalji mal-fattura.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which document are you filling in? Luqa: A standard customs declaration. I'm checking the details against the invoice.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你正在填哪份文件？卢卡：标准海关申报单。我正在对照发票核对详细信息。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你正在填哪份文件？
messages.en: Which document are you filling in?

messages.speaker: Luqa (报关经办人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dikjarazzjoni doganali standard. Qed niċċekkja d-dettalji mal-fattura.
messages.mt_standard: Dikjarazzjoni doganali standard. Qed niċċekkja d-dettalji mal-fattura.
messages.zh: 标准海关申报单。我正在对照发票核对详细信息。
messages.en: A standard customs declaration. I'm checking the details against the invoice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“海关申报”整个短语，再把末尾 standard 想成表格上的“标准”标签，连起来就是“标准海关申报”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A declaration that presents the essential information in a concise form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以简明形式列出必要信息的声明或申报。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li tippreżenta l-informazzjoni essenzjali b'mod qasir u ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以概要形式提供必要信息的声明或申报。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li tiġbor l-informazzjoni meħtieġa u tippreżentaha fil-qosor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A summary declaration is a statement that sets out the essential information in a concise form.

formal.mt: L-applikant għandu jippreżenta dikjarazzjoni fil-qosor li tinkludi l-punti ewlenin tat-talba tiegħu.
formal.en: The applicant should submit a summary declaration containing the main points of the request.
formal.zh: 申请人应提交一份简要声明，列出其请求的主要内容。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi nikteb id-dettalji kollha hawn? Mark: Le, għalissa ħejji dikjarazzjoni fil-qosor bil-punti ewlenin biss. Lara: Tajjeb, nibda bl-aktar informazzjoni importanti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Should I write all the details here? Mark: No, for now prepare a summary declaration with just the main points. Lara: All right, I'll start with the most important information.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里要写下所有细节吗？马克：不用，先准备一份简要声明，只列主要内容。拉拉：好，我先写最重要的信息。

messages.speaker: Lara (申请人)
messages.zh: 这里要写下所有细节吗？
messages.en: Should I write all the details here?

messages.speaker: Mark (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għalissa ħejji dikjarazzjoni fil-qosor bil-punti ewlenin biss.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għalissa ħejji dikjarazzjoni fil-qosor bil-punti ewlenin biss.
messages.zh: 不用，先准备一份简要声明，只列主要内容。
messages.en: No, for now prepare a summary declaration with just the main points.

messages.speaker: Lara (申请人)
messages.zh: 好，我先写最重要的信息。
messages.en: All right, I'll start with the most important information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句想成一张只列重点的声明纸：看到 fil-qosor 就提醒自己“简要概括”，重点在信息精简。

gloss_zh: 发票声明；发票上的声明

teaching_sense.en_definition: A declaration written on an invoice about the goods or transaction described in it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 写在发票上、就其中所列货物或交易作出的声明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni miktuba fuq fattura dwar l-oġġetti jew it-tranżazzjoni deskritti fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 载于发票上、涉及该发票所列货物或交易的声明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li titniżżel fuq fattura u tagħti informazzjoni dwar l-oġġetti jew it-tranżazzjoni msemmija fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An invoice declaration is a statement included on an invoice concerning the goods or transaction it records.

formal.mt: Qabel ma tintbagħat il-fattura lill-klijent, għandha tiġi vverifikata l-informazzjoni fid-dikjarazzjoni fuq fattura.
formal.en: Before the invoice is sent to the customer, the information in the invoice declaration should be checked.
formal.zh: 将发票发送给客户之前，应核查发票声明中的信息。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn inpoġġi din id-dikjarazzjoni dwar l-oġġetti? Pawlu: Fuq il-fattura stess; hekk tkun dikjarazzjoni fuq fattura. Nina: Tajjeb, inżidha qabel nibgħat il-fattura.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where should I put this declaration about the goods? Pawlu: On the invoice itself; that makes it an invoice declaration. Nina: All right, I'll add it before sending the invoice.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这份关于货物的声明应该放在哪里？保罗：就写在发票上，这样就是发票声明了。妮娜：好，我会在发送发票前加上。

messages.speaker: Nina (销售助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inpoġġi din id-dikjarazzjoni dwar l-oġġetti?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inpoġġi din id-dikjarazzjoni dwar l-oġġetti?
messages.zh: 这份关于货物的声明应该放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this declaration about the goods?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (会计)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-fattura stess; hekk tkun dikjarazzjoni fuq fattura.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-fattura stess; hekk tkun dikjarazzjoni fuq fattura.
messages.zh: 就写在发票上，这样就是发票声明了。
messages.en: On the invoice itself; that makes it an invoice declaration.

messages.speaker: Nina (销售助理)
messages.zh: 好，我会在发送发票前加上。
messages.en: All right, I'll add it before sending the invoice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象发票上多出一栏声明：fuq fattura 提醒你看声明写在什么文件上，把“发票”和“声明”成对记忆。

gloss_zh: 以名誉担保的声明；诚信声明

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement in which a person gives their word of honour that the information provided is true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声明人以个人名誉保证所提供信息真实的声明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li fiha persuna tagħti kelmtha fuq l-unur tagħha li l-informazzjoni mogħtija hija vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由声明人以自身名誉担保内容真实的声明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li biha persuna tikkonferma, fuq l-unur tagħha, li dak li tiddikjara huwa minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A declaration on honour is a statement in which someone pledges their personal honour that the information given is true.

collocations.zh: 签署一份以名誉担保的声明

formal.mt: L-applikanta hemżet dikjarazzjoni fuq l-unur li tikkonferma li l-informazzjoni mogħtija fl-applikazzjoni hija vera.
formal.en: The applicant attached a declaration on honour confirming that the information provided in the application is true.
formal.zh: 申请人附上了一份以名誉担保的声明，确认申请中提供的信息真实。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser dikjarazzjoni fuq l-unur? Marija: Tfisser li tagħti kelmtek li l-informazzjoni li qed tagħti hija vera. Sara: Mela niċċekkja kollox sew qabel niffirma.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does a declaration on honour mean? Marija: It means you give your word that the information you are providing is true. Sara: Then I'll check everything carefully before signing.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：以名誉担保的声明是什么意思？玛丽娅：就是你以自己的信用保证所提供的信息真实。萨拉：那我签字前要仔细核对所有内容。

messages.speaker: Sara (申请人)
messages.zh: 以名誉担保的声明是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a declaration on honour mean?

messages.speaker: Marija (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li tagħti kelmtek li l-informazzjoni li qed tagħti hija vera.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li tagħti kelmtek li l-informazzjoni li qed tagħti hija vera.
messages.zh: 就是你以自己的信用保证所提供的信息真实。
messages.en: It means you give your word that the information you are providing is true.

messages.speaker: Sara (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela niċċekkja kollox sew qabel niffirma.
messages.mt_standard: Mela niċċekkja kollox sew qabel niffirma.
messages.zh: 那我签字前要仔细核对所有内容。
messages.en: Then I'll check everything carefully before signing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象签字时说“我以自己的名誉保证属实”：把 fuq l-unur 与“名誉担保”绑定，记住声明强调真实性。

gloss_zh: 临时存储申报；暂存申报

teaching_sense.en_definition: A declaration providing information about goods intended for temporary storage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为拟临时存放的货物提供相关信息的申报。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li tagħti informazzjoni dwar oġġetti maħsuba biex jinħażnu għal żmien limitat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为货物临时存储而作出的申报。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni magħmula għall-ħażna ta' oġġetti għal żmien limitat, li tinkludi informazzjoni dwar dawk l-oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A declaration for temporary storage is a statement providing details of goods that are to be stored for a limited period.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 载明临时存放货物相关信息的暂存申报。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li tirrigwarda oġġetti li jkunu se jitqiegħdu f'ħażna temporanja u tipprovdi d-dettalji tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A temporary storage declaration is a document that gives information about goods intended to remain in storage for a limited time.

collocations.en: submit a declaration for temporary storage

formal.mt: Id-dikjarazzjoni għall-ħażna temporanja telenka l-oġġetti li se jinħażnu u tindika l-kwantità tagħhom.
formal.en: The temporary storage declaration lists the goods to be stored and states their quantity.
formal.zh: 临时存储申报列出拟存放的货物，并注明其数量。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Dawn il-kaxxi se jibqgħu hawn għal ftit jiem biss. Rita: Mela ħejji d-dikjarazzjoni għall-ħażna temporanja u niżżel kemm hemm kaxxi. Toni: Tajjeb, ngħoddhom u nimla d-dikjarazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Toni: These boxes will only stay here for a few days. Rita: Then prepare the temporary storage declaration and write down how many boxes there are. Toni: All right, I'll count them and complete the declaration.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：这些箱子只会在这里放几天。丽塔：那就准备临时存储申报，写明共有多少箱。托尼：好，我数一下，再填写申报。

messages.speaker: Toni (仓库职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn il-kaxxi se jibqgħu hawn għal ftit jiem biss.
messages.mt_standard: Dawn il-kaxxi se jibqgħu hawn għal ftit jiem biss.
messages.zh: 这些箱子只会在这里放几天。
messages.en: These boxes will only stay here for a few days.

messages.speaker: Rita (仓库主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ħejji d-dikjarazzjoni għall-ħażna temporanja u niżżel kemm hemm kaxxi.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ħejji d-dikjarazzjoni għall-ħażna temporanja u niżżel kemm hemm kaxxi.
messages.zh: 那就准备临时存储申报，写明共有多少箱。
messages.en: Then prepare the temporary storage declaration and write down how many boxes there are.

messages.speaker: Toni (仓库职员)
messages.zh: 好，我数一下，再填写申报。
messages.en: All right, I'll count them and complete the declaration.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“申报—用于存储—临时的”三段理解，想象箱子只暂放几天：ħażna 记存储，temporanja 记临时。

gloss_zh: 缔约前声明；签约前声明

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement made before a contract is concluded that provides information about the proposed agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在合同订立前作出的声明，用于说明拟议协议的有关情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li ssir qabel ma jiġi konkluż kuntratt u li tagħti informazzjoni dwar il-ftehim propost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在订立合同之前作出的、涉及拟议合同或交易的声明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni magħmula qabel il-konklużjoni ta' kuntratt dwar il-kuntratt jew it-tranżazzjoni proposta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pre-contractual statement is a statement made before a contract is concluded about the agreement being considered.

formal.mt: Qabel l-iffirmar tal-kuntratt, il-klijent qara d-dikjarazzjoni prekuntrattwali u talab kjarifika dwar l-ispejjeż imsemmija fiha.
formal.en: Before signing the contract, the client read the pre-contractual statement and requested clarification about the costs mentioned in it.
formal.zh: 签署合同前，客户阅读了缔约前声明，并要求进一步说明其中提到的费用。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qrajt id-dikjarazzjoni prekuntrattwali? Lara: Iva, imma għadni ma fhimtx sew il-parti dwar l-ispejjeż. Mark: Ejja nistaqsu dwarha qabel niffirmaw.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you read the pre-contractual statement? Lara: Yes, but I still haven't fully understood the part about the costs. Mark: Let's ask about it before we sign.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你读过缔约前声明了吗？Lara：读过了，不过费用那部分我还没完全弄懂。Mark：我们签字前先问清楚吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (共同签约人)
messages.zh: 你读过缔约前声明了吗？
messages.en: Have you read the pre-contractual statement?

messages.speaker: Lara (共同签约人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għadni ma fhimtx sew il-parti dwar l-ispejjeż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għadni ma fhimtx sew il-parti dwar l-ispejjeż.
messages.zh: 读过了，不过费用那部分我还没完全弄懂。
messages.en: Yes, but I still haven't fully understood the part about the costs.

messages.speaker: Mark (共同签约人)
messages.zh: 我们签字前先问清楚吧。
messages.en: Let's ask about it before we sign.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组与“签字之前先读声明”的画面绑定：看到合同和旁边的说明纸，就回想 dikjarazzjoni prekuntrattwali，重点记住声明发生在订约之前。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A declaration presented in a simpler form, including a simplified declaration used for customs purposes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以较简明形式呈现的声明或申报，也可专指用于海关手续的简化报关单。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni ppreżentata f'forma aktar sempliċi, li tista' tintuża wkoll għal skopijiet doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于海关申报的简化形式报关单。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni għad-dwana li tippreżenta l-informazzjoni dwar il-merkanzija f'forma simplifikata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A simplified customs declaration is a declaration that presents information about goods to customs in a simplified form.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 采用较简单形式或表述方式的声明或申报。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li tuża forma jew kliem aktar sempliċi biex tippreżenta l-informazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A simplified declaration is a declaration presented in a simpler format or expressed in simpler language.

collocations.en: submit a simplified declaration to customs
collocations.zh: 向海关提交简化报关单

collocations.en: a simplified declaration in clear language
collocations.zh: 用清晰语言表述的简化声明

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ppreżentat dikjarazzjoni simplifikata lid-dwana u żammet kopja tagħha flimkien mad-dokumenti tal-merkanzija.
formal.en: The company submitted a simplified customs declaration and kept a copy with the documents relating to the goods.
formal.zh: 公司向海关提交了简化报关单，并将其副本与货物相关文件一同保存。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din id-dikjarazzjoni simplifikata hija aktar faċli biex tifhimha? Pawlu: Iva, il-kliem huwa aktar ċar u s-sentenzi huma iqsar. Maja: Tajjeb, mela naqraha qabel nimla l-formola.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this simplified declaration easier to understand? Pawlu: Yes, the wording is clearer and the sentences are shorter. Maja: Good, then I'll read it before filling in the form.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这份简化声明更容易看懂吗？Pawlu：是的，用词更清楚，句子也更短。Maja：好，那我先读一读，再填表。

messages.speaker: Maja (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Din id-dikjarazzjoni simplifikata hija aktar faċli biex tifhimha?
messages.mt_standard: Din id-dikjarazzjoni simplifikata hija aktar faċli biex tifhimha?
messages.zh: 这份简化声明更容易看懂吗？
messages.en: Is this simplified declaration easier to understand?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (服务台工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kliem huwa aktar ċar u s-sentenzi huma iqsar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kliem huwa aktar ċar u s-sentenzi huma iqsar.
messages.zh: 是的，用词更清楚，句子也更短。
messages.en: Yes, the wording is clearer and the sentences are shorter.

messages.speaker: Maja (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, mela naqraha qabel nimla l-formola.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, mela naqraha qabel nimla l-formola.
messages.zh: 好，那我先读一读，再填表。
messages.en: Good, then I'll read it before filling in the form.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一份声明被改成更清楚、更简明的版本，用这个画面记住 dikjarazzjoni simplifikata；若旁边出现海关和货物，就切换到“简化报关单”这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An additional declaration that provides further information, including information needed to complete a customs declaration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为提供进一步资料而提交的补充声明或申报；在海关语境中，指补全有关申报资料的补充申报。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li żżid aktar informazzjoni ma' dikjarazzjoni oħra, inkluża informazzjoni meħtieġa biex titlesta dikjarazzjoni doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向海关提交、用于补充或补全相关申报资料的补充申报。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni ppreżentata lid-dwana biex iżżid jew tikkompleta l-informazzjoni dwar merkanzija li tkun diġà ġiet iddikjarata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A supplementary customs declaration is an additional submission to customs that provides information needed to complete an earlier declaration.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在已有声明或申报之外另行作出、用于提供额外资料的补充声明或补充申报。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni addizzjonali li tipprovdi aktar tagħrif dwar dak li jkun diġà ntqal jew ġie ddikjarat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A supplementary declaration is a further statement that adds information to something already declared.

collocations.en: submit a supplementary declaration to customs
attach a supplementary declaration to the application
collocations.zh: 在申请中附上补充声明

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ppreżentat dikjarazzjoni supplimentari lid-dwana biex tikkompleta l-informazzjoni dwar il-merkanzija.
formal.en: The company submitted a supplementary declaration to customs to complete the information about the goods.
formal.zh: 该公司向海关提交了补充申报，以补全货物资料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Diġà bgħatt l-applikazzjoni, imma ħallejt xi informazzjoni barra. Mark: Tista' tehmeż dikjarazzjoni supplimentari biex iżżid dak li jonqos. Maja: Tajjeb, nimlieha llum.
colloquial.en: Maja: I've already sent the application, but I left some information out. Mark: You can attach a supplementary declaration to add what's missing. Maja: All right, I'll fill it in today.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我已经把申请寄出去了，但漏了一些资料。Mark：你可以附上一份补充声明，把缺少的内容加上。Maja：好，我今天就填。

messages.speaker: Maja (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà bgħatt l-applikazzjoni, imma ħallejt xi informazzjoni barra.
messages.mt_standard: Diġà bgħatt l-applikazzjoni, imma ħallejt xi informazzjoni barra.
messages.zh: 我已经把申请寄出去了，但漏了一些资料。
messages.en: I've already sent the application, but I left some information out.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tehmeż dikjarazzjoni supplimentari biex iżżid dak li jonqos.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tehmeż dikjarazzjoni supplimentari biex iżżid dak li jonqos.
messages.zh: 你可以附上一份补充声明，把缺少的内容加上。
messages.en: You can attach a supplementary declaration to add what's missing.

messages.speaker: Maja (申请人)
messages.zh: 好，我今天就填。
messages.en: All right, I'll fill it in today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成“原表旁边再添一页”：dikjarazzjoni 是声明或申报，supplimentari 提示补充；遇到海关场景就记作“补充申报”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official declaration giving information about goods intended for export.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 就拟出口货物向有关主管机关提供资料的正式申报，也可指承载这些资料的出口申报单。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni uffiċjali li tagħti informazzjoni dwar merkanzija maħsuba biex tintbagħat barra mill-pajjiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为办理货物出口而作出的正式申报。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni uffiċjali magħmula għall-esportazzjoni ta' merkanzija, li tipprovdi d-dettalji meħtieġa dwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A declaration for export is an official statement providing details of goods that are to be sent abroad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向海关或有关主管机关申报出口货物资料的出口申报或申报单。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni mogħtija lid-dwana jew lill-awtorità responsabbli li tinkludi informazzjoni dwar il-merkanzija li tkun se tiġi esportata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An export declaration is an official submission to the relevant authority identifying goods being exported and giving details about them.

collocations.en: submit an export declaration to customs
check the details in the export declaration
collocations.zh: 核对出口申报单中的资料

formal.mt: Qabel ma ppreżentat id-dikjarazzjoni ta' esportazzjoni lid-dwana, il-kumpanija vverifikat id-deskrizzjoni u l-kwantità tal-merkanzija.
formal.en: Before submitting the export declaration to customs, the company checked the description and quantity of the goods.
formal.zh: 在向海关提交出口申报之前，该公司核对了货物的描述和数量。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Imlejt id-dikjarazzjoni ta' esportazzjoni għall-kaxxi li se nibagħtu barra? Pawlu: Kważi lesta. Għadni rrid niċċekkja l-kwantità. Lara: Tajjeb, ejja ngħoddu l-kaxxi flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you filled in the export declaration for the boxes we're sending abroad? Pawlu: It's almost ready. I still need to check the quantity. Lara: All right, let's count the boxes together.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们要发往国外的这些箱子，你填好出口申报单了吗？Pawlu：快好了，我还要核对一下数量。Lara：好，我们一起数一数箱子。

messages.speaker: Lara (物流同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Imlejt id-dikjarazzjoni ta' esportazzjoni għall-kaxxi li se nibagħtu barra?
messages.mt_standard: Imlejt id-dikjarazzjoni ta' esportazzjoni għall-kaxxi li se nibagħtu barra?
messages.zh: 我们要发往国外的这些箱子，你填好出口申报单了吗？
messages.en: Have you filled in the export declaration for the boxes we're sending abroad?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (物流同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi lesta. Għadni rrid niċċekkja l-kwantità.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi lesta. Għadni rrid niċċekkja l-kwantità.
messages.zh: 快好了，我还要核对一下数量。
messages.en: It's almost ready. I still need to check the quantity.

messages.speaker: Lara (物流同事)
messages.zh: 好，我们一起数一数箱子。
messages.en: All right, let's count the boxes together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“货物出国，先填申报”记住整个短语：dikjarazzjoni 对应申报，ta' esportazzjoni 限定为出口用途；把它和装箱、核对数量的场景一起记。

gloss_zh: 出发前申报；离境前申报

teaching_sense.en_definition: A declaration submitted before a person, vehicle, or shipment departs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人员、交通工具或货物出发前提交的申报或声明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li tiġi ppreżentata qabel ma titlaq persuna, vettura jew merkanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在人员、交通工具或货物出发之前提交的申报。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li tagħti informazzjoni meħtieġa qabel it-tluq ta' persuna, vettura jew merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pre-departure declaration is a statement submitted before a person, vehicle, or shipment leaves.

formal.mt: Skont l-istruzzjonijiet tal-kumpanija, id-dikjarazzjoni ta' qabel it-tluq għandha tinkludi d-data tat-tluq u d-destinazzjoni.
formal.en: According to the company's instructions, the pre-departure declaration should include the departure date and destination.
formal.zh: 按照公司的说明，出发前申报应包括出发日期和目的地。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Imlejt id-dikjarazzjoni ta' qabel it-tluq? Pawlu: Għadni le. Se nimlieha issa, qabel nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Have you completed the pre-departure declaration? Pawlu: Not yet. I'll complete it now, before we leave.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你填好出发前申报了吗？Pawlu：还没有。我现在就填，赶在我们出发之前。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 你填好出发前申报了吗？
messages.en: Have you completed the pre-departure declaration?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le. Se nimlieha issa, qabel nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le. Se nimlieha issa, qabel nitilqu.
messages.zh: 还没有。我现在就填，赶在我们出发之前。
messages.en: Not yet. I'll complete it now, before we leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词组放进时间顺序记忆：先填写申报，再动身出发；看到 qabel it-tluq，就联想“出发之前”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement specifying the intended final use of goods, equipment, or materials.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说明货物、设备或材料预定最终用途的声明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li tispeċifika għal xiex huma maħsuba li jintużaw fl-aħħar mill-aħħar oġġetti, tagħmir jew materjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 载明货物、设备或材料预定最终使用目的的声明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li tiddeskrivi l-għan finali li għalih se jintużaw oġġetti, tagħmir jew materjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A statement of end-use explains what goods, equipment, or materials are ultimately intended to be used for.

collocations.zh: 要求提供最终用途声明

formal.mt: Id-dikjarazzjoni ta' użu finali tispeċifika li t-tagħmir se jintuża biss għar-riċerka fil-laboratorju.
formal.en: The statement of end-use specifies that the equipment will be used only for laboratory research.
formal.zh: 最终用途声明载明，该设备将仅用于实验室研究。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-fornitur talab dikjarazzjoni ta' użu finali? David: Biex ikun jaf għal xiex se nużaw it-tagħmir.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the supplier request a statement of end-use? David: So that they know what we'll use the equipment for.
colloquial.zh: Sara：供应商为什么要求提供最终用途声明？David：为了知道我们打算用这套设备做什么。

messages.speaker: Sara (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-fornitur talab dikjarazzjoni ta' użu finali?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-fornitur talab dikjarazzjoni ta' użu finali?
messages.zh: 供应商为什么要求提供最终用途声明？
messages.en: Why did the supplier request a statement of end-use?

messages.speaker: David (实验室同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ikun jaf għal xiex se nużaw it-tagħmir.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ikun jaf għal xiex se nużaw it-tagħmir.
messages.zh: 为了知道我们打算用这套设备做什么。
messages.en: So that they know what we'll use the equipment for.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“这台设备最终拿来做什么”作记忆提问：użu finali 对应最终用途，整组词就是把用途写清楚的声明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement made by one party independently of other parties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由一方独立作出、并非各方共同发表的声明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni magħmula minn parti waħda b'mod indipendenti, mingħajr ma tkun dikjarazzjoni konġunta mal-partijiet l-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由某一方单独作出或发表的声明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li ssir minn naħa waħda biss u li ma tiġix ippreżentata bħala dikjarazzjoni konġunta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A unilateral statement is made by one party acting independently of the other parties involved.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ħarġet dikjarazzjoni unilaterali li tispjega l-pożizzjoni tagħha dwar il-proġett.
formal.en: The company issued a unilateral statement explaining its position on the project.
formal.zh: 该公司发表了一份单方面声明，说明其对该项目的立场。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Iż-żewġ naħat ħarġu din id-dikjarazzjoni flimkien? Mark: Le, hija dikjarazzjoni unilaterali tal-kumpanija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did both sides issue this statement together? Mark: No, it's a unilateral statement by the company.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这份声明是双方共同发表的吗？Mark：不是，这是公司单方面发表的声明。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iż-żewġ naħat ħarġu din id-dikjarazzjoni flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Iż-żewġ naħat ħarġu din id-dikjarazzjoni flimkien?
messages.zh: 这份声明是双方共同发表的吗？
messages.en: Did both sides issue this statement together?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 不是，这是公司单方面发表的声明。
messages.en: No, it's a unilateral statement by the company.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议桌只有一方举起声明稿：一方独自发声，就是单方面声明；用这个画面记住整个词组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical compound CCl2F2, whose molecules contain one carbon atom, two chlorine atoms, and two fluorine atoms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学式为 CCl2F2 的化合物，每个分子含一个碳原子、两个氯原子和两个氟原子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompost kimiku bil-formula CCl2F2, li kull molekula tiegħu fiha atomu wieħed tal-karbonju, żewġ atomi tal-kloru u żewġ atomi tal-fluworu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 化学式 CCl2F2 所表示的二氯二氟甲烷。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kompost kimiku rrappreżentat bil-formula CCl2F2, b'atomu wieħed tal-karbonju, żewġ atomi tal-kloru u żewġ atomi tal-fluworu f'kull molekula.
sense_translations.en_explanation: CCl2F2 is the chemical formula for a compound containing one carbon atom, two chlorine atoms, and two fluorine atoms per molecule.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 本义项中用来指称二氯二氟甲烷的名称 Halon。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'dan is-sens, l-isem Halon jirreferi għad-diklorodifluworometan, il-kompost bil-formula CCl2F2.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this sense, Halon refers specifically to the compound dichlorodifluoromethane, represented by the formula CCl2F2.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 二氯二氟甲烷，化学式为 CCl2F2 的化合物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kompost kimiku msejjaħ diklorodifluworometan, li l-formula tiegħu hija CCl2F2 u li fih karbonju, kloru u fluworu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dichlorodifluoromethane is a chemical compound whose molecules each contain one carbon atom bonded to two chlorine atoms and two fluorine atoms.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 二氟二氯甲烷，即二氯二氟甲烷，化学式为 CCl2F2。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem ieħor għad-diklorodifluworometan, l-istess kompost kimiku bil-formula CCl2F2.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Difluorodichloromethane is another name for the same compound as dichlorodifluoromethane, with the chemical formula CCl2F2.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 氟碳化合物十二号，指化学式为 CCl2F2 的二氯二氟甲烷。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem li jirreferi għad-diklorodifluworometan, il-kompost kimiku bil-formula CCl2F2.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fluorocarbon-12 is a name used for dichlorodifluoromethane, the chemical compound represented by CCl2F2.

collocations.zh: 二氯二氟甲烷的化学式
一个二氯二氟甲烷分子

formal.mt: Fit-tabella, id-diklorodifluworometan huwa identifikat bil-formula CCl2F2, li tindika l-għadd ta' atomi ta' kull element f'molekula waħda.
formal.en: In the table, dichlorodifluoromethane is identified by the formula CCl2F2, which indicates the number of atoms of each element in one molecule.
formal.zh: 表中用化学式 CCl2F2 标示二氯二氟甲烷，该式表明一个分子中各元素的原子数。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif niftakar il-formula tad-diklorodifluworometan? Adam: Aħseb f'karbonju wieħed, żewġ atomi tal-kloru u żewġ atomi tal-fluworu: CCl2F2.
colloquial.en: Nina: How can I remember the formula of dichlorodifluoromethane? Adam: Think of one carbon atom, two chlorine atoms, and two fluorine atoms: CCl2F2.
colloquial.zh: Nina：二氯二氟甲烷的化学式怎么记？Adam：想着一个碳原子、两个氯原子和两个氟原子：CCl2F2。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 二氯二氟甲烷的化学式怎么记？
messages.en: How can I remember the formula of dichlorodifluoromethane?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħseb f'karbonju wieħed, żewġ atomi tal-kloru u żewġ atomi tal-fluworu: CCl2F2.
messages.mt_standard: Aħseb f'karbonju wieħed, żewġ atomi tal-kloru u żewġ atomi tal-fluworu: CCl2F2.
messages.zh: 想着一个碳原子、两个氯原子和两个氟原子：CCl2F2。
messages.en: Think of one carbon atom, two chlorine atoms, and two fluorine atoms: CCl2F2.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词与化学式配对朗读，再画一个碳连着两个氯和两个氟的示意图；用“一碳、二氯、二氟”帮助记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Without delay or at the very moment something happens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示行动没有拖延，或某事就在当下的一瞬间发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bla dewmien jew fl-istess waqt li tiġri xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 立即；马上，强调不拖延地采取行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bla ma jgħaddi żmien ta' stennija qabel issir xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you do something immediately, you do it without waiting or allowing any delay.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瞬间；即刻，强调在极短时间内发生或完成。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'ħin qasir ħafna, hekk kif jiġri jew jidher xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens instantly, it happens at once, with virtually no time passing.

formal.mt: Meta rċeviet l-ittra, is-segretarja wieġbet dikment biex tevita aktar dewmien.
formal.en: When she received the letter, the secretary replied immediately to avoid further delay.
formal.zh: 秘书收到信后立即回复，以免进一步耽搁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaraftu meta rajtu? Mark: Iva, għaraftu dikment, anki wara tant snin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you recognize him when you saw him? Mark: Yes, I recognized him instantly, even after so many years.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你见到他时认出他了吗？马克：认出来了，虽然过了这么多年，我还是一下子就认出了他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你见到他时认出他了吗？
messages.en: Did you recognize him when you saw him?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għaraftu dikment, anki wara tant snin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għaraftu dikment, anki wara tant snin.
messages.zh: 认出来了，虽然过了这么多年，我还是一下子就认出了他。
messages.en: Yes, I recognized him instantly, even after so many years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dikment 放在两个画面中记忆：收到信就回复是“立即”，见到老朋友就认出是“瞬间”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Careful and hardworking when carrying out tasks or responsibilities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做事认真、勤奋，并持续用心履行任务或职责的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaħdem b'ħafna ħsieb, attenzjoni u ħila biex iwettaq ix-xogħol u d-dmirijiet tiegħu sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勤勉的；做事认真细致、肯下功夫并尽责的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jwettaq ix-xogħol jew id-dmirijiet tiegħu b'attenzjoni, b'impenn u bi sforz kontinwu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is diligent works hard and takes consistent care over their tasks and responsibilities.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, l-għalliema ddeskriviet lil Pawlu bħala student diliġenti li jipprepara kull lezzjoni bir-reqqa.
formal.en: In her report, the teacher described Pawlu as a diligent student who prepares carefully for every lesson.
formal.zh: 老师在报告中将保罗描述为一名勤奋认真的学生，每节课前都会仔细准备。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sejjer Pawlu fl-iskola? Maja: Tajjeb ħafna. Hu diliġenti u jiċċekkja xogħlu qabel jagħtih lill-għalliema.
colloquial.en: Sara: How is Pawlu doing at school? Maja: Very well. He is diligent and checks his work before handing it to the teacher.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗在学校表现怎么样？玛雅：很好。他很认真，会检查好作业再交给老师。

messages.speaker: Sara (家长)
messages.zh: 保罗在学校表现怎么样？
messages.en: How is Pawlu doing at school?

messages.speaker: Maja (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna. Hu diliġenti u jiċċekkja xogħlu qabel jagħtih lill-għalliema.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna. Hu diliġenti u jiċċekkja xogħlu qabel jagħtih lill-għalliema.
messages.zh: 很好。他很认真，会检查好作业再交给老师。
messages.en: Very well. He is diligent and checks his work before handing it to the teacher.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“认真准备、仔细检查、坚持完成”三个动作记住 diliġenti，既有勤奋，也有细心尽责。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of severe mental confusion, or a false belief held as if it were true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指严重的精神混乱状态，或把不真实的想法当作事实而坚信的妄想。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' konfużjoni mentali kbira, jew twemmin falz li persuna tqisu bħala veru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谵妄，指明显的精神混乱状态；也指妄想，即坚信与事实不符的想法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat li fih il-ħsieb u l-għarfien ta' persuna jkunu mħawdin ħafna, jew idea falza li l-persuna temmen li hija vera.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Delirium is a state of severe mental confusion, while a delusion is a false belief that a person accepts as true.

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rumanz, l-awtriċi tispjega li l-karattru juri dillierju ta' kobor: jemmen li għandu setgħat straordinarji, għalkemm il-ġrajja ma tagħti ebda prova ta' dan.
formal.en: In her analysis of the novel, the author explains that the character displays a delusion of grandeur: he believes he has extraordinary powers, although the story provides no evidence of this.
formal.zh: 作者在对小说的分析中指出，这个人物表现出夸大妄想：他相信自己拥有非凡的能力，尽管故事没有提供任何证据。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex il-karattru jaħseb li kulħadd irid jobdih? Sara: Għandu dillierju ta' kobor; jemmen li hu s-sultan tad-dinja.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why does the character think everyone has to obey him? Sara: He has a delusion of grandeur; he believes he is the king of the world.
colloquial.zh: 马克：为什么这个人物觉得所有人都得听他的？萨拉：他有夸大妄想，相信自己是全世界的国王。

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karattru jaħseb li kulħadd irid jobdih?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karattru jaħseb li kulħadd irid jobdih?
messages.zh: 为什么这个人物觉得所有人都得听他的？
messages.en: Why does the character think everyone has to obey him?

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu dillierju ta' kobor; jemmen li hu s-sultan tad-dinja.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu dillierju ta' kobor; jemmen li hu s-sultan tad-dinja.
messages.zh: 他有夸大妄想，相信自己是全世界的国王。
messages.en: He has a delusion of grandeur; he believes he is the king of the world.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dillierju 配两张语义卡：“意识思维混乱”帮助记谵妄，“把虚假想法当真”帮助记妄想；结合上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word form that expresses small size and may also convey affection or familiarity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示所指事物较小的词语形式，有时也用于表达亲昵或熟悉的感情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma ta' kelma li tindika li xi ħaġa hija żgħira u li xi drabi tesprimi wkoll għożża jew familjarità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指小形式；表示体积、程度等较小，有时兼表亲昵意味的词语形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma jew forma ta' kelma li tintuża biex tindika ċokon jew, f'ċerti kuntesti, biex tesprimi għożża lejn min jew lejn dak li tissemma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A diminutive is a word or word form used to indicate smallness, sometimes also expressing affection or familiarity.

collocations.en: a word in the diminutive form

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tat-test, l-istudenta osservat li l-użu tad-diminuttiv jesprimi għożża lejn il-persuna msemmija, aktar milli ċokon fiżiku.
formal.en: In her analysis of the text, the student observed that the use of the diminutive expresses affection for the person mentioned, more than physical smallness.
formal.zh: 学生在文本分析中指出，这里使用指小形式主要是为了表达对所提人物的亲昵，而非强调其身体矮小。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm kelma fid-diminuttiv f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Hawnhekk tesprimi għożża; ma tfissirx bilfors li l-ħaġa hija żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there a word in the diminutive form in this sentence? Pawlu: Here it expresses affection; it does not necessarily mean that the thing is small.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么这个句子里有个词用了指小形式？保罗：这里是为了表达亲昵，不一定表示那个东西很小。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm kelma fid-diminuttiv f'din is-sentenza?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm kelma fid-diminuttiv f'din is-sentenza?
messages.zh: 为什么这个句子里有个词用了指小形式？
messages.en: Why is there a word in the diminutive form in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk tesprimi għożża; ma tfissirx bilfors li l-ħaġa hija żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk tesprimi għożża; ma tfissirx bilfors li l-ħaġa hija żgħira.
messages.zh: 这里是为了表达亲昵，不一定表示那个东西很小。
messages.en: Here it expresses affection; it does not necessarily mean that the thing is small.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diminuttiv 想成给词语加上“小小的、亲爱的”语气标签；先看是否表示小，再看是否表达亲昵。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An evil supernatural being, such as a devil or demon, described in religious beliefs or stories.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗教信仰或故事中具有邪恶力量的超自然存在，指魔鬼或恶魔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlejqa sopranaturali ħażina, bħal xitan jew spirtu ħażin, li tissemma fit-twemmin reliġjuż jew fl-istejjer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 魔鬼；宗教信仰或故事中代表邪恶、诱使人作恶的超自然存在。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlejqa sopranaturali li tirrappreżenta l-ħażen u li, fit-twemmin reliġjuż jew fl-istejjer, tħajjar lin-nies jagħmlu l-ħażin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A devil is an evil supernatural being that is believed or portrayed as tempting people to do wrong.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恶魔；被认为能够伤害、恐吓或控制人的邪恶灵体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spirtu ħażin li, skont ċertu twemmin jew ċerti stejjer, jista' jagħmel ħsara lin-nies, ibeżżagħhom jew jaħkem fuqhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A demon is an evil spirit that is believed or portrayed as harming, frightening, or possessing people.

formal.mt: F'din il-ġrajja, id-dimonju jħajjar lill-protagonist jagħżel il-ħażen.
formal.en: In this tale, the devil tempts the protagonist to choose evil.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，魔鬼诱使主人公选择邪恶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għalaqt il-ktieb? Mark: Għax fl-istampa hemm dimonju tal-biża'! Maja: Huwa biss karattru fl-istorja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you close the book? Mark: Because there is a frightening demon in the picture! Maja: It is just a character in the story.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么把书合上了？Mark：因为图里有个可怕的恶魔！Maja：那只是故事里的角色。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把书合上了？
messages.en: Why did you close the book?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为图里有个可怕的恶魔！
messages.en: Because there is a frightening demon in the picture!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那只是故事里的角色。
messages.en: It is just a character in the story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dimonju 和故事书里吓人的恶魔形象一起记：它是一个邪恶角色，词义可对应“魔鬼”或“恶魔”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Full of energy and initiative, or involving continuing activity, development, and change.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人精力充沛、积极主动，或形容事物持续活动、发展和变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna enerġija u inizjattiva, jew li jinvolvi attività, żvilupp u bidla kontinwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 充满活力、积极主动的；也指处于持续活动、发展或变化之中的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri enerġija u inizjattiva, jew li jkun dejjem attiv u għaddej minn żvilupp jew bidla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is dynamic shows energy and initiative or is continually active, developing, and changing.

formal.mt: Il-proġett jeħtieġ mexxej dinamiku li jkun kapaċi jħeġġeġ lit-tim u jadatta għall-bidliet.
formal.en: The project requires a dynamic leader who can motivate the team and adapt to changes.
formal.zh: 这个项目需要一位充满活力、能够激励团队并适应变化的领导者。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inhu l-għalliem il-ġdid? Pawlu: Dinamiku ħafna! Dejjem għandu idea ġdida għal-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the new teacher like? Pawlu: Very dynamic! He always has a new idea for the lesson.
colloquial.zh: Lara：新老师怎么样？Pawlu：特别有活力！他上课总有新点子。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 新老师怎么样？
messages.en: What is the new teacher like?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dinamiku ħafna! Dejjem għandu idea ġdida għal-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Dinamiku ħafna! Dejjem għandu idea ġdida għal-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 特别有活力！他上课总有新点子。
messages.en: Very dynamic! He always has a new idea for the lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dinamiku 配给“总有新点子的老师”：描述人时记“有活力”，描述环境时记“持续变化”。

gloss_zh: 活力；积极进取的劲头；发展动力

teaching_sense.en_definition: The energy, initiative, and drive that keep a person, group, or activity moving forward.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使个人、群体或某项活动不断向前发展的活力、主动性和干劲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-enerġija, l-inizjattiva u l-ħeġġa li bihom persuna, grupp jew attività jimxu 'l quddiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 活力；表现为精力充沛、积极主动并推动发展或变革的特质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' min jew ta' dak li juri ħafna enerġija u inizjattiva u jagħti spinta lill-iżvilupp jew lill-bidla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dynamism is the energy and initiative that enable someone or something to make progress and bring about change.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza d-dinamiżmu tal-intrapriżi żgħar u l-kontribut tagħhom għall-iżvilupp ekonomiku.
formal.en: The report highlights the dynamism of small enterprises and their contribution to economic development.
formal.zh: 报告强调了小型企业的活力及其对经济发展的贡献。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sejjer il-grupp il-ġdid? Daniel: Għandu ħafna dinamiżmu; kulħadd iġib ideat u jibda jaħdem fuqhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: How is the new group doing? Daniel: It has a lot of dynamism; everyone brings ideas and starts working on them.
colloquial.zh: Sara：新小组进展怎么样？Daniel：很有活力；大家都会提出点子，然后着手去做。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 新小组进展怎么样？
messages.en: How is the new group doing?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu ħafna dinamiżmu; kulħadd iġib ideat u jibda jaħdem fuqhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu ħafna dinamiżmu; kulħadd iġib ideat u jibda jaħdem fuqhom.
messages.zh: 很有活力；大家都会提出点子，然后着手去做。
messages.en: It has a lot of dynamism; everyone brings ideas and starts working on them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“团队提出点子并马上行动”的画面记 dinamiżmu：它是名词，表示推动事情前进的活力与干劲。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A succession of rulers from the same family, or a family whose members hold power across generations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由同一家族的统治者先后执政而形成的王朝，也可指世代掌握权力的家族。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' ħakkiema mill-istess familja li jmexxu wieħed wara l-ieħor, jew familja li żżomm il-poter għal diversi ġenerazzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 王朝；同一家族的统治者相继执政的统治序列，也可指世代掌权的家族。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' ħakkiema tal-istess familja li jieħdu l-poter wieħed wara l-ieħor, jew familja li l-membri tagħha jibqgħu fil-poter minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dynasty is a succession of rulers from the same family or a family that holds power over several generations.

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jeżamina kif il-poter għadda minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra fi ħdan l-istess dinastija.
formal.en: The chapter examines how power passed from one generation to the next within the same dynasty.
formal.zh: 本章探讨了权力如何在同一王朝内部代代传承。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dawn ir-rejiet kienu kollha mill-istess familja? Adam: Iva, kienu parti mill-istess dinastija. Nina: Issa nifhem għaliex is-siġra tal-familja tinsab ħdejn it-test.
colloquial.en: Nina: Were these kings all from the same family? Adam: Yes, they were part of the same dynasty. Nina: Now I understand why the family tree is next to the text.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这些国王都来自同一个家族吗？Adam：是的，他们属于同一个王朝。Nina：现在我明白为什么课文旁边放着家谱了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn ir-rejiet kienu kollha mill-istess familja?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn ir-rejiet kienu kollha mill-istess familja?
messages.zh: 这些国王都来自同一个家族吗？
messages.en: Were these kings all from the same family?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，他们属于同一个王朝。
messages.en: Yes, they were part of the same dynasty.

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nifhem għaliex is-siġra tal-familja tinsab ħdejn it-test.
messages.mt_standard: Issa nifhem għaliex is-siġra tal-familja tinsab ħdejn it-test.
messages.zh: 现在我明白为什么课文旁边放着家谱了。
messages.en: Now I understand why the family tree is next to the text.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张家谱上连续几代人都戴着王冠，用“同一家族接续统治”的画面记住 dinastija，意思是“王朝”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A prehistoric reptile belonging to the group known as dinosaurs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于恐龙类的史前爬行动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rettile preistoriku li jagħmel parti mill-grupp tad-dinosawri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恐龙；一种属于恐龙类的史前爬行动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rettile preistoriku li jappartjeni għall-grupp tad-dinosawri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dinosaur is a prehistoric reptile belonging to the group of animals known as dinosaurs.

formal.mt: Il-mużew qed jesebixxi skeletru ta' dinosawru sabiex il-viżitaturi jkunu jistgħu josservaw l-istruttura tiegħu.
formal.en: The museum is exhibiting a dinosaur skeleton so that visitors can observe its structure.
formal.zh: 博物馆正在展出一副恐龙骨架，让参观者观察它的结构。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak il-mudell ta' dinosawru! Kemm hu kbir! Mark: Iva! Ejja nieħdu ritratt ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that dinosaur model! It's so big! Mark: Yes! Let's take a photo next to it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看那个恐龙模型！好大啊！马克：是啊！我们在它旁边拍张照吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak il-mudell ta' dinosawru! Kemm hu kbir!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak il-mudell ta' dinosawru! Kemm hu kbir!
messages.zh: 看那个恐龙模型！好大啊！
messages.en: Look at that dinosaur model! It's so big!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊！我们在它旁边拍张照吧。
messages.en: Yes! Let's take a photo next to it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dinosawru 和博物馆里的恐龙骨架一起记：看到骨架，就说 skeletru ta' dinosawru，用具体画面记住“恐龙”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A relationship or condition in which someone or something relies on another, or an addiction to a substance or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人或某物需要依靠他者的关系或状态，也可指对某种物质或活动的成瘾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Relazzjoni jew kundizzjoni li fiha persuna jew ħaġa tiddependi fuq oħra; tista' tfisser ukoll vizzju marbut ma' sustanza jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依赖关系；某人或某物必须依靠另一人或另一事物才能运作或获得所需支持的关系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Relazzjoni li fiha persuna jew ħaġa teħtieġ lil persuna jew ħaġa oħra biex tiffunzjona jew tikseb l-appoġġ meħtieġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dependency is a relationship in which one person or thing needs another in order to function or receive support.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依赖；需要他人或某种事物提供帮助、支持或必需资源的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' min jeħtieġ l-għajnuna jew l-appoġġ ta' ħaddieħor, jew ikollu bżonn xi ħaġa biex jaqdi l-ħtiġijiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dependence is the state of needing someone or something for help, support, or essential resources.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成瘾；对某种物质或活动产生强烈需求，且难以控制或停止的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha persuna tħoss ħtieġa qawwija li tuża sustanza jew tagħmel attività u ssibha diffiċli tikkontrolla jew twaqqaf dan l-użu jew din l-attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An addiction is a strong need to use a substance or engage in an activity that is difficult to control or stop.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirrakkomanda miżuri biex titnaqqas id-dipendenza tal-pajjiż fuq l-importazzjoni tal-ikel.
formal.en: The report recommends measures to reduce the country's dependence on food imports.
formal.zh: 报告建议采取措施，减少该国对食品进口的依赖。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Bdejt naħdem biex innaqqas id-dipendenza finanzjarja tiegħi fuq il-ġenituri. Pawlu: Tajjeb! Issa tista' tħallas aktar mill-ispejjeż tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Sara: I've started working to reduce my financial dependence on my parents. Pawlu: That's good! Now you can cover more of your own expenses.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我开始工作了，想减少对父母的经济依赖。保罗：很好啊！现在你可以多承担一些自己的开销了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bdejt naħdem biex innaqqas id-dipendenza finanzjarja tiegħi fuq il-ġenituri.
messages.mt_standard: Bdejt naħdem biex innaqqas id-dipendenza finanzjarja tiegħi fuq il-ġenituri.
messages.zh: 我开始工作了，想减少对父母的经济依赖。
messages.en: I've started working to reduce my financial dependence on my parents.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb! Issa tista' tħallas aktar mill-ispejjeż tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb! Issa tista' tħallas aktar mill-ispejjeż tiegħek.
messages.zh: 很好啊！现在你可以多承担一些自己的开销了。
messages.en: That's good! Now you can cover more of your own expenses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“依靠什么”串联 dipendenza 的义项：经济上依靠父母是“依赖”，对赌博难以自控则是“成瘾”；搭配 fuq 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mental health condition involving persistent low mood and loss of interest that can affect daily life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种以持续情绪低落、兴趣减退等表现为特征，并可能影响日常生活的心理健康状况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni tas-saħħa mentali li tinvolvi burdata baxxa u telf ta' interess għal żmien twil u li tista' taffettwa l-ħajja ta' kuljum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抑郁症；涉及持续情绪低落、兴趣减退，并可能影响日常生活的心理健康状况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni tas-saħħa mentali li fiha persuna tesperjenza burdata baxxa u telf ta' interess għal żmien twil, b'effetti possibbli fuq il-ħajja tagħha ta' kuljum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Depression is a mental health condition in which persistent low mood and reduced interest can interfere with a person's daily life.

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jispjega kif id-dipressjoni tista' taffettwa l-ħajja ta' kuljum u jiddeskrivi s-servizzi ta' appoġġ disponibbli.
formal.en: The leaflet explains how depression can affect daily life and describes the support services available.
formal.zh: 这份宣传册解释抑郁症如何影响日常生活，并介绍可获得的支持服务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Oħti qaltli li qed tbati minn dipressjoni. Mark: Kif nista' ngħinha? Lara: Tista' tismagħha u tistaqsiha x'appoġġ tixtieq.
colloquial.en: Lara: My sister told me she's suffering from depression. Mark: How can I help her? Lara: You can listen to her and ask what support she'd like.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我姐姐告诉我，她正在受抑郁症困扰。马克：我能怎么帮助她？拉拉：你可以听她说说，问问她希望得到什么支持。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Oħti qaltli li qed tbati minn dipressjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Oħti qaltli li qed tbati minn dipressjoni.
messages.zh: 我姐姐告诉我，她正在受抑郁症困扰。
messages.en: My sister told me she's suffering from depression.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我能怎么帮助她？
messages.en: How can I help her?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tismagħha u tistaqsiha x'appoġġ tixtieq.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tismagħha u tistaqsiha x'appoġġ tixtieq.
messages.zh: 你可以听她说说，问问她希望得到什么支持。
messages.en: You can listen to her and ask what support she'd like.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dipressjoni 放进“持续低落、兴趣减少”的学习场景，再配记 sintomi ta' dipressjoni“抑郁症状”，避免只联想到一时不开心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official instruction or order stating what someone must do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由有权者发出、说明某人必须采取何种行动的正式指示或命令。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struzzjoni jew ordni uffiċjali mogħtija minn min għandu l-awtorità, li tgħid x'għandu jsir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指令；由有权者发布、规定行动方式或要求的正式指示。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Struzzjoni uffiċjali maħruġa minn min għandu l-awtorità, li tistabbilixxi kif għandu jsir xi ħaġa jew x'azzjoni għandha tittieħed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A directive is an official instruction issued by an authority explaining what action must be taken.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 命令；由有权者发出、要求他人执行某项行动的指示。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kmand mogħti minn min għandu l-awtorità, li jobbliga lil xi ħadd jagħmel azzjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An order is an instruction from someone in authority requiring another person to do something.

formal.mt: Il-maniġment ħareġ direttiva li titlob lill-impjegati jirrappurtaw kull ħsara fit-tagħmir minnufih.
formal.en: Management issued a directive requiring employees to report any damage to equipment immediately.
formal.zh: 管理层发布了一项指令，要求员工立即报告设备的任何损坏。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt id-direttiva l-ġdida dwar il-bieb ta' wara? David: Iva, irridu nżommuh magħluq il-ħin kollu. Nina: Sewwa, nagħlquh issa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see the new directive about the back door? David: Yes, we have to keep it closed at all times. Nina: Right, let's close it now.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看到关于后门的新指令了吗？戴维：看到了，我们得一直把它关着。妮娜：好，那我们现在把它关上吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt id-direttiva l-ġdida dwar il-bieb ta' wara?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt id-direttiva l-ġdida dwar il-bieb ta' wara?
messages.zh: 你看到关于后门的新指令了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the new directive about the back door?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irridu nżommuh magħluq il-ħin kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irridu nżommuh magħluq il-ħin kollu.
messages.zh: 看到了，我们得一直把它关着。
messages.en: Yes, we have to keep it closed at all times.

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 好，那我们现在把它关上吧。
messages.en: Right, let's close it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象主管发出一份写着“必须这样做”的通知，把 direttiva 记成正式“指令”；再用“发布指令、遵照指令”两个动作巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized list of names and contact details, or a location used to organize computer files.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按一定方式编排的姓名、机构及联系方式名录，也可指计算机中用于组织文件的目录。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lista organizzata ta' ismijiet u dettalji ta' kuntatt, jew post f'sistema tal-kompjuter fejn jiġu organizzati l-fajls.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 名录；计算机文件目录。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġabra organizzata ta' ismijiet u informazzjoni dwar persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet, jew post fil-kompjuter li fih jinżammu fajls.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A directory is an organized collection of names and details, or a location in which computer files are stored.

formal.mt: Id-direttorju tal-kumpaniji jinkludi l-indirizz u n-numru tat-telefon ta' kull kumpanija.
formal.en: The company directory includes the address and telephone number of each company.
formal.zh: 公司名录列有每家公司的地址和电话号码。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn insib in-numru tal-kumpanija? Mark: Fittex fid-direttorju; hemm issib ukoll l-indirizz.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where can I find the company's number? Mark: Look in the directory; you will also find the address there.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我在哪里能找到这家公司的电话号码？马克：查一下名录，里面也有地址。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 我在哪里能找到这家公司的电话号码？
messages.en: Where can I find the company's number?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fittex fid-direttorju; hemm issib ukoll l-indirizz.
messages.mt_standard: Fittex fid-direttorju; hemm issib ukoll l-indirizz.
messages.zh: 查一下名录，里面也有地址。
messages.en: Look in the directory; you will also find the address there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 direttorju 想成一本分栏名录：找机构看联系方式，找文件看所在目录，用两个查找场景记住它。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A printed or electronic list of people or organizations and their telephone numbers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 列出个人或机构名称及其电话号码的纸质或电子名录。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lista stampata jew elettronika ta' persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet flimkien man-numri tat-telefon tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电话簿，即按姓名或名称编排、供人查找电话号码的簿册或电子名录。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ktieb jew lista elettronika li fiha l-ismijiet ta' persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet u n-numri tat-telefon tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A phone book lists people or organizations together with the telephone numbers you can use to contact them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电话号码名录，即系统列出个人或机构名称及其电话号码的资料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġabra organizzata ta' ismijiet u numri tat-telefon li tintuża biex jinstab in-numru ta' persuna jew organizzazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A telephone directory is an organized list that helps you find the telephone number of a person or organization.

collocations.en: look up a number in the phone book

formal.mt: In-numru tal-uffiċċju jista' jinstab fid-direttorju tat-telefon taħt l-isem tal-organizzazzjoni.
formal.en: The office number can be found in the telephone directory under the organization's name.
formal.zh: 在电话簿中按该机构的名称查找，即可找到办公室的电话号码。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek in-numru tal-ħanut? Pawlu: Le, imma nistgħu nfittxuh fid-direttorju tat-telefon.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have the shop's number? Pawlu: No, but we can look it up in the phone book.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有那家商店的电话号码吗？保罗：没有，不过我们可以查电话簿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有那家商店的电话号码吗？
messages.en: Do you have the shop's number?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, imma nistgħu nfittxuh fid-direttorju tat-telefon.
messages.mt_standard: Le, imma nistgħu nfittxuh fid-direttorju tat-telefon.
messages.zh: 没有，不过我们可以查电话簿。
messages.en: No, but we can look it up in the phone book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 direttorju 是名录，再把整个短语与查电话号码的动作绑定；看到 tat-telefon，就把名录的范围缩小到电话。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who directs an organization or activity, or oversees the artistic production of a film or play.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责领导机构或统筹某项工作的人，也可指指导电影或戏剧创作与演出的导演。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi organizzazzjoni jew attività, jew li tidderieġi x-xogħol artistiku ta' film jew dramm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主管、主任等负责领导或统筹工作的人；也指电影或戏剧导演。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna responsabbli mit-tmexxija ta' organizzazzjoni jew attività, jew mid-direzzjoni artistika ta' film jew produzzjoni teatrali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A director is someone who leads an organization or activity, or guides the artistic work involved in making a film or play.

formal.mt: Id-direttur tal-kumpanija ppreżenta l-pjan għas-sena li ġejja waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The company director presented the plan for the coming year during the meeting.
formal.zh: 公司主管在会议上介绍了下一年的计划。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu d-direttur ta' dan il-film? Luqa: Ma nafx, imma nistgħu naraw ismu fl-aħħar tal-film.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is the director of this film? Luqa: I don't know, but we can see his name at the end of the film.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这部电影的导演是谁？卢卡：我不知道，不过我们可以在片尾看到他的名字。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu d-direttur ta' dan il-film?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu d-direttur ta' dan il-film?
messages.zh: 这部电影的导演是谁？
messages.en: Who is the director of this film?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx, imma nistgħu naraw ismu fl-aħħar tal-film.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx, imma nistgħu naraw ismu fl-aħħar tal-film.
messages.zh: 我不知道，不过我们可以在片尾看到他的名字。
messages.en: I don't know, but we can see his name at the end of the film.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人物与物品对照记忆：direttur 是负责指挥的人，direttorju 是供人查找的名录；再用办公室主管和片场导演两个画面巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take away someone's weapons or to take an object apart into its components.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 除去某人的武器，使其解除武装；或把某件物品拆成组成部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tneħħi l-armi lil xi ħadd, jew tifred oġġett fil-partijiet li jkun magħmul minnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解除某人的武装，或将机器、装置等拆卸开来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tneħħi l-armi lil persuna jew grupp, jew tħoll magna jew oġġett ieħor billi tifred il-partijiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you disarm someone, you remove their weapons; the supplied Maltese equivalent can also describe taking an object apart.

formal.mt: F'din is-sentenza, 'disarm' jintuża fis-sens ta' tneħħija tal-armi: il-pulizija żarmat lir-raġel mingħajr ma weġġa' ħadd.
formal.en: In this sentence, 'disarm' is used in the sense of removing weapons: the police disarmed the man without anyone being injured.
formal.zh: 在这个句子中，disarm 表示解除武装：警方解除了该男子的武装，无人受伤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'disarm' f'din il-lista? Mark: L-ekwivalenti mogħti hu 'żarma': tista' żżarma lil xi ħadd billi tneħħilu l-armi, jew żżarma magna billi tifred il-partijiet tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'disarm' mean in this list? Mark: The equivalent given is 'żarma': you can disarm someone by removing their weapons, or dismantle a machine by separating its parts.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这份词表里的 disarm 是什么意思？马克：给出的对应词是 żarma：可以指拿走某人的武器、解除其武装，也可以指把机器的部件拆开。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这份词表里的 disarm 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'disarm' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ekwivalenti mogħti hu 'żarma': tista' żżarma lil xi ħadd billi tneħħilu l-armi, jew żżarma magna billi tifred il-partijiet tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: L-ekwivalenti mogħti hu 'żarma': tista' żżarma lil xi ħadd billi tneħħilu l-armi, jew żżarma magna billi tifred il-partijiet tagħha.
messages.zh: 给出的对应词是 żarma：可以指拿走某人的武器、解除其武装，也可以指把机器的部件拆开。
messages.en: The equivalent given is 'żarma': you can disarm someone by removing their weapons, or dismantle a machine by separating its parts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按给定对应词 żarma 记两个动作：从人手中移走武器，从机器上拆下部件；借助宾语区分解除武装与拆卸。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flat, circular object, especially one used to store information or recorded sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 扁平的圆形物体，尤指用于储存信息或录制声音的盘片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett ċatt u tond, speċjalment wieħed li jintuża biex tinħażen informazzjoni jew jinżamm ħoss irrekordjat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圆盘；扁平的圆形物体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett ċatt li għandu forma tonda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A disc is a flat object with a circular shape.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磁盘或其他用于储存计算机数据的盘片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mezz fil-forma ta' diska li fuqu tinħażen informazzjoni diġitali u li jista' jinqara minn kompjuter.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A disk is a storage medium on which a computer can save and retrieve information.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 唱片；录有音乐等声音、可供播放的圆形盘片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Diska li fuqha jkun hemm mużika jew ħoss irrekordjat u li tindaqq b'apparat adattat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A record is a circular object containing recorded sound that can be played on suitable equipment.

formal.mt: Il-mużew juri disk tal-vinil flimkien mal-apparat li kien jintuża biex jindaqq.
formal.en: The museum displays a vinyl record alongside the equipment that was used to play it.
formal.zh: 博物馆将一张黑胶唱片与曾用于播放它的设备一同展出。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'hemm f'din il-kaxxa? Lara: Disk tal-vinil li kien ta' missieri. Mark: Għad għandek fuqiex iddoqqu? Lara: Iva, għandi l-apparat id-dar.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's in this box? Lara: A vinyl record that belonged to my father. Mark: Do you still have something to play it on? Lara: Yes, I have the equipment at home.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个盒子里有什么？Lara：一张以前属于我爸爸的黑胶唱片。Mark：你还有能播放它的设备吗？Lara：有，设备在我家里。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个盒子里有什么？
messages.en: What's in this box?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Disk tal-vinil li kien ta' missieri.
messages.mt_standard: Disk tal-vinil li kien ta' missieri.
messages.zh: 一张以前属于我爸爸的黑胶唱片。
messages.en: A vinyl record that belonged to my father.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还有能播放它的设备吗？
messages.en: Do you still have something to play it on?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，设备在我家里。
messages.en: Yes, I have the equipment at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 disk 想成一张扁圆盘：看形状记“圆盘”，看储存用途记“磁盘”，看播放用途记“唱片”。这是语境联想记忆法。

gloss_zh: 盘片；唱片；一首录制的乐曲

teaching_sense.en_definition: A disk or record, or an individual piece of recorded music.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 盘片或唱片，也可指一首已经录制的乐曲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett ċatt u tond li jista' jintuża biex jinżammu reġistrazzjonijiet jew informazzjoni, jew biċċa mużika rrekordjata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盘片；扁平的圆形物体，也可用于储存数据。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett ċatt u tond li jista' jintuża, fost affarijiet oħra, biex tinħażen informazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A disk is a flat, circular object that may be used to store information.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 唱片；录有声音并可用相应设备播放的盘片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett ċatt u tond li fuqu jkun hemm ħoss irrekordjat u li jista' jindaqq b'apparat adattat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A record is a physical disc carrying recorded sound for playback on suitable equipment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一首录制的歌曲或乐曲，侧重音乐作品本身。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kanzunetta jew biċċa mużika oħra li tkun ġiet irrekordjata u li tista' tinstema'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A piece of recorded music is a song or composition preserved in a recording for people to hear.

collocations.en: play a recorded track on the radio
collocations.zh: 在广播中播放一首录制的乐曲

formal.mt: Il-programm tar-radju jinkludi diska ġdida tal-kantanta u intervista dwar ix-xogħol tagħha.
formal.en: The radio programme includes a new track by the singer and an interview about her work.
formal.zh: 该广播节目包括这位女歌手的一首新歌，以及一次关于她作品的访谈。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Smajt id-diska l-ġdida ta' din il-kantanta? Ben: Iva, daqqewha fuq ir-radju dalgħodu. Sara: Għoġbitek? Ben: Ħafna! Irrid nerġa' nismagħha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you heard this singer's new track? Ben: Yes, they played it on the radio this morning. Sara: Did you like it? Ben: Very much! I want to hear it again.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你听过这位女歌手的新歌吗？Ben：听过，今天早上广播里放了。Sara：你喜欢吗？Ben：很喜欢！我想再听一遍。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt id-diska l-ġdida ta' din il-kantanta?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt id-diska l-ġdida ta' din il-kantanta?
messages.zh: 你听过这位女歌手的新歌吗？
messages.en: Have you heard this singer's new track?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 听过，今天早上广播里放了。
messages.en: Yes, they played it on the radio this morning.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢吗？
messages.en: Did you like it?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 很喜欢！我想再听一遍。
messages.en: Very much! I want to hear it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diska 放进“播放音乐”的场景：手里拿着时可指唱片，广播里听到时可指一首录制的乐曲；结合上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Living without moral restraint and indulging excessively in pleasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生活缺乏道德约束、过度纵情享乐的，通常带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħix bla rażan morali u jingħata żżejjed għall-pjaċiri, kelma li normalment tesprimi diżapprovazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放荡的；行为缺乏道德约束、纵情享乐的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jrażżanx l-imġiba tiegħu skont prinċipji morali u jingħata għall-pjaċiri bla qies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is dissolute behaves without moral restraint and spends much of their life pursuing pleasure.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生活糜烂的；沉溺于酗酒、性享乐等过度放纵行为的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun mogħti għall-eċċessi fix-xorb, fis-sess jew fi pjaċiri oħra, b'mod meqjus moralment ħażin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is debauched indulges excessively in drinking, sexual activity, or other pleasures in a way regarded as immoral.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-awtur jippreżenta lill-protagonist bħala raġel disklu li jaħli ġidu fix-xorb u fil-pjaċiri.
formal.en: In the novel, the author presents the protagonist as a dissolute man who squanders his wealth on drinking and pleasure.
formal.zh: 在小说中，作者将主人公描写成一个生活放荡、把财富挥霍在饮酒享乐上的男人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser li dan il-karattru hu disklu? Pawlu: Ifisser li jgħix bla rażan u jingħata żżejjed għall-pjaċiri. Maja: Mela l-kelma tesprimi diżapprovazzjoni? Pawlu: Iva, mhijiex kelma ta' tifħir.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does it mean to say this character is dissolute? Pawlu: It means he lives without restraint and indulges excessively in pleasure. Maja: So the word expresses disapproval? Pawlu: Yes, it isn't a word of praise.
colloquial.zh: Maja：说这个人物 disklu 是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是他生活没有约束，过度纵情享乐。Maja：所以这个词表达不赞同？Pawlu：对，这不是夸奖人的词。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser li dan il-karattru hu disklu?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser li dan il-karattru hu disklu?
messages.zh: 说这个人物 disklu 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean to say this character is dissolute?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jgħix bla rażan u jingħata żżejjed għall-pjaċiri.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jgħix bla rażan u jingħata żżejjed għall-pjaċiri.
messages.zh: 意思是他生活没有约束，过度纵情享乐。
messages.en: It means he lives without restraint and indulges excessively in pleasure.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 所以这个词表达不赞同？
messages.en: So the word expresses disapproval?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 对，这不是夸奖人的词。
messages.en: Yes, it isn't a word of praise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用小说人物记 disklu：一个人整日纵酒享乐、挥霍家财，就可用这个带贬义的形容词描述；重点记“放纵无节制”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A public speech, an extended discussion of a subject, or ordinary talk between people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公开发表的演讲，对某个主题展开的论述，或人与人之间的一般谈话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem indirizzat lil udjenza, trattazzjoni ta' suġġett bil-kliem jew bil-kitba, jew taħdit bejn in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公开演讲；面向听众发表的一段正式讲话。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taħdita li persuna tagħmel quddiem udjenza biex twassal ideat, informazzjoni jew messaġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public speech is a talk that someone delivers to an audience on a particular occasion.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 论述；围绕某个主题展开的口头或书面讨论。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Trattazzjoni ta' suġġett bil-kliem jew bil-kitba li fiha jiġu espressi u żviluppati ideat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Discourse is spoken or written communication in which ideas about a subject are expressed and developed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谈话；人们说的话或彼此交谈的内容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kliem li jingħad waqt konversazzjoni jew skambju ta' ħsibijiet bejn in-nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Talk is the spoken exchange of thoughts, information, or opinions between people.

formal.mt: Fid-diskors tal-ftuħ, id-direttriċi spjegat l-għanijiet tal-konferenza u rringrazzjat lill-parteċipanti.
formal.en: In her opening speech, the director explained the aims of the conference and thanked the participants.
formal.zh: 在开幕致辞中，女主任说明了会议的目标，并向与会者表示感谢。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif mar id-diskors tiegħek fl-iskola? Sam: Tajjeb, imma għall-ewwel kont nervuż. Nina: In-nies semgħuk? Sam: Iva, u wara staqsewni ħafna mistoqsijiet.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did your speech at school go? Sam: Well, but I was nervous at first. Nina: Did people listen to you? Sam: Yes, and afterwards they asked me lots of questions.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你在学校的演讲怎么样？Sam：挺好，不过一开始我很紧张。Nina：大家有认真听吗？Sam：有，之后还问了我很多问题。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你在学校的演讲怎么样？
messages.en: How did your speech at school go?

messages.speaker: Sam (学生)
messages.zh: 挺好，不过一开始我很紧张。
messages.en: Well, but I was nervous at first.

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 大家有认真听吗？
messages.en: Did people listen to you?

messages.speaker: Sam (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u wara staqsewni ħafna mistoqsijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u wara staqsewni ħafna mistoqsijiet.
messages.zh: 有，之后还问了我很多问题。
messages.en: Yes, and afterwards they asked me lots of questions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diskors 与“说出一段话”相连：对着听众是演讲，围绕主题展开是论述，朋友之间交流是谈话；用场景区分三个义项。

gloss_zh: 商业化落差；商业化缺口

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gap between the potential or intended commercial use of a product or idea and its actual development or availability on the market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产品或构想在预期或潜在商业应用与实际市场开发、供应之间存在的差距。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Differenza bejn l-użu kummerċjali possibbli jew ippjanat ta' prodott jew idea u l-iżvilupp jew id-disponibbiltà tiegħu fis-suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 商业化缺口，指产品或构想的商业潜力与实际进入市场、实现商业应用之间的落差。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nuqqas jew differenza bejn il-potenzjal kummerċjali ta' prodott jew idea u kemm dan il-potenzjal ikun twettaq fis-suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A commercialisation gap exists when a product or idea has commercial potential that has not yet been fully realised in the market.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika diskrepanza fil-kummerċjalizzazzjoni bejn ir-riżultati tar-riċerka u l-prodotti li jaslu fis-suq.
formal.en: The report identifies a commercialisation gap between research results and the products that reach the market.
formal.zh: 报告指出，研究成果与最终进入市场的产品之间存在商业化落差。

colloquial.mt: Marta: L-idea taħdem fil-laboratorju, imma għadna ma nbigħux il-prodott. Pawlu: Mela hemm diskrepanza fil-kummerċjalizzazzjoni; irridu naraw kif inwassluh fis-suq.
colloquial.en: Marta: The idea works in the laboratory, but we are not selling the product yet. Pawlu: Then there is a commercialisation gap; we need to work out how to bring it to market.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这个构想在实验室里行得通，但我们还没开始销售产品。保罗：那就是存在商业化落差；我们得想办法把产品推向市场。

messages.speaker: Marta (研究员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-idea taħdem fil-laboratorju, imma għadna ma nbigħux il-prodott.
messages.mt_standard: L-idea taħdem fil-laboratorju, imma għadna ma nbigħux il-prodott.
messages.zh: 这个构想在实验室里行得通，但我们还没开始销售产品。
messages.en: The idea works in the laboratory, but we are not selling the product yet.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela hemm diskrepanza fil-kummerċjalizzazzjoni; irridu naraw kif inwassluh fis-suq.
messages.mt_standard: Mela hemm diskrepanza fil-kummerċjalizzazzjoni; irridu naraw kif inwassluh fis-suq.
messages.zh: 那就是存在商业化落差；我们得想办法把产品推向市场。
messages.en: Then there is a commercialisation gap; we need to work out how to bring it to market.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象实验室与商店货架之间缺了一座桥：成果已经出现，商品尚未上市，这段距离就是“商业化落差”。

gloss_zh: 谨慎得体的；嘴严的；不张扬的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Careful about what one says or does, especially to protect private information or avoid attracting unwanted attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 言行谨慎得体的，尤其指能够保守私密信息或避免引起不必要关注的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joqgħod attent għal dak li jgħid jew jagħmel, speċjalment biex iħares il-privatezza jew jevita li jiġbed attenzjoni mhux mixtieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谨慎得体、能够保密的；行事不张扬、不会引起不必要注意的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jitkellem u jaġixxi b'għaqal u b'attenzjoni, mingħajr ma jikxef informazzjoni privata jew jiġbed attenzjoni bla bżonn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is discreet takes care not to reveal private information or draw unnecessary attention to a situation.

formal.mt: L-impjegat għandu jkun diskret meta jittratta informazzjoni personali tal-klijenti.
formal.en: The employee should be discreet when handling clients' personal information.
formal.zh: 员工处理客户个人信息时应当谨慎守密。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed inħejju sorpriża għal ommi; kun diskret meta titkellem magħha. Mark: Tinkwetax, ma ngħidilha xejn.
