colloquial.en: Lara: We are preparing a surprise for my mother; be discreet when you talk to her. Mark: Don't worry, I won't tell her anything.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们正在给我妈妈准备惊喜；你跟她说话时注意保密。马克：放心，我什么都不会告诉她。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħejju sorpriża għal ommi; kun diskret meta titkellem magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħejju sorpriża għal ommi; kun diskret meta titkellem magħha.
messages.zh: 我们正在给我妈妈准备惊喜；你跟她说话时注意保密。
messages.en: We are preparing a surprise for my mother; be discreet when you talk to her.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 放心，我什么都不会告诉她。
messages.en: Don't worry, I won't tell her anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diskret 配上“惊喜派对不能说漏嘴”的画面：说话留神、守住秘密、动作低调，三者都围绕谨慎得体。

gloss_zh: 歧视；审慎选择；鉴别取舍

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unfair treatment based on personal or group characteristics, or the exercise of careful judgment when distinguishing and selecting things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基于个人或群体特征给予的不公平待遇；也可指通过仔细辨别而作出的审慎选择。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trattament inġust ibbażat fuq karatteristiċi ta' persuna jew grupp, jew għażla magħmula b'ġudizzju u b'attenzjoni wara li jiġu eżaminati d-differenzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 歧视，指因个人所属群体或某种个人特征而给予不公平、较差的待遇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Trattament inġust jew inqas favorevoli ta' persuna jew grupp minħabba karatteristiċi bħall-oriġini, is-sess jew ir-reliġjon.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Discrimination is the unfair treatment of people because of characteristics such as their origin, sex, or religion.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 审慎选择，指仔细比较差异、判断质量或适用性后作出的鉴别与取舍。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għażla bir-reqqa li ssir billi jitqabblu d-differenzi u jiġu ġġudikati l-kwalità jew l-adattabilità tal-affarijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Discrimination can mean the ability to judge differences carefully and select what is suitable or of good quality.

collocations.zh: 选择资料来源时的审慎鉴别

formal.mt: Fl-għażla tas-sorsi, ir-riċerkatur għandu jeżerċita diskriminazzjoni, billi jqabbel il-kwalità u r-rilevanza tagħhom.
formal.en: When selecting sources, the researcher should exercise discrimination by comparing their quality and relevance.
formal.zh: 研究人员选择资料来源时，应比较其质量与相关性，作出审慎取舍。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ma tawhx l-istess ċans bħall-oħrajn sempliċement minħabba minn fejn ġej. David: Dik hi diskriminazzjoni; għandhom jiġġudikawh fuq il-ħila tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: They didn't give him the same chance as the others simply because of where he comes from. David: That is discrimination; they should judge him on his ability.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他们仅仅因为他的出身，就没给他和其他人一样的机会。戴维：那就是歧视；他们应该根据他的能力来评价他。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma tawhx l-istess ċans bħall-oħrajn sempliċement minħabba minn fejn ġej.
messages.mt_standard: Ma tawhx l-istess ċans bħall-oħrajn sempliċement minħabba minn fejn ġej.
messages.zh: 他们仅仅因为他的出身，就没给他和其他人一样的机会。
messages.en: They didn't give him the same chance as the others simply because of where he comes from.

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hi diskriminazzjoni; għandhom jiġġudikawh fuq il-ħila tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hi diskriminazzjoni; għandhom jiġġudikawh fuq il-ħila tiegħu.
messages.zh: 那就是歧视；他们应该根据他的能力来评价他。
messages.en: That is discrimination; they should judge him on his ability.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面对照记忆：按出身区别对待人是“歧视”，按质量仔细挑选资料是“审慎选择”；理解时看对象与语境。

gloss_zh: 任意歧视；缺乏合理依据的差别待遇

teaching_sense.en_definition: Instances of unequal or unfair treatment based on personal whim or decisions that lack a reasonable, consistent basis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由个人好恶或缺乏合理、一致依据的决定造成的多项或多种不公平差别待遇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Każijiet ta' trattament mhux ugwali jew inġust li jiddependu fuq il-kapriċċ ta' xi ħadd jew fuq deċiżjonijiet mingħajr bażi raġonevoli u konsistenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 任意歧视，指并非依据合理、一致标准，而是凭主观好恶或武断决定施加的不公平差别待遇；该马耳他语词组为复数形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forom jew każijiet ta' trattament inġust bejn persuni jew gruppi, ibbażati fuq kapriċċ jew deċiżjonijiet li ma jsegwux kriterji raġonevoli u konsistenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Arbitrary discrimination occurs when people receive unequal treatment because of personal whim or decisions without a reasonable and consistent basis.

collocations.en: arbitrary discrimination in the provision of services
collocations.zh: 服务提供中的任意差别待遇

formal.mt: Il-proċedura għandha tapplika kriterji ċari u konsistenti sabiex tevita diskriminazzjonijiet arbitrarji bejn l-applikanti.
formal.en: The procedure should apply clear and consistent criteria to avoid arbitrary discrimination between applicants.
formal.zh: 该程序应采用明确且一致的标准，以避免对申请人施加任意差别待遇。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Lil xi wħud talbuhom iħallsu aktar, mingħajr ma taw raġuni. Toni: Dawn huma diskriminazzjonijiet arbitrarji; l-istess regoli għandhom japplikaw għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: They asked some people to pay more without giving a reason. Toni: These are cases of arbitrary discrimination; the same rules should apply to everyone.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他们要求有些人多付钱，却没有说明理由。托尼：这些就是任意差别待遇；同样的规则应该适用于所有人。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil xi wħud talbuhom iħallsu aktar, mingħajr ma taw raġuni.
messages.mt_standard: Lil xi wħud talbuhom iħallsu aktar, mingħajr ma taw raġuni.
messages.zh: 他们要求有些人多付钱，却没有说明理由。
messages.en: They asked some people to pay more without giving a reason.

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn huma diskriminazzjonijiet arbitrarji; l-istess regoli għandhom japplikaw għal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Dawn huma diskriminazzjonijiet arbitrarji; l-istess regoli għandhom japplikaw għal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 这些就是任意差别待遇；同样的规则应该适用于所有人。
messages.en: These are cases of arbitrary discrimination; the same rules should apply to everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一排顾客被随意收取不同费用：区别待遇没有一致理由，就是“任意歧视”。把整个词组作为复数表达一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A talk or conversation in which people exchange thoughts, information, or news.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们交流想法、信息或近况的一次谈话，也可指轻松的闲聊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diskursata hija taħdita bejn nies li jaqsmu ħsibijiet, informazzjoni jew aħbarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次谈话，指围绕某件事情进行的口头交流。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Diskursata hija taħdita li fiha n-nies jitkellmu dwar xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A talk is an occasion when people speak together about something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闲聊，指轻松、随意地交流日常事情或近况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Diskursata hija taħdita ħafifa u informali dwar affarijiet ta' kuljum jew aħbarijiet personali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chat is a friendly, informal exchange about everyday matters or personal news.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交谈，指两人或多人通过说话相互交流。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Diskursata hija skambju ta' kliem bejn żewġ persuni jew aktar li jitkellmu ma' xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A conversation is an exchange in which two or more people speak to one another.

formal.mt: Wara l-laqgħa, saret diskursata qasira bejn l-għalliema u l-ġenituri dwar il-progress tat-tfal.
formal.en: After the meeting, the teachers and parents had a brief conversation about the children's progress.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，教师和家长就孩子们的进步进行了简短交谈。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek ftit ħin għal diskursata? Lara: Iva, ejja noqogħdu hawn u nitkellmu ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a little time for a chat? Lara: Yes, let's sit here and talk for a bit.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有一点时间聊聊吗？Lara：有，我们坐在这里聊一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有一点时间聊聊吗？
messages.en: Do you have a little time for a chat?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja noqogħdu hawn u nitkellmu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja noqogħdu hawn u nitkellmu ftit.
messages.zh: 有，我们坐在这里聊一会儿吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's sit here and talk for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diskursata 记成一次可以坐下来进行的谈话：看到 nagħmlu diskursata，就联想朋友说“我们聊聊吧”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes a subject or matter that people have talked about and considered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某个话题或事项已经被人们谈论、讨论过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diskuss jiddeskrivi suġġett jew każ li n-nies tkellmu dwaru u qiesu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被讨论的，指某个话题或事项已经成为谈论和交换意见的对象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Suġġett diskuss huwa suġġett li dwaru diġà sar skambju ta' fehmiet jew informazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A discussed subject is one that people have already talked about and considered.

formal.mt: Is-suġġett diskuss waqt il-laqgħa kien it-titjib tas-servizz lill-klijenti.
formal.en: The subject discussed during the meeting was improving customer service.
formal.zh: 会议中讨论的话题是改善客户服务。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Liema kien il-punt diskuss ilbieraħ? Sara: Kif nistgħu nqassmu x-xogħol aħjar.
colloquial.en: Mark: What was the point discussed yesterday? Sara: How we can divide up the work better.
colloquial.zh: Mark：昨天讨论的要点是什么？Sara：怎样才能更好地分配工作。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 昨天讨论的要点是什么？
messages.en: What was the point discussed yesterday?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 怎样才能更好地分配工作。
messages.en: How we can divide up the work better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diskuss 放在“话题”后面记：is-suġġett diskuss 就是“讨论过的话题”，重点是描述已经讨论过的状态。

gloss_zh: 递送；发运；转送安排；发运货物

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sending, routing, or delivery of goods or messages, or a shipment sent out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物或信息的发送、转送安排或递送，也可指发运的一批货物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dispaċċ huwa l-proċess li bih jintbagħtu, jitqassmu jew jitwasslu oġġetti jew messaġġi, jew il-merkanzija li tintbagħat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 递送，指将货物、包裹或信息送达接收方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dispaċċ huwa t-twassil ta' oġġetti, pakketti jew messaġġi lill-persuna jew fil-post maħsub.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Delivery is the process of taking goods or messages to their intended recipient.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发送或发运，指把物品或信息从出发处发出去的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dispaċċ huwa l-proċess li bih oġġetti jew messaġġi jintbagħtu mill-post tat-tluq lejn id-destinazzjoni tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dispatching is the process of sending goods or messages out towards their destination.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 转送安排，指确定物品或信息应循何种路线或渠道送往目的地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dispaċċ huwa l-arranġament tar-rotta jew tal-mezz li bih oġġetti jew messaġġi jintbagħtu lejn id-destinazzjoni tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Routing is the arrangement of the path that goods or messages follow to their destination.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发运的一批货物，指作为一批发送或运输的物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dispaċċ huwa grupp ta' oġġetti jew kwantità ta' merkanzija li tintbagħat flimkien lejn destinazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shipment is a quantity of goods sent together to a particular destination.

formal.mt: Id-dispaċċ tal-pakketti se jsir wara li jiġu kkonfermati l-indirizzi tar-riċevituri.
formal.en: The parcels will be dispatched after the recipients' addresses have been confirmed.
formal.zh: 包裹将在确认收件人地址后发出。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Meta se jsir id-dispaċċ tal-pakkett tiegħi? Rita: Illum waranofsinhar; nibagħtulek messaġġ meta jitlaq.
colloquial.en: Mark: When will my parcel be dispatched? Rita: This afternoon; we'll send you a message when it leaves.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我的包裹什么时候发出？Rita：今天下午；发出时我们会给你发消息。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se jsir id-dispaċċ tal-pakkett tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se jsir id-dispaċċ tal-pakkett tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我的包裹什么时候发出？
messages.en: When will my parcel be dispatched?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum waranofsinhar; nibagħtulek messaġġ meta jitlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Illum waranofsinhar; nibagħtulek messaġġ meta jitlaq.
messages.zh: 今天下午；发出时我们会给你发消息。
messages.en: This afternoon; we'll send you a message when it leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用包裹流程记 dispaċċ：发出去、安排转送路线、送到收件人；若句中说“一批”，则联想发运的那批货物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of regret about something, or displeasure at something unwelcome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某件事而产生的遗憾、懊悔，或对不合心意之事感到的不悦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dispjaċir huwa sens ta' niket jew sogħba dwar xi ħaġa, jew nuqqas ta' pjaċir minħabba xi ħaġa li ma togħġbokx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遗憾或懊悔，指因某事发生、未发生或因自己的行为而感到难过，并希望情况原本有所不同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dispjaċir huwa sens ta' sogħba għal xi ħaġa li ġrat, li ma ġratx jew li għamilt, flimkien max-xewqa li l-affarijiet kienu differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Regret is sadness about something that happened or failed to happen, with a wish that things had been different.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不悦，指因某件事不合心意而感到不快或不满。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dispjaċir huwa sens ta' nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon jew skuntentizza minħabba xi ħaġa li ma togħġbokx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Displeasure is a feeling of unhappiness or dissatisfaction caused by something you do not like.

formal.mt: B'dispjaċir kbir, ninfurmawkom li l-avveniment ta' għada ġie kkanċellat.
formal.en: With great regret, we inform you that tomorrow's event has been cancelled.
formal.zh: 我们深感遗憾地通知各位，明天的活动已取消。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħassejt dispjaċir li ma stajtx niġi għall-festa tiegħek. Lara: Tinkwetax, niltaqgħu darba oħra!
colloquial.en: Maja: I felt sorry that I couldn't come to your party. Lara: Don't worry, we'll meet another time!
colloquial.zh: Maja：没能参加你的聚会，我觉得很遗憾。Lara：别放在心上，我们下次再见！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt dispjaċir li ma stajtx niġi għall-festa tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt dispjaċir li ma stajtx niġi għall-festa tiegħek.
messages.zh: 没能参加你的聚会，我觉得很遗憾。
messages.en: I felt sorry that I couldn't come to your party.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 别放在心上，我们下次再见！
messages.en: Don't worry, we'll meet another time!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dispjaċir 放进两个情境记：错过朋友聚会是“遗憾”，遇到不合心意的事是“不悦”；根据上下文选择中文意思。

gloss_zh: 可用的；有空的；可获得的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ready to be used or obtained, or free to help or meet someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物品、服务等可以使用或获得，或指人有时间提供帮助、见面或参与活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jintuża jew jinkiseb, jew li għandu ħin biex jgħin lil xi ħadd jew jiltaqa' miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可供使用或取得的；有空提供帮助或参加活动的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun jista' jintuża jew jinkiseb meta jkun hemm bżonnu, jew li jkun ħieles biex jgħin jew jieħu sehem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is available, you can use or obtain it; if someone is available, they have time to help or meet you.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport sħiħ huwa disponibbli fuq is-sit tal-iskola.
formal.en: The full report is available on the school's website.
formal.zh: 完整报告可在学校网站上查阅。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int disponibbli għada filgħodu? Mark: Iva, nista' niltaqa' miegħek fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you available tomorrow morning? Mark: Yes, I can meet you at nine.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你明天上午有空吗？Mark：有，我可以九点和你见面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天上午有空吗？
messages.en: Are you available tomorrow morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我可以九点和你见面。
messages.en: Yes, I can meet you at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进两个画面记忆：资料伸手可取，就是“可获得”；朋友日程有空，就是“有空”。两者都强调当前能够使用或联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's usual temperament or tendency to feel and behave in a particular way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人通常表现出来的性情，以及以某种方式感受事物或采取行动的倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-karattru jew it-tendenza ta' persuna li tħoss u taġixxi b'ċertu mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 性情；一个人在情绪和行为方面通常表现出来的倾向。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mod kif persuna tkun soltu fil-karattru tagħha u kif għandha t-tendenza li tħoss u ġġib ruħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's disposition is the kind of character they usually show through their feelings and behaviour.

formal.mt: Id-dispożizzjoni kalma tal-għalliema tgħin lill-istudenti jħossuhom komdi waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The teacher's calm disposition helps students feel comfortable during the lesson.
formal.zh: 这位教师沉稳的性情有助于学生在课堂上感到自在。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif inhi l-kollega l-ġdida? Pawlu: Għandha dispożizzjoni ferrieħa u dejjem issellmilna bi tbissima.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is the new colleague like? Pawlu: She has a cheerful disposition and always greets us with a smile.
colloquial.zh: Sara：新来的同事人怎么样？Pawlu：她性情开朗，总是笑着和我们打招呼。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 新来的同事人怎么样？
messages.en: What is the new colleague like?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha dispożizzjoni ferrieħa u dejjem issellmilna bi tbissima.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha dispożizzjoni ferrieħa u dejjem issellmilna bi tbissima.
messages.zh: 她性情开朗，总是笑着和我们打招呼。
messages.en: She has a cheerful disposition and always greets us with a smile.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在人物卡片上写“沉稳”或“开朗”，再把这个词写在卡片标题处，用人物一贯表现出来的性情来记忆这个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A provision in an agreement or legal text intended to protect rights or interests against specified risks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 协议或法律文本中，为防范特定风险、保护权利或利益而设置的条款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dispożizzjoni fi ftehim jew f'test legali maħsuba biex tipproteġi drittijiet jew interessi minn riskji speċifiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保护性条款；协议或法律文本中旨在保护有关人员的权利或利益的规定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dispożizzjoni fi ftehim jew f'test legali li għandha l-għan li tipproteġi d-drittijiet jew l-interessi tal-persuni kkonċernati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A protective clause is a provision included in an agreement or legal text to protect particular rights or interests.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保障条款；为应对特定风险或不利情况而在协议或法律文本中设置保护措施的规定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dispożizzjoni fi ftehim jew f'test legali li tistabbilixxi miżuri ta' protezzjoni kontra riskji jew ċirkostanzi sfavorevoli speċifiċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A safeguard clause sets out protections that apply when specified risks or adverse circumstances arise.

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jinkludi dispożizzjoni ta' salvagwardja biex jipproteġi d-drittijiet tal-parteċipanti jekk il-proġett jieqaf qabel iż-żmien.
formal.en: The agreement includes a safeguard clause to protect participants' rights if the project ends early.
formal.zh: 该协议包含一项保障条款，用于在项目提前终止时保护参与者的权利。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex żidtu din id-dispożizzjoni ta' salvagwardja? David: Biex ikollna protezzjoni jekk jinbidlu ċ-ċirkostanzi msemmija fil-ftehim.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you add this safeguard clause? David: So that we have protection if the circumstances specified in the agreement change.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你们为什么加了这项保障条款？David：这样一来，如果协议中列明的情况发生变化，我们就有相应的保障。

messages.speaker: Marija (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex żidtu din id-dispożizzjoni ta' salvagwardja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex żidtu din id-dispożizzjoni ta' salvagwardja?
messages.zh: 你们为什么加了这项保障条款？
messages.en: Why did you add this safeguard clause?

messages.speaker: David (项目负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ikollna protezzjoni jekk jinbidlu ċ-ċirkostanzi msemmija fil-ftehim.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ikollna protezzjoni jekk jinbidlu ċ-ċirkostanzi msemmija fil-ftehim.
messages.zh: 这样一来，如果协议中列明的情况发生变化，我们就有相应的保障。
messages.en: So that we have protection if the circumstances specified in the agreement change.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象合同里有一段文字旁边画着盾牌：文字是“条款”，盾牌表示“保障”。把整个短语作为“提供保护的条款”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who openly disagrees with an official policy, established authority, or widely accepted view.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公开反对官方政策、既有权威或普遍接受的观点的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tesprimi bil-miftuħ nuqqas ta' qbil ma' politika uffiċjali, ma' awtorità stabbilita jew ma' fehma aċċettata minn ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 持异议者；对某项主张、决定或多数人的意见表示不同意的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tesprimi nuqqas ta' qbil ma' proposta, ma' deċiżjoni jew mal-fehma tal-maġġoranza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dissenter is someone who expresses disagreement with a proposal, decision, or opinion accepted by others.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 异见人士；公开反对政府、政党或其他既有权威的政策或主张的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li topponi bil-miftuħ il-politika jew il-fehmiet ta' gvern, ta' partit jew ta' awtorità oħra stabbilita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dissident is someone who publicly opposes the policies or views of a government or another established authority.

formal.mt: Fl-artiklu tiegħu, id-dissident politiku spjega għaliex kien jopponi l-politika tal-gvern.
formal.en: In his article, the political dissident explained why he opposed the government's policy.
formal.zh: 这位政治异见人士在文章中解释了自己反对政府政策的原因。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed isejħulu dissident fil-partit? Toni: Għax qal bil-miftuħ li ma jaqbilx mad-deċiżjoni tat-tmexxija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are they calling him a dissenter within the party? Toni: Because he openly said that he disagrees with the leadership's decision.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他们为什么称他为党内持异议者？Toni：因为他公开表示不同意领导层的决定。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们为什么称他为党内持异议者？
messages.en: Why are they calling him a dissenter within the party?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qal bil-miftuħ li ma jaqbilx mad-deċiżjoni tat-tmexxija.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qal bil-miftuħ li ma jaqbilx mad-deċiżjoni tat-tmexxija.
messages.zh: 因为他公开表示不同意领导层的决定。
messages.en: Because he openly said that he disagrees with the leadership's decision.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议中有人举手说“我不同意”，先记住“持异议者”；再把场景换成公开反对官方政策，就能记住“异见人士”的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone whose way of life shows little moral restraint, especially in the pursuit of pleasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人的生活放荡、缺少道德约束，尤其指毫无节制地追求享乐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li tgħix bla rażan morali, speċjalment billi tfittex il-pjaċiri bla kontroll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放荡的，指生活缺乏道德约束、纵情享乐的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jgħix ħajja bla rażan morali u jfittex il-pjaċiri bla kontroll.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is dissolute lives with little moral restraint, especially by indulging excessively in pleasure.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist jgħix ħajja dissoluta u jittraskura r-responsabbiltajiet tiegħu lejn il-familja.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist leads a dissolute life and neglects his responsibilities towards his family.
formal.zh: 小说中的主人公生活放荡，忽视了自己对家庭的责任。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħid li dan il-karattru hu dissolut? Pawlu: Għax ifittex biss il-pjaċiri u ma jagħtix kas tar-responsabbiltajiet tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you say this character is dissolute? Pawlu: Because he only seeks pleasure and pays no attention to his responsibilities.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说这个人物生活放荡？保罗：因为他只顾享乐，完全不管自己的责任。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li dan il-karattru hu dissolut?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li dan il-karattru hu dissolut?
messages.zh: 你为什么说这个人物生活放荡？
messages.en: Why do you say this character is dissolute?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ifittex biss il-pjaċiri u ma jagħtix kas tar-responsabbiltajiet tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ifittex biss il-pjaċiri u ma jagħtix kas tar-responsabbiltajiet tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为他只顾享乐，完全不管自己的责任。
messages.en: Because he only seeks pleasure and pays no attention to his responsibilities.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dissolut 放进小说人物评价中记忆：只顾享乐、抛开责任，就是“生活放荡”；搭配 ħajja 时记成 ħajja dissoluta。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substance used to dissolve another substance, including a preparation used to remove varnish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于溶解其他物质的物质，也可指用于去除清漆的制剂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tintuża biex tħoll sustanza oħra, jew preparat li jintuża biex ineħħi l-verniċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 溶剂，能够溶解其他物质的物质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sustanza li tista' tħoll sustanza oħra u tintuża għal dan il-għan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A solvent is a substance that dissolves another substance to form a solution.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清漆去除剂，用于清除物体表面清漆涂层的制剂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Preparat li jintuża biex ineħħi saff ta' verniċ minn fuq wiċċ ta' oġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A varnish remover is a preparation used to strip varnish from a surface.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju jindika li ntuża dissolvant organiku biex tinħall is-sustanza qabel l-analiżi.
formal.en: The laboratory report indicates that an organic solvent was used to dissolve the substance before analysis.
formal.zh: 实验室报告指出，分析前使用了有机溶剂来溶解该物质。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom dissolvant għall-verniċ? Rita: Iva, dan ineħħi l-verniċ minn fuq l-injam; aqra l-istruzzjonijiet qabel tużah.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have varnish remover? Rita: Yes, this one removes varnish from wood; read the instructions before using it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们有清漆去除剂吗？丽塔：有，这款能去除木材表面的清漆；使用前请阅读说明。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们有清漆去除剂吗？
messages.en: Do you have varnish remover?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan ineħħi l-verniċ minn fuq l-injam; aqra l-istruzzjonijiet qabel tużah.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan ineħħi l-verniċ minn fuq l-injam; aqra l-istruzzjonijiet qabel tużah.
messages.zh: 有，这款能去除木材表面的清漆；使用前请阅读说明。
messages.en: Yes, this one removes varnish from wood; read the instructions before using it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记 dissolvant：实验室里帮助物质溶解的是“溶剂”，处理清漆涂层时则是“清漆去除剂”；根据用途辨义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The amount of space between two people, objects, or places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两个人、物体或地点之间的空间距离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-medda ta' spazju bejn żewġ persuni, oġġetti jew postijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 距离，指两个人、物体或地点之间相隔的空间长度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-medda ta' spazju li tifred żewġ persuni, oġġetti jew postijiet minn xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The distance between two people, objects, or places is the amount of space separating them.

formal.mt: Id-distanza bejn l-iskola u l-librerija hija ta' żewġ kilometri, skont il-kejl fuq il-mappa.
formal.en: The distance between the school and the library is two kilometres, according to the measurement on the map.
formal.zh: 根据地图上的测量结果，学校与图书馆之间的距离为两公里。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm hi d-distanza minn hawn sal-bajja? Toni: Madwar kilometru biss; nistgħu mmorru bil-mixi.
colloquial.en: Lara: How far is it from here to the beach? Toni: Only about a kilometre; we can walk.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：从这里到海滩有多远？托尼：只有一公里左右，我们可以走过去。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hi d-distanza minn hawn sal-bajja?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hi d-distanza minn hawn sal-bajja?
messages.zh: 从这里到海滩有多远？
messages.en: How far is it from here to the beach?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Madwar kilometru biss; nistgħu mmorru bil-mixi.
messages.mt_standard: Madwar kilometru biss; nistgħu mmorru bil-mixi.
messages.zh: 只有一公里左右，我们可以走过去。
messages.en: Only about a kilometre; we can walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 distanza 和地图上的两点连线一起记：问两地相隔多远，就在问 distanza；再配上 kilometru，形成“距离加单位”的画面。

gloss_zh: 清晰可辨的；明显不同的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clearly noticeable or recognizably different from something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够清楚感知或辨认的，或与其他事物有明显区别的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jingħaraf ċar jew li għandu differenza ċara minn xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清晰可辨的；与其他事物明显不同、能够区分的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jidher jew jinħass b'mod ċar, jew li jista' jingħaraf minn xi ħaġa oħra minħabba differenza ċara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is distinct is clearly noticeable or sufficiently different from other things to be recognized separately.

formal.mt: L-istudju jidentifika żewġ gruppi distinti ta' parteċipanti, kull wieħed bi bżonnijiet differenti.
formal.en: The study identifies two distinct groups of participants, each with different needs.
formal.zh: 该研究识别出两个明显不同的参与者群体，各自有不同的需求。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Smajt dak il-ħoss distint? Adam: Iva, kien il-qanpiena tar-rota; għaraftha mill-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you hear that distinct sound? Adam: Yes, it was the bicycle bell; I recognized it straight away.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你听到那个清晰可辨的声音了吗？亚当：听到了，是自行车铃声；我一下就认出来了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到那个清晰可辨的声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that distinct sound?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien il-qanpiena tar-rota; għaraftha mill-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien il-qanpiena tar-rota; għaraftha mill-ewwel.
messages.zh: 听到了，是自行车铃声；我一下就认出来了。
messages.en: Yes, it was the bicycle bell; I recognized it straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 distint 记成“分得清”：声音清楚到能认出来，群体不同到能区分开，都可用它；复数搭配记作 gruppi distinti。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A difference between people, things, or ideas, or the act of recognizing that difference.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人、事物或概念之间的差别，或辨认并指出这种差别的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Differenza bejn persuni, affarijiet jew ideat, jew l-att li tagħraf u turi din id-differenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 两者或多者之间的区别，或对这种区别的辨认与划分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Differenza li tifred żewġ persuni, affarijiet jew ideat jew aktar minn xulxin, jew l-għarfien ta' din id-differenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A distinction is a difference between things or the act of recognizing and explaining that difference.

collocations.en: to make a distinction between two things

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jagħmel distinzjoni ċara bejn il-fatti u l-opinjonijiet.
formal.en: The report makes a clear distinction between facts and opinions.
formal.zh: 报告明确区分了事实与观点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma nifhimx id-distinzjoni bejn dawn iż-żewġ kelmiet. Mark: Din tintuża għan-nies, u l-oħra għall-affarijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: I don't understand the distinction between these two words. Mark: This one is used for people, and the other for things.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我不明白这两个词有什么区别。Mark：这个用于人，另一个用于事物。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nifhimx id-distinzjoni bejn dawn iż-żewġ kelmiet.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nifhimx id-distinzjoni bejn dawn iż-żewġ kelmiet.
messages.zh: 我不明白这两个词有什么区别。
messages.en: I don't understand the distinction between these two words.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Din tintuża għan-nies, u l-oħra għall-affarijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Din tintuża għan-nies, u l-oħra għall-affarijiet.
messages.zh: 这个用于人，另一个用于事物。
messages.en: This one is used for people, and the other for things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给两个相似概念画一条分界线，把 distinzjoni 与“区别、区分”一起记；搭配 bejn 可练习表达“二者之间的区别”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company that supplies goods to shops or other businesses for sale.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向商店或其他企业供应商品、供其销售的个人或公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tqassam u tforni prodotti lil ħwienet jew negozji oħra biex jinbiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责分销商品并向商店或其他商家供货的个人或企业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tforni prodotti lil ħwienet jew negozji oħra sabiex dawn ibigħuhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A distributor is a person or business that supplies goods to shops or other sellers.

formal.mt: Il-ħanut ordna mitt kopja tal-ktieb mingħand id-distributur lokali.
formal.en: The shop ordered one hundred copies of the book from the local distributor.
formal.zh: 这家商店向本地分销商订购了一百本该书。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Waslu l-kotba l-ġodda? Mark: Għadhom le. Id-distributur se jġibhom għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have the new books arrived? Mark: Not yet. The distributor will bring them tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Lara：新书到了吗？Mark：还没有。分销商明天会送来。

messages.speaker: Lara (书店店员)
messages.zh: 新书到了吗？
messages.en: Have the new books arrived?

messages.speaker: Mark (书店经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadhom le. Id-distributur se jġibhom għada.
messages.mt_standard: Għadhom le. Id-distributur se jġibhom għada.
messages.zh: 还没有。分销商明天会送来。
messages.en: Not yet. The distributor will bring them tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用供货链画面记忆 distributur：商品先到分销商，再送进各家商店；把“商店向谁进货”作为回忆提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A machine that automatically supplies a selected product after payment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 付款并选择商品后，自动提供相应商品的机器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magna li tagħti prodott magħżul b'mod awtomatiku wara li jsir il-ħlas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 顾客付款并作出选择后，自动售出饮料、零食等商品的设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Magna li tbigħ prodotti bħal xorb jew ikel ħafif u tagħtihom awtomatikament wara li l-klijent iħallas u jagħżel il-prodott.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An automatic vending machine is a machine that dispenses a chosen product after a customer pays.

collocations.en: to buy from a vending machine

formal.mt: Ġie installat distributur awtomatiku tax-xorb ħdejn id-daħla tal-bini.
formal.en: A drinks vending machine has been installed near the entrance to the building.
formal.zh: 大楼入口附近已安装了一台饮料自动售货机。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nista' nixtri flixkun ilma? Lara: Hemm distributur awtomatiku ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I buy a bottle of water? Lara: There's a vending machine next to the door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：哪里可以买到一瓶水？Lara：门旁边有一台自动售货机。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 哪里可以买到一瓶水？
messages.en: Where can I buy a bottle of water?

messages.speaker: Lara (接待员)
messages.zh: 门旁边有一台自动售货机。
messages.en: There's a vending machine next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象付款、按键、饮料落下的连续动作，把 distributur awtomatiku 整体记作“自动售货机”；用 awtomatiku 提醒自己这里指自动运作的设备。

gloss_zh: 指定分销商；授权分销商

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company officially selected or permitted by a supplier to distribute its products.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经供应方正式指定或许可，负责分销其产品的个人或公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija magħżula uffiċjalment jew mogħtija permess minn fornitur biex tqassam il-prodotti tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由供应方正式选定、承担其产品分销工作的经销商。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li fornitur ikun għażel uffiċjalment biex tqassam il-prodotti tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An appointed distributor is a person or company formally chosen by a supplier to distribute its products.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获得供应方正式许可、可以分销其产品的经销商。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li għandha permess uffiċjali mingħand fornitur biex tqassam il-prodotti tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An authorised distributor is a person or company that has official permission to distribute a supplier's products.

collocations.en: an authorised distributor of the brand
to buy from an authorised distributor

formal.mt: Il-manifattur ħatar lill-kumpanija bħala distributur awtorizzat tal-prodotti tiegħu f'Malta.
formal.en: The manufacturer appointed the company as an authorised distributor of its products in Malta.
formal.zh: 制造商指定该公司为其产品在马耳他的授权分销商。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ħanut huwa distributur awtorizzat tal-marka? Lara: Iva, il-marka telenkah fuq is-sit tagħha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this shop an authorised distributor of the brand? Lara: Yes, the brand lists it on its website.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这家店是该品牌的授权分销商吗？Lara：是的，品牌官网上列有这家店。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħanut huwa distributur awtorizzat tal-marka?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħanut huwa distributur awtorizzat tal-marka?
messages.zh: 这家店是该品牌的授权分销商吗？
messages.en: Is this shop an authorised distributor of the brand?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-marka telenkah fuq is-sit tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-marka telenkah fuq is-sit tagħha.
messages.zh: 是的，品牌官网上列有这家店。
messages.en: Yes, the brand lists it on its website.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象分销商旁放着品牌的正式授权书，把 distributur awtorizzat 连成一个画面；学习时分别抓住“被正式选定”和“获正式许可”两个释义重点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of giving out goods, materials, or resources to different people or places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将物品、材料或资源分发给不同的人或分配到不同地点的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih oġġetti, materjal jew riżorsi jitqassmu lil persuni differenti jew f'postijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分发或分配，即把物品或资源按一定安排交给不同的人或送到不同地点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih oġġetti jew riżorsi jitqassmu lil nies differenti jew jintbagħtu f'postijiet differenti skont arranġament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Distribution is the process of giving or delivering things to different people or places.

formal.mt: Id-distribuzzjoni tal-ikel lill-familji fil-bżonn se tibda nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: The distribution of food to families in need will begin on Monday.
formal.zh: 向有需要的家庭分发食品的工作将于星期一开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta tibda d-distribuzzjoni tal-ikel? Pawlu: Fid-disgħa. Ejja ftit qabel biex tgħinna.
colloquial.en: Maja: When does the food distribution start? Pawlu: At nine. Come a little earlier to help us.
colloquial.zh: Maja：什么时候开始分发食品？Pawlu：九点。你早一点来帮我们吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (志愿者)
messages.zh: 什么时候开始分发食品？
messages.en: When does the food distribution start?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (活动协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fid-disgħa. Ejja ftit qabel biex tgħinna.
messages.mt_standard: Fid-disgħa. Ejja ftit qabel biex tgħinna.
messages.zh: 九点。你早一点来帮我们吧。
messages.en: At nine. Come a little earlier to help us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 distribuzzjoni 想成一次分发活动的名称：食品交到不同家庭手中，就是“分发”的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Given out or delivered to different people or places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经分发给不同的人或配送到不同地点的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tqassam lil persuni differenti jew twassal f'postijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已分发或已分配的，指物品或材料已交到不同接收者手中或送往不同地点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ngħata lil diversi persuni jew intbagħat lejn diversi postijiet bħala parti minn tqassim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is distributed has been given out or delivered to different people or places.

formal.mt: Il-materjal distribwit waqt il-laqgħa jinkludi struzzjonijiet dettaljati għall-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The material distributed during the meeting includes detailed instructions for participants.
formal.zh: 会议期间分发的材料包含提供给参与者的详细说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek il-fuljett li ġie distribwit dalgħodu? Mark: Iva, qiegħed fil-basket tiegħi. Trid tarah?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have the leaflet that was distributed this morning? Mark: Yes, it's in my bag. Do you want to see it?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有今天早上分发的那张传单吗？Mark：有，在我的包里。你想看看吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek il-fuljett li ġie distribwit dalgħodu?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek il-fuljett li ġie distribwit dalgħodu?
messages.zh: 你有今天早上分发的那张传单吗？
messages.en: Do you have the leaflet that was distributed this morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fil-basket tiegħi. Trid tarah?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fil-basket tiegħi. Trid tarah?
messages.zh: 有，在我的包里。你想看看吗？
messages.en: Yes, it's in my bag. Do you want to see it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 distribwit 配上“已经发到手”的画面；materjal distribwit 就是已经分发的材料，强调分发后的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Damaged so severely that it no longer exists in its original form or cannot be used.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遭到严重破坏，以致不再保持原有形态或无法使用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġarrab ħsara tant kbira li ma għadux fil-forma oriġinali tiegħu jew ma jistax jintuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被毁坏或被摧毁的，指遭到彻底或极其严重的破坏。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li nqered jew ġarrab ħsara kbira ħafna, b'mod li tilef il-forma jew il-funzjoni tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is destroyed has been damaged so badly that it no longer exists or can no longer be used.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jikkonferma li l-pont ġie kompletament distrutt mill-għargħar.
formal.en: The report confirms that the bridge was completely destroyed by the flooding.
formal.zh: 报告证实，该桥已被洪水彻底摧毁。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-mudell tiegħi spiċċa distrutt meta waqa' mill-mejda. Maja: Jiddispjaċini. Nistgħu nibnuh mill-ġdid flimkien.
colloquial.en: Mark: My model ended up destroyed when it fell off the table. Maja: I'm sorry. We can rebuild it together.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我的模型从桌上掉下来，摔毁了。Maja：真遗憾。我们可以一起重新把它搭起来。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mudell tiegħi spiċċa distrutt meta waqa' mill-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Il-mudell tiegħi spiċċa distrutt meta waqa' mill-mejda.
messages.zh: 我的模型从桌上掉下来，摔毁了。
messages.en: My model ended up destroyed when it fell off the table.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 真遗憾。我们可以一起重新把它搭起来。
messages.en: I'm sorry. We can rebuild it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一座桥被洪水冲毁：pont distrutt。用“毁坏后无法正常使用”的画面记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An interruption or disruption of someone's activity, peace, or normal conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人的活动、安宁或正常状态造成的打扰或扰乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfixkil li jinterrompi l-attività ta' xi ħadd, il-kwiet jew il-kundizzjonijiet normali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干扰或扰乱，指使活动中断、安宁受到影响或正常秩序被打乱的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfixkil li jwaqqaf jew ifixkel attività, inaqqas il-kwiet jew ibiddel l-ordni normali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A disturbance is something that interrupts an activity or disrupts peace or normal conditions.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema ntalbu jnaqqsu l-istorbju biex jevitaw disturb waqt l-eżami.
formal.en: The workers were asked to reduce the noise to avoid a disturbance during the examination.
formal.zh: 工作人员被要求降低噪声，以免在考试期间造成干扰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Skużani għad-disturb. Nista' nistaqsik xi ħaġa? Pawlu: Żgur. X'għandek bżonn?
colloquial.en: Maja: Sorry for disturbing you. Can I ask you something? Pawlu: Of course. What do you need?
colloquial.zh: Maja：抱歉打扰你。我可以问你一件事吗？Pawlu：当然。你需要什么？

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani għad-disturb. Nista' nistaqsik xi ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: Skużani għad-disturb. Nista' nistaqsik xi ħaġa?
messages.zh: 抱歉打扰你。我可以问你一件事吗？
messages.en: Sorry for disturbing you. Can I ask you something?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 当然。你需要什么？
messages.en: Of course. What do you need?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用礼貌开场白 skużani għad-disturb 记住“打扰”；这里的 disturb 是名词，表示造成的干扰。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A disruption to the normal functioning or stability of a market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使市场正常运作或稳定状态受到干扰的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfixkil li jaffettwa l-funzjonament normali jew l-istabbiltà ta' suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 市场的正常交易、供求或价格秩序受到干扰的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni li fiha jiġu mfixkla l-kummerċ, il-provvista, id-domanda jew il-prezzijiet f'suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A market disturbance is a disruption that affects normal trading conditions, supply, demand, or prices.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif in-nuqqas ta' provvisti kkawża disturb fis-suq u żied il-prezzijiet.
formal.en: The report explains how a shortage of supplies caused a market disturbance and increased prices.
formal.zh: 报告解释了供应短缺如何引发市场扰动并推高价格。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex għolew il-prezzijiet daqshekk? Lara: Hemm disturb fis-suq għax mhux qed jaslu biżżejjed provvisti.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why have prices risen so much? Lara: There is a market disturbance because not enough supplies are arriving.
colloquial.zh: 马克：价格怎么涨了这么多？拉拉：到货供应不足，市场出现了紊乱。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 价格怎么涨了这么多？
messages.en: Why have prices risen so much?

messages.speaker: Lara (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm disturb fis-suq għax mhux qed jaslu biżżejjed provvisti.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm disturb fis-suq għax mhux qed jaslu biżżejjed provvisti.
messages.zh: 到货供应不足，市场出现了紊乱。
messages.en: There is a market disturbance because not enough supplies are arriving.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上“供货中断、价格波动”的画面，记住它表示市场运作受到干扰。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose job is to investigate crimes or gather information about particular cases.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以调查犯罪或搜集特定案件相关信息为职业的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tinvestiga reati jew tiġbor informazzjoni dwar każijiet partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责调查犯罪、查明案情或为客户搜集信息的侦探或侦查员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tinvestiga reati, tfittex evidenza jew tiġbor informazzjoni għal klijenti dwar każijiet speċifiċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A detective is someone whose work involves investigating crimes or gathering information to establish what happened.

formal.mt: Id-ditektiv eżamina l-evidenza u tkellem max-xhieda qabel ħejja r-rapport dwar il-każ.
formal.en: The detective examined the evidence and spoke to the witnesses before preparing the report on the case.
formal.zh: 侦查员先检查证据并询问证人，然后撰写案件报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jinvestiga s-serqa? Mark: Ġej ditektiv tal-pulizija biex ikellimna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to investigate the theft? Mark: A police detective is coming to speak to us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来调查这起盗窃案？马克：一位警方侦查员要来找我们谈话。

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.zh: 谁来调查这起盗窃案？
messages.en: Who is going to investigate the theft?

messages.speaker: Mark (店主)
messages.zh: 一位警方侦查员要来找我们谈话。
messages.en: A police detective is coming to speak to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“查看证据、询问证人、查明案情”三个动作串成画面，把 ditektiv 和侦探的工作联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The firm resolve to continue working towards a goal despite difficulties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 即使遇到困难，也坚持朝目标努力的坚定意志。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-rieda soda li persuna tkompli taħdem biex tilħaq għan minkejja d-diffikultajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面对困难仍坚持行动、力求达到目标的决心。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-rieda qawwija li wieħed jibqa' jistinka u ma jaqtax qalbu sakemm jilħaq l-għan tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Determination is the quality of continuing to pursue a goal even when doing so is difficult.

formal.mt: L-istudenta wriet diterminazzjoni kbira billi kompliet tistudja minkejja d-diffikultajiet li ltaqgħet magħhom.
formal.en: The student showed great determination by continuing to study despite the difficulties she encountered.
formal.zh: 这名学生尽管遇到困难，仍继续学习，表现出了坚定的决心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-eżami diffiċli, imma se nibqa' nipprova. Lara: B'din id-diterminazzjoni, tista' tagħmel progress kbir.
colloquial.en: Maja: This exam is difficult, but I will keep trying. Lara: With this determination, you can make a lot of progress.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这场考试很难，但我会继续努力。拉拉：有这样的决心，你能取得很大的进步。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-eżami diffiċli, imma se nibqa' nipprova.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-eżami diffiċli, imma se nibqa' nipprova.
messages.zh: 这场考试很难，但我会继续努力。
messages.en: This exam is difficult, but I will keep trying.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: B'din id-diterminazzjoni, tista' tagħmel progress kbir.
messages.mt_standard: B'din id-diterminazzjoni, tista' tagħmel progress kbir.
messages.zh: 有这样的决心，你能取得很大的进步。
messages.en: With this determination, you can make a lot of progress.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diterminazzjoni 配上“遇到难题仍继续练习”的画面，记住它强调坚持目标的决心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A commercial brand identifying products or services, or a company carrying on business.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于识别商品或服务的商业品牌，也可指从事经营活动的公司或商号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marka kummerċjali li tidentifika prodotti jew servizzi, jew kumpanija li twettaq attività kummerċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于区分某一生产者或经营者的商品、服务的品牌。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marka kummerċjali li biha l-prodotti jew is-servizzi ta' negozju jingħarfu minn dawk ta' negozji oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A brand is the identity under which particular products or services are marketed and distinguished from others.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从事生产、销售或提供服务等经营活动的公司或商号。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Organizzazzjoni kummerċjali li tipproduċi jew tbigħ oġġetti, jew tipprovdi servizzi lill-klijenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A company is a business organization that produces or sells goods or provides services to customers.

formal.mt: Id-ditta tal-kostruzzjoni ppreżentat offerta dettaljata għall-bini ta' skola ġdida.
formal.en: The construction company submitted a detailed bid for the construction of a new school.
formal.zh: 这家建筑公司为新学校的建设提交了一份详细的投标书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ta' liema ditta huma dawn iż-żraben? Lara: Ma nafx, imma huma komdi ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What brand are these shoes? Lara: I don't know, but they are very comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这双鞋是什么牌子的？拉拉：我不知道，不过穿着很舒服。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ta' liema ditta huma dawn iż-żraben?
messages.mt_standard: Ta' liema ditta huma dawn iż-żraben?
messages.zh: 这双鞋是什么牌子的？
messages.en: What brand are these shoes?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx, imma huma komdi ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx, imma huma komdi ħafna.
messages.zh: 我不知道，不过穿着很舒服。
messages.en: I don't know, but they are very comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看鞋上的标识时联想“品牌”，看承接工程的经营单位时联想“公司”；用两幅画面记住 ditta 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A business that examines financial records and reports whether they are accurate and reliable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 检查财务记录，并就其准确性和可靠性出具报告的专业机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ditta li teżamina r-rekords finanzjarji u tirrapporta jekk humiex preċiżi u affidabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提供财务记录审查和审计报告服务的专业事务所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ditta li tipprovdi servizzi ta' eżami tar-rekords finanzjarji u tħejji rapporti tal-awditjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An audit firm is a business that checks financial records and provides an independent opinion on them.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija qabbdet ditta tal-awditjar indipendenti biex teżamina r-rekords finanzjarji tagħha.
formal.en: The company engaged an independent audit firm to examine its financial records.
formal.zh: 公司聘请了一家独立审计事务所，检查其财务记录。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Iddokumentajt l-ispejjeż kollha? Mark: Iva, għax għada ġejja d-ditta tal-awditjar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you documented all the expenses? Mark: Yes, because the audit firm is coming tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你把所有支出都记录好了吗？Mark：是的，因为审计事务所明天要来。

messages.speaker: Lara (会计师)
messages.zh: 你把所有支出都记录好了吗？
messages.en: Have you documented all the expenses?

messages.speaker: Mark (财务助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax għada ġejja d-ditta tal-awditjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax għada ġejja d-ditta tal-awditjar.
messages.zh: 是的，因为审计事务所明天要来。
messages.en: Yes, because the audit firm is coming tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上“专业团队进公司查账”的画面，记住它指审计事务所；搭配 tqabbad 一起练习，表示聘请这类机构。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ruler who holds extensive power and governs without effective democratic control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 掌握高度集中的权力，且其统治缺乏有效民主制约的统治者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mexxej li għandu setgħa kbira u jmexxi mingħajr kontroll demokratiku effettiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 独揽国家统治权、缺乏有效民主制约的独裁统治者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħakkiem li jikkonċentra s-setgħa f'idejh u jmexxi pajjiż mingħajr kontroll demokratiku effettiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dictator is a ruler who exercises extensive power without effective democratic checks on their authority.

collocations.en: under the rule of a dictator

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz jiddeskrivi l-ħajja taċ-ċittadini taħt il-ħakma ta' dittatur li jipprojbixxi kull kritika pubblika.
formal.en: The novel describes the lives of citizens under a dictator who prohibits all public criticism.
formal.zh: 这部小说描写了公民在一名禁止一切公开批评的独裁者统治下的生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fil-film, għaliex in-nies jibżgħu jitkellmu? Pawlu: Għax id-dittatur jikkastiga lil kull min jikkritikah.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are people afraid to speak in the film? Pawlu: Because the dictator punishes anyone who criticizes him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：电影里的人为什么不敢说话？Pawlu：因为那个独裁者会惩罚任何批评他的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里的人为什么不敢说话？
messages.en: Why are people afraid to speak in the film?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax id-dittatur jikkastiga lil kull min jikkritikah.
messages.mt_standard: Għax id-dittatur jikkastiga lil kull min jikkritikah.
messages.zh: 因为那个独裁者会惩罚任何批评他的人。
messages.en: Because the dictator punishes anyone who criticizes him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一个人把持权力、旁人不敢批评”的场景记忆 dittatur；再把 id-dittatur 当作“那位独裁者”整块朗读。

gloss_zh: 著名女歌唱家；自视甚高、要求特殊待遇的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A celebrated female singer, especially in opera; also a person who considers themselves very important and expects special treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 备受赞誉的女歌唱家，尤指歌剧女歌唱家；也指自视甚高、期待特殊待遇的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kantanta ċċelebrata, speċjalment fl-opra; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għal persuna li tqis lilha nnifisha importanti ħafna u tistenna trattament speċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 享有盛名、备受赞誉的女歌唱家，尤指歌剧女歌唱家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kantanta famuża u ammirata ħafna, speċjalment waħda li tkanta fl-opra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A diva is a celebrated female singer, especially one who performs leading roles in opera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自视甚高、认为自己十分重要并期待他人给予特殊待遇的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha stima għolja ħafna tagħha nnifisha u tistenna li oħrajn jagħtuha attenzjoni jew trattament speċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you call someone a diva, you mean that they consider themselves very important and expect special treatment.

collocations.zh: 摆出自视甚高、要求特殊待遇的姿态

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-kunċert jippreżenta lill-kantanta bħala diva tal-opra magħrufa għall-vuċi qawwija tagħha.
formal.en: The concert programme presents the singer as an opera diva known for her powerful voice.
formal.zh: 音乐会节目册将这位歌唱家介绍为一名以洪亮嗓音闻名的歌剧名伶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lara trid kamra għaliha biss u ma tridx tistenna bħal kulħadd. Nina: Illum qed iġġib ruħha ta' diva!
colloquial.en: Maja: Lara wants a room all to herself and refuses to wait like everyone else. Nina: She's behaving like a diva today!
colloquial.zh: Maja：Lara 要自己独占一个房间，还不愿意像大家一样等着。Nina：她今天真会摆架子！

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Lara trid kamra għaliha biss u ma tridx tistenna bħal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Lara trid kamra għaliha biss u ma tridx tistenna bħal kulħadd.
messages.zh: Lara 要自己独占一个房间，还不愿意像大家一样等着。
messages.en: Lara wants a room all to herself and refuses to wait like everyone else.

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum qed iġġib ruħha ta' diva!
messages.mt_standard: Illum qed iġġib ruħha ta' diva!
messages.zh: 她今天真会摆架子！
messages.en: She's behaving like a diva today!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画区分义项：舞台中央的著名女歌唱家，以及生活中要求特殊待遇的人；前者可赞誉，后者通常带批评意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A separation or development in different directions; also a difference of opinion between people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物彼此分离或朝不同方向发展的现象；也指人们之间的意见分歧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Separazzjoni jew żvilupp f'direzzjonijiet differenti; il-kelma tfisser ukoll differenza fl-opinjonijiet bejn persuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事物逐渐分离、朝不同方向发展或彼此差异增大的现象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew il-qagħda li fiha affarijiet jitbiegħdu minn xulxin jew jiżviluppaw f'direzzjonijiet differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Divergence occurs when things move apart or develop in increasingly different directions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不同的人或群体对同一问题持有不一致的看法或立场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Differenza fl-opinjonijiet jew fil-pożizzjonijiet ta' persuni jew gruppi dwar l-istess kwistjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A disagreement is a situation in which people hold different opinions about the same matter.

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi d-diverġenza bejn iż-żewġ rotot wara li joħorġu mill-wied: waħda tkompli lejn it-tramuntana u l-oħra lejn il-lvant.
formal.en: The map shows the divergence between the two routes after they leave the valley: one continues north and the other east.
formal.zh: 地图显示了两条路线离开山谷后的分离情况：一条继续向北，另一条向东。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għad hemm diverġenza dwar il-prezz? Lara: Iva, jien naħseb li hu għoli wisq, imma Pawlu jaħseb li hu ġust.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is there still a disagreement over the price? Lara: Yes, I think it's too high, but Pawlu thinks it's fair.
colloquial.zh: Mark：关于价格还有分歧吗？Lara：有，我觉得太高了，但 Pawlu 觉得合理。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 关于价格还有分歧吗？
messages.en: Is there still a disagreement over the price?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien naħseb li hu għoli wisq, imma Pawlu jaħseb li hu ġust.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien naħseb li hu għoli wisq, imma Pawlu jaħseb li hu ġust.
messages.zh: 有，我觉得太高了，但 Pawlu 觉得合理。
messages.en: Yes, I think it's too high, but Pawlu thinks it's fair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两条路线从同处逐渐分开，帮助记住“趋异”；再想象两个人的想法走向不同方向，帮助记住“意见分歧”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A share of a company's profits paid to its shareholders.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公司从利润中分配给股东的一笔收益，称为股息或红利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sehem mill-profitti ta' kumpanija li jitħallas lill-azzjonisti tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 股息，指公司向股东分配的利润份额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dividend huwa ħlas li kumpanija tagħmel lill-azzjonisti tagħha bħala sehem mill-profitti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dividend is an amount of money that a company pays to its shareholders from its profits.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ħabbret li se tħallas dividend lill-azzjonisti tagħha fl-aħħar tas-sena.
formal.en: The company announced that it would pay a dividend to its shareholders at the end of the year.
formal.zh: 公司宣布将在年底向股东支付股息。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-kumpanija se tħallas dividend din is-sena? Pawlu: Iva, iżda għadna ma nafux kemm se jkun.
colloquial.en: Marija: Will the company pay a dividend this year? Pawlu: Yes, but we do not yet know how much it will be.
colloquial.zh: Marija：公司今年会派发股息吗？Pawlu：会，但我们还不知道具体金额。

messages.speaker: Marija (股东)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpanija se tħallas dividend din is-sena?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpanija se tħallas dividend din is-sena?
messages.zh: 公司今年会派发股息吗？
messages.en: Will the company pay a dividend this year?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda għadna ma nafux kemm se jkun.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda għadna ma nafux kemm se jkun.
messages.zh: 会，但我们还不知道具体金额。
messages.en: Yes, but we do not yet know how much it will be.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dividend 和“公司盈利后给股东分钱”的画面绑定，搭配 tħallas dividend 一起记，表示支付股息。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The nature or quality of being divine, or a divine being.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 神所具有的本性或特质，也可指一位神明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-natura jew il-kwalità ta' dak li hu divin, jew esseri divin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神性，即神所具有的本性或特质；也可指神明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-divinità hija n-natura jew il-kwalità divina; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għal esseri divin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Divinity is the nature or quality of being divine, and a divinity can also be a god or goddess.

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel il-kunċett tad-divinità f'diversi tradizzjonijiet reliġjużi.
formal.en: The study compares the concept of divinity across several religious traditions.
formal.zh: 这项研究比较了几种宗教传统中的神性概念。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din l-istatwa tirrappreżenta divinità antika? Mark: Iva, skont it-tikketta, tirrappreżenta alla tal-baħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this statue represent an ancient deity? Mark: Yes, according to the label, it represents a god of the sea.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这尊雕像表现的是一位古代神明吗？Mark：是的，标签上说它表现的是一位海神。

messages.speaker: Lara (博物馆参观者)
messages.zh: 这尊雕像表现的是一位古代神明吗？
messages.en: Does this statue represent an ancient deity?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, skont it-tikketta, tirrappreżenta alla tal-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, skont it-tikketta, tirrappreżenta alla tal-baħar.
messages.zh: 是的，标签上说它表现的是一位海神。
messages.en: Yes, according to the label, it represents a god of the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 divinità 配两幅学习图：抽象的神圣光芒提示“神性”，具体的神像提示“一位神明”，用语境区分两种理解。

gloss_zh: 分部；组别；体育联赛级别

teaching_sense.en_definition: A section or category within a larger organization or competition, especially a level in a sports league.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 较大组织或竞赛中的一个分部或组别，尤指体育联赛中的级别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqsima jew kategorija fi ħdan organizzazzjoni jew kompetizzjoni akbar, speċjalment livell f'kampjonat sportiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分部或组别；在体育语境中，指联赛按水平划分的级别。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Divixin huwa taqsima jew kategorija f'organizzazzjoni jew kompetizzjoni; fl-isport, jirreferi għal livell f'kampjonat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A division is a section of a larger organization or competition, such as a group of teams at a particular level.

formal.mt: It-tim tela' għat-tieni divixin wara staġun ta' riżultati tajbin.
formal.en: The team was promoted to the second division after a season of good results.
formal.zh: 该队在一个赛季中取得良好成绩后，升入了第二级别联赛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: F'liema divixin jilgħab it-tim tiegħek? Ġużeppi: Fit-tieni divixin, u nhar is-Sibt għandna logħba importanti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which division does your team play in? Ġużeppi: In the second division, and we have an important match on Saturday.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你的球队参加哪个级别的联赛？Ġużeppi：第二级别，我们星期六有一场重要比赛。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的球队参加哪个级别的联赛？
messages.en: Which division does your team play in?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (球队球员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fit-tieni divixin, u nhar is-Sibt għandna logħba importanti.
messages.mt_standard: Fit-tieni divixin, u nhar is-Sibt għandna logħba importanti.
messages.zh: 第二级别，我们星期六有一场重要比赛。
messages.en: In the second division, and we have an important match on Saturday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 divixin 放进联赛阶梯图中记忆：每一级是一个组别，l-ewwel divixin 和 it-tieni divixin 分别标在第一、第二级。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The property of being divisible, especially the ability of a number to be divided by another without a remainder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够被分开的性质；在数学中，尤指一个数能被另一个数除尽而没有余数的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proprjetà li xi ħaġa tista' tinqasam; fil-matematika, il-proprjetà li numru jista' jinqasam b'numru ieħor mingħajr ma jibqa' fdal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可分性；数学中的整除性，即一个数除以另一个数后余数为零的性质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-diviżibilità hija l-proprjetà li xi ħaġa tista' tinqasam, u fil-matematika tindika li numru jista' jinqasam b'numru ieħor mingħajr fdal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Divisibility is the property of being divisible, particularly when one number can be divided by another without leaving a remainder.

formal.mt: It-test tad-diviżibilità bi tlieta juża s-somma taċ-ċifri biex jiddetermina jekk numru jistax jinqasam bi tlieta mingħajr fdal.
formal.en: The divisibility test for three uses the sum of the digits to determine whether a number can be divided by three without a remainder.
formal.zh: 三的整除判定法利用各位数字之和，判断一个数能否被三整除。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif nuża r-regola tad-diviżibilità bi tlieta għal 123? David: Għodd iċ-ċifri: wieħed u tnejn u tlieta jagħmlu sitta, allura 123 jinqasam bi tlieta mingħajr fdal.
colloquial.en: Anna: How do I apply the divisibility rule for three to 123? David: Add the digits: one plus two plus three makes six, so 123 is divisible by three without a remainder.
colloquial.zh: Anna：怎样用三的整除规则判断123？David：把各位数字相加：一加二加三等于六，所以123能被三整除。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nuża r-regola tad-diviżibilità bi tlieta għal 123?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nuża r-regola tad-diviżibilità bi tlieta għal 123?
messages.zh: 怎样用三的整除规则判断123？
messages.en: How do I apply the divisibility rule for three to 123?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għodd iċ-ċifri: wieħed u tnejn u tlieta jagħmlu sitta, allura 123 jinqasam bi tlieta mingħajr fdal.
messages.mt_standard: Għodd iċ-ċifri: wieħed u tnejn u tlieta jagħmlu sitta, allura 123 jinqasam bi tlieta mingħajr fdal.
messages.zh: 把各位数字相加：一加二加三等于六，所以123能被三整除。
messages.en: Add the digits: one plus two plus three makes six, so 123 is divisible by three without a remainder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diviżibilità 和“十二块饼干分给三人，每人四块，余数为零”的画面绑定，重点记住数学中的整除性。

gloss_zh: 引起分裂的；造成严重分歧的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something divisive causes strong disagreement or creates opposing groups among people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容言论、议题或措施等引起强烈分歧，使人们形成相互对立的群体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tqajjem nuqqas ta' qbil qawwi jew toħloq firda bejn in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起强烈分歧或使人们分成对立阵营的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi suġġett, diskors jew azzjoni li joħolqu firda jew nuqqas ta' qbil qawwi bejn in-nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is divisive, it causes strong disagreement and separates people into opposing groups.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinnota li d-diskors diviżiv żied it-tensjoni bejn iż-żewġ gruppi u għamilha aktar diffiċli li jintlaħaq ftehim.
formal.en: The report notes that the divisive speech increased tension between the two groups and made reaching an agreement more difficult.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这番引起分裂的言论加剧了两个群体之间的紧张关系，使达成协议更加困难。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tridx nitkellmu dwar dan waqt l-ikla? Mark: Għax hu suġġett diviżiv, u ma rridx li nispiċċaw niġġieldu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you want us to talk about this over dinner? Mark: Because it's a divisive topic, and I don't want us to end up arguing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么不想让我们吃饭时谈这件事？马克：因为这个话题很容易引起分歧，我不想最后大家吵起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx nitkellmu dwar dan waqt l-ikla?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx nitkellmu dwar dan waqt l-ikla?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想让我们吃饭时谈这件事？
messages.en: Why don't you want us to talk about this over dinner?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu suġġett diviżiv, u ma rridx li nispiċċaw niġġieldu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu suġġett diviżiv, u ma rridx li nispiċċaw niġġieldu.
messages.zh: 因为这个话题很容易引起分歧，我不想最后大家吵起来。
messages.en: Because it's a divisive topic, and I don't want us to end up arguing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象餐桌上的一个话题让朋友分成两派：用 diviżiv 形容这种造成分歧的性质，搭配 suġġett 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Division is the act of separating something into parts or shares; in mathematics, it is the operation used to find how many times one number fits into another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指把整体划分为若干部分或份额；在数学中，指求一个数包含另一个数多少次的运算，即除法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qsim ta' ħaġa f'partijiet jew f'ishma; fil-matematika, l-operazzjoni li biha nsibu kemm-il darba numru jidħol f'numru ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把整体分成部分或份额的行为；也指数学中的除法运算。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li taqsam xi ħaġa f'partijiet jew f'ishma, jew l-operazzjoni matematika li turi kemm-il darba numru jidħol f'numru ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Division is the process of separating something into parts or shares, and it also refers to the mathematical operation of dividing one number by another.

formal.mt: Il-pjan jippreżenta diviżjoni ċara tax-xogħol bejn il-membri tat-tim, sabiex kull persuna tkun taf liema kompiti għandha twettaq.
formal.en: The plan presents a clear division of work among the team members so that each person knows which tasks to carry out.
formal.zh: 该计划明确划分了团队成员的工作，使每个人都知道自己需要完成哪些任务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ma fhimtx din is-somma ta' diviżjoni. Ben: Aħseb fi tnax-il gallettina mqassma ndaqs bejn tlett itfal; kull wieħed jieħu erbgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: I didn't understand this division problem. Ben: Think of twelve biscuits shared equally among three children; each child gets four.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我没弄懂这道除法题。本：想象把十二块饼干平均分给三个孩子，每人就能分到四块。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma fhimtx din is-somma ta' diviżjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ma fhimtx din is-somma ta' diviżjoni.
messages.zh: 我没弄懂这道除法题。
messages.en: I didn't understand this division problem.

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħseb fi tnax-il gallettina mqassma ndaqs bejn tlett itfal; kull wieħed jieħu erbgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Aħseb fi tnax-il gallettina mqassma ndaqs bejn tlett itfal; kull wieħed jieħu erbgħa.
messages.zh: 想象把十二块饼干平均分给三个孩子，每人就能分到四块。
messages.en: Think of twelve biscuits shared equally among three children; each child gets four.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把十二块饼干分成三份，每份四块：用这个画面记 diviżjoni 的划分和除法义，再联想到团队中的工作分工。

gloss_zh: 耍大牌的作风；自视甚高的举动

teaching_sense.en_definition: Diviżmu is demanding or self-important behaviour in which someone expects admiration, special treatment, or constant attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指表现得像大牌明星一样，要求特殊待遇、他人关注或赞赏的作风，也指自视甚高者的举动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba ta' persuna li tagħti lilha nnifisha importanza kbira u tistenna attenzjoni, ammirazzjoni jew trattament speċjali mingħand ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 如同大牌明星般要求他人迁就、关注或给予特殊待遇的作风；耍大牌。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imġiba bħal dik ta' diva li tistenna li kulħadd jagħtiha attenzjoni u jilqa' t-talbiet tagħha għal trattament speċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Diviżmu is behaviour associated with a demanding star who expects others to provide attention and special treatment.

sense_translations.en_definition: the actions of a highly self-regarding person
sense_translations.zh_definition: 极为看重自己、认为自己特别重要的人所表现出的举动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-azzjonijiet ta' persuna li tqis lilha nnifisha importanti ħafna u taġixxi bħallikieku x-xewqat tagħha għandhom dejjem jiġu l-ewwel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Diviżmu describes the actions of someone who has an exaggerated sense of their own importance and expects others to recognise it.

collocations.zh: 表现出自视甚高的作风

formal.mt: Fir-reviżjoni tal-ispettaklu, il-kritiku ddeskriva t-talba tal-kantant għal kamra sħiħa għalih biss bħala att ta' diviżmu.
formal.en: In the review of the show, the critic described the singer's demand for an entire room to himself as an act of diva-like behaviour.
formal.zh: 在演出评论中，评论家把这位歌手要求独占整个房间的做法称为一次耍大牌的举动。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ried li kulħadd jieqaf jaħdem sakemm jasal il-kafè tiegħu. Pawlu: Dak diviżmu; il-ħin tal-oħrajn għandu valur ukoll.
colloquial.en: Nina: He wanted everyone to stop working until his coffee arrived. Pawlu: That's self-important behaviour; other people's time matters too.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他竟然要所有人停下工作，等他的咖啡送到。保罗：这就是耍大牌，别人的时间也很宝贵。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried li kulħadd jieqaf jaħdem sakemm jasal il-kafè tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ried li kulħadd jieqaf jaħdem sakemm jasal il-kafè tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他竟然要所有人停下工作，等他的咖啡送到。
messages.en: He wanted everyone to stop working until his coffee arrived.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak diviżmu; il-ħin tal-oħrajn għandu valur ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Dak diviżmu; il-ħin tal-oħrajn għandu valur ukoll.
messages.zh: 这就是耍大牌，别人的时间也很宝贵。
messages.en: That's self-important behaviour; other people's time matters too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人为了自己的一杯咖啡让全组停工：用 diviżmu 记住耍大牌和自视甚高的举动，注意它是表示行为的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who is divorced was previously married, but that marriage has legally ended.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指曾经结婚，而该段婚姻已通过离婚在法律上终止的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li kienet miżżewġa u li ż-żwieġ tagħha ntemm legalment permezz ta' divorzju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已离婚的；曾有一段婚姻，而该段婚姻已通过离婚正式终止的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li ż-żwieġ tagħha jkun intemm legalment permezz ta' divorzju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is divorced has had their marriage legally ended through divorce.

collocations.en: he has been divorced for two years

formal.mt: Meta mela l-formola dwar l-istat ċivili tiegħu, Mark indika li kien divorzjat u daħħal id-data li fiha ntemm iż-żwieġ.
formal.en: When completing the form about his marital status, Mark indicated that he was divorced and entered the date on which the marriage ended.
formal.zh: 马克填写婚姻状况表格时，注明自己已离婚，并填写了婚姻终止的日期。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadek miżżewweġ? Mark: Le, jien divorzjat. Ili divorzjat sentejn, u għadni nitkellem mal-eks mara tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you still married? Mark: No, I'm divorced. I've been divorced for two years, and I still talk to my ex-wife.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你现在还是已婚吗？马克：不是，我离婚了。已经离婚两年了，我和前妻仍有联系。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你现在还是已婚吗？
messages.en: Are you still married?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jien divorzjat. Ili divorzjat sentejn, u għadni nitkellem mal-eks mara tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jien divorzjat. Ili divorzjat sentejn, u għadni nitkellem mal-eks mara tiegħi.
messages.zh: 不是，我离婚了。已经离婚两年了，我和前妻仍有联系。
messages.en: No, I'm divorced. I've been divorced for two years, and I still talk to my ex-wife.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 divorzjat 放进婚姻状况表格的画面中记忆，再朗读 Jien divorzjat，理解为我已离婚，重点记住它描述的是离婚后的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The legal ending of a marriage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过法律程序解除婚姻关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tmiem ta' żwieġ permezz ta' proċess legali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 离婚；婚姻关系在法律上的解除。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-divorzju huwa t-tmiem legali ta' żwieġ bejn żewġ persuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A divorce is the legal process through which a marriage is ended.

formal.mt: Il-koppja talbet informazzjoni dwar il-proċess tad-divorzju.
formal.en: The couple requested information about the divorce process.
formal.zh: 这对夫妻询问了有关离婚程序的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif qed tħossok wara d-divorzju? Lara: Għadni qed nidra, imma l-ħbieb tiegħi qed jgħinuni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are you feeling after the divorce? Lara: I'm still getting used to it, but my friends are helping me a lot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：离婚后你感觉怎么样？拉拉：我还在适应，不过朋友们给了我很多帮助。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 离婚后你感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How are you feeling after the divorce?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni qed nidra, imma l-ħbieb tiegħi qed jgħinuni ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni qed nidra, imma l-ħbieb tiegħi qed jgħinuni ħafna.
messages.zh: 我还在适应，不过朋友们给了我很多帮助。
messages.en: I'm still getting used to it, but my friends are helping me a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 divorzju 放进“婚姻依法结束”的画面中记忆；再用 wara d-divorzju“离婚后”练习描述生活变化。

gloss_zh: 全面披露；完整公开相关信息

teaching_sense.en_definition: The provision of all relevant information about a matter without withholding important details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某件事情的所有相关信息完整披露，不隐瞒重要细节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti tal-informazzjoni rilevanti kollha dwar kwistjoni mingħajr ma jinżammu moħbija dettalji importanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 全面披露；完整提供所有相关信息而不隐瞒重要事项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Divulgazzjoni totali tfisser li tingħata l-informazzjoni rilevanti kollha dwar xi ħaġa u li ma jitħallewx barra dettalji importanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Full disclosure is the act of providing all relevant information about something without hiding important details.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jipprovdi divulgazzjoni totali tal-ispejjeż kollha marbuta mal-proġett.
formal.en: The report provides full disclosure of all costs associated with the project.
formal.zh: 报告全面披露了与该项目有关的所有费用。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qabel naqbel, irrid divulgazzjoni totali tal-ispejjeż. Rita: Żgur, se ngħidlek kemm tiswa kull ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Before I agree, I want full disclosure of the costs. Rita: Of course, I'll tell you how much everything costs.
colloquial.zh: 马克：在我同意之前，我要了解全部费用。丽塔：当然，我会告诉你每一项要花多少钱。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Qabel naqbel, irrid divulgazzjoni totali tal-ispejjeż.
messages.mt_standard: Qabel naqbel, irrid divulgazzjoni totali tal-ispejjeż.
messages.zh: 在我同意之前，我要了解全部费用。
messages.en: Before I agree, I want full disclosure of the costs.

messages.speaker: Rita (服务人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, se ngħidlek kemm tiswa kull ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, se ngħidlek kemm tiswa kull ħaġa.
messages.zh: 当然，我会告诉你每一项要花多少钱。
messages.en: Of course, I'll tell you how much everything costs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 divulgazzjoni totali 想成摊开一份完整账单：每项费用都看得见，重要细节一项也不藏，用这个场景记住“全面披露”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: People in later generations of a family who are related to an earlier person through their children.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过子女一代代延续而与某位先人有亲属关系的人，如其子女、孙辈及更后世代。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuni li jiġu minn xi ħadd permezz ta' wliedu u tal-ġenerazzjonijiet ta' warajhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 后代；某人的子女以及由其子女延续的各代子孙。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dixxendenti ta' persuna huma wliedha, in-neputijiet tagħha u l-membri tal-ġenerazzjonijiet tal-familja li jiġu warajhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's descendants are their children and the people in later generations who are related to them through those children.

formal.mt: Id-dokument jinkludi lista tad-dixxendenti tal-koppja u d-dati tat-twelid tagħhom.
formal.en: The document includes a list of the couple's descendants and their dates of birth.
formal.zh: 文件列出了这对夫妻的后代及其出生日期。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min huma dawn in-nies fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Huma d-dixxendenti ta' ħu n-nannu; kollha ġew għal-laqgħa tal-familja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who are these people in the photograph? Pawlu: They're the descendants of Grandpa's brother; they all came to the family gathering.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：照片里的这些人是谁？保罗：他们是爷爷兄弟的后代；他们都来参加家庭聚会了。

messages.speaker: Nina (孙女)
messages.zh: 照片里的这些人是谁？
messages.en: Who are these people in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Huma d-dixxendenti ta' ħu n-nannu; kollha ġew għal-laqgħa tal-familja.
messages.mt_standard: Huma d-dixxendenti ta' ħu n-nannu; kollha ġew għal-laqgħa tal-familja.
messages.zh: 他们是爷爷兄弟的后代；他们都来参加家庭聚会了。
messages.en: They're the descendants of Grandpa's brother; they all came to the family gathering.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一棵家谱树，从一位先人连到子女、孙辈及更后世代，把这些后代一起圈起来，标上 dixxendenti，记住它表示复数的“后代”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of following rules and controlling behaviour so that activities are carried out in an orderly way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遵守规则并约束行为，使活动有秩序地进行的行为准则或自我控制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li wieħed jimxi mar-regoli u jikkontrolla l-imġiba tiegħu biex l-attivitajiet isiru b'ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纪律；遵守规则、约束行为的要求或能力，也指坚持行动所需的自律。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dixxiplina hija l-ħila jew il-prattika li wieħed josserva r-regoli u jikkontrolla l-imġiba tiegħu sabiex iżomm l-ordni jew jilħaq għan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Discipline is the practice of following rules or controlling your behaviour so that you can maintain order or achieve a goal.

formal.mt: Id-dixxiplina fil-klassi tgħin lill-istudenti jisimgħu lil xulxin u jaħdmu b'ordni.
formal.en: Classroom discipline helps students listen to one another and work in an orderly way.
formal.zh: 课堂纪律有助于学生相互倾听并有序开展学习。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif jirnexxilek tistudja kuljum? Ben: Bi ftit dixxiplina: nitfi t-telefon u nibda dejjem fl-istess ħin.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do you manage to study every day? Ben: With a little discipline: I turn off my phone and always start at the same time.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么做到每天都学习的？本：靠一点自律：我关掉手机，每天都在同一时间开始。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你怎么做到每天都学习的？
messages.en: How do you manage to study every day?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Bi ftit dixxiplina: nitfi t-telefon u nibda dejjem fl-istess ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Bi ftit dixxiplina: nitfi t-telefon u nibda dejjem fl-istess ħin.
messages.zh: 靠一点自律：我关掉手机，每天都在同一时间开始。
messages.en: With a little discipline: I turn off my phone and always start at the same time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dixxiplina 联想到每天定时关掉手机、开始学习的动作；个人坚持靠“自律”，全班有序靠“纪律”，两个场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Using or relating to information represented electronically as numbers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用数字形式表示、储存或处理信息的，或与这种技术有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juża informazzjoni rrappreżentata bħala numri biex tinħażen, tiġi pproċessata jew tintbagħat b'mezzi elettroniċi, jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' din it-teknoloġija.
