sense_translations.zh_definition: 数字的；数码的，指以数字形式表示信息，或使用这种信息形式的电子技术、设备及服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' informazzjoni f'forma ta' numri jew ma' teknoloġija, apparat u servizzi elettroniċi li jużaw din il-forma ta' informazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Digital technology represents and processes information as numbers, allowing it to be stored or transmitted electronically.

formal.mt: L-arkivju diġitali jippermetti lill-istudenti jfittxu d-dokumenti u jaqrawhom mill-bogħod.
formal.en: The digital archive allows students to search for documents and read them remotely.
formal.zh: 数字档案库让学生能够远程检索和阅读文档。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi nipprintja l-biljett? Mark: Le, tista' turi l-biljett diġitali fuq it-telefon tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do I need to print the ticket? Mark: No, you can show the digital ticket on your phone.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我需要把票打印出来吗？Mark：不用，你可以出示手机上的电子票。

messages.speaker: Nina (观众)
messages.zh: 我需要把票打印出来吗？
messages.en: Do I need to print the ticket?

messages.speaker: Mark (票务工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tista' turi l-biljett diġitali fuq it-telefon tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tista' turi l-biljett diġitali fuq it-telefon tiegħek.
messages.zh: 不用，你可以出示手机上的电子票。
messages.en: No, you can show the digital ticket on your phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把手机里的电子票、电脑中的档案和数字签名放在同一幅记忆图里，用 diġitali 把这些以数字形式保存或处理的信息串起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of harmony or agreement between people or between parts of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人与人之间缺乏和睦或共识，或事物各部分之间缺乏协调的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' qbil jew armonija bejn in-nies jew bejn il-partijiet ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不和；意见或关系缺乏协调一致的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat ta' nuqqas ta' qbil jew armonija bejn persuni, gruppi jew elementi differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When there is discord, people disagree or different elements fail to work together harmoniously.

collocations.en: a lack of harmony between the colours

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li n-nuqqas ta' komunikazzjoni ħoloq diżarmonija bejn il-membri tat-tim.
formal.en: The report indicates that a lack of communication created discord among the team members.
formal.zh: 报告指出，缺乏沟通造成了团队成员之间的不和。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm daqshekk diżarmonija fit-tim? Pawlu: Kulħadd irid jagħmel kollox bil-mod tiegħu. Irridu nitkellmu u nsibu ftehim.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there so much discord in the team? Pawlu: Everyone wants to do everything their own way. We need to talk and reach an agreement.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：团队里为什么这么不和？保罗：大家都想按自己的方式做所有事情。我们得谈一谈，达成共识。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 团队里为什么这么不和？
messages.en: Why is there so much discord in the team?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kulħadd irid jagħmel kollox bil-mod tiegħu. Irridu nitkellmu u nsibu ftehim.
messages.mt_standard: Kulħadd irid jagħmel kollox bil-mod tiegħu. Irridu nitkellmu u nsibu ftehim.
messages.zh: 大家都想按自己的方式做所有事情。我们得谈一谈，达成共识。
messages.en: Everyone wants to do everything their own way. We need to talk and reach an agreement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象合唱团人人唱不同的调，用这幅不协调的画面记住 diżarmonija，也联想到人际关系中的不和。

gloss_zh: 灾难性的；造成严重后果的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing extremely serious harm, damage, or failure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 造成极其严重的伤害、损失或失败的；灾难性的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jikkawża ħsara kbira ħafna, telf serju jew falliment gravi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灾难性的；带来极其严重的破坏、损失或失败的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jwassal għal diżastru jew għal konsegwenzi ta' ħsara estrema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an event or mistake is catastrophic, it causes extremely serious damage, loss, or failure.

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' manutenzjoni kellu effett diżastruż fuq il-pont, li sar perikoluż għall-pubbliku.
formal.en: The lack of maintenance had a disastrous effect on the bridge, which became dangerous to the public.
formal.zh: 缺乏维护给桥梁带来了灾难性的影响，使其危及公众安全。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif mar il-kejk? Ġanni: Ir-riżultat kien diżastruż! Inħaraq kollu, u issa rridu nagħmlu ieħor.
colloquial.en: Marta: How did the cake turn out? Ġanni: The result was disastrous! It burnt completely, and now we need to make another one.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：蛋糕做得怎么样？詹尼：结果简直是灾难！整个都烤焦了，现在我们得再做一个。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 蛋糕做得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the cake turn out?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-riżultat kien diżastruż! Inħaraq kollu, u issa rridu nagħmlu ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-riżultat kien diżastruż! Inħaraq kollu, u issa rridu nagħmlu ieħor.
messages.zh: 结果简直是灾难！整个都烤焦了，现在我们得再做一个。
messages.en: The result was disastrous! It burnt completely, and now we need to make another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diżastruż 和整盘蛋糕烤成黑炭的画面绑定：它表示后果严重，也可在口语中夸张地说结果糟透了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state in which things are not properly arranged or activities are not well organized.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品没有妥善排列，或活动缺乏组织和秩序的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat li fih l-affarijiet mhumiex irranġati sew jew l-attivitajiet mhumiex organizzati kif suppost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混乱；事物缺乏整齐安排或正常秩序的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' ordni fl-arranġament tal-affarijiet jew fl-organizzazzjoni tal-attivitajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When there is disorder, things are untidy or activities lack proper organization and control.

formal.mt: Minħabba d-diżordni fl-arkivju, l-impjegati ma setgħux isibu d-dokumenti meħtieġa fil-ħin.
formal.en: Because of the disorder in the archive, the employees could not find the required documents in time.
formal.zh: 由于档案室杂乱无序，员工未能及时找到所需文件。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhu dan id-diżordni kollu fuq il-mejda? Mark: Kont qed infittex iċ-ċwievet. Issa nirranġa kollox.
colloquial.en: Anna: What's all this mess on the table? Mark: I was looking for the keys. I'll tidy everything up now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：桌上怎么乱成这样？马克：我刚才在找钥匙。我现在就把东西都整理好。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan id-diżordni kollu fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan id-diżordni kollu fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 桌上怎么乱成这样？
messages.en: What's all this mess on the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont qed infittex iċ-ċwievet. Issa nirranġa kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Kont qed infittex iċ-ċwievet. Issa nirranġa kollox.
messages.zh: 我刚才在找钥匙。我现在就把东西都整理好。
messages.en: I was looking for the keys. I'll tidy everything up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上纸张、钥匙和书本混成一堆，找不到需要的东西；把这幅杂乱无序的画面与 diżordni 配对记忆。

gloss_zh: 方言的；具有方言特征的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a dialect or characteristic of a particular dialect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与方言有关的，或具有某种方言特征的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' djalett jew li huwa karatteristiku ta' djalett partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 方言的；属于某种方言或体现其特点的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni għal djalett jew li juri karatteristiċi ta' djalett fl-użu tal-lingwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dialectal word or feature belongs to, or is characteristic of, a particular dialect.

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel il-varjanti djalettali tal-istess kelma kif tintuża f'irħula differenti.
formal.en: The study compares dialectal variants of the same word as it is used in different villages.
formal.zh: 这项研究比较了同一个词在不同村庄使用时呈现的方言变体。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex in-nanna tuża kelma differenti għal din il-ħaġa? Luqa: Forsi hija kelma djalettali. Ejja nistaqsuha xi tfisser.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does Grandma use a different word for this thing? Luqa: Maybe it's a dialectal word. Let's ask her what it means.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：奶奶为什么用另一个词来称呼这个东西？卢卡：可能是方言词。我们问问她是什么意思吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (妹妹)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex in-nanna tuża kelma differenti għal din il-ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex in-nanna tuża kelma differenti għal din il-ħaġa?
messages.zh: 奶奶为什么用另一个词来称呼这个东西？
messages.en: Why does Grandma use a different word for this thing?

messages.speaker: Luqa (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi hija kelma djalettali. Ejja nistaqsuha xi tfisser.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi hija kelma djalettali. Ejja nistaqsuha xi tfisser.
messages.zh: 可能是方言词。我们问问她是什么意思吧。
messages.en: Maybe it's a dialectal word. Let's ask her what it means.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一件东西在不同村庄有不同叫法；用这张方言地图记住 djalettali，重点联想词语或表达的地方特征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A conversation or exchange of views between two or more people or groups.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两个人或多个个人、群体之间进行的交谈或意见交流。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Konverżazzjoni jew skambju ta' fehmiet bejn żewġ persuni jew gruppi jew aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 双方或多方通过交谈交换想法、意见或信息的对话。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taħdita bejn żewġ persuni jew gruppi jew aktar li fiha jaqsmu ideat, fehmiet jew informazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dialogue is conversation between people or groups in which they exchange ideas, information, or opinions.

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat laqgħa biex tħeġġeġ djalogu miftuħ bejn l-għalliema u l-ġenituri.
formal.en: The school organized a meeting to encourage open dialogue between teachers and parents.
formal.zh: 学校组织了一次会议，以鼓励教师与家长坦诚交流。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif marret il-laqgħa? Mark: Tajjeb. Kellna djalogu miftuħ u kulħadd seta' jgħid x'jaħseb.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did the meeting go? Mark: Well. We had an open dialogue, and everyone could say what they thought.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：会议进行得怎么样？马克：很好。我们坦诚交流，每个人都能表达自己的想法。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 会议进行得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the meeting go?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb. Kellna djalogu miftuħ u kulħadd seta' jgħid x'jaħseb.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb. Kellna djalogu miftuħ u kulħadd seta' jgħid x'jaħseb.
messages.zh: 很好。我们坦诚交流，每个人都能表达自己的想法。
messages.en: Well. We had an open dialogue, and everyone could say what they thought.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 djalogu 和英语 dialogue 配对记忆，想象两个人轮流说话；再用 djalogu miftuħ 记住“坦诚对话”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A process in which an organization discusses possible solutions with competing suppliers before choosing an offer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个机构与相互竞争的供应商讨论可能的解决方案，然后选择报价或提案的程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess li fih organizzazzjoni tiddiskuti soluzzjonijiet possibbli ma' fornituri li jikkompetu bejniethom qabel tagħżel offerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 竞争性对话，即采购方在选择方案或报价之前，与相互竞争的供应商讨论需求及可能解决方案的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess ta' xiri li fih ix-xerrej jiddiskuti l-ħtiġijiet tiegħu u soluzzjonijiet possibbli ma' fornituri li jikkompetu bejniethom qabel jagħżel offerta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Competitive dialogue is a purchasing process in which a buyer discusses possible solutions with competing suppliers before selecting an offer.

collocations.en: take part in a competitive dialogue

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni nediet djalogu kompetittiv biex tiddiskuti soluzzjonijiet possibbli mal-fornituri qabel tagħżel offerta.
formal.en: The organization launched a competitive dialogue to discuss possible solutions with suppliers before selecting an offer.
formal.zh: 该机构启动了竞争性对话，以便在选择报价之前与供应商讨论可能的解决方案。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Diġà għażiltu fornitur? Pawlu: Le, għadna fil-proċess ta' djalogu kompetittiv. Qed niddiskutu s-soluzzjonijiet mal-fornituri.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you chosen a supplier yet? Paul: No, we are still in the competitive dialogue process. We are discussing the solutions with the suppliers.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你们已经选好供应商了吗？保罗：还没有，我们仍在进行竞争性对话，正在和供应商讨论解决方案。

messages.speaker: Anna (项目同事)
messages.zh: 你们已经选好供应商了吗？
messages.en: Have you chosen a supplier yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (采购负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadna fil-proċess ta' djalogu kompetittiv. Qed niddiskutu s-soluzzjonijiet mal-fornituri.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadna fil-proċess ta' djalogu kompetittiv. Qed niddiskutu s-soluzzjonijiet mal-fornituri.
messages.zh: 还没有，我们仍在进行竞争性对话，正在和供应商讨论解决方案。
messages.en: No, we are still in the competitive dialogue process. We are discussing the solutions with the suppliers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成“边谈方案，边作竞争选择”：djalogu 提醒你“对话”，kompetittiv 对照英语 competitive，合起来记为“竞争性对话”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A book or personal record in which someone regularly writes about daily events, experiences, and feelings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供个人经常记录日常事件、经历和感受的日记本，或其中的日记记录。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ktieb jew rekord personali li fih persuna tikteb regolarment dwar il-ġrajjiet, l-esperjenzi u s-sentimenti tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按日或经常记录个人生活、经历与感受的日记，亦指用于这种记录的本子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ktieb jew ġabra ta' kitbiet personali li fihom persuna tirreġistra minn jum għal ieħor dak li jiġrilha u dak li tħoss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A diary is a book or personal record in which you regularly write about what happens to you and how you feel.

formal.mt: Matul il-vjaġġ, l-istudenta żammet djarju li fih irreġistrat l-esperjenzi u l-osservazzjonijiet tagħha ta' kuljum.
formal.en: During the trip, the student kept a diary in which she recorded her daily experiences and observations.
formal.zh: 旅行期间，这名学生坚持写日记，记录每天的经历和观察。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tikteb daqshekk? Sara: Qed nikteb fid-djarju tiegħi. Irrid niftakar x'għamilna llum.
colloquial.en: Maya: Why are you writing so much? Sara: I am writing in my diary. I want to remember what we did today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么写了这么多？萨拉：我在写日记。我想记住我们今天做了什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么写了这么多？
messages.en: Why are you writing so much?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nikteb fid-djarju tiegħi. Irrid niftakar x'għamilna llum.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nikteb fid-djarju tiegħi. Irrid niftakar x'għamilna llum.
messages.zh: 我在写日记。我想记住我们今天做了什么。
messages.en: I am writing in my diary. I want to remember what we did today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 djarju 和英语 diary 放在同一张记忆卡上，配一幅睡前写日记的画面；用 inżomm djarju 整体记住“坚持记日记”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of the Christian Church under the authority of a bishop.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督教会中由一位主教负责管理的区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona tal-Knisja Nisranija li tkun taħt it-tmexxija ta' isqof.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由一位主教管辖、通常包含多个堂区的教会行政区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona amministrattiva tal-Knisja taħt it-tmexxija ta' isqof, li ġeneralment tinkludi għadd ta' parroċċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A diocese is the area for which a bishop is responsible within the Christian Church.

formal.mt: L-isqof tad-djoċesi stieden lir-rappreżentanti tal-parroċċi għal laqgħa dwar is-servizzi fil-komunità.
formal.en: The bishop of the diocese invited parish representatives to a meeting about community services.
formal.zh: 该教区的主教邀请各堂区代表参加一次有关社区服务的会议。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Din il-parroċċa tagħmel parti minn liema djoċesi? Toni: Mid-djoċesi tagħna. L-isqof se jżurha l-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
colloquial.en: Rita: Which diocese does this parish belong to? Tony: Our diocese. The bishop is going to visit it next week.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这个堂区属于哪个教区？托尼：属于我们教区。主教下周会来探访这个堂区。

messages.speaker: Rita (来访者)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-parroċċa tagħmel parti minn liema djoċesi?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-parroċċa tagħmel parti minn liema djoċesi?
messages.zh: 这个堂区属于哪个教区？
messages.en: Which diocese does this parish belong to?

messages.speaker: Toni (堂区志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Mid-djoċesi tagħna. L-isqof se jżurha l-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
messages.mt_standard: Mid-djoċesi tagħna. L-isqof se jżurha l-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
messages.zh: 属于我们教区。主教下周会来探访这个堂区。
messages.en: Our diocese. The bishop is going to visit it next week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 djoċesi 和英语 diocese 配对，画一个大圈包住几个堂区，并在大圈旁写“主教”；用这幅图记住教区的管辖层级。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duty to act loyally and responsibly in the interests of someone who has entrusted you with authority or responsibility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因他人托付权力或责任而承担的义务，要求忠实、负责地维护委托人的利益。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dmir li persuna taġixxi b'lealtà u b'responsabbiltà fl-interess ta' min ikun fdalha setgħa jew responsabbiltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信义义务，指受托掌握权力或承担责任的人须忠实维护委托人利益的义务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dmir ta' lealtà lejn persuna li tkun fdat lil ħaddieħor biex jaġixxi fl-interess tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fiduciary duty is a responsibility to act loyally in the interests of someone who has placed trust in you.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受托义务，指因受人信赖并接受托付而必须维护对方利益的责任。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Obbligu li jirriżulta minn relazzjoni ta' fiduċja u jitlob li min jirċievi r-responsabbiltà jħares l-interessi tal-persuna li fdatu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fiduciary obligation is an obligation arising from entrusted responsibility that requires you to protect another person's interests.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina jekk l-amministratur wettaqx id-dmir fiduċjarju tiegħu meta ħa d-deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The report examines whether the administrator fulfilled his fiduciary duty when making the decision.
formal.zh: 报告审查该管理人在作出决定时是否履行了信义义务。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'jiġifieri dmir fiduċjarju? Pawlu: Ifisser li meta xi ħadd jafdalek responsabbiltà, trid tħares l-interessi tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does fiduciary duty mean? Pawlu: It means that when someone entrusts you with a responsibility, you must protect their interests.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：信义义务是什么意思？保罗：就是别人把责任托付给你时，你必须维护对方的利益。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 信义义务是什么意思？
messages.en: What does fiduciary duty mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li meta xi ħadd jafdalek responsabbiltà, trid tħares l-interessi tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li meta xi ħadd jafdalek responsabbiltà, trid tħares l-interessi tiegħu.
messages.zh: 就是别人把责任托付给你时，你必须维护对方的利益。
messages.en: It means that when someone entrusts you with a responsibility, you must protect their interests.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词组放进“受人之托，维护其利益”的情境记忆：别人交给你责任，你就承担相应的信义义务。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In Catholic teaching, a less serious sin that weakens a person's relationship with God without destroying it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天主教教义中程度较轻的罪，会损害人与天主的关系，但不会使这种关系完全断绝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fit-tagħlim Kattoliku, dnub inqas gravi li jdgħajjef ir-relazzjoni tal-persuna ma' Alla mingħajr ma jeqridha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小罪，天主教中指损害但不完全断绝人与天主关系的较轻罪过。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dnub li, skont it-tagħlim Kattoliku, huwa inqas gravi minn dnub mejjet u ma jeqridx ir-relazzjoni tal-persuna ma' Alla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In Catholic teaching, a venial sin is a less serious sin that damages but does not destroy a person's relationship with God.

collocations.mt: id-differenza bejn dnub venjali u dnub mejjet
collocations.en: the difference between a venial sin and a mortal sin

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tal-katekiżmu tispjega d-differenza bejn dnub venjali u dnub mejjet fit-tagħlim Kattoliku.
formal.en: The catechism lesson explains the difference between a venial sin and a mortal sin in Catholic teaching.
formal.zh: 这堂教理课解释天主教教义中小罪与大罪的区别。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser dnub venjali f'dan il-ktieb? Luqa: Fit-tagħlim Kattoliku, huwa dnub inqas gravi minn dnub mejjet.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does venial sin mean in this book? Luqa: In Catholic teaching, it is a less serious sin than a mortal sin.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这本书里的“小罪”是什么意思？卢卡：在天主教教义中，它是比大罪程度轻的罪。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser dnub venjali f'dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser dnub venjali f'dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 这本书里的“小罪”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does venial sin mean in this book?

messages.speaker: Luqa (教理老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Fit-tagħlim Kattoliku, huwa dnub inqas gravi minn dnub mejjet.
messages.mt_standard: Fit-tagħlim Kattoliku, huwa dnub inqas gravi minn dnub mejjet.
messages.zh: 在天主教教义中，它是比大罪程度轻的罪。
messages.en: In Catholic teaching, it is a less serious sin than a mortal sin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用教理课上的轻重对照来记：dnub venjali 对应“小罪”，记住它是宗教中的罪过分类。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Certain that one's beliefs are right and unwilling to consider other views.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坚信自己的观点正确，不愿考虑其他意见或接受质疑的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsisti li l-fehmiet tiegħu huma tajbin u ma jkunx lest jikkunsidra fehmiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教条的；武断的；固执地认定自己的观点正确而不接受其他意见的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew atteġġjament ikun dogmatiku meta ma jaċċettax dubji jew fehmiet differenti u jqis opinjoni bħala verità żgura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is dogmatic expresses opinions as unquestionable truths and is unwilling to consider different views.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, ir-riċerkatriċi wissiet li approċċ dogmatiku jista' jfixkel diskussjoni miftuħa dwar ir-riżultati.
formal.en: In her report, the researcher warned that a dogmatic approach could hinder an open discussion of the results.
formal.zh: 研究人员在报告中提醒，教条式的处理方式可能妨碍对研究结果进行开放讨论。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għaliex ma tridx tisma' l-idea ta' Marija? Mark: Forsi qed inkun dogmatiku wisq. Ħa nismagħha qabel niddeċiedi.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Why don't you want to hear Marija's idea? Mark: Perhaps I'm being too dogmatic. Let me hear her out before I decide.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你为什么不愿听听玛丽亚的想法？马克：也许我太武断了。让我先听她说完再决定。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx tisma' l-idea ta' Marija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx tisma' l-idea ta' Marija?
messages.zh: 你为什么不愿听听玛丽亚的想法？
messages.en: Why don't you want to hear Marija's idea?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi qed inkun dogmatiku wisq. Ħa nismagħha qabel niddeċiedi.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi qed inkun dogmatiku wisq. Ħa nismagħha qabel niddeċiedi.
messages.zh: 也许我太武断了。让我先听她说完再决定。
messages.en: Perhaps I'm being too dogmatic. Let me hear her out before I decide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dogmatiku 配上一幅“捂住耳朵，坚持自己永远正确”的画面，记住它描述教条、武断的态度。

gloss_zh: 船坞；供船舶停泊、装卸或修理的港口设施

teaching_sense.en_definition: A harbour facility where ships berth for loading, unloading, or repairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 港口中供船舶停泊、装卸货物或进行修理的设施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Faċilità f'port fejn il-vapuri jidħlu jew jintrabtu biex jitgħabbew, jinħattu jew jissewwew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船坞；港口内供船舶停靠、装卸或维修的设施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokk huwa faċilità f'port li tintuża biex vapur jieqaf għat-tagħbija, għall-ħatt jew għat-tiswija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dock is a harbour facility where ships stay while cargo is handled or repairs are carried out.

formal.mt: Il-vapur daħal fid-dokk niexef sabiex it-tekniċi jkunu jistgħu jispezzjonaw u jsewwu l-parti ta' taħt tiegħu.
formal.en: The ship entered the dry dock so that technicians could inspect and repair its underside.
formal.zh: 船舶驶入干船坞，以便技术人员检查并修理船底。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hu l-vapur illum? Toni: Qiegħed fid-dokk għat-tiswija. Għandu jerġa' joħroġ il-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is the ship today? Toni: It's in the dock for repairs. It should be back out next week.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：那艘船今天在哪里？托尼：在船坞里维修，应该下周就能出来。

messages.speaker: Marija (游客)
messages.zh: 那艘船今天在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the ship today?

messages.speaker: Toni (港口工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed fid-dokk għat-tiswija. Għandu jerġa' joħroġ il-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed fid-dokk għat-tiswija. Għandu jerġa' joħroġ il-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
messages.zh: 在船坞里维修，应该下周就能出来。
messages.en: It's in the dock for repairs. It should be back out next week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一艘大船进入标着 dokk 的船坞，停下来装货或维修；用“大船的停靠维修处”记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large bench with room for several people to sit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供数人并排坐下的大型长凳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bank kbir li fuqu jistgħu joqogħdu bilqiegħda diversi persuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大型长凳；可供数人同坐的宽大长座。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokkiena hija bank kbir li joffri biżżejjed spazju biex diversi persuni joqogħdu bilqiegħda ħdejn xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A large bench is a long seat that provides enough space for several people to sit together.

collocations.en: to sit on the large bench

formal.mt: Fil-bitħa tqiegħdet dokkiena tal-ġebel biex il-viżitaturi jkunu jistgħu joqogħdu bilqiegħda u jistrieħu.
formal.en: A large stone bench was placed in the courtyard so that visitors could sit down and rest.
formal.zh: 庭院里安放了一张大型石制长凳，供访客坐下休息。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn se noqogħdu nistennew? Luqa: Ejja noqogħdu fuq id-dokkiena ħdejn il-bieb. Hemm post għalina t-tnejn.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where shall we sit while we wait? Luqa: Let's sit on the large bench beside the door. There's room for both of us.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们坐在哪里等呢？卢卡：坐在门旁那张大长凳上吧，我们两个人都坐得下。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们坐在哪里等呢？
messages.en: Where shall we sit while we wait?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu fuq id-dokkiena ħdejn il-bieb. Hemm post għalina t-tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu fuq id-dokkiena ħdejn il-bieb. Hemm post għalina t-tnejn.
messages.zh: 坐在门旁那张大长凳上吧，我们两个人都坐得下。
messages.en: Let's sit on the large bench beside the door. There's room for both of us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给一张能并排坐下好几个人的大长凳贴上 dokkiena 标签，用“大家一起坐”的画面记住它。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A written or electronic record containing information, often for an official purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 载有信息的书面或电子记录，常用于正式事务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kitba fuq karta jew f'forma elettronika li fiha informazzjoni, spiss għal skop uffiċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文件；记录信息的纸质或电子文书，常用于证明、说明或办理事务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument huwa kitba fuq karta jew f'forma elettronika li tirreġistra informazzjoni u tista' tintuża bħala prova jew għal skop uffiċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A document is a written or electronic record that contains information and may serve an official purpose.

formal.mt: L-applikant għandu jaqra d-dokument bir-reqqa u jiffirmah qabel ma jibagħtu lill-uffiċċju responsabbli.
formal.en: The applicant must read the document carefully and sign it before sending it to the responsible office.
formal.zh: 申请人须仔细阅读文件并签字，然后将其发送给负责办理的办公室。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ġibt id-dokument li għandna bżonn? Mark: Iva, qiegħed fil-basket. Trid tara l-oriġinal jew kopja?
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you bring the document we need? Mark: Yes, it's in the bag. Do you want to see the original or a copy?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们需要的那份文件，你带来了吗？马克：带来了，在包里。你要看原件还是副本？

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 我们需要的那份文件，你带来了吗？
messages.en: Did you bring the document we need?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fil-basket. Trid tara l-oriġinal jew kopja?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fil-basket. Trid tara l-oriġinal jew kopja?
messages.zh: 带来了，在包里。你要看原件还是副本？
messages.en: Yes, it's in the bag. Do you want to see the original or a copy?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dokument 与英语 document 对照记忆，再想象一份等待签字的文件，把拼写和实际使用场景连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A document sent or provided together with an item or another document to give related information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随物品或另一份文件一同提供、用于说明相关信息的文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument li jintbagħat jew jingħata flimkien ma' oġġett jew dokument ieħor biex jipprovdi informazzjoni relatata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与物品、货件或其他文件一同交付的说明性或相关文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li jakkumpanja oġġett, kunsinna jew dokument ieħor u jagħti informazzjoni dwaru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An accompanying document is supplied with something else and provides information connected with it.

formal.mt: Id-dokument ta' akkumpanjament jinkludi deskrizzjoni tal-oġġetti li jinsabu fil-pakkett.
formal.en: The accompanying document includes a description of the items in the package.
formal.zh: 随附文件中列有包裹内物品的说明。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hemm dokument ta' akkumpanjament mal-pakkett? Pawlu: Iva, qiegħed ġewwa l-kaxxa, fuq l-oġġetti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is there an accompanying document with the package? Pawlu: Yes, it is inside the box, on top of the items.
colloquial.zh: Lara：包裹有随附文件吗？Pawlu：有，在箱子里面，放在物品上面。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 包裹有随附文件吗？
messages.en: Is there an accompanying document with the package?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed ġewwa l-kaxxa, fuq l-oġġetti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed ġewwa l-kaxxa, fuq l-oġġetti.
messages.zh: 有，在箱子里面，放在物品上面。
messages.en: Yes, it is inside the box, on top of the items.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把文件想成陪着包裹一起到达的说明纸：看到 dokument ta' akkumpanjament，就联想“随物同行的文件”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A document that provides instructions or records details about the installation of equipment or software.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供设备或软件安装说明，或记录安装相关细节的文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument li jagħti struzzjonijiet jew jirreġistra dettalji dwar l-installazzjoni ta' tagħmir jew softwer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于说明安装方法或记录安装过程、设置及相关信息的文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li jispjega kif issir installazzjoni jew jirreġistra l-proċess, is-settings u informazzjoni oħra relatata magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An installation document explains how something is installed or records information about its installation.

formal.mt: Id-dokument tal-installazzjoni jiddeskrivi l-passi biex it-tagħmir jitqabbad u jiġi kkonfigurat.
formal.en: The installation document describes the steps for connecting and configuring the equipment.
formal.zh: 安装文件说明了连接和配置设备的步骤。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu d-dokument tal-installazzjoni? Għandi bżonn nara kif jitqabbad dan l-apparat. David: Qiegħed ħdejn il-kaxxa. Ejja narawh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the installation document? I need to see how to connect this device. David: It is next to the box. Let's look at it together.
colloquial.zh: Nina：安装文件在哪里？我得看看这个设备怎么连接。David：在箱子旁边。我们一起看看吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu d-dokument tal-installazzjoni? Għandi bżonn nara kif jitqabbad dan l-apparat.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu d-dokument tal-installazzjoni? Għandi bżonn nara kif jitqabbad dan l-apparat.
messages.zh: 安装文件在哪里？我得看看这个设备怎么连接。
messages.en: Where is the installation document? I need to see how to connect this device.

messages.speaker: David (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed ħdejn il-kaxxa. Ejja narawh flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed ħdejn il-kaxxa. Ejja narawh flimkien.
messages.zh: 在箱子旁边。我们一起看看吧。
messages.en: It is next to the box. Let's look at it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“拆箱、接线、看文件”连成一个画面；installazzjoni 对应“安装”，dokument tal-installazzjoni 就是安装时查阅的文件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A document that records information about goods being carried and the arrangements for their transport.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 记录所运货物及其运输安排等信息的单据或文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument li jirreġistra informazzjoni dwar merkanzija li tkun qed tinġarr u dwar l-arranġamenti għat-trasport tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 载有货物承运事项及相关信息的运输单据。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li jkun fih dettalji dwar il-ġarr ta' merkanzija u l-arranġamenti marbuta miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A carriage document records details relating to the carriage of goods from one place to another.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 记载货物运输情况、运输安排或相关资料的文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li jagħti informazzjoni dwar il-merkanzija ttrasportata, il-vjaġġ tagħha jew l-arranġamenti għat-trasport.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A transport document provides information about a shipment and the arrangements for moving it.

formal.mt: Id-dokument tat-trasport jindika d-destinazzjoni tal-merkanzija u n-numru ta' pakketti fil-kunsinna.
formal.en: The transport document states the destination of the goods and the number of packages in the shipment.
formal.zh: 运输单据载明货物的目的地及该批货物的包件数量。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek id-dokument tat-trasport? Irrid niċċekkja kemm hemm kaxxi. Toni: Iva, hawn hu. Fuqu hemm miktub li huma għaxra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have the transport document? I want to check how many boxes there are. Toni: Yes, here it is. It says there are ten.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你有运输单据吗？我想核对一下有多少箱。Toni：有，在这里。上面写着十箱。

messages.speaker: Sara (仓库管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek id-dokument tat-trasport? Irrid niċċekkja kemm hemm kaxxi.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek id-dokument tat-trasport? Irrid niċċekkja kemm hemm kaxxi.
messages.zh: 你有运输单据吗？我想核对一下有多少箱。
messages.en: Do you have the transport document? I want to check how many boxes there are.

messages.speaker: Toni (送货司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn hu. Fuqu hemm miktub li huma għaxra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn hu. Fuqu hemm miktub li huma għaxra.
messages.zh: 有，在这里。上面写着十箱。
messages.en: Yes, here it is. It says there are ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象收货时拿着单据核对箱数和目的地；trasport 提示“运输”，把 dokument tat-trasport 连同“运输单据”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 单一文件；一份整合文件

teaching_sense.en_definition: One document that contains the relevant information together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将相关信息集中在一起的一份文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument wieħed li jiġbor fih l-informazzjoni rilevanti kollha flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 单一文件，即集中承载相关内容的一份文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument wieħed li fih tinġabar l-informazzjoni meħtieġa, minflok ma tkun mifruxa fuq diversi dokumenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A single document brings the relevant information together in one document.

collocations.en: to collect the information in a single document
collocations.zh: 将信息汇集在一份文件中

formal.mt: L-applikant għandu jiġbor id-dettalji kollha tal-proġett f'dokument uniku u jibagħtu lill-kumitat.
formal.en: The applicant must collect all the project details in a single document and send it to the committee.
formal.zh: 申请人须将项目的全部细节汇集在一份文件中，并发送给委员会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nibgħatlek il-lista u n-noti separatament? Mark: Le, poġġi kollox f'dokument uniku, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall I send you the list and the notes separately? Mark: No, put everything in a single document, please.
colloquial.zh: Maja：清单和笔记要分开发给你吗？Mark：不用，请把所有内容放在一份文件里。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 清单和笔记要分开发给你吗？
messages.en: Shall I send you the list and the notes separately?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, poġġi kollox f'dokument uniku, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Le, poġġi kollox f'dokument uniku, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 不用，请把所有内容放在一份文件里。
messages.en: No, put everything in a single document, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把桌上散开的清单和笔记装进同一个文件：这里整个词组表示“一份整合文件”，学习时把它和“将内容集中在一起”的动作配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The written documents that contain or explain the terms and details of a contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 载明或说明合同条款、约定及相关细节的一组书面文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dokumenti bil-miktub li jkun fihom jew jispjegaw il-kundizzjonijiet u d-dettalji ta' kuntratt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 载有合同条款及相关约定的文件，或构成合同内容的一组文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokumenti li jkun fihom il-kundizzjonijiet u l-ftehimiet marbuta ma' kuntratt jew li jiffurmaw parti minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Contract documents are the written records that set out the terms of a contract or form part of the agreement.

collocations.en: a copy of the contract documents

formal.mt: Qabel ma jiffirmaw, iż-żewġ partijiet għandhom jaqraw id-dokumenti tal-kuntratt bir-reqqa.
formal.en: Before signing, both parties should read the contract documents carefully.
formal.zh: 签署前，双方应仔细阅读合同文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ġibt id-dokumenti tal-kuntratt? Mark: Iva, qegħdin fil-fajl blu. Nistgħu naqrawhom flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you bring the contract documents? Mark: Yes, they are in the blue folder. We can read them together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你带合同文件了吗？Mark：带了，在蓝色文件夹里。我们可以一起看。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你带合同文件了吗？
messages.en: Did you bring the contract documents?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qegħdin fil-fajl blu. Nistgħu naqrawhom flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qegħdin fil-fajl blu. Nistgħu naqrawhom flimkien.
messages.zh: 带了，在蓝色文件夹里。我们可以一起看。
messages.en: Yes, they are in the blue folder. We can read them together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象签约前打开一整套文件：dokumenti 是复数“文件”，tal-kuntratt 提示“合同的”，合起来记作“合同文件”。

gloss_zh: 元（名为 dollar 的货币单位）；美元等

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit of money called a dollar, used in several countries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 若干国家使用的、英语称为 dollar 的货币单位，具体所指取决于国家或语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità monetarja li tintuża f'diversi pajjiżi u li l-valur tagħha jiddependi mill-munita tal-pajjiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 元：若干国家使用的货币单位，可按语境指美元、加元、澳元等。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Unità ta' flus użata f'diversi pajjiżi, fosthom l-Istati Uniti, il-Kanada u l-Awstralja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dollar is a unit of money used in several countries, including the United States.

formal.mt: Il-prezz ta' kull karta postali huwa ta' dollaru Amerikan wieħed, u l-ħlas isir mal-ordni.
formal.en: Each postcard costs one US dollar, and payment is made when the order is placed.
formal.zh: 每张明信片的价格为一美元，下单时付款。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm tiswa din il-karta postali? Rita: Dollaru wieħed. Mark: Tajjeb, nieħu waħda.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much is this postcard? Rita: One dollar. Mark: All right, I'll take one.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这张明信片多少钱？Rita：一元。Mark：好，我买一张。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这张明信片多少钱？
messages.en: How much is this postcard?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 一元。
messages.en: One dollar.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 好，我买一张。
messages.en: All right, I'll take one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dollaru 和英语 dollar 对照记忆，再配上“一张标价一元的明信片”。遇到这个词先想到货币单位，再根据国家名称判断是哪一种元。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shop that sells sweets, cakes, and other sweet foods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出售糖果、蛋糕及其他甜食的商店。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanut li jbigħ ħelu, kejkijiet u prodotti ħelwin oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 糖果糕点店，出售糖果、蛋糕等甜食的商店。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħanut fejn jinbiegħu prodotti ħelwin bħal ħelu, kejkijiet u pasti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A confectionery is a shop where sweets, cakes, and similar sweet foods are sold.

collocations.en: to buy a cake from a confectionery
a confectionery known for its pastries
collocations.zh: 一家以糕点闻名的甜食店

formal.mt: Id-dolċerija ħejjiet kejk kbir u għażla ta' pasti għaċ-ċelebrazzjoni tal-iskola.
formal.en: The confectionery prepared a large cake and a selection of pastries for the school celebration.
formal.zh: 这家糖果糕点店为学校庆典准备了一个大蛋糕和多款糕点。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn nixtru kejk għal għeluq snin ommi? Pawlu: Hemm dolċerija ħdejn il-pjazza. Immorru naraw x'għandhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we buy a cake for my mother's birthday? Pawlu: There's a confectionery near the square. Let's go and see what they have.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们去哪儿买蛋糕给我妈妈过生日？Pawlu：广场附近有一家糖果糕点店。我们去看看他们有什么吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn nixtru kejk għal għeluq snin ommi?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn nixtru kejk għal għeluq snin ommi?
messages.zh: 我们去哪儿买蛋糕给我妈妈过生日？
messages.en: Where shall we buy a cake for my mother's birthday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm dolċerija ħdejn il-pjazza. Immorru naraw x'għandhom.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm dolċerija ħdejn il-pjazza. Immorru naraw x'għandhom.
messages.zh: 广场附近有一家糖果糕点店。我们去看看他们有什么吧。
messages.en: There's a confectionery near the square. Let's go and see what they have.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“生日买蛋糕”的画面绑定：走进摆满糖果、蛋糕和糕点的小店，看到柜台就回想 dolċerija，记住它指甜食店。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The amount of a product or service that people want and are willing to buy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们想要并愿意购买的商品或服务的数量，即市场需求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwantità ta' prodott jew servizz li n-nies iridu u jkunu lesti li jixtru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 需求，指消费者想要并愿意购买某种商品或服务的数量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwantità ta' prodott jew servizz li l-konsumaturi jixtiequ u jkunu lesti li jixtru bi prezz partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Demand is the amount of a product or service that people want and are willing to buy.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电力需求，指用户在特定时刻所需的电功率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ammont ta' qawwa elettrika li l-utenti jkollhom bżonn f'ħin partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Electric demand is the amount of electrical power that users require at a particular time.

collocations.zh: 对某种产品的旺盛需求

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza d-domanda għall-prodotti tal-kumpanija u, f'taqsima separata, id-domanda għall-elettriku fil-fabbrika matul il-ġurnata.
formal.en: The report analyses demand for the company's products and, in a separate section, electricity demand at the factory throughout the day.
formal.zh: 报告分析了市场对该公司产品的需求，并在另一个章节中分析了工厂一天内的电力需求。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-ħanut ordna aktar fannijiet? Toni: Għax hemm domanda kbira għalihom f'din is-sħana. Sara: U meta kulħadd jixgħel il-fannijiet, tiżdied ukoll id-domanda għall-elettriku.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the shop order more fans? Toni: Because there's strong demand for them in this heat. Sara: And when everyone switches on their fans, electricity demand increases too.
colloquial.zh: Sara：商店为什么又订了更多风扇？Toni：因为天气这么热，大家对风扇的需求很大。Sara：而且大家都打开风扇时，电力需求也会增加。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 商店为什么又订了更多风扇？
messages.en: Why did the shop order more fans?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hemm domanda kbira għalihom f'din is-sħana.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hemm domanda kbira għalihom f'din is-sħana.
messages.zh: 因为天气这么热，大家对风扇的需求很大。
messages.en: Because there's strong demand for them in this heat.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: U meta kulħadd jixgħel il-fannijiet, tiżdied ukoll id-domanda għall-elettriku.
messages.mt_standard: U meta kulħadd jixgħel il-fannijiet, tiżdied ukoll id-domanda għall-elettriku.
messages.zh: 而且大家都打开风扇时，电力需求也会增加。
messages.en: And when everyone switches on their fans, electricity demand increases too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用炎热天气串联两个义项：人们抢着买风扇，是商品需求；大家同时开风扇，是电力需求。看到 domanda，就先问“需要的是什么”，再由搭配判断具体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A domain is an area of activity or control; dominance is the position of having greater power or influence than others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指某种活动或控制所涉及的领域，也可指比其他人或事物更有权力、影响力的支配地位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dominju jista' jkun qasam ta' attività jew kontroll, jew il-pożizzjoni ta' min għandu aktar setgħa jew influwenza minn oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某种活动、知识或控制所涉及的领域或范围；在互联网语境中也可指域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dominju huwa qasam jew ambitu partikolari ta' attività, għarfien jew kontroll; fl-internet jista' jirreferi għal dominju identifikat b'isem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A domain is a particular area of activity, knowledge, or control, and can also be an identifiable area of the internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在力量、权力或影响力方面超过其他人或事物的支配地位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dominju huwa l-pożizzjoni ta' persuna, grupp jew ħaġa li għandha aktar saħħa, setgħa jew influwenza minn oħrajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dominance is the position of having more power, strength, or influence than others.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina d-dominju tal-kumpanija fis-suq lokali u l-influwenza tagħha fuq il-prezzijiet.
formal.en: The report examines the company's dominance in the local market and its influence on prices.
formal.zh: 该报告考察了这家公司在本地市场的支配地位及其对价格的影响。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għażilt isem ta' dominju għas-sit il-ġdid? Mark: Iva, għażilt isem qasir biex in-nies jiftakruh faċilment.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you chosen a domain name for the new website? Mark: Yes, I chose a short name so people can remember it easily.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你给新网站选好域名了吗？马克：选好了，我选了一个简短的名字，方便大家记住。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għażilt isem ta' dominju għas-sit il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Għażilt isem ta' dominju għas-sit il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 你给新网站选好域名了吗？
messages.en: Have you chosen a domain name for the new website?

messages.speaker: Mark (网站负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għażilt isem qasir biex in-nies jiftakruh faċilment.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għażilt isem qasir biex in-nies jiftakruh faċilment.
messages.zh: 选好了，我选了一个简短的名字，方便大家记住。
messages.en: Yes, I chose a short name so people can remember it easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分别记义：网站地址对应“域”，市场中占据优势的公司对应“支配地位”；根据搭配判断 dominju 的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A domicile is the place where a person has their permanent home.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一个人作为长期生活基地的固定住所，常用于正式或行政语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-domiċilju huwa l-post fejn persuna għandha d-dar permanenti tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个人长期居住并视为固定生活基地的住所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-domiċilju huwa l-post fejn persuna tgħix b'mod permanenti u li tqisu bħala d-dar tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your domicile is the place where you have your permanent home.

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok ikteb l-indirizz sħiħ tad-domiċilju tiegħek fil-formola.
formal.en: Please enter the full address of your domicile on the form.
formal.zh: 请在表格中填写您固定住所的完整地址。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għandi nikteb fejn hemm 'domiċilju'? Pawlu: Ikteb l-indirizz tad-dar fejn tgħix b'mod permanenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What should I write where it says 'domicile'? Pawlu: Write the address of the home where you live permanently.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：写着“固定住所”的地方该填什么？保罗：填你长期居住的家的地址。

messages.speaker: Maja (申请人)
messages.zh: 写着“固定住所”的地方该填什么？
messages.en: What should I write where it says 'domicile'?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikteb l-indirizz tad-dar fejn tgħix b'mod permanenti.
messages.mt_standard: Ikteb l-indirizz tad-dar fejn tgħix b'mod permanenti.
messages.zh: 填你长期居住的家的地址。
messages.en: Write the address of the home where you live permanently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进填写住址的画面里记忆：想到表格上的长期家庭地址，就想到 domiċilju。

gloss_zh: 易于正确使用的；不易因操作失误而出错的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something foolproof is so simple or carefully designed that people can use it successfully without making mistakes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容方法、说明或装置简单易懂、设计周全，使人容易正确使用而不出错。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li hija faċli ħafna biex tintuża jew imfassla b'tali mod li wieħed jista' jużaha tajjeb mingħajr ma jiżbalja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简单可靠、容易正确操作的；设计得能避免使用者犯错的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Faċli biex jinftiehem jew jintuża u mfassal b'mod li jipprevjeni żbalji waqt l-użu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a method or device is foolproof, it is designed to be used successfully with very little risk of mistakes.

collocations.mt: metodu sempliċi li ma jħallix lok għal żbalji
collocations.zh: 简单可靠、不易出错的方法

collocations.mt: struzzjonijiet ċari li ma jħallux lok għal żbalji
collocations.zh: 清楚易懂、不易照做出错的说明

formal.mt: Il-gwida tippreżenta metodu sempliċi li ma jħallix lok għal żbalji, b'passi ċari u stampi għal kull stadju.
formal.en: The guide presents a foolproof method, with clear steps and pictures for every stage.
formal.zh: 这份指南介绍了一种简单可靠、不易出错的方法，每个阶段都有清晰的步骤和配图。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din ir-riċetta faċli għal min għadu jibda? Nina: Iva, jekk timxi mal-passi, ma tistax tiżbalja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this recipe easy for a beginner? Nina: Yes, it's foolproof if you follow the steps.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这份食谱适合新手吗？妮娜：适合，照着步骤做就不容易出错。

messages.speaker: Lara (烹饪新手)
messages.mt_spoken: Din ir-riċetta faċli għal min għadu jibda?
messages.mt_standard: Din ir-riċetta faċli għal min għadu jibda?
messages.zh: 这份食谱适合新手吗？
messages.en: Is this recipe easy for a beginner?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk timxi mal-passi, ma tistax tiżbalja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk timxi mal-passi, ma tistax tiżbalja.
messages.zh: 适合，照着步骤做就不容易出错。
messages.en: Yes, it's foolproof if you follow the steps.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 foolproof 的使用画面：新手照着清楚步骤也能成功；马耳他语可用“不留出错余地”的表达帮助理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Double means twice the usual or stated amount, number, or size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示数量、数目或大小是通常值或所述基准的两倍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Doppju jfisser darbtejn l-ammont, in-numru jew id-daqs tas-soltu jew ta' dak li jkun issemma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 双倍的或两倍的数量、数目、大小；具体所指由比较的基准决定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Doppju jindika ammont, numru jew daqs li huwa darbtejn dak li jintuża bħala bażi ta' tqabbil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an amount or size is double another, it is twice as great as that amount or size.

formal.mt: Din is-sena l-għadd ta' parteċipanti laħaq id-doppju ta' dak tas-sena l-oħra, minn ħamsin għal mija.
formal.en: This year the number of participants reached double last year's figure, rising from fifty to one hundred.
formal.zh: 今年的参加人数达到去年的两倍，从五十人增加到一百人。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nieħu porzjon doppju tar-ross? Rita: Żgur, inżidlek porzjon ieħor.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I have a double portion of rice? Rita: Of course, I'll add another portion for you.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我可以要双份米饭吗？丽塔：当然，我再给你加一份。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 我可以要双份米饭吗？
messages.en: Can I have a double portion of rice?

messages.speaker: Rita (服务员)
messages.zh: 当然，我再给你加一份。
messages.en: Of course, I'll add another portion for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一份变两份，五十变一百”记住 doppju：先找比较基准，再把基准乘以二。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A structure in which a colony of bees lives.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供一群蜜蜂共同生活的巢或蜂箱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura li fiha tgħix kolonja ta' naħal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜂群居住的蜂巢或蜂箱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Doqqajs huwa struttura li fiha jgħixu n-naħal flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A beehive is a structure where a colony of bees lives together.

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara edukattiva, l-istudenti osservaw doqqajs minn distanza sigura.
formal.en: During the educational visit, the students observed a beehive from a safe distance.
formal.zh: 在教学参观期间，学生们从安全距离观察了一个蜂巢。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm hemm naħal ħdejn dak id-doqqajs! Pawlu: Iva, ejja nibqgħu ftit 'il bogħod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how many bees there are beside that beehive! Pawlu: Yes, let's stay a little way back.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，那个蜂巢旁边有好多蜜蜂！保罗：是啊，我们离远一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hemm naħal ħdejn dak id-doqqajs!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hemm naħal ħdejn dak id-doqqajs!
messages.zh: 看，那个蜂巢旁边有好多蜜蜂！
messages.en: Look how many bees there are beside that beehive!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们离远一点吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's stay a little way back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 doqqajs 和一群蜜蜂共同居住的画面配对，再用 ħdejn id-doqqajs 练习表达“在蜂巢旁边”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A room containing beds where several people sleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设有多张床、供多人共同睡觉的寝室。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra b'diversi sodod fejn jorqdu diversi persuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供多人住宿和睡觉的集体寝室。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dormitorju huwa kamra maħsuba biex diversi persuni jorqdu fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dormitory is a room where several people sleep in separate beds.

formal.mt: Id-dormitorju għandu għaxar sodod u jintuża mill-istudenti waqt il-kamp.
formal.en: The dormitory has ten beds and is used by the students during the camp.
formal.zh: 这间集体寝室有十张床，供学生们在营地活动期间使用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: F'liema dormitorju se torqod? Nina: F'dak ta' fuq, ħdejn it-taraġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which dormitory will you sleep in? Nina: The one upstairs, beside the stairs.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你要住哪间集体寝室？妮娜：楼上靠近楼梯的那间。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你要住哪间集体寝室？
messages.en: Which dormitory will you sleep in?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 楼上靠近楼梯的那间。
messages.en: The one upstairs, beside the stairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 dormitorju 时想象一间摆着多张床的集体寝室，把“多人一起住宿”的场景与这个词绑定。

gloss_zh: 词义未明确；所给释义为“是什么意思？”

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning is not specified in the supplied gloss, which asks what it means.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条标注为名词，但所给释义只是“是什么意思？”这一提问，未明确提供具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din il-kelma hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda l-glossa mogħtija tistaqsi xi tfisser u ma tagħtix tifsira speċifika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: “是什么意思？”；这是询问词义的问题，未给出该名词的实际含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-frażi mogħtija hija mistoqsija dwar it-tifsira tal-kelma u mhijiex definizzjoni tan-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss asks what the word means without defining the noun itself.

formal.mt: Il-glossa tal-kelma dossologija fiha l-mistoqsija "Xi tfisser", iżda ma tipprovdix definizzjoni.
formal.en: The gloss for the word dossologija contains the question "What does it mean", but does not provide a definition.
formal.zh: dossologija 的释义栏中写着“是什么意思”这一问题，但没有提供定义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser il-kelma dossologija? Mark: Din in-nota ma tagħtix it-tifsira; fiha biss mistoqsija.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the word dossologija mean? Mark: This note does not give the meaning; it only contains a question.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：dossologija 这个词是什么意思？马克：这条笔记没有给出词义，里面只有一个问题。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: dossologija 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word dossologija mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Din in-nota ma tagħtix it-tifsira; fiha biss mistoqsija.
messages.mt_standard: Din in-nota ma tagħtix it-tifsira; fiha biss mistoqsija.
messages.zh: 这条笔记没有给出词义，里面只有一个问题。
messages.en: This note does not give the meaning; it only contains a question.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dossologija 暂贴“词义待明确”的学习标签；Xi tfisser 是“是什么意思”的提问，不能当作这个名词的含义来背。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money or property that a bride brings to a marriage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 新娘结婚时带入婚姻的金钱或财产。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flus jew ġid li l-għarusa ġġib magħha meta tiżżewweġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嫁妆，指新娘在结婚时带来的钱财或其他财产。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dota hija flus jew proprjetà li l-għarusa ġġib magħha fiż-żwieġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dowry is money or property that a bride brings with her when she marries.

formal.mt: Id-dokument jelenka l-flus u l-proprjetà li kienu jiffurmaw id-dota tal-għarusa.
formal.en: The document lists the money and property that formed the bride's dowry.
formal.zh: 这份文件列出了构成新娘嫁妆的金钱和财产。

colloquial.mt: Anna: F'din l-istorja, x'kienet tinkludi d-dota? Rita: Kienet tinkludi xi flus u dar żgħira.
colloquial.en: Anna: In this story, what did the dowry include? Rita: It included some money and a small house.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个故事里的嫁妆包括什么？丽塔：包括一些钱和一栋小房子。

messages.speaker: Anna (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的嫁妆包括什么？
messages.en: In this story, what did the dowry include?

messages.speaker: Rita (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet tinkludi xi flus u dar żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet tinkludi xi flus u dar żgħira.
messages.zh: 包括一些钱和一栋小房子。
messages.en: It included some money and a small house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dota 放进“新娘带着钱财成婚”的故事画面中，并连着 id-dota tal-għarusa 一起记成“新娘的嫁妆”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of a river farther along in the direction in which its water flows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 河流沿水流方向较靠后的河段或区域，即下游。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' xmara li tinsab aktar 'il quddiem fid-direzzjoni tal-fluss tal-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 河流沿水流方向较靠后的下游河段或区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti t'isfel ta' xmara, li lejha jkompli miexi l-ilma minn punt partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The downstream of a river is the section farther along in the direction of its flow.

collocations.en: the downstream section of the river

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqabbel il-kwalità tal-ilma fid-downstream tax-xmara ma' dik qrib is-sors.
formal.en: The report compares water quality in the downstream section of the river with that near its source.
formal.zh: 报告比较了河流下游河段与源头附近的水质。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niġbru l-kampjuni tal-ilma? Pawlu: Fid-downstream tax-xmara, wara l-pont.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are we going to collect the water samples? Pawlu: In the downstream section of the river, past the bridge.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们要在哪里采集水样？保罗：在河流下游，过了桥的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 我们要在哪里采集水样？
messages.en: Where are we going to collect the water samples?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 在河流下游，过了桥的地方。
messages.en: In the downstream section of the river, past the bridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一片树叶顺水漂走，它继续漂向的河段就是下游；本条按名词记作下游区域。

gloss_zh: 温顺的；顺从的；易于管教的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Quiet, willing to follow instructions, and easy to manage or train.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 性情温和，愿意听从指示，容易管理或训练的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu mġiba kalma, jaċċetta l-gwida u jkun faċli biex wieħed imexxih jew iħarrġu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 温顺而愿意听从引导的；容易管理或训练的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun kalm u ubbidjenti, jaċċetta l-istruzzjonijiet u ma jkunx diffiċli biex wieħed imexxih jew iħarrġu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or animal that is docile is quiet, willing to follow instructions, and easy to manage.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ż-żiemel bħala doċli u faċli biex jitħarreġ.
formal.en: The report describes the horse as docile and easy to train.
formal.zh: 报告将这匹马描述为性情温顺、易于训练。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kelb tiegħek doċli? Ninu: Iva, joqgħod bilqiegħda meta ngħidlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your dog docile? Ninu: Yes, he sits down when I tell him to.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的狗温顺听话吗？尼努：是的，我叫它坐下，它就坐下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的狗温顺听话吗？
messages.en: Is your dog docile?

messages.speaker: Ninu (狗主人)
messages.zh: 是的，我叫它坐下，它就坐下。
messages.en: Yes, he sits down when I tell him to.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只听到“坐下”就安静坐好的狗，用 kelb doċli 这幅画面记住“温顺、听从引导”的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of washing your body under a spray of water, or the equipment used for this.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让喷出的水流淋在身上以清洗身体的洗浴方式，也指用于这种洗浴的设备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħasil tal-ġisem taħt ilma li joħroġ minn ras b'toqob żgħar, jew l-apparat li jintuża għal dan il-ħasil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淋浴，指在喷洒的水流下洗身体，也指提供这种水流的洗浴设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mod kif wieħed jaħsel ġismu taħt ilma li jinżel minn ras b'toqob żgħar, kif ukoll l-apparat użat għal dan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shower is a way of washing your body under a spray of water, or the equipment that produces the spray.

formal.mt: Kull kamra tal-lukanda għandha kamra tal-banju privata b'doċċa.
formal.en: Each hotel room has a private bathroom with a shower.
formal.zh: 酒店每间客房都设有带淋浴设备的独立浴室。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se nieħu doċċa qabel noħorġu. Mark: Tajjeb, nistenniek fil-kċina.
colloquial.en: Nina: I'll take a shower before we go out. Mark: Okay, I'll wait for you in the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：出门前我要先洗个淋浴。马克：好，我在厨房等你。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 出门前我要先洗个淋浴。
messages.en: I'll take a shower before we go out.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我在厨房等你。
messages.en: Okay, I'll wait for you in the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象运动后站到喷头下冲水，把 doċċa 与“淋浴”画面绑定，再整块记住 nieħu doċċa 表示“我洗淋浴”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A measured amount of medicine or another substance taken or given at one time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次服用或给予的药物或其他物质的规定用量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwantità mkejla ta' mediċina jew ta' sustanza oħra li tittieħed jew tingħata f'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次服用或给予的药物等物质的剂量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ammont ta' mediċina jew sustanza oħra maħsub biex jittieħed jew jingħata darba waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dose is a measured quantity of a medicine or other substance that is taken or administered at one time.

formal.mt: L-infermier irreġistra d-doża tal-mediċina li ngħatat lill-pazjent.
formal.en: The nurse recorded the dose of medicine administered to the patient.
formal.zh: 护士记录了给予患者的药物剂量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħadt id-doża ta' dalgħodu? Pawlu: Iva, u ktibt il-ħin biex niftakar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you taken this morning's dose? Pawlu: Yes, and I wrote down the time so I can remember.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你服过今天早上的那剂药了吗？保罗：服过了，我还记下了时间，方便记住。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 你服过今天早上的那剂药了吗？
messages.en: Have you taken this morning's dose?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ktibt il-ħin biex niftakar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ktibt il-ħin biex niftakar.
messages.zh: 服过了，我还记下了时间，方便记住。
messages.en: Yes, and I wrote down the time so I can remember.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 doża 和药杯上的刻度联系起来：刻度量出一次用多少，记住它表示剂量。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An insect with a long slender body and two pairs of transparent wings, often seen near water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种身体细长、有两对透明翅膀、常在水边活动的昆虫，即蜻蜓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett b'ġisem twil u rqiq u b'żewġ pari ġwienaħ trasparenti, li spiss jidher qrib l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 昆虫；此词具体指身体细长、有两对透明翅膀的蜻蜓。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Insett li għandu ġisem twil u rqiq u żewġ pari ġwienaħ trasparenti, u li ta' spiss itir qrib l-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dragonfly is an insect with a long slender body and two pairs of transparent wings, commonly seen near water.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għadira, l-istudenti raw dragon fly itir fuq wiċċ l-ilma.
formal.en: While observing the pond, the students saw a dragonfly flying over the surface of the water.
formal.zh: 观察池塘时，学生们看见一只蜻蜓在水面上飞。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak id-dragon fly fuq il-qasba! Pawlu: Rajtu! Għandu ġwienaħ trasparenti sbieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that dragonfly on the reed! Pawlu: I see it! It has beautiful transparent wings.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看芦苇上的那只蜻蜓！保罗：看到了！它的透明翅膀真漂亮。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak id-dragon fly fuq il-qasba!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak id-dragon fly fuq il-qasba!
messages.zh: 看芦苇上的那只蜻蜓！
messages.en: Look at that dragonfly on the reed!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了！它的透明翅膀真漂亮。
messages.en: I see it! It has beautiful transparent wings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用池塘边的画面记忆：细长身体、两对透明翅膀，在水面轻飞的就是蜻蜓。

gloss_zh: 剧烈的；大幅度的；严厉的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very severe or far-reaching in its extent, effect, or consequences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 程度很强、幅度很大或影响深远的，常形容变化或措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun qawwi ħafna jew ikollu effetti kbar u profondi, speċjalment meta jirreferi għal bidla jew miżura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剧烈的、大幅度的或严厉的；指变化、行动或措施程度很强，影响很大。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi bidla kbira ħafna jew azzjoni qawwija li tħalli effetti estensivi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A drastic change or measure is very great or severe and has a considerable effect on a situation.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri tnaqqis drastiku fl-użu tal-karta wara l-introduzzjoni tas-sistema diġitali.
formal.en: The report shows a drastic reduction in paper use after the introduction of the digital system.
formal.zh: 报告显示，引入数字系统后，纸张使用量大幅下降。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tneħħi l-għamara kollha mill-kamra? Pawlu: Le, dak ikun tibdil drastiku wisq; għalissa se nbiddel il-mejda biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to remove all the furniture from the room? Pawlu: No, that would be too drastic a change; for now, I'll just replace the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要把房间里的家具全搬走吗？保罗：不，那样改动太大了；眼下我只换张桌子。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你要把房间里的家具全搬走吗？
messages.en: Are you going to remove all the furniture from the room?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dak ikun tibdil drastiku wisq; għalissa se nbiddel il-mejda biss.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dak ikun tibdil drastiku wisq; għalissa se nbiddel il-mejda biss.
messages.zh: 不，那样改动太大了；眼下我只换张桌子。
messages.en: No, that would be too drastic a change; for now, I'll just replace the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 drastiku 和调节旋钮一下转到底的画面相连：变化幅度很大，便是剧烈或大幅度的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A beverage or a serving of liquid intended for drinking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人饮用的饮品，也可指一杯或一份饮料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xarba, jew porzjon ta' xarba, li persuna tixrob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 饮品；供饮用的一杯或一份饮料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xarba jew porzjon ta' likwidu maħsub biex jinxtorob.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A drink is a beverage or an individual serving of liquid that someone drinks.

formal.mt: Il-prezz tal-ikla jinkludi drink wieħed għal kull persuna.
formal.en: The price of the meal includes one drink per person.
formal.zh: 餐费包含每人一杯饮料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid drink kiesaħ? Mark: Iva, grazzi. Nixtieq meraq tal-larinġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a cold drink? Mark: Yes, thanks. I'd like some orange juice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想喝杯冷饮吗？马克：好，谢谢。我想喝橙汁。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想喝杯冷饮吗？
messages.en: Would you like a cold drink?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，谢谢。我想喝橙汁。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. I'd like some orange juice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进点单画面记忆：tordna drink 就是点一杯饮料；本条按名词理解。

gloss_zh: 分割的权利；划分为份额的权利

teaching_sense.en_definition: A right divided into separate shares.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 划分为若干独立份额的权利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dritt li jkun maqsum f'ishma separati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已划分为不同份额的权利。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dritt li jkun ġie maqsum f'ishma distinti, b'kull sehem jirrappreżenta parti minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A divided right is a right that has been separated into distinct shares.

collocations.en: a share in a divided right
collocations.zh: 分割权利中的一个份额

collocations.en: the apportionment of a divided right

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi dritt diviż u jispeċifika s-sehem ta' kull persuna.
formal.en: The document describes a divided right and specifies each person's share.
formal.zh: 文件说明了一项分割的权利，并明确了每个人的份额。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser dritt diviż hawn? Pawlu: Ifisser li d-dritt huwa maqsum f'ishma. Id-dokument jgħid kemm għandu kull wieħed.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does a divided right mean here? Pawlu: It means the right is divided into shares. The document says how much each person has.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的分割权利是什么意思？保罗：意思是这项权利分成了若干份额。文件写明了每个人各有多少。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的分割权利是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a divided right mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li d-dritt huwa maqsum f'ishma. Id-dokument jgħid kemm għandu kull wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li d-dritt huwa maqsum f'ishma. Id-dokument jgħid kemm għandu kull wieħed.
messages.zh: 意思是这项权利分成了若干份额。文件写明了每个人各有多少。
messages.en: It means the right is divided into shares. The document says how much each person has.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个代表权利的圆，再分成几个份额：用这个画面记住整组词表示分割的权利。

gloss_zh: 补救权；纠正履约缺失的权利

teaching_sense.en_definition: A right to remedy a failure or breach before further consequences follow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在进一步后果发生之前，对履约缺失或违约进行纠正和补救的权利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dritt li jagħti lil parti l-opportunità li tirrimedja nuqqas jew ksur qabel ma jiġu applikati konsegwenzi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 补救权，指当事方在进一步后果发生之前纠正履约缺失或违约的权利。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dritt ta' parti li tikkoreġi nuqqas fit-twettiq ta' obbligu jew tirrimedja ksur qabel ma jittieħdu passi oħra minħabba dak in-nuqqas jew ksur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A right to cure gives a party an opportunity to remedy a failure or breach before further consequences follow.

collocations.en: to exercise the right to cure
a clause concerning the right to cure

formal.mt: Skont dan il-kuntratt, il-fornitur għandu dritt ta' riparazzjoni u jista' jirrimedja n-nuqqas fi żmien għaxart ijiem.
formal.en: Under this contract, the supplier has a right to cure and may remedy the failure within ten days.
formal.zh: 根据这份合同，供应商享有补救权，可以在十天内纠正履约缺失。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi jfisser dritt ta' riparazzjoni f'dan il-kuntratt? Rita: Ifisser li l-fornitur għandu ċans jirranġa n-nuqqas. Hawn għandu għaxart ijiem biex jagħmel dan.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does the right to cure mean in this contract? Rita: It means the supplier has a chance to put the failure right. Here, the supplier has ten days to do so.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这份合同里的补救权是什么意思？丽塔：意思是供应商有机会纠正履约缺失。这里给了供应商十天时间来处理。

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser dritt ta' riparazzjoni f'dan il-kuntratt?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser dritt ta' riparazzjoni f'dan il-kuntratt?
messages.zh: 这份合同里的补救权是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the right to cure mean in this contract?

messages.speaker: Rita (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-fornitur għandu ċans jirranġa n-nuqqas. Hawn għandu għaxart ijiem biex jagħmel dan.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-fornitur għandu ċans jirranġa n-nuqqas. Hawn għandu għaxart ijiem biex jagħmel dan.
messages.zh: 意思是供应商有机会纠正履约缺失。这里给了供应商十天时间来处理。
messages.en: It means the supplier has a chance to put the failure right. Here, the supplier has ten days to do so.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住合同里先给机会纠正缺失的画面：本条的补救权强调当事方获得纠正履约问题的机会。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The rights that protect people when they buy goods or services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们购买商品或服务时享有、用于保护其消费者利益的各项权利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-drittijiet li jipproteġu lin-nies meta jixtru prodotti jew servizzi bħala konsumaturi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消费者在购买商品或服务时享有的各项权利。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-drittijiet li għandhom il-konsumaturi fir-rigward tax-xiri ta' prodotti jew servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consumer rights are the rights people have in their dealings with businesses when buying goods or services.

formal.mt: L-għan ta' din il-gwida huwa li tispjega d-drittijiet tal-konsumatur b'lingwaġġ ċar.
formal.en: The purpose of this guide is to explain consumer rights in clear language.
formal.zh: 本指南旨在用清晰的语言解释消费者权利。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn nista' naqra dwar id-drittijiet tal-konsumatur? Nina: Għandi gwida qasira. Nistgħu naqrawha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where can I read about consumer rights? Nina: I have a short guide. We can read it together.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我可以在哪里阅读有关消费者权利的资料？妮娜：我有一本简短的指南。我们可以一起读。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' naqra dwar id-drittijiet tal-konsumatur?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' naqra dwar id-drittijiet tal-konsumatur?
messages.zh: 我可以在哪里阅读有关消费者权利的资料？
messages.en: Where can I read about consumer rights?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi gwida qasira. Nistgħu naqrawha flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi gwida qasira. Nistgħu naqrawha flimkien.
messages.zh: 我有一本简短的指南。我们可以一起读。
messages.en: I have a short guide. We can read it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想购物后查阅权利指南的场景：drittijiet 是各项权利，tal-konsumatur 限定为消费者的。

gloss_zh: 怀疑；疑虑；难以抉择的困境

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of uncertainty about whether something is true, correct, or suitable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事是否真实、正确或合适缺乏把握时产生的怀疑或疑虑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' ċertezza dwar jekk xi ħaġa hijiex vera, korretta jew xierqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怀疑；疑虑；对某事缺乏确信。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħsieb jew sentiment li juri li persuna mhijiex ċerta dwar il-verità jew il-korrettezza ta' xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you have a doubt about something, you are not completely certain that it is true or correct.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 难以抉择的困境；不知道应当采取哪种行动的为难处境。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni li fiha persuna ma tkunx taf x'għandha tagħmel jew liema għażla għandha tagħmel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are in a quandary, you find it difficult to decide what you should do.

collocations.en: to have a doubt about something

formal.mt: Jekk għandek xi dubju dwar l-istruzzjonijiet, itlob spjegazzjoni qabel tibda x-xogħol.
formal.en: If you have any doubt about the instructions, ask for an explanation before starting the work.
formal.zh: 如果你对说明有任何疑问，请在开始工作前要求解释。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi dubju dwar il-ħin tal-laqgħa. Mark: Ejja niċċekkjaw il-messaġġ flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm unsure about the meeting time. Mark: Let's check the message together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我对开会时间有点拿不准。马克：我们一起看看消息吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我对开会时间有点拿不准。
messages.en: I'm unsure about the meeting time.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我们一起看看消息吧。
messages.en: Let's check the message together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dubju 联想成脑中冒出的问号：真假拿不准是“疑虑”，行动选不定是“为难”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of the city called Dublin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 都柏林，指称这座城市的专有名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju li jirreferi għall-belt magħrufa bħala Dublin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 都柏林，城市名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dublin huwa isem proprju ta' belt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dublin is a proper name used to identify a particular city.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir f'Dublin, u l-parteċipanti se jirċievu l-programm qabel il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Dublin, and participants will receive the programme before the trip.
formal.zh: 会议将在都柏林举行，与会者将在出行前收到日程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se tmur Dublin din il-ġimgħa? Pawlu: Iva, se mmur hemm għal laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you going to Dublin this week? Pawlu: Yes, I'm going there for a meeting.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你这周要去都柏林吗？保罗：是的，我要去那里开会。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你这周要去都柏林吗？
messages.en: Are you going to Dublin this week?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se mmur hemm għal laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se mmur hemm għal laqgħa.
messages.zh: 是的，我要去那里开会。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going there for a meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把大写 Dublin 当作地图上的“都柏林”标签，再用 lejn Dublin 记“去”，用 f'Dublin 记“在”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lion, a large wild cat whose adult male usually has a mane.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 狮子，一种大型野生猫科动物，成年雄性通常长有鬃毛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iljun, annimal selvaġġ kbir tal-familja tal-qtates, li r-raġel adult tiegħu normalment ikollu kriniera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狮子；一种成年雄性通常具有鬃毛的大型猫科动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal selvaġġ kbir tal-familja tal-qtates, magħruf ukoll bħala iljun, li r-raġel adult tiegħu ġeneralment ikollu kriniera.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lion is a large wild cat, and the adult male usually has a mane around its head and neck.

formal.mt: Fl-istampa jidher dubries adult bi kriniera madwar rasu u għonqu.
formal.en: The picture shows an adult lion with a mane around its head and neck.
formal.zh: 图中是一头成年狮子，头部和颈部周围长着鬃毛。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dak l-annimal fl-istampa? Maja: Dak dubries. Ara l-kriniera tiegħu!
colloquial.en: Nina: What's that animal in the picture? Maja: That's a lion. Look at its mane!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：图片里那是什么动物？玛雅：那是狮子。看它的鬃毛！

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里那是什么动物？
messages.en: What's that animal in the picture?

messages.speaker: Maja (教师)
messages.zh: 那是狮子。看它的鬃毛！
messages.en: That's a lion. Look at its mane!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dubries 配一张雄狮鬃毛的记忆图片，看到词就回想“狮子”，再用“大狮子”短语巩固。

gloss_zh: 具体词义未明确；所给英文释义为“translation in English”

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun supplied with the gloss 'translation in English', which does not establish a specific lexical meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个被标注为名词的词；所给英文释义为“translation in English”，但该表述未明确其具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li ngħata l-glossa Ingliża 'translation in English', iżda din il-glossa ma tispeċifikax it-tifsira eżatta tal-kelma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给表述直译为“英语译文”或“用英语翻译”；它未明确说明 dukkara 的具体词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa mogħtija tfisser litteralment traduzzjoni bl-Ingliż, iżda ma tagħtix tifsira lessikali ċara għall-kelma dukkara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss refers to a translation in English, but it does not clearly identify what this noun denotes.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'dukkara' hija mniżżla bħala nom, iżda l-glossa 'translation in English' ma tiċċarax it-tifsira eżatta tagħha.
formal.en: The word 'dukkara' is listed as a noun, but the gloss 'translation in English' does not clarify its exact meaning.
formal.zh: “dukkara”被列为名词，但“translation in English”这条释义没有明确其具体词义。

colloquial.en: Lara: What does the word 'dukkara' mean? Mark: The supplied gloss isn't clear enough for us to know its exact meaning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：“dukkara”这个词是什么意思？马克：给出的释义不够清楚，我们无法据此确定它的具体意思。

messages.mt_standard: Il-glossa mogħtija mhijiex ċara biżżejjed biex inkunu nafu t-tifsira eżatta tagħha.
messages.zh: 给出的释义不够清楚，我们无法据此确定它的具体意思。
messages.en: The supplied gloss isn't clear enough for us to know its exact meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dukkara 写在带问号的词卡上，先记名词身份和拼写，具体词义留待明确，避免把释义提示误背成词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of beginning to offer goods or services in a market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 企业或产品开始在某个市场提供商品或服务的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih kumpanija jew prodott jibda joffri oġġetti jew servizzi f'suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进入某个市场开展销售或提供服务的行为或过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bidu tal-attività kummerċjali f'suq, meta kumpanija tibda tbigħ prodotti jew toffri servizzi fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Market entry is the process by which a business begins selling goods or providing services in a particular market.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ħejjiet strateġija ta' dħul fis-suq li tinkludi riċerka dwar il-klijenti u l-kompetituri.
formal.en: The company prepared a market entry strategy that includes research into customers and competitors.
formal.zh: 公司制定了一项市场进入策略，其中包括对客户和竞争对手的研究。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sejjer il-pjan ta' dħul fis-suq? Mark: Qed nitkellmu mal-ħwienet; jekk jaqblu, nibdew inbigħu x-xahar id-dieħel.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is the market entry plan going? Mark: We're talking to the shops; if they agree, we'll start selling next month.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：进入市场的计划进展怎么样？马克：我们正在跟商店洽谈；如果他们同意，我们下个月就开始销售。

messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer il-pjan ta' dħul fis-suq?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer il-pjan ta' dħul fis-suq?
messages.zh: 进入市场的计划进展怎么样？
messages.en: How is the market entry plan going?

messages.speaker: Mark (销售负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nitkellmu mal-ħwienet; jekk jaqblu, nibdew inbigħu x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nitkellmu mal-ħwienet; jekk jaqblu, nibdew inbigħu x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 我们正在跟商店洽谈；如果他们同意，我们下个月就开始销售。
messages.en: We're talking to the shops; if they agree, we'll start selling next month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成产品正式走进市场、开始面对顾客销售的画面，再用“进入策略”和“进入壁垒”两个搭配巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money received from sales after the relevant deductions have been made.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 销售所得款项扣除退款等相关扣减项目后剩余的收入。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-flus li jibqgħu mill-bejgħ wara li jitnaqqsu l-ammonti rilevanti, bħal rifużjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 销售收款扣除相关扣减项目后所得的净额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ammont ta' flus li jibqa' mill-bejgħ wara li jsir it-tnaqqis rilevanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A business's net receipts from sales are the amounts it receives from selling goods or services after the relevant deductions have been made.

collocations.en: an increase in net receipts from sales

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri d-dħul nett mill-bejgħ wara li jitnaqqsu r-rifużjonijiet lill-klijenti.
formal.en: The report shows net receipts from sales after customer refunds are deducted.
formal.zh: 报告列出了扣除客户退款后的销售净收入。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kemm kien id-dħul nett mill-bejgħ illum? Pawlu: Disa' mitt ewro. Daħlu elf ewro u tajna lura mitt ewro lill-klijenti.
colloquial.en: Marija: How much were our net receipts from sales today? Pawlu: Nine hundred euros. We received a thousand euros and refunded a hundred euros to customers.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：今天的销售净收入是多少？保罗：九百欧元。我们收了一千欧元，退给客户一百欧元。

messages.speaker: Marija (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm kien id-dħul nett mill-bejgħ illum?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm kien id-dħul nett mill-bejgħ illum?
messages.zh: 今天的销售净收入是多少？
