messages.en: How much were our net receipts from sales today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (收银员)
messages.mt_spoken: Disa' mitt ewro. Daħlu elf ewro u tajna lura mitt ewro lill-klijenti.
messages.mt_standard: Disa' mitt ewro. Daħlu elf ewro u tajna lura mitt ewro lill-klijenti.
messages.zh: 九百欧元。我们收了一千欧元，退给客户一百欧元。
messages.en: Nine hundred euros. We received a thousand euros and refunded a hundred euros to customers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成销售收款表：先有销售进账，再扣退款，最后圈出净额；注意销售净收入不等于最终利润。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Entry into a place or system on a lasting basis without a temporary time limit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以长期持续、没有临时期限的方式进入某个场所或系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dħul f'post jew f'sistema fuq bażi dejjiema, mingħajr limitu ta' żmien temporanju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有永久性质、而非仅在有限期间内有效的进入或准入。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dħul li jkun fuq bażi permanenti u mhux marbut ma' perjodu temporanju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Permanent entry is entry into a place or system on a lasting basis, rather than for a limited period.

formal.mt: Ir-regolament jiddistingwi bejn dħul permanenti u dħul temporanju u jistabbilixxi l-kundizzjonijiet għal kull wieħed.
formal.en: The regulation distinguishes between permanent entry and temporary entry and sets out the conditions for each.
formal.zh: 该规章区分永久准入与临时准入，并规定了各自的条件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawnhekk, dħul permanenti jfisser li hemm limitu ta' tliet xhur? Mark: Le, ifisser dħul fuq bażi dejjiema, mhux għal tliet xhur biss.
colloquial.en: Lara: Here, does permanent entry mean there is a three-month limit? Mark: No, it means entry on a lasting basis, not just for three months.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的永久准入是指有三个月的期限吗？马克：不是，指的是长期持续的准入，并非只有三个月。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, dħul permanenti jfisser li hemm limitu ta' tliet xhur?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, dħul permanenti jfisser li hemm limitu ta' tliet xhur?
messages.zh: 这里的永久准入是指有三个月的期限吗？
messages.en: Here, does permanent entry mean there is a three-month limit?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ifisser dħul fuq bażi dejjiema, mhux għal tliet xhur biss.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ifisser dħul fuq bażi dejjiema, mhux għal tliet xhur biss.
messages.zh: 不是，指的是长期持续的准入，并非只有三个月。
messages.en: No, it means entry on a lasting basis, not just for three months.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个短语画成一扇通往长期安排的大门，旁边写上“永久”；再与标有截止日期的临时准入卡对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of money into a business, account, or fund.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资金进入企业、账户或资金池的流动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment ta' flus lejn negozju, kont jew fond.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流入企业、账户或资金池的现金款项或资金流动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Flus li jidħlu f'negozju, f'kont jew f'fond matul perjodu partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cash in-flow occurs when money comes into a business, account, or fund from a payment or another source.

formal.mt: Il-ħlasijiet li waslu mingħand il-klijenti żiedu d-dħul ta' flus tal-kumpanija matul ix-xahar.
formal.en: Payments received from customers increased the company's cash in-flow during the month.
formal.zh: 本月收到的客户付款增加了公司的现金流入。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-klijent ħallas illum? David: Iva, waslu mitejn ewro fil-kont. Dan huwa dħul ta' flus.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did the customer pay today? David: Yes, two hundred euros came into the account. That is a cash in-flow.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：客户今天付款了吗？戴维：付了，账户收到两百欧元。这就是一笔现金流入。

messages.speaker: Nina (店主)
messages.zh: 客户今天付款了吗？
messages.en: Did the customer pay today?

messages.speaker: David (会计)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, waslu mitejn ewro fil-kont. Dan huwa dħul ta' flus.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, waslu mitejn ewro fil-kont. Dan huwa dħul ta' flus.
messages.zh: 付了，账户收到两百欧元。这就是一笔现金流入。
messages.en: Yes, two hundred euros came into the account. That is a cash in-flow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象账户是一个水池，钱沿箭头流进池内，就是现金流入；记住重点是资金进入，不一定代表赚到利润。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Admission or entry into a place or system for a limited period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仅在有限期间内获准进入或实际进入某个场所或系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dħul f'post jew f'sistema li jkun permess jew iseħħ għal perjodu limitat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仅在有限期间内有效的准入或接纳。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Permess jew aċċettazzjoni biex wieħed jidħol f'post jew f'sistema għal perjodu limitat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Temporary admission is permission to enter a place or system for a limited period under the applicable conditions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以临时性质进入某个场所或系统，持续时间有限。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dħul f'post jew f'sistema għal żmien limitat, aktar milli fuq bażi permanenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Temporary entry occurs when someone or something enters a place or system for a limited time rather than permanently.

formal.mt: L-istituzzjoni tippermetti dħul temporanju fil-laboratorju għal ġimgħa, skont il-kundizzjonijiet tal-permess.
formal.en: The institution allows temporary admission to the laboratory for one week, subject to the permit's conditions.
formal.zh: 该机构依据许可证的条件，允许为期一周的实验室临时准入。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-permess jagħtini dħul temporanju fil-laboratorju? Ġorġ: Iva, tista' tidħol għal ġimgħa biss. Wara jkollok bżonn permess ieħor.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this permit give me temporary admission to the laboratory? Ġorġ: Yes, you can enter for one week only. After that, you will need another permit.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张许可证允许我临时进入实验室吗？乔治：是的，只允许一周。之后你需要另一张许可证。

messages.speaker: Sara (访问学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-permess jagħtini dħul temporanju fil-laboratorju?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-permess jagħtini dħul temporanju fil-laboratorju?
messages.zh: 这张许可证允许我临时进入实验室吗？
messages.en: Does this permit give me temporary admission to the laboratory?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (实验室管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' tidħol għal ġimgħa biss. Wara jkollok bżonn permess ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' tidħol għal ġimgħa biss. Wara jkollok bżonn permess ieħor.
messages.zh: 是的，只允许一周。之后你需要另一张许可证。
messages.en: Yes, you can enter for one week only. After that, you will need another permit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张印着截止日期的访客证：拿证获准进入对应临时准入，持证实际进去对应临时进入，两者都只持续有限时间。

gloss_zh: 标点类别条目，释义标签为 p；具体功能未明确

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry classified as punctuation and labelled 'p', with its specific function unspecified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 归入标点类别、释义标签为 p 的条目；尚未明确其所表示的具体符号或功能。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata fil-kategorija tal-punteġġjatura bit-tikketta 'p', mingħajr indikazzjoni tal-funzjoni speċifika tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: p：此标点类别条目的释义标签，具体含义和标点功能未明确。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tikketta 'p' għal din l-entrata fil-kategorija tal-punteġġjatura; it-tifsira preċiża u l-funzjoni tagħha mhumiex speċifikati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Here, 'p' labels a punctuation entry whose precise meaning and function have not been specified.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, 'dħulja' tidher fil-kategorija tal-punteġġjatura bit-tikketta 'p', iżda l-funzjoni tagħha mhix speċifikata.
formal.en: In the exercise, 'dħulja' appears in the punctuation category with the label 'p', but its function is unspecified.
formal.zh: 在练习中，“dħulja”列在标点类别下，标签为“p”，但具体功能尚未明确。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tindika 'dħulja' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Toni: Hemm biss it-tikketta 'p'; għandna bżonn spjegazzjoni biex inkunu nafu l-funzjoni tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'dħulja' indicate in this exercise? Toni: There's only the label 'p'; we need an explanation to know its function.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这道练习里的“dħulja”表示什么？托尼：这里只有“p”这个标签；我们需要进一步说明才能知道它的功能。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这道练习里的“dħulja”表示什么？
messages.en: What does 'dħulja' indicate in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm biss it-tikketta 'p'; għandna bżonn spjegazzjoni biex inkunu nafu l-funzjoni tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm biss it-tikketta 'p'; għandna bżonn spjegazzjoni biex inkunu nafu l-funzjoni tagħha.
messages.zh: 这里只有“p”这个标签；我们需要进一步说明才能知道它的功能。
messages.en: There's only the label 'p'; we need an explanation to know its function.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先做一张待补全的词卡：正面写 dħulja，背面写“标点类别、标签 p、功能待明确”；不要凭字母猜成某个具体标点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small stone, especially one that is smooth and rounded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一块小石头，尤指表面光滑、形状圆润的小卵石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġebla żgħira, speċjalment waħda lixxa u fit-tond.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小卵石；尤指光滑圆润的小石子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġebla żgħira li spiss ikollha wiċċ lixx u għamla tonda u li tista' ssibha fuq bajja jew ħdejn xmara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pebble is a small stone, often smooth and rounded, that you may find on a beach or beside a river.

formal.mt: L-istudenta poġġiet ċagħqa lixxa fuq il-mejda u ddeskriviet il-forma tagħha.
formal.en: The student placed a smooth pebble on the table and described its shape.
formal.zh: 这名女学生把一颗光滑的小卵石放在桌上，并描述了它的形状。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara din iċ-ċagħqa! Kemm hi lixxa! Ben: Iva, poġġiha hawn biex naraha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at this pebble! It's so smooth! Ben: Yes, put it here so I can see it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看这颗小卵石！真光滑！本：是啊，放到这里让我看看。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara din iċ-ċagħqa! Kemm hi lixxa!
messages.mt_standard: Ara din iċ-ċagħqa! Kemm hi lixxa!
messages.zh: 看这颗小卵石！真光滑！
messages.en: Look at this pebble! It's so smooth!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，放到这里让我看看。
messages.en: Yes, put it here so I can see it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象掌心托着一颗海边捡来的光滑小石子，边摸边说“ċagħqa”，把词音和小卵石的触感一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The hooting sound made by an owl.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 猫头鹰发出的鸣叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss li tagħmel il-kokka meta tgħajjat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猫头鹰发出的鸣叫声。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħoss li tinstema' tagħmel il-kokka meta tgħajjat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The hooting of an owl is the sound that the bird makes when it calls.

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni ta' billejl, instema' ċ-ċajjar tal-kokka minn fost is-siġar.
formal.en: During the nighttime observation, the owl's hooting was heard from among the trees.
formal.zh: 夜间观察期间，树林里传来了猫头鹰的鸣叫声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt iċ-ċajjar tal-kokka? Mark: Iva, ġej minn dik is-siġra ħdejn il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear the owl hooting? Mark: Yes, it's coming from that tree beside the wall.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到猫头鹰叫了吗？马克：听到了，声音是从墙边那棵树上传来的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到猫头鹰叫了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the owl hooting?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej minn dik is-siġra ħdejn il-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej minn dik is-siġra ħdejn il-ħajt.
messages.zh: 听到了，声音是从墙边那棵树上传来的。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from that tree beside the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċajjar放进夜间听声的画面：树林安静，猫头鹰忽然鸣叫；记住它对应的是叫声。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flat tile used to cover a surface, including a large tile laid on a floor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于铺覆表面的平整砖片，也可特指铺地用的大块地砖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ċatta li tintuża biex tgħatti wiċċ, u li tista' tkun maduma kbira għat-tqegħid fl-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于铺覆表面的砖片或铺面砖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa ċatta li titqiegħed ma' oħrajn biex tgħatti wiċċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tile is a flat piece placed with others to cover a surface.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铺在地面上的大块地砖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Maduma kbira u ċatta li titqiegħed fl-art bħala parti mill-kisi tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A large floor tile is a broad, flat piece used as part of a floor covering.

formal.mt: Iċ-ċangatura l-kbira ħdejn id-daħla għandha tinbidel minħabba xquq fil-wiċċ tagħha.
formal.en: The large floor tile near the entrance should be replaced because its surface is cracked.
formal.zh: 入口附近的那块大地砖表面出现裂纹，应予更换。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din iċ-ċangatura tiċċaqlaq meta nimxi fuqha. Mark: Rajtha; irridu nwaħħluha sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: This floor tile moves when I walk on it. Mark: I've noticed it; we need to secure it properly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我踩上去的时候，这块地砖会晃动。马克：我注意到了；我们得把它固定好。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din iċ-ċangatura tiċċaqlaq meta nimxi fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Din iċ-ċangatura tiċċaqlaq meta nimxi fuqha.
messages.zh: 我踩上去的时候，这块地砖会晃动。
messages.en: This floor tile moves when I walk on it.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我注意到了；我们得把它固定好。
messages.en: I've noticed it; we need to secure it properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象入口处一块平整的大地砖，把ċangatura与铺面砖的画面绑定；普通砖片和大块地砖两个义项一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large stone or a substantial piece of rock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体积较大的石头或大块岩石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġebla kbira jew biċċa kbira ta' blat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体积较大的一块石头。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġebla ta' daqs kbir li tista' tkun tqila biex tinġarr.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A large stone is a substantial piece of rock that may be difficult to move.

formal.mt: Ċangun waqa' mill-ħajt u mblokka parti mill-mogħdija.
formal.en: A large stone fell from the wall and blocked part of the path.
formal.zh: 一块大石头从墙上掉落，堵住了部分通道。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak iċ-ċangun f'nofs il-mogħdija! Mark: Rajtu. Ejja ngħaddu minn ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that large stone in the middle of the path! Mark: I see it. Let's go around it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，路中间有那么大一块石头！马克：看到了。我们从旁边绕过去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 看，路中间有那么大一块石头！
messages.en: Look at that large stone in the middle of the path!

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了。我们从旁边绕过去吧。
messages.en: I see it. Let's go around it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċangun记成挡在路中央、需要绕行的大石块；用体积很大的具体画面帮助记住词义。

gloss_zh: 强奸了；摧毁了；建造了（依语境）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb that can refer to raping someone, destroying something, or building something, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境可表示强奸某人、摧毁某物或建造某物的动词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb li, skont il-kuntest, jista' jfisser li xi ħadd stupra persuna, qered xi ħaġa jew bena xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强奸了某人、摧毁了某物或建造了某物；具体含义取决于语境。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jista' jfisser li xi ħadd stupra persuna, qered xi ħaġa jew bena xi ħaġa, skont il-kuntest tas-sentenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone performed the action described by this verb, they raped a person, destroyed something, or built something, depending on the context.

formal.mt: Meta jiġi interpretat il-verb 'ċaqqan', il-kuntest għandu juri jekk it-tifsira hijiex marbuta ma' stupru, qerda jew bini.
formal.en: When interpreting the verb 'ċaqqan', the context should indicate whether its meaning concerns rape, destruction, or building.
formal.zh: 理解动词ċaqqan时，应根据语境判断其含义涉及强奸、摧毁还是建造。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'ċaqqan' f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Hawn ifisser 'bena', għax is-sentenza titkellem dwar dar ġdida.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ċaqqan' mean in this sentence? Mark: Here it means 'built', because the sentence is about a new house.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：ċaqqan在这个句子里是什么意思？马克：这里是“建造了”的意思，因为句子说的是一座新房子。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: ċaqqan在这个句子里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ċaqqan' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser 'bena', għax is-sentenza titkellem dwar dar ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser 'bena', għax is-sentenza titkellem dwar dar ġdida.
messages.zh: 这里是“建造了”的意思，因为句子说的是一座新房子。
messages.en: Here it means 'built', because the sentence is about a new house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为ċaqqan制作三张语境卡，分别写强奸、摧毁、建造；每次结合整句判断，不靠孤立词形选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular piece of land considered as a separate plot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为独立地块看待的一块土地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa art meqjusa bħala parti separata mill-art ta' madwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块独立的土地；地块。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa art meqjusa bħala parti separata mill-art ta' madwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A plot of land is a particular piece of ground considered as a separate area.

collocations.en: a plot of land beside the house

formal.mt: Iċ-ċarru ħdejn id-dar se jintuża biex jitkabbar it-tadam.
formal.en: The plot of land beside the house will be used to grow tomatoes.
formal.zh: 房子旁的那块土地将用来种植番茄。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'se tagħmel b'dak iċ-ċarru? Pawlu: Se nkabbar it-tadam fih.
colloquial.en: Marija: What will you do with that plot of land? Pawlu: I'll grow tomatoes on it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你打算用那块地做什么？保罗：我要在上面种番茄。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 你打算用那块地做什么？
messages.en: What will you do with that plot of land?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (土地使用者)
messages.zh: 我要在上面种番茄。
messages.en: I'll grow tomatoes on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċarru和房旁一块种番茄的土地一起记：脑中给土地画个边框，就能想起“地块”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object used to lock or unlock a lock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来锁上或打开锁的物件，即钥匙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jintuża biex jissakkar jew jinfetaħ serratur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于锁上或打开锁的钥匙。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett li jintuża biex jissakkar jew jinfetaħ serratur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A key is an object that you use to lock or unlock a lock.

formal.mt: Iċ-ċavvetta tal-bieb għandha tinżamm f'post sigur.
formal.en: The door key should be kept in a safe place.
formal.zh: 门钥匙应存放在安全的地方。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hi ċ-ċavvetta tal-bieb? Mark: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-telefon.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the door key? Mark: On the table, beside the phone.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：门钥匙在哪里？马克：在桌上，电话旁边。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 门钥匙在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the door key?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 在桌上，电话旁边。
messages.en: On the table, beside the phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċavvetta写在钥匙图旁，每次想象拿钥匙开门时读一遍，用“钥匙开门”的动作帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fruit of a mulberry tree, eaten fresh or used to make foods such as jam.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 桑树所结的果实，可鲜食，也可用来制作果酱等食品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-frott tas-siġra taċ-ċawsli, li jista' jittiekel frisk jew jintuża biex isir il-ġamm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 桑葚，即桑树所结的果实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-frott tas-siġra taċ-ċawsli, li jittiekel frisk jew jintuża fil-preparazzjoni tal-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mulberry is a fruit that grows on a mulberry tree and can be eaten fresh or made into jam.

formal.mt: Għall-preparazzjoni tal-ġamm, aħsel iċ-ċawsli sew qabel it-tisjir.
formal.en: To prepare the jam, wash the mulberries thoroughly before cooking.
formal.zh: 制作果酱时，应在烹煮前将桑葚彻底洗净。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid ftit ċawsli? Toni: Iva, grazzi! Dan misjur?
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like some mulberries? Toni: Yes, thanks! Are these ripe?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你要吃一点桑葚吗？托尼：好呀，谢谢！这些熟了吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要吃一点桑葚吗？
messages.en: Would you like some mulberries?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 好呀，谢谢！这些熟了吗？
messages.en: Yes, thanks! Are these ripe?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċawsli和一碗桑葚、一罐桑葚果酱连在一起记，再用ġamm taċ-ċawsli巩固“桑葚”的意思。

gloss_zh: 便宜的；价格低的（澳大利亚马耳他语用法）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Low in price, in Maltese Australian usage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 价格低、花钱少的；用于澳大利亚马耳他语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu prezz baxx jew jiswa ftit flus; jintuża fil-Malti tal-Awstralja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 便宜的、价格低的；属于澳大利亚马耳他语用法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiswa ftit flus jew għandu prezz baxx, fl-użu tal-Malti tal-Awstralja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In Maltese Australian usage, something described as ċejp costs relatively little money.

formal.mt: Fil-Malti tal-Awstralja, biljett bi prezz baxx jista' jiġi deskritt bħala ċejp.
formal.en: In Maltese Australian usage, a low-priced ticket can be described as ċejp.
formal.zh: 在澳大利亚马耳他语中，一张价格低的票可以用 ċejp 来形容。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-biljett ċejp? Rita: Iva, jiswa biss ħames ewro.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this ticket cheap? Rita: Yes, it costs only five euros.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这张票便宜吗？Rita：便宜，只要五欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这张票便宜吗？
messages.en: Is this ticket cheap?

messages.speaker: Rita (售票员)
messages.zh: 便宜，只要五欧元。
messages.en: Yes, it costs only five euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċejp 和一张低价票的画面一起记：意思是“便宜的”，同时给这个词贴上“澳大利亚马耳他语用法”的标签。

gloss_zh: 牢房；修道院里的小单间

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small room for one person, especially in a prison or monastery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供一人使用的小房间，尤指监狱中的牢房或修道院中的单间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra żgħira għal persuna waħda, speċjalment f'ħabs jew f'kunvent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小单间，尤指牢房或修道院中供一人居住的房间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kamra żgħira, ġeneralment għal persuna waħda, bħal dik ta' priġunier f'ħabs jew ta' reliġjuż f'kunvent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cell is a small room occupied by a prisoner or by someone living in a monastery.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ċella tal-ħabs b'sodda waħda u tieqa żgħira.
formal.en: The report describes a prison cell with one bed and a small window.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一间设有一张床和一扇小窗的牢房。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kien hemm wara dan il-bieb? Toni: Ċella ta' patri, b'sodda u mejda żgħira.
colloquial.en: Lara: What used to be behind this door? Toni: A friar's cell, with a bed and a small table.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这扇门后面原来是什么？Toni：一位修士的单间，里面有一张床和一张小桌子。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 这扇门后面原来是什么？
messages.en: What used to be behind this door?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċella ta' patri, b'sodda u mejda żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Ċella ta' patri, b'sodda u mejda żgħira.
messages.zh: 一位修士的单间，里面有一张床和一张小桌子。
messages.en: A friar's cell, with a bed and a small table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ċella 时想象一扇小门后只有一张床：这是供人居住的小单间，可用于牢房或修士房间；本条用房间画面辅助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The smallest structural and functional unit of a living organism.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构成生物体并执行生命活动的基本结构和功能单位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-iżgħar unità strutturali u funzjonali ta' organiżmu ħaj.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 细胞；生物体的基本结构和功能单位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Unità bażika li minnha jinbnew l-organiżmi ħajjin u li twettaq funzjonijiet meħtieġa għall-ħajja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living organism.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw ċellula tal-pjanti taħt il-mikroskopju u pinġew dak li raw.
formal.en: The students observed a plant cell under the microscope and drew what they saw.
formal.zh: 学生们用显微镜观察了一个植物细胞，并画下了所见的结构。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed nara taħt il-mikroskopju? Marija: Dik ċellula tal-pjanti. Ħares lejn il-ħajt ta' madwarha.
colloquial.en: Sara: What am I looking at under the microscope? Marija: That is a plant cell. Look at the wall around it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我在显微镜下看到的是什么？Marija：那是一个植物细胞。看看它周围的细胞壁。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 我在显微镜下看到的是什么？
messages.en: What am I looking at under the microscope?

messages.speaker: Marija (生物老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik ċellula tal-pjanti. Ħares lejn il-ħajt ta' madwarha.
messages.mt_standard: Dik ċellula tal-pjanti. Ħares lejn il-ħajt ta' madwarha.
messages.zh: 那是一个植物细胞。看看它周围的细胞壁。
messages.en: That is a plant cell. Look at the wall around it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċellula 写在显微镜的想象画面旁，记成组成生命的小单位“细胞”；与用小房间画面记忆的 ċella 配对练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Celtic peoples, languages, or cultures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与凯尔特民族、语言或文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-popli Ċeltiċi, mal-lingwi tagħhom jew mal-kulturi tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凯尔特民族的；凯尔特语言或文化的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirreferi għall-popli Ċeltiċi jew għal-lingwi u l-kulturi tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Celtic relates to Celtic peoples, their languages, or their cultures.

formal.mt: L-istudent għażel simbolu ċeltiku bħala s-suġġett tal-preżentazzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The student chose a Celtic symbol as the subject of his presentation.
formal.zh: 这名学生选择了一个凯尔特符号作为他的报告主题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan x'tip ta' simbolu hu? Mark: Hu simbolu ċeltiku. Maja: Jogħġobni d-disinn tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What kind of symbol is this? Mark: It's a Celtic symbol. Maja: I like its design.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这是什么类型的符号？Mark：这是凯尔特符号。Maja：我喜欢它的设计。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是什么类型的符号？
messages.en: What kind of symbol is this?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是凯尔特符号。
messages.en: It's a Celtic symbol.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我喜欢它的设计。
messages.en: I like its design.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċeltiku和英文Celtic并排记，再用“凯尔特符号”这幅图像巩固形容词含义。

gloss_zh: 衣着土气、不修边幅的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose clothes and appearance look unfashionable and unattractive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 衣着缺乏时尚感、外表显得土气或不修边幅的人；带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tidher traskurata u tilbes ħwejjeġ bla stil jew li m'għadhomx moda; kelma li tesprimi ġudizzju negattiv fuq id-dehra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衣着老土、外表不够整洁或缺乏吸引力的人，含贬义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li l-ilbies u d-dehra tagħha jitqiesu bla stil, traskurati jew mhux tal-moda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is described as a dowdy person, their clothes and appearance are considered unfashionable and unattractive.

collocations.en: to dress like a dowdy person

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru jsejjaħ lill-ġara tiegħu ċenpula minħabba l-ilbies tagħha, u b'hekk juri kemm jiġġudika lin-nies minn dehrithom.
formal.en: In the story, the character calls his neighbour a dowdy person because of her clothes, showing how readily he judges people by their appearance.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个人物因为邻居的衣着而称她为土里土气的人，显露出他多么容易以貌取人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: B'dan il-kowt nidher qisha ċenpula? Nina: Le, imma forsi tippreferi l-ġakketta l-blu. Sara: Ħa nipprovaha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do I look dowdy in this coat? Nina: No, but you might prefer the blue jacket. Sara: Let me try it on.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我穿这件大衣是不是显得很土气？Nina：没有，不过你可能会更喜欢那件蓝夹克。Sara：我来试试。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我穿这件大衣是不是显得很土气？
messages.en: Do I look dowdy in this coat?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, imma forsi tippreferi l-ġakketta l-blu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, imma forsi tippreferi l-ġakketta l-blu.
messages.zh: 没有，不过你可能会更喜欢那件蓝夹克。
messages.en: No, but you might prefer the blue jacket.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我来试试。
messages.en: Let me try it on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用试衣镜前担心“穿得太土气”的场景记ċenpula；它评价人的外表，语气带贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lease allowing property to be used for payment, or the rent payable under that arrangement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以支付费用为条件使用土地或房产的租约，也可指依照这种安排应付的租金。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim li jagħti lil persuna l-użu ta' art jew proprjetà bi ħlas għal żmien miftiehem, jew il-ħlas dovut skont dak il-ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 租约；规定土地或房产使用期限、费用及其他条件的租赁协议。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim li bih persuna tingħata l-użu ta' art jew proprjetà għal żmien stabbilit u bi ħlas skont kundizzjonijiet miftiehma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lease is an agreement allowing someone to use property for a specified period in return for payment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 租金；为使用土地或房产而依约支付的费用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħlas li persuna tagħti skont ftehim għall-użu ta' art jew proprjetà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rent is the money someone pays under an agreement for the use of land or property.

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt taċ-ċens jindika t-tul tal-ftehim, l-ammont li għandu jitħallas u d-data tal-ħlas.
formal.en: The lease contract states the duration of the agreement, the amount payable, and the payment date.
formal.zh: 租赁合同注明了协议期限、应付金额和付款日期。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Meta rridu nħallsu ċ-ċens? Rita: Sal-aħħar tax-xahar. Mark: Tajjeb, inħallsu għada.
colloquial.en: Mark: When do we need to pay the rent? Rita: By the end of the month. Mark: All right, we'll pay tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们什么时候要交租金？Rita：月底之前。Mark：好，我们明天付。

messages.speaker: Mark (共同承租人)
messages.zh: 我们什么时候要交租金？
messages.en: When do we need to pay the rent?

messages.speaker: Rita (共同承租人)
messages.zh: 月底之前。
messages.en: By the end of the month.

messages.speaker: Mark (共同承租人)
messages.zh: 好，我们明天付。
messages.en: All right, we'll pay tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċens放进“签租约、交租金”两个连续画面：谈协议时记租约，谈付款时记租金。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container used for burning incense, especially during religious ceremonies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于焚烧香料的容器，尤指宗教仪式中使用的香炉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li fih jinħaraq l-inċens, speċjalment waqt ċerimonji reliġjużi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 焚烧香料用的香炉，尤用于宗教仪式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent użat biex jinħaraq fih l-inċens waqt ċerimonji reliġjużi jew f'okkażjonijiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A censer is a container in which incense is burned, especially during religious ceremonies.

collocations.en: incense is burned in the censer

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, il-qassis uża ċensier biex jaħraq l-inċens.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the priest used a censer to burn incense.
formal.zh: 仪式期间，神父使用香炉焚香。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak l-oġġett tal-metall? Pawlu: Dak ċensier; jintuża biex jinħaraq fih l-inċens.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that metal object? Pawlu: That's a censer; it's used for burning incense.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那个金属物件是什么？Pawlu：那是香炉，用来焚香。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 那个金属物件是什么？
messages.en: What is that metal object?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ċensier; jintuża biex jinħaraq fih l-inċens.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ċensier; jintuża biex jinħaraq fih l-inċens.
messages.zh: 那是香炉，用来焚香。
messages.en: That's a censer; it's used for burning incense.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċensier 和仪式中香炉升起烟雾的画面绑定，看到词就想起“盛香焚烧的容器”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The hundredth anniversary of an event, or a celebration marking that anniversary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某一事件发生满一百年的周年纪念，或为此举行的庆祝活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mitt anniversarju ta' ġrajja, jew ċelebrazzjoni li ssir biex tfakkar dan l-anniversarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某事件的一百周年纪念，或纪念这一周年的庆典。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Anniversarju li jfakkar li għaddew mitt sena minn ġrajja, jew iċ-ċelebrazzjoni ta' dan l-anniversarju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The centenary of an event is its hundredth anniversary, or a celebration held to mark that anniversary.

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat wirja biex tfakkar iċ-ċentenarju tal-fondazzjoni tagħha.
formal.en: The school organized an exhibition to mark the centenary of its founding.
formal.zh: 学校举办了一场展览，纪念建校一百周年。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex hemm festa fl-iskola llum? Toni: Qed niċċelebraw iċ-ċentenarju tagħha; l-iskola twaqqfet mitt sena ilu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is there a celebration at school today? Toni: We're celebrating its centenary; the school was founded a hundred years ago.
colloquial.zh: Marija：今天学校为什么举行庆祝活动？Toni：我们在庆祝建校一百周年；学校是一百年前创办的。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 今天学校为什么举行庆祝活动？
messages.en: Why is there a celebration at school today?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed niċċelebraw iċ-ċentenarju tagħha; l-iskola twaqqfet mitt sena ilu.
messages.mt_standard: Qed niċċelebraw iċ-ċentenarju tagħha; l-iskola twaqqfet mitt sena ilu.
messages.zh: 我们在庆祝建校一百周年；学校是一百年前创办的。
messages.en: We're celebrating its centenary; the school was founded a hundred years ago.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象校庆横幅上写着大大的“100周年”，用这个画面记住 ċentenarju 表示百年纪念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A monetary unit equal to one hundredth of a euro or another currency divided into cents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 分，一种货币单位，等于一欧元或其他采用百分制货币基本单位的百分之一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità monetarja li tiswa parti waħda minn mija ta' ewro jew ta' munita oħra maqsuma f'ċenteżmi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分，欧元等货币的辅助单位，一百分等于一个基本货币单位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Unità ta' flus li tirrappreżenta parti waħda minn mija ta' ewro jew ta' unità monetarja oħra maqsuma f'ċenteżmi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cent is a unit of money worth one hundredth of a euro or of another currency divided into cents.

formal.mt: Il-prezz ta' kull envelop żdied b'ċenteżmu wieħed.
formal.en: The price of each envelope increased by one cent.
formal.zh: 每个信封的价格上涨了一分。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandi disa' u disgħin ċenteżmu. Biżżejjed għal ewro? Rita: Kważi! Jonqsok ċenteżmu wieħed.
colloquial.en: Mark: I have ninety-nine cents. Is that enough for one euro? Rita: Almost! You're one cent short.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我有九十九分。够一欧元了吗？Rita：差一点！你还差一分。

messages.speaker: Mark (孩子)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi disa' u disgħin ċenteżmu. Biżżejjed għal ewro?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi disa' u disgħin ċenteżmu. Biżżejjed għal ewro?
messages.zh: 我有九十九分。够一欧元了吗？
messages.en: I have ninety-nine cents. Is that enough for one euro?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 差一点！你还差一分。
messages.en: Almost! You're one cent short.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一欧元分成一百份，每份一分”来记 ċenteżmu，再想象九十九分还差一分的找钱场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A metric unit of length equal to one hundredth of a metre, or ten millimetres.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 厘米，公制长度单位，等于一米的百分之一，也就是十毫米。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità metrika ta' tul li hija parti waħda minn mija ta' metru u li tiswa għaxar millimetri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厘米，长度单位，一厘米等于百分之一米或十毫米。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżura ta' tul fis-sistema metrika li hija ugwali għal għaxar millimetri jew għal parti waħda minn mija ta' metru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A centimeter is a metric unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter, or ten millimeters.

formal.mt: Ħalli marġni ta' ċentimetru wieħed madwar l-istampa qabel taqta' l-karta.
formal.en: Leave a margin of one centimeter around the picture before cutting the paper.
formal.zh: 裁纸前，在图片四周留出一厘米的边距。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm għandi naqta' minn din iż-żigarella? Sara: Aqta' ċentimetru wieħed biss; kejlu bir-riga l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Nina: How much should I cut off this ribbon? Sara: Cut off just one centimeter; measure it with the ruler first.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这条丝带应该剪掉多长？Sara：只剪掉一厘米；先用尺子量一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm għandi naqta' minn din iż-żigarella?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm għandi naqta' minn din iż-żigarella?
messages.zh: 这条丝带应该剪掉多长？
messages.en: How much should I cut off this ribbon?

messages.speaker: Sara (手工教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqta' ċentimetru wieħed biss; kejlu bir-riga l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Aqta' ċentimetru wieħed biss; kejlu bir-riga l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 只剪掉一厘米；先用尺子量一下。
messages.en: Cut off just one centimeter; measure it with the ruler first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看尺子上从零到一厘米的距离，记住 ċentimetru 是厘米；一百个这样的长度正好是一米。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant that produces chayotes, fruits with a gourd-like shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种结出葫芦状果实的植物，指佛手瓜植株，也可用于谈论其果实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li tagħmel frott b'għamla li tixbah lil qargħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: chayote (a type of plant shaped like a gourd)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 佛手瓜，一种结出葫芦状果实的植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta li l-frott tagħha għandu għamla li tixbah lil qargħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chayote is a plant that produces fruits with a shape resembling a gourd.

collocations.en: the fruit of the chayote plant
collocations.zh: 佛手瓜植株结出的果实

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-pjanta taċ-ċentinarja u ddeskrivew l-għamla tal-frott tagħha.
formal.en: The students observed the chayote plant and described the shape of its fruit.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了佛手瓜植株，并描述了它的果实形状。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik il-pjanta fil-ġnien? Pawlu: Dik ċentinarja. Ara l-frott tagħha, qisu qargħa żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that plant in the garden? Pawlu: That's a chayote plant. Look at its fruit; it's like a little gourd.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：花园里那是什么植物？保罗：那是佛手瓜。看看它的果实，像个小葫芦。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 花园里那是什么植物？
messages.en: What's that plant in the garden?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik ċentinarja. Ara l-frott tagħha, qisu qargħa żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Dik ċentinarja. Ara l-frott tagħha, qisu qargħa żgħira.
messages.zh: 那是佛手瓜。看看它的果实，像个小葫芦。
messages.en: That's a chayote plant. Look at its fruit; it's like a little gourd.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċentinarja配上一张佛手瓜植株图，先指植株再指葫芦状果实，用图像把词与实物连接起来。

gloss_zh: 客户电话服务中心；客服呼叫中心

teaching_sense.en_definition: A centre where staff answer customers' telephone calls and provide assistance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由工作人员接听客户电话、解答问题并提供帮助的服务中心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċentru fejn il-ħaddiema jwieġbu t-telefonati tal-klijenti u jagħtuhom għajnuna jew informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 客服呼叫中心，通过电话为客户提供咨询和帮助的服务机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċentru li jipprovdi servizz lill-klijenti bit-telefon, billi jwieġeb il-mistoqsijiet tagħhom u jgħinhom isolvu problemi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customer call centre is a place where staff handle telephone enquiries and help customers with problems.

collocations.en: to call the customer call centre
to work in a customer call centre

formal.mt: Għal mistoqsijiet dwar il-kont tiegħek, jekk jogħġbok ikkuntattja ċ-ċentru telefoniku għall-klijenti.
formal.en: For questions about your account, please contact the customer call centre.
formal.zh: 如有关于您账户的问题，请联系客户电话服务中心。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandi mistoqsija dwar il-kont. Lil min inċempel? Sara: Ċempel liċ-ċentru telefoniku għall-klijenti. Hemmhekk jistgħu jgħinuk.
colloquial.en: Mark: I have a question about the account. Who should I call? Sara: Call the customer call centre. They can help you there.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我有个账户方面的问题，该给谁打电话？萨拉：打给客服呼叫中心，那里的人能帮你。

messages.speaker: Mark (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi mistoqsija dwar il-kont. Lil min inċempel?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi mistoqsija dwar il-kont. Lil min inċempel?
messages.zh: 我有个账户方面的问题，该给谁打电话？
messages.en: I have a question about the account. Who should I call?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċempel liċ-ċentru telefoniku għall-klijenti. Hemmhekk jistgħu jgħinuk.
messages.mt_standard: Ċempel liċ-ċentru telefoniku għall-klijenti. Hemmhekk jistgħu jgħinuk.
messages.zh: 打给客服呼叫中心，那里的人能帮你。
messages.en: Call the customer call centre. They can help you there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按词组分块记忆：ċentru是中心，telefoniku表示电话的，għall-klijenti表示为客户服务；连起来就是客户电话服务中心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bell that makes a ringing sound when moved or struck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摇动或敲击时会发出清脆铃声的小铃铛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qanpiena żgħira li tagħmel ħoss meta titħarrek jew tintlaqat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小铃铛；体积较小、摇动或敲击时会响的铃。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qanpiena ta' daqs żgħir li ddoqq meta titħarrek jew meta xi ħaġa tolqotha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A little bell is a small object that produces a ringing sound when shaken or struck.

collocations.en: the sound of the little bell

formal.mt: L-għalliema ħawdet ċenċiela biex tiġbed l-attenzjoni tat-tfal qabel ma bdiet l-attività.
formal.en: The teacher shook a little bell to get the children's attention before starting the activity.
formal.zh: 老师在开始活动前摇了摇小铃铛，以引起孩子们的注意。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhu dak il-ħoss? Pawlu: Hemm ċenċiela fil-kaxxa. Lina: Ħawwadha ħalli nismagħha mill-ġdid!
colloquial.en: Lina: What's that sound? Pawlu: There's a little bell in the box. Lina: Shake it so I can hear it again!
colloquial.zh: Lina：那是什么声音？Pawlu：盒子里有个小铃铛。Lina：摇一摇，让我再听一次！

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 盒子里有个小铃铛。
messages.en: There's a little bell in the box.

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 摇一摇，让我再听一次！
messages.en: Shake it so I can hear it again!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象盒子里藏着一枚小铃铛，边摇边念ċenċiela，把词形与清脆铃声一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The English language, considered as a language that people speak, read, write, or study.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英语，指可供人们交谈、阅读、写作或学习的一种语言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-lingwa Ingliża, li tintuża fit-taħdit u fil-kitba u li tista' titgħallem bħala suġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英语，作为一种语言的名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-lingwa Ingliża, użata biex in-nies jitkellmu, jaqraw, jiktbu u jikkomunikaw bejniethom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: English is a language that people use for speaking, reading, writing, and communicating with one another.

formal.mt: Il-kors taċ-ċepħa jinkludi eżerċizzji fil-qari, fil-kitba u fit-taħdit.
formal.en: The English course includes exercises in reading, writing, and speaking.
formal.zh: 这门英语课程包含阅读、写作和口语练习。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed tistudja llum? Ben: Qed nistudja ċ-ċepħa. Għandi eżerċizzju tal-qari għal għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you studying today? Ben: I'm studying English. I have a reading exercise for tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今天在学什么？本：我在学英语，明天要交一份阅读练习。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你今天在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying today?

messages.speaker: Ben (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistudja ċ-ċepħa. Għandi eżerċizzju tal-qari għal għada.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nistudja ċ-ċepħa. Għandi eżerċizzju tal-qari għal għada.
messages.zh: 我在学英语，明天要交一份阅读练习。
messages.en: I'm studying English. I have a reading exercise for tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为本条指定的英语义制作配对卡：正面写ċepħa，背面写英语，并画上听说读写四个学习图标。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hard material made by firing clay, or pottery objects and the craft of making them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将黏土烧制而成的坚硬材料，也指陶制器物或制作这些器物的工艺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal iebes magħmul bit-tafal li jinħaraq f'forn, jew l-oġġetti magħmula minnu u l-arti ta' kif isiru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陶瓷，指由黏土等材料经高温烧制而成的坚硬材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal iebes li jsir meta t-tafal jingħata forma u jinħaraq f'forn f'temperatura għolja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ceramic is a hard material made by shaping clay and firing it at a high temperature.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陶器，指用黏土塑形并烧制的器物；也指制作陶器的工艺，即陶艺。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti bħal skutelli, tazzi u vażuni magħmula mit-tafal u maħruqa f'forn, jew l-arti ta' kif isiru dawn l-oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pottery consists of objects made from clay and fired in a kiln, and also refers to the craft of making them.

formal.mt: Fil-kors taċ-ċeramika, l-istudenti jitgħallmu jagħtu forma lit-tafal u jagħmlu oġġetti li mbagħad jinħarqu f'forn.
formal.en: On the pottery course, students learn to shape clay and make objects that are then fired in a kiln.
formal.zh: 在陶艺课程中，学生学习给黏土塑形，制作随后放入窑中烧制的器物。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din it-tazza taċ-ċeramika għamiltha int? Karl: Iva, għamiltha fil-kors taċ-ċeramika. Trid tara l-iskutella wkoll?
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you make this ceramic cup yourself? Karl: Yes, I made it on the pottery course. Would you like to see the bowl too?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个陶瓷杯是你自己做的吗？卡尔：是啊，我在陶艺课上做的。你还想看看那个碗吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个陶瓷杯是你自己做的吗？
messages.en: Did you make this ceramic cup yourself?

messages.speaker: Karl (陶艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għamiltha fil-kors taċ-ċeramika. Trid tara l-iskutella wkoll?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għamiltha fil-kors taċ-ċeramika. Trid tara l-iskutella wkoll?
messages.zh: 是啊，我在陶艺课上做的。你还想看看那个碗吗？
messages.en: Yes, I made it on the pottery course. Would you like to see the bowl too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一条制作画面串联词义：黏土塑形、入窑烧制、成为杯碗；材料记陶瓷，成品记陶器，制作活动记陶艺。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Grain-producing plants, their edible grains, or breakfast foods made from those grains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供食用籽粒的谷类植物及其谷粒，也指用这些谷粒制成的早餐麦片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanti bħall-qamħ, ix-xgħir u l-ħafur, iż-żrieragħ tagħhom li jintużaw bħala ikel, jew prodotti tal-kolazzjon magħmula minnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谷类植物或其可食用谷粒；也指以谷物制成、常配牛奶食用的早餐麦片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanti li jitkabbru għaż-żrieragħ tagħhom li jittieklu, iż-żrieragħ infushom, jew ikel tal-kolazzjon magħmul minn dawn iż-żrieragħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Cereal refers to grain crops, their edible grains, or breakfast food prepared from those grains.

formal.mt: Iċ-ċereali bħall-qamħ u x-xgħir jintużaw fil-produzzjoni ta' diversi tipi ta' ikel.
formal.en: Cereals such as wheat and barley are used in the production of various types of food.
formal.zh: 小麦和大麦等谷物用于制作多种食品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi trid għall-kolazzjon? Pawlu: Nixtieq skutella ċereali bil-ħalib, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: What would you like for breakfast? Pawlu: I'd like a bowl of cereal with milk, please.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：早餐你想吃什么？保罗：请给我一碗加牛奶的麦片。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 早餐你想吃什么？
messages.en: What would you like for breakfast?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq skutella ċereali bil-ħalib, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq skutella ċereali bil-ħalib, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我一碗加牛奶的麦片。
messages.en: I'd like a bowl of cereal with milk, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把麦田里的谷粒和早餐碗里的麦片连成一幅图，记住ċereali既可指谷物，也可指早餐麦片。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal event with an arranged sequence of actions marking an important occasion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为纪念、庆祝或确认重要事项，按照一定程序举行的正式活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avveniment formali b'sensiela ta' atti organizzati biex tiġi ċċelebrata jew imfakkra okkażjoni importanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为庆祝、纪念或正式确认某件重要事情，依照既定程序举行的仪式或典礼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attività formali li ssir skont ordni jew drawwiet stabbiliti biex timmarka okkażjoni importanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ceremony is a formal event in which particular actions are performed to mark an important occasion.

formal.mt: Iċ-ċerimonja tal-ftuħ tal-wirja se ssir nhar il-Ġimgħa fis-sitta ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: The exhibition's opening ceremony will take place on Friday at six in the evening.
formal.zh: 展览开幕式将于星期五傍晚六点举行。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'ħin tibda ċ-ċerimonja tal-gradwazzjoni? David: Fl-għaxra, imma ejja naslu ftit qabel.
colloquial.en: Marija: What time does the graduation ceremony start? David: At ten, but let's arrive a little early.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：毕业典礼几点开始？戴维：十点，不过我们提前一点到吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 毕业典礼几点开始？
messages.en: What time does the graduation ceremony start?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-għaxra, imma ejja naslu ftit qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-għaxra, imma ejja naslu ftit qabel.
messages.zh: 十点，不过我们提前一点到吧。
messages.en: At ten, but let's arrive a little early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象毕业生依次上台、接过证书的正式流程，用这个场景把ċerimonja记成仪式或典礼。

gloss_zh: 确定的；确信的；有把握的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Definitely true or going to happen, or feeling confident that something is true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示事情确定属实或会发生，也表示人对某件事确信、有把握。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li huwa magħruf bħala veru jew li se jiġri bla dubju, jew li għandu fiduċja li xi ħaġa hija vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 确定的；确实的；指某事属实或会发生，没有疑问。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma hemmx dubju dwaru għax huwa veru jew għax se jiġri żgur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is certain, there is no doubt that it is true or will happen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 确信的；有把握的；指人相信某件事属实或正确，心中没有疑虑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jemmen bis-sħiħ li xi ħaġa hija vera jew korretta u ma jkollux dubju dwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are sure about something, you feel confident that it is true or correct.

collocations.en: sure of what he is saying
collocations.zh: 对自己所说的话有把握

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li s-suċċess tal-proġett għadu mhux ċert.
formal.en: The report indicates that the project's success is still uncertain.
formal.zh: 报告指出，该项目能否成功仍未确定。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Int ċert li l-laqgħa tibda fid-disgħa? Mark: Iva, jien ċert. Għadni kemm qrajt l-email.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you sure the meeting starts at nine? Mark: Yes, I'm sure. I've just read the email.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你确定会议九点开始吗？马克：对，我确定。我刚看过那封邮件。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Int ċert li l-laqgħa tibda fid-disgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Int ċert li l-laqgħa tibda fid-disgħa?
messages.zh: 你确定会议九点开始吗？
messages.en: Are you sure the meeting starts at nine?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien ċert. Għadni kemm qrajt l-email.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien ċert. Għadni kemm qrajt l-email.
messages.zh: 对，我确定。我刚看过那封邮件。
messages.en: Yes, I'm sure. I've just read the email.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个落点：事情没有疑问是确定的，人心里没有疑问是确信的；都可以用ċert表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to express strong confidence in a statement or to give an emphatic affirmative reply.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于强调说话者认为某事肯定属实或会发生，也可用于明确肯定的回答，表示当然。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex wieħed jesprimi fiduċja qawwija li xi ħaġa hija vera jew se tiġri, jew biex jagħti tweġiba affermattiva b'enfasi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肯定；无疑；用于表达对判断的强烈信心，或认为某事理应如此。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li turi li min jitkellem jemmen bis-sħiħ li dak li qed jgħid huwa veru jew li għandu jkun hekk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use surely to express strong confidence that something is true or should be expected.

formal.mt: Din il-miżura ċertament se ttejjeb l-aċċess għas-servizzi pubbliċi.
formal.en: This measure will surely improve access to public services.
formal.zh: 这项措施无疑会改善公众获取公共服务的条件。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se tiġi magħna għada? Luqa: Ċertament! Għidli biss x'ħin se nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you coming with us tomorrow? Luqa: Certainly! Just tell me what time we're leaving.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你明天和我们一起去吗？卢卡：当然！告诉我几点出发就行。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天和我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Are you coming with us tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċertament! Għidli biss x'ħin se nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Ċertament! Għidli biss x'ħin se nitilqu.
messages.zh: 当然！告诉我几点出发就行。
messages.en: Certainly! Just tell me what time we're leaving.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象回答邀请时坚定地点头说当然，再把这份肯定语气带进整句话，记住ċertament强调无疑或肯定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A firm state of conviction in which someone feels sure and does not hesitate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某件事深信不疑、态度明确而不动摇的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' konvinzjoni soda li fih persuna tkun żgura minn xi ħaġa u ma toqgħodx taħsibha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信念或态度的坚定性；确信而不犹豫的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' konvinzjoni jew pożizzjoni soda, mingħajr dubju jew eżitazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Firmness is the quality of being sure of your position and maintaining it without hesitation.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, ir-riċerkatriċi esprimiet ċertezza fil-konklużjoni tagħha u spjegat fuq liema provi kienet ibbażata.
formal.en: In her report, the researcher expressed firm conviction in her conclusion and explained the evidence on which it was based.
formal.zh: 研究人员在报告中表达了对自己结论的坚定信念，并说明了结论所依据的证据。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tkellimt b'dik iċ-ċertezza? Lara: Għax kont ivverifikajt il-fatti qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you speak with such assurance? Lara: Because I had checked the facts beforehand.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说得那么肯定？拉拉：因为我事先核实过事实。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说得那么肯定？
messages.en: Why did you speak with such assurance?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为我事先核实过事实。
messages.en: Because I had checked the facts beforehand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċertezza 联想成核实事实后稳稳点头：心里确信，说话坚定。

gloss_zh: 植物检疫证书；植物卫生证书

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official document certifying that plants or plant products meet the applicable plant health requirements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 证明植物或植物产品符合适用植物卫生要求的官方文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument uffiċjali li jiċċertifika li pjanti jew prodotti tal-pjanti jissodisfaw ir-rekwiżiti applikabbli dwar is-saħħa tal-pjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物检疫证书，证明有关植物或植物产品符合适用的植物卫生要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument uffiċjali li jiċċertifika li l-pjanti jew il-prodotti tal-pjanti koperti minnu jissodisfaw ir-rekwiżiti fitosanitarji applikabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A phytosanitary certificate is an official document confirming that specified plants or plant products satisfy applicable plant health requirements.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物卫生证书，用于证明有关植物或植物产品符合植物卫生要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċertifikat uffiċjali dwar is-saħħa tal-pjanti li jikkonferma li l-pjanti jew il-prodotti msemmija fih jissodisfaw ir-rekwiżiti applikabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A plant health certificate is a document that certifies compliance with the plant health requirements applying to the plants or products described.

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal ivverifika li d-dettalji fuq iċ-ċertifikat fitosanitarju kienu jaqblu mal-pjanti fil-kunsinna.
formal.en: The officer checked that the details on the phytosanitary certificate matched the plants in the consignment.
formal.zh: 工作人员核查了植物检疫证书上的信息是否与该批货物中的植物相符。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu ċ-ċertifikat fitosanitarju għal dawn il-pjanti? Rita: Qiegħed fil-fajl tal-kunsinna; se nġibu issa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the phytosanitary certificate for these plants? Rita: It is in the shipment file; I will get it now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些植物的检疫证书在哪里？丽塔：在这批货物的文件夹里，我现在去拿。

messages.speaker: Mark (货运协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu ċ-ċertifikat fitosanitarju għal dawn il-pjanti?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu ċ-ċertifikat fitosanitarju għal dawn il-pjanti?
messages.zh: 这些植物的检疫证书在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the phytosanitary certificate for these plants?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed fil-fajl tal-kunsinna; se nġibu issa.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed fil-fajl tal-kunsinna; se nġibu issa.
messages.zh: 在这批货物的文件夹里，我现在去拿。
messages.en: It is in the shipment file; I will get it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一箱植物旁放着健康检查文件：把整个词组与“植物检疫证书”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 预先核定证书；出口条件预先核定证书

teaching_sense.en_definition: A certificate recording that specified terms or amounts for a trade transaction have been fixed in advance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 记载某项贸易交易的特定条件或金额已预先核定的证书。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċertifikat li jiddokumenta li ċerti kundizzjonijiet jew ammonti għal tranżazzjoni kummerċjali ġew iffissati minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预先核定证书，证明有关交易条件或金额已提前确定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li jiċċertifika li kundizzjonijiet jew ammonti speċifikati għal tranżazzjoni ġew stabbiliti qabel ma titwettaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An advance fixing certificate is a document recording terms or amounts that have been established before the relevant transaction takes place.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出口预先核定证书，记载出口交易中事先核定的有关条件或金额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċertifikat marbut ma' esportazzjoni li jiddokumenta l-iffissar minn qabel ta' kundizzjonijiet jew ammonti relatati magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this export context, the expression refers to a certificate recording relevant terms or amounts fixed before the export transaction.

collocations.en: to request an advance fixing certificate
to check an advance fixing certificate

formal.mt: Qabel ma pproċediet bit-tranżazzjoni, il-kumpanija vverifikat il-kundizzjonijiet imniżżla fiċ-ċertifikat ta' ffissar bil-quddiem.
formal.en: Before proceeding with the transaction, the company checked the terms recorded in the advance fixing certificate.
formal.zh: 公司在继续办理交易之前，核查了预先核定证书中列明的条件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek iċ-ċertifikat ta' ffissar bil-quddiem? Pawlu: Iva, hawn hu. Ejja niċċekkjaw il-kundizzjonijiet flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have the advance fixing certificate? Pawlu: Yes, here it is. Let us check the terms together.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：预先核定证书在你那里吗？保罗：在，这就是。我们一起核对一下条件吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (出口业务员)
messages.zh: 预先核定证书在你那里吗？
messages.en: Do you have the advance fixing certificate?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn hu. Ejja niċċekkjaw il-kundizzjonijiet flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn hu. Ejja niċċekkjaw il-kundizzjonijiet flimkien.
messages.zh: 在，这就是。我们一起核对一下条件吧。
messages.en: Yes, here it is. Let us check the terms together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“证书—核定—提前”分块记忆，想象交易开始前就把条件写定在证书上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official document that certifies an import or authorizes goods to be imported, depending on its function.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据具体用途，证明货物进口情况或准许货物进口的官方文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument uffiċjali li, skont il-funzjoni tiegħu, jiċċertifika importazzjoni jew jagħti permess biex jiġu importati oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口证明书，用于证明有关货物的进口情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument uffiċjali li jiċċertifika l-importazzjoni tal-oġġetti msemmija fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A certificate of import is an official document certifying the import of the goods identified in it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口证明书，用于证明所列货物的进口事项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċertifikat uffiċjali li jagħti prova tal-importazzjoni tal-merkanzija deskritta fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A certificate of importation provides official confirmation of the importation of the goods described in the document.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口证书，证明有关进口事项或所列进口货物情况的文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument uffiċjali li jiċċertifika informazzjoni dwar importazzjoni jew dwar l-oġġetti importati msemmija fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An import certificate is an official document certifying information about an import or the imported goods it identifies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口许可证，由主管机构签发、准许进口指定货物的文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument maħruġ minn awtorità kompetenti li jawtorizza l-importazzjoni ta' oġġetti speċifikati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An import licence is an official authorization allowing specified goods to be imported under the conditions stated.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口许可文件，准许按照规定条件进口有关货物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Permess uffiċjali li jippermetti li l-oġġetti koperti minnu jiġu importati skont il-kundizzjonijiet stabbiliti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An import permit is an official document giving permission to import the goods covered by it.

collocations.en: to apply for an import certificate

formal.mt: L-impjegata qabblet id-deskrizzjoni tal-merkanzija fuq iċ-ċertifikat ta' importazzjoni mad-dettalji fuq il-fattura.
formal.en: The employee compared the description of the goods on the import certificate with the details on the invoice.
formal.zh: 工作人员将进口证书上的货物描述与发票上的详细信息进行了核对。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandna ċ-ċertifikat ta' importazzjoni għal din il-kunsinna? Mark: Iva, qiegħed mal-fattura. Se nibgħatlek kopja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do we have the import certificate for this shipment? Mark: Yes, it is with the invoice. I will send you a copy.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们有这批货物的进口证书吗？马克：有，和发票放在一起。我给你发一份副本。

messages.speaker: Nina (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna ċ-ċertifikat ta' importazzjoni għal din il-kunsinna?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna ċ-ċertifikat ta' importazzjoni għal din il-kunsinna?
messages.zh: 我们有这批货物的进口证书吗？
messages.en: Do we have the import certificate for this shipment?

messages.speaker: Mark (物流同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed mal-fattura. Se nibgħatlek kopja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed mal-fattura. Se nibgħatlek kopja.
messages.zh: 有，和发票放在一起。我给你发一份副本。
messages.en: Yes, it is with the invoice. I will send you a copy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词组放进“货物进入本国，随附进口文件”的画面中；具体译成证书还是许可证，要看文件是在证明还是准许进口。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A certificate issued before goods are exported.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在货物出口之前签发的证书。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċertifikat li jinħareġ qabel ma tiġi esportata l-merkanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出口前证书，即在货物出口之前签发的证明文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument ta' ċertifikazzjoni li jinħareġ qabel l-esportazzjoni tal-merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pre-export certificate is a document issued before the goods concerned are exported.

collocations.mt: il-ħruġ ta' ċertifikat ta' qabel l-esportazzjoni
collocations.en: the issuing of a pre-export certificate
a copy of the pre-export certificate

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li ċ-ċertifikat ta' qabel l-esportazzjoni nħareġ qabel ma l-merkanzija telqet mill-pajjiż.
formal.en: The report indicates that the pre-export certificate was issued before the goods left the country.
formal.zh: 报告指出，出口前证书在货物离境之前已签发。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Wasal iċ-ċertifikat ta' qabel l-esportazzjoni? David: Iva, wasal dalgħodu. Ħallejt kopja fuq l-iskrivanija tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has the pre-export certificate arrived? David: Yes, it arrived this morning. I left a copy on your desk.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：出口前证书到了吗？戴维：到了，今天早上到的。我在你的办公桌上放了一份副本。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 出口前证书到了吗？
messages.en: Has the pre-export certificate arrived?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wasal dalgħodu. Ħallejt kopja fuq l-iskrivanija tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wasal dalgħodu. Ħallejt kopja fuq l-iskrivanija tiegħek.
messages.zh: 到了，今天早上到的。我在你的办公桌上放了一份副本。
messages.en: Yes, it arrived this morning. I left a copy on your desk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 qabel 表示“在……之前”：把画面排成“先拿到证书，后出口货物”，就能记住整个词组强调的是出口前这个时间点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A certificate recording an advance fixing connected with an export.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 记录与出口有关的事项已预先核定的证书。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċertifikat li juri li sar iffissar minn qabel ta' aspetti marbuta mal-esportazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 证明有关事项已提前核定的证书；本词条用于出口语境。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċertifikat li juri li ċerti aspetti ġew iffissati minn qabel, f'dan il-każ b'rabta mal-esportazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An advance fixing certificate is a document recording that specified matters have been fixed beforehand.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 记录出口相关事项已预先核定的证明文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li jiċċertifika l-iffissar minn qabel ta' aspetti relatati mal-esportazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This expression refers to certification that export-related matters have been determined in advance.

collocations.en: an application for an advance fixing certificate for export
collocations.zh: 出口预先核定证书的申请

collocations.en: the issuing of the advance fixing certificate for export
collocations.zh: 出口预先核定证书的签发

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-applikazzjoni għal ċertifikat tal-esportazzjoni antiċipata u jindika d-data tal-ħruġ tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes the application for an advance fixing certificate for export and indicates its issue date.
formal.zh: 报告说明了出口预先核定证书的申请情况，并注明了证书的签发日期。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek iċ-ċertifikat tal-esportazzjoni antiċipata? Lara: Iva, qiegħed fil-fajl blu. Trid tara l-kopja?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have the advance fixing certificate for export? Lara: Yes, it is in the blue file. Would you like to see the copy?
colloquial.zh: 马克：出口预先核定证书在你那里吗？拉拉：在，放在蓝色文件夹里。你要看看副本吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 出口预先核定证书在你那里吗？
messages.en: Do you have the advance fixing certificate for export?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fil-fajl blu. Trid tara l-kopja?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fil-fajl blu. Trid tara l-kopja?
messages.zh: 在，放在蓝色文件夹里。你要看看副本吗？
messages.en: Yes, it is in the blue file. Would you like to see the copy?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个长词组放进“出口事项提前核定”的文件场景来记：看到证书，就联想“先核定，再处理出口”。这是学习提示，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 进口证明书；进口许可证

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official document certifying an import or granting permission to import goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于证明货物进口，或准许货物进口的正式文件；具体含义依语境而定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument uffiċjali li jiċċertifika l-importazzjoni ta' merkanzija jew jagħti permess biex tiġi importata, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口证明书，证明有关货物进口事项的文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li jiċċertifika fatti jew dettalji dwar l-importazzjoni ta' merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A certificate of import is a document certifying facts about goods being imported.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口证明书，用于证明货物的进口行为或相关情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċertifikat li jattesta l-importazzjoni ta' merkanzija jew dettalji marbuta magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A certificate of importation provides documentary confirmation of an import or its associated details.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口证书，用于证明进口相关事实的正式文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument uffiċjali li jagħti konferma ta' fatti relatati mal-importazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An import certificate is an official document confirming information relating to imported goods.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口许可证，由有关机构签发、准许进口货物的文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument maħruġ minn awtorità li jawtorizza l-importazzjoni ta' merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An import licence is an official document authorizing someone to bring goods into a country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口许可文件，表示已获准将货物输入某个国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li jagħti permess biex merkanzija tiddaħħal f'pajjiż minn barra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An import permit is a document granting permission for goods to enter a country.

collocations.en: an application for an import certificate
a copy of the import certificate

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija hemżet kopja taċ-ċertifikat tal-importazzjoni mar-rapport dwar il-merkanzija.
formal.en: The company attached a copy of the import certificate to the report on the goods.
formal.zh: 公司在货物报告中附上了进口证书的副本。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn poġġejt iċ-ċertifikat tal-importazzjoni? Pawlu: Fil-kexxun ta' fuq, ħdejn il-fattura.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where did you put the import certificate? Pawlu: In the top drawer, next to the invoice.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你把进口证书放在哪里了？保罗：最上面的抽屉里，就在发票旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你把进口证书放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the import certificate?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 最上面的抽屉里，就在发票旁边。
messages.en: In the top drawer, next to the invoice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一批货物进入国内，随货放着一份证书。语境强调事实时记作“进口证明”，强调准许时记作“进口许可”，把两种用途一起记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A deer, a plant-eating mammal with hooves and slender legs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鹿，一种以植物为食、长有蹄和细长腿的哺乳动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal mammiferu li jiekol il-pjanti u għandu n-nagħal u saqajn irqaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鹿，一种有蹄、腿较细长的食草哺乳动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal mammiferu b'nagħal u saqajn irqaq li jiekol il-pjanti u jista' jgħix fil-foresti jew f'art miftuħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A deer is a hoofed mammal with slender legs that feeds on plants.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, ir-riċerkaturi raw ċerva tirgħa ħdejn ix-xifer tal-foresta u rreġistraw l-imġiba tagħha.
formal.en: During the observation, the researchers saw a deer grazing near the edge of the forest and recorded its behaviour.
formal.zh: 观察期间，研究人员看到一只鹿在森林边缘附近吃草，并记录了它的行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, hemm ċerva ħdejn is-siġar! Mark: Rajtha! Ejja nibqgħu hawn u narawha mill-bogħod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, there is a deer near the trees! Mark: I see it! Let's stay here and watch it from a distance.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，树旁边有一只鹿！马克：我看到了！我们就待在这里，远远地看它吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，树旁边有一只鹿！
messages.en: Look, there is a deer near the trees!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha! Ejja nibqgħu hawn u narawha mill-bogħod.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha! Ejja nibqgħu hawn u narawha mill-bogħod.
messages.zh: 我看到了！我们就待在这里，远远地看它吧。
messages.en: I see it! Let's stay here and watch it from a distance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ċerva 配上一张“林边细腿鹿低头吃草”的心中图片，再朗读 ċerva tirgħa，把单词与鹿吃草的动作一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The transfer of a right or claim from one person or organization to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某项权利或请求权从一个人或机构转移给另一个人或机构的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-trasferiment ta' dritt jew pretensjoni minn persuna jew organizzazzjoni għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 转让，指将权利或请求权移交给另一方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċessjoni hija l-għoti jew it-trasferiment ta' dritt jew pretensjoni lil parti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An assignment is an arrangement in which a right or claim is transferred from one party to another.

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jiddeskrivi ċ-ċessjoni tad-drittijiet minn kumpanija għal oħra.
formal.en: The agreement describes the assignment of rights from one company to another.
formal.zh: 该协议说明了权利从一家公司转让给另一家公司的安排。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'ċessjoni' f'dan id-dokument? Mark: Hawn tfisser li dritt jgħaddi minn parti għal oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ċessjoni' mean in this document? Mark: Here it means that a right passes from one party to another.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这份文件里的ċessjoni是什么意思？Mark：这里指一项权利从一方转移给另一方。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 这份文件里的ċessjoni是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ċessjoni' mean in this document?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser li dritt jgħaddi minn parti għal oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser li dritt jgħaddi minn parti għal oħra.
messages.zh: 这里指一项权利从一方转移给另一方。
messages.en: Here it means that a right passes from one party to another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċessjoni想成把写着“权利”的文件递给另一方，用交接画面记住“转让”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the study of control, communication, and feedback in machines or living systems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与控制论有关的，即涉及机器或生命系统中的控制、通信与反馈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-istudju tal-kontroll, il-komunikazzjoni u r-rispons f'magni jew sistemi ħajjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 控制论的；与系统的控制、通信及反馈机制有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa ċibernetika għandha x'taqsam mal-mod kif is-sistemi jużaw l-informazzjoni u r-rispons biex jikkontrollaw il-ħidma tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is cybernetic concerns how systems use communication and feedback to control their operation.

formal.mt: L-istudju jippreżenta mudell ċibernetiku li juri kif ir-rispons jgħin biex tiġi rregolata sistema.
formal.en: The study presents a cybernetic model showing how feedback helps regulate a system.
formal.zh: 该研究提出了一个控制论模型，说明反馈如何帮助调节系统。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dan il-mudell jissejjaħ ċibernetiku? Pawlu: Għax juri kif sistema tuża r-rispons biex taġġusta l-ħidma tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is this model called cybernetic? Pawlu: Because it shows how a system uses feedback to adjust its operation.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么这个模型被称为控制论模型？Pawlu：因为它展示了系统如何利用反馈调整自身运行。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么这个模型被称为控制论模型？
messages.en: Why is this model called cybernetic?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax juri kif sistema tuża r-rispons biex taġġusta l-ħidma tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax juri kif sistema tuża r-rispons biex taġġusta l-ħidma tagħha.
messages.zh: 因为它展示了系统如何利用反馈调整自身运行。
messages.en: Because it shows how a system uses feedback to adjust its operation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċibernetiku配上一张“检测结果、反馈信息、调整运行”的循环图，记住“控制论的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A seabird known as the Mediterranean shearwater.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地中海鹱，一种在海上活动的海鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-baħar magħruf bl-isem Ingliż Mediterranean Shearwater, li jtir fuq il-baħar u jfittex l-ikel fl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地中海鹱，一种在海面上飞行并在海中觅食的海鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iċ-ċief huwa għasfur tal-baħar li jtir fuq l-ilma u jfittex l-ikel fil-baħar, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala Mediterranean Shearwater.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The Mediterranean shearwater is a seabird that flies over the sea and feeds in marine waters.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport isemmi ċ-ċief fost l-għasafar tal-baħar osservati matul l-istħarriġ.
formal.en: The report lists Mediterranean shearwaters among the seabirds observed during the survey.
formal.zh: 报告将地中海鹱列为调查期间观察到的海鸟之一。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għasafar huma dawk fuq il-baħar? Pawlu: Dawk huma ċief. Ħares lejhom bit-trombi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What birds are those over the sea? Pawlu: Those are Mediterranean shearwaters. Look at them through the binoculars.
colloquial.zh: Lara：海面上那些是什么鸟？Pawlu：那些是地中海鹱，用双筒望远镜看看。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 海面上那些是什么鸟？
messages.en: What birds are those over the sea?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟向导)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawk huma ċief. Ħares lejhom bit-trombi.
messages.mt_standard: Dawk huma ċief. Ħares lejhom bit-trombi.
messages.zh: 那些是地中海鹱，用双筒望远镜看看。
messages.en: Those are Mediterranean shearwaters. Look at them through the binoculars.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċief写在海面飞鸟的图旁，再配上“地中海鹱”，用海上观鸟场景帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A numerical amount that expresses an estimate, a quantity, or a price, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用数字表示的数额，可依语境指估计数、数量或价格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont espress b'numru li, skont il-kuntest, jindika stima, kwantità jew prezz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 估计数；依据现有资料推算、尚未最终确定的数额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ammont ikkalkulat bejn wieħed u ieħor fuq il-bażi tal-informazzjoni disponibbli, li għadu mhux ikkonfermat bħala finali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A figure used as an estimate gives an approximate amount before the exact amount is known.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 数量；用数字表达的个数或总量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għadd jew ammont ta' xi ħaġa espress b'numru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A figure expressing quantity tells you how many things there are or how much of something is involved.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 价格；购买商品或获得服务所需支付的金额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus mitluba jew imħallsa għal oġġett jew servizz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A figure used as a price states the amount of money requested or paid for something.

formal.mt: Iċ-ċifra ta' ħamest elef ewro fir-rapport hija stima tal-ispiża, u mhux il-prezz finali.
formal.en: The figure of five thousand euros in the report is an estimate of the cost, rather than the final price.
formal.zh: 报告中的五千欧元是费用估计数，并非最终价格。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm se tiswa t-tiswija? Mark: Għadhom ma tawniex prezz finali, imma semmew ċifra ta' madwar mitejn ewro.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much will the repair cost? Mark: They haven't given us a final price yet, but they mentioned a figure of around two hundred euros.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：维修要花多少钱？马克：他们还没给我们最终价格，不过提了一个大约两百欧元的数。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 维修要花多少钱？
messages.en: How much will the repair cost?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadhom ma tawniex prezz finali, imma semmew ċifra ta' madwar mitejn ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Għadhom ma tawniex prezz finali, imma semmew ċifra ta' madwar mitejn ewro.
messages.zh: 他们还没给我们最终价格，不过提了一个大约两百欧元的数。
messages.en: They haven't given us a final price yet, but they mentioned a figure of around two hundred euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċifra 放在预算表的数字格里记：未确定时是估计数，统计时是数量，报价时是价格；靠语境判断数额的用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of riding a bicycle, especially when practised as a sport.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 骑自行车的活动，尤指作为体育项目进行的自行车运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività tas-sewqan tar-rota, speċjalment meta ssir bħala sport.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骑自行车；以自行车骑行为内容的活动或运动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività tas-sewqan tar-rota, kemm għar-rikreazzjoni kif ukoll bħala eżerċizzju jew sport.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Cycling is the activity of riding a bicycle for recreation, exercise, or sport.

sense_translations.en_definition: practice of the sport of cycling
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从事自行车运动；以训练或比赛为目的进行自行车骑行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-prattika tas-sewqan tar-rota bħala sport, permezz ta' taħriġ jew parteċipazzjoni f'tiġrijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The practice of cycling as a sport involves riding a bicycle for athletic training or competition.

formal.mt: Il-klabb taċ-ċikliżmu jorganizza sessjonijiet ta' taħriġ kull ġimgħa għal min jixtieq jipprattika dan l-isport.
formal.en: The cycling club organises weekly training sessions for people who wish to practise the sport.
formal.zh: 自行车运动俱乐部每周为希望从事这项运动的人组织训练。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'sport tagħmel fi tmiem il-ġimgħa? David: Nipprattika ċ-ċikliżmu; is-Sibt immur bir-rota ma' sħabi.
colloquial.en: Sara: What sport do you do at weekends? David: I do cycling; on Saturdays I go riding with my friends.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你周末做什么运动？戴维：我骑自行车；星期六会和朋友们一起去骑车。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你周末做什么运动？
messages.en: What sport do you do at weekends?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nipprattika ċ-ċikliżmu; is-Sibt immur bir-rota ma' sħabi.
messages.mt_standard: Nipprattika ċ-ċikliżmu; is-Sibt immur bir-rota ma' sħabi.
messages.zh: 我骑自行车；星期六会和朋友们一起去骑车。
messages.en: I do cycling; on Saturdays I go riding with my friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ċikliżmu 时想象周末骑行和车队训练两个画面：前者帮助记骑车活动，后者帮助记正式的自行车运动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fireworks that produce bright lights, colours, and sounds when set off, especially during celebrations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 燃放时产生亮光、色彩和声响的烟花或焰火，尤其用于庆祝活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħob tan-nar li meta jinħaraq joħloq dawl, kuluri u ħsejjes, speċjalment waqt ċelebrazzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烟花；焰火；燃放后产生光彩和声响的庆祝用品或其表演。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Logħob tan-nar li jinħaraq biex joħloq effetti ta' dawl, kuluri u ħsejjes waqt festa jew ċelebrazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fireworks are devices set off during celebrations to produce colourful lights and sounds.

formal.mt: Skont il-programm taċ-ċelebrazzjoni, il-wirja taċ-ċikċifogu se tibda fid-disgħa ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: According to the celebration programme, the fireworks display will begin at nine in the evening.
formal.zh: 根据庆祝活动的安排，烟花表演将于晚上九点开始。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tiġi tara ċ-ċikċifogu llejla? Pawlu: Iva, niltaqgħu fil-pjazza qabel id-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to come and watch the fireworks tonight? Pawlu: Yes, let's meet in the square before nine.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今晚你想来看烟花吗？保罗：想，我们九点前在广场见吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚你想来看烟花吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come and watch the fireworks tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，我们九点前在广场见吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's meet in the square before nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面记 ċikċifogu：夜晚的广场上，人们抬头看彩光绽放；把整个词与一场烟花表演一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming from Chile or relating to Chile, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自智利的，或与智利、智利人民及其文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej miċ-Ċilì jew li għandu x'jaqsam maċ-Ċilì, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 智利的；与智利这个国家、其人民或文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam maċ-Ċilì bħala pajjiż, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Chilean is connected with Chile, its people, or its culture.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or related to Chile
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自智利的，或与智利有联系的；表示来源地或关联。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joriġina miċ-Ċilì jew li għandu rabta ma' dan il-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or thing described this way comes from Chile or has a connection with that country.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-festival jinkludi laqgħa ma' kittieb ċilen li se jitkellem dwar il-letteratura ta' pajjiżu.
formal.en: The festival programme includes a meeting with a Chilean writer who will discuss the literature of his country.
formal.zh: 文化节的活动安排包括与一位智利作家见面，他将介绍本国文学。
