colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn hu dan l-inbid? Mark: Huwa ċilen; xtrajtu għall-ikla tal-lejla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is this wine from? Mark: It's Chilean; I bought it for tonight's dinner.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这瓶葡萄酒是哪儿产的？马克：是智利的；我买来配今晚的晚餐。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这瓶葡萄酒是哪儿产的？
messages.en: Where is this wine from?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是智利的；我买来配今晚的晚餐。
messages.en: It's Chilean; I bought it for tonight's dinner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċilen 当作写着“智利的”的小标签，分别贴在作家介绍和葡萄酒标签上，记住它修饰人或物的来源与关联。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the shape of a cylinder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈圆柱体形状的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi oġġett li għandu l-forma ta' ċilindru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圆柱形的；具有圆柱体形状的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett ċilindriku għandu l-forma ta' ċilindru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An object that is cylindrical has the shape of a cylinder.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形状像圆柱体的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li l-forma tagħha tixbah lil ċilindru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something shaped like a cylinder has a circular cross section and a curved side.

formal.mt: Għal dan l-esperiment, jintuża kontenitur ċilindriku magħmul mill-ħġieġ.
formal.en: For this experiment, a cylindrical container made of glass is used.
formal.zh: 本实验使用一个玻璃制的圆柱形容器。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema kontenitur trid? Mark: Dak ċilindriku, ħdejn il-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which container do you want? Mark: The cylindrical one, next to the box.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你要哪个容器？马克：盒子旁边那个圆柱形的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要哪个容器？
messages.en: Which container do you want?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 盒子旁边那个圆柱形的。
messages.en: The cylindrical one, next to the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个直立的圆筒，把 ċilindriku 与“圆柱形的”一起记；练说 kontenitur ċilindriku，用形状修饰容器。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong cylindrical container used to store gas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于储存气体的坚固圆柱形容器，日常也可指燃气钢瓶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontenitur b'saħħtu f'forma ta' ċilindru li jintuża biex jinħażen il-gass.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 气瓶；用来储存气体的圆柱形容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċilindru tal-gass huwa kontenitur b'saħħtu li jintuża għall-ħażna tal-gass.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gas cylinder is a strong container used for storing gas.

formal.mt: Fir-reġistru tal-ħażna hemm imniżżel ċilindru tal-gass mimli u wieħed vojt.
formal.en: The stock register lists one full gas cylinder and one empty one.
formal.zh: 库存登记簿列有一个满气瓶和一个空气瓶。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom ċilindru tal-gass mimli? Rita: Iva, trid tibdel dak vojt?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a full gas cylinder? Rita: Yes, do you want to exchange the empty one?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们有满的燃气瓶吗？丽塔：有，你想把那个空瓶换掉吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们有满的燃气瓶吗？
messages.en: Do you have a full gas cylinder?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 有，你想把那个空瓶换掉吗？
messages.en: Yes, do you want to exchange the empty one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与家用燃气瓶的画面绑定，再用 mimli“满的”和 vojt“空的”做对照，记住 ċilindru tal-gass。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The country of China, in East Asia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 中国，位于东亚的国家名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċ-Ċina hija pajjiż fil-Lvant tal-Asja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中国，位于东亚的国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċina huwa l-isem proprju ta' pajjiż fil-Lvant tal-Asja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: China is a country located in East Asia.

formal.mt: Id-delegazzjoni se żżur iċ-Ċina biex tieħu sehem f'konferenza internazzjonali.
formal.en: The delegation will visit China to take part in an international conference.
formal.zh: 代表团将访问中国，参加一场国际会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn jgħix ħuk issa? Lara: Jgħix fiċ-Ċina, u se mmur inżuru x-xahar id-dieħel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where does your brother live now? Lara: He lives in China, and I am going to visit him next month.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥现在住在哪里？拉拉：他住在中国，我下个月要去看他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥现在住在哪里？
messages.en: Where does your brother live now?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jgħix fiċ-Ċina, u se mmur inżuru x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: Jgħix fiċ-Ċina, u se mmur inżuru x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 他住在中国，我下个月要去看他。
messages.en: He lives in China, and I am going to visit him next month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中地图上给中国贴上 Ċina 标签，注意国家名首字母大写；再把 fiċ-Ċina 整体记成“在中国”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where people watch films shown on a large screen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供观众观看大银幕电影的场所，即电影院。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jintwerew films fuq skrin kbir biex jarahom l-udjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电影院；向观众放映电影的场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċinema hija post fejn in-nies imorru jaraw films fuq skrin kbir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cinema is a place where people watch films on a large screen.

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat żjara fiċ-ċinema biex l-istudenti jaraw film edukattiv.
formal.en: The school organized a visit to the cinema so that the students could watch an educational film.
formal.zh: 学校组织学生前往电影院，观看一部教育影片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid immorru ċ-ċinema llejla? Mark: Iva! Liema film tixtieq tara?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to go to the cinema tonight? Mark: Yes! Which film would you like to see?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今晚想一起去电影院吗？马克：好啊！你想看哪部电影？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚想一起去电影院吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go to the cinema tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好啊！你想看哪部电影？
messages.en: Yes! Which film would you like to see?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċinema 和英语 cinema 对照记忆，想象拿着电影票走进影院；再用 biljett taċ-ċinema 串起“电影票”的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A belt that transmits power to drive a mechanical fan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将动力传递给机械风扇、使其转动的传动带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċinga li tittrasmetti l-moviment minn mutur għal fann biex iddawru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于传递动力、带动机械风扇转动的皮带。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċinga li twassal il-moviment minn mutur għall-fann sabiex il-fann idur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fan belt is a belt that transfers power from an engine or motor to a fan.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, it-tekniku sab li ċ-ċinga tal-fann kienet mikula u kellha tinbidel.
formal.en: During the inspection, the technician found that the fan belt was worn and needed replacing.
formal.zh: 检查时，技术人员发现风扇传动带已经磨损，需要更换。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Minn fejn ġej dak il-ħoss? Toni: Miċ-ċinga tal-fann. Se niċċekkjaha issa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is that noise coming from? Toni: From the fan belt. I'll check it now.
colloquial.zh: Mark：那个声音是从哪里传来的？Toni：风扇传动带那里。我现在检查一下。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 那个声音是从哪里传来的？
messages.en: Where is that noise coming from?

messages.speaker: Toni (维修师傅)
messages.zh: 风扇传动带那里。我现在检查一下。
messages.en: From the fan belt. I'll check it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上一幅“皮带带动风扇”的画面，再连读“检查风扇传动带”和“更换风扇传动带”，用动作记住这件机械零件。

gloss_zh: 犬儒的；愤世嫉俗的；犬儒者

teaching_sense.en_definition: Distrustful of people's sincerity and inclined to believe that they act mainly for their own benefit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不相信他人的真诚，倾向于认为人主要出于自身利益而行动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jafdax fis-sinċerità tan-nies u għandu t-tendenza jemmen li jaġixxu l-aktar għall-interess tagħhom stess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不轻信他人真诚、常认为人的行为主要出于私利的人；犬儒者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ma tafdax fis-sinċerità tal-oħrajn u taħseb li ħafna minn dak li jagħmlu jkun għall-interess tagħhom stess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cynic is someone who tends to believe that people act for selfish reasons rather than from sincere intentions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对他人的动机和真诚持不信任态度、常认定其出于私利的；愤世嫉俗的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri nuqqas ta' fiduċja fis-sinċerità tal-oħrajn u jemmen li l-imġiba tagħhom tkun immexxija mill-interess personali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is cynical, they tend to distrust people's sincerity and suspect that their actions are motivated by self-interest.

formal.mt: L-awtur jadotta ton ċiniku meta jiddeskrivi l-wegħdiet tal-mexxejja, għax iqishom bħala mezz biex jiksbu aktar poter.
formal.en: The author adopts a cynical tone when describing the leaders' promises, viewing them as a means of gaining more power.
formal.zh: 作者以愤世嫉俗的语气描述领导者的承诺，认为这些承诺是他们获取更多权力的手段。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu offra li jgħinna nġorru l-kaxxi. Mark: Żgur irid xi ħaġa mingħandna. Maja: Kemm int ċiniku! Forsi jrid jgħin biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu offered to help us carry the boxes. Mark: He must want something from us. Maja: You're so cynical! Maybe he just wants to help.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu说可以帮我们搬箱子。Mark：他肯定想从我们这里得到什么。Maja：你也太不相信别人的好意了！也许他只是想帮忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu offra li jgħinna nġorru l-kaxxi.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu offra li jgħinna nġorru l-kaxxi.
messages.zh: Pawlu说可以帮我们搬箱子。
messages.en: Pawlu offered to help us carry the boxes.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他肯定想从我们这里得到什么。
messages.en: He must want something from us.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm int ċiniku! Forsi jrid jgħin biss.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm int ċiniku! Forsi jrid jgħin biss.
messages.zh: 你也太不相信别人的好意了！也许他只是想帮忙。
messages.en: You're so cynical! Maybe he just wants to help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人听到好意，总问“他想得到什么？”：用 ċiniku 描写这种态度，也可指抱有这种想法的人，分别记住形容词和人物义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An attitude of distrust towards people's sincerity, especially the belief that they act mainly out of self-interest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不信任他人真诚的态度，尤其指认为人的行为主要由私利驱动的心态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attitudni ta' nuqqas ta' fiduċja fis-sinċerità tan-nies, speċjalment it-twemmin li jaġixxu l-aktar għall-interess tagħhom stess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怀疑他人真诚、倾向于把他人行为解释为追求私利的态度；犬儒心态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attitudni li biha wieħed jiddubita s-sinċerità tal-oħrajn u jqis l-interess personali bħala l-motiv ewlieni tal-imġiba tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Cynicism is an attitude in which you distrust people's sincerity and believe that they are mainly concerned with their own interests.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinnota ċiniżmu fost ir-residenti, li jemmnu li l-wegħdiet il-ġodda saru biss biex jinkisbu l-voti tagħhom.
formal.en: The report notes cynicism among residents, who believe that the new promises were made solely to win their votes.
formal.zh: 报告指出，居民抱有犬儒心态，认为新承诺只是为了赢得他们的选票。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex taħseb li kull min jgħin irid xi ħaġa lura? Luqa: Wara dak li ġara, ftit għadni nafda. Sara: Nifhmek, imma dan iċ-ċiniżmu qed iġiegħlek tiddubita minn kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you think everyone who helps wants something in return? Luqa: After what happened, I hardly trust anyone anymore. Sara: I understand, but this cynicism is making you doubt everyone.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么觉得每个帮忙的人都想要回报？Luqa：发生那件事以后，我已经很难相信别人了。Sara：我理解你，但这种犬儒心态让你怀疑每一个人。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex taħseb li kull min jgħin irid xi ħaġa lura?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex taħseb li kull min jgħin irid xi ħaġa lura?
messages.zh: 你为什么觉得每个帮忙的人都想要回报？
messages.en: Why do you think everyone who helps wants something in return?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara dak li ġara, ftit għadni nafda.
messages.mt_standard: Wara dak li ġara, ftit għadni nafda.
messages.zh: 发生那件事以后，我已经很难相信别人了。
messages.en: After what happened, I hardly trust anyone anymore.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhmek, imma dan iċ-ċiniżmu qed iġiegħlek tiddubita minn kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Nifhmek, imma dan iċ-ċiniżmu qed iġiegħlek tiddubita minn kulħadd.
messages.zh: 我理解你，但这种犬儒心态让你怀疑每一个人。
messages.en: I understand, but this cynicism is making you doubt everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“人人做事都是为了自己”写进一个思想气泡，用 ċiniżmu 给整个气泡命名：这里记的是一种心态，核心是不相信他人的真诚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tropical tree whose bark is a source of quinine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种热带树木，其树皮可用于提取奎宁，称为金鸡纳树。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġra tropikali li mill-qoxra tagħha tinkiseb il-kinina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金鸡纳树，一种树皮含有奎宁的热带树木。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Siġra li tikber f'reġjuni tropikali u li l-qoxra tagħha fiha l-kinina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Cinchona is a tropical tree whose bark contains quinine.

formal.mt: Il-gwida botanika tiddeskrivi ċ-ċinkona bħala siġra tropikali u tispjega li mill-qoxra tagħha tinkiseb il-kinina.
formal.en: The botanical guide describes cinchona as a tropical tree and explains that quinine is obtained from its bark.
formal.zh: 这本植物指南将金鸡纳树描述为一种热带树木，并说明奎宁可从其树皮中提取。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jisimha din is-siġra? Marija: Ċinkona. Il-qoxra tagħha fiha l-kinina. Nina: Se nikteb l-isem biex niftakru.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's this tree called? Marija: Cinchona. Its bark contains quinine. Nina: I'll write the name down so I remember it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这棵树叫什么？Marija：金鸡纳树。它的树皮含有奎宁。Nina：我把名字写下来，好记住它。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.zh: 这棵树叫什么？
messages.en: What's this tree called?

messages.speaker: Marija (植物园导游)
messages.zh: 金鸡纳树。它的树皮含有奎宁。
messages.en: Cinchona. Its bark contains quinine.

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.zh: 我把名字写下来，好记住它。
messages.en: I'll write the name down so I remember it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一棵标着“金鸡纳树”的热带树，在树皮旁写上“奎宁”，再给整棵树贴上 ċinkona 标签，用“树木—树皮”的画面记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A belt worn around the waist to hold clothing in place or as an accessory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 系在腰间、用来固定衣物或作装饰的带子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strixxa li tintlibes madwar il-qadd biex iżżomm il-ħwejjeġ f'posthom jew bħala tiżjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腰带；围系在腰间、用于固定衣物或装饰的带子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strixxa li persuna tilbes madwar il-qadd biex iżżomm il-qalziet jew ħwejjeġ oħra f'posthom, jew bħala tiżjin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A belt is a strip worn around your waist to hold clothing in place or to decorate an outfit.

formal.mt: Għall-okkażjoni formali, huwa għażel ċintorin tal-ġilda li jaqbel maż-żraben.
formal.en: For the formal occasion, he chose a leather belt that matched his shoes.
formal.zh: 为了出席正式场合，他选了一条与鞋子相配的皮腰带。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu ċ-ċintorin tiegħi? Anna: Fuq is-siġġu, ħdejn il-qalziet.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is my belt? Anna: On the chair, next to the trousers.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我的腰带在哪里？安娜：在椅子上，裤子旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (丈夫)
messages.zh: 我的腰带在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my belt?

messages.speaker: Anna (妻子)
messages.zh: 在椅子上，裤子旁边。
messages.en: On the chair, next to the trousers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċintorin和“腰间系带”的动作一起记：穿好裤子，再系腰带，朗读ċintorin tal-ġilda。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A belt worn around the waist to secure clothing or decorate an outfit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围系在腰间、用来固定衣物或搭配服装的带子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strixxa li tintlibes madwar il-qadd biex iżżomm il-ħwejjeġ f'posthom jew biex iżżejjen l-ilbies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腰带；系在腰间、用于固定衣物或装饰服装的带子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strixxa li ddur mal-qadd u tintuża biex iżżomm il-ħwejjeġ f'posthom jew biex iżżejjen l-ilbies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A belt is something you fasten around your waist to secure clothing or add decoration to what you wear.

formal.mt: Il-libsa hija mżejna b'ċintra wiesgħa madwar il-qadd.
formal.en: The dress is decorated with a wide belt around the waist.
formal.zh: 这条连衣裙的腰间配有一条宽腰带作为装饰。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din iċ-ċintra tmur ma' din il-libsa? Lara: Iva, il-kulur jaqbel ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this belt go with this dress? Lara: Yes, the colour matches very well.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这条腰带配这条连衣裙吗？拉拉：配，颜色很协调。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din iċ-ċintra tmur ma' din il-libsa?
messages.mt_standard: Din iċ-ċintra tmur ma' din il-libsa?
messages.zh: 这条腰带配这条连衣裙吗？
messages.en: Does this belt go with this dress?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.zh: 配，颜色很协调。
messages.en: Yes, the colour matches very well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给连衣裙配上一条宽腰带，把ċintra wiesgħa整组记住；用“宽腰带”的画面帮助回忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A child's toy that spins while balanced on its pointed end.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以尖端支撑并旋转的儿童玩具，即陀螺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġugarell tat-tfal li jdur fuq il-ponta tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陀螺；能够以尖端为支点旋转的儿童玩具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġugarell li t-tfal idawru fuq il-ponta tiegħu u li jibqa' wieqaf waqt li jdur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A top is a child's toy that balances on its pointed end while spinning.

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività, kull tifel ipprova jdawwar ċippitotu tal-injam fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: During the activity, each boy tried to spin a wooden top on the table.
formal.zh: 活动期间，每个男孩都试着让一个木陀螺在桌上转起来。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Ara kemm qed idur malajr iċ-ċippitotu! Nina: Ħallini nipprova ndawru jien ukoll.
colloquial.en: Ben: Look how fast the top is spinning! Nina: Let me try spinning it too.
colloquial.zh: 本：看，陀螺转得多快！妮娜：也让我试着转一下。

messages.speaker: Ben (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm qed idur malajr iċ-ċippitotu!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm qed idur malajr iċ-ċippitotu!
messages.zh: 看，陀螺转得多快！
messages.en: Look how fast the top is spinning!

messages.speaker: Nina (妹妹)
messages.zh: 也让我试着转一下。
messages.en: Let me try spinning it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读ċippitotu时想象一个小陀螺在桌上不停旋转；把词的节奏和“转呀转”的画面绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 塞浦路斯的；来自塞浦路斯的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Cyprus or describing someone or something that comes from Cyprus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与塞浦路斯有关的，或用来描述来自塞浦路斯的人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Ċipru jew li ġej minn Ċipru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 塞浦路斯的；与塞浦路斯及其人民或文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Ċipru, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Cypriot is connected with Cyprus, its people, or its culture.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自塞浦路斯的；表示某人或某物以塞浦路斯为来源地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġej minn Ċipru, kemm jekk jirreferi għal persuna kif ukoll għal xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or thing described this way comes from Cyprus.

formal.mt: Student ċiprijott ta preżentazzjoni dwar il-kultura ta' pajjiżu.
formal.en: A Cypriot student gave a presentation about his country's culture.
formal.zh: 一名塞浦路斯学生就自己国家的文化作了报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn hu l-istudent il-ġdid? Pawlu: Hu ċiprijott, minn Ċipru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the new student from? Pawlu: He is Cypriot, from Cyprus.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新来的男同学是哪里人？保罗：他是塞浦路斯人，来自塞浦路斯。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 新来的男同学是哪里人？
messages.en: Where is the new student from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 他是塞浦路斯人，来自塞浦路斯。
messages.en: He is Cypriot, from Cyprus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把Ċipru“塞浦路斯”和student ċiprijott“塞浦路斯学生”配对记忆，用“他来自哪里”的问答巩固形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized group of people who meet to share an interest or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由兴趣或活动相同的人组成、定期聚会的俱乐部或社团。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqda ta' nies li jiltaqgħu biex jaqsmu interess jew jieħdu sehem f'attività komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以杂技、小丑表演等节目供观众观赏的马戏团。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kumpanija ta' artisti li tippreżenta spettakli b'akrobati, buffi u numri oħra ta' divertiment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A circus is a company of performers who entertain audiences with acts such as acrobatics and clowning.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为共同兴趣、娱乐或其他活动而组织起来的俱乐部或社团。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għaqda li l-membri tagħha jiltaqgħu għal interess, divertiment jew attività komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A club is an organization whose members meet to pursue a shared interest or activity.

formal.mt: L-artisti taċ-ċirklu ppreżentaw spettaklu ta' akrobazija quddiem udjenza kbira.
formal.en: The circus performers presented an acrobatic show before a large audience.
formal.zh: 马戏团演员在众多观众面前表演了杂技。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tingħaqad maċ-ċirklu taċ-ċess tagħna? Mark: Iva! Meta tiltaqgħu?
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like to join our chess club? Mark: Yes! When do you meet?
colloquial.zh: Lara：你想加入我们的国际象棋俱乐部吗？Mark：想啊！你们什么时候聚会？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想加入我们的国际象棋俱乐部吗？
messages.en: Would you like to join our chess club?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 想啊！你们什么时候聚会？
messages.en: Yes! When do you meet?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项配成两张学习卡：看到杂技演员就联想“马戏团”，看到会员和共同兴趣就联想“俱乐部”，靠语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The boundary of a circle, or the distance measured all the way around it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圆的边界线，也指沿这条边界绕一周的长度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-linja li ddawwar ċirku, jew it-tul ta' dik il-linja kollha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圆周，即圆的边界线；也指圆周的总长度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-linja magħluqa li tifforma l-konfini ta' ċirku, jew il-kejl tat-tul tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The circumference of a circle is its outer boundary or the total distance around that boundary.

formal.mt: L-istudenti kejlu ċ-ċirkonferenza tal-għatu tond b'tejp tal-kejl u rreġistraw ir-riżultat f'ċentimetri.
formal.en: The students measured the circumference of the round lid with a measuring tape and recorded the result in centimetres.
formal.zh: 学生们用卷尺测量了圆形盖子的周长，并以厘米为单位记录结果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif inkejjel iċ-ċirkonferenza ta' dan l-għatu? Pawlu: Dawwar it-tejp tal-kejl mat-tarf tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do I measure the circumference of this lid? Pawlu: Wrap the measuring tape around its edge.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个盖子的周长怎么量？Pawlu：把卷尺沿着它的边缘绕一圈。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inkejjel iċ-ċirkonferenza ta' dan l-għatu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inkejjel iċ-ċirkonferenza ta' dan l-għatu?
messages.zh: 这个盖子的周长怎么量？
messages.en: How do I measure the circumference of this lid?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 把卷尺沿着它的边缘绕一圈。
messages.en: Wrap the measuring tape around its edge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象卷尺沿圆形盖子的边缘完整绕一圈：走过的边界是圆周，读出的长度就是圆周长，用这个动作记住词义。

gloss_zh: 情况；情形；影响事件的条件

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fact or condition connected with an event or situation that can affect what happens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某件事或某种处境有关、可能影响其发展或处理方式的情况或条件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fatt jew kundizzjoni marbuta ma' ġrajja jew sitwazzjoni li tista' tinfluwenza dak li jiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与事件或处境相关的具体情况、条件或因素。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fatt, kundizzjoni jew aspett ta' sitwazzjoni li jkun marbut ma' ġrajja u jista' jaffettwa kif tiżviluppa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A circumstance is a fact or condition surrounding an event that may influence what happens or how people respond.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ikkunsidra kull ċirkustanza rilevanti qabel ma ħa d-deċiżjoni finali.
formal.en: The committee considered every relevant circumstance before making its final decision.
formal.zh: 委员会在作出最终决定之前，考虑了每一项相关情况。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ħassartu l-laqgħa? David: Minħabba ċirkustanza mhux mistennija: il-kamra mtliet bl-ilma.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you cancel the meeting? David: Because of an unexpected circumstance: the room flooded.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你们为什么取消了会议？David：因为出了意外情况：会议室进水了。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 你们为什么取消了会议？
messages.en: Why did you cancel the meeting?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba ċirkustanza mhux mistennija: il-kamra mtliet bl-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba ċirkustanza mhux mistennija: il-kamra mtliet bl-ilma.
messages.zh: 因为出了意外情况：会议室进水了。
messages.en: Because of an unexpected circumstance: the room flooded.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“什么情况影响了这件事”来提示自己：会议室进水影响开会，进水这一具体情况就是一个 ċirkustanza。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A closed sac in body tissue that contains fluid or other material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体组织内形成的封闭囊状结构，内部含有液体或其他物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Borża magħluqa li tifforma f'tessut tal-ġisem u jkun fiha likwidu jew materjal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 囊肿，指身体组织内形成、含有液体或其他物质的封闭囊状结构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Struttura magħluqa bħal borża f'tessut tal-ġisem, li jkun fiha likwidu jew materjal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cyst is a closed sac that forms in body tissue and contains fluid or other material.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-eżami jiddeskrivi ċista mimlija likwidu u jagħti l-qies tagħha.
formal.en: The examination report describes a fluid-filled cyst and gives its size.
formal.zh: 检查报告描述了一处充满液体的囊肿，并注明了其大小。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fir-rapport hemm il-kelma ċista. Xi tfisser? Rita: Hija borża magħluqa f'tessut tal-ġisem li jkun fiha likwidu jew materjal ieħor.
colloquial.en: Anna: The report contains the word cyst. What does it mean? Rita: It is a closed sac in body tissue that contains fluid or other material.
colloquial.zh: Anna：报告里有“囊肿”这个词，是什么意思？Rita：它是身体组织内的一种封闭囊状结构，里面含有液体或其他物质。

messages.speaker: Anna (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fir-rapport hemm il-kelma ċista. Xi tfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Fir-rapport hemm il-kelma ċista. Xi tfisser?
messages.zh: 报告里有“囊肿”这个词，是什么意思？
messages.en: The report contains the word cyst. What does it mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (医生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija borża magħluqa f'tessut tal-ġisem li jkun fiha likwidu jew materjal ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Hija borża magħluqa f'tessut tal-ġisem li jkun fiha likwidu jew materjal ieħor.
messages.zh: 它是身体组织内的一种封闭囊状结构，里面含有液体或其他物质。
messages.en: It is a closed sac in body tissue that contains fluid or other material.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċista 配上一幅“组织里的封闭小囊袋”示意图，袋内画液体或其他内容物，用形状和内容物一起记住“囊肿”。

gloss_zh: 板条箱；运输用的大箱子

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large, strong box used for storing or transporting goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于存放或运输货物的结实大箱子，常为木制板条箱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kaxxa kbira u b'saħħitha, spiss magħmula mill-injam, li tintuża biex jinħażnu jew jinġarru l-oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于储存或运输货物的大型结实箱子，通常为木制板条箱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċistun huwa kaxxa kbira u b'saħħitha li tintuża għall-ħażna jew għat-trasport ta' oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A crate is a large, strong box in which goods are stored or transported.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema poġġew il-fliexken fiċ-ċistun tal-injam biex jipproteġuhom waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: The workers placed the bottles in the wooden crate to protect them during transport.
formal.zh: 工人们把瓶子放进木制板条箱，以便在运输途中保护它们。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn inpoġġi dan iċ-ċistun? Maja: Ħallih ħdejn il-bieb; niġi ngħinek iġġorru.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where should I put this crate? Maja: Leave it by the door; I'll come and help you carry it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个板条箱放哪儿？玛雅：先放在门边，我来帮你搬。

messages.speaker: Mark (搬家者)
messages.zh: 这个板条箱放哪儿？
messages.en: Where should I put this crate?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallih ħdejn il-bieb; niġi ngħinek iġġorru.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallih ħdejn il-bieb; niġi ngħinek iġġorru.
messages.zh: 先放在门边，我来帮你搬。
messages.en: Leave it by the door; I'll come and help you carry it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċistun 和搬货画面一起记：一个结实的大板条箱，里面装着蔬菜或瓶子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spotted wild cat with a slender body that can run very fast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种身体修长、皮毛有斑点、能够快速奔跑的野生猫科动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal selvaġġ mill-familja tal-qtates, b'ġisem irqiq u pil bit-tikek, li kapaċi jiġri b'veloċità kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猎豹，一种身体修长、皮毛有斑点、以奔跑速度快著称的猫科动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċita hija annimal selvaġġ mill-familja tal-qtates li għandu ġisem irqiq, pil bit-tikek u l-ħila li jiġri malajr ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cheetah is a slender, spotted wild cat that is known for running very fast.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-ġisem irqiq u l-pil bit-tikek taċ-ċita waqt il-lezzjoni dwar l-annimali.
formal.en: The students observed the cheetah's slender body and spotted coat during the lesson about animals.
formal.zh: 在介绍动物的课上，学生们观察了猎豹修长的身体和带斑点的皮毛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara kemm qed tiġri malajr iċ-ċita fil-filmat! Pawlu: Iva, u ara kemm għandha tikek fuq il-pil!
colloquial.en: Lara: Look how fast the cheetah is running in the video! Pawlu: Yes, and look how many spots it has on its coat!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看，视频里的猎豹跑得多快！保罗：是啊，再看它的皮毛上有多少斑点！

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm qed tiġri malajr iċ-ċita fil-filmat!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm qed tiġri malajr iċ-ċita fil-filmat!
messages.zh: 看，视频里的猎豹跑得多快！
messages.en: Look how fast the cheetah is running in the video!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ara kemm għandha tikek fuq il-pil!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ara kemm għandha tikek fuq il-pil!
messages.zh: 是啊，再看它的皮毛上有多少斑点！
messages.en: Yes, and look how many spots it has on its coat!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ċita 时想象一只带斑点的猎豹飞快跑过，把“斑点、细身、快跑”连成画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant genus that includes oranges, lemons, and other related fruit-bearing trees and shrubs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 包括橙、柠檬等果树及灌木的植物属，教学中可理解为柑橘类植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġeneru ta' siġar u arbuxxelli li jagħtu frott bħall-larinġ u l-lumi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柑橘属，包括橙、柠檬等植物的属。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iċ-ċitru huwa ġeneru ta' pjanti li jinkludi siġar u arbuxxelli li jagħtu frott bħall-larinġ u l-lumi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Citrus is the plant genus that includes oranges, lemons, and other closely related fruit-bearing plants.

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien tal-iskola hemm siġar taċ-ċitru, fosthom siġra tal-larinġ u siġra tal-lumi.
formal.en: The school garden contains citrus trees, including an orange tree and a lemon tree.
formal.zh: 学校花园里种有柑橘类果树，其中包括一棵橙树和一棵柠檬树。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'siġar għandek fil-ġnien? Toni: Għandi żewġ siġar taċ-ċitru: waħda tal-lumi u waħda tal-larinġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: What trees do you have in the garden? Toni: I have two citrus trees: a lemon tree and an orange tree.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你花园里种了什么树？托尼：我有两棵柑橘类果树，一棵柠檬树，一棵橙树。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 你花园里种了什么树？
messages.en: What trees do you have in the garden?

messages.speaker: Toni (园主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi żewġ siġar taċ-ċitru: waħda tal-lumi u waħda tal-larinġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi żewġ siġar taċ-ċitru: waħda tal-lumi u waħda tal-larinġ.
messages.zh: 我有两棵柑橘类果树，一棵柠檬树，一棵橙树。
messages.en: I have two citrus trees: a lemon tree and an orange tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċitru 记成花园里的分类牌：牌下同时站着橙树和柠檬树，提示它表示柑橘这一类。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strongly fortified place within or overlooking a town, built for defence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于城镇内部或俯瞰城镇的位置、用于防御的坚固城堡或要塞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post imsaħħaħ b'ħitan u fortifikazzjonijiet, ġewwa belt jew fuq għolja li tħares fuqha, mibni għad-difiża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 城中要塞，位于城镇内部或其上方高处、具有坚固防御设施的堡垒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċittadella hija fortizza ġewwa belt jew f'post għoli fuqha, b'ħitan u strutturi mibnija biex jiddefenduha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A citadel is a strongly fortified place within or above a town, built to defend it.

formal.mt: Il-grupp daħal fiċ-ċittadella u eżamina l-ħitan ħoxnin biex jifhem kif kienet tiddefendi l-belt.
formal.en: The group entered the citadel and examined its thick walls to understand how it used to defend the town.
formal.zh: 小组进入城中要塞，查看厚实的城墙，以了解它过去如何保卫城镇。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Niltaqgħu ħdejn id-daħla taċ-ċittadella? David: Iva, u mbagħad nitilgħu naraw il-veduta minn fuq il-ħitan.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall we meet by the entrance to the citadel? David: Yes, and then we'll go up to see the view from the walls.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们在城堡入口旁见面好吗？戴维：好，然后我们上城墙看看风景。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.zh: 我们在城堡入口旁见面好吗？
messages.en: Shall we meet by the entrance to the citadel?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u mbagħad nitilgħu naraw il-veduta minn fuq il-ħitan.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u mbagħad nitilgħu naraw il-veduta minn fuq il-ħitan.
messages.zh: 好，然后我们上城墙看看风景。
messages.en: Yes, and then we'll go up to see the view from the walls.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ċittadella 时画一座保护城镇的坚固城堡，突出高墙和入口，把词义与防御场景联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to citizens, their responsibilities, or the affairs of their community.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与公民、公民责任或社区公共事务有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam maċ-ċittadini, mar-responsabbiltajiet tagħhom jew mal-affarijiet tal-komunità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公民的；与公民责任或社区公共事务有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda liċ-ċittadini, id-dmirijiet tagħhom jew il-ħajja pubblika tal-komunità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Civic activities and responsibilities concern people as members of a community and their involvement in public life.

formal.mt: Il-programm edukattiv għandu l-għan li jsaħħaħ is-sens ċiviku fost l-istudenti.
formal.en: The educational programme aims to strengthen civic awareness among students.
formal.zh: 该教育项目旨在增强学生的公民意识。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sejjer għal-laqgħa tal-komunità? Mark: Għax inħoss li huwa dmir ċiviku li nieħu sehem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you going to the community meeting? Mark: Because I feel it is a civic duty to take part.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么要去参加社区会议？马克：因为我觉得参与是公民义务。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 你为什么要去参加社区会议？
messages.en: Why are you going to the community meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax inħoss li huwa dmir ċiviku li nieħu sehem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax inħoss li huwa dmir ċiviku li nieħu sehem.
messages.zh: 因为我觉得参与是公民义务。
messages.en: Because I feel it is a civic duty to take part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċiviku 和“社区中的公民”画面相连，再用 dmir ċiviku“公民义务”整组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A round edible seed of a legume, commonly cooked and used in soups, salads, or hummus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鹰嘴豆这种豆科植物的可食用种子，常煮熟用于汤、沙拉或鹰嘴豆泥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żerriegħa tonda u li tittiekel ta' pjanta leguminuża, li spiss tissajjar u tintuża fis-sopop, fl-insalati jew fil-ħummus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鹰嘴豆，指常用于烹饪的圆形可食用豆粒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċiċra hija żerriegħa tonda ta' pjanta leguminuża li tittiekel wara t-tisjir u tintuża f'diversi platti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chickpea is a round edible seed that is cooked and used in dishes such as salads and hummus.

formal.mt: Għal din l-insalata, ħallat iċ-ċiċri mgħollija mat-tadam u ftit żejt taż-żebbuġa.
formal.en: For this salad, mix the boiled chickpeas with tomatoes and a little olive oil.
formal.zh: 制作这道沙拉时，将煮熟的鹰嘴豆与番茄及少许橄榄油拌匀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Waqgħet ċiċra mill-iskutella. Mark: Rajtha. Niġborha jien.
colloquial.en: Maja: A chickpea fell out of the bowl. Mark: I saw it. I'll pick it up.
colloquial.zh: Maja：一粒鹰嘴豆从碗里掉出来了。Mark：我看到了，我来捡。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 一粒鹰嘴豆从碗里掉出来了。
messages.en: A chickpea fell out of the bowl.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我看到了，我来捡。
messages.en: I saw it. I'll pick it up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一粒带小尖嘴的圆豆，把ċiċra贴在这粒豆旁边，再用ċiċri记一碗鹰嘴豆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chemical compound containing the cyanide group, many forms of which are highly poisonous.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含氰基团的化合物，其中许多种类具有剧毒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompost kimiku li fih il-grupp CN, li huwa magħmul minn karbonju u nitroġenu; ħafna minn dawn il-komposti huma velenużi ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 氰化物，含氰基团的一类化合物，其中许多具有剧毒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kompost kimiku li fih il-grupp CN, magħmul minn karbonju u nitroġenu, u li f'ħafna każijiet ikun velenuż ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Cyanide refers to chemical compounds containing the cyanide group, many of which are highly poisonous.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju kkonferma l-preżenza ta' traċċi ta' ċjanur fil-kampjun.
formal.en: The laboratory report confirmed the presence of traces of cyanide in the sample.
formal.zh: 实验室报告确认样本中存在微量氰化物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser ċjanur f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Huwa isem ta' sustanza kimika li tista' tkun velenuża ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does cyanide mean in this text? Pawlu: It is the name of a chemical substance that can be highly poisonous.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这篇文章里的 ċjanur 是什么意思？保罗：它是一种可能具有剧毒的化学物质的名称。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 ċjanur 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does cyanide mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa isem ta' sustanza kimika li tista' tkun velenuża ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa isem ta' sustanza kimika li tista' tkun velenuża ħafna.
messages.zh: 它是一种可能具有剧毒的化学物质的名称。
messages.en: It is the name of a chemical substance that can be highly poisonous.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċjanur 放进“实验报告中的氰化物”这一场景，配合 traċċi ta' ċjanur“微量氰化物”记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The period of a person's life when they are a child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人尚是儿童时的人生阶段，即童年。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-perjodu tal-ħajja meta persuna tkun għadha tifel jew tifla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 童年，指一个人还是孩子时的生活阶段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iż-żmien fil-ħajja ta' persuna meta tkun għadha tifel jew tifla, qabel ma tikber.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person's childhood is the period of their life when they are a child.

formal.mt: Fl-ewwel kapitlu, l-awtur jiddeskrivi ċkunitu u l-ħajja tal-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: In the first chapter, the author describes his childhood and his family life.
formal.zh: 在第一章中，作者描述了自己的童年和家庭生活。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Pawlu ilu jħobb il-baħar? Maja: Iva, minn ċkunitu. Kien imur jgħum ma' missieru.
colloquial.en: Nina: Has Pawlu loved the sea for a long time? Maja: Yes, since his childhood. He used to go swimming with his father.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：保罗喜欢大海已经很久了吗？玛雅：是啊，他从小就喜欢。他以前常和父亲一起去游泳。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗喜欢大海已经很久了吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu loved the sea for a long time?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, minn ċkunitu. Kien imur jgħum ma' missieru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, minn ċkunitu. Kien imur jgħum ma' missieru.
messages.zh: 是啊，他从小就喜欢。他以前常和父亲一起去游泳。
messages.en: Yes, since his childhood. He used to go swimming with his father.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人翻看小时候的照片，把 ċkunitu 与“童年”相连，再整组记住 minn ċkunitu“他自幼”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unpleasantly warm and humid, used to describe weather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容天气温热而潮湿，空气令人感到憋闷不适的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun sħun u umdu b'mod li jġiegħlek tħossok skomdu, meta jingħad għat-temp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闷热潮湿的，指温度和湿度使人感到不舒服的天气。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jingħad għal temp sħun u umdu li fih l-arja tinħass tqila u skomda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If the weather is muggy, it is unpleasantly warm and humid, making the air feel heavy.

formal.mt: Wara jum ċlampu, l-arja saret aktar friska filgħaxija.
formal.en: After a muggy day, the air became cooler in the evening.
formal.zh: 经过闷热潮湿的一天，傍晚的空气变得更凉爽了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-temp illum ċlampu ħafna. Niftħu t-tieqa? Mark: Iva, forsi tidħol ftit arja friska.
colloquial.en: Sara: It is very muggy today. Shall we open the window? Mark: Yes, perhaps some fresh air will come in.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天天气真闷热。我们把窗户打开好吗？马克：好啊，也许能进来一点新鲜空气。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-temp illum ċlampu ħafna. Niftħu t-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: It-temp illum ċlampu ħafna. Niftħu t-tieqa?
messages.zh: 今天天气真闷热。我们把窗户打开好吗？
messages.en: It is very muggy today. Shall we open the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, forsi tidħol ftit arja friska.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, forsi tidħol ftit arja friska.
messages.zh: 好啊，也许能进来一点新鲜空气。
messages.en: Yes, perhaps some fresh air will come in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ċlampu 时想象“热气加湿气，衣服黏着皮肤”，再把 temp ċlampu 作为“闷热天气”整组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small objects around which thread is wound, or pegs used to hold something in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于缠绕线的小轴，也可指用于固定物体的小桩或销。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti żgħar li madwarhom jitgeżwer il-ħajt, jew biċċiet żgħar li jintużaw biex iżommu xi ħaġa f'postha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绕线轴，用于缠绕和存放线的小轴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti żgħar li madwarhom jitgeżwer il-ħajt biex jinżamm miġbur u jkun jista' jintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bobbins are small objects around which thread is wound for storage or use.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绕线轴，即供线缠绕其上的小轴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir li madwaru jitgeżwer il-ħajt biex jinżamm miġbur u jkun jista' jintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bobbin is a small object that holds thread wound around it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小桩或固定销，用于将物体固定在适当位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċiet żgħar u dojoq li jintużaw biex iwaħħlu xi ħaġa jew iżommuha f'postha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pegs are small pieces used to fasten things or hold them in position.

formal.mt: Qabel tibda taħdem il-bizzilla, irranġa ċ-ċombini u kun żgur li l-ħajt ma jkunx imħabbel.
formal.en: Before you begin making lace, arrange the bobbins and make sure the thread is not tangled.
formal.zh: 开始制作花边之前，请摆好绕线轴，并确保线没有缠结。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn qegħdin iċ-ċombini tal-ħajt? Marija: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-mejda. Ħu dawk li għandek bżonn.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where are the bobbins of thread? Marija: In the box beside the table. Take the ones you need.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：那些缠着线的绕线轴在哪里？玛丽娅：在桌子旁边的盒子里。拿你需要的就好。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 那些缠着线的绕线轴在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the bobbins of thread?

messages.speaker: Marija (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-mejda. Ħu dawk li għandek bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-mejda. Ħu dawk li għandek bżonn.
messages.zh: 在桌子旁边的盒子里。拿你需要的就好。
messages.en: In the box beside the table. Take the ones you need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一盒缠着彩线的小轴，用画面记住 ċombini；遇到“小桩、固定销”的义项时另配固定物体的画面，避免混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large number considered together, or a gang of people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聚在一起的一大群，也可指结成一帮的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd kbir meqjus flimkien, jew grupp ta' nies li jkunu jew jaġixxu flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量；一大群，强调数量多。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għadd kbir ta' nies jew affarijiet meqjusa flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A large number is a quantity containing many people or things.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一帮人；结成一伙或一起活动的一群人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies li jiltaqgħu, joqogħdu jew jaġixxu flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gang is a group of people who gather or act together.

formal.mt: Ċorma nies inġabret quddiem il-mużew qabel ma nfetħu l-bibien.
formal.en: A large crowd gathered in front of the museum before the doors opened.
formal.zh: 博物馆开门之前，一大群人聚集在门前。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm daqshekk storbju barra? Pawlu: Hemm ċorma tfal jilagħbu fil-bitħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there so much noise outside? Pawlu: There's a large group of children playing in the courtyard.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：外面怎么这么吵？保罗：有一大群孩子在院子里玩。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 外面怎么这么吵？
messages.en: Why is there so much noise outside?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 有一大群孩子在院子里玩。
messages.en: There's a large group of children playing in the courtyard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċorma 和“一大群人挤在一起”的画面绑定；搭配 nies 记人群，搭配 tfal 记孩子群，再联系“一帮人”的义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun given the meaning 'Skibidi', with no more specific referent stated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 释义为“Skibidi”的名词，其具体所指未作进一步说明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom mogħti bit-tifsira 'Skibidi', mingħajr ma jkun speċifikat aktar għal xiex jirreferi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Skibidi；此义项的具体所指未进一步说明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija għal dan in-nom hija 'Skibidi', iżda ma hemmx spjegazzjoni aktar preċiża ta' dak li jirreferi għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Here, ċuff is a noun meaning 'Skibidi', although its specific referent is not explained.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-vokabolarju, l-istudent kiteb il-kelma 'ċuff' ħdejn it-tifsira 'Skibidi'.
formal.en: In the vocabulary exercise, the student wrote the word 'ċuff' beside the meaning 'Skibidi'.
formal.zh: 在词汇练习中，学生把“ċuff”写在释义“Skibidi”旁边。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'tifsira għandek miktuba għal 'ċuff'? Mark: Għandi 'Skibidi', iżda ma nafx eżatt għal xiex jirreferi.
colloquial.en: Nina: What meaning have you written down for 'ċuff'? Mark: I've got 'Skibidi', but I don't know exactly what it refers to.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你给“ċuff”记下的释义是什么？马克：我记的是“Skibidi”，但还不清楚它具体指什么。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你给“ċuff”记下的释义是什么？
messages.en: What meaning have you written down for 'ċuff'?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi 'Skibidi', iżda ma nafx eżatt għal xiex jirreferi.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi 'Skibidi', iżda ma nafx eżatt għal xiex jirreferi.
messages.zh: 我记的是“Skibidi”，但还不清楚它具体指什么。
messages.en: I've got 'Skibidi', but I don't know exactly what it refers to.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张正面为 ċuff、背面为 Skibidi 的配对卡，只记住当前给出的对应关系，暂不添加具体形象或其他词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small object around which thread is wound for storage or use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于缠绕线的小轴，便于存放线或在工作时取用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir li madwaru jitgeżwer il-ħajt biex jinżamm miġbur u jkun jista' jintuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绕线轴，供线缠绕在其上的小轴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir li jżomm il-ħajt imgeżwer madwaru għall-ħażna jew għall-użu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bobbin is a small object that holds thread wound around it.

collocations.en: to wind thread around a bobbin

formal.mt: Poġġi ċ-ċumbin fuq il-mejda u geżwer il-ħajt madwaru b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: Place the bobbin on the table and carefully wind the thread around it.
formal.zh: 把绕线轴放在桌子上，小心地把线缠在上面。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tgħaddili ċ-ċumbin tal-ħajt? Toni: Iva, hawn hu. Trid ukoll l-imqass?
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you pass me the bobbin of thread? Toni: Yes, here it is. Do you want the scissors too?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：能把那个缠着线的绕线轴递给我吗？托尼：可以，给你。你还要剪刀吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 能把那个缠着线的绕线轴递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me the bobbin of thread?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn hu. Trid ukoll l-imqass?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn hu. Trid ukoll l-imqass?
messages.zh: 可以，给你。你还要剪刀吗？
messages.en: Yes, here it is. Do you want the scissors too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手里拿着一个缠满线的小轴，一边做缠线动作一边读 ċumbin，再用 ċumbin tal-ħajt 整组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ring given to someone as a sign of a promise to marry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 赠予对方、表示双方承诺结婚的戒指。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċurkett li jingħata lil persuna bħala sinjal tal-wegħda li jiżżewġu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 订婚戒指，表示承诺结婚而赠予对方的戒指。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċurkett li persuna tagħti lil oħra bħala sinjal li beħsiebhom jiżżewġu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An engagement ring is a ring that someone gives their partner to show that they have agreed to marry.

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċelebrazzjoni tal-għerusija, Sara wriet lill-familja ċ-ċurkett tal-għerusija li kien taha Daniel.
formal.en: During the engagement celebration, Sara showed her family the engagement ring that Daniel had given her.
formal.zh: 在订婚庆祝活动上，萨拉向家人展示了丹尼尔送给她的订婚戒指。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan iċ-ċurkett tal-għerusija tiegħek? Sara: Iva, Daniel tahuli lbieraħ. Maja: Kemm hu sabiħ! Awguri!
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this your engagement ring? Sara: Yes, Daniel gave it to me yesterday. Maja: It's so beautiful! Congratulations!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是你的订婚戒指吗？萨拉：是的，丹尼尔昨天送给我的。玛雅：真漂亮！恭喜！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是你的订婚戒指吗？
messages.en: Is this your engagement ring?

messages.speaker: Sara (准新娘)
messages.zh: 是的，丹尼尔昨天送给我的。
messages.en: Yes, Daniel gave it to me yesterday.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 真漂亮！恭喜！
messages.en: It's so beautiful! Congratulations!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语放进“答应求婚、收到戒指”的画面中记忆：ċurkett tal-għerusija 对应订婚戒指，再与婚礼时使用的 ċurkett taż-żwieġ 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ring worn as a sign that a person is married.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示佩戴者已婚身份或婚姻关系的戒指。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċurkett li jintlibes bħala sinjal li persuna hija miżżewġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结婚戒指，作为婚姻关系象征而佩戴的戒指。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċurkett li persuna miżżewġa tilbes bħala simbolu taż-żwieġ tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wedding ring is a ring that a person wears as a symbol of their marriage.

collocations.en: to take off the wedding ring

formal.mt: Qabel beda x-xogħol fil-laboratorju, Mark neħħa ċ-ċurkett taż-żwieġ u poġġieh f'kaxxa żgħira.
formal.en: Before starting work in the laboratory, Mark took off his wedding ring and placed it in a small box.
formal.zh: 开始在实验室工作之前，马克摘下结婚戒指，把它放进一个小盒子里。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Rajt iċ-ċurkett taż-żwieġ tiegħi? Lara: Iva, ħallejtu ħdejn is-sink. Mark: Sibthu, grazzi!
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you seen my wedding ring? Lara: Yes, you left it beside the sink. Mark: I've found it, thanks!
colloquial.zh: 马克：你看见我的结婚戒指了吗？拉拉：看见了，你把它放在水槽旁边了。马克：找到了，谢谢！

messages.speaker: Mark (丈夫)
messages.zh: 你看见我的结婚戒指了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen my wedding ring?

messages.speaker: Lara (妻子)
messages.zh: 看见了，你把它放在水槽旁边了。
messages.en: Yes, you left it beside the sink.

messages.speaker: Mark (丈夫)
messages.zh: 找到了，谢谢！
messages.en: I've found it, thanks!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“婚礼交换戒指、婚后继续佩戴”的场景记住 ċurkett taż-żwieġ；把它与求婚订婚场景中的 ċurkett tal-għerusija 成对练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sweet substance that you chew without swallowing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放在嘴里咀嚼而不吞咽的甜味胶状食品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza ħelwa li tomgħodha f'ħalqek mingħajr ma tiblagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口香糖，供咀嚼而非吞咽的胶状食品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sustanza li ġeneralment tkun ħelwa u li tinżamm fil-ħalq biex tintmagħad mingħajr ma tinbela'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Chewing gum is a substance, usually sweet, that you chew in your mouth without swallowing it.

formal.mt: Skont ir-regoli tal-klassi, l-istudenti ma jistgħux jomogħdu ċ-ċuwingam waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: According to the classroom rules, students may not chew gum during the lesson.
formal.zh: 根据课堂规定，学生上课时不得嚼口香糖。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid biċċa ċuwingam? Pawlu: Iva, grazzi. Bla zokkor? Nina: Iva, u għandu togħma ta' nagħniegħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Would you like a piece of chewing gum? Pawlu: Yes, thanks. Is it sugar-free? Nina: Yes, and it's mint-flavoured.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：要来一块口香糖吗？保罗：好，谢谢。是无糖的吗？妮娜：是的，还是薄荷味的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 要来一块口香糖吗？
messages.en: Would you like a piece of chewing gum?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，谢谢。是无糖的吗？
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Is it sugar-free?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għandu togħma ta' nagħniegħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għandu togħma ta' nagħniegħ.
messages.zh: 是的，还是薄荷味的。
messages.en: Yes, and it's mint-flavoured.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友递来一块口香糖，边做咀嚼动作边说 ċuwingam；再把 biċċa ċuwingam（一块口香糖）作为完整短语反复练习。

gloss_zh: 惊呆的；震惊得一时反应不过来的

teaching_sense.en_definition: So shocked or surprised that one is temporarily unable to react.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因震惊或意外而一时发愣、难以作出反应的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun tant maħsud jew sorpriż li għal ftit ħin ma jkunx jaf kif jirreaġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惊呆的；因震惊或意外而一时反应不过来的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun tant maħsud jew sorpriż li għal ftit ħin jibqa' bla reazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is stunned, they are so shocked or surprised that they cannot react immediately.

formal.mt: Meta sema' l-aħbar mhux mistennija, ir-raġel baqa' ċċassat għal ftit mumenti.
formal.en: When he heard the unexpected news, the man was stunned for a few moments.
formal.zh: 听到这个意外的消息后，那名男子惊呆了片刻。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex bqajt ċċassat meta qrajt il-messaġġ? David: Għax ma stennejtx li rbaħt il-premju!
colloquial.en: Marta: Why were you stunned when you read the message? David: Because I didn't expect to have won the prize!
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你看了消息后怎么惊呆了？戴维：因为我没想到自己竟然获奖了！

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex bqajt ċċassat meta qrajt il-messaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex bqajt ċċassat meta qrajt il-messaġġ?
messages.zh: 你看了消息后怎么惊呆了？
messages.en: Why were you stunned when you read the message?

messages.speaker: David (获奖者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma stennejtx li rbaħt il-premju!
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma stennejtx li rbaħt il-premju!
messages.zh: 因为我没想到自己竟然获奖了！
messages.en: Because I didn't expect to have won the prize!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读到意外获奖消息后愣住的表情，把整个画面配上baqa' ċċassat，记住“惊呆了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Well known and admired for achievements or qualities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因成就或特质而广为人知、受到赞誉的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħruf u ammirat minn ħafna nies minħabba l-kisbiet jew il-kwalitajiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 著名且受到广泛赞誉的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li hu magħruf ħafna u mfaħħar għall-kisbiet jew għall-kwalitajiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A celebrated person is widely known and admired for their achievements or particular qualities.

formal.mt: Il-mużew organizza wirja tax-xogħlijiet ta' artist ċċelebrat.
formal.en: The museum organized an exhibition of works by a celebrated artist.
formal.zh: 博物馆举办了一位著名艺术家的作品展。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-palk? Pawlu: Hu kittieb ċċelebrat. Qrajt żewġ kotba tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that man beside the stage? Pawlu: He is a celebrated writer. I've read two of his books.
colloquial.zh: Maja：舞台旁边那个男人是谁？Pawlu：他是一位备受赞誉的作家。我读过他的两本书。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-palk?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-palk?
messages.zh: 舞台旁边那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man beside the stage?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu kittieb ċċelebrat. Qrajt żewġ kotba tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Hu kittieb ċċelebrat. Qrajt żewġ kotba tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他是一位备受赞誉的作家。我读过他的两本书。
messages.en: He is a celebrated writer. I've read two of his books.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位作家登台时，大家既认得他又赞赏他的作品：用这个画面记住 ċċelebrat 的“著名且备受赞誉”。
